title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
description: In the criminal justice system, sexually-based offenses are considered especially heinous. In New York City, the dedicated detectives who investigate these vicious felonies are members of an elite squad known as the Special Victims Unit. These are their stories.

episodes.title: Payback
episodes.description: Detectives Stabler and Benson investigate the murder and dismemberment of a taxi driver; the team discovers that he may have been a vicious Serbian war criminal living in the United States under a false identity.

episodes.title: A Single Life
episodes.description: Benson and Stabler run into multiple dead ends while investigating the case of a woman who plummeted six stories to her death clad only in a slip.

episodes.title: ...Or Just Look Like One
episodes.description: When a teen model is murdered and another is left for dead at a hospital emergency room, the team uncovers an insidious drug and sex conspiracy in the world of high fashion. Benson and Stabler enter into a modeling underworld of thoughtless parents, drug-dealing doctors and a trendy agency executive.

episodes.title: Hysteria
episodes.description: When a young African-American woman is found dead, she is initially believed to be a prostitute and the latest in a long line of victims, but when looking into her home life Benson and Stabler realize that she does not fit the pattern, and may not be connected to the other deaths after all, but the other deaths have a connection no one anticipated.

episodes.title: Wanderlust
episodes.description: When a world-traveling author is found dead in a room he rented from an alcoholic woman and her precocious 14-year-old daughter, the detectives are shocked to discover who the murderer is.

episodes.title: Sophomore Jinx
episodes.description: A female student at an upper-class university is raped and murdered, and two of the college's basketball stars are suspected. However, the college blocks their investigation at every turn because they are not willing to risk the negative publicity that the investigation could bring to the school and the upcoming championship.

episodes.title: Uncivilized
episodes.description: When a young boy is found raped and murdered in a field, suspicion leads detectives to a recently paroled child molester who lives in the neighborhood.. Although they both hate what the man has done in the past, it is soon obvious to the detectives that the teenagers who initially steered them in the man's direction are hiding secrets of their own.

episodes.title: Stalked
episodes.description: When an assistant district attorney is found raped and murdered in Central Park, the Special Victims Unit learn that she'd been stalked by a real estate agent whom she'd convicted of date rape. Benson lets her emotions get the best of her as she takes it upon herself to bring the suspected rapist to justice. Stabler tries to get the man's business partner to help him, but Benson may be the one who ends up needing help.

episodes.title: Stocks & Bondage
episodes.description: An investment analyst is found hanged in her bedroom, and the Special Victims Unit explores her sordid sexual past to uncover her murderer's identity. The team uncovers the world of bondage and sado-masochism where they first investigate the woman's colleagues but are soon on the trail of a host of individuals involved in the world of whips and chains.

episodes.title: Closure
episodes.description: When a woman is raped, she turns to the Special Victims Unit for help, but lack of evidence prevents them from apprehending the criminal. When the detectives revisit the case a few months later, they find the woman even less willing to talk about what happened, as she claims she has moved on. Things turn sticky when Benson and Cassidy spend the night together.

episodes.title: Bad Blood
episodes.description: A moral coalition leader's gay son is found murdered on the roof of his apartment building. Initially, Benson and Stabler investigate his father, a Conservative well-known for his homophobic viewpoints, but once they start looking into the young man's living arrangements they realize the person they're looking for may be closer than they think. Munch tries to help Benson find the man who raped her mother, and could potentially be her father.

episodes.title: Russian Love Poem
episodes.description: When a multi-millionaire is found strangled in his home, Benson and Stabler turn their suspicion to his long list of lovers, which includes both men and women. Detectives discover he was involved with a group of beautiful Russian women that came to the U.S. to take advantage of wealthy Americans.

episodes.title: Disrobed
episodes.description: A judge who fought for the rights of abused women is found shot in his car under sordid circumstances, and the detectives uncover a case of corruption that leads to the state parole board. The team soon turns their eye to a battered wife with a secret.

episodes.title: Limitations
episodes.description: At the request of a victim, the police commissioner comes to Cragen with a special request -- close the five-year-old case of a serial rapist before the statute of limitations expires. The detectives finally get a lead but the investigation is hindered by one of the victims.

episodes.title: Entitled (I)
episodes.description:
After a salesman is murdered, the detectives turn their attention to the youngest daughter of a well-known family with some deep connections. But as they join forces with the officers from the two-seven, they realize that their case is connected with a long-unsolved case that Briscoe once handled years ago with his former partner Mike Logan.

The crossover continues in Law & Order S10E14 Entitled (II).

episodes.title: The Third Guy
episodes.description: An elderly woman is found tied up and sexually assaulted in her apartment, and suspicion is initially on the young men that had broken into her home and robbed her, but once the detectives are surprised to learn that the rape was committed after the robbery – by someone else.

episodes.title: Misleader
episodes.description: The pregnant daughter-in-law of a Christian College president is murdered in her hotel room, and the detectives discover that the man had been involved in some very unholy activities.

episodes.title: Chat Room
episodes.description: When a teenage girl comes into the squad room to tell the detectives that she was raped by a man she met on the Internet, the investigation leads the Special Victims Unit to a network of pedophiles and child pornographers.

episodes.title: Contact
episodes.description: After seven young women in a six month time span are raped by a flash and dash assailant on the city subways, the brass calls in a psychiatrist to help the team get into the head of the perp. When he is caught, he possesses the driver's license of a new victim who could put him away.

episodes.title: Remorse
episodes.description: A female television news reporter decides to go public with her story when she attacked and raped by two men, but the decision proves to be fatal.

episodes.title: Nocturne
episodes.description: After a pharmacy turns over some disturbing photos of a young boy, a beloved neighborhood piano teacher is suspected of being a sexual predator who takes advantage of his innocent young students.

episodes.title: Slaves
episodes.description: A Romanian immigrant is being held as a psychological prisoner by her abusive employer and his wife, who is also traumatized by years of abuse and is willing to commit murder to protect her husband. A forensic psychologist analyzes the team, and presents disturbing findings to Cragen, suggesting that one of the detectives be removed from the team.

episodes.title: Wrong Is Right
episodes.description: Stabler's daughter bears witness to a horrific crime scene: a rocket scientist found dead with his crotch on fire. The scientist had strong ties to government security and detectives must determine if that had something to do with his demise. The internal investigation into the psyches of the SVU detectives yields interesting results.

episodes.title: Honor
episodes.description: The vicious sexual assault and brutal beating of an Afghan diplomat's daughter uncovers clues that may suggest Taliban traditions justify 'honor killings' when the child defies the wishes of their parents or their culture; the trail leads close to home.

episodes.title: Closure (2)
episodes.description: Stabler and Benson investigate a sexual assault very similar to one they worked six months ago whose victim follows her alleged attacked and reports his activities to the police.

episodes.title: Legacy
episodes.description: An abused 7-year-old girl lays comatose as the detectives investigate members of her dysfunctional family to determine the source of the abuse, in a case that hits close to home for Munch.

episodes.title: Baby Killer
episodes.description: The tragic shooting death of a young girl leads investigators to a little boy, and they soon realize that the gun used has been used in another crime scene and a drug ring using young kids as pawns.

episodes.title: Noncompliance
episodes.description: The question of patients' rights surfaces when a schizophrenic man refusing to take his medication is suspected in the rape and stabbing death of an aspiring psychologist, whose body is found in a convenience store.

episodes.title: Asunder
episodes.description: It's a classic case of "he said, she said" when a cop's wife charges him with rape. The truth behind the alleged rape comes to light when a history of domestic abuse is uncovered.

episodes.title: Taken
episodes.description: The case of a seventeen-year-old rape victim during a gala for the opening of a luxury hotel takes a strange turn when her immediate family tries to keep the scandal quiet. Detectives soon discover that the girl isn't the innocent that she pretends to be. Benson struggles to deal with her mother's death and she learns about her past.

episodes.title: Pixies
episodes.description: The investigation of a young gymnast's murder involves her strict trainer, a wealthy benefactor and a competitor. Detectives must look into her pressured lifestyle to find out who did it.

episodes.title: Consent
episodes.description: A college co-ed is found raped and dazed after a frat party, but can't remember anything that happened. The detectives then find that she had a date rape drug in her system, leaving them with many suspects and accomplices, tho the victim is reluctant to press charges.

episodes.title: Abuse
episodes.description: Parental neglect may have led to the tragic death of the son of two famous singers, leading them to fear for his sister. Benson develops a strong attachment to the girl who has a history of serious injuries.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.description: An exceptional teacher, who helped inner city kids get into college, led a dangerous double life as a sex addict. When she is murdered, there is a long list of suspects but the case hits a snag after the woman's illicit sexual history is exposed.

episodes.title: Victims
episodes.description: A former police officer, now a community activist, is a suspect in the murders of known sex offenders, all of whom share a certain characteristic that scars their victims for life. The detectives find it's difficult to protect potential victims when they used to be perps as they investigate the murders of two convicted rapists.

episodes.title: Paranoia
episodes.description: The mysterious rape of a veteran police officer, who trained Benson, is first linked to her ex-husband's gambling debts, and then to her fellow officers. It turns into a nightmare investigation as the IAB tries to thwart the SVU squad's efforts.

episodes.title: Countdown
episodes.description: The detectives become a little edgy after working around the clock to find an abducted girl when clues point to a serial murderer and rapist who kills his victims on the third day. After trapping the killer, they are prepared to give him the death penalty until they find out that one of his victims was never found and he offers her location as a plea bargain.

episodes.title: Runaway
episodes.description: The search for an out-of-state police officer's runaway daughter leads the detectives through an underground rave culture that caters to wayward teens. They use an Internet journalist to track her and their search is seen through the eyes of the squad room personnel as told in their interviews with the Internal Affairs division.

episodes.title: Folly
episodes.description: Male escorts are assaulted and one is murdered, and the police have a tough time finding the bizarre couple whose sexual fantasy has turned violent. The investigation uncovers a dangerous male escort service where the boss may have reasons for sending her staff on potentially deadly dates.

episodes.title: Manhunt
episodes.description: The details of a kidnapping are similar to a series of rapes and murders that may link the crime to a serial killer.

episodes.title: Parasites
episodes.description: The remains of a Romanian woman are found three years after her death, buried in an apartment courtyard with a collar and leash. The detectives have a tough time finding the killer until a composite photo leads them to the victim's identical twin sister.

episodes.title: Pique
episodes.description: Observed by an FBI psychiatrist, the detectives uncover a horrifying motive for the slaying of a software company employee by a fired colleague when they learn of the suspect's bizarre relationship with his overbearing mother and a strange sexual fetish called piquerism.

episodes.title: Scourge
episodes.description: A "Jack the Ripper" type murderer, who justifies his crimes with paranoid religious motivation set on by a rapidly deteriorating medical condition, is on the loose. After a citywide manhunt, Detectives Benson and Stabler are tasked with finding the killer.

episodes.title: Repression
episodes.description: An 18-year-old girl is aided by her therapist in recalling repressed memories of childhood molestation by her father and reports the incest to Benson and Stabler in hopes of sparing her younger sisters the same fate. She brings charges of rape against her father who winds up murdered when those charges are dismissed.

episodes.title: Wrath
episodes.description: The detectives investigate three murders that seemingly have no connection to each other, but each murder has ties to Benson's previous cases. As they join with the FBI to investigate, the detectives worry that Benson is the intended target.

episodes.title: Stolen
episodes.description: The kidnapping of an infant at a grocery store leads to an illegal adoption ring and the long lost closure of a case from 12 years prior of a murdered mother and missing baby which involved Capt. Cragen and his partner, the late Max Greevey.

episodes.title: Rooftop
episodes.description: When an HIV-positive male, with a record of assaulting underage girls, is discovered in a sexual clincher with a young woman on a rooftop, the detectives are determined to put him back inside. After a series of rapes and murders of young African-American women cannot be traced to him though, they begin to wonder if they've been looking at the wrong suspect.

episodes.title: Tangled
episodes.description: When arriving party guests find a prominent doctor beaten to death and his wife raped, the detectives have a parade of suspects and the realization that the wife was the intended victim.

episodes.title: Redemption
episodes.description: A string of murders leads detectives to question an initial suspect, the Soho Strangler, but they realize he might have been the wrong person all along.

episodes.title: Sacrifice
episodes.description: A man, who is shot and raped outside a gay bar, initially doesn't want to cooperate to find his shooter. When he finally does, the investigation leads to his family and turns his life upside down.

episodes.title: Inheritance
episodes.description: A series of brutal rapes and attacks on Asian women lead the police to a suspect who was himself a product of rape - his father being a rapist who was convicted. The question is brought to court of whether his genetic make-up was responsible for the crimes.

episodes.title: Care
episodes.description: The battered body of a five-year-old girl in foster care is discovered and suspicion soon turns to members of the girl's foster family as well as to the girl's biological mother; who is the real guilty party and who is only a red herring?

episodes.title: Ridicule
episodes.description: What appears as a bizarre accidental death leads to a case involving a male stripper who claims that the deceased was one of three powerful women who raped him at a bachelorette party.

episodes.title: Monogamy
episodes.description: The pregnant wife of a psychiatrist is found in a parking garage, unconscious and bleeding from a gaping abdominal wound with her fetus missing. The investigation leads to infedility and uncertainty as to the paternity, adding fuel to the fire of an already agitated Stabler.

episodes.title: Protection
episodes.description: A 6-year-old boy wounded in a shooting is brought to the ER but abandoned by his brother, who reported it, and their mother, who fears for her own life. The case leads the detectives to a woman who is on the run from an abusive drug-dealer boyfriend.

episodes.title: Prodigy
episodes.description: Two people are found murdered in the park, including an animal rights activist who has been raped and then decapitated. Benson and Stabler must determine which of their two main suspects -- a sociopathic teenager and a recently paroled rapist -- is responsible for the murder.

episodes.title: Counterfeit
episodes.description: A woman is found raped and killed by her car. Then, a similar rape is committed and the victim says that a police officer raped her after pulling her over for a supposed driving violation. This leads police to look at one of their own, until they realize the suspect is not who they think he is.

episodes.title: Execution
episodes.description: Detective Stabler and Dr. Huang question a convicted serial killer on death row, hours before his execution, with the hope of solving an old murder case for the sake of the victim's parents. The investigation goes haywire with mixed results.

episodes.title: Popular
episodes.description: Stabler's wife tells him that her friend, a high school nurse, treated a young girl for rape. Despite being advised not to find out further details, Stabler, with help from Benson, crack open the case to disturbing details.

episodes.title: Surveillance
episodes.description: An accomplished cellist is raped in her own apartment and the detectives are lead to a stalker who uses surveillance equipment and has been watching her every move.

episodes.title: Guilt
episodes.description: When A.D.A. Cabot is faced with a reluctant teenage witness in a child molestation case, she goes above and beyond the normal scope of duty in her search for evidence to convict the serial abuser. But her passion supercedes her compliance with the law, jeopardizing not only her case, but the careers of all involved.

episodes.title: Justice
episodes.description: A rebellious 16-year-old teenager is raped and murdered; the case becomes complex when they learn that her stepfather is a judge with whom she has had major problems.

episodes.title: Greed
episodes.description: Investigating the rape of the wife of a restaurateur during a robbery, leads the detectives to a similar assault, and to a locksmith.

episodes.title: Denial
episodes.description: When a heroin junkie is found raped, Tutuola takes an interest in her, but he's not the only one. The case turns into a bizarre murder investigation when the finger of a small child is found in the victim's purse opening a can of worms that spans back thirteen years.

episodes.title: Competence
episodes.description: A mentally challenged girl with Down's Syndrome is pregnant, and the question is, was she raped or did she consent and is she competent enough to keep her child?

episodes.title: Silence
episodes.description: A murder in a church of a young cross-dresser leads Benson and Stabler to an alleged cover-up involving sexual child abuse by a priest.

episodes.title: Chameleon
episodes.description: The detectives are on the trail of a recently paroled rapist responsible for the murder of a prostitute during a raid at a men's club and are called to the scene where he was shot in self defense by his own gun. However, the murder weapon was also used in another crime while he was still in prison, leading the detectives to investigate the victim through a trail of previously unsolved cases, a spending spree and another victim. They uncover a more serious criminal in the process.

episodes.title: Deception
episodes.description: A family portrait painted by a kindergartner leads the detectives to investigate her mother for child sexual abuse of her teenage stepson. When the boy's father is found murdered, the focus of the investigation shifts to the boy -- and his stepmother goes to great lengths to protect him and prevent the detectives from learning the truth.

episodes.title: Vulnerable
episodes.description: When an elderly woman with Alzheimer's breaks into an apartment, the detectives discover she had been abused, triggering memories of similar crimes from her childhood. They discover that she had been released from a nursing home to the custody of her financially scheming son who becomes the prime suspect. However, they go back to the nursing home to find a pair of suspects; the real crime is what's being done to the elderly.

episodes.title: Lust
episodes.description: A public health doctor, the wife of a retired attorney, who tracked HIV cases is found murdered and raped in Central Park. Her work involved contacting sexual partners of HIV patients which gives the detectives a long list of suspects and the detectives try to link threatening phone calls to the crime. The discovery of a second body in Central Park with the same signature shifts the focus to a possible serial killer.

episodes.title: Disappearing Acts
episodes.description: A high-powered executive is raped, but the situation is complicated by her involvement with the Feds and the Russian mob - as well as a father-son duo who are in the federal witness protection program and an agent who appears bound and determined to protect them, regardless of consequence.

episodes.title: Angels
episodes.description: A battered young boy suffocates while hiding in the luggage compartment of an airport shuttle bus and it leads the detectives to his guardian and into the investigation of a perverted child molestation ring.

episodes.title: Dolls
episodes.description: Detectives try and solve the gruesome murder of a sexually molested five-year-old girl whose killer, a serial pedophile, has an obsession with dolls. They race to save the life of his latest victim.

episodes.title: Waste
episodes.description: The Detectives investigate the rape of a woman who's been in a coma for a year, and after eliminating a huge pool of suspects, they make a startling discovery.

episodes.title: Juvenile
episodes.description: A cancer patient, who was growing marijuana in her apartment and selling it, is found raped and murdered, sending the detectives on a hunt for two middle school students, each blaming the other.

episodes.title: Resilience
episodes.description: A 14-year-old girl tries to commit suicide by jumping in front of a train after she is raped. She falsely accuses an ex-boyfriend but when the search turns to her dysfunctional family, surprise discoveries are made and SVU discovers that the family is even worse off than they thought.

episodes.title: Damaged
episodes.description: A six-year-old girl is critically injured in an apparent robbery-gone-bad and later dies. The investigation gets complicated when it is discovered that the murders were designed to silence the young girl, who was sexually abused.

episodes.title: Risk
episodes.description: An infant ingests pure cocaine disguised in baby formula, uncovering a complicated narcotics ring with unlikely participants and the entire squad goes undercover to flush them out.

episodes.title: Rotten
episodes.description: In their investigation of a prisoner's death, Benson and Tutuola learn that he was sexually assaulted before being incarcerated and since it happened while in custody, the police are suspected.

episodes.title: Mercy
episodes.description: When the body of a 1-month-old baby girl is found stuffed inside a cooler, the detectives are horrified. But they soon learn that the baby had a genetic disorder known as Tay-Sachs disease, and it may have been a mercy killing.

episodes.title: Pandora
episodes.description: The brutal rape, and subsequent death, of a female motorist turns out to be an undercover FBI informant acting as a cyber vigilante for catching online pedophiles to capture the predator trafficking internet porn. The detectives find the victim's husband murdered and follow the trail of evidence for the latest victim she had been tracking, which ​turns into an international case of teenage prostitution, with ties to the Czech Republic.

episodes.title: Tortured
episodes.description: A Tibetan woman who was tortured in her home country is found murdered, with her foot missing, and after an exhaustive search of potential suspects, the killer is a victim of torture himself.

episodes.title: Privilege
episodes.description: A young female film student dressed in a maid's uniform has apparently committed suicide but it's very suspicious. The detectives learn that she just broke up with her very rich and powerful boyfriend.

episodes.title: Desperate
episodes.description: After a young boy witnesses the brutal sexual assault and murder of his stepmother, he is too terrified to tell the detectives who attacked her.

episodes.title: Appearances
episodes.description: The body of a nine-year-old beauty pageant contestant is found raped and murdered on a bus, but the case goes beyond the killer when it leads detectives to a virtual-pornography website.

episodes.title: Dominance
episodes.description: A quadruple homicide with sexual overtones is just the start of an intense rampage of a serial killer that brings a homicide detective into the mix. As the entire squad races against time to prevent further victims, the evidence uncovers a horrible situation of incest and abuse.

episodes.title: Fallacy
episodes.description: A female party-goer and rape victim claims self-defense after killing her attacker. Events take an unusual turn when they find out that the victim is a pre-operative transgender.

episodes.title: Futility
episodes.description: A man accused of raping several neighborhood women denies everything and represents himself in court.

episodes.title: Grief
episodes.description: A dead girl is found outside a bar. The death, however, is ruled a suicide, because the victim's boyfriend continually raped her. The victim's father vows revenge against his daughter's rapist.

episodes.title: Perfect
episodes.description: A murdered 14-year-old girl leads the detectives to a prominent physician who specializes in reproduction therapy and exposes a dangerous "foundation" where disenfranchised young women are brainwashed.

episodes.title: Soulless
episodes.description: After a rape victim is abducted from the hospital and later found dead, the detectives suspect several young socialites of her rape, at a Manhattan nightclub, and subsequent murder.

episodes.title: Tragedy
episodes.description: A woman with a high-risk pregnancy disappears and her ex-boyfriend, who's the father, and engaged to the boss' daughter, is under suspicion. In a race against time to find her as her delivery date approaches, Benson and Stabler are faced with more than one suspect willing to take the fall for the crime.

episodes.title: Manic
episodes.description: Detectives enlist Dr. Huang's help as they investigate the deaths of two high-school basketball players gunned down while shooting hoops in the gymnasium and the connection to an illegal marketing campaign by a major pharmaceutical company.

episodes.title: Mother
episodes.description: A psychiatrist with unconventional methods is found sexually assaulted, unconscious and near death in a crack house. It's easier said than done to get her to cooperate with the investigation as they are hampered by doctor-patient confidentiality as she may have been attacked by one of her patients.

episodes.title: Loss
episodes.description: A female undercover agent for the DEA is raped and murdered, leading to a complicated investigation and the arrest of a suspect highly connected with a Colombian drug cartel. This is the toughest case of Cabot's career as she is faced with death threats on herself and her family along with pressure to yield the case to federal authorities.

episodes.title: Serendipity
episodes.description: A newborn baby is found dead in a gutter, sending the detectives on a hunt for the mother. She too turns up murdered, and the clues point to a serial child molester.

episodes.title: Coerced
episodes.description: A schizophrenic homeless man kidnaps a boy he thinks is his son, murdering a man in the process. In resolving the case, with Dr. Huang's help, a private mental health facility is brought into question.

episodes.title: Choice
episodes.description: While patrolling, police stumble upon an attack in progress at Momma Sue's restaurant on the pregnant owner. Her husband is arrested and then seeks to have her charged with neglect for drinking during her pregnancy. The detectives discover it's not the first time a child has been exposed to the devastating repercussions of her uncontrolled alcoholism.

episodes.title: Abomination
episodes.description: Benson and Stabler have trouble identifying a male murder victim in his 20's found in a pile of sheets in the West Village; they later suspect an outspoken minister who was in the process of flooding the victim with hate mail and death threats. When the activist's alibi checks out, the detectives turn their attention to a professor who objects to the victim's thesis on the failure of sexual re-education groups.

episodes.title: Control
episodes.description: A subway commuter is found castrated and bleeding profusely, leading the detectives to discover their "victim" may be the perpetrator in abducting women and forcing them to live in his dungeon for several years as his bride. As the detectives prepare to arrest their victim turned suspect, Benson arrives to find him murdered.

episodes.title: Shaken
episodes.description: The discovery of a beaten infant leads detectives on a search for the attacker, who may be a pedophile. When the medical evidence shows the injuries were a result of shaken baby syndrome, their focus shifts to those closest to the child: her mother, the mother's boyfriend and the nannies.

episodes.title: Escape
episodes.description: When a convicted pedophile, desperate to prove his innocence before his terminally ill mother dies, escapes from a Virginia Correctional Facility and kidnaps his accuser to force him to recant his story, a Deputy Marshall teams up with Benson to track them down. Benson eventually finds herself in the middle of a hostage situation beginning to believe his story.

episodes.title: Brotherhood
episodes.description: When the body of young man is found in a tank at a wastewater treatment plant, the medical examiner identifies a tattoo that says TE, the symbol for the fraternity Tau Omega. The investigation into the murder and sodomy of this local fraternity pledge master leads the detectives to his pornographic website featuring college girls at a local bar.

episodes.title: Hate
episodes.description: A young Arab woman is brutally raped and burned, and after identifying her, the detectives suspect her husband and mother-in-law. After a man accused of the murders of three Arabs, he claims that he was genetically and biologically predisposed to hatred and violence, but soon they uncover the real impetus to the slayings.

episodes.title: Ritual
episodes.description: Two garbage collectors discover what they first think is a scene of animal sacrifice but is the body of a young boy who appears to be the victim of a ritualistic killing. The investigation leads to the discovery of international child slavery.

episodes.title: Families
episodes.description: The investigation into the death of a pregnant high school student exposes a long-held family secret, which precipitates yet another violent death and eventually the destruction of two families.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.description: A young, emaciated boy is found by neighbors scrounging for food; detectives suspect the boy is a victim of abuse and are reluctant to let him go home.

episodes.title: Mean
episodes.description: The conviction of a group of sociopathic high school bullies who turned on one of their own escalates into even more violence and death in their exclusive private school.

episodes.title: Careless
episodes.description: When a young foster child dies due to a religious ritual gone awry, the detectives unravel a mysterious pattern of violence, abuse and murder within one foster care family.

episodes.title: Sick
episodes.description: A wealthy toy mogul is the suspect of the sexual abuse of a child. His prosecution impeded by the child's parents who refuse to produce their child for questioning to avoid losing the millions paid through a non-disclosure agreement, and by the discovery that a second accusation was falsified in an attempt to extort a settlement.

episodes.title: Lowdown
episodes.description: Detectives try to decipher a motive for the strangulation of a Bronx assistant DA in an area where hookers stroll. When the death of the prosecutor looks staged using information gleaned from a co-worker's caseload, Novak endangers her career to obtain a confession.

episodes.title: Criminal
episodes.description: When it becomes obvious that a forensics expert raped and murdered a student, the investigation focuses on a criminology professor Cragen arrested decades earlier for similar crimes, but is the professor a perpetrator or a victim?

episodes.title: Painless
episodes.description: A woman claiming to have been the victim of rape commits suicide while she is still in the emergency room.

episodes.title: Bound
episodes.description: The death of a wealthy senior citizen leads to an investigation that uncovers a serial killer with childhood abandonment issues who targets the elderly.

episodes.title: Poison
episodes.description: A young girl is in a coma after ingesting detergent and her mother is suspected of poisoning her. A biased judge makes the case hard to prosecute which leads to an investigation into his past.

episodes.title: Head
episodes.description: A boy is accused of being molested after his soccer game, but he doesn't admit to it. His principal and his soccer coach are the prime suspects.

title: The Simpsons
description: Set in Springfield, the average American town, the show focuses on the antics and everyday adventures of the Simpson family; Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa and Maggie, as well as a virtual cast of thousands. Since the beginning, the series has been a pop culture icon, attracting hundreds of celebrities to guest star. The show has also made name for itself in its fearless satirical take on politics, media and American life in general.

cast.characterName: Homer Simpson / Abe Simpson / Barney Gumble / Krusty the Clown / Groundskeeper Willie / Mayor Quimby (voice)
Marge Simpson / Patty Bouvier / Selma Bouvier / Jacqueline Bouvier (voice)
Bart Simpson / Maggie Simpson / Nelson Muntz / Ralph Wiggum (voice)
Moe Szyslak / Chief Wiggum / Apu / Comic Book Guy / Carl Carlson / Superintendent Chalmers (voice)
Ned Flanders / Mr. Burns / Smithers / Principal Skinner / Lenny Leonard (voice)

episodes.title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
episodes.description: Homer's Christmas bonus is canceled and the rainy-day funds are needed to pay for Bart's tattoo removal.

episodes.title: Bart the Genius
episodes.description: Bart's labeled a genius and sent to a school for the gifted.

episodes.title: Homer's Odyssey
episodes.description: After being fired from the nuclear power plant for negligence, Homer becomes a safety activist.

episodes.title: There's No Disgrace Like Home
episodes.description: After seeing families being nice to each other at a company picnic, Homer orders the Simpsons to a family therapist.

episodes.title: Bart the General
episodes.description: Terrorized by the school bully, Bart seeks counsel from Grandpa Simpson, who takes him to a warfare expert for basic training.

episodes.title: Moaning Lisa
episodes.description: The meaning of life and second grade have Lisa playing the blues solo, until she jams with a kindred spirit; Homer seeks tutelage to beat Bart at video boxing.

episodes.title: The Call of the Simpsons
episodes.description: The Simpsons put the wild back in the wilderness when their RV goes over a cliff and Homer and Bart go for help, get lost and lose their clothes.

episodes.title: The Telltale Head
episodes.description: Bart pulls a stunt that shocks the entire town, including the new friends he was trying to impress.

episodes.title: Life on the Fast Lane
episodes.description: Homer's bowling-ball gift "for Marge" prompts her to take up the sport, and maybe also a handsome instructor who offers to teach her "many things."

episodes.title: Homer's Night Out
episodes.description: Shutterbug Bart captures Homer with a sexy entertainer at a bachelor party.

episodes.title: The Crepes of Wrath
episodes.description: A little story about how Bart saves France after blowing up Principal Skinner's mom with a cherry bomb.

episodes.title: Krusty Gets Busted
episodes.description: Bart's TV hero Krusty the Clown is arrested for a convenience-store robbery, and witness Homer must testify against the clown.

episodes.title: Some Enchanted Evening
episodes.description: Homer takes Marge out for a romantic night, leaving the kids with a sitter, who's profiled on "America's Most Armed and Dangerous."

episodes.title: Bart Gets an 'F'
episodes.description: Bart fails four consecutive history exams and the school psychiatrist recommends that Bart repeat the fourth grade.

episodes.title: Simpson and Delilah
episodes.description: Homer uses his medical insurance to buy Dimoxinil, a miracle hair-growth formula. After growing luxurious locks, he's given a promotion which allows him to hire a secretary named Karl and makes grand promises to his family at home.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror
episodes.description: The Simpson kids hide in the family treehouse and tell each other spooky stories. The first regards haunted houses, the second introduces Kang and Kodos for the first time in an alien abduction, and the third is a Simpson-adapted retelling of The Raven.

episodes.title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
episodes.description: Bart catches a three-eyed fish in a river downstream of the Nuclear Power Plant. This causes the plant to become inspected, and in order to prevent it from being shut down, Mr. Burns decides to run for governor. After a hard campaign which sees Burns rise from being universally despised to running neck and neck with popular incumbent Mary Bailey, it is decided that Burns will have dinner with a random employee the night before the election. Homer is chosen, much to Marge's chagrin.

episodes.title: Dancin' Homer
episodes.description: Homer fires up the crowd at a Springfield Isotopes baseball game and is chosen to be the team's new mascot. He immediately becomes a popular attraction and the Isotopes start a winning streak. As a result, Homer is promoted to a team in Capital City, the Capital City Capitals.

episodes.title: Dead Putting Society
episodes.description: Bart and Todd Flanders decide to enter a miniature golf tournament. Homer becomes confident that Bart will win and makes a bet with Ned that the father of the boy that does not win will have to mow their neighbors lawn in their wife's Sunday dress.

episodes.title: Bart vs. Thanksgiving
episodes.description: Lisa makes a table centerpiece for the Thanksgiving dinner, which Bart accidentally destroys. After he is sent to his room by his parents, Bart angrily runs away from home and experiences a very different kind of Thanksgiving holiday.

episodes.title: Bart the Daredevil
episodes.description: The Simpsons go to a Monster truck rally that features famous daredevil Lance Murdock. Bart immediately becomes enamored and decides that he wants to become a daredevil as well. His first stunt ends in injury, but to gain the respect of his friends, he promises a far more impressive feat to them: to jump the Springfield Gorge.

episodes.title: Itchy & Scratchy & Marge
episodes.description: Maggie attacks Homer with a mallet after seeing it on Itchy & Scratchy. Marge begins a protest outside the production offices, demanding the show be retooled to prevent further violence.

episodes.title: Bart Gets Hit by a Car
episodes.description: After Mr. Burns hits Bart with his car, ambulance-chasing attorney Lionel Hutz persuades Homer and Marge to sue for a million dollars.

episodes.title: One Fish, Two Fish, Blowfish, Blue Fish
episodes.description: After eating poisonous blowfish at a sushi restaurant, Homer decides to live life to the fullest in the 24 hours he has left to live.

episodes.title: The Way We Was
episodes.description: When the TV breaks, Marge and Homer entertain the kids with the story of how they first met.

episodes.title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
episodes.description: Homer becomes the most popular guy in town when he gets an illegal cable hook-up, but Lisa fears he will go to hell for violating the Eighth Commandment.

episodes.title: Principal Charming
episodes.description: When Marge begs Homer to find Selma a husband, he sets her up with Principal Skinner... who falls in love with Patty instead.

episodes.title: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?
episodes.description: Homer's long-lost half-brother is the CEO of a car company that's wildly successful... until he hires Homer to help design a car for the average man.

episodes.title: Bart's Dog Gets an 'F'
episodes.description: After a series of destructive acts, Homer decides that Santa's Little Helper must go unless he passes obedience school. As the dog's last hours with the family approach, Bart must find a way to get through to him.

episodes.title: Old Money
episodes.description: When Grandpa's new girlfriend at the Springfield Retirement Castle dies, he inherits her savings and must decide the best way to spend his windfall.

episodes.title: Brush with Greatness
episodes.description: Marge rediscovers her interest in art and takes up painting. When Mr. Burns hires her to paint his official portrait, Marge tries but fails to find his "inner beauty."

episodes.title: Lisa's Substitute
episodes.description: With Miss Hoover out sick, a substitute teacher takes the class and becomes an inspiring role model for Lisa.

episodes.title: The War of the Simpsons
episodes.description: At a lakeside retreat for married couples, Marge is determined to fix her marriage with Homer, but Homer is more determined to catch General Sherman, the freakishly large catfish that lives in the lake.

episodes.title: Three Men and a Comic Book
episodes.description: Bart, Milhouse, and Martin pool their money to buy the new first issue of Radioactive Man, but their investment and their friendship are threatened when they can't agree on who will keep it.

episodes.title: Blood Feud
episodes.description: When Mr. Burns is saved by a transfusion of Bart's blood, Homer expects a handsome reward but is outraged to receive only a simple thank-you note.

episodes.title: Stark Raving Dad
episodes.description: A deviation from his norm lands Homer in a mental institution, where he shares a room with a man who thinks he's Michael Jackson.

episodes.title: Mr. Lisa Goes to Washington
episodes.description: Lisa's essay wins the Simpsons a trip to Washington, D.C., where her faith in democracy is shaken by her unethical Congressman.

episodes.title: When Flanders Failed
episodes.description: Flanders suffers a failure after Homer wishes him ill.

episodes.title: Bart the Murderer
episodes.description: While working for Fat Tony, Bart gains enough influence with his boss to solve his problems with Principal Skinner--perhaps permanently.

episodes.title: Homer Defined
episodes.description: Homer's averting of a nuclear meltdown earns him employee-of-the-month honors--and a call from Magic Johnson; Milhouse's parents prohibit him from playing with Bart.

episodes.title: Like Father, Like Clown
episodes.description: Bart and Lisa use theological arguments to try to reunite Krusty the Clown and his rabbi father, who disowned Krusty when he turned from rabbi to clown.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror II
episodes.description: Maggie uses one of three wishes; a mind-reading Bart rules Springfield; Homer donates his brain to Mr. Burns' science project.

episodes.title: Lisa's Pony
episodes.description: After disappointing Lisa, Homer buys her a pony, solving one problem, but creating others, requiring a second job--at Apu's Kwik-E-Mart.

episodes.title: Saturdays of Thunder
episodes.description: When Homer helps Bart build a soapbox racer, it does little for the car but a lot for their relationship.

episodes.title: Flaming Moe's
episodes.description: Moe steals the drink recipe Homer invented, and the rechristened “Flaming Moe” turns his tavern into a hotspot. When a national franchise wants to buy the recipe, Homer wants revenge.

episodes.title: Burns Verkaufen der Kraftwerk
episodes.description: Burns sells the power plant to a German corporation that doesn't care for Homer's approach to his work.

episodes.title: I Married Marge
episodes.description: A trip down memory lane to the early days of Simpson wedded bliss, when Marge was with child and Homer was without a job.

episodes.title: Radio Bart
episodes.description: Bart fools the town into thinking there's a little boy trapped in a well.

episodes.title: Lisa the Greek
episodes.description: Lisa's ability to pick winning football teams kicks off a strong bond with Homer.

episodes.title: Homer Alone
episodes.description: A stressed Marge vacations alone, leaving Bart and Lisa with Patty and Selma, and Maggie with Homer--until she leaves in search of Marge.

episodes.title: Bart the Lover
episodes.description: Bart's answer to detention from Mrs. Krabappel is to answer her personal ad with letters from a Mr. Wonderful, but his last laugh is more of a guilty whimper.

episodes.title: Homer at the Bat
episodes.description: Burns hires Major League ringers for the plant softball championship.

episodes.title: Separate Vocations
episodes.description: The results from their aptitude tests cause Bart and Lisa to make 180-degree turns in their behavior.

episodes.title: Dog of Death
episodes.description: Santa's Little Helper notices resentment after the Simpsons make sacrifices to fund his life-saving operation.

episodes.title: Colonel Homer
episodes.description: Marge fears a cheatin' heart when a waitress-country singer asks Homer to be her manager.

episodes.title: Black Widower
episodes.description: Bart suspects something rotten when Selma gets engaged to Sideshow Bob.

episodes.title: The Otto Show
episodes.description: Spinal Tap hits Springfield, and Otto the bus driver hits the skids after being fired, taking refuge in the Simpsons' garage.

episodes.title: Bart's Friend Falls in Love
episodes.description: Bart resents Milhouse's new girlfriend; Homer gets the wrong subliminal tape, which has him gaining vocabulary, not losing weight.

episodes.title: Brother, Can You Spare Two Dimes?
episodes.description: Homer's half-brother asks for a loan after Homer is awarded some cash.

episodes.title: Kamp Krusty
episodes.description: Bart leads an uprising at Krusty's summer camp after he and Lisa are subjected to a Dickensian sweatshop.

episodes.title: A Streetcar Named Marge
episodes.description: Marge is cast in a version of "A Streetcar Named Desire," playing Blanche to Ned Flanders' Stanley.

episodes.title: Homer the Heretic
episodes.description: After skipping church one Sunday morning, Homer decides to quit church altogether and spend Sundays worshiping in his own way -- with cigars and beer.

episodes.title: Lisa the Beauty Queen
episodes.description: Homer enters Lisa into the Little Miss Springfield Pageant to help her feel better about her looks. But when she must choose between the title and her integrity, she realizes that confidence comes from within.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror III
episodes.description: A Halloween trilogy includes a murderous Krusty doll; a "King Kong" parody; an invasion of zombies unleashed by Bart's incantation.

episodes.title: Itchy & Scratchy: The Movie
episodes.description: Bart is punished by being barred from the Itchy and Scratchy movie.

episodes.title: Marge Gets a Job
episodes.description: Mr. Burns is instantly smitten when Marge takes a job at the nuclear power plant.

episodes.title: New Kid on the Block
episodes.description: Bart has a crush on his new neighbor, a teenage girl who only has eyes for Jimbo Jones. Bart sets out to prove that Jimbo is not as tough as he seems.

episodes.title: Mr. Plow
episodes.description: Homer and Barney become competitors in the snow-plowing business.

episodes.title: Lisa's First Word
episodes.description: While trying to get Maggie to say her first word, Marge and Homer reminisce about Bart's and Lisa's first words.

episodes.title: Homer's Triple Bypass
episodes.description: Homer sees a discount doctor for a coronary bypass.

episodes.title: Marge vs. the Monorail
episodes.description: When Springfield gets a sudden windfall, a charismatic traveling salesman convinces the town to build a monorail.

episodes.title: Selma's Choice
episodes.description: After seeing Aunt Gladys die alone, Aunt Selma wants to get married and have a baby... until she spends a day babysitting Bart and Lisa at Duff Gardens.

episodes.title: Brother from the Same Planet
episodes.description: When Homer neglects Bart once too often, Bart goes to the Big Brother program to get a new father figure. Stung, Homer replaces Bart with a little brother.

episodes.title: I Love Lisa
episodes.description: Chief Wiggum's son has a crush on Lisa after she gives him a Valentine out of pity.

episodes.title: Duffless
episodes.description: After a DUI, Homer swears off beer for a month. Meanwhile, Bart and Lisa's sibling rivalry plays out in the school science fair.

episodes.title: Last Exit to Springfield
episodes.description: Union president Homer fights to keep the dental plan.

episodes.title: So It's Come to This: A Simpsons Clip Show
episodes.description: An April Fools' Day prank provides the jumping-off point for Simpson family flashbacks.

episodes.title: The Front
episodes.description: Lisa and Bart write an Itchy and Scratchy episode; Homer makes up a missing high-school credit.

episodes.title: Whacking Day
episodes.description: Lisa takes a stand against Springfield's annual snake-bashing festival.

episodes.title: Marge in Chains
episodes.description: Overwhelmed by her family's demands during a flu epidemic, Marge accidentally shoplifts at the Kwik-E-Mart and winds up in prison.

episodes.title: Krusty Gets Kancelled
episodes.description: Krusty's Hollywood pals help when his show is canceled after a new star causes his ratings to plummet.

episodes.title: Homer's Barbershop Quartet
episodes.description: Homer recalls when he, Apu, Barney and Principal Skinner became recording icons.

episodes.title: Cape Feare
episodes.description: The Simpsons go incognito to avoid the newly paroled Sideshow Bob, who's out to get Bart.

episodes.title: Homer Goes to College
episodes.description: Homer takes Nuclear Physics 101 at the local college, where he gets a trio of nerdy tutors expelled for extracurricular activities.

episodes.title: Rosebud
episodes.description: Burns longs for a childhood toy that winds up in the grip of Maggie.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror IV
episodes.description: Homer sells his soul; Vampire Burns invites the Simpsons for dinner; Bart sees a gremlin damaging his school bus.

episodes.title: Marge on the Lam
episodes.description: Marge's wild night out with neighbor Ruth includes running from the police in Ruth's car, stolen from her ex.

episodes.title: Bart's Inner Child
episodes.description: Springfield emulates Bart after he's praised by a self-help guru.

episodes.title: Boy-Scoutz 'N the Hood
episodes.description: After a reckless Squishee bender with Milhouse, Bart wakes to the shocking realization that he joined the Junior Campers. Lured by pocketknives and knot-tying lessons, Bart assimilates into the group but then must face the father-son rafting trip.

episodes.title: The Last Temptation of Homer
episodes.description: Homer struggles with his attraction to new coworker Mindy, a beautiful engineer whose love for doughnuts is equal to his own.

episodes.title: $pringfield (Or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
episodes.description: Legalized gambling comes to Springfield, and Marge becomes addicted; Robert Goulet entertains at Bart's casino for kids.

episodes.title: Homer the Vigilante
episodes.description: Homer leads a vigilante group to catch the Springfield Cat Burglar, who then robs the museum.

episodes.title: Bart Gets Famous
episodes.description: When an on-air remark catapults Bart to instant stardom, he finds that fame isn't all it's cracked up to be.

episodes.title: Homer and Apu
episodes.description: Homer accompanies Apu to the Kwik-E-Mart home office--in India--after Apu is fired.

episodes.title: Lisa vs. Malibu Stacy
episodes.description: Lisa's outrage over the gender stereotypes reinforced by a new talking doll prompts her to confront the dollmaker.

episodes.title: Deep Space Homer
episodes.description: Homer and Barney compete to be the first "average" American in space.

episodes.title: Homer Loves Flanders
episodes.description: Flanders' extra ticket to the big game makes him Homer's new best friend, a role that sorely tests Flanders' patience.

episodes.title: Bart Gets an Elephant
episodes.description: Bart wins an elephant, but Homer won't let him keep it.

episodes.title: Burns' Heir
episodes.description: Bart is picked to be Burns' heir and moves into the Burns mansion, prompting Homer and Marge to hire a deprogrammer to get him back.

episodes.title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
episodes.description: Bart takes his dog to school, which gets Skinner fired, which in turn leaves Bart missing his archnemesis.

episodes.title: The Boy Who Knew Too Much
episodes.description: Bart can clear Mayor Quimby's nephew of a charge of battery, but only by implicating himself as a hooky player.

episodes.title: Lady Bouvier's Lover
episodes.description: Grandpa Simpson falls for Marge's mother, but loses out to a competitor; Bart gets ripped off shopping at home with Homer's credit card.

episodes.title: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
episodes.description: Homer teaches a class on marriage, but sharing secrets about his own union gets him kicked out of the house.

title: Reacher
description: Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator, has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served.

episodes.title: Welcome to Margrave
episodes.description: Reacher is wrongly accused of murder while visiting the small town of Margrave, GA.

episodes.title: First Dance
episodes.description: When more victims are discovered, Reacher attempts to get answers but is set up. Roscoe receives a threatening message.

episodes.title: Spoonful
episodes.description: Reacher and Finlay’s investigation into the missing Spivey leads them into a confrontation with Kliner Sr. Roscoe learns unsettling news about Reacher.

episodes.title: In a Tree
episodes.description: As the danger increases, Reacher and Roscoe grow closer and they make plans to meet with their contact from Homeland Security.

episodes.title: No Apologies
episodes.description: As the mystery deepens, Reacher teams up with an old colleague and Finlay makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Papier
episodes.description: As the town is rocked by another murder, Reacher heads to New York and learns the truth about the illegal business in Margrave while Roscoe faces danger in the woods.

episodes.title: Reacher Said Nothing
episodes.description: Reacher springs a trap and then gets trapped himself.

episodes.title: Pie
episodes.description: Reacher leads a rescue mission at the warehouse that ends in a showdown.

episodes.title: ATM
episodes.description: Reacher and Neagley investigate the murder of a member of 110th, a group of Special investigators assembled by Reacher, only to realize the whole unit may be at risk.

episodes.title: What Happens in Atlantic City
episodes.description: The investigation into Franz's murder takes Reacher and the surviving members of his former Army unit to Atlantic City where the mystery deepens, danger awaits, and an old flame is rekindled.

episodes.title: Picture Says a Thousand Words
episodes.description: After more of his friends fall victim, Reacher forges an uneasy alliance with a dogged detective, and their only clue in the case leads the 110th to a troubling discovery.

episodes.title: A Night at the Symphony
episodes.description: Reacher and his team head to Boston to track down a political aide with insider knowledge of a top secret military-defense contract that may be the reason behind their friends' deaths.

episodes.title: Burial
episodes.description: Neagley and Dixon discover shocking information about an old friend in Denver while Reacher and O'Donnell learn more about the nefarious and mysterious A.M..

episodes.title: New York's Finest
episodes.description: As the mystery continues to unfold, Reacher and his team set a trap to even the score.

episodes.title: The Man Goes Through
episodes.description: As the team close in on Langston, two members of the 110th face danger, compelling Reacher to devise a dangerous plan to rescue them.

episodes.title: Fly Boy
episodes.description: Reacher and Neagley make a final desperate attempt to save O’Donnell and Dixon, stop A.M. and avenge their friends’ murder.

episodes.title: Persuader
episodes.description: Reacher's attempt to thwart a kidnapping brings him into contact with mysterious businessman Zachary Beck.

episodes.title: Truckin'
episodes.description: Tasked with transporting cargo for his new employer Zachary Beck, Reacher must juggle the involvement of the DEA and a nosy new associate.

episodes.title: Number 2 with a Bullet
episodes.description: As a rising body count threatens his undercover position, Reacher makes a dangerous play to secure Beck's trust.

episodes.title: Dominique
episodes.description: Reacher reunites with Duffy and Villanueva and finally shares the painful details of his history with Xavier Quinn.

episodes.title: Smackdown
episodes.description: When a DEA tragedy puts the entire mission at risk, Reacher, Duffy, and Villanueva improvise a drastic plan to save their cover.

episodes.title: Smoke on the Water
episodes.description: Reacher is torn between his desire to kill Quinn and his promise to Duffy to save Teresa.

episodes.title: L.A. Story
episodes.description: After Reacher and Duffy travel to Los Angeles to arrange a deal, Neagley arrives in Maine to help Reacher get answers.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.description: Reacher finally faces off with both Paulie and Quinn.

episodes.title: City of Brotherly Love
episodes.description: A chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a Philadelphia subway car draws Jack Reacher into a deadly mystery involving a missing flash drive that contains secrets worth killing for.

episodes.title: Cage Fight
episodes.description: Tamara finds herself caught up in the mystery whether she likes it or not as she, Reacher, and Jacob face off against shady government agents and a mysterious squad of professional soldiers all looking for the same missing flash drive.

episodes.title: One Small Step
episodes.description: Reacher learns that things are more complex than they seem as he and Lila draw closer. Meanwhile, Tamara, Jacob, and Plum find an important clue after another attack from one of their mysterious adversaries sends them back to Philadelphia.

episodes.title: Karambits and Pieces
episodes.description: Reacher interrogates Sampson, Tamara breaks into a government facility, Jacob receives some crushing news and the team learns a piece of information that changes everything.

episodes.title: Bridge
episodes.description: After a misunderstanding, Reacher becomes Philadelphia's Most Wanted. Meanwhile, old enemies catch up with him and new ones emerge. Jacob, Tamara and Plum end up in a firefight, giving Jacob his first real shot at avenging his sister's death.

episodes.title: Plum Out of Luck
episodes.description: Fleeing the police, Reacher and Tamara head out-of-town to find the mysterious Ahlquist only to run into more trouble. Meanwhile, Jacob and Plum deal with their own problems back in Philadelphia.

episodes.title: Vote for Sampson
episodes.description: Reacher and Tamara finally get the answers they've been looking for. Meanwhile, Jacob learns that their problems are just beginning when Plum's sources come through with some timely information.

episodes.title: Cut
episodes.description: Reacher, Tamara and Jacob take the fight to the enemy as the full extent of their plot is revealed. Reacher faces off with those responsible for Anna's death while Jacob faces a moment of truth and Plum gets his shot at redemption.

title: The Mentalist
description: Patrick Jane, a former celebrity psychic medium, uses his razor sharp skills of observation and expertise at "reading" people to solve serious crimes with the California Bureau of Investigation.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: CBI consultant Patrick Jane, Senior Agent Teresa Lisbon and her team investigate the double murder in Palm Springs of a pro golfer's wife and her doctor, which has the hallmarks of a serial killer with a personal connection to Jane.

episodes.title: Red Hair and Silver Tape
episodes.description: While Lisbon and her team investigate the murder of a young waitress in the Napa Valley, Jane goes behind Lisbon's back to orchestrate his own undercover operation using Van Pelt as bait.

episodes.title: Red Tide
episodes.description: When a high school girl's body washes up on the beach, Patrick Jane sets a mentalist trap in order to get her surfing friends to turn on each other and reveal what really happened.

episodes.title: Ladies in Red
episodes.description: When the team learns that a wealthy investment banker found murdered inside his locked safe room was living a dual life and skimming millions from clients, Patrick Jane sets up a mental conundrum to see which of the suspects will show their true colors.

episodes.title: Redwood
episodes.description: When a girl is found covered in blood and holding the murder weapon that killed her best friend, she becomes an obvious suspect, though she can't remember anything. But Jane, believing she's innocent, engineers a risky maneuver in which she must relive the terrifying events in order to spark her memory.

episodes.title: Red Handed
episodes.description: While investigating the case of a murdered casino owner, Patrick Jane uses his mentalist skills to ultimately entrap the killer, and win big at the card tables.

episodes.title: Seeing Red
episodes.description: Patrick Jane goes head-to-head with a "psychic" he suspects of murder. Intent on proving the so-called psychic is a fraud -- as well as a killer -- Jane arranges a séance to expose the murderer.

episodes.title: The Thin Red Line
episodes.description: While the police suspect a drug dealer on trial is behind the murders of the State's witness in his case, as well as his girlfriend, Patrick Jane sees a different motive for the crime -- as well as a different suspect.

episodes.title: Flame Red
episodes.description: Patrick Jane suspects the only surviving member of a National Guard unit of murdering his friends - and goes undercover to prove it.

episodes.title: Red Brick and Ivy
episodes.description: When a leading scientific researcher is killed by poisoning, Patrick Jane takes a personal interest in the case when he learns the prime suspect is the victim's wife - and Jane's former psychiatrist.

episodes.title: Red John's Friends
episodes.description: Enticed by the promise from a convicted murder that he'll reveal information about Red John upon his release, Patrick Jane becomes singularly focused and quits the CBI in order to prove the prisoner is innocent.

episodes.title: Red Rum
episodes.description: Patrick Jane sets a mentalist trap to find out who is responsible for the murder of a high school boy who antagonized the local self-proclaimed witch by killing her cat.

episodes.title: Paint It Red
episodes.description: While it appears obvious that a business tycoon's son-in-law was in on the robbery of a $50 million painting since his body is found where the painting once hung, Patrick Jane suspects others, including a Russian oil baron, an art forger and an art curator.

episodes.title: Crimson Casanova
episodes.description: With Patrick Jane's help, Cho goes undercover as a sweet-talking ladies man with all the right moves in order to catch a pick-up artist and killer with his own set of pseudo-mentalist techniques.

episodes.title: Scarlett Fever
episodes.description: As Jane and the team investigate the poisoning death of the "queen bee" in a country club, they discover that the community is full of secrets, including love affairs and drug abuse

episodes.title: Bloodshot
episodes.description: Patrick Jane must rely on his other senses during the murder investigation of a financial advisor when he loses his sight as a result of an explosion.

episodes.title: Carnelian Inc.
episodes.description: A story of greed and betrayal pits Patrick Jane against a group of financiers when the CBI investigates a series of murders at a corporate retreat in the wilds of the Sierra Nevada foothills.

episodes.title: Russet Potatoes
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the CBI team track down a mastermind who hypnotizes people into doing their bidding.

episodes.title: A Dozen Red Roses
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the team go to Hollywood when they investigate the murder of a movie producer.

episodes.title: Red Sauce
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate the murder of a mobster who was in the witness protection program.

episodes.title: Miss Red
episodes.description: Patrick Jane uses his mentalist skills to play suspects off each other in order to solve the case of a wealthy software company CEO found murdered on his yacht.

episodes.title: Blood Brothers
episodes.description: Patrick Jane must find a clever way to convince the troubled kids in a wilderness program to confide in him about what really happened surrounding the death of one of their peers.

episodes.title: Red John's Footsteps
episodes.description: Lisbon fears that the serial killer Red John is drawing Patrick Jane into a trap when the CBI team investigates the murder of a young girl and the abduction of her twin sister.

episodes.title: Redemption
episodes.description: Jane and Lisbon learn that the Red John case has been reassigned to a different CBI team led by the straight-shooting officer Sam Bosco.

episodes.title: The Scarlet Letter
episodes.description: Lisbon and the team work the case of a State Senator's murdered intern, while Jane simultaneously tries to find out what new information Bosco has uncovered on the Red John case.

episodes.title: Red Badge
episodes.description: Jane, Cho, Rigsby and Van Pelt decide to conduct their own investigation when Lisbon is accused of murdering a child molester she arrested who was recently paroled.

episodes.title: Red Menace
episodes.description: Jane and the CBI investigate the murder of Gordon Hodge, a powerful attorney, who is responsible for allowing a vicious murderer, Van McBride, to walk away a free man.

episodes.title: Red Scare
episodes.description: Jane and the CBI team are called in to investigate the death of a prominent architect found murdered in a crumbling old mansion, and there appears to be a number of suspects.

episodes.title: Black Gold and Red Blood
episodes.description: Even after Bosco arrests Jane and puts him in prison for spying on him, Jane is able to help the CBI team from his cell to solve the murder of a young man.

episodes.title: Red Bulls
episodes.description: Minelli orders Patrick Jane and Lisbon and company to play nice and work together with Bosco and his team to locate a kidnapped woman being held for ransom.

episodes.title: His Red Right Hand
episodes.description: The CBI team is faced with a violent and shocking crime in their own office, but must work the case in spite of their alarm of who may be behind it. Meanwhile, Rigsby and Van Pelt are definitely an "item".

episodes.title: A Price Above Rubies
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the team are called to investigate the robbery and murder of a wealthy jeweler while attending a black tie fundraiser for the CBI.

episodes.title: Throwing Fire
episodes.description: While Jane and the team examine the crime scene where a baseball scout is found murdered, Jane is clocked in the head by a ball and flashes back to his childhood with his overbearing father.

episodes.title: Rose-Colored Glasses
episodes.description: Jane and company investigate the murder of a man and his wife, on her way to his fifteen year high school reunion where, clearly, the attendees haven't changed all that much.

episodes.title: Bleeding Heart
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the team investigate the murder of a mayor's aide, and Rigsby and Van Pelt make a big announcement.

episodes.title: Redline
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate when the body of a high-end luxury car sales woman is found in the trunk of a Bentley in the dealership's showroom.

episodes.title: Blood In, Blood Out
episodes.description: When a member of Cho's former gang, the Avon Park Playboys, is found murdered, Patrick Jane insists on helping Cho with his off-the-books investigation.

episodes.title: Red Herring
episodes.description: Jane and the team investigate the murder of an arrogant chef during a cooking competition in Napa Valley.

episodes.title: Code Red
episodes.description: When Dr. Alicia Seberg, a government research scientist, is exposed to a deadly toxin while at work and has only hours to live, she calls Patrick Jane and the CBI to find her murderer.

episodes.title: The Red Box
episodes.description: Patrick and the CBI team investigate the murder of a tutor, and find a mysterious little red box near the body, starting a chain of events that turns the murder into the search for a priceless ring stolen from the British Museum. Meanwhile, Lisbon is worried when a new boss, Madeleine Hightower, takes command of the CBI, as well as mysteriously learning about Rigsby and Van Pelt's relationship.

episodes.title: Aingavite Baa
episodes.description: When a "Jane Doe" with amnesia and covered in blood steps in front of Cho and Van Pelt's car, Patrick Jane must use all of his skills to discover who she is, her last location and why she lost her memory

episodes.title: Blood Money
episodes.description: When Patrick Jane's sneaky conduct causes the case of a confessed hitman to be tossed out of court, his annoyed CBI team must start the investigation over from scratch.

episodes.title: Red All Over
episodes.description: When a media mogul is murdered, Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate cult leader Bret Stiles, who may have had an axe to grind following the publication of a critical story about his group.
Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate the death of a mathematical genius by a gun-wielding clown.

episodes.title: Red Letter
episodes.description: Romantic sparks begin to fly when Patrick Jane and supposed psychic Kristina Frye cross paths again during the CBI investigation into the murder of a charismatic head of a non-profit organization that fights human trafficking.

episodes.title: Red Sky in the Morning
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and Kristina's first date is interrupted by a report of Red John striking again, which is discovered to be a copycat. But when Kristina reaches out to the real Red John, both she and Jane find themselves in grave danger.

episodes.title: Red Sky at Night
episodes.description: When the CBI investigates the kidnapping of a prominent lawyer and state house lobbyist, the CBI Director wants Jane on the case, but he is uncertain of his future with the unit after his encounter with Red John.

episodes.title: Cackle-Bladder Blood
episodes.description: When Jane's brother-in-law returns to town and gets mixed up in a murder investigation, Jane must come to his aid despite personal reservations.

episodes.title: The Blood on His Hands
episodes.description: When Patrick Jane faces off once again with cult leader Bret Stiles, Stiles offers Jane information regarding Red John and the missing Kristina Frye.

episodes.title: Red Carpet Treatment
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the CBI team are called in to investigate the murder of a convict who served nine years for rape and murder, but was recently released on DNA evidence.

episodes.title: The Red Ponies
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the CBI team hit the horse track when a jockey is found murdered and suspects abound.

episodes.title: Pink Chanel Suit
episodes.description: The case of a murder and missing person on an intensely secure wealthy family's compound perplexes Jane and the CBI team.

episodes.title: Red Hot
episodes.description: Jane and the CBI team narrowly escape a fiery end when a building explodes while they're investigating a death threat. Meanwhile, sparks fly between Lisbon and billionaire Walter Mashburn when they meet again while on the case.

episodes.title: Ball of Fire
episodes.description: When Jane is kidnapped, Lisbon and the team realize there are many suspects who might want to harm him.

episodes.title: Red Moon
episodes.description: Patrick Jane accepts the help of a local astrologer, Ellis Mars, to solve the puzzling case of a triple homicide that involves two policemen and the fiancé of an EMT worker.

episodes.title: Jolly Red Elf
episodes.description: The CBI pursues two lines of investigation when a Santa is murdered: Patrick Jane goes undercover in an AA group; and Rigsby and Van Pelt question members of an authentic Santa society. Meanwhile, following the demise of a person in custody at the CBI, J.J. LaRoche is brought in to question the team when it appears to be an inside job.

episodes.title: Bloodsport
episodes.description: Patrick and the team investigate the murder of a woman with ties to one of the fighters. Meanwhile, LaRoche focuses his investigation on Rigsby, who in turn is forced to ask Cho for a huge favor in order to keep his job.

episodes.title: Bloodhounds
episodes.description: When Patrick Jane and the CBI must work with a criminal profiler, Dr. Montague, to solve a double murder, it becomes a competition for Jane to prove that his methods are superior.

episodes.title: Red Alert
episodes.description: When Patrick Jane and others are taken hostage by an armed man accused of murder, Jane must think quickly to defuse the situation.

episodes.title: Blood for Blood
episodes.description: Van Pelt's actions are called into question when a witness is murdered while she is assigned to his protection.

episodes.title: Red Gold
episodes.description: When a modern-day prospector is found dead near a mining site and Lisbon is injured during the initial stages of the investigation, Agent Hightower joins Patrick Jane in the field for the first time.

episodes.title: Red Queen
episodes.description: Evidence in the murder of an antiques dealer found dead in a museum indicates that the suspect may be a member of the CBI team.

episodes.title: Bloodstream
episodes.description: After a doctor is found dead at a golf course, the CBI team searches for a killer amongst a hospital's staff and patients. Meanwhile, when LaRoche is placed in charge of the CBI, his first act of business is to name Cho the new team leader.

episodes.title: The Red Mile
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the CBI team must track down the killer of a man who believed he experienced an alien abduction - even after the victim's body is stolen from the coroner's van. Meanwhile, Van Pelt takes a break from the case to shop for wedding dresses.

episodes.title: Every Rose Has Its Thorn
episodes.description: Patrick Jane sets out to prove a beautiful yet manipulative matchmaker shot and killed her husband after his body is found floating in the marina.

episodes.title: Redacted
episodes.description: Patrick Jane must deal with two failed robbery attempts: one resulting in the murder of a repair shop owner and the other involving a former suspect personally hired by Jane to break into LaRoche's home.

episodes.title: Like a Redheaded Stepchild
episodes.description: When a prison guard is stabbed to death outside of a jewelry store, Patrick Jane suspects one of the guard's inmates is the killer. Meanwhile, Rigsby questions his own father about the murder.

episodes.title: Rhapsody in Red
episodes.description: After a young violinist is shot to death, Patrick Jane questions the members of the Northern California Symphony Orchestra about the murder. Meanwhile, Cho crosses paths with a precocious young pickpocket.

episodes.title: Strawberries and Cream (1)
episodes.description: A robber with a bomb attached to him is blown up in front of a convenience store, and CBI soon discovers that there may be connections between this case and Red John and agent Hightower.

episodes.title: Strawberries and Cream (2)
episodes.description: Patrick trades Hightower's secret location to Laroche for the four remaining names on his list. The team then sets up a trap to uncover Red John's real informant, leading to a possible face-to-face showdown between Patrick and Red John.

episodes.title: Scarlet Ribbons
episodes.description: In prison for killing his nemesis, Patrick Jane must prove that the man he shot really was Red John. Meanwhile, Lisbon urges Van Pelt to seek counseling in the aftermath of the death of her fiancé.

episodes.title: Little Red Book
episodes.description: With Lisbon suspended and the rest of the team reassigned, Jane is reinstated as a CBI consultant and forced to work with a new team. During the investigation, Jane conspires to bring his former team back together.

episodes.title: Pretty Red Balloon
episodes.description: When the son of a former client from Jane's days as a psychic is kidnapped, Jane and the CBI team are asked to help find him. Meanwhile, Jane butts heads with his former client's new "spiritual advisor."

episodes.title: Ring Around the Rosie
