Meanwhile, Barry meets someone with a mysterious connection to Henry Allen.

episodes.title: True Colors
episodes.description: After hearing that Amunet has struck a deal to buy all of the metahumans in Iron Heights, Barry must decide if he should expose his powers in order to save his cellmates. After a visit from an old friend, Ralph is reminded of his shady past and wonders if he’s really a changed man.

episodes.title: Subject 9
episodes.description: Barry meets a powerful woman whose abilities could help him in his battle with DeVoe. Meanwhile, after learning that DeVoe is targeting everyone who was on the bus, Ralph decides he doesn't want to be a hero anymore, his only concern is staying alive. Harry offers to help Joe.

episodes.title: Enter Flashtime
episodes.description: When a nuclear bomb detonates in downtown Central City, Barry, Jesse Quick and Jay Garrick slow down time by entering Flashtime. As everyone in the city is frozen, the three speedsters push themselves to the breaking point to save the city and everyone in it.

episodes.title: Run, Iris, Run
episodes.description: Team Flash confront a new bus meta, Matthew aka Melting Pot. He has the ability to swap people’s DNA, so during a battle with Team Flash, he transfers Barry’s super speed to Iris. Now, with a new threat unleashed on Central City, Barry must act as the team leader while Iris takes on the mantle of superhero speedster in order to defeat their new foe.

episodes.title: Null and Annoyed
episodes.description: Barry and Ralph take different approaches to finding the remaining bus metas before DeVoe gets to them. However, Ralph's cavalier attitude frustrates Barry and the two clash over what it means to be a hero. Meanwhile, Breacher returns to ask Cisco for a favor.

episodes.title: Lose Yourself
episodes.description: When Barry and Team Flash find a way to enter The Thinker’s lair, Ralph considers crossing a dangerous line to defeat DeVoe. Meanwhile, Joe is concerned by Harry’s recent behavior.

episodes.title: Fury Rogue
episodes.description: When Barry needs help transporting a dangerous meta, he calls on a new friend for help - Leo Snart AKA Citizen Cold. Meanwhile, Cisco becomes suspicious of Harry.

episodes.title: Therefore She Is
episodes.description: Barry and Team Flash team up with Gypsy to try to thwart Thinker's plan. Meanwhile, Cisco and Gypsy have a heart to heart talk about their relationship.

episodes.title: Harry and the Harrisons
episodes.description: With DeVoe's Enlightenment device nearly complete, in order to disable it The Flash and his team must put their faith in an unlikely ally – Amunet Black. Meanwhile, Harry hits an all-time low when the "Council of Wells" kicks him out but then Cisco introduces him to the "Council of Harrisons."

episodes.title: Think Fast
episodes.description: When DeVoe assaults an A.R.G.U.S. facility to complete his Enlightenment Machine, Barry realizes the only way he can stop him is if he allows Cisco and Caitlin to accompany him into the facility. Still shaken by Ralph’s death, Barry isn’t sure he wants to risk any more of his friends’ lives and considers taking on DeVoe solo.

episodes.title: We Are The Flash
episodes.description: Team Flash gets help from a surprising ally in their battle against DeVoe.

episodes.title: Nora
episodes.description: After an unexpected guest from the future, Nora West-Allen, appears at their home, Barry and Iris must figure out how to get her back to the future without disrupting the timeline…even more than she already has. Team Flash must work together to send Nora back, while simultaneously fighting off another villainous meta.

episodes.title: Blocked
episodes.description: As Barry helps his daughter, Nora, become a better speedster, he and Team Flash also track down a meta stealing high-tech weapons, only to cross paths with a new foe named Cicada, who is hunting the very same meta with nefarious intent.

episodes.title: The Death of Vibe
episodes.description: After Cicada's attack on The Flash, the team realizes they need to think outside the box to stop this dangerous new foe. Desperate to help her parents, Nora comes up with a plan that ultimately puts a member of Team Flash in danger. Meanwhile, Caitlin delves into her past.

episodes.title: News Flash
episodes.description: Barry and Iris face the ultimate parenting test when Team Flash battles Spin, a savvy millennial armed with meta tech, and a dangerous agenda for their daughter, Nora. Ralph is feeling defeated until an unlikely source issues a challenge to help boost his confidence.

episodes.title: All Doll'd Up
episodes.description: Nora lets something slip about the future that devastates Iris. In an attempt to distract his wife, Barry asks Iris to team up to stop a new meta, Rag Doll. Meanwhile, Caitlin learns something about her father.

episodes.title: The Icicle Cometh
episodes.description: Caitlin, Barry and Cisco learn something new about Caitlin’s father. Meanwhile, Iris and Sherloque follow a clue about Cicada.

episodes.title: O Come, All Ye Thankful
episodes.description: While Nora grapples with unresolved anger over her father’s disappearance in the future, Barry and Team Flash must stop a powerful new meta, Weather Witch, from killing her own father, Weather Wizard.

episodes.title: What's Past Is Prologue
episodes.description: Barry and Team Flash come up with a plan to stop Cicada. However, the plan calls for Barry and Nora to travel back in time to gather some key necessities. However, Barry hesitates, concerned about his daughter seeing certain parts of his life. Meanwhile, Sherloque takes his concerns about Nora to Iris, and Caitlin turns up a key asset in the fight against Cicada.

episodes.title: Elseworlds (I)
episodes.description:
When Barry Allen and Oliver Queen wake up one morning and realize they have swapped bodies with each other, the two set off to find out what disturbed the timeline to cause such a shift. However, things quickly go from bad to worse when they present their case to Team Flash and the gang doesn’t believe them. Barry and Oliver realize they need Supergirl’s help and travel to Smallville on Earth-38 where they end up meeting Kara’s cousin, Clark Kent, and intrepid reporter, Lois Lane.

The crossover continues on Arrow S07E09 Elseworlds (II) and Supergirl S04E09 Elseworlds (III).

episodes.title: The Flash & The Furious
episodes.description: While Nora grapples with the revelation that Thawne killed her grandmother, Team Flash must stop the formidable team-up of a newly sprung from jail Weather Witch and Silver Ghost, a new meta-tech villain who can control engines and motorized technology. Meanwhile, Caitlin and Cisco discuss creating a meta-human cure.

episodes.title: Seeing Red
episodes.description: During a battle with Cicada, Nora is severely injured. Due to Cicada's dampening powers, Nora's speed healing isn't working, leaving Barry and Iris scared for their daughter's future. Upset about his injured child, The Flash is filled with rage and confronts Cicada in a brutal battle. Meanwhile, Killer Frost keeps interfering with Caitlin's work on the cure.

episodes.title: Memorabilia
episodes.description: When Sherloque wants to use a memory machine on Barry and Nora to help gain access to Grace's memories, Nora panics, fearing her parents will find out the secrets she's been keeping from them. Nora secretly decides to use the machine on her own which ends in disaster after she gets trapped inside Grace's mind. Barry and Iris go in after their daughter and Iris is brokenhearted by what she finds. Meanwhile, Ralph tricks Cisco into going out for a night out on the town.

episodes.title: Goldfaced
episodes.description: Barry and Ralph must go undercover as criminals in an illegal black market to purchase a device that could help them stop Cicada. Once inside, Barry and Ralph find their morality tested as they slip deeper into the criminal world, eventually having to choose between committing a crime, or losing the means to defeat one of their greatest foes. Meanwhile, Iris investigates a lead on Cicada's whereabouts and ends up in a dangerous situation.

episodes.title: Cause and XS
episodes.description: After Iris lands in serious danger, Nora races to save her mother. Barry puts the finishing touches on the metahuman cure, leaving Cisco with a rare night off so he decides to take Kamilla on a date.

episodes.title: King Shark vs. Gorilla Grodd
episodes.description: When Gorilla Grodd attacks Central City, Barry and Team Flash find themselves teaming up with an unexpected ally to defeat – King Shark. However, when they hit a snag, they bring in Dr. Tanya Lamden to try to reach the man behind the shark, Shay Lamden.

episodes.title: Failure Is an Orphan
episodes.description: With the meta-human cure ready to use, Barry and Team Flash must figure out a way to subdue Cicada long enough to take it. Killer Frost steps in to help with the plan. Meanwhile, Joe eases back into work, and Nora isn’t happy about the way her dad plans to stop Cicada.

episodes.title: Time Bomb
episodes.description: Team Flash finds out that a suburban mom named Vickie Bolen is in danger and they race to save her. Upon meeting her, they discover she’s a meta-human who is hiding her abilities from her family. Barry encourages Vickie to share her secret with her family, which makes Nora realize she needs to come clean with her parents about Thawne.

episodes.title: Godspeed
episodes.description: After discovering that Nora is working with Thawne, Barry and Iris disagree about how to handle their daughter in the wake of this shocking news. Team Flash isn't sure they can trust Nora, so they go through her journal to find out exactly how she came to work alongside their greatest nemesis.

episodes.title: Snow Pack
episodes.description: When Icicle returns to enact the next phase of his devious plan, Caitlin and her mother, Dr. Carla Tannhauser, must resolve their long-combative relationship to defeat the icy monster. After Barry makes a big decision about their family without consulting her, Iris decides to take matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: Gone Rogue
episodes.description: Barry continues to struggle with how he feels about Nora's betrayal. Brie Larvan, Joss Jackam and Peter Merkel return to Central City. Meanwhile, Cisco makes a bold decision.

episodes.title: The Girl With The Red Lightning
episodes.description: Team Flash is on high alert after Cicada II threatens to unleash a dangerous virus that would put all meta-humans at risk.

episodes.title: Legacy
episodes.description: Barry faces off with his oldest, and most formidable nemesis, Reverse Flash.

title: The Blacklist
description: Raymond "Red" Reddington, one of the FBI's most wanted fugitives, surrenders in person at FBI Headquarters in Washington, D.C. He claims that he and the FBI have the same interests: bringing down dangerous criminals and terrorists. In the last two decades, he's made a list of criminals and terrorists that matter the most but the FBI cannot find because it does not know they exist. Reddington calls this "The Blacklist". Reddington will co-operate, but insists that he will speak only to Elizabeth Keen, a rookie FBI profiler.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: The race to stop a terrorist begins in the premiere of this crime series about a most-wanted fugitive who works with a rookie FBI profiler to take down criminals and evildoers.

episodes.title: The Freelancer
episodes.description: Red and Liz go under cover to stop an assassin known as The Freelancer from killing his next target; Ressler and a recently re-hired CIA agent try to protect Red from a distance; Liz wonders what she should do about Tom and the mysterious box.

episodes.title: Wujing
episodes.description: The FBI is on the hunt for a high-ranking Chinese spy, Wujing which Red claims has hired him to help decode a classified CIA transmission. Liz, posing as an FBI cryptographer goes with Red to decode the message while protecting US government secrets. Meanwhile, Liz proactively investigates Tom.

episodes.title: The Stewmaker
episodes.description: While continuing her investigation into the truth about Tom, Liz testifies against drug lord, Hector Lorca. Later another witness is abducted when he is forced to testify against the dangerous drug trafficker. Red’s interest is peaked and he informs the team that the witness may have been taken by "The Stewmaker" a man responsible for hundreds of missing and presumed dead people. Meanwhile, in an unlikely twist of events, Red and Ressler must work together for the first time.

episodes.title: The Courier
episodes.description: Red and the FBI try to stop a dangerous messenger (Robert Knepper) whose appearance is unknown; Liz is thrust into a kidnapping plot.

episodes.title: Gina Zanetakos
episodes.description: Tom claims he is innocent and wants to turn the box into the FBI; Red's next target is a beautiful and deadly corporate terrorist (Margarita Levieva).

episodes.title: Frederick Barnes
episodes.description: The FBI searches for the man responsible for a chemical attack on a subway; Liz wants to avoid Red after he implicated Tom.

episodes.title: General Ludd
episodes.description: When Red reveals a new name, Liz learns of a plot to destroy the country's financial system; Tom helps Liz when a loved one falls ill.

episodes.title: Anslo Garrick (1)
episodes.description: Anslo Garrick, the newest person on the blacklist, tries to capture Red; Liz is caught in an elevator.

episodes.title: Anslo Garrick (2)
episodes.description: Liz infiltrates the blacksite and disarms the signal jammers to call in backup but runs into trouble along the way. The fate of Ressler hangs in the balance as Red tries to bargain with Anslo Garrick. Meanwhile, Tom becomes increasingly worried about Liz’ situation and the fate of Red is unknown.

episodes.title: The Good Samaritan
episodes.description: A serial killer from Liz's past strikes again while Red hunts for whoever betrayed him.

episodes.title: The Alchemist
episodes.description: Red informs the team that "The Alchemist" - a man who relies upon science to transform a person’s DNA - has been contracted to protect a well-known mob informant and his wife. As the team goes undercover to catch him, Liz finds herself on the hunt for an unlikely couple. Meanwhile Liz and Tom find themselves at another bump in their relationship and Ressler debates whether or not he should give his ex-girlfriend his blessing.

episodes.title: The Cyprus Agency
episodes.description: After a recent spate of abductions of babies from their mothers, Red informs Liz that the "Cyprus Agency" is the illegal adoption organization responsible. Coincidentally, Liz and Tom contemplate adoption of their own which fuels Liz to track down the organizations CEO, Owen Mallory.

episodes.title: Madeline Pratt
episodes.description: Liz helps Tom adjust to the impending adoption; Red reveals a woman from his past is a target; Red convinces Liz to pull of a heist at the Syrian Embassy.

episodes.title: The Judge
episodes.description: Red believes he knows who was responsible for a prominent prosecutor's 12 year disappearance; Red investigates the woman who tempts Tom.

episodes.title: Mako Tanida
episodes.description: One of Red's former associates, a crime lord, becomes the next target; Tom decides to confront Jolene.

episodes.title: Ivan
episodes.description: After a cyber defense asset is stolen by a terrorist only known as Ivan, Red and Liz discover a cover-up; new evidence regarding Jolene's disappearance unravels some of the mystery surrounding Tom.

episodes.title: Milton Bobbit
episodes.description: Red and the team search for a life insurance claim adjuster who talks people into becoming contract killers; Liz and Red try to uncover Tom's secrets.

episodes.title: The Pavlovich Brothers
episodes.description: As the team tries to protect a target of the Pavlovich brothers -- specialists in abductions -- Red has a job of his own for the duo; Liz patiently pursues the truth about Tom.

episodes.title: The Kingmaker
episodes.description: Red thinks the Kingmaker (Linus Roache), a strategist, is responsible when a politician in Prague is framed for murder; Liz uncovers a secret Red has been hiding.

episodes.title: Berlin (1)
episodes.description: After discovering the truth behind her father's death, Liz refuses to work with Red, just as his situation grows desperate.

episodes.title: Berlin: Conclusion (2)
episodes.description: Liz is forced to reunite with Red in order to track down Berlin.

episodes.title: Lord Baltimore
episodes.description: While continuing to battle Berlin, Red faces a new threat in the form of Lord Baltimore. A figure from Red's past returns. Liz tries to move on after her showdown with Tom.

episodes.title: Monarch Douglas Bank
episodes.description: A robbery provides Red with an opportunity to take down a questionable bank. Liz questions Red's intentions during the course of her investigation. An impressive addition is made to Cooper's team.

episodes.title: Dr. James Covington
episodes.description: When a body is found missing a heart, Liz and Ressler join forces with Samar Navabi to investigate Dr. Covington's operation. Red and an associate try to take advantage of an opportunity in Indonesia.

episodes.title: Dr. Linus Creel
episodes.description: Red thinks a dangerous sociopsychological experiment may be taking place when several previously nonviolent citizens become killers. Red has a complicated proposition for Naomi and her husband.

episodes.title: The Front
episodes.description: The team targets an eco-terrorist cell seeking a deadly weapon. Liz attempts to lose her guardian. Red resorts to manipulation to pursue a special someone.

episodes.title: The Mombasa Cartel
episodes.description: Liz asks Red for information about deadly wildlife poachers after a mutilated corpse washes ashore. Ressler forms a dangerous habit.

episodes.title: The Scimitar
episodes.description: A plot for revenge emerges after an Iranian nuclear scientist is assassinated. Liz and Ressler wind up in a predicament.

episodes.title: The Decembrist
episodes.description: Red's plans for Berlin take a sudden turn after he finds out that he was manipulated by the latest Blacklister to avenge Red.

episodes.title: Luther Braxton (1)
episodes.description: When Red is arrested and taken to a secret detention facility, Liz and the task force set out to save him before he disappears forever. At the facility, Red encounters a thief with whom he shares a complicated history.

episodes.title: Luther Braxton: Conclusion (2)
episodes.description: As chaos ensues at the Factory, leaving the fate of Red and the task force unknown, Cooper struggles to rescue his team from the detention facility. It’s a race against time to prevent Luther Braxton attaining confidential information.

episodes.title: Ruslan Denisov
episodes.description: When an undercover CIA agent is kidnapped by a band of separatists in Uzbekistan, the task force sets a rescue mission in motion. Red informs Liz and Ressler that they are up against a very dangerous former associate.

episodes.title: The Kenyon Family
episodes.description: When Red tips Liz off about the disappearance of a polygamous cult leader with dangerous shipping containers buried on his property, the task force sets out to investigate. Red utilizes his sources to appease Fitch’s last words and tries to track down his hidden safe.

episodes.title: The Deer Hunter
episodes.description: Red helps Liz and the task force find a killer -- the Deer Hunter -- who tracks victims like prey.

episodes.title: T. Earl King VI
episodes.description: A former paramour involves Reddington in a deadly game with a wealthy, powerful family dynasty whose ill-begotten fortune was amassed from an underground auction of human and material contraband. Meanwhile, Tom takes on a new mission.

episodes.title: The Major
episodes.description: When Agent Keen is questioned in court as a suspect in the murder of the DC Harbormaster, her unusual relationship with Red and their task force falls under scrutiny. Meanwhile, Red enlists Cooper and Ressler to locate "The Major," a dangerous former associate who is key in keeping Liz out of prison.

episodes.title: Tom Keen
episodes.description: Evidence mounts against Liz in a murder case, triggering Red and Ressler's efforts to clear her name by tracking down the recently vanished Tom Keen.

episodes.title: The Longevity Initiative
episodes.description: The task force tracks a scientist who abducts disabled patients to conduct experiments on immortality. Now back in Washington, DC, Tom scrambles to save himself from new enemies.

episodes.title: Vanessa Cruz
episodes.description: The task force tracks a provocative female Blacklister, a frame-up artist who targets the wealthy elite. Tom pleads for Liz's help. Red pressures Liz for the Fulcrum, claiming it's now a matter of life and death.

episodes.title: Leonard Caul
episodes.description: Red fights for his life while the task force races to track down a mysterious figure from his past while Tom provides help in an unexpected way.

episodes.title: Quon Zhang
episodes.description: After decoding the information that is embedded in The Fulcrum, Red is determined to stop the imminent threat. Meanwhile, the task force discovers that deceased bodies of Chinese-American women are being smuggled out of the country under false identities. Liz continues to search for answers about her past after discovering a picture hidden in Red's secret flat.

episodes.title: Karakurt
episodes.description: Following intel from Red, the FBI find themselves one-step behind the most dangerous Russian Assassin, Karakurt, an enemy on U.S. soil. To avoid catastrophe, Liz and Ressler meet with Russian Counter-Intelligence who offer insight not only on Karakurt, but also on the identity of Liz’s mother. Cooper finds himself in a compromising position.

episodes.title: Tom Connolly
episodes.description: Liz realizes she is being framed by The Cabal forcing Red to use his connections to help her clear her name. As Cooper receives shocking news, Ressler, Samar, and Aram must decide who on the task force can still be trusted.

episodes.title: The Troll Farmer
episodes.description: With the FBI hunting Liz for the murder of the attorney general, she and Red go on the run. Red reaches out to a contact for help fleeing the city.

episodes.title: Marvin Gerard
episodes.description: With Ressler in hot pursuit, Liz only has Red to trust; Red asks a lawyer named Marvin Gerard for help with a hostage situation. The FBI wants to force Cooper out of the task force.

episodes.title: Eli Matchett
episodes.description: Liz and Red take a detour to the Midwest. Ressler, Aram and Samar accidentally uncover what could turn into a global food crisis. Cooper seeks help from an unexpected source.

episodes.title: The Djinn
episodes.description: Red enlists a task force to locate the Djinn, an enigmatic woman who fulfills revenge fantasies. Red and Liz believe the Djinn can lead them to the Cabal and help them exonerate Liz.

episodes.title: Arioch Cain
episodes.description: Red and the FBI come together to protect Liz when a huge reward for her capture attracts attention from assassins.

episodes.title: Sir Crispin Crandall
episodes.description: Red and Liz catch wind that Andras Halmi, a trusted advisor of The Director, has gone missing. In pursuit of Halmi, Red and Liz narrowly escape a violent confrontation. Meanwhile, Tom ends up in a brutal "Fight Club" to find the one man he thinks will be able to exonerate Liz.

episodes.title: Zal Bin Hasaan
episodes.description: A family tragedy in Samar's past resurfaces when the Task Force hunt for an elusive international terrorist. The FBI and the Cabal gain significant ground in their search for Liz and Red. Meanwhile, Tom encounters complications in his plan to exonerate Liz.

episodes.title: Kings of the Highway
episodes.description: Red and Liz are unexpectedly separated from each other when Red falls into a dangerous situation. Samar makes a risky decision to help Liz while Tom and Cooper continue on their expedition to exonerate Liz.

episodes.title: The Director (1)
episodes.description: Liz awaits trial as Red and Aram take risky measures to protect her.

episodes.title: The Director: Conclusion (2)
episodes.description: The Cabal prepares to assassinate Liz, triggering Red's call to the task force to outmaneuver the Cabal in a bid to exonerate her. Red delivers a final ultimatum.

episodes.title: Mr. Gregory Devry
episodes.description: With her name finally cleared, Liz attempts to reclaim her former life. Red works with the task force to infiltrate an assembly of high-level criminals at large in a rare, risky opportunity to capture the heads of the world's most lethal organized crime syndicates.

episodes.title: The Vehm
episodes.description: When an associate of Red's is killed with a rare medieval device, Red realizes a lethal vigilante group from the Middle Ages has been resurrected; Liz considers her next move after receiving shocking news.

episodes.title: Alistair Pitt
episodes.description: Red and Liz work with the taskforce to stop a negotiator who has resurfaced to unite two rival crime families. Tom reconnects with a former flame.

episodes.title: Lady Ambrosia
episodes.description: After a missing child that has been presumed dead turns up alive, Red and Liz work with the taskforce to search for a dangerous woman who may be kidnapping children. Meanwhile, Tom faces shocking consequences after his plan to help Liz goes awry.

episodes.title: Drexel
episodes.description: After the founder of a successful internet start-up is found dead, Red recognizes the crime scene as the work of a notorious killer. Liz and the task force work with Red to track the murderer through a dangerous underground news source. Meanwhile, Tom faces a life threatening situation, while Liz considers options for her baby.

episodes.title: The Caretaker
episodes.description: After a State Department official is found dead in Beijing, Red and Liz link the murder to a secret keeper known as "The Caretaker," who maintains an impenetrable safety deposit vault for criminals. Red and Liz work with the task force to find the Caretaker and his collection of lethal and classified secrets. Meanwhile, Tom makes a risky decision, while Liz persists on her quest to find out more about her mother.

episodes.title: Mr. Solomon (1)
episodes.description: After Red learns that a tactical nuclear weapon is being targeted by thieves, it's a race against the clock as the task force struggles to stop them -- and prevent an imminent nuclear disaster. Meanwhile, Tom and Liz make a decision that will change their relationship forever.

episodes.title: Mr. Solomon: Conclusion (2)
episodes.description: A team member falls into grave danger due to a tragedy, leading the task force to rely on Red and his unorthodox methods. Meanwhile, an unforeseen complication impacts Tom and Liz.

episodes.title: Cape May
episodes.description: When a mysterious woman running from unknown assailants accidentally crosses paths with Reddington, he assists her in fighting her attackers.

episodes.title: The Artax Network
episodes.description: After an unexpected loss devastates the FBI task force, they must track down their assailants; a mysterious group whose agents operate using a worldwide satellite network. Meanwhile, Reddington is forced to confront a ghost from his past -- one who knows many of Red's secrets.

episodes.title: Susan Hargrave
episodes.description: When Reddington links an elegant, powerful and extremely dangerous woman to the recent tragic events, the task force is forced to play a deadly cat and mouse game to stop her before she strikes again.

episodes.title: Alexander Kirk (1)
episodes.description: The FBI task force's hunt for revenge nears its endgame. As Reddington and the team close in on the mysterious arch-criminal responsible for recent tragic events, they're forced to operate outside their comfort zone – and outside the law – in order to take down their enemy once and for all.

episodes.title: Alexander Kirk: Conclusion (2)
episodes.description: As Reddington and the task force close in on the person responsible for Liz's death, a shocking betrayal leaves them racing to save one of their own.

episodes.title: Esteban
episodes.description: After Liz is abducted by a man claiming to be her father, Red sets out to find her at any cost.  Meanwhile, the Task Force grapples with the shocking news that Liz is still alive.

episodes.title: Mato
episodes.description: Red enlists Tom and the Task Force to help track a notorious bounty hunter who may know Alexander Kirk's next move. Meanwhile, Liz struggles to decide if Kirk is trustworthy.

episodes.title: Miles McGrath
episodes.description: Red and the Task Force take extreme measures to hunt down one of Alexander Kirk's allies, Miles McGrath, a "criminal incubator" who finances crimes for profit. Meanwhile, Liz learns more about her family.

episodes.title: Gaia
episodes.description: As Red sets Liz and the Task Force on the trail of an eco-terrorist with a mysterious connection to Alexander Kirk, Tom takes matters into his own hands.

episodes.title: The Lindquist Concern
episodes.description: Liz's loyalties are tested as Red takes action on an operation to intercept Alexander Kirk. Meanwhile the Task Force races to find a killer who targets inventors of revolutionary technology.

episodes.title: The Thrushes
episodes.description: When Alexander Kirk contracts a mysterious group that specializes in hacking the world's most secure computer systems, Red and Liz see an opportunity to make a move on Kirk's organization.

episodes.title: Dr. Adrian Shaw (1)
episodes.description: Red directs the Task Force to track down an individual who provides new identities to criminals on the run. Meanwhile, as Alexander Kirk's medical condition worsens, Liz seeks guidance from Cooper on a crucial decision.

episodes.title: Dr. Adrian Shaw: Conclusion (2)
episodes.description: Red pressures Dr. Shaw to locate a former patient. Liz contemplates the implications of her ties to an increasingly desperate and dangerous Alexander Kirk. Mr. Kaplan comes to a critical realization about her future.

episodes.title: Lipet's Seafood Company
episodes.description: An investigation into an international terrorist operating on American soil tests the allegiances of the Task Force. As Aram faces the consequences of his girlfriend hacking into the FBI computer systems, Red cashes in on a favor.

episodes.title: The Forecaster
episodes.description: A new case arrives at Liz's doorstep, where someone has left a diorama depicting a crime soon to be committed. Meanwhile, Red explores a new business opportunity.

episodes.title: The Harem
episodes.description: Liz must prove herself to the leader of an elite group of female thieves in order to infiltrate their organization as they prepare for their next heist. Meanwhile, Red contends with unexpected problems in his operations, and Tom channels his energy into fatherly duties.

episodes.title: Natalie Luca
episodes.description: After discovering his criminal empire is under attack, Red turns to the task force for help, leading the team to hunt an assassin who kills her victims by infecting them with a lethal disease. Meanwhile, Red enlists Tom in an undercover operation.

episodes.title: Isabella Stone
episodes.description: As another member of Red's team is targeted, the task force races to stop the sophisticated criminal who has been attacking Red and his businesses. Meanwhile, a shocking event sends Tom on the hunt for information about his past.

episodes.title: The Architect
episodes.description: Aram goes under cover as a hacker to find a criminal who designs and executes crimes for a price.

episodes.title: The Apothecary
episodes.description: After being dosed with poison, Red must retrace his steps to discover which of his closest allies has betrayed him, while the task force races against the clock to find an antidote that will save him.

episodes.title: Dembe Zuma
episodes.description: After weeks of hunting for Dembe, Red and the Task Force finally get a lead on his whereabouts when Aram goes missing. Meanwhile, Dembe takes a calculated risk as Red closes in.

episodes.title: Requiem
episodes.description: Memories of the past set Red on a dangerous collision course with an enemy determined to destroy his criminal empire.

episodes.title: Philomena
episodes.description: The Task Force chases an artful bounty hunter employed to target Red's closest associates. Meanwhile, Ressler faces a moral dilemma when he takes on a new assignment with a former colleague.

episodes.title: Dr. Bogdan Krilov
episodes.description: Red sets the Task Force on the trail of a Blacklister with the tools to manipulate memories, causing Liz to question her own experiences. As Gale intensifies his investigation, Ressler receives a new lead on the disappearance of Justice Department official Reven Wright.

episodes.title: The Debt Collector
episodes.description: When Liz becomes the target of a mercenary known as the Debt Collector, Red turns to an unlikely source for help. Meanwhile, Ressler faces an unexpected complication in his efforts to stay ahead of Agent Gale's investigation.

episodes.title: Mr. Kaplan (1)
episodes.description: Red tracks a high-end thief enlisted by Mr. Kaplan for a mysterious assignment. Aram faces a tough decision when agent Gale goes to extreme measures in his investigation into the Task Force's conduct.

episodes.title: Mr. Kaplan: Conclusion (2)
episodes.description: Red sets a dangerous plan in motion to save himself and the Task Force as Kaplan engages in the final phase of her assault on his criminal empire. With the future of the Task Force in jeopardy, Liz confronts the biggest questions about her past.

episodes.title: Smokey Putnum
episodes.description: With his criminal empire in ruins, Red enlists Liz in a plan to earn cash and deliver a new Blacklister to the Task Force.

episodes.title: Greyson Blaise
episodes.description: Liz and the Task Force join Red on an international adventure in pursuit of a billionaire who moonlights as a high end art thief. Meanwhile, Dembe chases a lead and Tom seeks outside help in identifying the remains in the suitcase.

episodes.title: Miss Rebecca Thrall
episodes.description: While the Task Force investigates a series of suspicious police shootings, Agent Ressler is distracted by increasing external pressures. With his back up against the wall, Red drafts Tom in executing an elaborate plan to help re-establish his criminal reputation.

episodes.title: The Endling
episodes.description: Liz and the Task Force hunt for an elusive criminal who will stop at nothing to destroy some of the world's most precious treasures. Meanwhile, a surprise encounter leads a cash-strapped Red toward a new business opportunity, and Tom takes action to investigate the bones in the suitcase.

episodes.title: Ilyas Surkov
episodes.description: When Red provides exclusive intel on an international terrorist, it puts Liz and the Task Force on a collision course with a rival unit from the CIA. Meanwhile, Red and Hawkins lay the groundwork for their new business venture, and Tom goes undercover in search of information.

episodes.title: The Travel Agency
episodes.description: While Cooper enlists Red on a case of personal importance, Ressler leads the Task Force on a mission to stop the resurgence of once-dormant murder-for-hire ring. Determined to find answers, Tom disregards a warning to halt his investigation into the suitcase.

episodes.title: The Kilgannon Corporation
episodes.description: Red and the Task Force place Dembe undercover to infiltrate an international human smuggling organization, but when communication is lost, they must intervene. Meanwhile, Tom's investigation into the suitcase lands him in grave danger.

episodes.title: Ian Garvey
episodes.description: Tom goes missing and Liz desperately retraces his steps to find him. Red's hunt for the suitcase of bones leads to lives being changed forever.

episodes.title: Ruin
episodes.description: Liz abandons her old life and seeks out a fresh start in a place where no one knows her history, her name, or the depths of her grief. When an unexpected threat finds her, she is forced to draw on her emotional and physical strength in a brutal fight for survival.

episodes.title: The Informant
episodes.description: When Red directs the Task Force to find a Blacklister who uses his position of power to sell sensitive information, Ressler finds himself at risk of exposure. Meanwhile, Liz plans her next move.

episodes.title: Abraham Stern
episodes.description: When Red goes on the hunt for a legendary treasure, he draws the attention of Abraham Stern, a cunning manipulator who has devoted his life - and the lives of many innocents - to recovering the fortune that is his birthright. Meanwhile, Liz's quest sends her down a dark path, leading her to study the methods of one of the Blacklist's most dangerous criminals.

episodes.title: The Cook
episodes.description: As Liz works with Red to hunt for Tom's killers, she begins to question his motives. The Task Force enlists the help of one arsonist to catch another.

episodes.title: The Invisible Hand
episodes.description: When bodies are discovered in abandoned woods, Red points the Task Force toward The Invisible Hand, a group that targets those whose actions are morally reprehensible yet fully legal. Meanwhile, Red steps in to assist one of his employees, and Liz discovers a major clue about Tom's investigation.

episodes.title: Mr. Raleigh Sinclair III
episodes.description: Red assists the Task Force in tracking a mysterious Blacklister who carefully develops airtight alibis for murderous clients. Meanwhile, Liz's reinstatement at the FBI hinges on an evaluation with a psychotherapist.

episodes.title: Pattie Sue Edwards
episodes.description: As Liz continues tracking Tom's killers, Red tries to solve a tax issue in his money laundering. Meanwhile, Aram goes out to the field when the Task Force investigates a viral outbreak.

episodes.title: The Capricorn Killer
episodes.description: As Liz investigates new details in a cold case from her early work as an FBI profiler, she explores her darker impulses in therapy with Dr. Fulton. The Task Force takes action to bring down Tom's killers within the legal system, while Red takes a different approach to closing in on Ian Garvey.

episodes.title: Anna-Gracia Duerte
episodes.description: When an associate of the Nash Syndicate is murdered, Red sets Liz and the Task Force on the case in order to recover evidence crucial to bringing down Ian Garvey. Meanwhile, Aram considers a step forward in his relationship with Samar.

episodes.title: Zarak Mosadek
episodes.description: In an attempt to apply pressure to Ian Garvey, Red and the Task Force head to Paris to track down a prominent heroin supplier for the Nash Syndicate. Distrustful of Red's agenda, Liz takes her own path in going after Garvey.

episodes.title: Ian Garvey: Conclusion
episodes.description: Liz uses intel from an unexpected source to force Red to uncover the secrets he holds. Red initiates a plan to retrieve the duffel bag of bones.

episodes.title: Nicholas T. Moore
episodes.description: An unidentified young girl reappears and the team tries to find her connection to the secret Red is hiding. When her family steps in to protect their own secrets, the investigation turns into a race to save the girl's life.

episodes.title: Lawrence Dane Devlin
episodes.description: Samar lands in the crosshairs of an unconventional Blacklister, and Aram and the task force spring into action to find her before it's too late. Red journeys to Costa Rica to prevent the duffel bag of bones from being sold at an underground auction.

episodes.title: Sutton Ross
episodes.description: Liz and Red face off in a climactic race to find a Blacklister in possession of the duffel bag of bones, forcing the truth about the bones to finally come to light.

title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
originalTitle: Miraculous, les aventures de Ladybug et Chat Noir
description: Marinette and Adrien, two Parisian teenagers, are entrusted with powerful jewels in order to transform into superheroes Ladybug and Cat Noir. But neither hero knows the other's true identity — or that they're classmates!

episodes.title: Stormy Weather
episodes.description: The loser of a kids-channel contest gets akumatized by Hawk Moth. Now Stormy Weather, she takes revenge on those who did not vote for her.  Dark skies await for our superheroes!

episodes.title: The Bubbler
episodes.description: Adrien's best friend, Nino, is akumatized into the Bubbler, a villain who traps adults in bubbles and sends them floating away into the atmosphere.

episodes.title: The Pharaoh
episodes.description: When a villain with the power of the ancient Egyptian gods wants to sacrifice Alya, Ladybug and Cat Noir must fight an army of mummies to rescue her.

episodes.title: Lady Wifi
episodes.description: Mistakenly believing that Chloé is Ladybug, Alya gets expelled from school for her nosiness and becomes akumatized into the villain Lady Wifi.

episodes.title: Timebreaker
episodes.description: When anger over a broken watch turns Alix into a time-traveling villain, it's up to Ladybug to return to the past and thwart her plans.

episodes.title: Mr. Pigeon
episodes.description: The akuma fighters try to apprehend Mr. Pigeon, a bird lover who has kidnapped all the park keepers in Paris, but Cat Noir's allergies interfere.

episodes.title: The Evillustrator
episodes.description: A fellow student with a crush on Marinette is akumatized into the Evillustrator, a villain that Cat Noir must face without Ladybug.

episodes.title: Rogercop
episodes.description: When he's fired by the mayor, police officer Roger becomes Rogercop, a villain who thinks he's enforcing the law by ruling Paris as a dictator.

episodes.title: Copycat
episodes.description: A jealous sculptor in love with Ladybug akumatizes into Copycat, a duplicate of Cat Noir who tries to take his rival's place by Ladybug's side.

episodes.title: Dark Cupid
episodes.description: Marinette considers declaring her feelings to Adrien for Valentine's Day, but first they must stop Dark Cupid, a villain bent on eradicating love.

episodes.title: Horrificator
episodes.description: During the filming of a short horror movie for Marinette's class, scared star Mylène is akumatized into a slimy monster that feeds on others' fears.

episodes.title: Darkblade
episodes.description: While Marinette tries to retrieve her diary from Chloé, Adrien's fencing teacher is akumatized into Darkblade, a villain who storms city hall.

episodes.title: The Mime
episodes.description: When Mylène's father loses a part in a play to his scheming understudy, he akumatizes into the Mime, a villain whose pantomimes become real.

episodes.title: Kung Food
episodes.description: When his dish at a competition is sabotaged, Marinette's great-uncle chef Wang Cheng becomes Kung Food, who recruits henchmen with his cooking.

episodes.title: Gamer
episodes.description: Marinette beats Adrien's video game tournament partner, Max, so she can replace him and spend time with her crush, but Max akumatizes into a villain.

episodes.title: Animan
episodes.description: A humiliated zookeeper is akumatized into a villainous shapeshifting animal on a day when Marinette, Adrien and friends are visiting the zoo in Paris.

episodes.title: Antibug
episodes.description: Crestfallen when her hero Ladybug refuses to heed her advice, Chloé akumatizes into Antibug, an evil twin of Ladybug with identical powers.

episodes.title: The Puppeteer
episodes.description: Marinette babysits little Manon, who becomes akumatized into the Puppeteer while playing with dolls of Ladybug, Cat Noir and some infamous villains.

episodes.title: Reflekta
episodes.description: Excluded from a class photo, dejected Juleka akumatizes into the villain Reflekta, who turns everyone, including Cat Noir, into copies of herself.

episodes.title: Guitar Villain
episodes.description: Rock star Jagged Stone is akumatized into a supervillain who tries to transform all Parisians into fans and undermine his musical rival, Mr. XY.

episodes.title: Pixelator
episodes.description: Rejected by a rock star, an angry fan becomes Pixelator, who traps Parisians in his camera's memory until Cat Noir and Ladybug halt his photo spree.

episodes.title: Princess Fragrance
episodes.description: Marinette can't transform into Ladybug when classmate Rose is akumatized into a villain whose perfume lets her control Cat Noir and a visiting prince.

episodes.title: Simon Says
episodes.description: A hypnotist akumatizes into Simon Says, a villain who can make anyone obey him with his deck of cards, and seeks revenge on Adrien's father.

episodes.title: Volpina
episodes.description: After Ladybug exposes her lies in front of Adrien, Lila, a new student, becomes akumatized and poses as a superhero.

episodes.title: Ladybug & Cat Noir - Origins, Part 1
episodes.description: In a flashback, Ladybug and Cat Noir's origins are revealed, as Marinette befriends Alya and meets Adrien, a famous model with an overprotective dad.

episodes.title: Stoneheart - Origins, Part 2
episodes.description: In a continuing flashback to Ladybug and Cat Noir's origins, Marinette mistakes Adrien for a bully and hesitates to embrace her Ladybug persona.

episodes.title: The Collector
episodes.description: Master Fu and Marinette believe that the owner of the Miraculous book is Hawk Moth, but that suspicion leads to either Adrien or his father, Gabriel.

episodes.title: Despair Bear
episodes.description: Trying to learn how to be nice, Chloé throws a party but loses her temper and fires her butler, who becomes akumatized into the vengeful Despair Bear.

episodes.title: Prime Queen
episodes.description: During an exclusive interview, a reporter trying to trap Ladybug and Cat Noir into confessing feelings for each other is akumatized by Hawk Moth.

episodes.title: Befana
episodes.description: When Marinette elects to hang out with her friends on her birthday instead of her grandmother, grandma is akumatized into a candy-gun-wielding baddie.

episodes.title: Riposte
episodes.description: A fencing opponent who loses a duel against Adrien gets akumatized and goes after him for a rematch while only Ladybug is around to protect him.

episodes.title: Robostus
episodes.description: Hawk Moth akumatizes Max's best friend and pet robot, Markov, into Robostus, a raging techno-threat with the power to bring inanimate objects to life.

episodes.title: Gigantitan
episodes.description: Marinette's plans to ask Adrien out on a romantic walk are foiled when Hawk Moth akumatizes a frustrated child into a giant, lollipop-seeking baby.

episodes.title: The Dark Owl
episodes.description: After school principal Damocles is akumatized into Dark Owl, he traps Ladybug and Cat Noir in a warehouse and tries to uncover their true identities.

episodes.title: Glaciator
episodes.description: Marinette meets Alya and friends for a treat at André's, a legendary Parisian ice cream maker, but André is akumatized into the villain Glaciator.

episodes.title: Sapotis
episodes.description: During a sleepover with Marinette, Alya punishes her twin sisters, Etta and Ella, who get akumatized into monsters that multiply when they eat.

episodes.title: Gorizilla
episodes.description: Marinette must rescue Adrien from a group of overzealous fans and from his own bodyguard, who has been akumatized into the hulking Gorizilla.

episodes.title: Captain Hardrock
episodes.description: Hawk Moth akumatizes Juleka's mother into Captain Hardrock, a pirate whose indestructible ship blasts loud music to destroy a music festival.

episodes.title: Zombizou
episodes.description: The students give gifts to Miss Bustier on her birthday but the popular teacher is akumatized into Zombizou, a monster armed with evil black lipstick.

episodes.title: Syren
episodes.description: When her crush, Kim, goes on a movie date with someone else, talented swimmer Ondine gets akumatized into Syren, who tries to submerge Paris.

episodes.title: Frightningale
episodes.description: Marinette is cast to play Ladybug and Adrien as Cat Noir for a music video honoring the heroes, but the star gets akumatized into a musical monster.

episodes.title: Troublemaker
episodes.description: A rock star is scheduled to visit the bakery owned by Marinette's parents, but his overwhelmed personal assistant is akumatized by Hawk Moth.

episodes.title: Anansi
episodes.description: Alya's older sister Nora becomes akumatized by Hawk Moth into Anansi, an enormous spider-woman hybrid named after an African folktale.

episodes.title: Sandboy
episodes.description: The supervillain Sandboy uses his powers to turn the nightmares of Parisians into reality, forcing a Tikki-less Marinette to intervene.

episodes.title: Reverser
episodes.description: Angry over his perception that Marinette and Nathaniel humiliated him, fellow student Marc becomes Reverser, who is determined to get revenge.

episodes.title: Frozer
episodes.description: A figure skater gets akumatized by Hawk Moth into Frozer, a villain armed with powerful skates who tries to turn Paris into a frozen wasteland.

episodes.title: Style Queen: The Queen's Battle (1)
episodes.description: When she is humiliated by Gabriel, Chloe's mother becomes Style Queen, who possesses a magical scepter and aims to exact her revenge on Adrien.

episodes.title: Queen Wasp: The Queen's Battle (2)
episodes.description: In an attempt to impress her mother, Chloe tries to become the superhero Queen Bee but is instead transformed into the supervillain Queen Wasp.

episodes.title: Malediktator
episodes.description: When Chloe considers leaving Paris, her father, Mayor Bourgeois, turns into Malediktator, a powerful villain who wants her to stay at any cost.

episodes.title: Catalyst: Heroes' Day (1)
episodes.description: Marinette lies about preparing a good deed to perform for others on the Day of Heroes and quickly finds her untruth spinning out of control.

episodes.title: Mayura: Heroes' Day (2)
episodes.description: Ladybug and Cat Noir face one of their most fearsome opponents when Hawk Moth sets a sinister plan into motion by akumatizing his assistant.

episodes.title: Backwarder
episodes.description: After Marinette mixes up some messages, an old love of Master Fu becomes Backwarder, who wields a magic wand that can steal time from others.

episodes.title: Weredad
episodes.description: Disappointed that Cat Noir doesn't return his daughter's love, Tom becomes Weredad, who locks Marinette in a magic prison to protect her from hurt.

episodes.title: Chameleon
episodes.description: Marinette and Adrien confront Lila with her lies, so she asks Hawk Moth to akumatize her into Chameleon, a new villain determined to destroy Ladybug.

episodes.title: Animaestro
episodes.description: Humiliated at the premiere of his new Ladybug and Cat Noir movie, the director becomes Animaestro, forcing the real superheroes to act fast.

episodes.title: Bakerix
episodes.description: Marinette meets her grumpy grandpa for the first time, leading him to akumatize into a villain who wants to destroy everything modern in Paris.

episodes.title: Silencer
episodes.description: Marinette and Kitty Section record a music video, but an unscrupulous producer, the father of XY, steals their ideas and inspires Luka to seek revenge.

episodes.title: Oblivio
episodes.description: When they enter the Montparnasse Tower, Ladybug and Cat Noir lose their memories and transform back into Marinette and Adrien in front of each other.

episodes.title: Stormy Weather 2
episodes.description: Ladybug and Cat Noir must fight Aurore Boreale when she is akumatized again into Stormy Weather 2, who wants to plunge the world into endless winter.

episodes.title: Reflekdoll
episodes.description: Ladybug and Cat Noir each get the other's Miraculous when they must take on Juleka, who has become Reflekta again and now has a sentimonster.

episodes.title: Oni-Chan
episodes.description: Kagami becomes jealous when Lila manipulates her way into the Agreste mansion and turns into Oni-Chan, a masked villain who can teleport.

episodes.title: Miraculer
episodes.description: Sabrina, angry at Chloe for the attention she gives to Ladybug, becomes Miraculer, who can steal powers away from superheroes.

episodes.title: The Puppeteer 2
episodes.description: Marinette tries to arrange some alone time with Adrien at the wax museum, but she's supposed to be babysitting Manon, who becomes Puppeteer again.

episodes.title: Desperada
episodes.description: Jagged Stone seeks to replace the guitarist he fired, who akumatizes into Desperada, a villain with a magic guitar that turns people into stickers.

episodes.title: Startrain
episodes.description: Anxiously awaiting news about her astronaut application, Max's mom becomes Startrain, who wants to turn her train into a rocket ship.

episodes.title: Kwamibuster
episodes.description: Mrs. Mendeleiev discovers Plagg and Tikki and plans to reveal the existence of the kwamis on a TV show until she is akumatized into Kwami Buster.

episodes.title: Feast
episodes.description: A strange statue uncovered in Tibet turns out to be a sentimonster called Feast that was created accidentally by Master Fu when he was a child.

episodes.title: Ikari Gozen
episodes.description: Adrien is the prize in a Paris-wide Friendship Day treasure hunt, but Marinette is teamed up with Kagami, who has disobeyed her mother to participate.

episodes.title: Timetagger
episodes.description: Ladybug and Cat Noir are trapped between two time travelers from the future, one of whom has been sent by Hawk Moth to steal their Miraculous.

episodes.title: Party Crasher
episodes.description: After Adrien tells his friend Wayem he's not allowed to have friends over, Wayem discovers an impromptu party at the Agrestes that makes him jealous.

episodes.title: Gamer 2.0
episodes.description: When he can't find anyone to test his video game that pits formerly akumatized villains against one another, Max again becomes one himself: Gamer 2.0.

episodes.title: Cat Blanc
episodes.description: Marinette uses her powers to leave a gift for Adrien, causing him to realize her secret identity -- which has a devastating impact on the future.

episodes.title: Félix
episodes.description: Marinette reveals her feelings for Adrien on the anniversary of his mom's death, but his lookalike cousin pretends to be Adrien and responds cruelly.

episodes.title: Ladybug
episodes.description: Marinette's scheming nemesis Lila manipulates all of her friends into turning against her and even gets Marinette expelled from school.

episodes.title: Chris Master
episodes.description: Marinette babysits Nino's little brother, Chris, who akumatizes into Chris Master and wields a magic snow globe that can make giant toys.

episodes.title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous – Part 1)
episodes.description: At a celebration for their twentieth anniversary, the Bourgeois couple is akumatized into Hearthunter, a two-headed Cerberus that devours love.

episodes.title: Miracle Queen (The Battle of the Miraculous – Part 2)
episodes.description: Hawk Moth changes Chloe into Miracle Queen and conquers Paris, forcing Miraculous wearers to reveal themselves -- but Ladybug and Cat Noir escape.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.description: A friend of Marinette's gets akumatized into Truth. Using his power to force people to tell the truth, he wants to know Marinette's secret.

episodes.title: Lies
episodes.description: A friend of Adrien's gets akumatized into Lies and becomes determined to rid the world of lies and those who tell them.

episodes.title: Gang of Secrets
episodes.description: Marinette's friends get akumatized into the Gang of Secrets, a team of supervillains determined to save her.

episodes.title: Mr. Pigeon 72
episodes.description: Mr. Ramier gets akumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the 72nd time, and now he can turn people into evil pigeons.

episodes.title: Furious Fu
episodes.description: Ladybug and Cat Noir face someone they know well, and never imagined they would have to fight someday.

episodes.title: Sole Crusher
episodes.description: A newcomer to Marinette's circle of friends gets akumatized into Sole Crusher, a humongous supervillain who can absorb people.

episodes.title: Queen Banana
episodes.description: Chloe is akumatized into Queen Banana and Ladybug decides to entrust a Miraculous to help her stop a supervillain.

episodes.title: Guiltrip
episodes.description: When Reflekta becomes entangled in a bottomless abyss of guilt, Ladybug calls an ally for help with unshakable optimism.

episodes.title: Crocoduel
episodes.description: Because of a plan thought up by Marinette, Shadow Moth akumatizes two villains. Ladybug and Cat Noir will need help to stop the evil duo.

episodes.title: Optigami
episodes.description: What would happen if Shadow Moth created a fearsome supervillain while Marinette and Adrien couldn't transform into Ladybug and Cat Noir?

episodes.title: Sentibubbler
episodes.description: Shadow Moth creates Sentibubbler, a fearsome sentimonster that will only stop if Rena Rouge betrays Ladybug and Cat Noir!

episodes.title: Rocketear
episodes.description: As Guardian of Miraculous, Ladybug must make difficult decisions which affect the people around her. But not everyone is ready to live in permanent hiding like her...

episodes.title: Mega Leech
episodes.description: When Malediktator comes back, now seconded by a Sentimonster, Ladybug entrusts a committed friend and ally with a Miraculous to help her save Paris.

episodes.title: Wishmaker
episodes.description: As Marinette thinks about her future, a supervillain shows up in Paris. Able to force people to live their childhood dreams, he turns into a nightmare for our heroes.

episodes.title: Hack-San
episodes.description: When Marinette needs to leave Paris for a day for her aunt's birthday in London, the fear of something happening in Ladybug's absence makes her super nervous. Shadow Moth manages to infect Max's robot with an evil virus to akumatize it again. What will happen?

episodes.title: Simpleman
episodes.description: Adrien asks Marinette a favor, who can't say no and ends up leaving her grandfather taking care of the 4 children she was taking care of to help Adrien. What she doesn't realize is that it ends up making her grandfather the Shadow Moth's next target.

episodes.title: Glaciator 2
episodes.description: Ladybug and Cat Noir face Glaciator again. Glaciator annoys Ladybug by insisting that the superheroes are in love. Cat Noir encounters Marinette, who wrestles with secret romance.

episodes.title: Dearest Family
episodes.description: Galette Day is eventful for Marinette! Tikki is acting very strange and three supervillains show up! Will Ladybug still manage to establish herself as queen of the day?

episodes.title: Ephemeral
episodes.description: Ladybug decides whether she should reveal Cat Noir's identity so that she can remain the Guardian.

episodes.title: Gabriel Agreste
episodes.description: Marinette sneaks into the Agreste home during a private dinner, only to find that a supervillain is also crashing the party.

episodes.title: Psycomedian
episodes.description: A famous comedian gets akumatized into Psycomedian; able to impose any emotions on anyone, he wants to wipe the smiles off everyone's faces starting with Ladybug and Cat Noir.

episodes.title: Kuro Neko
episodes.description: Ladybug manages to assemble an amazing team of superheroes now that she is Guardian of the Miraculous, but Cat Noir is feeling left out and decides to give up his Miraculous. Ladybug now needs to deliver the Cat Miraculous to someone else.

episodes.title: Penalteam
episodes.description: When one of Shadow Moth's favorite victims is akumatized into Penalteam, a fearsome team of supervillains, Ladybug calls on her own superhero team in order to face her; may the best team win.

episodes.title: Qilin
episodes.description: Because one of Marinette's careless mistakes, one of her closet relatives is akumatized into Qilin, a fearsome supervillain.

episodes.title: Risk (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 1)
episodes.description: Without Ladybug and Cat Noir knowing, Shadow Moth patiently sets his final attack in motion...

episodes.title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
episodes.description: Shadow Moth's trap closes in on Ladybug and Cat Noir, threatening to turn their fate upside down forever...

episodes.title: Evolution
episodes.description: After having access to almost all the Miraculouses, Hawk Moth turns into Monarch and uses the Rabbit Miraculous to return to a vulnerable moment in Ladybug and Cat Noir's past to capture their Miraculous.

episodes.title: Multiplication
episodes.description: As the days go by, not a single akumatized villain shows up to torment Paris. Could Monarch possibly have given up?

episodes.title: Destruction
episodes.description: What if Ladybug's worst nightmare came true? What if Monarch showed up at Marinette Dupain-Cheng's home... would she be able to escape him?

episodes.title: Jubilation
episodes.description: Monarch entrusts an akumatized villain with the power of Jubilation, which shows people their deepest desires. Will Ladybug and Cat Noir escape that dangerous power?

episodes.title: Determination
episodes.description: While Marinette and Adrien wonder about their feelings, Ladybug and Cat Noir face a villain... and her 17 goons!

episodes.title: Passion
episodes.description: As everything turns upside down in their love lives, Ladybug and Cat Noir must exchange their Miraculous to escape a ruthless villain.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.description: While visiting the Louvre museum, Marinette discovers the secrets of the kwagatama that Tikki gave her on her birthday.

episodes.title: Illusion
episodes.description: A secret network at school is determined to find out how Monarch's new power works by deliberately triggering an akumatization. Would Ladybug and Cat Noir agree with such a plan?

episodes.title: Elation
episodes.description: As Ladybug and Cat Noir face Glaciator again, our heroes don’t know that they are about to make a chilling discovery!

episodes.title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
episodes.description: Tikki and Plagg are sad to see their carriers so sad to be forced to give up their feelings. The Kwamis will then make a radical choice that will change many things in Paris.

episodes.title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
episodes.description: Monarch is faced with a unique opportunity that he refuses to miss. The world is about to be reconfigured, and no one seems able to prevent it, for the Kwamis have made a choice that completely freed Marinette and Adrien from their responsibilities. For better… and for worse.

episodes.title: Perfection
episodes.description: The whole class has decided to do everything to help Marinette finally get closer to Adrien, but what they don't know is that she also has come up with a unique plan to try and tell Adrien how she feels.

episodes.title: Migration
episodes.description: As the son of a celebrity, Luka piques special interest in Bob Roth, who would do anything to make money! But Luka himself would do anything to defend his values and his friends.

episodes.title: Derision
episodes.description: Marinette is about to have a normal date with Adrien, but she starts to suffer repeated panic attacks creating an emotional situation that can make her a target for Monarch.

episodes.title: Intuition
episodes.description: Monarch senses a unique occasion to get a real second chance. He is ready to do anything, even if it means that this could be his last chance to seize the Miraculous.

episodes.title: Protection
episodes.description: While the gang concocts yet another elaborate plan to reunite Marinette and Adrien, Lila uses her talents for manipulation to persuade Kagami that Marinette is a liar.

episodes.title: Adoration
episodes.description: Marinette learns that Zoé is secretly in love with someone in ninth grade at school. Zoé says that she cannot talk about it. To Marinette, this can only mean one thing: Zoé is in love with Adrien!

episodes.title: Emotion
episodes.description: Adrien must attend the Diamonds’ Dance organized by his father and Mrs. Tsurugi. When she finds out that Adrien did not dare to tell her about the dance, Marinette decides to go too.

episodes.title: Pretension
episodes.description: Marinette decides to have a frank talk with Gabriel Agreste about her love for Adrien, and her courage inspires her friend Kagami as she tries to open up to her mother.

episodes.title: Revelation
episodes.description: Marinette and Adrien’s closeness pushes the boy’s father to make Kagami the face of the brand, which infuriates Lila. She uses the class accident to call for a new election so that she can replace Marinette as class representative.

episodes.title: Confrontation
episodes.description: The end of secondary school is approaching and Lila & Chloé have to defend their classmates futures in front of the class council. Marinette is worried. What will be the next evil plan of the 2 villains?

episodes.title: Collusion
episodes.description: The end of the school year is approaching and the rebellion is growing. Monarch decides to implement a dangerous plan for his secret identity, but also very precarious for Ladybug and Cat Noir.

episodes.title: Revolution
episodes.description: Chloé is more powerful than ever and, thanks to her, so is Monarch. Ladybug and Cat Noir wonder about their superpowers, unaware that they have just fallen into a machiavellian trap. As for Marinette and Adrien, their lives are about to change forever.

episodes.title: Representation
episodes.description: When Adrien disobeys his father to join Marinette, the latter is forced to find his son. At the same time, Marinette is convinced that Adrien is looking for her. Thinking she will find the boy she loves, she discovers a secret that nothing prepared her for.

episodes.title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)
episodes.description: Monarch has just placed the final pieces of his machiavellian plan on his chessboard of evil. Are Ladybug and Chat Noir doomed?

episodes.title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
episodes.description: Monarch's ultimate plan is now underway. Nothing seems to be able to stop him. Especially as, while the world is plunged into chaos, the super-villain has just trapped Ladybug himself.

title: Tulsa King
description: New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi is released from prison after 25 years and exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a crew.

episodes.title: Go West, Old Man
episodes.description: Dwight, blindsided by the news that his mob family has nothing left for him in New York, is sent to Tulsa, Oklahoma; as he settles in and surveys his new surroundings, Dwight wastes no time making new associates.

episodes.title: Center of the Universe
episodes.description: Dwight, Tyson, and Bodhi go on a road trip to take care of some business; Stacy does some digging into Dwight's past.

episodes.title: Caprice
episodes.description: Dwight takes note of a possible new business opportunity. Later, a routine errand has an explosive, unexpected outcome. Stacy opens up to Dwight about what led her to Tulsa.

episodes.title: Visitation Place
episodes.description: At the Tulsa Arena, Dwight and company test out their new plan, until a roadblock forces them to adjust and defend their turf. Tyson and his father argue about his future. Dwight gets an unexpected call.

episodes.title: Token Joe
episodes.description: Dwight returns to New York under unfortunate circumstances, where his reunion with his daughter and family doesn't go quite as expected. Back in Tulsa, Tyson runs into some trouble. Armand gets some news from Roxy.

episodes.title: Stable
episodes.description: Dwight visits Tina before returning to Tulsa. Pete agrees to send Goodie to Oklahoma, while Roxy tries to keep the FBI at bay. Dwight has an offer for Mitch.

episodes.title: Warr Acres
episodes.description: Stacy makes a decision that has serious consequences. Dwight and Armand dispose of evidence, and Bodhi proposes a new plan. Tina contemplates her future.

episodes.title: Adobe Walls
episodes.description: Dwight and Bodhi lay out the casino plan for Jimmy. As pressure increases, Dwight, Mitch, and Tyson assemble their team. Stacy confronts Waltrip.

episodes.title: Happy Trails
episodes.description: It's all hands on deck as tensions between Dwight's crew and Waltrip escalate past the point of no return. Elsewhere, a flashback reveals what sent Dwight to prison 25 years ago.

episodes.title: Back in the Saddle
episodes.description: As Dwight and his crew prepare for the opening of their casino and new weed shop, the law comes knocking.

episodes.title: Kansas City Blues
episodes.description: A family member from Dwight's past surprises him in Tulsa, meanwhile his newfound success draws attention from the Kansas City Mob.

episodes.title: Oklahoma v. Manfredi
episodes.description: Dwight has a contentious meeting with Bill Bevilaqua and later finds out his fate in court.

episodes.title: Heroes and Villains
episodes.description: Dwight and Bodhi explore a new investment opportunity. Meanwhile, Thresher learns how far he can push certain people.

episodes.title: Tilting at Windmills
episodes.description: Thresher makes a move on Dwight's crew as tensions rise within the New York City Mob family.

episodes.title: Navigator
episodes.description: Dwight has a sit-down with Kansas City and New York. Tyson tries to make his family proud but it comes at a price.

episodes.title: Life Support
episodes.description: Dwight and his crew try to identify who's responsible for the recent attack. Power dynamics within the NYC Mob start to shift.

episodes.title: Under New Management
episodes.description: Bevilaqua prepares for revenge. Thresher and Ming discuss a new arrangement.

episodes.title: Triad
episodes.description: Margaret gets caught up in the middle of Dwight's business as trouble ensues at Fennario Ranch.

episodes.title: Reconstruction
episodes.description: Dwight and his crew tie up loose ends as their empire expands.

episodes.title: Blood and Bourbon
episodes.description: Dwight tries to secure a distillery deal.

episodes.title: The Fifty
episodes.description: Dwight faces threats from Jeremiah Dunmire and the Dixie Mafia.

episodes.title: The G and the OG
episodes.description: Dwight is forced to work with Agent Musso to take down a terrorist.

episodes.title: Staring Down the Barrel
episodes.description: Dwight rallies his crew to recover the stolen bourbon from Dunmire.

episodes.title: On the Rocks
episodes.description: Dwight launches his bourbon brand as Dunmire schemes to crash the event.

episodes.title: Bubbles
episodes.description: Dwight scrambles while facing threats from Dunmire and Quiet Ray.

episodes.title: Art of War
episodes.description: Dwight moves to reopen his distillery. Tyson, Goodie & Spencer run a sting.

episodes.title: Nothing Is Over
episodes.description: Dwight uncovers a deadly plan by Dunmire and races to stop it.

episodes.title: Dead Weight
episodes.description: As Dwight expands his liquor empire, Tyson's side hustle draws heat.

episodes.title: Jesus Lizard
episodes.description: Dwight and his crew gear up for all-out war.

episodes.title: W.W.D.D.
episodes.description: Dwight leads his crew toward expanding their empire. Season premiere.

episodes.title: Blind Rooster
episodes.description: Reeling from a crushing personal loss, Dwight leans on Bodhi's unexpected honesty as his crew faces fallout from Tyson's tainted pills.

episodes.title: Cease & Desist
episodes.description: Dwight rallies the troops to fight back as Governor Clark shuts down his businesses, freezes bourbon shipments, and targets his crew.

episodes.title: Square One
episodes.description: Dwight regroups as Mitch and Spencer prep for a high stakes score. Bodhi expands a counterfeit scheme, and Tyson tests his rap ambitions.

episodes.title: Dinosaurs
episodes.description: Dwight sees his enemies multiplying. Bodhi and Timpone race to profit from their wine as Mitch and Spencer make a discovery worth millions.

episodes.title: Racket Club
episodes.description: Dwight battles Turco's rising demands while racing to protect the ranch from Van Heusen's land grab. Tyson gets a life changing offer.

episodes.title: Black Diamonds
episodes.description: Dwight expands his operation while seeking stronger backing abroad. Mitch and Spencer look to score big at the track.

episodes.title: Nerved Up
episodes.description: Dwight corners Governor Clark before heading to New York to confront Quiet Ray. Meanwhile, Bevilaqua feeds both sides, triggering a deadly showdown.

episodes.title: Exit Interview
episodes.description: Dwight's empire is on the brink - but a brutal double-cross shifts the balance of power, forcing him towards a dangerous new throne.

title: Lioness
description: Cruz Manuelos, a rough-around-the-edges but passionate young Marine, is recruited to join the CIA's Lioness Engagement Team to help bring down a terrorist organization from within. Joe, the station chief of the Lioness program, is tasked with training, managing and leading her female undercover operatives.

episodes.title: Sacrificial Soldiers
episodes.description: Things go awry for Joe and her team during a mission out in the field. Joe is left devastated. Upon her return home, Joe's family life presents it's own challenges. Cruz tries to escape a dangerous situation. Joe must choose an agent.

episodes.title: The Beating
episodes.description: Joe continues her training with Cruz whose methods are questionable. Cruz starts to build a relationship with Aaliyah. Kate gets into a fight during her soccer game. Neal has to deliver difficult news to a patient.

episodes.title: Bruise Like a Fist
episodes.description: Cruz is invited to spend the weekend with Aaliyah and her inner-circle. Joe keeps Kaitlyn informed of Cruz's progress. Kyle comes to Joe desperate for help with an asset.

episodes.title: The Choice of Failure
episodes.description: Cruz is put in a compromising position while out with Aaliyah and friends in the Hamptons, causing Joe and Kaitlyn to doubt her. Kaitlyn and Westfield confront Kyle over what happened at the border, complicating things further for Joe and her team.

episodes.title: Truth Is the Shrewdest Lie
episodes.description: Joe and Neal deal with the aftermath of Kate's accident. Westfield and Kaitlyn deploy Joe's team to subdue a terrorist threat. Cruz's cover may be in jeopardy.

episodes.title: The Lie Is the Truth
episodes.description: Aaliyah bonds with Cruz over a spa day. Bobby, Tex, Two Cups, Randy and Tucker confront a threat at the Safe House. Kaitlyn and Joe are scolded for the San Antonio mission in a debrief.

episodes.title: Wish the Fight Away
episodes.description: While shopping in Manhattan for the wedding, Aaliyah and Cruz get closer. Kate returns home only to say goodbye to her mom once again. Joe guides Cruz through internal struggle and doubt in completing the mission.

episodes.title: Gone Is the Illusion of Order
episodes.description: Unforeseen circumstances leaves the mission in jeopardy. A suspicious Ehsan confronts Cruz before his wedding day. Joe and the team prepare for the worst.

episodes.title: Beware the Old Soldier
episodes.description: Joe, Kyle, and the QRF team embark on a timely extraction after a high-ranking government official is kidnapped by a cartel.

episodes.title: I Love My Country
episodes.description: After a new Lioness is identified, Joe and her team travel to Iraq to close the asset.

episodes.title: Along Came a Spider
episodes.description: Kaitlyn works to drum up support for their plan. Meanwhile, Lioness training begins for Captain Josie Carrillo.

episodes.title: Five Hundred Children
episodes.description: Joe and Kyle make contact with a potential new source of intel. A newly expanded team conducts a hit with unanticipated results.

episodes.title: Shatter the Moon
episodes.description: The warehouse discovery rattles the team. Joe is torn between two urgent missions.
Events come to a head at the Carrillo estate faster than expected. Josie makes her move.

episodes.title: The Devil Has Aces
episodes.description: Despite Joe's weakened state, the team is forced back to Iraq to make a point.

episodes.title: The Compass Points Home
episodes.description: Operation Sky Hawk is a go as Kaitlyn and Westfield pressure Pablo to side with them.

episodes.title: The Spider and the Fly
episodes.description: A covert strike draws Joe into a chain of events.

episodes.title: No Sorrow Like the Survivor
episodes.description: Kaitlyn races to contain a crisis spiraling across agencies.

episodes.title: The Bear Is Infected
episodes.description: Joe confronts a breach, driving the team into a risky play.

episodes.title: Murder Hornets
episodes.description: A frantic hunt is launched as the team races against time.

episodes.title: The Idiot Army
episodes.description: Joe leads the hunt as her team exposes a hidden network.

episodes.title: Sugar Land
episodes.description: Kaitlyn and the team bid to decode hints through a hidden network.

episodes.title: Kiss the Girls
episodes.description: Kaitlyn and Westfield coordinate a massive search.

episodes.title: The Unravelling
episodes.description: Kyle's chase sparks fallout as Joe uncovers a wider plot.

title: Smallville
description: The origins of the world’s greatest hero–from Krypton refugee Kal-el’s arrival on Earth through his tumultuous teen years to Clark Kent’s final steps toward embracing his destiny as the Man of Steel.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: The first episode tells the story of the meteor shower that hit Smallville and changed life in the Kansas town forever. Clark Kent meets Lex Luthor for the first time and encounters the first in a long line of humans mutated by the strange green meteor rocks that accompanied him on his journey to Earth.

episodes.title: Metamorphosis
episodes.description: Clark must deal with Greg, a nerdish bug collector with a crush on Lana who gains the ability of various insects and uses them to lash out at anyone who opposes him.

episodes.title: Hothead
episodes.description: An abusive and hot-tempered football coach gains the ability to control and project fire.

episodes.title: X-Ray
episodes.description: Clark begins experiencing "vision problems" as his x-ray vision begins manifesting. Meanwhile a mysterious shapeshifter is going about town using his or her abilities to steal and get others in trouble.

episodes.title: Cool
episodes.description: A jock named Sean gains the ability to absorb heat from everything and everyone around him, and begins preying on people to gain the heat he needs to survive.

episodes.title: Hourglass
