Naruto and Jiraiya fought bravely, and they were eventually able to defeat the courier ninjas. They saved the book, and they also learned a valuable lesson about teamwork.

episodes.title: Encounter! The Boy with a Star's Name
episodes.description: About 200 years, a star fell to the Hidden Star Village. This star supposedly as mystic powers. However, the village has few ninja, so they require the help of other villages. Naruto accompanies Lee, Neji, and Tenten on a mission to protect it.

episodes.title: The Remembered Lullaby
episodes.description: When the mysterious attacker flies away with the star, using only their Chakra, the Konoha group are left in the dust. They swear to reclaim the star but it isn't as simple as they might hope. Meanwhile, Naruto learns some of Subaru's history and Natsuhiboshi...

episodes.title: Hidden Jutsu! The Price of the Ninja Art: Kujaku
episodes.description: The Konoha team continue to investigate the star's theft and start to realise everything is not quite as it seems. Everything seems to be leading to a final battle, but who is the real enemy behind all this?

episodes.title: Hoshikage: The Buried Truth
episodes.description: Naruto has been rescued by the mysterious woman and soon learns who she really is. Can the two of them continue the mission the was started so very long ago and what will Subaru think when he discovers the truth?

episodes.title: Reunion, The Remaining Time
episodes.description: Subaru finally meets his mother, but is it too late for them? Can Naruto defeat Akahoshi and stop the star from falling back into his hands, and what side will the village choose to take?

episodes.title: The Star's Radiance
episodes.description: After Akahoshi tries to execute Sumaru, Hakato and the rest of the children stand up to protect their village. Akahoshi, finding the village turning against him, takes drastic steps to ensure his success. Naruto is the only one left who can take down this menace, can he do it alone? or will he find help from someone more powerful....

episodes.title: Kiba's Long Day!
episodes.description: When Akamaru is taken ill and starts to undergo a mysterious transformation, can Kiba do anything to save his friend? When the whole village appears to be against him what lengths will he go through, to protect his friend?

episodes.title: A Legend from the Hidden Leaf: The Onbaa!
episodes.description: While Naruto trains in the forest, a mysterious creature latches onto his back. This legendary creature can't be removed until it becomes an adult, but that's only the beginning of Naruto's problems.

episodes.title: Laughing Shino
episodes.description: Naruto and Shino go on a mission together to Motoyoshi Village, where a man named Fuuta has a strange request. To receive his inheritance money, he must not laugh at his fathers funeral. There is however one clause that may be enough to save him from losing everything when his relatives try every trick in the book, to cause laughter...

episodes.title: Open for Business! The Leaf Moving Service
episodes.description: Naruto, Hinata, and Chouji are chosen on a mission to protect some peddlers running away from a war at the Greenery Country. However, Tsunade gave them more than just a simple guard duty mission, making them movers as well. The peddlers are just simple folk, who were never even registered citizens in the country. But, when Naruto discovers the group is being pursued, the three ninja realize that there is more going on than meets the eyes.

episodes.title: Mystery of the Targeted Merchants
episodes.description: The group splits off into two, in an attempt to deter their mysterious attackers. However, when Naruto and Chouji discover the plan hasn't worked as intended, they soon realise that somebody is hiding something important....

episodes.title: A Limitless Supply of Ninja Tools
episodes.description: Naruto, Chouji, and Yurinojou take on Ruiga, who uses water as a weapon. Ruiga has the power to draw out water from the Earth, giving him an unlimited supply of ninja weapons. How can they defeat an opponent who has a limitless supply of water? Even if they can win, can they defeat the second ninja, Jiga? Also, what is the Princess' true motive for running away?

episodes.title: The Byakugan Sees the Blind Spot!
episodes.description: With Naruto defeated, Hinata decides to join the fight. Will she be able to defeat the second evil ninja? And what of the princess?

episodes.title: Forecast: Death! Cloudy with Chance of Sun!
episodes.description: The battle with the third and final evil ninja is on. He has only one desire and that is to kill Princess Haruna. Will Naruto be able to defeat this new menace and save Haruna?

episodes.title: Ino Screams! Chubby Paradise!
episodes.description: When the daughter of a Feudal Lord calls for a double, Ino is brought in to take her place. The only problem is they look nothing alike, the princess has become big boned because she had a lot of stress and ate a lot. Now Ino must stand in for her and arrange a marriage with a man from Udon Country. Can Ino arrage the marriage without problem?

episodes.title: Viva Dojo Challenge! Youth is All About Passion!
episodes.description: When Naruto returns from a mission, he discovers that Lee has set up a Dojo and is desperate for a challenger. When Gai discovers nobody has challenged him he steps up to the plate! However, a last minute change in plans throws changes everything, and when an imposter joins the fray, chaos ensues....

episodes.title: The Mysterious Curse of the Haunted Castle
episodes.description: Naruto, Hinata, and Kiba are sent to the Land of Honey to search for the Daimyō's wife. There, they find an eerie castle, and journey inside to search for clues.

episodes.title: The Third Super-Beast!
episodes.description: When Lee misses his check-up with Tsunade, Naruto is sent to find him. Meanwhile Gai is training someone called Yagura and has decided that Lee and Yagura should have a training match. Can Lee beat the new trainee after hearing some uncomfortable news at his examination?

episodes.title: Hot-Blooded Confrontation: Student vs. Sensei
episodes.description: Gai is trapped inside a fortress made of practice posts. Yagura appears but is he there to help or to hinder? Naruto, Neji and Tenten show up to try and rescue Gai, but will it be too much for them to handle on their own?

episodes.title: Crisis: The Hidden Leaf 11 Gather!
episodes.description: Naruto meets an old man, a construction worker named Gennou. However, when Gennou steals plans for some of the buildings in Konoha, Naruto suddenly finds himself under investigation by the ANBU. What is the truth behind Gennou and why does nobody seem to know what is going on?

episodes.title: The ANBU Gives Up? Naruto's Recollection
episodes.description: In order to get the information they need about Gennou, the ANBU put Naruto in a trance, hoping to prong the information they need from Naruto's memory. However, even by doing all of this, will they get the information they need?

episodes.title: The Missed Target
episodes.description: Naruto and the others continue their search for any clues leading to Gennou or his plan. During an investigation of the Ninja Academy, they discover a suspicious training post which leads to an even scarier discovery.

episodes.title: The Powerful Helper
episodes.description: With the city of Konoha mapped in explosive tags, a decision must be made weather to try and remove them, or to evacuate the entire city! However, something is strange about these tags, can they discover what it is? And can they remove all of them in time?

episodes.title: Multiple Traps! Countdown to Destruction
episodes.description: While Shikamaru tries to figure out what Gennou is planning next, Naruto is fighting Gennou in the Great Stone faces. Can Shikamaru stop Gennou's next step in the plan before it is to late? And will Naruto be able to defeat the Trap Master?

episodes.title: The Top 5 Ninja Battles!
episodes.description: Naruto and Sakura host a special recap episode featuring the top five battles so far! There are also interviews with some of the team, and perhaps even some of the enemy....

episodes.title: Kurenai's Decision: Squad 8 Left Behind
episodes.description: Naruto encounters a girl named Yakumo who has a surprising talent for destruction. Shortly after, Kurenai Yuhi, leader of Team 8 makes a startling decision and Naruto is determined to find out why.

episodes.title: Yakumo's Sealed Ability
episodes.description: Naruto sneaks into Yakumo's mansion in the night, and has a dream that Kurenai threatened to seal Yakumo's abilities. He then discovers that this is the reason why she left the team, but Kurenai refuses to disclose any more. As Kurenai goes to see Yakumo, several Kurama Clan members attack.

episodes.title: Kurenai's Top Secret Mission: The Promise with the Third Hokage
episodes.description: As Kurenai attempts to escape with Yakumo, Naruto and Sakura, Team 8 and Might Gai arrive to lend their assistance. We learn some of the history between Kurenai and Yakumo and discover why things have turned out the way they have...

episodes.title: Genjutsu or Reality?
episodes.description: Naruto, Kurenai, Yakumo and Team 8 return to Konoha to a shocking discovery. Can this really be reality or is it all some kind of sick illusion?

episodes.title: The Supposed Sealed Ability
episodes.description: Naruto and the members of Team 8 head into Yakumo's house to find her with Kurenai. It is revealed that a mysterious entity might be behind all this. Can the group discover the truth in time?

episodes.title: The Weight of the Prized Artifact!
episodes.description: Naruto and Kiba are ordered to escort a man named Shinemon who is transporting a rare and valuable artifact. However, when Bandits steal the artifact, can the pair retrieve it and keep Shinemon alive?

episodes.title: The Enemy: Ninja Dropouts
episodes.description: Naruto, Sakura and Lee are sent to escort a prisoner named Gantetsu to the Forest Country Capital. Their job is only to back up the escort group incase something goes wrong, which inevitably, it does....

episodes.title: The Bewildering Forest
episodes.description: With the ship split in half, Naruto, Todoroki and Gantetsu are seperated from the others. Now Naruto must face the other three Shinobazu that Gantetsu was with. Can Naruto lead them out or will they have to trust Gantetsu to lead the way?

episodes.title: Memory of Flames
episodes.description: Todoroki wants to avenge his family and kill Gantetsu. The only problem is that Naruto has other ideas. Elsewhere, Lee and Sakura are surrounded by children who are demanding they give them Gantetsu. Can Naruto and Todoroki get Gantetsu back? And what are the childrens reasons for wanting him?

episodes.title: To Each His Own Path
episodes.description: Naruto arrives to save Gantetsu and the kids but has trouble when Akio is kidnapped and Todoroki realizes his brother is alive. Will Naruto and Todoroki be able to save Akio?

episodes.title: Vanished Memories
episodes.description: Naruto rescues a kid who was injured but he is an outsider to Konoha. Tsunade assigns Naruto to take care of the kid until he gets his memory back. What was this kid doing outside of Konoha and why can't he remember anything?

episodes.title: Bringing Back Reality
episodes.description: Naruto and Menma manage to get Tsunade to let them go find Menma's memories. However, they are forced to go with Neji and Tenten guarding them. On the way, they come across a burned-down village. There, they greet the villagers and ask them what happened. Unfortunately, the villagers aren't too happy to see them.

episodes.title: A Past to Be Erased
episodes.description: Ran wants to kill Menma, upon seeing the mark on his arm, but Neji stands in the way, saying it would be unfair to kill a criminal without any memories of his crimes. Ran finally agrees and performs surgery on Menma, saving his life, but the villagers aren’t as happy. Are they prepared for when foreign shinobi group comes for a second attack?

episodes.title: The Targeted Shukaku
episodes.description: A Sand shinobi, Matsuri, has been abducted by a mysterious ninja. In order to bring them bring back, Gaara must accept the mystery ninja's challenge. Can Naruto prevent this challenge ending in catastrophe?

episodes.title: Sand Alliance With The Leaf Shinobi
episodes.description: The rogue ninjas continue running as Gaara, Temari and Kankuro give chase. At the same time, Shino, Hinata and Neji are using their abilities to try and find the Shitenshounnin. Who will end up fighting first and, who will ultimately win?

episodes.title: The Counterattack!
episodes.description: Shikamaru and Ino arrive to help out Temari against Kyaku, while Kiba and Chouji go to help Konkuro. All seems to be going well until Neji notices something odd...

episodes.title: The Ultimate Weapon Reborn
episodes.description: Even with his chakra so low, Gaara fights the Shitenshounin leader. When he fails and is trapped, Naruto arrives to try and rescue him. But when the leader of Takumi Village, Seimei, is revived, can Naruto save Gaara before Shukaku takes complete control of him?

episodes.title: Departure
episodes.description: The exciting conclusion to Naruto. What will become of Gaara, and now that Jiraiya has returned, will Naruto finally leave Konoha to begin his training?

title: Friends
description: Six young people from New York City, on their own and struggling to survive in the real world, find the companionship, comfort and support they get from each other to be the perfect antidote to the pressures of life.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: After Rachel leaves her fiancé at the altar, she moves in with Monica and finds that independence is not so easy, particularly without Daddy's credit cards.

episodes.title: The One with the Sonogram at the End
episodes.description: Ross's lesbian ex-wife Carol is pregnant with his child, and he doesn't like her choice of last name for the baby. Rachel finds out that her ex-fiancé went on what would have been their honeymoon with her maid of honor.

episodes.title: The One with the Thumb
episodes.description: Monica finds it difficult to break up with her latest boyfriend whom everyone likes; Chandler is reunited with his beloved cigarettes; Phoebe receives a large sum of money.

episodes.title: The One with George Stephanopoulos
episodes.description: While the men attend a hockey game and end up at a hospital, a delivery man accidentally brings a pizza meant for George Stephanopoulos, who lives across the street from the girls; they decide to peek at the former White House advisor with their binoculars.

episodes.title: The One with the East German Laundry Detergent
episodes.description: While Chandler and Phoebe decide to break up with their significant others on the same night, Ross helps Rachel do laundry and considers the evening a first date. Joey has Monica pose as his new girlfriend, because he wants to get back with the girl he just dumped.

episodes.title: The One with the Butt
episodes.description: Joey gets his big film break when he's hired to be Al Pacino's stunt butt. Ross tries to be less conservative and Chandler thinks his fantasies have come true when he has an affair with a married woman.

episodes.title: The One with the Blackout
episodes.description: A power outage leaves Chandler stranded in an ATM vestibule with Victoria's Secret model Jill Goodacre, whom he desperately tries to impress, Ross tries to ask Rachel out on a date, and Joey learns that Monica used to be infatuated with him.

episodes.title: The One Where Nana Dies Twice
episodes.description: Monica and Ross mourn the death of their grandmother with a little help from the gang, and Monica and her mom come to an unspoken understanding about the relationship between mothers and daughters. Meanwhile, Chandler is irritated by office speculation that he is gay.

episodes.title: The One Where Underdog Gets Away
episodes.description: Monica's first Thanksgiving dinner for the gang goes horribly wrong when they all run to the rooftop to see the runaway Underdog balloon from the parade.

episodes.title: The One with the Monkey
episodes.description: The gang makes--then breaks--a pact to celebrate New Year's Eve without dates. Ross compensates for his loneliness by getting a roommate, a monkey named Marcel.

episodes.title: The One with Mrs. Bing
episodes.description: Chandler's romance-novelist mother comes to New York to visit him, and Joey catches her and Ross kissing.

episodes.title: The One with the Dozen Lasagnas
episodes.description: Everyone knows the sex of Ross's baby, except for Ross, who doesn't want to find out until it's born. Monica gives Paolo one of the dozen lasagnas she made for her aunt, who doesn't want them anymore because they've got meat in them.

episodes.title: The One with the Boobies
episodes.description: Chandler accidentally sees Rachel wandering around topless after her shower, so Rachel tries to even the score. And no one can stand Phoebe's new boyfriend, an irritating guy named Roger.

episodes.title: The One with the Candy Hearts
episodes.description: Ross's first date in nine years is on Valentine's Day with a beautiful neighbor. Susan and Carol, also out on a romantic date; end up at the same restaurant. Joey sets Chandler up on a blind date. And Phoebe, Rachel and Monica decide to spend the holiday building a boyfriend bonfire in their apartment.

episodes.title: The One with the Stoned Guy
episodes.description: Monica cooks a gourmet meal for a restaurateur looking for a new chef but, unfortunately, he's stoned. After working as a data processing permanent temp for five years, Chandler gets promoted. And Ross has a date with a beautiful colleague.

episodes.title: The One with Two Parts (1)
episodes.description: Joey falls for Phoebe's twin sister, Ursula, making Phoebe feel neglected. Ross has doubts about parenthood when he attends Lamaze classes with Carol and Susan. Meanwhile, Chandler finds himself between a rock and a hard place, when he is told to fire an employee he is attracted to.

episodes.title: The One with Two Parts (2)
episodes.description: When Rachel sprains her ankle and has no insurance, she cajoles Monica into trading identities so she can use Monica's coverage. When Phoebe's twin sister, Ursula, breaks Joey's heart, Phoebe tries to fix it.

episodes.title: The One with All the Poker
episodes.description: Tired of being referred to by customers as "Excuse me" Rachel interviews for a job as an assistant buyer at Saks Fifth Avenue. She also sees another side of the usually docile Ross when the girls face the boys during a not-so-friendly game of poker.

episodes.title: The One Where the Monkey Gets Away
episodes.description: The gang searches frantically for Marcel, who slipped out of the apartment while Rachel was baby-sitting him. Just as it looks as though Rachel and Ross might actually spend a romantic evening together, her ex-fiancé barges in and declares his love for her.

episodes.title: The One with the Evil Orthodontist
episodes.description: Rachel and Barry start dating again, which is kind of awkward since he's now engaged to Mindy, who wants Rachel to be her maid of honor. Meanwhile, Chandler goes nuts when a woman he likes won't return his phone calls.

episodes.title: The One with the Fake Monica
episodes.description: When Monica's credit card is stolen, she, along with Phoebe and Rachel, decide to catch the thief. Joey enlists his friends to help him come up with a less ethnic-sounding stage name. And  Ross finds out that Marcel has reached sexual maturity and needs to be with other monkeys.

episodes.title: The One with the Ick Factor
episodes.description: After losing his virginity to her, Monica's boyfriend reveals that he's a high school senior. When Phoebe temps as Chandler's secretary, she finds out a secret.

episodes.title: The One with the Birth
episodes.description: As Monica's biological clock ticks away like a time bomb, Carol goes into labor. Ross, Susan and Phoebe end up getting locked in a closet just as Carol's about to give birth to the baby. And Rachel flirts with an OB/GYN.

episodes.title: The One Where Rachel Finds Out
episodes.description: Joey's new girlfriend wants to go to bed with him but he can't, yet. During Rachel's birthday party, Chandler accidentally lets it slip that Ross is in love with her. However, Ross is on his way to China and Rachel can't decide whether she wants to be more than friends with Ross.

episodes.title: The One with Ross's New Girlfriend
episodes.description: Rachel waits patiently at the airport for Ross, returning from China. Meanwhile, after giving Joey and Chandler new haircuts, Phoebe is persuaded to cut Monica's hair. And Joey learns that his tailor is a very naughty man.

episodes.title: The One with the Breast Milk
episodes.description: The guys are uncomfortable with the thought of Carol's breast milk while Rachel is upset by Monica's growing friendship with Julie. Meanwhile, Joey competes with a fellow cologne spritzer for the affections of a beautiful colleague.

episodes.title: The One Where Heckles Dies
episodes.description: After Mr. Heckles dies and leaves all his belongings to Monica and Rachel, Chandler discovers eerie similarities between the late eccentric man and his own life. Ross and Phoebe have a dispute over the progression of evolution.

episodes.title: The One with Phoebe's Husband
episodes.description: The gang is amazed to learn that Phoebe married a gay Canadian ice dancer to help him get his green card. And Ross seeks relationship advice from Rachel.

episodes.title: The One with Five Steaks and an Eggplant
episodes.description: When a sexy woman calls the wrong number, Chandler seeks to make the most of the situation. Income issues divide the friends; Monica, Ross and Chandler have money, while Phoebe, Rachel and Joey don't.

episodes.title: The One with the Baby on the Bus
episodes.description: Chandler and Joey lose Ross's son, Ben, while checking out women on a bus. Phoebe loses her Central Perk singing gig to a professional singer. And Ross has an allergic reaction to Monica's kiwi-lime pie.

episodes.title: The One Where Ross Finds Out
episodes.description: A drunken Rachel is persuaded to call Ross and reveal her feelings for him on his answering machine. Now, Ross must make a decision between her and Julie. Meanwhile, Monica finds work as Chandler's personal trainer and Phoebe has a hard time trying to get her boyfriend to have sex with her.

episodes.title: The One with the List
episodes.description: Ross enlists Joey and Chandler to help with his decision to choose Julie or Rachel by making a list of the pros and cons of each. Big mistake. Meanwhile, Monica gets a job making food with a synthetic chocolate substitute called Mockolate.

episodes.title: The One with Phoebe's Dad
episodes.description: It's Christmas time and Monica tries tipping with cookies, rather than cash, with mixed results. Phoebe tries to track down her real father. And Chandler and Joey wait too late to shop for presents.

episodes.title: The One with Russ
episodes.description: Monica gets back together with Fun Bobby. Joey lands a role of a neurosurgeon on Days of Our Lives. And Rachel, dating a guy named Russ, can't see his uncanny resemblance to Ross.

episodes.title: The One with the Lesbian Wedding
episodes.description: Monica caters the wedding of Ross's ex-wife and her lesbian lover. Phoebe is possessed by the spirit of an 82-year-old massage client who dies in the middle of a session. And Rachel's mom comes to visit and drops a bombshell.

episodes.title: The One After the Super Bowl (1)
episodes.description: Ross goes to visit Marcel, his monkey, while on a trip to California. Joey gets his first fan letter and ends up dating the woman. Phoebe is asked to sing for the children at the library, but their parents are horrified by her lyrics.

episodes.title: The One After the Super Bowl (2)
episodes.description: Rachel and Monica compete for the affections of Jean-Claude Van Damme after meeting him on a movie set. Chandler meets a former schoolmate while an excited Joey gets a role as an extra in the movie. Ross and Marcel go on a whirlwind tour of the city.

episodes.title: The One with the Prom Video
episodes.description: After getting his big break, with Days of Our Lives, Joey pays Chandler back. Monica is unemployed and hard up for money. Monica and Rachel's prom video reveals Monica's former girth, Rachel's former nose and the way Ross has always felt about Rachel.

episodes.title: The One Where Ross and Rachel... You Know
episodes.description: Joey buys a big screen TV and two leather recliners with his newfound money. Monica has a catering job for one of her parents' friends and becomes infatuated. Ross and Rachel attempt to have their first real date, but Rachel laughs every time they kiss. When they try again the next evening, they are interrupted when Ross is called into the museum.

episodes.title: The One Where Joey Moves Out
episodes.description: After having a fight with Chandler, Joey decides to move out. Rachel and Phoebe decide to get tattoos. And, on his birthday, Mr. Geller receives the unsettling news that his best friend and his daughter are dating.

episodes.title: The One Where Eddie Moves In
episodes.description: Phoebe is discovered by a record producer who wants to make "Smelly Cat" a video. Ross's new relationship with Rachel makes Monica feel like she's living with her brother again... and she hates it.  And Joey considers moving back in with Chandler, but Chandler has a new roommate.

episodes.title: The One Where Dr. Ramoray Dies
episodes.description: Chandler learns more about his new roommate, Eddie. Ross is stressed out to learn that Rachel had 'animal sex' with Paolo. Richard and Monica are uncomfortable to learn what their numbers of ex-lovers are. Joey's remarks to a fan magazine could cause him to lose his job playing Dr Ramoray.

episodes.title: The One Where Eddie Won't Go
episodes.description: Creeped out by his bizarre new roommate, Chandler demands he move out; Eddie agrees... but won't go. Joey has trouble coming to grips with the death of Dr. Drake Ramoray and is facing some exorbitant bills. And a new book on women's empowerment inspires the ladies to have a "goddess meeting."

episodes.title: The One Where Old Yeller Dies
episodes.description: Monica's new boyfriend impresses Chandler and Joey. Phoebe's world view is shattered when she finds out what she missed as a child, and Rachel resents the fact that Ross has planned their whole life together.

episodes.title: The One with the Bullies
episodes.description: Monica is broke and decides to gamble on the stock market, while Chandler and Ross run into a couple of bullies in Central Park. Rachel and Joey help Phoebe locate her father, but a vicious dog prevents Phoebe from finally meeting him.

episodes.title: The One with the Two Parties
episodes.description: Monica decides to hold a surprise birthday for Rachel, but everything goes wrong when Rachel's estranged parents turn up unexpectedly. The party then splits into two factions, but complications inevitably ensue.

episodes.title: The One with the Chicken Pox
episodes.description: Phoebe's submariner ex-boyfriend visits New York on leave for 2 weeks from the Navy. Unfortunately, Phoebe catches chicken pox at Ben's first birthday party. When Monica realizes that Richard has no real neuroses, she worries that she is too strange for him. Chandler organizes a job as a processor for Joey.

episodes.title: The One with Barry and Mindy's Wedding
episodes.description: Rachel agrees to be maid of honor at her ex-fiancé's wedding; she relives the nightmare of her own failed wedding day. Meanwhile, Chandler becomes enamored with a woman he meets on the Internet, but is surprised when he finally meets her. Monica ponders her future with Richard.

episodes.title: The One with the Princess Leia Fantasy
episodes.description: Ross reveals a fantasy to Rachel involving a certain "Star Wars" character. Monica suffers from insomnia after her breakup with Richard. And Chandler, back together with Janice, wants Joey to bond with her.

episodes.title: The One Where No One's Ready
episodes.description: In a race against the clock, a stressed Ross tries to get the gang dressed and ready for a black-tie benefit at the museum while Joey and Chandler clash over personal belongings and personal space.

episodes.title: The One with the Jam
episodes.description: Phoebe dates a man who thinks he's stalking her twin sister. Ross and Rachel give Chandler "boyfriend" lessons. Monica decides the best way to get over Richard is to keep herself busy, so she uses her free time to make jam and considers insemination via a sperm bank.

episodes.title: The One with the Metaphorical Tunnel
episodes.description: Phoebe poses as Joey's agent and has some success in getting him auditions. Ross panics when he sees his son with a Barbie doll. Chandler is advancing in his relationship with Janice and, realizing that he has a fear of commitment, goes to the girls for advice.

episodes.title: The One with Frank, Jr.
episodes.description: Phoebe's half-brother visits, but they have trouble bonding. Joey attempts to build an entertainment center. Ross is challenged to name the five celebrities he'd like to sleep with most.

episodes.title: The One with the Flashback
episodes.description: When Janice asks the gang if any of them have ever slept together, the friends flash back to a time three years before.

episodes.title: The One with the Race Car Bed
episodes.description: Monica buys a new bed from Janice's soon-to-be-ex-husband, "The Mattress King", but the wrong one is delivered.  Rachel's attempts to have her father and Ross bond fail, until she stops trying. Joey gets a job teaching a soap opera acting class.

episodes.title: The One with the Giant Poking Device
episodes.description: When Phoebe believes she's killed the ugly naked guy across the street from Rachel and Monica, Joey constructs a long poking device. Joey and Monica catch Janice kissing her ex-husband; Chandler confronts Janice.

episodes.title: The One with the Football
episodes.description: Emotions become the feast of the day when the gang plays a game of touch football on Thanksgiving. Joey and Chandler argue over who gets to date a model while Ross and Monica argue over winning in a case of sibling rivalry.

episodes.title: The One Where Rachel Quits
episodes.description: Rachel makes a rash decision after Gunther tells her she needs to be retrained.  Phoebe tries to help Joey when he gets a job selling Christmas trees.  And Ross accidentally breaks a girl's leg and tries to make it up to her.

episodes.title: The One Where Chandler Can't Remember Which Sister
episodes.description: Ross is suspicious about Rachel's possible job offer from a good-looking stranger.  And a drunken Chandler fools around with one of Joey's sisters, but he can't remember which one.

episodes.title: The One with All the Jealousy
episodes.description: Ross becomes increasingly jealous of Rachel's new colleague, Mark, and spies on her. Monica hooks up with a co-worker, who writes her a poem with a hidden meaning. One of Joey's numerous lies on his resume is exposed when he takes part in a Broadway musical.

episodes.title: The One Where Monica and Richard Are Just Friends
episodes.description: Monica's willpower is tested when she runs into Richard at the video store. Rachel agrees to read The Shining if Joey reads Little Women. Phoebe's athletic date has a problem with short shorts.

episodes.title: The One with Phoebe's Ex-Partner
episodes.description: Phoebe is reunited with her former singing partner who thinks "Smelly Cat" has hit potential; Chandler dates a woman with a prosthetic leg who also has some history with Joey. Meanwhile, Ross goes to a fashion seminar with Rachel, so she won't go with Mark, but falls asleep in the middle of it.

episodes.title: The One Where Ross and Rachel Take a Break
episodes.description: Wanting more time to focus on her new job, Rachel suggests that she and Ross take a break from their relationship. Ross later seeks solace at a party. Phoebe dates a diplomat who needs an interpreter to communicate with her. Chandler and Joey ponder a ménage a trois with a woman who seems hot for both of them.

episodes.title: The One with the Morning After
episodes.description: Ross tries to prevent Rachel from learning his disturbing secret. She finds out anyway and they go back to her apartment to have a fight. The other four friends are trapped in Monica's bedroom, forced to listen in.

episodes.title: The One Without the Ski Trip
episodes.description: Ross and Rachel compete to spend time with their other friends. When a lonely Ross is excluded from Rachel's ski trip with her pals, he visits Carol. On the way to the cabin, they run out of gas. Meanwhile, Chandler starts smoking again.

episodes.title: The One with the Hypnosis Tape
episodes.description: Monica receives a tip from an admirer worth a small fortune then goes out with the guy. A hypnosis tape intended to assist Chandler to stop smoking has a rather strange side effect. Phoebe is upset when her 18-year-old half-brother, Frank Jr., makes a surprise announcement that he is getting married - to a woman more than twice his age.

episodes.title: The One with the Tiny T-Shirt
episodes.description: Rachel goes on her first date after splitting from Ross... and it's with Mark, her former colleague. Joey is cast in a play and develops a crush on his costar. Monica continues to date Pete, even though she is still not attracted to him.

episodes.title: The One with the Dollhouse
episodes.description: Monica inherits a beautiful dollhouse that is too elaborate to play with, so Phoebe makes her own. Joey thinks he's found his true love, and Rachel's boss dates Chandler, placing her in a dangerous situation.

episodes.title: The One with the Chick and the Duck
episodes.description: Monica considers a dream job as head chef in Pete's new restaurant, but Phoebe fears there is more to the deal. Ross makes a sacrifice to help Rachel, who may have a broken rib. Meanwhile, Joey buys Chandler an unusual pet.

episodes.title: The One with the Screamer
episodes.description: When Rachel finds out that Ross is bringing a date to the premiere of Joey's big play, she finds one of her own. Ross alone concludes that her date is insane. Poor Phoebe is on hold for days with a company she needs to talk to before her phone warranty expires. Meanwhile, Joey's play gets terrible reviews, but his co-star provides some comfort.

episodes.title: The One with Ross's Thing
episodes.description: Afflicted with a mysterious skin condition on his butt that doctors cannot identify the cause of, Ross seeks advice from Phoebe's herbalist. Phoebe finds herself in a dilemma when she cannot choose between two guys. Monica can't decide about Pete when she thinks he is going to propose.

episodes.title: The One with the Ultimate Fighting Champion
episodes.description: To Monica's horror, Pete wants to be the Ultimate Fighting Champion. Chandler has a problem when his new boss is slaphappy. Phoebe sets Ross up on a date with a woman who used to be bald. The group overhears a scandalous conversation at Central Perk.

episodes.title: The One at the Beach
episodes.description: Phoebe invites everyone to stay at her massage client's beach house for the weekend. In search of her father, Phoebe meets someone who knows details about her family. Rachel expresses her jealousy of Ross' uninhibited girlfriend and Joey nags the friends into agreeing to play strip poker with unintended results. Chandler wonders why Monica doesn't think he's serious after asking if she would ever date him.

episodes.title: The One with the Jellyfish
episodes.description: Ross chooses between Rachel and his bald-headed girlfriend Bonnie. Phoebe struggles to deal with the revelation that her mother's friend is actually her mother. Monica gets stung by a jellyfish, forcing Chandler and Joey to step up to the plate in order to relieve her pain.

episodes.title: The One with the Cat
episodes.description: Phoebe believes that her adoptive mother's spirit resides in a cat that jumped into her guitar case in Central Perk.  Monica goes on a date with Rachel's hunky high-school boyfriend, who was cool in high-school, but a failure now. And when Joey and Chandler decide to sell the entertainment center, Joey takes stupidity to a new level.

episodes.title: The One with the 'Cuffs
episodes.description: Monica caters a party for her mother, who still doesn't quite know how to talk to her daughter. Chandler's encounter with Rachel's boss leads to an embarrassing situation. And an encyclopedia salesman takes advantage of Joey.

episodes.title: The One with the Ballroom Dancing
episodes.description: Joey attempts ballroom dancing in order to help Monica and Rachel keep their illegal sublet. Phoebe is attracted to one of her massage clients. And Ross tries to help Chandler quit the gym.

episodes.title: The One with Joey's New Girlfriend
episodes.description: Chandler hits on a woman at Central Perk, not realizing she is Joey's new girlfriend. He soon realizes he is very attracted to, possibly in love, with her. Ross and Rachel play the jealousy game in their relationships. And Phoebe desperately tries to catch a cold after discovering that her voice is sexier and her singing better when she has phlegm in her throat.

episodes.title: The One with the Dirty Girl
episodes.description: Ross's new girlfriend seems nearly perfect until he visits her house and discovers that her apartment is incredibly dirty.  Chandler helps Joey pick out a thoughtful present for Kathy's birthday. Rachel attempts to finish a crossword puzzle by herself. And Phoebe helps Monica cater a funeral.

episodes.title: The One Where Chandler Crosses the Line
episodes.description: Chandler must decide between the girl of his dreams and his best friend when he and Kathy share a passionate kiss. Needless to say, Joey is not happy when he finds out about it. And nobody wants to tell Ross how awful his keyboard playing is.

episodes.title: The One with Chandler in a Box
episodes.description: Chandler agrees to spend Thanksgiving in a shipping crate as penance for kissing Kathy. The gang decides to give each other Secret Santa gifts. After Monica gets ice in her eye, she ends up visiting Richard's son, who is as attracted to Monica as his father was.

episodes.title: The One Where They're Going to Party!
episodes.description: Chandler and Ross's college friend Gandalf is planning to come to town. Gandalf is "the party wizard." Ross and Chandler are very excited until Gandalf cancels. However, they decide to make their own party with Joey's help. Joanna squashes Rachel's chance at a promotion. And when Monica fills in for a friend as food critic for a small newspaper, she must decide between a steady job as head chef of a restaurant she panned or keeping her catering business with her friend Phoebe.

episodes.title: The One with the Girl from Poughkeepsie
episodes.description: Ross must decide whether to continue dating a girl he must travel two-and-a-half hours to see. Chandler sets Rachel up with a co-worker who misunderstands her intentions. Monica is being treated poorly by her new co-workers so she hires Joey just so she can fire him and show who's the boss. And Phoebe tries to write the perfect holiday song.

episodes.title: The One with Phoebe's Uterus
episodes.description: Phoebe considers her options when her brother visits with his new wife and asks her to carry their child. Joey works as a tour guide at Ross's museum and tries to tear down the walls between tour guides and scientists. And Chandler seeks advice from Monica and Rachel after he fears that he will not live up to Kathy's sexual expectations--especially since the last guy she slept with before him was Joey.

episodes.title: The One with the Embryos
episodes.description: Phoebe's uterus is examined for implantation of the embryos. Meanwhile, a seemingly harmless game between Chandler and Joey against Monica and Rachel escalates into a full blown contest where the stakes are raised higher and higher.

episodes.title: The One with Rachel's Crush
episodes.description: After seeing Kathy's play, Chandler becomes convinced she is cheating on him with her co-star. Rachel develops a crush on one of her customers. Monica becomes jealous when she realizes she is no longer the 'hostess'.

episodes.title: The One with Joey's Dirty Day
episodes.description: After a three-day fishing trip with his dad, Joey is in a jam when he doesn't have time to take a shower before going to the set of Charlton Heston's new movie.  Rachel, continuing to fawn over clothing shopper Joshua, sets Ross up with her boss's niece Emily when she is unable to take her to the opera. And while Chandler is despondent after his breakup with Kathy, the girls take him to a strip club.

episodes.title: The One with All the Rugby
episodes.description: Chandler runs into Janice, and finds her more irritating than ever. Meanwhile, Ross attempts to learn how to play rugby to impress Emily and Monica obsesses over an electric switch in her new apartment.

episodes.title: The One with the Fake Party
episodes.description: With two days left until Emily's departure back to England, Rachel throws a fake party for her, just so that she can see Joshua outside of work. And a pregnant (vegetarian) Phoebe craves meat.

episodes.title: The One with the Free Porn
episodes.description: Chandler and Joey discover that they're getting a free porno station on their TV. Monica encourages Ross to tell Emily he loves her just before she leaves for London. Phoebe gets some shocking news when she visits her OB-GYN.

episodes.title: The One with Rachel's New Dress
episodes.description: Rachel has an awkward encounter with Joshua's parents. Phoebe is offered the chance to name one of the triplets. Ross becomes paranoid when Emily goes to London with Susan.

episodes.title: The One with All the Haste
episodes.description: Ross proposes to Emily. Monica and Rachel try to win their apartment back from Chandler and Joey.

episodes.title: The One with All the Wedding Dresses
episodes.description: Chandler takes Joey to a sleep clinic when he starts snoring. After Ross asks Monica to pick up Emily's wedding dress, she tries it on and can't stop wearing it. Meanwhile, jealous of Ross's proposal to Emily, Rachel tries to talk Joshua into marriage.

episodes.title: The One with the Invitation
episodes.description: As Ross and Emily send out wedding invitations, he and Rachel each look back on their relationship together while Joey and Chandler look for a purpose in life.

episodes.title: The One with the Worst Best Man Ever
episodes.description: Joey convinces Ross to pick him as his best man instead of Chandler. He throws a great bachelor party, but the next morning he's shocked to find out that the wedding ring is missing and he suspects that the stripper stole it. Meanwhile, Phoebe is experiencing major mood swings due to her pregnancy and the girls decide to throw her a baby shower to cheer her up, but it only makes matters worse.

episodes.title: The One with Ross's Wedding
episodes.description:
The gang heads over to London for Ross and Emily's wedding. Joey can't contain his excitement about London which annoys Chandler to no end and results in two of them arguing. While the guys are touring the city, Monica, together with Ross and Emily, visit the chapel where the wedding ceremony is supposed to take place only to find out that it's being torn down prematurely.

Phoebe tries to warn the gang that Rachel is coming to London to tell Ross that she still loves him. After the initial excitement about visiting England dissipates, Joey begins to feel homesick, however, one of the bridesmaids helps him to forget about it. Meanwhile, Ross and Emily's parents get into an argument over the bill for the wedding.

episodes.title: The One After Ross Says Rachel
episodes.description: In the aftermath of his Freudian slip, Ross tries to rescue his marriage with Emily.  Meanwhile, Chandler and Monica try and find a moment alone in order to continue their affair while overseas.

episodes.title: The One with All the Kissing
episodes.description: Ross continues to try and mend his marriage to Emily. When Chandler accidentally kisses Monica in front of everyone before leaving for work, he tries to recover by kissing Rachel and Phoebe as well. Meanwhile, Phoebe starts getting irritated by everyone's London stories.

episodes.title: The One Hundredth
episodes.description: Phoebe is rushed to the hospital for the birth of her brother's triplets. While there, Joey winds up with severe sympathy pains that turn out to be kidney stones. Meanwhile, Rachel tries to set Monica up on a date with a male nurse.

episodes.title: The One Where Phoebe Hates PBS
episodes.description: Joey lands a job with a PBS telethon, which ignites an old hatred Phoebe has towards the network.  Meanwhile, Monica tries to convince Rachel that she's dating someone from work to hide her relationship with Chandler. And Ross finally gets in touch with Emily and they try to work it out.

episodes.title: The One with the Kips
episodes.description: Monica and Chandler plan an Atlantic City getaway in order to have an intimate weekend away from their friends.  Meanwhile, Ross prepares himself to tell Rachel that he can't see her anymore.

episodes.title: The One with the Yeti
episodes.description: Emily decides that the only way to continue her marriage with Ross is to have him get rid of all traces of Rachel in his apartment.  Meanwhile, Rachel and Monica mistake a hairy neighbor for a yeti.

episodes.title: The One Where Ross Moves In
episodes.description: Chandler and Joey let Ross move in with them once his marriage to Emily falls apart.  Meanwhile, Phoebe gets involved with the local health inspector and Rachel becomes convinced that Danny is trying to seduce her with mind games.

episodes.title: The One with All the Thanksgivings
episodes.description: Although the Thanksgiving meal is great, Chandler is still moody over his parent's divorce during the holiday when he was a boy and Ross is depressed about his second divorce. The group reminisces about their worst Thanksgivings in order to cheer them up, and Monica's worst memory is revealed.

episodes.title: The One with Ross's Sandwich
episodes.description: Joey starts to get uncomfortable with protecting Monica and Chandler's secret, especially when it places him in embarrassing situations with the rest of the group. Meanwhile, Ross becomes enraged at work when someone swipes his turkey sandwich. Phoebe and Rachel enroll in a literature class.

episodes.title: The One with the Inappropriate Sister
episodes.description: Joey teaches Ross how to be unemployed. Phoebe is working for the Salvation Army during the holidays. Monica is tired of Rachel's obsessing about Danny and asks him to go out with her. Ross convinces Joey to write a play about himself. Phoebe is distressed after finding out that New Yorkers are mean. Rachel meets Danny's sister and is dismayed when the two seem a little too playful. Phoebe vows a return to "Street Phoebe."

episodes.title: The One with All the Resolutions
episodes.description: With the New Year, the friends make New Year's resolutions. Ross resolves to try a new thing every day. Chandler resolves to not make fun of his friends for a week. Joey resolves to learn how to play the guitar, with Phoebe as his teacher. Rachel resolves to give up gossiping. Chandler nearly goes insane holding it all in. Ross is stuck in a sticky situation at his date's apartment, in constricting and hot leather pants. Rachel discovers a big secret (Monica and Chandler) that threatens to spoil her resolution.

episodes.title: The One with Chandler's Work Laugh
episodes.description: Monica begins to hang out with Chandler during his work functions, since they don't have to keep their relationship a secret among his coworkers.  However, she learns that Chandler has a second, more annoying personality when he's around his boss.  Meanwhile, Ross learns that Emily is getting remarried and in his grief hooks up with an old nemesis of the gang: Janice.

episodes.title: The One with Joey's Bag
episodes.description: Phoebe's grandmother dies, and Phoebe is shocked when her father turns up at the funeral. Meanwhile, Rachel gives Joey a "man's bag" for an audition, and Chandler is scared to tell Monica he doesn't like her massages.

episodes.title: The One Where Everybody Finds Out
episodes.description: When the friends discover that Ugly Naked Guy is moving out of his apartment, Ross leaps at the opportunity to get his own place again. Phoebe finds out about Monica and Chandler's relationship, and tries to get them to reveal the truth by seducing Chandler.

episodes.title: The One with the Girl Who Hits Joey
episodes.description: Joey starts dating Katie, a little girl who packs a mean punch.  When Ross refuses to contribute to the retirement fund of the building's maintenance man, he winds up offending everyone in the building. Meanwhile, Chandler freaks out about his relationship with Monica.

episodes.title: The One with the Cop
episodes.description: Joey has a dream about Monica and becomes convinced he is in love with her. Meanwhile, Phoebe finds a police badge in Central Perk and uses it to go on missions of mercy. And Ross buys a new sofa but has trouble moving it up the stairs into his new apartment.

episodes.title: The One with Rachel's Inadvertent Kiss
episodes.description: Monica becomes jealous of Phoebe and Gary. Rachel has an awkward encounter when she interviews for a new job. Joey tries to meet a girl living in Ross's building, but has trouble with finding her apartment.

episodes.title: The One Where Rachel Smokes
episodes.description: Rachel decides to start smoking in order to avoid missing important meetings with her boss. Meanwhile, Ben gets offered an audition for a soup commercial, and Joey auditions to be Ben's father during the ad. Also, Monica and Phoebe plan a surprise birthday party for Rachel together, but Monica takes over.

episodes.title: The One Where Ross Can't Flirt
episodes.description: As Joey's Italian-speaking grandmother visits to watch him on TV, Ross has trouble flirting with the pizza delivery girl, and Rachel tries to find an earring of Monica's that she has misplaced.

episodes.title: The One with the Ride Along
episodes.description: While the guys go on a ride-along with Gary, Rachel accidentally deletes a message from Emily on Ross's answering machine.

episodes.title: The One with the Ball
episodes.description: Phoebe learns that Gary is going to ask her to move in with him and thinking this is way to fast, she tries to get Chandler to talk him out of this decision. Rachel buys an expensive sphynx cat but is disappointed when it doesn't behave as she hoped it would. Meanwhile, Ross and Joey start throwing a ball while they are bored but it changes from a time-filler to a super-competitive obsession when Monica joins in.

episodes.title: The One with Joey's Big Break
episodes.description: Joey seems to have finally hit big when he gets offered a lead part in a movie shooting outside of Las Vegas. However, when Chandler begins expressing doubts about the film's legitimacy, it causes a rift in their friendship. Also, Rachel gets an eye infection but is reluctant to seek treatment because of her eye phobia. And Phoebe is mad at Ross, but doesn't know why.

episodes.title: The One in Vegas
episodes.description:
Chandler decides the only way to mend his friendship with Joey is to fly out to Vegas and visit him. Phoebe is determined not to be left out on another adventure, so everyone winds up going. Trouble is in the water, however, when Chandler finds out that Monica had lunch with Richard. Meanwhile, Ross and Rachel try to embarrass each other after an awkward encounter.

Chandler and Monica reconcile and hastily decide to get married. Ross and Rachel get drunk and roam the casino. Phoebe deals with a 'lurker' on the slot machines.

title: Young Sheldon
description: The early life of child genius Sheldon Cooper, later seen in The Big Bang Theory.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper is a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science but learns that isn’t always helpful growing up in East Texas, a land where church and football are king.

episodes.title: Rockets, Communists, and the Dewey Decimal System
episodes.description: To appease his worried mother, Sheldon employs the techniques of a self-help book to try and make a friend.

episodes.title: Poker, Faith, and Eggs
episodes.description: When George Sr. is rushed to the emergency room, Connie comes to babysit, and the kids have an adventure getting to the hospital on their own.

episodes.title: A Therapist, a Comic Book, and a Breakfast Sausage
episodes.description: After choking on a breakfast sausage, Sheldon wrestles with his fear of solid foods and discovers comic books for the first time.

episodes.title: A Solar Calculator, a Game Ball, and a Cheerleader's Bosom
episodes.description: Sheldon struggles with newfound popularity after utilizing statistics to help the football team.

episodes.title: A Patch, a Modem, and a Zantac
episodes.description: When a NASA representative visits Sheldon’s school and dismisses his science, Sheldon is set on a mission to prove him wrong.

episodes.title: A Brisket, Voodoo, and Cannonball Run
episodes.description: The kids brainstorm ways to resolve a family feud when Connie refuses to give George Sr. her brisket recipe.

episodes.title: Cape Canaveral, Schrödinger's Cat, and Cyndi Lauper's Hair
episodes.description: While Mary, Connie and Missy have their girls night at the salon, the three Cooper men plan their road trip to see the space launcher, but it doesn't go as well as they plan.

episodes.title: Spock, Kirk, and Testicular Hernia
episodes.description: George Sr. strikes a deal with Sheldon to tutor Georgie when poor grades threaten to keep him from playing football. While Sheldon's tutoring attempts are ultimately unsuccessful, he does learn some skills from his brother.

episodes.title: An Eagle Feather, a String Bean, and an Eskimo
episodes.description: When Sheldon moves to Dallas to attend a school for gifted children, the family struggles to cope with his absence.

episodes.title: Demons, Sunday School, and Prime Numbers
episodes.description: A worried Mary sends Sheldon to Sunday school after she finds him playing Dungeons and Dragons with his friends, Tam and Billy.

episodes.title: A Computer, a Plastic Pony, and a Case of Beer
episodes.description: Sheldon asks for a computer and unknowingly sparks a heated argument between Mary and George Sr. over the family’s finances.

episodes.title: A Sneeze, Detention, and Sissy Spacek
episodes.description: When flu season hits Medford, Sheldon takes extreme measures to remain healthy.

episodes.title: Potato Salad, a Broomstick, and Dad's Whiskey
episodes.description: When Mary takes a job as church secretary, she finds herself becoming Pastor Jeff's marriage counselor. Also, Sheldon and Missy spend their first afternoon home alone.

episodes.title: Dolomite, Apple Slices, and a Mystery Woman
episodes.description: Sheldon makes friends with an upperclassman who introduces him to a new field of science. Also, Mary and George disagree on how to handle Sheldon's blossoming social life.

episodes.title: Killer Asteroids, Oklahoma, and a Frizzy Hair Machine
episodes.description: A disappointing loss at the science fair sends Sheldon’s life in a new direction.

episodes.title: Jiu-Jitsu, Bubble Wrap, and Yoo-hoo
episodes.description: Sheldon is bullied by an unlikely character, and Mary and George disagree on how to handle the situation.

episodes.title: A Mother, A Child, and a Blue Man's Backside
episodes.description: Mary bans Sheldon from reading a mature comic book. Sheldon decides it's time to stop living under Mary's thumb.

episodes.title: Gluons, Guacamole, and the Color Purple
episodes.description: When Sheldon is no longer academically challenged at Medford High, he audits a college class taught by Dr. John Sturgis.

episodes.title: A Dog, a Squirrel, and a Fish Named Fish
episodes.description: A battle erupts between the Coopers and Sparks when the Sparks' new dog terrorizes Sheldon.

episodes.title: Summer Sausage, a Pocket Poncho, and Tony Danza
episodes.description: While Sheldon is busy keeping tabs on Connie’s budding relationship with Dr. Sturgis, George Sr. and Mary attempt to bond with their other children.

episodes.title: Vanilla Ice Cream, Gentleman Callers, and a Dinette Set
episodes.description: When Connie is pursued by two gentlemen callers, Sheldon interferes, forcing her to set some ground rules.

episodes.title: A High-Pitched Buzz and Training Wheels
episodes.description: After Sheldon dismantles the refrigerator to stop an annoying hum, he gets a paper route to pay for the repairs.

episodes.title: A Rival Prodigy and Sir Isaac Neutron
episodes.description: When Dr. Sturgis bonds with Paige, another 10-year-old genius, Sheldon’s jealousy leads Connie to intervene. Mary invites Paige’s family over for a play date.

episodes.title: A Crisis of Faith and Octopus Aliens
episodes.description: When Mary’s faith is shaken by a tragedy in the community, Sheldon becomes an unlikely ally.

episodes.title: A Financial Secret and Fish Sauce
episodes.description: When George Sr. asks Sheldon to keep a secret from Mary, the stress of not being honest drives Sheldon to hideout at Tam’s for his first sleepover.

episodes.title: A Research Study and Czechoslovakian Wedding Pastries
episodes.description: When Dr. Sturgis recommends Sheldon and Missy for a university research study on twins, Mary is unhappy when the test results go to Sheldon's head.

episodes.title: Seven Deadly Sins and a Small Carl Sagan
episodes.description: Mary clashes with Sheldon's drama teacher over plans for a Halloween fundraiser for the church. Georgie falls for a rebellious teenage girl whom Sheldon is tutoring.

episodes.title: Carbon Dating and a Stuffed Raccoon
episodes.description: Sheldon gets into trouble with fellow child genius, Paige at the science museum. George is forced to play therapist to Paige’s bickering parents. Mary, Georgie and Missy help Connie with a garage sale.

episodes.title: An 8-Bit Princess and a Flat Tire Genius
episodes.description: A video game takes over Sheldon and Connie’s life. George Sr. is jealous when Georgie bonds with Herschel at the auto shop.

episodes.title: Family Dynamics and a Red Fiero
episodes.description: Sheldon studies his family for a psychology project. Thanksgiving dinner turns into a family fight when George Sr. is offered a job in Oklahoma.

episodes.title: A Stunted Childhood and a Can of Fancy Mixed Nuts
episodes.description: When Sheldon learns that people with stunted childhoods can turn into social outcasts, he tries to act. Connie and Dr. Sturgis' relationship is tested when she teaches him how to drive.

episodes.title: A Race of Superhumans and a Letter to Alf
episodes.description: Sheldon experiments on Missy, and Georgie joins Mary’s bible study to spend more time with his crush, Veronica.

episodes.title: A Tummy Ache and a Whale of a Metaphor
episodes.description: When Sheldon has to spend a few days in the hospital, he turns into the world’s worst patient. Also, Missy gets a taste of what life would be like without her twin.

episodes.title: A Nuclear Reactor and a Boy Called Lovely
episodes.description: Sheldon attempts to build a nuclear reactor. Also, a university cocktail party gets heated when Dr. Sturgis’ colleague, Dr. Linkletter, flirts with Connie, and Georgie is heartbroken when he learns Veronica has a boyfriend.

episodes.title: David, Goliath and a Yoo-hoo from the Back
episodes.description: Sheldon uses his new friendship with the school bully to boss Georgie around. Also, Missy steals Connie's makeup for picture day.

episodes.title: A Math Emergency and Perky Palms
episodes.description: Sheldon and Dr. Sturgis have their first fight when Dr. Sturgis marks a question wrong on Sheldon's test. Also, Mary takes over for Pastor Jeff when he's out sick.

episodes.title: A Loaf of Bread and a Grand Old Flag
episodes.description: Things spiral out of control when Sheldon boycotts his favorite bread company. Also, Georgie offers Veronica a shoulder to cry on when she's dumped by her boyfriend.

episodes.title: Albert Einstein and the Story of Another Mary
episodes.description: Inspired by his hero, Albert Einstein, Sheldon tries his hand at the violin. Also, Mary and Connie secretly buy a pregnancy test when Mary thinks she's pregnant

episodes.title: A Perfect Score and a Bunsen Burner Marshmallow
episodes.description: Sheldon moves in with Dr. Sturgis for the weekend to see what his life will be like in college. Also, a lonely Mary tries to bond with the other Coopers during Sheldon's absence.

episodes.title: A Political Campaign and a Candy Land Cheater
episodes.description: Unhappy that school funds are going towards football rather than academics, Sheldon decides to run for class president.

episodes.title: A Proposal and a Popsicle Stick Cross
episodes.description: Georgie is thrilled when Veronica stays at the Coopers' house for a few days. Also, Connie and Dr. Sturgis celebrate their one-year anniversary.

episodes.title: A Broken Heart and a Crock Monster
episodes.description: The Coopers help Pastor Jeff through a rough patch in his marriage. Also, Sheldon pressures church members for donations when Mary takes him to work for a day.

episodes.title: A Swedish Science Thing and the Equation for Toast
episodes.description: Sheldon invites the entire school to a party for the Nobel Prize announcements. Also, Connie learns more about Dr. Sturgis' past, and Georgie's desire for cable TV leads to a standoff between him and George Sr.

episodes.title: Quirky Eggheads and Texas Snow Globes
episodes.description: After Dr. Sturgis experiences a nervous breakdown, Mary worries Sheldon is headed down a similar path. Also, Georgie discovers he has a knack for sales.

episodes.title: A Broom Closet and Satan's Monopoly Board
episodes.description: Without Dr. Sturgis’ university class, Sheldon must find a new way to stay academically challenged. Also, Mary helps Pastor Jeff avoid temptation with his girlfriend.

episodes.title: An Entrepreneurialist and a Swat on the Bottom
episodes.description: Sheldon takes matters into his own hands when Connie refuses to drive him to a lecture with Dr. Linkletter. Also, Georgie tries to impress Veronica with his new business venture

episodes.title: Hobbitses, Physicses and a Ball with Zip
episodes.description: Sheldon is forced to take a break from science when his new obsession with "The Lord of the Rings" leads to an unhealthy habit. Also, Missy asks George Sr. to teach her how to play catch.

episodes.title: A Pineapple and the Bosom of Male Friendship
episodes.description: After being released from the mental hospital, Dr. Sturgis unexpectedly breaks up with Connie.

episodes.title: A Parasol and a Hell of an Arm
episodes.description: A church carnival leads Missy to try out for the baseball team. Also, Connie struggles after her breakup with Dr. Sturgis.

episodes.title: Pongo Pygmaeus and a Culture that Encourages Spitting
episodes.description: Sheldon starts an internet flame war, and Missy stands up to the boys on her baseball team. Also, Connie is unhappy when George Sr. spends time with her new boyfriend.

episodes.title: The Sin of Greed and a Chimichanga from Chi-chi's
episodes.description: The University makes George Sr. a lucrative job offer in the hopes of recruiting Sheldon. Also, Georgie gets a job working for Connie's new boyfriend, and Mary is determined to rid her home of greed.

episodes.title: A Party Invitation, Football Grapes and an Earth Chicken
episodes.description: Mary gets Pastor Jeff involved when Sheldon isn't invited to Billy's birthday party. Also, George Sr. has "male-bonding time" with Dr. Sturgis.

episodes.title: Teenager Soup and a Little Ball of Fib
episodes.description: Sheldon fakes being sick to avoid a swim test at school. Also, Dr. Sturgis spies on Connie's new boyfriend.

episodes.title: A Live Chicken, a Fried Chicken and Holy Matrimony
episodes.description: George Sr. and Connie struggle to manage the Cooper household while Mary plans Pastor Jeff’s wedding.

episodes.title: Body Glitter and a Mall Safety Kit
episodes.description: The fate of the world lies in Sheldon's hands. Faced with dire consequences in the wake of Georgie's murder, he must reunite with friends old and new to stop the second coming of the big bang before Meemaw can complete her evil plan and take over the world forever.

episodes.title: Contracts, Rules and a Little Bit of Pig Brains
episodes.description: George Sr. and Georgie go camping with Connie's new boyfriend, Dale, but things get complicated when her ex-boyfriend, Dr. Sturgis, tags along. Also, Sheldon and Missy invent a super-game.

episodes.title: A Slump, a Cross and Roadside Gravel
episodes.description: Sheldon and Georgie mine for platinum in roadside gravel. Mary is concerned when Missy misuses religion to help with a batting slump.

episodes.title: A Boyfriend's Ex-Wife and a Good Luck Head Rub
episodes.description: Connie meets Dale’s ex-wife, June. Sheldon is forced to work on a group project with reluctant college students.

episodes.title: Pasadena
episodes.description: Sheldon visits CalTech for the very first time. Also, Georgie is furious when Mary listens in on a phone call with his girlfriend, and Connie tries to cheer up a jealous Missy.

episodes.title: An Academic Crime and a More Romantic Taco Bell
episodes.description: Dr. Sturgis is furious when Sheldon accuses him of plagiarism. Also, Mary sets out to find a “girl trophy” for Missy’s end-of-season baseball ceremony, and Georgie has an awkward run-in with Veronica while on a date with his new girlfriend, Jana.

episodes.title: A Couple Bruised Ribs and a Cereal Box Ghost Detector
episodes.description: When George Sr. accidentally lands the school librarian in the hospital, the Cooper family must nurse her back to health. Connie gives Georgie relationship advice.

episodes.title: A House for Sale and Serious Woman Stuff
episodes.description: When Sheldon learns the house next door is for sale, he takes it upon himself to find the perfect neighbors. Missy is torn when she’s forced to pitch against her boyfriend at the baseball game.

episodes.title: A Baby Tooth and the Egyptian God of Knowledge
episodes.description: Sheldon has a scientific breakthrough at the dentist's office. Also, Dale and Connie go to the casino, and Georgie makes a big mistake when Dale leaves him in charge of the store

episodes.title: A Secret Letter and a Lowly Disc of Processed Meat
episodes.description: Sheldon discovers that Mary's been keeping a secret about his future. Also, Connie is furious when she learns Dale fired Georgie.

episodes.title: Graduation
episodes.description: After graduating high school, Sheldon has a breakdown when he realizes he may not be ready for college. Dale tries to make amends with Connie.

episodes.title: A Docent, A Little Lady and a Bouncer Named Dalton
episodes.description: Sheldon gets a summer job at the local train museum. Also, George and Missy bond when Missy embarks on a new stage of womanhood, and Georgie discovers Mary's guilty pleasure.

episodes.title: Training Wheels and an Unleashed Chicken
episodes.description: With college in sight, Sheldon is determined to ride his bike without training wheels. Also, Mary and George Sr. argue over parenting styles.

episodes.title: Bible Camp and a Chariot of Love
episodes.description: When their mothers force them to attend Vacation Bible School. Also, George is furious after Georgie makes a questionable purchase.

episodes.title: A Musty Crypt and a Stick to Pee On
episodes.description: Dale and Connie work out relationship issues while playing Dungeons and Dragons with Sheldon and Missy. Also, Mary and George take a trip with Coach Wilkins and his wife, and Georgie freaks out when his girlfriend thinks she's pregnant.

episodes.title: Freshman Orientation and the Inventor of The Zipper
episodes.description: College orientation does not go as Sheldon planned. Also, Mary is invited to a party when she's mistaken for a university student, and George Sr. helps Pastor Jeff set up a children's nursery.

episodes.title: A Philosophy Class and Worms That Can Chase You
episodes.description: Sheldon's first day of college is derailed by his new philosophy teacher, Professor Ericson. Also, Mary and Brenda live vicariously through Missy's first day of middle school.

episodes.title: An Existential Crisis and a Bear That Makes Bubbles
episodes.description: Connie takes matters into her own hands when Sheldon's philosophy teacher, Professor Ericson, sends him into a tailspin. Also, George Sr. learns Georgie has been cutting class.

episodes.title: Crappy Frozen Ice Cream and an Organ Grinder's Monkey
episodes.description: Sheldon and George Sr. dine with President Hagemeyer and a university benefactor. Also, Georgie gives Missy some brotherly advice when Mary won't let her go to the school dance, and Dale and June convince Connie to attend their son's wedding.

episodes.title: Cowboy Aerobics and 473 Grease-Free Bolts
episodes.description: Sheldon campaigns to become Dr. Linkletter's lab assistant. Also, Georgie enlists the help of Mr. Lundy, the drama teacher, for a surprising business venture.

episodes.title: A Pager, a Club and a Cranky Bag of Wrinkles
episodes.description: Dr. Linkletter pushes Sheldon to make friends with his fellow students at college. Also, Georgie gets a pager.

episodes.title: A Box of Treasure and the Meemaw of Science
episodes.description: Sheldon, Dr. Linkletter and Connie team up on a science experiment. Also, Mary is jealous that Pastor Jeff and Brenda are spending time together, and Georgie has a new side hustle.

episodes.title: The Geezer Bus and a New Model for Education
episodes.description: Sheldon refuses to ride in a car after getting into an accident with Connie. Also, Missy uses their trauma to her advantage at school and Connie is forced to take the church shuttle while her car is in the shop.

episodes.title: Mitch's Son and the Unconditional Approval of a Government Agency
episodes.description: When the IRS accuses Sheldon of making a mistake, he'll stop at nothing to prove them wrong. Also, Dale is forced to get a colonoscopy and tries to convince Connie to join him.

episodes.title: A Virus, Heartbreak and a World of Possibilities
episodes.description: Sheldon is caught in a moral dilemma when offered a bootleg copy of a computer game he can't afford. Also, Mary and Connie take Brenda out for girls' night while George Sr. and the guys watch Billy, and Missy asks Georgie to take her and Marcus on a secret date.

episodes.title: A Second Prodigy and the Hottest Tips for Pouty Lips
episodes.description: Sheldon finds himself at odds with Paige once again when she considers enrolling at East Texas Tech. Also, Mary seeks June's advice when looking for a change.

episodes.title: A Black Hole
episodes.description: The Coopers discuss the possibilities of black holes and alternate universes when Dr. Sturgis comes over for dinner.

episodes.title: The Wild and Woolly World of Nonlinear Dynamics
episodes.description: Missy's first heartbreak triggers a series of events that lead the Cooper family to the brink.

episodes.title: One Bad Night and Chaos of Selfish Desires
episodes.description: Sheldon and Missy both run away from home, and Mary gets upsetting news about George Sr.

episodes.title: Snoopin' Around and the Wonder Twins of Atheism
episodes.description: Sheldon encourages Missy to question the Bible. Also, Connie is determined to catch George Sr. in a lie, and Mary helps Pastor Jeff search for a youth pastor.

episodes.title: Potential Energy and Hooch on a Park Bench
episodes.description: Sheldon tries to convince Dr. Sturgis to return to the university. Also, Georgie upsets the family when he makes a life-changing decision.

episodes.title: Pish Posh and a Secret Back Room
episodes.description: Sheldon, Missy and Georgie adapt to new living arrangements. Also, Connie opens a gambling room.

episodes.title: Stuffed Animals and a Sweet Southern Syzygy
episodes.description: Sheldon and Dr. Linkletter struggle to solve an equation. Also, Georgie has a solution for Connie's business woes, and George Sr. gives advice on Missy's love life.

episodes.title: Money Laundering and a Cascade of Hormones
episodes.description: Missy asks some uncomfortable questions at church, and Connie and Georgie go into business together.

episodes.title: An Introduction to Engineering and a Glob of Hair Gel
episodes.description: Sheldon takes his first engineering class with Professor Boucher. Also, Meemaw and Dale help take care of his ex-wife, June.

episodes.title: The Grand Chancellor and a Den of Sin
episodes.description: Sheldon battles President Hagemeyer's mysterious boss over the university's science requirements. Also, Mary discovers that Georgie is working at Connie's illegal gambling room.

episodes.title: The Yips and an Oddly Hypnotic Bohemian
episodes.description: Sheldon gets the science yips and has to learn how to not think. Also, George Sr. plays handyman at Brenda Sparks' house.

episodes.title: An Expensive Glitch and a Goof-Off Room
episodes.description: Sheldon gets a dorm room all to himself. Also, Connie gains an unwanted business partner.

episodes.title: A Lock-In, a Weather Girl and a Disgusting Habit
episodes.description: Sheldon acts as Mary's spy during a youth lock-in at church. Also, Georgie is attracted to an older woman, Mandy.

episodes.title: A Pink Cadillac and a Glorious Tribal Dance
episodes.description: Sheldon attends his first comic book convention; Mary tries selling makeup.

episodes.title: A Lot of Band-Aids and the Cooper Surrender
episodes.description: Sheldon makes friends with his dorm neighbors; George Sr. learns his job is in jeopardy.

episodes.title: A Free Scratcher and Feminine Wiles
episodes.description: Sheldon butts heads with Dr. Lee, a new scientist in the lab. Also, Mary is given a lotto ticket.

episodes.title: A Lobster, an Armadillo and a Way Bigger Number
episodes.description: Sheldon joins Dr. Linkletter and Dr. Sturgis on a science road trip. Also, Georgie continues to lie about his age.

episodes.title: A Suitcase Full of Cash and a Yellow Clown Car
episodes.description: Connie's gambling room is a success, and Sheldon dips his toe in the stock market. Also, Missy starts a business.

episodes.title: A Solo Peanut, a Social Butterfly and the Truth
episodes.description: Sheldon gets an odd request from an old friend, Paige. Also, George Sr. and Mary are caught in the middle of Connie and Dale's breakup, and Georgie comes clean to Mandy.

episodes.title: Babies, Lies and a Resplendent Cannoli
episodes.description: Sheldon copes with the death of a hero. Also, Missy wants to babysit, and Georgie struggles with his big secret.

episodes.title: A God-Fearin' Baptist and a Hot Trophy Husband
episodes.description: George and Mary insist on meeting the new woman in Georgie's life. Also, Sheldon and Missy have suspicions about what's going on with their family.

episodes.title: Uncle Sheldon and a Hormonal Firecracker
episodes.description: Sheldon and Missy learn about Georgie's pregnancy, and the whole family promises to keep it a secret.

episodes.title: White Trash, Holy Rollers and Punching People
episodes.description: As the church congregation gossips about Georgie, Missy stands up for her brother, and Sheldon is distracted by the family drama.

episodes.title: Clogged Pore, a Little Spanish and the Future
episodes.description: Sheldon struggles to cope with the first signs of puberty. Also, Mary and George Sr. hunt for new jobs, and Georgie and Meemaw take a business trip across the border.

title: Suits
description: While running from a drug deal gone bad, Mike Ross, a brilliant young college-dropout, slips into a job interview with one of New York City's best legal closers, Harvey Specter. Tired of cookie-cutter law school grads, Harvey takes a gamble by hiring Mike on the spot after he recognizes his raw talent and photographic memory.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: A "closer" for one of New York City's most successful law firms decides to hire an aloof genius who has passed the bar but never went to law school as his associate.

episodes.title: Errors and Omissions
episodes.description: Mike has an ethical dilemma when Louis forces him to make a decision that could hurt his relationship with Harvey. Elsewhere, Harvey's past comes back to haunt him during a case.

episodes.title: Inside Track
episodes.description: Jessica hopes Harvey's promotion will reign him in, but when a crisis arises with the first client he brought into the firm, Harvey goes rogue trying to fix it.

episodes.title: Dirty Little Secrets
episodes.description: Harvey and Jessica's relationship is tested when Harvey defends someone from her past. Also, Louis assigns Mike his first solo case, a pro bono that has him itching for a win.

episodes.title: Bail Out
episodes.description: Mike's life becomes complicated when an old friend reappears and needs his help. Harvey must decide between closing a multi-million dollar deal and helping his trusted driver defend himself against a law suit.

episodes.title: Tricks of the Trade
episodes.description: Harvey and Mike work to save a woman wrongly accused of insider trading. Mike helps Rachel study for the LSAT, only to find out she is on the brink of discovering his closely guarded secret.

episodes.title: Play the Man
episodes.description: Mike takes on Louis' protégé during a mock trial, but his conflict with Rachel could hurt his chances of winning. Elsewhere, Harvey works on a merger between two hotel chains, but his past with the opposing counsel complicates matters.

episodes.title: Identity Crisis
episodes.description: Mike is tasked with reigning in a modern day Robin Hood whose illicit deeds are putting a client's business at risk. Also, Louis must resolve his differences with Harvey to win a case. Amanda Crew and Bruce Altman guest star.

episodes.title: Undefeated
episodes.description: Harvey meets his match in a cocky opposing counsel in a class action lawsuit, and Mike unknowingly helps frame Rachel as a traitor to the firm.

episodes.title: Shelf Life
episodes.description: Harvey must fire an accountant for falsifying his credentials, but Mike finds a more sinister motive for his termination and becomes concerned about his own employment. Meanwhile, Louis thinks he's found his future wife.

episodes.title: Rules of the Game
episodes.description: Harvey's former mentor turns to him for help when his office comes under investigation. Meanwhile, Jenny suspects Mike may be occupied with more than just his job.

episodes.title: Dog Fight
