However, the Squad soon discovers that their rescue mission isn't what they expected. Meanwhile, Ray learns that Oliver is the Arrow and sets out to bring him in for his crimes.

episodes.title: Public Enemy
episodes.description: Ra's makes his next move against Oliver by reveling the Arrow's secret identity to Quentin. Left without alternatives, Oliver has no choice but to surrender. Meanwhile, Ray is injured in an attack and Felicity must take a risk to save his life.

episodes.title: Broken Arrow
episodes.description: After Roy confesses that he's the Arrow, Oliver is forced to lie low as Quentin continues his quest to prove that Oliver is the real Arrow. Meanwhile, a metahuman kills two bank guards and Oliver is forced to turn to Ray--as the Atom--for help.

episodes.title: The Fallen
episodes.description: Oliver has no choice but to accept Ra's's offer to resurrect Thea. In return, Oliver must become the Heir to the Demon.

episodes.title: Al Sah-him
episodes.description: Ra's sets out to transform Oliver into his perfect heir. Meanwhile, Nyssa and Laurel draw closer, but their mentor/student relationship is threatened when Ra's sends men to bring his errant daughter back to Nanda Parbat..

episodes.title: This is Your Sword
episodes.description: Ra's tells Nyssa that she must marry Oliver or face death. Meanwhile, an unexpected ally travels to Starling City to ask Diggle, Felicity, and Laurel to help infiltrate Nanda Parbat. In the past, Maseo and Oliver try to find the cure for Akio before it's too late.

episodes.title: My Name Is Oliver Queen
episodes.description: With time running out for Starling City, Oliver tries to stop Ra's from unleashing the bioweapon and killing millions.

episodes.title: Green Arrow
episodes.description: Oliver and Felicity's blissful getaway is cut short when Thea and Laurel pay them a visit and tell Oliver they need his help back in Star City. The city has been attacked by Ghosts, assassins led by a dangerous man named Damien Darhk. However, when Oliver returns, Diggle makes it very clear that he doesn't want Oliver on the team.

episodes.title: The Candidate
episodes.description: Oliver and Thea are concerned when a family friend plans to run for mayor. Thea starts to exhibit side effects from the Lazarus Pit. Felicity asks an employee for help with a business decision.

episodes.title: Restoration
episodes.description: The growing tension between Oliver and Diggle puts both their lives at risk when they go after Damien Darhk and a H.I.V.E. deployed meta-human. Meanwhile, Laurel talks Thea into returning to Nanda Parbat to ask her father to put Sara into the Lazarus Pit. However, Laurel is surprised when Nyssa refuses to do it.

episodes.title: Beyond Redemption
episodes.description: Laurel must deal with the repercussions of taking Sara to Nanda Parbat. Meanwhile, Oliver asks Captain Lance for a favor and while he's not surprised at the response, he is surprised at what he finds out next.

episodes.title: Haunted
episodes.description: When things take a turn for the worse with Sara, Oliver calls in a favor from an old friend who deals in the mystical, John Constantine.

episodes.title: Lost Souls
episodes.description: Felicity is frantic when she learns that Ray is alive and being held by Damien Darhk. Felicity's guilt over not finding Ray sooner causes tension between her and Oliver. Meanwhile, Sara joins Laurel, Thea, and the team on a rescue mission for Ray. However, the effects of the Lazarus Pit take over and threaten to jeopardize the entire operation. Donna Smoak returns to Star City.

episodes.title: Brotherhood
episodes.description: Team Green Arrow's ongoing battle with Damien Darhk is complicated by a shocking revelation. Thea's bloodlust returns and she loses control in front of Alex.

episodes.title: Legends of Yesterday (II)
episodes.description:
Oliver and Barry Allen take Kendra Saunders and Carter Hall to a remote location to keep them hidden from Vandal Savage while they figure out how to defeat him. Malcolm arranges a meeting between Vandal, Green Arrow and The Flash that doesn't go as planned. Meanwhile, Felicity, Thea, Diggle and Laurel work with Team Flash to come up with a weapon powerful enough to destroy Vandal Savage.

The crossover starts on The Flash S02E08 Legends of Today (I).

episodes.title: Dark Waters
episodes.description: After the city is attacked again, Oliver makes a bold move against HIVE. Malcolm checks in on Thea and leaves her with a warning. Things take a horrible turn when Damien Darhk retaliates in a brutal manner at Oliver's mayoral holiday party.

episodes.title: Blood Debts
episodes.description: Oliver must deal with the devastating consequences of Darhk's last attack. Seeking revenge, Oliver goes on a brutal manhunt looking for Dahrk.

episodes.title: A.W.O.L.
episodes.description: Diggle must learn to trust his brother Andy when an enemy of their wartime past, an agent of the criminal organization Shadowspire, pays a visit to Star City. However, Diggle learns more than he bargained for about their shared time at war. Meanwhile, Oliver has to learn a whole new way of life.

episodes.title: Unchained
episodes.description: The team faces off against a formidable villain nicknamed The Calculator. Meanwhile, Nyssa makes her move and Roy Harper returns to Star City.

episodes.title: Sins of the Father
episodes.description: Oliver receives an offer from Nyssa that is hard to refuse. Meanwhile, Thea continues to battle the blood lust, Malcolm steps in to help his daughter, and Laurel has a heart to heart talk with Nyssa.

episodes.title: Code of Silence
episodes.description: Oliver and team uncover HIVE's plan to take out Team Arrow once and for all. With HIVE's next attack imminent, Lance wonders if Donna is safer without him in her life. Meanwhile, with the wedding fast approaching, Oliver begins to feel guilty that he hasn't told Felicity about his son.

episodes.title: Taken
episodes.description: Oliver realizes he needs help battling Darhk so he calls in an old friend – Vixen. Using her magical ability to summon animal powers, Vixen gets a lock on Darhk's location and the team goes to war. Meanwhile, Thea has a heart-to-heart talk with Malcolm.

episodes.title: Broken Hearts
episodes.description: A heartbroken Cupid returns to Star City with one goal – to destroy anyone in love. The team learns she's killing couples on their wedding day so Oliver and Felicity decide to pose as bait.

episodes.title: Beacon of Hope
episodes.description: Brie Larvan breaks out of jail and turns up at Palmer Tech threatening to kill everyone unless she gets the bio-chip that is implanted in Felicity's spine. When Oliver realizes that Felicity, Thea and Donna are trapped in Palmer Tech with everyone else, he looks to a surprising ally to help Team Arrow save the day.

episodes.title: Eleven-Fifty-Nine
episodes.description: Oliver and Diggle learn that Merlyn is going to try to break Darhk out of prison. Meanwhile, Laurel gets a surprising offer and Felicity has a heart-to-heart talk with Curtis.

episodes.title: Canary Cry
episodes.description: Oliver and the team struggle to come to terms with Laurel's death, especially Diggle who is overwhelmed with guilt for choosing to believe Andy had changed. Meanwhile, Lance refuses to believe his daughter is really gone and asks Nyssa to help bring her back. A recent Black Canary sighting in Star City only seems to prove his theory that Laurel isn't actually dead.

episodes.title: Genesis
episodes.description: As Oliver and Felicity look for a magical solution to defeat Darhk, a vengeance-driven Diggle gets a lead on Andy's whereabouts and heads off to confront his brother. Meanwhile, Alex takes Thea on a vacation that quickly turns into a nightmare.

episodes.title: Monument Point
episodes.description: When Team Arrow learns what Damien Darhk's next move is Felicity realizes she needs to ask her father, Noah Kuttler, for help. Noah and Oliver have a heart to heart talk that leaves Oliver rattled.

episodes.title: Lost in the Flood
episodes.description: Following the shocking events in the previous episode, Oliver and Diggle race to rescue Thea, while Felicity, Curtis and Noah join together to stop Darhk.

episodes.title: Schism
episodes.description: Oliver teams up with a surprising force in an attempt to stop Damien Darhk and his magic once and for all.

episodes.title: Legacy
episodes.description: A deadly new criminal, Tobias Church, threatens Star City, which forces Oliver to consider forming a new team of superheroes to help him do battle. In flashbacks, Oliver faces off against the Bratva in Russia.

episodes.title: The Recruits
episodes.description: Oliver recruits Curtis, Wild Dog and Evelyn Sharp for his team, but his training methods prove to be too much for some to handle. In flashbacks, Oliver continues his initiation into the Bratva.

episodes.title: A Matter of Trust
episodes.description: The Green Arrow is forced to face a powerful new drug dealer when Wild Dog goes off on his own.

episodes.title: Penance
episodes.description: Oliver and Lyla team up on a secret mission for Diggle. Felicity finds out and disapproves of the plan and opts to stay behind. When Tobias Church launches a deadly assault against the city, Felicity must decide if she wants to send the recruits out sans the Green Arrow.

episodes.title: Human Target
episodes.description: When Tobias Church captures and tortures one of Oliver's new recruits, Oliver must turn to an old friend, Christopher Chance AKA the Human Target, for help. Meanwhile, Felicity's worlds collide when Detective Malone joins the ACU.

episodes.title: So It Begins
episodes.description: Prometheus claims two more victims, and Oliver realizes that the killings are related to the people on his father's list. His recruits aren't happy to hear that Oliver used to be a serial killer. In the past, Oliver finally meets Kovar and may not live to regret it.

episodes.title: Vigilante
episodes.description: When the bodies of two criminals are dropped at SCPD, Oliver realizes there is a new Vigilante in Star City. The team is split about whether they should stop someone who is helping keep the city safe. Diggle is frustrated with his new situation and Thea fights for Lance who confesses a shocking secret. Meanwhile, in the flashbacks, Oliver finally sits down with Konstantin Kovar.

episodes.title: Invasion! (III)
episodes.description:
Oliver wakes up to a life where he never got on The Queen’s Gambit. Robert and Moira Queen are alive and well. Laurel is his loving fiancée and their wedding is imminent. Everything seems perfect, but Oliver starts to notice small imperfections that make him question this new reality. Meanwhile, Felicity and the recruits take on a new threat with help from The Flash and Supergirl.

The crossover starts on Supergirl S02E08 Medusa (I) and The Flash S03E08 Invasion! (II). It continues on DC's Legends of Tomorrow S02E07 Invasion! (IV).

episodes.title: What We Leave Behind
episodes.description: After Prometheus attacks Curtis, Oliver realizes Prometheus knows all of Team Arrow's secret identities and is planning to come for them one by one. Felicity and Detective Malone discover a clue that links Prometheus to Oliver's past.

episodes.title: Who Are You?
episodes.description: Worried that Prometheus is right and he is truly a killer at heart, Oliver looks for any ray of hope and finds it in what seems to be the miraculous return of Laurel Lance. However Felicity, still reeling from Detective Malone's murder, is bent on revenge - she wants to stop Prometheus at any cost. While in prison, Diggle fights for his life.

episodes.title: Second Chances
episodes.description: In his quest to take down Kovar, Oliver gets help from a surprising source - Talia al Ghul. However, when she reveals what she wants from him in exchange, Oliver isn't sure he can accept her help. Felicity attempts to hack the NSA to help free Diggle but when her online efforts are flagged, she faces off against an unknown adversary. Meanwhile, Curtis tells the team about a female vigilante, Tina Boland, he uncovered online who has been wreaking havoc all over the country.

episodes.title: Bratva
episodes.description: A mission takes Oliver, Felicity and team to Russia where they meet up with Oliver's old friend, Anatoly. Meanwhile, fresh out of rehab, Lance returns to the mayor's office ready to get back to work. However, when Susan asks for an interview with Lance to discuss his addiction, he balks and it's up to Rene to help keep things on track.

episodes.title: Spectre of the Gun
episodes.description: A traumatic attack on City Hall triggers painful memories for Rene about his family. Flashbacks reveal how Rene went from simple family man to a hero named Wild Dog. Meanwhile, Oliver must deal with the perpetrator behind the attack and realizes the best way to do so is as Mayor Queen instead of the Green Arrow. Tensions run high in the Arrow bunker.

episodes.title: The Sin-Eater
episodes.description: China White, Cupid and Liza Warner break out of Iron Heights and head to Star City for revenge. Oliver tries to bring in the newly formed girl gang but the ACU intervenes mid-fight. To his surprise, they are there to arrest the Green Arrow for the murder of Det. Malone. Meanwhile, Lance feels responsible for the prison break after Warner tells him she heard about him working with Damien Darhk.

episodes.title: Fighting Fire with Fire
episodes.description: Oliver faces his biggest challenge yet as mayor. Felicity continues down her dark path with Helix. After Vigilante attacks Oliver while he's acting as the mayor, Diggle leads the team in a mission to stop Vigilante once and for all.

episodes.title: Checkmate
episodes.description: Oliver gets closer to the truth about Prometheus. Meanwhile, Helix refuses to continue helping Felicity until she does a favor for them.

episodes.title: Kapiushon
episodes.description: Prometheus goes to extreme lengths to destroy Oliver. In flashbacks, Oliver's violent tendencies come to a head in a confrontation with Anatoly.

episodes.title: Disbanded
episodes.description: Diggle and Felicity are shocked by Oliver's decision to ask the Bratva for help in taking down Prometheus.

episodes.title: Dangerous Liaisons
episodes.description: Oliver, Team Arrow, ARGUS and the SCPD kick off a citywide manhunt for Adrian Chase. Helix tells Felicity they have a way to find Chase but they will need something big, and illegal, from her in return.

episodes.title: Underneath
episodes.description: Oliver and Felicity get trapped in the bunker together, while Diggle and Lyla deal with marital issues.

episodes.title: Honor Thy Fathers
episodes.description: Oliver faces the forced release of criminals prosecuted by Adrian Chase, while a crate is delivered to Oliver's office containing a corpse in concrete.

episodes.title: Missing
episodes.description: Black Siren returns to give Chase help; Felicity plans a birthday party for Oliver; Lance is angry with Rene for missing the custody hearing about his daughter.

episodes.title: Lian Yu
episodes.description: Oliver assembles a group of unlikely allies - Slade, Nyssa, Merlyn and Digger Harkness - to engage in an epic battle against Chase and his army.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description: A father recounts to his children - through a series of flashbacks - the journey he and his four best friends took leading up to him meeting their mother.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: When Ted's best friend Marshall proposes to his girlfriend, Lily, Ted realizes he'd better get a move on if he hopes to find true love. Ted soon meets Robin in a neighborhood bar, immediately becomes smitten and scores a first date. But when Ted can hardly wait to see her again, his eagerness threatens to scare her away.

episodes.title: Purple Giraffe
episodes.description: In a desperate attempt for a second date, Ted invites Robin to a party he is throwing. However, she doesn't show up and he keeps throwing parties in the hopes she will finally arrive.

episodes.title: Sweet Taste of Liberty
episodes.description: Ted agrees to let Barney spice up his love life, and ends up on a crazy adventure of flying to Philadelphia, encountering the law, and visiting the Liberty Bell.

episodes.title: Return of the Shirt
episodes.description: Ted's outlook on his continuing search for love is altered when he rediscovers a shirt that has not seen daylight in years. Meanwhile, Barney amuses himself by coaxing Robin into sacrificing her job by saying completely outlandish things on air live for a cash reward.

episodes.title: Okay Awesome
episodes.description: Ted and Barney start checking out the club scene with their friend Robin, whereas Lily and Marshall try to participate in some more "grown-up" activities, as they draw slowly nearer to their wedding.

episodes.title: The Slutty Pumpkin
episodes.description: Ted makes his yearly pilgrimage to the rooftop Halloween party in search of a girl dressed as a pumpkin who he met years ago. Meanwhile, Robin struggles her new boyfriend because of her independent ways.

episodes.title: Matchmaker
episodes.description: When a matchmaker with a 100% success rate turns Ted away because he is not compatible with any of the available women in her database, he is still determined that he is going to find his match. Meanwhile, Marshall and Lily are obsessed with ridding their apartment of a critter.

episodes.title: The Duel
episodes.description: As Lily officially moves into the apartment, Ted feels like he is being edged out of the mix by his engaged roomies. Ted and Marshall each want to keep the place, so they settle it like real "grown-ups" -- launching into a sword fight.

episodes.title: Belly Full of Turkey
episodes.description: Ted and Robin are surprised to run into Barney when they volunteer at a homeless shelter on Thanksgiving. Lily is on the brink of freaking out when she goes to Thanksgiving dinner at her future in-laws house.

episodes.title: The Pineapple Incident
episodes.description: After being forced into knocking back 5 shots so he will stop thinking, Ted goes on a partying rampage. The next morning, he wakes up with a woman -- and a pineapple. The gang tries to piece together the night and figure out who the woman is in his bed.

episodes.title: The Limo
episodes.description: Ted rents a limo to take the gang out to sample five New Year's Eve parties in a quest to find the perfect celebration.

episodes.title: The Wedding
episodes.description: Robin accepts Ted's invite to a friend's wedding, but thanks to Ted, the couple may never make it down the aisle.

episodes.title: Drumroll, Please
episodes.description: Ted finds a new woman at the wedding. They want to remember the evening so they don't exchange last names or numbers; but Ted takes a big fall when he tries to find out her name.

episodes.title: Zip, Zip, Zip
episodes.description: After agreeing to take things slowly and not have sex for a month, Ted and Victoria decide that they have waited long enough.

episodes.title: Game Night
episodes.description: A mysterious tape arrives for Barney from one of his numerous ex-girlfriends, and the entire gang watches it. But, in order for them all to find out how she broke Barney's heart and made him into a suit-wearing bachelor, everyone must share their most embarrassing moment.

episodes.title: Cupcake
episodes.description: Things are going great with Ted and Victoria's relationship, but when Victoria is offered her dream job, the couple have to make serious relationship decisions. Meanwhile Marshall and Lily set out to purchase their wedding outfits and find out that none can afford what they bought.

episodes.title: Life Among the Gorillas
episodes.description: Marshall interns at the corporation where Barney works and Lily finds that he is becoming a shallow jerk as he tries to fit in with his crude fratty coworkers. Meanwhile, Ted feels guilty when he receives several gifts from Victoria (Erika Singh) while he hasn't sent her anything.

episodes.title: Nothing Good Happens After 2 A.M.
episodes.description: Robin, who is very lonely, asks Ted to come over to her apartment after 2 A.M., but he isn't sure if he wants to go as he has a phone call on the way over with his friends, and with Victoria on his mind

episodes.title: Mary the Paralegal
episodes.description: Robin is nominated to receive an award for a news report and everyone needs a date to take to the show. Barney introduces Ted to Mary as a date that Ted can take to the show. Originally Ted is opposed to the idea of just trying to save face in front of Robin but when she shows up with a date he changes his mind. Robin asks Mary lots of questions, and Ted begins to really like Mary, despite her occupation.

episodes.title: Best Prom Ever
episodes.description: Lily, Barney and Robin attend a high school prom to scout out a potential band for Lily and Marshall's wedding reception. In order to get in Lily and Robin pretend to be the dates of two kids who were going alone. Ted and Marshall are back at the apartment where they are preparing the invitations to be sent out.

episodes.title: Milk
episodes.description: When a matchmaking company calls Ted claiming they have found his soul mate, he is forced to postpone his date when Lily asks for his help.

episodes.title: Come On
episodes.description: Ted tries to keep Robin from going on a camping trip so that she can spend time with him. Barney enlists the help of an old flame to perform a rain dance. At the same time Marshall finds out about Lily's interview for the fellowship in San Francisco.

episodes.title: Where Were We?
episodes.description: The gang tries to help Marshall get over Lily, especially when he finds a credit card bill that leads to a hotel in New York City where some of her charges are listed.

episodes.title: The Scorpion and the Toad
episodes.description: Barney works with Marshall on his bachelor skills, which include hitting on women. Lily is back from her venture. Robin helps her look for a new apartment but gets sick of hearing about San Francisco.

episodes.title: Brunch
episodes.description: Ted's parents visit New York for their anniversary and he learns a family secret. Robin worries that they won't like her. Lily and Marshall try to adjust to the new format of their relationship now that they are no longer together.

episodes.title: Ted Mosby, Architect
episodes.description: After Ted and Robin's first big fight, Barney tries to convince Ted that being an architect is an easy in to picking up chicks. Lily and Robin start following his trail after discovering that Ted hit it off with a girl named Anna shortly afterward.

episodes.title: World's Greatest Couple
episodes.description: Marshall tries to get used to being single in a world that is very coupled-oriented. Barney intended one-night-stand won't go away. Barney uses Lily to get out of his "horrifying" situation. Lily finds a place to stay.

episodes.title: Aldrin Justice
episodes.description: Barney seduces Marshall's law professor in hopes of getting her to grade more leniently. Lily takes a job at Ted's office, where she promptly steals to teach Ted's boss a lesson.

episodes.title: Swarley
episodes.description: Marshall goes on his first real date post-breakup with Lily. Not only do Ted and Barney try to warn him that this girl has got the crazy eyes, but Lily decides to do everything she can to find out about this her and break them up. Also, Barney gets a new name.

episodes.title: Atlantic City
episodes.description: Marshall and Lily drag the gang to Atlantic City to elope, and their quest to overcome the three-day wait for a marriage license crosses them with some Chinese gamblers, a ship captain, and a sexy novelty shirt.

episodes.title: Slap Bet
episodes.description: Ted and Barney discusses their viewpoints on knowing things about women. Barney thinks that the more you know the more likely you are to find a deal breaker. Ted wants to know the deal breakers right away, as Robin refuses to go to the mall to cover her secret.

episodes.title: Single Stamina
episodes.description: Barney's brother, James (Wayne Brady), visits and Robin, the only one in the group that has never met him, is suprised. But James has a surprise for Barney that he finds difficult to swallow.

episodes.title: How Lily Stole Christmas
episodes.description: Ted almost ruins Christmas for everyone when, still carrying around anger toward Lily, he calls her a horribly disgusting name. Robin tends to Barney while he has a cold.

episodes.title: First Time in New York
episodes.description: Robin wants to tell Ted that she loves him, but she can't tell him. Meanwhile, her sister visits and brings her boyfriend, and Robin doesn't know how to react when her sister says she's ready to lose her virginity.

episodes.title: Columns
episodes.description: When Ted is constantly insulted by his former boss, who is now working for him on a project, he is told to fire the man, but he finds that a hard thing to do. Meanwhile, Barney offers Lily a lot of money to paint a nude portrait of him.

episodes.title: Monday Night Football
episodes.description: When a funeral conflicts with the Super Bowl, the gang vows to avoid hearing the score and watch it together on Monday. This proves difficult, as Marshall is threatened with the score by a boy in Lily's class, while doing the news puts Robin in danger of finding out who won.

episodes.title: Lucky Penny
episodes.description: Ted can't seem to catch a flight to interview for his dream job and he and Robin contemplate why. The story unfolds backwards as they think about it they remember when Robin and Lily went hunting for a wedding dress and when Barney got stuck on the subway.

episodes.title: Stuff
episodes.description: Lily gets asked to play in an off-off-off-off-broadway play, and the gang shows up to support her. Ted and Robin get hung up on what each kept from their past relationships. Barney performs his own play to prove a point to Lily.

episodes.title: Arrivederci, Fiero
episodes.description: Marshall is all set to celebrate his beloved Fiero hitting the 200,000 mile mark but it stops. While the gang sits in the mechanic's garage and waits to hear what will happen to the vehicle they think about times gone by that they have spent together in the car. We also get the story of how Ted met Marshall.

episodes.title: Moving Day
episodes.description: Barney takes drastic measures to prevent Ted from moving into Robin's apartment. Meanwhile, Marshall and Lily are discovering the ups and downs of having the apartment to themselves.

episodes.title: Bachelor Party
episodes.description: Robin attends Lily's bridal shower and finds the gift that she brought is out of place. Barney hires a stripper for Marshall's bachelor party.

episodes.title: Showdown
episodes.description: Thinking that Bob Barker may be his father, Barney is overjoyed to be a contestant on The Price is Right. Marshall and Lily try sleeping apart prior to the wedding.

episodes.title: Something Borrowed
episodes.description: With everything going wrong on Lily and Marshall's wedding day, to everyone's surprise it's confirmed bachelor Barney who tries to fix it all.

episodes.title: Something Blue
episodes.description: It's still Marshall and Lily's big wedding day but now we're at the reception. Robin tries to tell a story but keeps getting interrupted. Barney tries his hardest to figure out Ted and Robin's secret.

episodes.title: Wait for It
episodes.description: Robin shows up with a date and this motivates Ted to 'get back out there'. We also learn something major about 'the Mother'.

episodes.title: We're Not from Here
episodes.description: Ted and Barney pretend to be visitors to New York City to pick up women. Robin is still dating Gael.

episodes.title: Third Wheel
episodes.description: Ted's new attitude attracts women in the present and one from his past. The rest of the gang pulls together to help him make the most of the situation.

episodes.title: Little Boys
episodes.description: Barney and Ted compete for a girl. Robin is dating someone new.

episodes.title: How I Met Everyone Else
episodes.description: Amid sharing stories with her about how members of the gang met each other, Ted's hot new girlfriend has a reaction to the meeting that gets her a high ranking on Barney's crazy scale.

episodes.title: I'm Not That Guy
episodes.description: Marshall has to contemplate giving up his plan of using his law degree to help the planet when he's courted by a major firm; Lily reveals a secret to Robin that not even Marshall knows; Ted discovers a porn actor is using his name

episodes.title: Dowisetrepla
episodes.description: Marshall and Lily's plan to buy an apartment is hampered by mistakes and Lily's hidden debt.

episodes.title: Spoiler Alert
episodes.description: Marshall awaits his bar exam results; Ted introduces his latest girlfriend to the gang, who all see the flaw that Ted has missed

episodes.title: Slapsgiving
episodes.description: Lily and Marshall have their first Thanksgiving as a married couple; Barney is tortured by the slap bet countdown clock, worrying about when the slap will be dished out.

episodes.title: The Yips
episodes.description: When Barney loses his way with women, he hopes a trip to the Victoria's Secret Fall Fashion Show will help him regain his form.

episodes.title: The Platinum Rule
episodes.description: Ted's upcoming date with his doctor leads the gang to give him their own examples of why dating someone you already see regularly is a bad idea.

episodes.title: No Tomorrow
episodes.description: Ted lives like there's no tomorrow during a St. Patrick's Day celebration with Barney. Lily and Marshall spend the evening at their new apartment with Robin.

episodes.title: Ten Sessions
episodes.description: Ted pursues a woman named Stella, but only gets attention from her receptionist Abby.

episodes.title: The Bracket
episodes.description: Barney's efforts to hook up with women are being thwarted by a mysterious woman from his past. Barney and the gang must sift though his many past flings in an attempt to find out who she is.

episodes.title: The Chain of Screaming
episodes.description: After Marshall witnesses a work buddy get yelled at after handing in a report, he becomes paranoid that the same will happen to him.

episodes.title: Sandcastles in the Sand
episodes.description: Robin's musical past emerges again as the group learns of someone named Simon from Robin's past. Barney searches for more Robin Sparkles memorabilia.

episodes.title: The Goat
episodes.description: Barney and Marshall have a discussion about "The Bro Code" because Barney has broken it and wants advice.

episodes.title: Rebound Bro
episodes.description: Barney gets a new wingman and Ted meets Stella's daughter.

episodes.title: Everything Must Go
episodes.description: When Barney and Abby realize that they have one thing in common - their mutual hatred of Ted - the "couple" decides to go to the bar to flaunt their new relationship in Ted's face.

episodes.title: Miracles
episodes.description: Ted is in a car accident that prompts Marshall to talk about miracles. Everyone flashbacks to prior moments in their lives.

episodes.title: Do I Know You?
episodes.description: Ted and Stella get engaged, but Ted soon learns that he doesn't know anything about her. Meanwhile, Barney confesses to Lily that he's in love with Robin.

episodes.title: The Best Burger in New York
episodes.description: Marshall claims that he had the best hamburger in the world during his first week in New York City, but he forgot where the burger joint is located. The gang then hits the streets of Manhattan to help him find it.

episodes.title: I Heart NJ
episodes.description: When Stella's babysitter cancels, a night out turns into the gang hanging out at her place, and Ted talks up New Jersey... until he learns Stella wants him to move there after marriage.

episodes.title: Intervention
episodes.description: When Ted is packing his stuff for his move to New Jersey, he discovers that the gang was going to hold an intervention for his engagement to Stella and demands they hold it anyway.

episodes.title: Shelter Island
episodes.description: Ted and Stella move up their wedding date, but the wedding may not go off as planned after Ted breaks the "No Exes Rule" and invites Robin to come in from Japan for the wedding.

episodes.title: Happily Ever After
episodes.description: A serendipitous meeting with someone from his past has Ted thinking about how he would handle running into someone he would prefer to forget.

episodes.title: Not a Father's Day
episodes.description: Barney creates a holiday to celebrate not being a father. Meanwhile, Lily and Marshall are considering having a baby, but Lily first wants advice from Ted and Robin.

episodes.title: Woooo!
episodes.description: A birthday party for one of Lily's co-workers leads to Robin connecting with a group of single partiers known as the "Woo Girls". Ted presents a plan for Goliath National Bank's new HQ.

episodes.title: The Naked Man
episodes.description: The gang learns a new way to get their dates to sleep with them after Ted walks in on Robin's date sitting naked on the couch.

episodes.title: The Fight
episodes.description: Ted (to prove he's not a milquetoast) and Barney (to impress Robin) pick a fight with a group of guys sitting in the gang's favorite booth at MacLaren's.

episodes.title: Little Minnesota
episodes.description: Ted tries to keep his irresponsible sister from hooking up with Barney during her trip to New York, and Robin starts hanging out with Marshall at a bar for Minnesotans, not telling them that she's really Canadian.

episodes.title: Benefits
episodes.description: Ted and Robin discover that sex with each other solve their fights as roommates, which makes Barney very jealous and angry. Meanwhile, Marshall reveals that he's too embarrassed to use the office bathroom.

episodes.title: Three Days of Snow
episodes.description: Lily and Marshall try to continue their airport reunion tradition. Barney and Ted offer to keep MacLaren's open during a blizzard so they can meet up with some college girls.

episodes.title: The Possimpible
episodes.description: Robin, desperate to find a job before she is deported, agrees to let Barney produce a video resume for her.

episodes.title: The Stinsons
episodes.description: The gang thinks that Barney must have a secret girlfriend after noticing his bizarre behavior.

episodes.title: Sorry, Bro
episodes.description: Marshall and Lily are less than thrilled when they hear that Ted's college girlfriend (Laura Prepon) has moved to New York.

episodes.title: The Front Porch
episodes.description: Ted learns that not only did Lily plant another woman's earring in his bed for Karen to find, she has meddled in some of his other relationships as well.

episodes.title: Old King Clancy
episodes.description: Marshall and Barney lie to keep Ted from finding out the headquarters he'd been hired to design for GNB has been cancelled.

episodes.title: Murtaugh
episodes.description: When Barney learns Ted has a list of things he thinks the gang is too old to do, he sets out to do every task within 24 hours in order to prove Ted wrong.

episodes.title: Mosbius Designs
episodes.description: Ted goes out on his own as an architect and hires an intern to help get things started, but the intern gets a little too close to others in the gang.

episodes.title: The Three Days Rule
episodes.description: Ted breaks one of Barney and Marshall's relationship rules, texting a woman he recently met, so the pair play a joke on Ted by pretending to be the woman.

episodes.title: Right Place, Right Time
episodes.description: Ted ponders how being in the right place at the right time can impact a person's life; Barney celebrates his 200th female conquest.

episodes.title: As Fast as She Can
episodes.description: Ted is trying to find a new job, and when an old acquaintance tries to help nothing goes as planned. Barney tries to smooth talk his way out of a ticket.

episodes.title: The Leap
episodes.description: Ted is trying to keep his architecture firm afloat by doing an all-nighter, but Marshall tries to lure him to the roof for a surprise 31st birthday party, on the fourth season finale.

episodes.title: Definitions
episodes.description: After sharing a kiss at the beginning of the summer, Robin and Barney are unsure how to handle their mutual attraction. After some consideration they tell the gang they have decided to remain just friends, but secretly continue seeing each other. They are able to get away with their secret romance for a couple months, but are discovered when Ted, Marshall and Lily walk in on them together. They explain to the gang that they are happy with their casual relationship, and didn't want to complicate it by defining it. This is unacceptable to Lily, who pressures them to label their situation, and ultimately locks them in Robin's room to force them to address it. Meanwhile, Ted is anxious about his first days as a professor at Columbia, which is made worse when he shows up at the wrong class and starts his lecture.

episodes.title: Double Date
episodes.description: Barney takes Marshall, and Robin to a strip club where they find a stripper who looks almost exactly like Lily. Meanwhile, Ted discovers he had been fixed up with the same woman, Jen seven years earlier.

episodes.title: Robin 101
episodes.description: When Robin fears that Barney is cheating on her, she soon discovers that he is spending his evenings with Ted learning everything there is to know on how to date her.

episodes.title: The Sexless Innkeeper
episodes.description: Marshall and Lily want to hook up with Barney and Robin for double-dating and fun, but their desperate eagerness to please is a huge turn-off. Meanwhile, when a succession of girls come to his apartment and immediately fall asleep, Ted is bummed to learn he is a "Sexless Innkeeper" whose "dates" are only interested in a comfy place to crash

episodes.title: Duel Citizenship
episodes.description: Barney tries his best hoping to convince Robin into becoming an American citizen, while Ted and Marshall's road trip takes an unexpected turn for the worst when Marshall invites Lily to come along.

episodes.title: Bagpipes
episodes.description: Even though they do their best in order to be the perfect couple, Barney's attitude of know-it-all lands him in trouble with Robin and they are forced to seek Marshall and Lily for advice.

episodes.title: The Rough Patch
episodes.description: Lily comes up with a perfect plan to break up the relationship between Barney and Robin when they have a rough patch, but she needs help from Robin's famous friend, Alan Thicke, in order to make it work.

episodes.title: The Playbook
episodes.description: After his relationship with Robin ends, Barney dusts off his "playbook" to help him back into the dating scene

episodes.title: Slapsgiving 2: Revenge of the Slap
episodes.description: Barney freaks out when Marshall bequeaths a "slap bet" slap to Ted and Robin. Meanwhile, Lily's estranged father shows up for Thanksgiving.

episodes.title: The Window
episodes.description: When a perfect girl finally shows up, the gang tries everything to help Ted, while Marshall takes action when he discovers a letter written by younger himself.

episodes.title: Last Cigarette Ever
episodes.description: When Marshall picks up smoking again, it prompts Lily, Ted and Barney, ex-smokers all, to succumb as well. Meanwhile, Robin gets a new co-anchor at her show...

episodes.title: Girls vs. Suits
episodes.description: When Barney debates giving up wearing suits in order to land a hot bartender, his conflicted feelings lead to an amazingly awesome musical number. Meanwhile, Ted gets one step closer to meeting the future mother of his kids.

episodes.title: Jenkins
episodes.description: When Lily refuses to believe that Jenkins, Marshall's attractive female colleague, kissed him, Marshall insists Jenkins tell Lily what really happened. Meanwhile, Robin finds out that a drinking game has been made up about her.

episodes.title: Perfect Week
episodes.description: When Barney is about to complete the perfect week - landing seven different girls in seven days - the gang roots him on in order to forget about their own miserable week.

episodes.title: Rabbit or Duck
episodes.description: When Lily and Marshall forget to fix up Ted on a blind date for Valentine's Day, they use one of Barney's many discarded girls to see if they may become Ted's future wife. Meanwhile, Robin's obnoxious colleague invites her to a party at his apartment

episodes.title: Hooked
episodes.description: When the gang tries to convince Ted that he is being strung along by Tiffany, they reflect about relationships where each of them has been in the same situation.

episodes.title: Of Course
episodes.description: When Robin confesses that she is still angry with Barney for the way he handled their break-up, she enlists the help of Anita, a self-help author who plans to beat Barney at his own game.

episodes.title: Say Cheese
episodes.description: When Ted ruins Lily's birthday dinner celebration by bringing a date, Lily goes to great lengths to keep her out of the traditional photo she takes every year of the gang.

episodes.title: Zoo or False
episodes.description: When Marshall gets mugged, Lily decides she wants to get a gun for protection, so Marshall comes up with a convoluted story about the mugging to deter Lily from following through.

episodes.title: Home Wreckers
episodes.description: When Ted attends his mother's wedding, he is extremely disturbed by her overly affectionate relationship with her fiancé, which forces him to think about his own life and make an impulsive decision.

episodes.title: Twin Beds
episodes.description: When Ted and Barney jeopardize Robin's new relationship by professing their love for her, Robin realizes that she is finally over them. Meanwhile, after spending a weekend sleeping in twin beds, Marshall and Lily decide to get twin beds at home.

episodes.title: Robots vs. Wrestlers
episodes.description: When Ted, Marshall, Lily and Barney crash a highfalutin party at a swanky New York apartment, Ted gets the chance to mingle with the snooty guests and show off his intellectual side.

episodes.title: The Wedding Bride
episodes.description: When Ted takes a date to see a new hit movie, "The Wedding Bride," he is shocked to learn the story is loosely based on his life, and that it was written by Tony, the man Stella left him for at the altar.

episodes.title: Doppelgangers
episodes.description: Marshall and Lily make a secret pact to start trying to have a baby if they ever finally see Barney's doppelganger. Meanwhile, Robin finally gets an offer for her dream job.

title: FROM
description: Unravel the mystery of a nightmarish town in middle America that traps all those who enter. As the unwilling residents fight to keep a sense of normalcy and search for a way out, they must also survive the threats of the surrounding forest – including the terrifying creatures that come out when the sun goes down.

episodes.title: Long Day's Journey Into Night
episodes.description: The Matthews’ family road trip takes a horrifying turn when they are detoured to a small pastoral town from which they cannot leave. When their family RV crashes, Sheriff Boyd Stevens and other residents rush to save them before the sun goes down.

episodes.title: The Way Things Are Now
episodes.description: At Colony House, Tabitha and Julie grapple with their new nightmarish reality. Out in the forest, Jim, Boyd and Kristi struggle to treat Ethan’s injuries. Tragedy strikes from an unexpected source as a new threat arises among the residents of the town.

episodes.title: Choosing Day
episodes.description: The Matthews family must choose which of the two settlements they will join. Meanwhile, Jade comes to terms with his situation and Boyd is faced with an impossible decision that strikes at the very heart of life in the town.

episodes.title: A Rock and a Farway
episodes.description: Julie finds comfort in her new friends. Jim and Tabitha deal with their struggling marriage. Ethan ventures off into the forest with Victor. Father Khatri urges Boyd to embrace his role as leader. Sara receives another horrifying directive.

episodes.title: Silhouettes
episodes.description: Jim, Tabitha and Ethan begin asking questions about where they are in the hopes it may lead them home. Ellis and Fatima show Julie the lighter side of life in town. Jade struggles to make sense of their situation. Boyd seeks guidance.

episodes.title: Book 74
episodes.description: Boyd’s plan to head off into the forest provokes an unexpected response from Kenny. Jade enlists Jim’s help with an experiment. Tabitha makes a chilling discovery that sends her down a unique path searching for answers.

episodes.title: All Good Things
episodes.description: Father Khatri tells Boyd why he believes Sara may be useful. Jim and Tabitha find comfort in each other. Colony House celebrates the one-year anniversary of Fatima’s arrival with a party that goes terribly wrong.

episodes.title: Broken Windows, Open Doors
episodes.description: In the wake of another death, Boyd questions his decision to leave. Kenny steps up and embraces his new role. Jim rallies the town around his idea to build a radio tower. Fatima urges Ellis to make amends with his father before it’s too late.

episodes.title: Into the Woods
episodes.description: Boyd and Sara journey deeper into the forest than Boyd has ever gone, encountering new and terrifying mysteries. Jim’s confidence in the radio tower begins to wane. An unexpected tragedy causes Donna to unravel. Kenny and Kristi share a moment.

episodes.title: Oh, the Places We'll Go
episodes.description: Boyd draws strength from an unlikely source. Jim’s radio tower yields consequences which rock him to his very core. The hole that Tabitha has been digging leads her somewhere, and to someone, she could never have expected.

episodes.title: Strangers in a Strange Land
episodes.description: In Sheriff Boyd’s absence, Donna and Kenny struggle to manage the chaos as a busload of unwitting newcomers arrives in town. Victor and Tabitha go on a chilling journey through the nightmarish labyrinth of tunnels beneath the town.

episodes.title: The Kindness of Strangers
episodes.description: A tense night in the diner as the residents and newcomers wait for sunrise. Fear permeates the wreckage beneath the Matthews house, as Jim and Tom struggle to keep a panicked bus passenger quiet.

episodes.title: Tether
episodes.description: Kenny and Ellis make a grisly discovery out in the forest. Boyd struggles with the reality of what’s happening to him.

episodes.title: This Way Gone
episodes.description: As Boyd’s condition grows more alarming, Sara’s return to town puts him in a difficult position. Jim shares a troubling new theory about the town.

episodes.title: Lullaby
episodes.description: Sara must face the music, as word of her return spreads through town. Victor and Jade strike an unlikely bargain.

episodes.title: Pas de Deux
episodes.description: Tensions run high at Colony House when word of the coming food shortage leaks out. A night at the clinic takes a terrifying turn.

episodes.title: Belly of the Beast
episodes.description: Boyd and Kristi seek to capitalize on the apparent death of the Nightmare Creature. Jim finds an unlikely ally in the volatile Randall.

episodes.title: Forest for the Trees
episodes.description: In their pursuit of the truth about the town, Jim and Randall hatch a dangerous plan. Meanwhile, a new form of terror is brewing.

episodes.title: Ball of Magic Fire
episodes.description: Panic spreads through town as the residents face a chilling new threat to their survival. Jim realizes the magnitude of the mistake he made by enlisting Randall in his cause.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Time...
episodes.description: Boyd fears he may have finally run out of answers, as the residents of town prepare for the end. Tabitha clings to the belief that the children could be the key to their salvation.

episodes.title: Shatter
episodes.description: Boyd feels the town slipping away from him as the weather grows colder and the residents more desperate.

episodes.title: When We Go
episodes.description: Boyd struggles to find a path forward as the town bids farewell to one of their own; Fatima's health takes a turn for the worse; Tabitha finds help from an unlikely ally.

episodes.title: Mouse Trap
episodes.description: Kenny leads a group into the forest in search of food; Donna and Ellis try to talk Boyd out of a dangerous plan; Tabitha makes a mind-bending discovery; Fatima questions the welfare of her unborn baby.

episodes.title: There and Back Again
episodes.description: Boyd is forced to make a tough decision when newcomers arrive in town at nightfall; Victor unearths memories from the past in the hopes of finding answers.

episodes.title: The Light of Day
episodes.description: Victor must face a painful reminder of his past; Julie looks for ways to cope with her trauma; Boyd struggles to keep the town safe as the residents begin to question his judgement; Tabitha tries to adjust to her new surroundings.

episodes.title: Scar Tissue
episodes.description: Fatima and Ellis make a big decision about her pregnancy; Boyd fears for the future of his family; Tensions rise in the Matthews house; Randall opens up to Marielle about his fears.

episodes.title: These Fragile Lives
episodes.description: The edges begin to fray as concerns about Fatima's pregnancy deepen; Jade follows a clue trail into the forest; Julie and Randall seek a bit of normalcy.

episodes.title: Thresholds
episodes.description: Accusations start flying and truths come to light in the aftermath of a tragedy; Victor struggles to recover long-buried memories about the town's past; Julie and Ethan search for answers about the mysterious ruins in the woods.

episodes.title: Revelations: Chapter One
episodes.description: Tensions are at an all time high as the residents of town learn that one of their own has gone missing.

episodes.title: Revelations: Chapter Two
episodes.description: Boyd is pushed to his limit as time begins to run out for someone he loves; Randall is haunted by his trauma and Victor reveals a hard truth; Tabitha's unlikely journey takes a shocking turn.

episodes.title: The Arrival
episodes.description: A new arrival throws the town into chaos. Jade and Tabitha struggle with their revelation at the Bottle Tree. Boyd grapples with the implications of Smiley’s return.

episodes.title: Fray
episodes.description: A gruesome discovery sends shockwaves through the town as Jade and Tabitha struggle with the weight of their revelation.

episodes.title: Merrily We Go
episodes.description: Boyd tries to save Acosta from herself as Julie digs deeper into her newfound abilities; Tabitha embarks on a desperate gamble and Victor joins Ethan in a quest for answers.

episodes.title: Of Myths and Monsters
episodes.description: An ominous discovery puts Boyd and his trusted circle on high alert; Julie searches for a way to harness her newfound abilities and Sara is once again tortured by the voices in her head.

episodes.title: What a Long Strange Trip It's Been
episodes.description: Boyd and Jade set off on a desperate, mind-bending search for answers, while a food run to the settlement takes a chilling turn.

episodes.title: The Heart Is a Lonely Hunter
episodes.description: Boyd and Jade find themselves at odds over whether or not they can trust the knowledge in Jade's head; deeply troubling news from the settlement makes its way back to town.

episodes.title: Best Laid Plans
episodes.description: As Tabitha and Jade’s troubling history is brought to light, things begin to unravel for another resident in town. Boyd wants to test a dangerous theory.

episodes.title: Heavy Is the Head
episodes.description: A dangerous plan begins to take shape. How much is Boyd willing to risk for the chance to get everyone home?  Fatima and Henry find themselves at two very different and disturbing crossroads.  Victor helps Tabitha and Ethan prepare for the worst.

episodes.title: The Calm Before
episodes.description: The residents of town stand at a crossroads unlike any they’ve faced before as Boyd sets a daring, and dangerous, plan in motion.

episodes.title: If a Tree Falls in the Forest…
episodes.description: Boyd’s quest to lead the residents home reaches a terrifying crossroads, and nothing will ever be the same again.

title: Homeland
description: CIA officer Carrie Mathison is tops in her field despite being bipolar, which makes her volatile and unpredictable. With the help of her long-time mentor Saul Berenson, Carrie fearlessly risks everything, including her personal well-being and even sanity, at every turn.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: After missing and presumed dead for eight years, Marine Sergeant Nicholas Brody is rescued in Iraq, and returns home to his family. But CIA agent Carrie Mathison suspects he might have been turned by his terrorist captors, and believes he could be part of a plan to attack America.

episodes.title: Grace
episodes.description: Carrie receives new evidence from an undercover agent and stays glued to the surveillance footage of Brody's home, which reveals a man struggling with his traumatic memories.

episodes.title: Clean Skin
episodes.description: Brody prepares to enter the spotlight; Carrie closes in on an al-Qaeda plot.

episodes.title: Semper I
episodes.description: The political powers that be make big plans for national hero Brody, but his increasingly erratic behavior threatens his media darling status; Carrie grows desperate for evidence linking Brody with Abu Nazir, as Saul directs her to focus on Nazir's money trail.

episodes.title: Blind Spot
episodes.description: Brody confronts the lone survivor among the insurgents that held him, leading Carrie to believe she may be proved right about Brody once and for all - but Brody's reunion with his captor surprises everyone; the agency is hot on the trail of the lovers who bought a house near the airport with funds from a stolen necklace.

episodes.title: The Good Soldier
episodes.description: Reeling after losing key players in Nazir's plot against America, the CIA orders polygraphs on everyone who came in contact with them, including Brody, which Carrie sees as an opportunity to finally learn the truth.

episodes.title: The Weekend
episodes.description: The relationship between Carrie and Brody becomes more complicated when they head into the countryside for the weekend, while Mike and Jessica face the fallout of the truth about their relationship, and Saul catches Aileen on the run to Mexico.

episodes.title: Achilles Heel
episodes.description: As Carrie and Saul reel from the news that Walker is alive, the intelligence community clashes on the best way to capture him; Brody learns a shocking truth about his captivity.

episodes.title: Crossfire
episodes.description: After his attempt to sever ties with Abu Nazir, Brody finds himself reliving his captivity and recommits to his mission; Carrie finds herself in the middle of a public relations nightmare on the heels of the mosque shooting.

episodes.title: Representative Brody
episodes.description: Carrie and Saul identify Walker's contact in Washington but their target has diplomatic immunity; Brody is approached to run for a disgraced congressman's seat in the House of Representatives.

episodes.title: The Vest
episodes.description: In the wake of the explosion, Saul finds Carrie hospitalized and manic, but realizes her chaotic theories have merit; before his congressional campaign begins, Brody takes his family on a weekend trip to Gettysburg, where he retrieves an important item.

episodes.title: Marine One
episodes.description: While Carrie is near catatonic and confined to bed, Saul investigates the unsettling implications of her timeline; Walker secures a perch for his mission; Brody makes his final preparations for the Vice President's policy summit at the State Department.

episodes.title: The Smile
episodes.description: Brody has been elected to Congress. A woman named Roya comes to see him, and asks him to steal a list of homeland targets from Estes's office safe. Carrie is working with the CIA again because Fatima, an informant married to a man working for Abu Nazir, tells Saul that she'll only speak to Carrie. Estes goes to pick up Carrie at her sister's house, and then she's sent to Cyprus, where she's prepped for a brief mission in Lebanon.

episodes.title: Beirut is Back
episodes.description: Fatima tells Carrie about a meeting her husband - a Hezbollah commander - will be having in Beirut with Abu Nazir, and Carrie and Saul call Estes to tell him and to request a special forces team to capture Nazir.

episodes.title: State of Independence
episodes.description: Colonel Lubaid, who briefly detains Saul at the Rafic Hariri airport in Beirut as Saul is leaving Lebanon

episodes.title: New Car Smell
episodes.description: Brody takes his car to be professionally cleaned and to have a strong smoke smell removed. Max and Virgil follow Brody and take photos of him. Brody then takes a cab to CIA Headquarters, where Carrie waits inside for his arrival. As he walks towards the building from the parking lot, she exits and walks past him. He is very surprised to see her and calls her name. She turns and greets him casually.

episodes.title: Q&A
episodes.description: Brody finds himself prisoner again, but this time it's on American soil. Meanwhile, Carrie is forced to play second fiddle after her rash judgment call at the hotel as Estes is busy keeping Jessica off their trail. Dana's relationship with Finn goes to the next level when their date night turns deadly serious.

episodes.title: A Gettysburg Address
episodes.description: Dana is shocked by her visit to the hospital. Faber's Tom Walker questions get him tangled up with the CIA. Brody agrees to help stop an attack on America, but his loyalty is questioned when Gettysburg once again becomes a battleground.

episodes.title: The Clearing
episodes.description: Reeling from the recent ambush, Carrie and the team struggle to regain control of their operation while Brody and his family attend a fundraiser at a Virginia horse farm. Saul visits Aileen in solitary confinement, hoping she'll provide key intelligence on the attack. An anguished Dana pressures Finn to come clean about their hidden crime, but her quest to tell the truth collides with her father's secret mission in ways neither could have foreseen.

episodes.title: I'll Fly Away
episodes.description: He lies for Carrie. He lies for Roya. And he's still lying to Jessica. Brody heads towards a serious meltdown as he struggles to keep his complicated alliances clear. Against Quinn's orders, Carrie stages a risky intervention to keep Brody in line, forcing both of them to confront their mixed emotions. Meanwhile, Dana turns to an unlikely source for comfort.

episodes.title: Two Hats
episodes.description: Brody makes a necessary phone call. Saul teams up with Virgil and Max to dig up some information on one of their own. Carrie finds herself preparing for the most important meeting of her career.

episodes.title: Broken Hearts
episodes.description: Saul catches up with an old friend and discovers evidence of covert activities by Estes. Brody and Vice President Walden find themselves at odds over the future of their political relationship, while Dana and Finn come to terms with their own differences.

episodes.title: In Memoriam
episodes.description: Dangerously close to exhaustion, Carrie continues her hunt for Nazir and begins to suspect there is a mole in the CIA. Roya reveals her true colours under interrogation and Saul finds himself fighting to save his career under unexpected circumstances. Meanwhile, the Brodys struggle to maintain anything close to a state of sanity.

episodes.title: The Choice
episodes.description: Carrie is faced with a pivotal decision, while Brody meets with Faber to contemplate the future of the family. Meanwhile, Saul undertakes a secret assignment; and Quinn has a decision to make that may prove to be a game-changer.

episodes.title: Tin Man is Down
episodes.description: Alleged Langley bomber Nick Brody remains at large. Saul plots a risky counterstrike on the terrorists connected to the bombing. Carrie becomes the focus of a hostile Senate investigation. Humiliated and abandoned by the Marine Corps, the Brody family struggles to cope with Dana's destructive behavior.

episodes.title: Uh... Oh... Ah...
episodes.description: Saul attempts to track down those responsible for the Langley attack and recruits an unlikely expert to follow the money trail. Meanwhile, Quinn takes matters into his own hands; Carrie learns who is really on her side; and the Brody family turn to therapy to mend their broken household.

episodes.title: Tower of David
episodes.description: As Brody finds himself in increasingly desperate straits, he returns to his faith for guidance in an unexpected way. Carrie struggles to connect with Saul when a mysterious man offers to help her, but at a great cost.

episodes.title: Game On
episodes.description: Carrie learns that even in its crippled state, the CIA can still exercise power when needed. Dana Brody goes AWOL, forcing Jessica to go to the police. Saul and Fara follow the money trail to an unexpected location, and Carrie has breakfast with a new client.

episodes.title: The Yoga Play
episodes.description: Carrie puts her mission on the line to do a risky favor. Saul is forced to rub elbows with his adversary, Senator Lockhart, on a hunting trip. Still on the run, Dana makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Still Positive
episodes.description: Carrie turns the tables on the mastermind of the Langley bombing, but recruiting one of Iran's most powerful operatives has dangerous consequences. Meanwhile, Saul struggles to keep an intrusive Senator Lockhart at bay, and Dana makes a radical decision that will change the Brody family forever.

episodes.title: Gerontion
episodes.description: With an old adversary in custody, Saul makes the gamble of his career. Carrie and Quinn scramble to contain a local police investigation, while Mira finds her marriage at a crossroads.

episodes.title: A Red Wheelbarrow
episodes.description: After new information comes to light, Carrie and Quinn pursue a key suspect in the Langley bombing. Saul deals with political backlash while Fara discovers the toll an intelligence job can take. Meanwhile, the Brody family gets startling news.

episodes.title: One Last Thing
episodes.description: Carrie reunites with Brody, but the circumstances are more difficult than either of them could have imagined. Meanwhile, Saul gets a win from an unlikely source, and Dana grapples with her new life away from home.

episodes.title: Good Night
episodes.description: Brody embarks on a high stakes mission, but his fragile condition threatens the entire operation. Quinn makes an uncomfortable discovery about Carrie, while a sudden crisis forces Fara to rejoin the team.

episodes.title: Big Man in Tehran
episodes.description: Brody's loyalty to the mission wavers when he meets a ghost from his past. As Lockhart's confirmation looms, Saul stares into the precipice between success and failure.

episodes.title: The Star
episodes.description: Security forces close in on Carrie and Brody. As Saul plans a last ditch rescue operation, Brody struggles to find redemption.

episodes.title: The Drone Queen
episodes.description: As CIA Chief of Station in Kabul, Carrie makes a critical decision when her counterpart in Islamabad delivers urgent intelligence on a high value target. Saul struggles to adjust to his new role in the private sector.

episodes.title: Trylon and Perisphere
episodes.description: An official inquiry brings Carrie back to the States, where she struggles with her ambivalence towards motherhood. Quinn spirals out of control, while a disgraced former case officer reveals disturbing new information.

episodes.title: Shalwar Kameez
episodes.description: Carrie is forced to intervene when Fara fails to recruit a key asset. Still reeling over events in Islamabad, Quinn zeroes in on a potential lead.

episodes.title: Iron in the Fire
episodes.description: Carrie gets a tip from Redmond regarding Quinn's lead. Saul calls in a favor from an old friend in the Pakistani military. Fara uncovers a conspiracy.

episodes.title: About a Boy
episodes.description: Carrie tries to earn the trust of a frightened asset. Saul catches a break when he spots a familiar face. Quinn and Fara stake out a new suspect.

episodes.title: From A to B and Back Again
episodes.description: While Quinn takes an objective approach, Carrie puts her operation in motion and her life on the line to prevent a terrorist strike.

episodes.title: Redux
episodes.description: Lockhart comes to negotiate. Haqqani uses Saul as his shield. Carrie's investigation gets complicated, especially when someone tampers with her pills.

episodes.title: Halfway to a Donut
episodes.description: Carrie and Quinn organize a last-ditch operation. Saul extracts a painful promise from Carrie. Lockhart and Martha stall the ISI.

episodes.title: There's Something Else Going On
episodes.description: A trade with the Taliban for Saul's life angers Lockhart, forcing Carrie to improvise to salvage her mission. The CIA closes in on a security leak.

episodes.title: 13 Hours in Islamabad
episodes.description: The security breach has far-reaching consequences as Carrie and Saul get caught in an attack on their convoy and Haqqani's men infiltrate the embassy.

episodes.title: Krieg Nicht Lieb
episodes.description: When the embassy is evacuated and Quinn resists leaving Islamabad, Carrie puts her life on the line to get her whole team out of Pakistan.

episodes.title: Long Time Coming
episodes.description: Carrie and Saul investigate what she saw in Islamabad; Carrie tries to cope with the return of her estranged mother as her father is laid to rest.

episodes.title: Separation Anxiety
episodes.description: Almost two years after the Embassy attack in Islamabad, Carrie is building a new life in Berlin. But her peace is threatened when a request from her boss forces her towards the dangerous world she left behind.

episodes.title: The Tradition of Hospitality
episodes.description: Carrie goes with Otto as part of his security team to a Beirut refugee camp, where she makes a disturbing discovery. Quinn gets a shocking message.

episodes.title: Super Powers
episodes.description: Carrie resorts to desperate measures to figure out who is targeting her. The hackers negotiate the transfer of the rest of the documents.

episodes.title: Why Is This Night Different?
episodes.description: Quinn forces Carrie to take a necessary but painful next step. Numan learns of his partner's plan. Saul and Allison offer a deal difficult to refuse.

episodes.title: Better Call Saul
episodes.description: The hacktivists rise up. Quinn covers for Carrie. Dar and Allison assess the damage.

episodes.title: Parabiosis
episodes.description: Realizing there's a mole and he's being surveilled, Saul orders a sweep of the Berlin CIA building. A good Samaritan brings Quinn into mixed company.

episodes.title: Oriole
episodes.description: When Allison tries to get Saul to talk, she learns some disturbing news. The documents lead Carrie to an asset in Amsterdam. Quinn gets a new mission.

episodes.title: All About Allison
episodes.description: Carrie arranges a secret meeting with Allison. Flashbacks reveal the events that led to Allison's current duplicity and their connection to Carrie.

episodes.title: The Litvinov Ruse
episodes.description: The BND uses a ruse and Saul's intimate relationship with Allison to prompt her to lead them to her handler. Quinn learns his captors' true intent.

episodes.title: New Normal
episodes.description: Carrie spots a clue in the video of Quinn that could help pinpoint his whereabouts. With the release of the footage, a new threat emerges.

episodes.title: Our Man in Damascus
episodes.description: Carrie follows a clue found on Quinn. Saul tries a new tactic to get Faisal to reveal info on the impending terror plot. Allison gets secret orders.

episodes.title: A False Glimmer
episodes.description: Carrie begs a conflicted Qasim for help. Saul presses hard on Ivan in order to find Allison. Carrie reunites with Jonas and later gets two offers.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
originalTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
description: Beginning in a time of relative peace, we follow an ensemble cast of characters as they confront the re-emergence of evil to Middle-earth. From the darkest depths of the Misty Mountains, to the majestic forests of Lindon, to the breathtaking island kingdom of Númenor, to the furthest reaches of the map, these kingdoms and characters will carve out legacies that live on long after they are gone.

episodes.title: A Shadow of the Past
episodes.description: Galadriel is disturbed by signs of an ancient evil’s return; Arondir makes an unsettling discovery; Elrond is presented with an intriguing new venture; Nori breaks the Harfoot community’s most deeply-held rule.

episodes.title: Adrift
episodes.description: Galadriel finds a new ally; Elrond faces a cold reception from an old friend; Nori endeavors to help a Stranger; Arondir searches for answers while Bronwyn warns her people of a threat.

episodes.title: Adar
episodes.description: Arondir finds himself a captive. Galadriel and Halbrand explore a legendary kingdom. Elendil is given a new assignment. Nori faces the consequences.

episodes.title: The Great Wave
episodes.description: Queen Regent Míriel’s faith is tested. Isildur finds himself at a crossroads. Elrond uncovers a secret. Arondir is given an ultimatum. Theo disobeys Bronwyn.

episodes.title: Partings
episodes.description: Nori questions her instincts. Elrond struggles to stay true to his oath. Halbrand weighs his destiny. The Southlanders brace for attack.

episodes.title: Udûn
episodes.description: Adar and his army march on Ostirith.

episodes.title: The Eye
episodes.description: Survivors of a cataclysm try to find safety. The Harfoots confront evil. Durin is torn between friendship and duty. Adar considers a new name.

episodes.title: Alloyed
episodes.description: New alliances are forged.

episodes.title: Elven Kings Under the Sky
episodes.description: Sauron bargains with Adar. The Stranger and Nori venture into new lands. The Three Elven Rings face judgment.

episodes.title: Where the Stars Are Strange
episodes.description: Darkness falls over Khazad-dûm. Sauron and Galadriel each seek new allies. The Stranger and Harfoots encounter a growing threat.

episodes.title: The Eagle and the Sceptre
episodes.description: Isildur and an old friend reunite. Arondir grapples with change. Míriel faces rising opposition. Annatar counsels Celebrimbor.

episodes.title: Eldest
episodes.description: The Stranger finds what he's been searching for. Arondir and Isildur search for Theo. Galadriel and Elrond walk into a trap.

episodes.title: Halls of Stone
episodes.description: When Durin grows suspicious of the Dwarven Rings, Celebrimbor must reassess his priorities. Amidst Númenor's shifting currents, Elendil searches for hope.

episodes.title: Where Is He?
episodes.description: Galadriel considers a proposition. Elendil faces judgment. The Stranger finds himself at a crossroads. Sauron's plans bear fruit.

episodes.title: Doomed to Die
episodes.description: Eregion's fate is decided.

episodes.title: Shadow and Flame
episodes.description: The free peoples of Middle-earth struggle against the forces of darkness.

title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
description: A single-camera ensemble comedy following the lives of an eclectic group of detectives in a New York precinct, including one slacker who is forced to shape up when he gets a new boss.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: When tightly wound Capt. Holt takes over the precinct, carefree Det. Jake Peralta and his dysfunctional coworkers' lives get demanding.

episodes.title: The Tagger
episodes.description: Jake is assigned a lowly graffiti case as punishment for being late to roll call.

episodes.title: The Slump
episodes.description: Jake's unsolved cases pile up and the other detectives fear that his losing streak will rub off on them, while Amy must run an at-risk youth program.

episodes.title: M.E. Time
episodes.description: The team turns on Jake for delaying an autopsy report by flirting with an attractive medical examiner, who turns out to be more than he bargained for.

episodes.title: The Vulture
episodes.description: A Major Crimes detective known as "The Vulture" takes over Jake's nearly solved case and steals his thunder, prompting revenge.

episodes.title: Halloween
episodes.description: Halloween-hating Amy is anything but festive when she has to don a costume and hit the streets with Charles on busy Halloween night.

episodes.title: 48 Hours
episodes.description: After making an arrest with too little proof, Jake has 48 hours to get evidence or the perp will go free, forcing the team to work over the weekend.

episodes.title: Old School
episodes.description: Jake's dream day with his hero, a former crime reporter, turns nightmarish when his comments about Holt and the precinct go "on the record."

episodes.title: Sal's Pizza
episodes.description: When Jake's favorite pizzeria is burned down and the fire marshal suspects the owner, Jake steps outside his jurisdiction to catch the real arsonist.

episodes.title: Thanksgiving
episodes.description: Amy hosts Thanksgiving dinner for the precinct in an effort to get Holt to be her mentor, but Holt and Jake leave early and the rest hate her cooking.

episodes.title: Christmas
episodes.description: When Capt. Holt receives death threats, Jake is placed on his protective detail and revels in the chance to boss his boss around.

episodes.title: Pontiac Bandit
episodes.description: Jake and Rosa hunt an infamous car thief, Holt tries to find a home for puppies and the rest of the precinct tries to accommodate a wounded Charles.

episodes.title: The Bet
episodes.description: After Jake and Amy's bet about who can make more arrests is finally settled, the two go on a stakeout where Jake reevaluates their relationship.

episodes.title: The Ebony Falcon
episodes.description: On his first task back in the field, Terry takes advice from Jake on controlling his emotions to infiltrate and bust a steroid trafficking ring.

episodes.title: Operation: Broken Feather
episodes.description: While investigating a string of hotel robberies together, Jake discovers that Amy may transfer to the Major Crimes unit and work with "The Vulture."

episodes.title: The Party
episodes.description: At Capt. Holt's birthday party, Jake, Amy and the other officers try to make a good impression on Holt's husband but fail miserably.

episodes.title: Full Boyle
episodes.description: To stop Detective Boyle from getting too clingy, or "Full Boyle," with his new girlfriend, Jake goes on their date, but things don't go as planned.

episodes.title: The Apartment
episodes.description: When Jake's building goes co-op and he must pay nearly a half million dollars to keep his apartment, he desperately seeks Gina's help.

episodes.title: Tactical Village
episodes.description: At Tactical Village, where the precinct competes against other precincts in paintball exercises, Jake gets jealous when Amy runs into an old flame.

episodes.title: Fancy Brudgom
episodes.description: When Charles makes Jake his best man, it means cake tasting, choosing flowers and convincing fiancée Vivian that Charles doesn't want to move.

episodes.title: Unsolvable
episodes.description: On a solving streak, Jake decides to spend his weekend off with Sgt. Terry trying to crack a cold case that no one thinks can be solved.

episodes.title: Charges and Specs
episodes.description: Jake risks suspension when the commissioner shuts down his investigation of a civic leader and he gets Amy and Holt to help him work the case anyway.

episodes.title: Undercover
episodes.description: When Jake discovers that a mobster escaped his otherwise successful sting, he enlists Charles to help track him down, which worries Gina.

episodes.title: Chocolate Milk
episodes.description: Holt's nemesis heads the precinct inspection, while Terry readies for his vasectomy and Charles needs a date for his ex-wife's engagement party.

episodes.title: The Jimmy Jab Games
episodes.description: When a motorcade detail is delayed, it leads to a wacky competition, and Charles must get an incriminating videotape from Hitchcock.

episodes.title: Halloween II
episodes.description: For their annual Halloween wager, Jake bets Holt that he can steal his watch before midnight, and Gina gets kicked off her dance squad, Floorgasm.

episodes.title: The Mole
episodes.description: Holt and Jake search for a mole in the precinct, and Terry and Rosa visit a silent disco to find "Giggle Pig" dealers.

episodes.title: Jake and Sophia
episodes.description: Jake is attracted to a woman he soon discovers is the attorney for a perp he's after, and Rosa gets Amy to run for union rep to replace Scully.

episodes.title: Lockdown
episodes.description: When the precinct goes into lockdown on Thanksgiving night, it's up to Jake to keep morale high, even as things spiral out of control.

episodes.title: USPIS
episodes.description: To catch a drug dealer, Jake and Charles must team up with an incompetent Postal Service investigator. Meanwhile, the team helps Amy quit smoking.

episodes.title: The Road Trip
episodes.description: When Jake and Amy have to stay overnight at a hotel for a case, Jake invites Sophia and Amy's boyfriend Teddy over, but the move backfires.

episodes.title: The Pontiac Bandit Returns
episodes.description: Jake and Rosa catch the Pontiac Bandit, who could lead them to the Giggle Pig kingpin. Charles and Gina worry about their parents getting close.

episodes.title: Stakeout
episodes.description: Jake and Charles go on a stakeout that lasts way too long, and Terry writes a book for his daughters that angers Amy and Gina.

episodes.title: Beach House
episodes.description: Jake ruins the precinct's annual beach house getaway when he's pressured into bringing Captain Holt. Gina wants to see "six-drink Amy."

episodes.title: Payback
episodes.description: Jake has to go to great lengths to keep a secret about Terry from the rest of the precinct, and Amy finally gets to partner up with Captain Holt.

episodes.title: The Defense Rests
episodes.description: When his relationship with Sophia gets in the way of her work, Jake tries to help, Wuntch needs Holt's help, and Charles wants Gina's blessing.

episodes.title: Windbreaker City
episodes.description: The Nine-Nine is invited to a terrorist training drill with Homeland Security, but the precinct's role as hostages doesn't go over so well.

episodes.title: The Wednesday Incident
episodes.description: Jake is determined to prove that he's not to blame for Holt's bad mood, and when Charles catches a notorious bank robber, nobody believes him.

episodes.title: Boyle-Linetti Wedding
