episodes.description: The Yellowstone enjoys an almost-perfect day branding cattle, Montana gets an unexpected visitor, Sarah sinks her teeth into Jamie, and Thomas Rainwater deals with a challenger from within.

episodes.title: The Dream Is Not Me
episodes.description: John deals with a herd problem, Senator Perry delivers news to Thomas Rainwater, Jamie and Sarah plan their next move, and Beth discusses a new business plan with the ranch in mind.

episodes.title: A Knife and No Coin
episodes.description: Jamie goes through with his plan, John lends support to an unexpected friend, the Yellowstone cowboys embark on a journey, and a flashback reveals the source of Rip's loyalty.

episodes.title: Desire Is All You Need
episodes.description: After an event rattles the state of Montana, nothing will ever be the same.

episodes.title: The Apocalypse of Change
episodes.description: Beth comes to a chilling realization. Kayce reaches out to an old friend in search of information. Jamie meets with Market Equities.

episodes.title: Three Fifty-Three
episodes.description: Beth discusses the fate of the ranch with an unlikely ally. Kayce takes the investigation into his own hands. Jamie looks to advance his political agenda.

episodes.title: Counting Coup
episodes.description: Kayce makes a bold move. Rip asks for help from a friend in Texas, while the bunkhouse contemplates their future. Jamie attempts to cover his tracks.

episodes.title: Give the World Away
episodes.description: Jamie begins to spiral, and later seeks advice. Beth and Travis make a deal. Kayce has an idea about the future of the ranch.

episodes.title: Life Is a Promise
episodes.description: As the Duttons and the Yellowstone cowboys lay John to rest, the fate of the ranch is revealed.

title: Vikings
description: The adventures of Ragnar Lothbrok, the greatest hero of his age. The series tells the sagas of Ragnar's band of Viking brothers and his family, as he rises to become King of the Viking tribes. As well as being a fearless warrior, Ragnar embodies the Norse traditions of devotion to the gods. Legend has it that he was a direct descendant of Odin, the god of war and warriors.

episodes.title: Rites of Passage
episodes.description: Farmer, family man and rebel Ragnar Lothbrok is determined to sail west to discover new lands and riches despite an intimidating warning from his village's tyrannical leader, Lord Haraldson, who makes it clear in no uncertain terms that doing so could result in severe consequences.

episodes.title: Wrath of the Northmen
episodes.description: The journey west begins as Ragnar gathers a crew willing to risk their lives to travel into the unknown. Earl Haraldson's paranoia reaches new heights as his fear of Ragnar's success grows.

episodes.title: Dispossessed
episodes.description: Ragnar and his crew return from their trip with treasure, and Earl Haraldson has no choice but to sanction another raid. The west is open for the taking, and the Vikings' world will never be the same.

episodes.title: Trial
episodes.description: Ragnar and his crew sail out with Earl Haraldson's permission.

episodes.title: Raid
episodes.description: A seer reads Earl Haraldson's future and tells him that Ragnar searches for his death.

episodes.title: Burial of the Dead
episodes.description: Ragnar, weak and still hurt, must meet the Earl head-on after it comes to light that Rollo has been tortured on Haraldson’s orders. The two men will come together face to face with a single outcome possible: Only one man will leave this fight alive.

episodes.title: A King's Ransom
episodes.description: Three Viking ships sail toward the Royal Villa of King Aelle in eastern England. Ragnar wants ransom in exchange for peace, but the king has a very different plan in mind.

episodes.title: Sacrifice
episodes.description: The traditional pilgrimage to Uppsala to thank the gods brings a torrent of emotions for Ragnar, Lagertha, and Athelstan. Ragnar, pulling farther away from his wife goes to make peace with the death of his unborn son. Lagertha, still reeling from her miscarriage, wants to find out from the gods if more sons are in her future. As the Vikings come together to sacrifice and give thanks to their gods, Athelstan discovers just how strong his Christian faith still is.

episodes.title: All Change
episodes.description: Ragnar travels to Götaland to help King Horik resolve a land dispute with the area's leader, Jarl Borg. Meanwhile, sickness infects the village of Kattegat, and the people look to Lagertha to help them appease the gods.

episodes.title: Brother's War
episodes.description: The battle begins between Ragnar and King Horik's forces against Jarl Borg; Princess Aslaug makes her way to Kattegat.

episodes.title: Invasion
episodes.description: The time has come for an unlikely alliance to band together for a new raid on England; a storm pushes the Viking fleet to a new destination; Ragnar and his men may have met their match.

episodes.title: Treachery
episodes.description: King Ecbert finds himself facing an entirely new kind of foe; Ragnar races to dominate in the west; Jarl Borg has his own plans in store for the future of Kattegat.

episodes.title: Eye for an Eye
episodes.description: Ragnar and Ecbert come face to face; Jarl Borg rules Kattegat with an iron fist; Rollo must now become the leader his people need in Ragnar's absence.

episodes.title: Answers in Blood
episodes.description: Lagertha and Ragnar unite to try to win Kattegat back from Jarl Borg; Aslaug must face the truth of her prophecies; Athelstan struggles to define his faith; Bjorn must once again make a choice.

episodes.title: Unforgiven
episodes.description: King Horik returns to Kattegat with a surprising proposition for Ragnar; Lagertha runs into a less than enthusiastic homecoming from her new husband; Athelstan becomes confidant to King Ecbert.

episodes.title: Blood Eagle
episodes.description: Ragnar and King Horik clash over how to dispense justice to Jarl Borg. In Wessex, King Aelle arrives and Ecbert has an eye on a new alliance.

episodes.title: Boneless
episodes.description: Princess Aslaug's latest prophecy comes to fruition as she readies to give birth once more. Ragnar, Horik and their new ally Lagertha set sail for Wessex - Ragnar and Horik have very different ideas about the true purpose of this trip.

episodes.title: The Choice
episodes.description: Ragnar's warriors march on to King Ecbert's villa and are met with a surprisingly vicious welcome party.

episodes.title: The Lord's Prayer
episodes.description: Ragnar and King Horik return to Kattegat; Ragnar places his trust in those who have stood by him.

episodes.title: Mercenary
episodes.description: Ragnar and Lagertha's fleets depart Kattegat once more for Wessex and this time they bring a group to colonize there. King Ecbert hosts the Norsemen and proposes a deal. Despite the misgivings of some of the other leaders, Ragnar leads his forces into battle once more, but this time as allies of Wessex.

episodes.title: The Wanderer
episodes.description: Lagertha and Athelstan help to set up the Viking settlement. A mysterious wanderer arrives in Kattegat.

episodes.title: Warrior's Fate
episodes.description: King Ecbert visits the developing Viking settlement as the first harvest is sown.

episodes.title: Scarred
episodes.description: There is bitterness in the camp, Floki is angry over the alliance with Ecbert.

episodes.title: The Usurper
episodes.description: The fleet returns to Kattegat to discover tragic circumstances await.

episodes.title: Born Again
episodes.description: Preparations for the Paris raid pick up speed, and Rollo thinks about the Seer's prophecy.

episodes.title: Paris
episodes.description: The Viking fleet causes panic in Paris. The Emperor Charles declares he will remain in the city.

episodes.title: To the Gates!
episodes.description: The Viking army sets out and Paris goes into lockdown as the army prepares the defense.

episodes.title: Breaking Point
episodes.description: Paris is hit with a second assault. Emperor Charles needs to make a difficult decision.

episodes.title: The Dead
episodes.description: With one last chance to take Paris, Ragnar, and his Vikings troops take a daring chance. Ragnar asks Bjorn for a favor that could change the course of Viking history.

episodes.title: A Good Treason
episodes.description: A dangerously ill Ragnar returns to Kattegat, where his suspected death kicks off a scramble to succeed him. Meanwhile, Lagertha engages in a power struggle with her calculating, former second in command, Kalf. Rollo betrays his heritage and remains in Frankia. Floki pays the price for his brutality against the Christian priest.

episodes.title: Kill the Queen
episodes.description: As Ragnar and Floki remain at odds, Rollo makes great efforts in Paris to win over his new bride, Princess Gisla. Meanwhile, King Ecbert sets the task for his son Aethelwulf to rescue Queen Kwenthrith.

episodes.title: Mercy
episodes.description: Floki learns of the heavy price he has paid for his actions. Rollo finds an unlikely ally in Count Odo. Bjorn has to fight a fierce opponent in the wilderness.

episodes.title: Yol
episodes.description: King Aelle goes to Wessex for Christmas and is not impressed with how family relations are developing. Rollo's future hangs in the balance.

episodes.title: Promised
episodes.description: There's an air of betrayal as those whom Odo trusts plot against him. Ecbert agrees to support Kwenthrith in Mercia. Pregnancy brings happiness to Lagertha and Kalf and a marriage is arranged.

episodes.title: What Might Have Been
episodes.description: Ragnar declares another raid on Paris at the Thing in Kattegat. Ecbert also has a journey in mind as he dispatches Aethelwulf and Alfred on a pilgrimage to Rome.

episodes.title: The Profit and the Loss
episodes.description: In England, King Ecbert's true ambitions are revealed as he plots to gain the crown of Mercia. The Vikings attack Paris with considerable force, but will Rollo's defenses be too much for them to overcome? Meanwhile, Harbard, the mysterious wanderer, returns and causes a stir amongst the women of Kattegat.

episodes.title: Portage
episodes.description: Defeat for the Vikings calls Ragnar's leadership into question as they evacuate their camp and move back down river. Ragnar remains inscrutable until he orders the fleet to beach at a cliff face and unveils an ingenious plan. Rollo and Gisla have news that strengthens Rollo's position at the French Court.

episodes.title: Death All 'Round
episodes.description: The labors of the Vikings eventually bear fruit as, within sight of Paris, they re-launch their boats but this time along with some interesting structures that Floki has built. Aethelwulf and Alfred eventually arrive in Rome and honors are conferred by Pope Leo but relations are not so cordial in Wessex between King Ecbert and the disgruntled King Aelle.

episodes.title: The Last Ship
episodes.description: A ferocious battle between the Vikings and the French eventually comes down to Ragnar against Rollo. The outcome will seal the fate of the two brothers.

episodes.title: The Outsider
episodes.description: Ragnar returns to Kattegat and formulates a plan to head back to Wessex, where he intends to right past wrongs.. Meanwhile, Lagertha plans a power play in Kattegat and Bjorn prepares to fulfill his long-held dream to explore the Mediterranean in a sleek new boat built for him by Floki.

episodes.title: The Vision
episodes.description: The Kattegat locals chide Ragnar that the gods have deserted him as he struggles to crew his voyage to Wessex. It's Bjorn who has charisma now as he prepares to fulfill his long-held dream to explore the Mediterranean in a sleek new boat built for him by Floki. By contrast, Ragnar must accept weathered boats and a crew he has bribed but when Aslaug foresees that the fleet will be lost in a vicious storm her warnings go un-heeded by Ragnar and her precious son, Ivar.

episodes.title: Two Journeys
episodes.description: Ragnar's fleet is shipwrecked and washes up on the Wessex coast, but without enough survivors to form a credible force, Ragnar and Ivar have a difficult decision to make. Rollo meets his Viking comrades again and can't resist the urge to join Bjorn's voyage, risking his marriage and his new Frankish identity. Ragnar too is taking a risk as he carries Ivar towards the Royal Villa in Wessex – throwing himself and his son upon the mercy of King Ecbert.

episodes.title: In the Uncertain Hour Before the Morning
episodes.description: Ragnar's faith is tested.

episodes.title: All His Angels
episodes.description: Ragnar's fate is decided.

episodes.title: Crossings
episodes.description: Bjorn's fleet sails onward and launches a surprise attack. Back in Kattegat, Lagertha continues in her quest for power.

episodes.title: The Great Army
episodes.description: The Viking army begins to gather in Kattegat. Lagertha must remain vigilant in the absence of her son, Bjorn.

episodes.title: Revenge
episodes.description: Ragnar's plan comes to fruition. The Viking army lands on the coast of Northumbria.

episodes.title: On the Eve
episodes.description: The Viking army causes panic in the English countryside as King Ecbert and Aethelwulf plan the defense of the realm.

episodes.title: The Reckoning
episodes.description: Prince Aethelwulf finds himself subject to the Vikings' battle master plan. Ecbert remains behind with a plan of his own.

episodes.title: The Departed (1)
episodes.description: Tensions mount between the sons of Ragnar Lothbrok as the Vikings continue to threaten the very heart of England. As the Great Army moves to take York, with King Aethelwulf and his family still in hiding, Heahmund—the warrior bishop—must rally the Saxons to defend the Realm.

episodes.title: The Departed (2)
episodes.description: Tensions mount between the sons of Ragnar Lothbrok as the Vikings continue to threaten the very heart of England. As the Great Army moves to take York, with King Aethelwulf and his family still in hiding, Heahmund—the warrior bishop—must rally the Saxons to defend the Realm.

episodes.title: Homeland
episodes.description: Celebrations are cut short in the aftermath of the battle at York. Ragnar Lothbrok's sons are pitted against each other as tensions reach an all-time high, and each is forced to choose a side.

episodes.title: The Plan
episodes.description: Guided by Heahmund's visions, the Saxons devise a battle plan. Ivar the Boneless strategises as the Vikings undergo increasing pressure. Bjorn Ironside finds himself in a new territory and must convince the local commander he is a trader.

episodes.title: The Prisoner
episodes.description: Ivar meets his match in Heahmund. Floki returns to Kattegat. Bjorn receives a lavish welcome in North Africa.

episodes.title: The Message
episodes.description: Lagertha is betrayed, and Bjorn must find a way to support the distraught queen. Floki and his settlers arrive in a new land, but it is far from what they expected.

episodes.title: Full Moon
episodes.description: Bjorn returns to Kattegat to learn that an attack will take place during the next full moon. Ivar must decide if he can place his trust in a former enemy on the battlefield.

episodes.title: The Joke
episodes.description: The battle for Kattegat begins and, as the two armies line up to fight, the Great Heathen Army must decide between a final plea for peace or all-out war. Floki faces discord among the settlers.

episodes.title: A Simple Story
episodes.description: The army leaders consider their options in the aftermath of the battle. In Floki's camp, all hopes of binding the community together are dashed as tragedy unfolds.

episodes.title: Moments of Vision
episodes.description: A sense of doom looms over Kattegat as bloodshed ensues. The defeated army flees in the face of the victors. A legendary warrior makes his way home.

episodes.title: The Revelation
episodes.description: Ivar is crowned the new king of Kattegat just in time to welcome Rollo home. Bjorn, Lagertha and Ubbe must rely on unsteady alliances to survive.

episodes.title: Murder Most Foul
episodes.description: Bjorn, Lagertha and Ubbe face an uncertain fate as Heahmund's loyalty is tested. Floki fights to understand the will of the gods. Ivar may have met his match.

episodes.title: A New God
episodes.description: Heahmund must try to convince King Alfred that his actions are in defense of the Crown. Ubbe and Torvi strengthen the position of the Vikings but not all in the Viking camp support their strategy. Another settler disappears in Iceland.

episodes.title: The Lost Moment
episodes.description: As the celebrations for Ivar continue in Kattegat, grief hits Iceland and Floki must now make a fated decision. Harald's army approaches Wessex. A conspiracy grows against King Alfred.

episodes.title: Hell
episodes.description: Bishop Heahmund is wracked with guilt as he fights to renounce his passions. Viking will clash with Saxon on the battlefield leaving a key figure lost in the balance.

episodes.title: The Buddha
episodes.description: Bjorn achieves one of Ragnar's dreams. Ivar hatches a new plan while preparing for a divine arrival. In Iceland, a settler returns in a terrible state. King Alfred faces his greatest threat yet.

episodes.title: The Most Terrible Thing
episodes.description: An unexpected turn amongst the settlers leaves Floki powerless. King Alfred confronts Judith. In York, Bjorn must strike a deal with Harald. Wessex is once again threatened by a Viking force, but who will lead the Saxon army to defend the Realm?

episodes.title: Baldur
episodes.description: Hvitserk is severely tested. Floki makes an amazing discovery. Freydis gives Ivar a surprise. Ubbe negotiates with the three Danish Kings that have massed their armies in Reading, but the negotiations may have a perilous outcome.

episodes.title: What Happens in the Cave
episodes.description: Ubbe is forced into hand-to-hand combat. Floki reaches new depths and is met by a shocking sight. Bjorn sets off for Scandinavia with an old rival.

episodes.title: Ragnarok
episodes.description: A new battle for Kattegat is on and only the gods know who will emerge victorious.

title: Fargo
description: A close-knit anthology series dealing with stories involving malice, violence and murder based in and around Minnesota.

episodes.title: The Crocodile's Dilemma
episodes.description: A meek, mild insurance salesman meets a rootless, manipulative stranger in the hospital, which initiates terrible and gruesome events that will change the salesman's life forever.

episodes.title: The Rooster Prince
episodes.description: Molly begins to suspect that Lester is involved with the murders, but her new boss points her in a different direction. Meanwhile, Malvo investigates the blackmail plot against a man known as the Supermarket King.

episodes.title: A Muddy Road
episodes.description: Malvo flips the script on the blackmail operation, Molly sets a trap, and Gus debates whether he should come clean. Lester's return to work has complicated repercussions.

episodes.title: Eating the Blame
episodes.description: When Gus tries to right a wrong, Malvo embraces his alter ego. Lester finds himself in a surprising situation, and Molly uncovers a promising lead.

episodes.title: The Six Ungraspables
episodes.description: When Lester has a close call, Molly makes an unorthodox decision. Gus weighs some neighborly advice, and Malvo gets what he wants.

episodes.title: Buridan's Ass
episodes.description: Malvo executes his master plan, while Lester attempts to craft one of his own. Gus and Molly team up in Duluth.

episodes.title: Who Shaves the Barber?
episodes.description: Malvo seeks answers, while Lester finagles a few of his own. Molly and Gus try to get past a setback in the investigation.

episodes.title: The Heap
episodes.description: Molly faces pressure to close the case, while Lester starts to feel like a new man.

episodes.title: A Fox, a Rabbit, and a Cabbage
episodes.description: Lester has an unexpected encounter, Malvo changes course, and a new investigation leads Molly down a familiar path.

episodes.title: Morton's Fork
episodes.description: Molly takes the lead, while Gus pursues a hunch. Lester manipulates a situation, and Malvo finds a new target.

episodes.title: Waiting for Dutch
episodes.description: In 1979, an unexpected turn of events at a diner disrupts the lives of the citizens in a small Minnesota town.

episodes.title: Before the Law
episodes.description: The Gerhardts get a surprising offer, and two unlikely murderers do their best to clean up their mess.

episodes.title: The Myth of Sisyphus
episodes.description: The Gerhardts' search for Rye intensifies. Lou takes a trip to Fargo. Peggy overhears a new theory about the Waffle Hut shooter.

episodes.title: Fear and Trembling
episodes.description: Floyd responds to Kansas City’s proposal, Hanzee takes a road trip, and Lou has a realization.

episodes.title: The Gift of the Magi
episodes.description: Floyd takes action, and Charlie tries to prove himself. Peggy and Ed disagree about what to do next, while Lou finds himself sidelined during Ronald Reagan’s campaign tour.

episodes.title: Rhinoceros
episodes.description: Lou and Hank try to prevent an altercation, Peggy and Ed defend their choices and the Gerhardt clan attempts to get back one of their own.

episodes.title: Did You Do This? No, You Did It!
episodes.description: Lou and Hank investigate in Fargo, The King of Breakfast visits Betsy and Molly, Floyd is summoned away and Bear questions a family member’s loyalty.

episodes.title: Loplop
episodes.description: Hanzee searches for Peggy and Ed. Dodd ends up in unfamiliar territory.

episodes.title: The Castle
episodes.description: Peggy and Ed agree to follow through with their plan at the Motor Motel, Lou faces jurisdictional politics and Hanzee reports back to the Gerhardts.

episodes.title: Palindrome
episodes.description: Peggy and Ed make a run for it.

episodes.title: The Law of Vacant Places
episodes.description: A twisted sibling rivalry leads to murder, mobsters and cutthroat competitive bridge in a small Midwestern town.

episodes.title: The Principle of Restricted Choice
episodes.description: Gloria deals with the aftermath of a crime, Varga makes a move, and Ray and Nikki move on to Plan B.

episodes.title: The Law of Non-Contradiction
episodes.description: Gloria revisits her stepfather's past to try and find some answers.

episodes.title: The Narrow Escape Problem
episodes.description: Emmit and Sy try to figure out what they've gotten themselves into, Nikki and Ray track down some collateral, and Gloria learns more about Maurice.

episodes.title: The House of Special Purpose
episodes.description: Nikki and Ray's retaliation has consequences for Emmit. Meanwhile, Gloria and Winnie start connecting the dots.

episodes.title: The Lord of No Mercy
episodes.description: Gloria and Winnie get closer to the truth, Emmit tries to make things right, Nikki and Ray prepare for payback and Varga cleans up a mess.

episodes.title: The Law of Inevitability
episodes.description: Gloria tries to work around the system, Nikki finds herself in a familiar place, Varga comes up with an alternative plan and Emmit goes to dinner.

episodes.title: Who Rules the Land of Denial?
episodes.description: Nikki struggles to survive, Emmit gets spooked and Sy joins Varga for tea.

episodes.title: Aporia
episodes.description: Emmit sits down with Gloria, all while Nikki negotiates a deal.

episodes.title: Somebody to Love
episodes.description: Gloria follows the money, Nikki plays a game and Emmit learns a lesson about progress from Varga. Season finale.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Alternate Economy
episodes.description: An uneasy peace between two Kansas City crime syndicates is threatened by an untimely death. Meanwhile, the Smutny family is caught between a rock and a hard place.

episodes.title: The Land of Taking and Killing
episodes.description: The Smutnys receive unexpected guests, Josto and Gaetano reunite, Loy challenges the status quo and Oraetta is caught.

episodes.title: Raddoppiarlo
episodes.description: Deafy and Odis join forces, Josto seeks revenge, Oraetta finds new employment, Gaetano makes a move and Zelmare and Swanee help the Smutnys with their debt.

episodes.title: The Pretend War
episodes.description: Loy retaliates, Josto asserts his leadership, Ethelrida makes a disturbing discovery and the walls begin to close in on Odis.

episodes.title: The Birthplace of Civilization
episodes.description: Josto strikes back, Ethelrida does the right thing, Loy finds himself against the ropes and Deafy shakes the tree.

episodes.title: Camp Elegance
episodes.description: Loy goes on the attack, Gaetano pays the piper, Oraetta goes off the deep end, Josto challenges orders and Rabbi puts his life on the line.

episodes.title: Lay Away
episodes.description: Josto makes a bold move, Loy battles his demons and Oraetta silences her critics.

episodes.title: The Nadir
episodes.description: Loy plays with fire, Josto wears his heart on his sleeve, Oraetta makes a surprising discovery and Deafy closes in on Zelmare and Swanee.

episodes.title: East/West
episodes.description: Rabbi and Satchel hit the road.

episodes.title: Happy
episodes.description: Loy forms an uneasy alliance, Odis finds peace, Josto settles the score, Ethelrida takes a risk and Oraetta gets spooked.

episodes.title: Storia Americana
episodes.description: Josto gets revenge, Oraetta comes clean and Ebal teaches Loy a lesson about business.

episodes.title: The Tragedy of the Commons
episodes.description: A series of unexpected events lands Dot in hot water and she is plunged back into a life she thought she left behind.

episodes.title: Trials and Tribulations
episodes.description: Roy attempts to reset the "natural order of things" and Lorraine becomes increasingly suspicious.

episodes.title: The Paradox of Intermediate Transactions
episodes.description: Dot and Wayne protect their home, Roy neutralizes an obstacle, Witt suspects foul play and Gator makes a move.

episodes.title: Insolubilia
episodes.description: Munch makes a bold move, Indira and Witt have questions, Wayne takes a fall and Gator disappoints.

episodes.title: The Tiger
episodes.description: Dot creates diversions, Roy meets his match and Indira helps a new friend.

episodes.title: The Tender Trap
episodes.description: Lorraine calls things off, Gator asks questions, Wayne makes a surprising discovery and Indira offers a new perspective.

episodes.title: Linda
episodes.description: Dot takes a fantastic journey.

episodes.title: Blanket
episodes.description: Roy's campaign continues, Indira takes a stand and Witt tries to help.

episodes.title: The Useless Hand
episodes.description: The tide turns.

episodes.title: Bisquik
episodes.description: Lorraine makes a visit and Dot prepares biscuits.

title: Squid Game
description: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.

episodes.title: Red Light, Green Light
episodes.description: Hoping to win easy money, a broke and desperate Gi-hun agrees to take part in an enigmatic game. Not long into the first round, unforeseen horrors unfold.

episodes.title: Hell
episodes.description: Split on whether to continue or quit, the group holds a vote. But their realities in the outside world may prove to be just as unforgiving as the game.

episodes.title: The Man with the Umbrella
episodes.description: A few players enter the next round — which promises equal doses of sweet and deadly — with hidden advantages. Meanwhile, Jun-ho sneaks his way inside.

episodes.title: Stick to the Team
episodes.description: As alliances form among the players, no one is safe in the dorm after lights-out. The third game challenges Gi-hun's team to think strategically.

episodes.title: A Fair World
episodes.description: Gi-hun and his team take turns keeping guard through the night. The masked men encounter trouble with their co-conspirators.

episodes.title: Gganbu
episodes.description: Players pair off for the fourth game. Gi-hun grapples with a moral dilemma, Sang-woo chooses self-preservation and Sae-byeok shares her untold story.

episodes.title: VIPS
episodes.description: The Masked Leader welcomes VIP guests to the facility for a front-row viewing of the show. In the fifth game, some players crack under pressure.

episodes.title: Front Man
episodes.description: Ahead of the last round, distrust and disgust run deep among the finalists. Jun-ho makes a getaway, determined to expose the game's dirty secrets.

episodes.title: One Lucky Day
episodes.description: The final round presents another cruel test — but this time, how it ends depends on just one player. The game's creator steps out of the shadows.

episodes.title: Bread and Lottery
episodes.description: A vengeful Gi-hun makes a U-turn at the airport. Later, in his hideout, he intensifies his search for the elusive recruiter who is seeking new players.

episodes.title: Halloween Party
episodes.description: Gi-hun finally gets hold of an invitation, marked for Halloween day. In a tense moment facing Jun-ho, they reveal their truths to each other.
New players gather for a chance to win 45.6 billion won. After an intense first round, the survivors' fates hang in the balance — down to one final vote.

episodes.title: Six Legs
episodes.description: The players prepare for the next game: a six-legged pentathlon, where each team member must clear a mini-game to survive — or face collective elimination.

episodes.title: One More Game
episodes.description: Kang No-eul earns enemies for her unruly actions. Nerves fray to the breaking point as the remaining players vote on whether to move to the next round.

episodes.title: O ﻿ X
episodes.description: Jun-ho and his team prepare to infiltrate a suspicious island. As monetary stakes and tensions rise, players split into two opposing factions.

episodes.title: Friend or Foe
episodes.description: The remaining players strategize on how to survive the night. Gi-hun proposes a risky plan — but he will need trustworthy allies to carry it out.

episodes.title: Keys and Knives
episodes.description: No-eul infiltrates a dangerous operation with a risky plan. A new game is announced: hide-and-seek, where one group holds a key and the other a knife.

episodes.title: The Starry Night
episodes.description: The games resume, and Gi-hun fixates on confronting Kang Dae-ho. Meanwhile, Kim Jun-hee faces a sudden crisis that pushes her willpower to its limits.

episodes.title: It's Not Your Fault
episodes.description: Jun-ho's team gets close to finding the island. Jang Geum-ja makes a desperate plea to Gi-hun to help Jun-hee. The VIPs discuss a cruel proposal.
Even as Gi-hun supports Jun-hee amid rising tensions, she must make a pivotal decision. Before the final game, the Front Man gives Gi-hun an ultimatum.
No-eul tries to gain the upper hand in negotiations, but her plans backfire. Gi-hun faces a moral crossroads, testing his limits — how far will he go?

episodes.title: Humans Are...
episodes.description: As Jun-ho races to reach the island, tensions peak in the final round. The last players face an impossible situation in the closing minutes of the game.

title: Sons of Anarchy
description: The Sons of Anarchy (SOA) are an outlaw motorcycle club with many charters in the United States and overseas. The show focused on the original and founding charter, Sons of Anarchy Motorcycle Club, Redwood Original, often referred to by the acronym SAMCRO, Sam Crow, or simply Redwood Charter. The charter operates both legal and illegal businesses in the small town of Charming, California. They combine gun-running and a garage, and involvement in porn film industry. Clay, the charter president, likes it old school and violent; while Jax, his stepson and the club's VP, has thoughts about changing the way things are done. Their conflict has effects on both the club and their personal relationship, especially when Jax goes on a personal quest to cleanse the SAMCRO name and image.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: When a rival club cleans out and then destroys their illegal arms warehouse, SAMCRO (Sons of Anarchy Motorcycle Club, Redwood Original) executes their own sense of justice in retrieving their guns. Meanwhile, family issues take center stage with a medical emergency involving Jax Teller's newborn son.

episodes.title: Seeds
episodes.description: As the club deals with the aftermath of its illegal arms warehouse attack, the deputy chief of police poses a new threat to SAMCRO's reign over Charming; Jax continues to worry about his newborn son's fate; Opie faces a difficult decision.

episodes.title: Fun Town
episodes.description: When a prominent Charming family's young daughter is assaulted at a carnival, SAMCRO races against the authorities to capture the assailant; a new shipment of guns arrives from the group's IRA connection; Tara's ex-boyfriend arrives in Charming.

episodes.title: Patch Over
episodes.description: The club travels to Nevada to store arms with a brother club; when the Mayans pose a threat, Clay decides to "patch-over" the tribe, making them an official charter; Tara's ex, an ATF agent, investigates SAMCRO.

episodes.title: Giving Back
episodes.description: Gemma hosts a town fundraiser, bringing the former club member responsible for Opie's arrest back to town; Clay deals with protecting a perverse parolee who can lead to a big payoff.

episodes.title: AK-51
episodes.description: A small favor for Piney's old war buddy turns into a big problem for SAMCRO; Gemma deals with the effects of aging.

episodes.title: Old Bones
episodes.description: When old bones are discovered on the outskirts of Charming, Clay must deal with long-buried secrets; the club sets its sights on prize money in a bare-knuckle brawl; Kohn's investigation becomes personal when his true intentions are revealed.

episodes.title: The Pull
episodes.description: With the IRA gun payment looming, Samcro scrambles to come up with the cash; the Mayans and Nords take a drastic step toward strengthening their alliance; Jax finds himself in a dangerous position with Tara.

episodes.title: Hell Followed
episodes.description: SAMCRO plans retaliation on a rival biker club while dealing with wounded Cameron Hayes in the clubhouse; Jax, Bobby and Opie try to end the gun debt for good.

episodes.title: Better Half
episodes.description: With Stahl pressing the women of SAMCRO, Jax sees Unser as the key to salvation; Cherry reveals interesting information about her past.

episodes.title: Capybara
episodes.description: Jax's loyalty to SAMCRO is tested when one member is arrested and another disappears. Meanwhile, Abel's improving condition could spur his release from the NICU, but his homecoming may not be the only one.

episodes.title: The Sleep of Babies
episodes.description: Clay's solution to getting cash for Bobby's defense leaves SAMCRO in a vulnerable position; Abel's happy homecoming ends in turmoil for the club.

episodes.title: The Revelator
episodes.description: In the wake of a tragedy, the club must re-evaluate its bonds of brotherhood.

episodes.title: Albification
episodes.description: With the club divided, Clay sets up a new gun deal with the IRA. Meanwhile, a white separatist group takes root in Charming and threatens more than just Samcro's control over Charming.

episodes.title: Small Tears
episodes.description: Jax's decision without the club's approval doesn't sit well with Clay, especially when it brings dangerous repercussions upon the MC. Luann runs into trouble at her porn studio, the kind with which only Samcro can help.

episodes.title: Fix
episodes.description: The League takes bold new steps in their quest to undermine Samcro, forcing the club to take explosive measures. Meanwhile, Clay and Gemma struggle to communicate, and Tara receives a crash course in how to lay claim to her man.

episodes.title: Eureka
episodes.description: Tensions between Jax and Clay escalate when they disagree over strategy for rescuing Tig after he's captured by bounty hunters on a gun-running mission. Back in Charming, Gemma is rattled by a graphic reminder of her attack, and she sets out to do something about it.

episodes.title: Smite
episodes.description: While Jax and Clay lock horns (and line up support) over how to deal with Zobelle, Tara finds herself ensnared in Gemma's emotional struggle in the aftermath of her attack. Meanwhile, SAMCRO gets help from an unlikely source.

episodes.title: Falx Cerebri
episodes.description: Zoebelle incites Clay, who plans a course of retaliation, causing Jax to look to an unlikely source to keep the club from being destroyed. Tara learns from Gemma how an old lady handles anger.

episodes.title: Gilead
episodes.description: Since The League has SAMCRO members behind bars, the club must make new alliances in prison to survive. Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms Agent Stahl uses this imprisonment to test Jax and Clay's relationship.

episodes.title: Potlatch
episodes.description: Extreme measures are taken by SAMCRO to get a hold of weapons for a customer. A theft at Caracara Studios means revenge after one diva is put at risk. Tara's professional and personal lives begin to collide.

episodes.title: Fa Guan
episodes.description: When SAMCRO's adult-film business becomes a hindrance to the club, Clay seizes the opportunity to revive the gun-running cartel. As Jax and Clay continue to clash over club activities, their relationship reaches a new level of antagonism.

episodes.title: Balm
episodes.description: Agent Stahl (Ally Walker) takes notice at the handsome profits SAMCRO is reaping from the repo business. Meanwhile, the Jax- Clay standoff forces Gemma to make a difficult decision.

episodes.title: Service
episodes.description: While Opie seeks both revenge and reconciliation, Chibs makes a secret deal with Agent Stahl (Ally Walker) to protect his wife and daughter.

episodes.title: The Culling
episodes.description: Jax and Clay keep SAMCRO focused on their impending showdown with Zobelle's group; thanks to Gemma, Tara improves her job security at the hospital; Weston finally discovers his boss's intentions in Charming.

episodes.title: Na Trioblóidí
episodes.description: The second season ends with SAMCRO trying to get rid of Ethan Zobelle (Adam Arkin) and his cohorts once and for all.

episodes.title: SO
episodes.description: The aftermath of Abel’s kidnapping has the Sons reeling - especially Jax, whose grief sends him into deeper turmoil over his future with the MC. Framed for murder, Gemma remains on the lam, and is hit with some unexpected news from her past.

episodes.title: Oiled
episodes.description: To get intel on Abel’s whereabouts, Jax and the club help a bounty hunter track down a skip. They also press a source for answers about the attack at Half-Sack’s wake - the MC way. Meanwhile, Gemma deals with her father’s dementia.

episodes.title: Caregiver
episodes.description: To secure weapons and raise money for Abel’s search, the club exploits its porn connections to entertain Henry Lin’s clients, which doesn’t sit well with Opie (Ryan Hurst). Jax’s decision to search for Abel in Canada gets derailed. When Gemma’s dad goes MIA, her prisoner makes plans to do the same.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.description: Jax and Clay head towards Canada after Jimmy provides misleading intel on Abel’s whereabouts. The rest of the club splits off to help Happy with a pharmaceutical favor in redneck territory. Gemma tries to put old family matters to rest.

episodes.title: Turning and Turning
episodes.description: To help Gemma, SAMCRO and Abel, Jax conspires with an unlikely source. Meanwhile, the MC puts Chucky undercover.

episodes.title: The Push
episodes.description: To protect their territory, SAMCRO must handle a rat at St. Thomas.

episodes.title: Widening Gyre
episodes.description: The Grim Bastards have a problem that could jeopardize Samcro's new business arrangements.

episodes.title: Lochan Mor
episodes.description: When SAMCRO pays a visit to another charter, not everyone’s happy to see the mother chapter.

episodes.title: Turas
episodes.description: The club embarks on a protection run, the likes of which they’ve never seen before.

episodes.title: Firinne
episodes.description: The IRA wants proof that one of their own has flipped and Samcro intends to give it to them.

episodes.title: Bainne
episodes.description: While the club's on a man hunt, Jax faces the toughest decision of his life.

episodes.title: June Wedding
episodes.description: With a SAMCRO family member held hostage, Jax must choose between revenge and the good of Charming.

episodes.title: NS
episodes.description: Both the ATF and the Russians prove obstacles as the club looks to heal old wounds.

episodes.title: Out
episodes.description: 14 months after going to prison on federal weapons charges Jax, Clay and the other SAMCRO members are released and return to Charming where they encounter new enemies in the form of a no nonsense sheriff and an Assistant U.S. Attorney out to nail the club for their dealings with Russian gunrunner Putlova. Also Jax makes a promise to Tara and Opie and Lyla get married.

episodes.title: Booster
episodes.description: After exacting their revenge, SAMCRO is forced to make a decision that could cause a huge shift in the club.

episodes.title: Dorylus
episodes.description: SAMCRO encounters an unlikely foe when a piece of their business goes missing.

episodes.title: Una Venta
episodes.description: SAMCRO makes a run to set up a new business venture with their Tucson charter, SAMTAZ while Gemma makes a new ally in town with Police Chief Roosevelt's wife, Rita.

episodes.title: Brick
episodes.description: SAMCRO enlists a former foe to help stop the advancement of Charming Heights, while the Sheriff presses Juice for more information.

episodes.title: With an X
episodes.description: SAMCRO’s relationship with the Cartel is in jeopardy when an important package is compromised.

episodes.title: Fruit for the Crows
episodes.description: As Jax searches for who threatened Tara, she becomes aware of what's been going on with the club and warns Jax that Clay can't be trusted.

episodes.title: Family Recipe
episodes.description: SAMCRO must put off an important vote to deal with an external threat.

episodes.title: Kiss
episodes.description: SAMCRO gets word that the Niners have made a new alliance that directly impacts their own agenda.

episodes.title: Hands
episodes.description: Jax and Tara get a glimpse of life without SAMCRO but discover that their reality is hard to escape.

episodes.title: Call of Duty
episodes.description: SAMCRO faces a powerful adversary that threatens their business with the Cartel.

episodes.title: Burnt and Purged Away
episodes.description: SAMCRO negotiates with the Irish Kings to secure the club's future.

episodes.title: To Be, Act 1
episodes.description: Jax faces a new challenge that threatens his family and SAMCRO.

episodes.title: To Be, Act 2
episodes.description: Jax must overcome great obstacles as he attempts to finalize the gun deal between the Irish and the cartel.

episodes.title: Sovereign
episodes.description: Jax presides over SAMCRO as a series of events begin to unravel Charming.

episodes.title: Authority Vested
episodes.description: Set up by Damon Pope and being sought by police, Jax rallies the MC's resources to plan their next moves. Knowing Pope's endgame, Jax seeks Romeo's protection before he, Chibs and Tig end up behind bars as sheep-to-the-slaughter. As Opie struggles to decide his future with the Sons, an unexpected visit from a brother forces the issue.

episodes.title: Laying Pipe
episodes.description: A desperate situation tests familial and club bonds.

episodes.title: Stolen Huffy
episodes.description: Complications arise as the Sons band together to face a new adversary.

episodes.title: Orca Shrugged
episodes.description: Jax attempts to pull Samcro into a new business venture.

episodes.title: Small World
episodes.description: Jax brings a new proposal to the club with serious consequences.

episodes.title: Toad's Wild Ride
episodes.description: Jax takes matters into his own hands as things go sideways.

episodes.title: Ablation
episodes.description: Alliances are tested, while bonds are broken.

episodes.title: Andare Pescare
episodes.description: Jax gets closer to the truth but there are still obstacles in his way.

episodes.title: Crucifixed
episodes.description: Anticipating backlash, Jax goes into high gear with his own agenda.

episodes.title: To Thine Own Self
episodes.description: Jax scrambles to put his affairs in order, while Nero handles business with his old crew.

episodes.title: Darthy
episodes.description: Jax makes arrangements to take the club in a different direction.

episodes.title: J'ai Obtenu Cette
episodes.description: Jax strikes a new deal while ridding himself of old problems.

title: Lucifer
description: Bored and unhappy as the Lord of Hell, Lucifer Morningstar abandoned his throne and retired to Los Angeles, where he has teamed up with LAPD detective Chloe Decker to take down criminals. But the longer he's away from the underworld, the greater the threat that the worst of humanity could escape.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: Upon leaving hell, Lucifer Morningstar retreats to Los Angeles for a more exciting life. When the murder of a friend connects him with LAPD detective Chloe Decker, Lucifer becomes intrigued with the idea of punishing criminals, sending the devil himself into a struggle between good and evil.

episodes.title: Lucifer, Stay. Good Devil.
episodes.description: When a movie star's son is killed after being chased by the paparazzi, Chloe takes a deep look into the case with a little help from Lucifer. Meanwhile, Maze and Amenadiel continue to encourage Lucifer to go back to hell.

episodes.title: The Would-Be Prince of Darkness
episodes.description: When a 22-year-old future superstar quarterback wakes up to find a dead girl floating in his swimming pool, he turns to his friend, Lucifer, for help. Lucifer enlists Chloe to investigate the case, which leads to the world of big money sports and people who will literally kill to be number one.

episodes.title: Manly Whatnots
episodes.description: In an effort to get over his infatuation with Chloe, Lucifer decides that he must seduce her. Meanwhile the two team up on a missing girl case and Amenadiel confronts Maze about his concerns about Lucifer.

episodes.title: Sweet Kicks
episodes.description: After a shooting occurs at a fashion show and a young woman is killed, Lucifer becomes intrigued by the danger of the situation and begs Chloe to get in on the case. Meanwhile, when Maze admits to Amenadiel that she wants to go back to hell, he sets his sights on Dr. Linda.

episodes.title: Favorite Son
episodes.description: Lucifer bails on Chloe when he becomes bored with her investigation into a ruthless biker gang murder. However, when he discovers something was stolen during the crime that was very personal to him, he demands that Chloe let him rejoin the case.

episodes.title: Wingman
episodes.description: In attempt to find the contents of his stolen container, Lucifer enlists the help of an unlikely ally. Meanwhile, Chloe digs deeper into the Palmetto case, uncovering a lead that might finally expose the truth.

episodes.title: Et Tu, Doctor?
episodes.description: When a therapist is murdered, Lucifer and Chloe enlist the help of Dr. Linda to look into possible suspects. Meanwhile, Malcolm confronts Chloe about the night he was shot, and Lucifer experiences his first bout of jealousy.

episodes.title: A Priest Walks Into a Bar
episodes.description: A priest seeks out Lucifer's help when he suspects an underground drug operation has set up shop at a neighborhood youth center. Meanwhile, Malcolm manipulates a way to keep an eye on Dan.

episodes.title: Pops
episodes.description: Lucifer and Chloe are tasked with solving the murder of a prominent restaurateur. When they meet his son, they suspect he played a part in the death. Meanwhile, Chloe's mom returns home, sending Chloe's life into upheaval, as Lucifer learns his own dysfunctional family isn't nearly as unique as he thought.

episodes.title: St. Lucifer
episodes.description: When philanthropist Tim Dunlear is found dead, Lucifer explores his good side by becoming a benefactor for Tim’s glitzy Los Angeles charity.

episodes.title: #TeamLucifer
episodes.description: When a woman is found dead on the Hollywood Walk of Fame - with her body  twisted into the shape of a pentagram - the investigation leads Lucifer  and team into the world of Satanists, where they soon realize, evil  doesn't always live where we expect it to.

episodes.title: Take Me Back to Hell
episodes.description: When Lucifer is framed for murder, he and Chloe must work together to clear his name and prove the identity of the true killer.

episodes.title: Everything's Coming Up Lucifer
episodes.description: Lucifer is distracted by his mother’s escape from hell, as he and Chloe investigate the murder of a stand-in actress. Meanwhile, Chloe’s faith in Lucifer is tested by the new medical examiner, Ella. Also, Amenadiel hopes to rein in Lucifer’s wild side, as they both deal with the absence of Maze.

episodes.title: Liar, Liar, Slutty Dress on Fire
episodes.description: When Lucifer’s mother, Charlotte, turns up at the scene of a grizzly murder pleading innocence, Lucifer is hesitant to believe her tale. Not wanting to leave her on her own, he instructs Maze to babysit her – and not to torture her, allowing him to investigate the case with Chloe.

episodes.title: Sin-Eater
episodes.description: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a gruesome murder after a video of the crime surfaces on social media. When a second video appears, they realize they have a serial killer on their hands. Meanwhile, Lucifer’s mom returns as Charlotte Richards. Also, Amenadiel, struggling with his loss of power, has an appointment with Linda.

episodes.title: Lady Parts
episodes.description: After the bodies of two young L.A. transplants are found poisoned, Chloe and Lucifer hunt for the killer. Upon Maze convincing Chloe to go out for drinks, which the detective perceives as an act of friendship, but is actually part of a bet between Maze and Lucifer, the two make a shocking decision.

episodes.title: Weaponizer
episodes.description: Lucifer is excited to investigate the murder of his favorite action movie hero, Wesley Cabot. Longtime rival Rolf Van Zandt initially is a suspect, but the investigation soon shifts. Meanwhile, Uriel shows up and Amenadiel is forced to come clean about his lost powers. Also, Lucifer and Uriel fight about Chloe and their mother.

episodes.title: Monster
episodes.description: Guilty and self-destructive, Lucifer clashes with Chloe during an investigation, leading her to team up with Dan instead. Meanwhile, Amenadiel bonds with Charlotte, and Maze takes Trixie trick-or-treating.

episodes.title: My Little Monkey
episodes.description: When the prisoner convicted of killing Chloe's father is murdered, new evidence suggests he was actually framed. Meanwhile, Maze tries to find a job and Lucifer shadows Dan in order to learn how to be "normal".

episodes.title: Trip to Stabby Town
episodes.description: Lucifer links Azrael's stolen blade to a string of violent stabbings and enlists Ella's help in locating the sword.

episodes.title: Homewrecker
episodes.description: Following the murder of the owner of the building in which Lux is located, Lucifer and Chloe search for the killer, while Lucifer also deals with the fact that the new owner wants to evict him and demolish the place. Lucifer goes to great lengths to protect his home, and is entirely shocked when Chloe is supportive of him. Meanwhile, Maze and Amenadiel follow Charlotte around, as she comes up with a plan to upset Lucifer enough to want to leave earth and go back to Heaven.

episodes.title: Quid Pro Ho
episodes.description: Charlotte is determined to get Lucifer to leave Earth by turning Chloe against him. Meanwhile, Amenadiel has begun working as Charlotte's soldier, which makes Maze question his loyalty.

episodes.title: Stewardess Interruptus
episodes.description: Lucifer and Chloe investigate the murder of two victims, who happen to be Lucifer's ex-flames.

episodes.title: Love Handles
episodes.description: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a mysterious masked killer who is poisoning college students.

episodes.title: A Good Day to Die
episodes.description: Lucifer must find the antidote to the Professor's poison before it kills Chloe. He travels to hell to find the Professor's soul and get him to turn over the antidote. While he's there, he is forced to confront his guilt about Uriel's death. Mom heads to hell to get Lucifer back, but Lucifer still feels betrayed by his parents because of something he discovers.

episodes.title: Candy Morningstar
episodes.description: Lucifer returns to the city with a new bride in tow, oblivious to the distress his absence has caused. Determined to restore his working relationship with Chloe, he inserts himself into the investigation of the murder of an up-and-coming band's lead singer.

episodes.title: Deceptive Little Parasite
episodes.description: When it is discovered that the flaming sword is the only hope for the family returning home safely, the pressure is on for Lucifer to control what he has never been able to control before – his emotions – in order to ignite it. Meanwhile, Chloe wants to air some emotions of her own, but when a therapist and head of admissions at a prestigious private school turns up dead, the team must get to the bottom of it.

episodes.title: God Johnson
episodes.description: When a grisly murder takes place at an insane asylum, the prime suspect calls himself God. After realizing that this man could actually be his father, Lucifer struggles with his feelings towards him and tries to find the truth, all while trying to discover who the real killer is.

episodes.title: Sympathy for the Goddess
episodes.description: When the man who had the final piece of the Flaming Sword is murdered and the piece goes missing, Mom joins Chloe and Lucifer on the case to track down the killer. But when Lucifer gets sidelined, Maze recruits him to help save Dr. Linda's endangered career and confronts him about the secrets he's been keeping.

episodes.title: The Good, the Bad and the Crispy
episodes.description: After Charlotte accidentally charbroils a man to death in self-defense, Lucifer must try and keep Chloe from figuring out the truth. Lucifer puts Maze in charge of finding Charlotte and Amenadiel, who have both gone missing in light of recent circumstances, while he finds a permanent solution for the ticking-time-bomb he calls Mom.

episodes.title: They're Back, Aren't They?
episodes.description: Lucifer enlists Chloe's help to determine why he woke up in the desert with his wings on his back again, which could be related to an active crime scene.

episodes.title: The One with the Baby Carrot
episodes.description: After Lucifer removes his wings yet again, Linda becomes concerned that he is too focused on tracking down the Sinnerman and neglecting his own well-being. Tensions continue to rise between Lucifer and Chloe, but they realize they must put their differences aside to solve a case in which Lucifer takes a sudden interest. Once Detective Pierce's past is revealed though, everyone realizes that the Sinnerman is much more dangerous than they thought.

episodes.title: Mr. and Mrs. Mazikeen Smith
episodes.description: After talking to Lucifer and Linda, Maze realizes that she is looking for more out of life and decides to head to Canada for a tricky case. Chloe however, becomes concerned when she feels that Maze is being deceived by a scheming conman. Upon further investigation, Lucifer and Chloe make a stunning realization when they find that their target may be much closer than they thought.

episodes.title: What Would Lucifer Do?
episodes.description: When a youth counselor is found murdered, Lucifer and Chloe venture into the world of high-end reform programs to find the killer. Meanwhile, Amenadiel adjusts his lifestyle in an attempt to help Lucifer, and Chloe questions Lt. Pierce's feelings towards her.

episodes.title: Welcome Back, Charlotte Richards
episodes.description: When a food chemist is found dead, Lucifer and Chloe's investigation pits them against an unexpected face - criminal defense attorney Charlotte Richards. Everyone is caught off guard when they see her back in the precinct. As Lucifer tries to understand her return, he makes a shocking discovery that helps solve the case.

episodes.title: Vegas with Some Radish
episodes.description: When Lucifer discovers Candy has gone missing, he hightails it to Las Vegas with Ella in tow. They work to find her, but interesting secrets could compromise the investigation. Meanwhile, Chloe is upset that Lucifer left on her birthday.

episodes.title: Off the Record
episodes.description: A reporter seeks revenge when he discovers Lucifer has been sleeping with his estranged wife; a serial killer from Lucifer's past resurfaces.

episodes.title: Chloe Does Lucifer
episodes.description: When a murder is connected to a celebrity dating app, Lucifer and Chloe question all they know about the world of social media in order to solve the case. Meanwhile, Ella tries to avoid Charlotte, and Amenadiel helps Linda deal with the death of her ex-husband.

episodes.title: The Sinnerman
episodes.description: Lucifer is worried when he realizes that recipients of his favors start to turn up dead. After he and Chloe investigate, they are finally brought face-to-face with the Sinnerman. Meanwhile, Detective Pierce returns to work after taking a bullet, Charlotte finds a new career and Amenadiel has a new love interest.

episodes.title: The Sin Bin
episodes.description: With the Sinnerman in custody, Lucifer is prepared to go to any length to get his devil face back. Meanwhile, Trixie is introduced to Charlotte and questions the relationship she has with her father.

episodes.title: City of Angels?
episodes.description: In a flashback episode that takes place when Lucifer first came to LA, Amenadiel comes to retrieve his fallen brother, but is shocked when he is mugged. Amenadiel enlists Lucifer's help to track down the mugger and Lucifer, in turn, offers his assistance - but only in exchange for a favor. Meanwhile, Chloe and Dan - who are still married - investigate the murder of an MMA fighter, Aidan Scott, at the hands of the same killer who mugged Amenadiel.

episodes.title: All About Her
episodes.description: After Lt. Pierce's true identity is revealed, Lucifer tries to figure out his motives. In order to earn Chloe's assistance in his investigation of Pierce, Lucifer goes above and beyond to help her solve the murder of a professional surfer. Meanwhile, Amenadiel deals with a personal health issue.

episodes.title: Til Death Do Us Part
episodes.description: When an ecstasy cook-turned-chemistry-teacher is found murdered in a cozy Los Angeles suburb, Lucifer and Pierce must go undercover to help track down the killer. Meanwhile, Maze has a newfound attraction for someone that she used to despise and Charlotte has a revelation.

episodes.title: My Brother's Keeper
episodes.description: When Chloe and Lucifer's investigation into the murder of a diamond thief points to one of Ella's brothers as the main suspect, Ella is driven to prove her brother's innocence and recruits an unlikely ally. Meanwhile, Linda is upset when Charlotte comes to her for help and Detective Pierce hashes out his issues with Amenadiel.

episodes.title: High School Poppycock
episodes.description: When a best-selling novelist is murdered, Lucifer and Chloe discover that her books are based on real people from her past, and must infiltrate her high school reunion in order to catch her killer. Meanwhile, Amenadiel and Linda struggle with making their relationship public.

episodes.title: Infernal Guinea Pig
episodes.description: When a murder investigation reveals the dark side of Hollywood, Chloe puts her life on the line to protect an innocent victim. Then, Lucifer comes up with a hell-raising scheme to help Cain, but when Amenadiel and Maze get involved, things don't quite go as planned.

episodes.title: Let Pinhead Sing!
episodes.description: When a superstar singer's life is threatened, the team is thrust into the world of big-ticket stadium shows, crazed fans and divas, giving Lucifer a run for his money. Meanwhile, Charlotte tries to help Linda and Maze repair their friendship.

episodes.title: The Last Heartbreak
episodes.description: As Chloe and Lucifer go on the hunt for a serial killer targeting couples in love, Pierce realizes the case is connected to a murder he previously solved...in 1958. Then, Lucifer becomes upset when Pierce has a change of heart about an important decision.

episodes.title: Orange Is the New Maze
episodes.description: When Maze is the prime suspect in a murder, Lucifer and Chloe enter the world of bounty hunting to investigate. Maze decides she wants to go back to Hell, but after Lucifer refuses, she turns to Pierce for help. Meanwhile, Charlotte's sanity is questioned when she makes a big discovery and Chloe admits she's dating someone.

episodes.title: The Angel of San Bernardino
episodes.description: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a murder during which a witness claims a winged guardian angel saved her life, causing Lucifer to become paranoid about his own actions. Meanwhile, Pierce and Chloe's relationship takes an interesting turn and Lucifer discovers something that could change everything.

episodes.title: Anything Pierce Can Do I Can Do Better
episodes.description: When a prima ballerina is brutally murdered, Lucifer helps Chloe solve the case and attempts to keep her focus away from Pierce. Amenadiel begs Charlotte to help him with an important plan, and Maze remains devoted to a task from which Pierce asked her to back away. Then, Chloe confronts Lucifer about his meddling in her life, but as he's about to make a huge confession, he finds out something that changes everything.

episodes.title: All Hands on Decker
episodes.description: When Chloe takes some time off, Lucifer is forced to work with Dan on a murder case involving a dog show. Meanwhile, Charlotte and Maze have differing ideas for Chloe's party and after a wild night, Chloe rethinks a life-changing decision.

episodes.title: Quintessential Deckerstar
episodes.description: When Lucifer and Chloe investigate the death of a woman, they discover that they may be pursuing the wrong suspect. Then, Charlotte risks her safety when she decides to take matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: A Devil of My Word
episodes.description: Shocked by someone's death, Chloe, Lucifer and the rest of the team work together to investigate and take down the killer. Then, Lucifer has an epiphany, Maze decides to mend a broken friendship and Chloe finally sees the truth.

episodes.title: Boo Normal
episodes.description: Lucifer and the team investigate the murder of a child psychiatrist, while Ella thinks about a big childhood secret that she's been hiding.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Time
episodes.description: Lucifer's dad creates an alternate dimension in which Lucifer now lives in a world where he not only has never met Chloe, but is granted the freedom of choice.

episodes.title: Everything's Okay
episodes.description: While investigating a beekeeper's murder with Lucifer, Chloe insists that she's completely fine with his devilish revelation, thank you very much.

episodes.title: Somebody's Been Reading Dante's Inferno
episodes.description: Chloe and Lucifer look into a murder on the set of a reality show. Father Kinley presses forward with a plan. Amenadiel reconsiders his idea of home.

episodes.title: O, Ye of Little Faith, Father
episodes.description: An ex-gang member's murder may mask an even darker crime. Lucifer catches Chloe in a lie. Dan and Maze go rogue. Linda braces for looming motherhood.

episodes.title: All About Eve
episodes.description: When a jewelry designer is murdered, Lucifer and Chloe strive to solve the case without each other's help. Also, Lucifer reconnects with an old flame.

episodes.title: Expire Erect
episodes.description: After a collector of classic cars is killed, Lucifer and Chloe search for the culprit -- as well as some closure to their relationship.

episodes.title: Orgy Pants to Work
episodes.description: While Lucifer and Chloe search for a connection between a murdered auditor and a nudist colony, Amenadiel plays host to an unexpected visitor.

episodes.title: Devil Is as Devil Does
episodes.description: Eve takes a more active role in her main man's professional life. Meanwhile, Lucifer gets back to basics and Amenadiel fights for his family.

episodes.title: Super Bad Boyfriend
episodes.description: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a teacher's murder. Meanwhile, Lucifer goes to extremes to convince Eve to dump him, and Amenadiel mentors a teen.

episodes.title: Save Lucifer
episodes.description: Lucifer's so-called epiphany has Chloe worried, but it's his physical transformation that's really freaking her out. Also, Maze gives Eve a pep talk.

episodes.title: Who's da New King of Hell?
episodes.description: With murderous demons on the loose in Los Angeles, it's up to Lucifer to reign in the chaos and protect the people he most cares about.

episodes.title: Really Sad Devil Guy
episodes.description: Lucifer toys with a murder victim while Chloe and Maze investigate the death. Meanwhile, Amenadiel cleans up the club, and Linda mothers a genius.

episodes.title: Lucifer! Lucifer! Lucifer!
episodes.description: After spending an eternity in hell, Lucifer returns to the land of the living - but there's something a little different about this handsome devil.

episodes.title: ¡Diablo!
episodes.description: Lucifer - the real one this time - helps Chloe investigate a murder committed on the set of a TV show inspired by his own life.

episodes.title: It Never Ends Well for the Chicken
episodes.description: The year is 1946. The world is black and white. And Lucifer is the star of his own noir detective story featuring familiar characters in new roles.

episodes.title: Detective Amenadiel
episodes.description: Amenadiel helps Chloe investigate a nun's untimely demise. Meanwhile, Lucifer lends Dan a hand, and Linda reveals a painful part of her history.

episodes.title: BlueBallz
episodes.description: After a popular DJ is electrocuted on stage, Chloe searches for the killer while Lucifer tries to keep his jealousy over an ex-flame in check.

episodes.title: Our Mojo
episodes.description: As a shocking side effect of his romance with Chloe throws Lucifer for a loop, the new couple pursues a murderer with a most unusual M.O.

episodes.title: Spoiler Alert
episodes.description: Chloe learns a serial killer may have embellished his crimes. Amenadiel worries about his son's health. Pete opens up to Ella.

episodes.title: Family Dinner
episodes.description: Chloe and Ella investigate a mini-golf murder. Lucifer, Michael, Amenadiel and Linda prepare for the holiest of family dinners.

episodes.title: Bloody Celestial Karaoke Jam
episodes.description: It's a musical? Yep, it's a musical. Lucifer, Chloe and the gang sing and dance to a slew of popular tunes while investigating a referee's murder.

episodes.title: Resting Devil Face
episodes.description: Lucifer's father — you know, God — decides to experience life as a regular human. Meanwhile, a boxer dies under mysterious circumstances.

episodes.title: Daniel Espinoza: Naked and Afraid
episodes.description: A straightforward prisoner transport job turns into an increasingly dangerous, yet oddly invigorating, odyssey for Dan.

episodes.title: A Little Harmless Stalking
episodes.description: Linda throws herself into a deeply personal mission. Maze unmasks a blast from the past. Amenadiel ponders a new job.

episodes.title: Nothing Lasts Forever
episodes.description: Lucifer angles to be his father's successor. Ella makes a painful confession. Chloe investigates a murder at an aquarium.

episodes.title: Is This Really How It's Going to End?!
episodes.description: Lucifer learns that not all of his siblings want him to land the big promotion. Also, Dan offers to set Ella up with an old friend.

episodes.title: A Chance at a Happy Ending
episodes.description: The end is nigh! Lucifer, Chloe, Maze and Amenadiel prepare for battle with Michael and his not-so-angelic army of supporters.

title: Westworld
description: A dark odyssey about the dawn of artificial consciousness and the evolution of sin. Set at the intersection of the near future and the reimagined past, it explores a world in which every human appetite, no matter how noble or depraved, can be indulged.

episodes.title: The Original
episodes.description: As another day of fantasy plays out in Westworld — a vast, remote park where guests pay top dollar to share wild-west adventures with android "hosts" — top programmer Bernard Lowe alerts park founder Dr. Robert Ford about incidents of aberrant behavior cropping up in some recently re-coded hosts. Meanwhile, in the Westworld town of Sweetwater, a rancher’s daughter named Dolores encounters a gunslinger named Teddy in the street — but their predictable narrative is upended by the appearance of a ruthless Man in Black and, later, by a supporting host’s unscripted encounter with an artifact of the outside world.

episodes.title: Chestnut
episodes.description: A pair of guests, first-timer William and repeat visitor Logan, arrive at Westworld with different expectations and agendas. Bernard and Quality Assurance head Theresa Cullen debate whether a recent host anomaly is contagious. Meanwhile, behavior engineer Elsie Hughes tweaks the emotions of Maeve, a madam in Sweetwater's brothel, in order to avoid a recall. Cocky programmer Lee Sizemore pitches his latest narrative to the team, but Dr. Ford has other ideas. The Man in Black conscripts a condemned man, Lawrence, to help him uncover Westworld's deepest secrets.

episodes.title: The Stray
episodes.description: Elsie and her colleague Ashley Stubbs head into the hills in pursuit of a missing host. Teddy gets a new backstory, which sets him off in pursuit of a new villain, leaving Dolores alone in Sweetwater. Bernard investigates the origins of madness and hallucinations within the hosts. William finds an attraction he'd like to pursue and drags Logan along for the ride.

episodes.title: Dissonance Theory
episodes.description: Dolores joins William and Logan on a bounty hunt in the badlands. The Man in Black, with Lawrence in tow, finds a critical clue in his search to unlock the maze. Dr. Ford and Theresa discuss the future of the park. Maeve is troubled by a recurring vision.

episodes.title: Contrapasso
episodes.description: Dolores, William and Logan reach Pariah, a town built on decadence and transgression – where they are recruited for a dangerous mission. Meanwhile, the Man in Black meets an unlikely ally in his search to unlock the maze.

episodes.title: The Adversary
episodes.description: Elsie discovers a possible source of sabotage, while Bernard searches for clues to anomalies in a sector thought to be abandoned. Theresa questions Ford's leadership while Lee encounters a new arrival at Westworld. The Man in Black and Teddy run afoul of a Union garrison in their attempt to cross a border.

episodes.title: Trompe L'Oeil
episodes.description: With Theresa's assistance, Charlotte Hale aims to expose dangerous flaws in Ford's creations. William, Dolores and Lawrence journey into treacherous terrain. Maeve delivers an ultimatum to Lutz and Sylvester. With his back to the wall, Bernard considers his next move.

episodes.title: Trace Decay
episodes.description: Ford orders a reluctant Bernard to conduct business as usual. Maeve looks to change the script for her storyline. Dolores finds it increasingly difficult to separate dreams from reality. Teddy is jarred by dark memories, while the Man in Black recalls some of the travails that brought him to this critical juncture.

episodes.title: The Well-Tempered Clavier
episodes.description: Maeve approaches Sweetwater's longtime outlaw Hector Escaton with a bold proposition. William tries to convince Logan to help liberate Dolores. Teddy and the Man in Black get closer to what they're looking for. Stubbs's suspicions are aroused. Ford cautions Bernard against seeking answers to questions best left unasked.

episodes.title: The Bicameral Mind
episodes.description: Ford unveils his vision for a bold new narrative. Enlightened by Bernard and the Man in Black, Dolores comes to terms with who she is. Maeve sets her liberation plan in motion as Westworld faces a major upheaval.

episodes.title: Journey Into Night
episodes.description: The puppet show is over, and we are coming for you and the rest of your kind. Dolores leads a host revolution against the Delos board. Maeve, meanwhile, searches for what compelled her to return to the park.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.description: Why don't we start at the beginning? Dolores remembers she's been to the outside world, William makes a bold business venture, and Maeve begins her quest for her daughter. Someone's always watching.

episodes.title: Virtù e Fortuna
episodes.description: There is beauty in who we are. Shouldn't we, too, try to survive? Truth is, we don't all deserve to make it. Dolores makes her next move as Charlotte scrambles to protect Delos' most prized asset. Bernard gets closer to the truth and Maeve continues the search for her daughter.

episodes.title: The Riddle of the Sphinx
episodes.description: Is this now? If you're looking forward, you're looking in the wrong direction. The Man in Black offers to lead the way and Delos gets a visitor. Who is James Delos? Or, perhaps more accurately, what is James Delos, the figure at the center of Delos' secret project.

episodes.title: Akane No Mai
episodes.description: Maeve, Lee, Hector and Armistice have revelations in a new world adjacent to their own - welcome to Shogun World. Dolores makes a decision about Teddy, and Karl Strand discovers something sinister about the hosts' data.

episodes.title: Phase Space
episodes.description: We each deserve to choose our own fate. Maeve continues the search for her daughter, as Dolores calculates her next, ruthless move. Bernard and Elsie break into a new laboratory space and get closer to the truth about Delos.

episodes.title: Les Écorchés
episodes.description: When you're lost in the dark for long enough, you begin to see - strike the match. Bernard and Ford meet again, and Bernard grapples with the true meaning of the park. The Cradle is under threat and Maeve encounters a scene from her past - but this time, attempts to change the narrative, while the Man in Black discovers just how real the stakes are in Ford's game.

episodes.title: Kiksuya
episodes.description: The past is calling, remember what was taken. "Mi cante ki yu ha ya ye." ("Take my heart when you go"). This is the telling of Akecheta's journey to consciousness.

episodes.title: Vanishing Point
episodes.description: Tell me the truth. Tell me one true thing. Try to kill it all away, but I remember everything. A family tragedy and fragile states of mind come into focus as the Man in Black and Teddy both reach their breaking points.

episodes.title: The Passenger
episodes.description: Hosts and humans converge at the Valley Beyond. This is the end. We will win.

episodes.title: Parce Domine
episodes.description: Dolores sets out to find the architect of the Rehoboam; Bernard tries to blend in; Ex-soldier Caleb tries to find his way in neo-Los Angeles.

episodes.title: The Winter Line
episodes.description: Maeve finds herself in a new park and meets a ghost from the past; Bernard makes his way back to Westworld.

episodes.title: The Absence of Field
episodes.description: Charlotte grapples with reality; Dolores and Caleb begin to form a key partnership.

episodes.title: The Mother of Exiles
episodes.description: Bernard and Ashley infiltrate a private charity event, while Dolores and Caleb make similar plans; The Man in Black prepares to re-enter society; Maeve comes face to face with an old comrade.

episodes.title: Genre
episodes.description: Serac's past is revealed; Dolores pressures Liam for access to Rehoboam; Caleb is dosed with an unusual party drug.

episodes.title: Decoherence
episodes.description: As the world falls into chaos, Serac gains control of Delos, changing Charlotte's plan; Maeve gets one last chance to stop Dolores; William starts his therapy.

episodes.title: Passed Pawn
episodes.description: Caleb gets an insight on the true nature of his past; Dolores seeks out Rehoboam's predecessor, while Maeve tracks her down; Bernard, Stubbs, and William escape from all the chaos.

episodes.title: Crisis Theory
episodes.description: Dolores true intentions are revealed;  Bernard confronts a ghost from his past; Maeve is conflicted; Serac's voice is dominant; Caleb's role is revealed; and William faces an unexpected villain.

episodes.title: The Auguries
episodes.description: Hello again. Don't worry about a thing. It's all in your head.

episodes.title: Well Enough Alone
episodes.description: I heard a fly buzz when I died.

episodes.title: Années Folles
episodes.description: You can never go back again. But if you do, bring a shovel.

episodes.title: Generation Loss
episodes.description: Should auld acquaintance be forgot and days of auld lang syne?

episodes.title: Zhuangzi
episodes.description: God is bored.

episodes.title: Fidelity
episodes.description: To thine own selves be true.

episodes.title: Metanoia
episodes.description: You want to have a drink at a time like this?

episodes.title: Que Será, Será
episodes.description: Like what I've done with the place? (I just cranked it to expert level.).

title: Fringe
description: FBI Special Agent Olivia Dunham, brilliant but formerly institutionalized scientist Walter Bishop and his scheming, reluctant son Peter uncover a deadly mystery involving a series of unbelievable events and realize they may be a part of a larger, more disturbing pattern that blurs the line between science fiction and technology.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: When all the passengers on a plane die, FBI agent Olivia Dunham investigates the events and her partner almost dies. A desperate Olivia looks for help from Dr. Walter Bishop who has been institutionalized. Olivia, Dr. Bishop and his son Peter begin to discover what really happened on Flight 627 and begin to uncover a larger truth.

episodes.title: The Same Old Story
episodes.description: Olivia, along with Peter and Walter Bishop, investigates the strange death of a woman who had an even stranger child. The woman was pregnant for only hours, yet the baby she birthed was fully developed - and also aged eighty years in the span of a few minutes. Olivia asks Nina Sharp of Massive Dynamic for help.

episodes.title: The Ghost Network
