Kabuto tells Guren that Yūkimaru is only a tool to control the Three-Tails, which upsets Guren. Meanwhile, Shizune, Ino, Tenten and Lee meet up with the team and tell them that their new mission is to rescue Yūkimaru and capture the Three-Tails before Orochimaru's group can capture it.

episodes.title: Regroup!
episodes.description: Shizune, Ino, Lee and Tenten arrive and Kakashi, Shizune and Yamato discuss about a strategy to seal the Sanbi and rescue Yukimaru. Meanwhile, Kabuto and Rinji notice Guren's care for Yukimaru and become concerned.

episodes.title: The Four-Corner Sealing Barrier
episodes.description: The sealing unit prepares the sealing barrier and the other two teams go into battle with Guren and her henchmen. Kakashi, Naruto and Sai stall Guren and Gozu while Shino prepares to go against Guren's crystal style. Meanwhile, Lee goes against Guren's other henchmen and gets trapped in their smokescreen. Can Lee find a way to defeat them?

episodes.title: Breaking the Crystal Style
episodes.description: After Shino finishes preparing his insects, he goes against Guren's crystal style. Elsewhere, while Shizune, Sakura, Ino and Hinata are bringing the sealing barrier to the Sanbi, they are being watched by Tobi and Rinji.

episodes.title: The Battle Over the Barrier
episodes.description: Kabuto plans on breaking Leaf’s The Four-Corner Sealing Barrier from the inside by using Yukimaru’s power and have the Three-Tailed Beast go on a rampage.

episodes.title: Red Camellia
episodes.description: Yūkimaru falters and the Three-Tails injures Guren. Rinji tells Yūkimaru to suppress the beast to save her, but he is unable to do so. Guren leaves her position and protects Yūkimaru with a Crystal Style shield. Naruto goes out to find Yūkimaru, but ends up fighting the Three-Tails with Guren. Despite their efforts to defeat it, the beast overpowers the two of them, and then it proceeds to swallow them. Meanwhile, Kakashi, Shino and Sai find Yūkimaru unconcious and flee with him, leaving Kabuto frustrated.

episodes.title: Strange Bedfellows
episodes.description: Guren tries to attack Naruto within the Three-Tails, but, in her weakened state, is unable to do so and passes out. Meanwhile, Kakashi tells Sakura and Ino to heal Yūkimaru while he, Shizune, Kiba, Sai, and Hinata search for Naruto. Naruto and Guren soon encounter a horde of mini Three-Tails that try to attack them, but they evade them and begin to argue about Yūkimaru. While Yūkimaru awakens, Naruto summons a bunch of Shadow Clones to look for a way out of the beast's stomach. Elsewhere, Kabuto gives Curse Marks to Rinji's men.

episodes.title: Guidepost of the Camellia
episodes.description: Yukimaru informs Kakashi and the others to Naruto and Guren's whereabouts and they attempt to free them with Yukimaru's help. Kiba, Tenten and Lee once again battle Kihou, Kigiri and Nurari after gaining more power from Kabuto. Naruto and Guren continue to search for a way out, coming across human-sized Sanbi-like creatures and illusions. Will Naruto and Guren ever find a way out?

episodes.title: Counterattack of the Curse Mark
episodes.description: The Sealing Team prepared to start sealing the Three-Tails and tell Sai to take Yūkimaru somewhere safe, but he gets attacked by Kabuto's men. Kabuto meanwhile prepares his plans while Lee, Tenten, and Kiba are also attacked. Rinji finds his men and converts them back to his side, ordering them to attack the Sealing Team; they're stopped by Kakashi, Yamato and Shino. Rinji then makes Yūkimaru eat the pills to control the Three-Tails, which Naruto and Guren learn about.

episodes.title: Memory of Guilt
episodes.description: Katsuyu arrives to help the sealing team with the sealing barrier. Naruto and Guren arrive to save Yukimaru from Rinji, but after Guren and Yukimaru have a brief discussion, Rinji reveals the truth about Guren to Yukimaru in hope that he'll make the Sanbi go wild. What will Yukimaru's reaction be when he discovers Guren killed his mother?

episodes.title: Shattered Promise
episodes.description: The sealing team continue their efforts to seal the Sanbi while Kakashi and the others face against a monster fused together by Kigiri, Nurari and Kihou. Kabuto reveals Orochimaru's plans involving the Sanbi and he and Naruto begin to fight. While protecting Yukimaru, Guren fights against the real Rinji, who has been resurrected by Kabuto. When Guren sacrifices her life to save Yukimaru, Yukimaru's powers go into full effect. Now, in order to protect Yukimaru, Naruto prepares to go against the rampaging Sanbi.

episodes.title: The Place to Return To
episodes.description: The battle for the Sanbi comes to an end as neither the Konoha ninja nor Orochimaru are successful at obtaining it. Tsunade classifies the mission of catching the Sanbi as a failure, for it is too dangerous to accomplish. As Naruto and the others prepare to return home, Yukimaru goes missing. Unbeknownst to everyone, Akatsuki lies in wait, and they have their own plans for the Sanbi.

title: Futurama
description: The adventures of a late-20th-century New York City pizza delivery boy, Philip J. Fry, who, after being unwittingly cryogenically frozen for one thousand years, finds employment at Planet Express, an interplanetary delivery company in the retro-futuristic 31st century.

cast.characterName: Fry / Professor Farnsworth / Zoidberg / Zapp Brannigan (voice)

episodes.title: Space Pilot 3000
episodes.description: On New Year's Eve 1999, Pizza Delivery boy Philip J. Fry accidentally falls into a cryogenic chamber and is frozen for 1,000 years. Finally unfrozen, he explores New New York, meets his new best friend (a kleptomaniacal robot named Bender) and goes to work for his great-great-great-great-grand-nephew's space delivery business.

episodes.title: The Series Has Landed
episodes.description: For the crew's first mission, they must deliver a crate full of toys for an arcade game to the moon. Fry is very excited, while it is not really a big deal in the year 3000. Fry tries to persuade Leela to go exploring on the moon, while Amy tries to recover the keys to the Planet Express Ship.

episodes.title: I, Roommate
episodes.description: When it is discovered that Philip has been living in the Planet Express office, he is forced to move out. Trying to sleep standing up in Bender's closet-sized apartment doesn't work, so they go looking for a place both can be comfortable. Unfortunately, Bender is incompatible with the ideal apartment they do find until he has a radical... modification which makes him less than happy.

episodes.title: Love's Labours Lost in Space
episodes.description: On a mission intended to save endangered animals on a collapsing planet, Leela and the crew run into legendary starship captain Zapp Brannigan. A self-proclaimed ladies man, Zapp sees Leela as a potential new conquest. When the captain refuses to aid the animal rescue, Leela and her crew try to leave Zapp's starship. But Zapp throws Fry and Bender in jail, and summons Leela to his "Lovenasium". They ultimately escape and arrive on the doomed planet, where Leela finally finds love - with a cute, and very useful, creature named Nibbler.

episodes.title: Fear of a Bot Planet
episodes.description: Fry and Leela disguise themselves as robots to find Bender after he fails to return from a delivery to a robot planet, only to learn that he has become a celebrity in a culture which fears humans.

episodes.title: A Fishful of Dollars
episodes.description: Fry discovers his bank account interest has made him a billionaire and buys the one thing the year 3000 doesn't have, anchovies.

episodes.title: My Three Suns
episodes.description: Delivery Boy Philip J. Fry is promoted to Emperor after accidentally drinking his fluid-based predecessor.

episodes.title: A Big Piece of Garbage
episodes.description: A big piece of garbage that was released a thousand years ago is now on the way to Earth to destroy it. After Fry, Leela and Bender fail on placing a bomb on it, the city has to build another big piece of garbage, yet that may be a problem since trash doesn't exist in year 3000.

episodes.title: Hell Is Other Robots
episodes.description: During a Beastie Boys concert, Bender runs into a high school buddy, Fender. He invites him to a party, which turns out to be robots getting high off of electricity, or "jacking on". After one try, Bender is hooked.

episodes.title: A Flight to Remember
episodes.description: The Planet Express crew take a space cruise vacation. Leela tells Captain Zapp Brannigan that Fry is her boyfriend and Amy tells the same thing to her parents. Bender falls in love with a rich female robot. Problems start when the spaceship approaches a black hole.

episodes.title: Mars University
episodes.description: Fry, Leela, Bender and Farnsworth have to go to Mars University where Fry has to share a room with a talking monkey, Farnsworth's last invention. The monkey becomes a real headache when he starts beating Fry in all areas. Meanwhile, Bender is hanging out with nerd robots.

episodes.title: When Aliens Attack
episodes.description: The Omicronians invade Earth, demanding to see the lost final episode of the 1999 TV show Single Female Lawyer. The Planet Express crew must re-enact the episode to appease the invading aliens.

episodes.title: Fry & the Slurm Factory
episodes.description: When Fry wins a free tour of the Slurm soda factory, he and his friends split off from the tour group and make a horrifying discovery concerning the "secret ingredient" that makes Slurm so addictive.

episodes.title: I Second That Emotion
episodes.description: Professor Farnsworth installs an empathy chip in Bender after the inconsiderate robot flushes Nibbler down the toilet. With his newfound emotions, a concerned Bender ventures into the mutant-infested sewers to rescue Leela's beloved pet.

episodes.title: Brannigan, Begin Again
episodes.description: Upon destroying the new DOOP headquarters, Zapp Brannigan and Kif find themselves court-martialed and dishonorably discharged. They take up jobs at Planet Express, where Kif learns what respect feels like and Zapp incites a mutiny against Leela.

episodes.title: A Head in the Polls
episodes.description: When the price of titanium skyrockets, Bender pawns his titanium-rich body and lives the high life as just a head. But when the head-in-a-jar of Richard M. Nixon uses Bender's body to run for election for President of Earth, Bender vows to get his rightful property back.

episodes.title: Xmas Story
episodes.description: To apologize for an inconsiderate remark, Fry searches for the perfect Xmas gift for Leela, all the while trying to avoid the murderous SantaBot, whose standards for niceness are astronomically high.

episodes.title: Why Must I Be a Crustacean in Love?
episodes.description: When Dr. Zoidberg runs amok during the Decapodian mating season, Fry sets out to teach him how to woo a mate. Things backfire when Zoidberg's desired mate falls for Fry instead, and Zoidberg challenges Fry to a battle to the death.

episodes.title: Put Your Head on My Shoulders
episodes.description: Fry's brief relationship with Amy is forcibly prolonged when a near-fatal car crash leaves Fry's head grafted to Amy's left shoulder. Meanwhile, Bender cashes in on Valentine's Day by starting a dating service.

episodes.title: Lesser of Two Evils
episodes.description: Fry suspects Bender's new buddy, a bending unit named Flexo who looks almost exactly like Bender, of being pure evil. When a valuable atom of Jumbonium goes missing, Fry suspects Flexo, but can't tell which robot is which.

episodes.title: Raging Bender
episodes.description: Bender is the featured attraction in the Ultimate Robot Fighting League, but his glory is short-lived when he is instructed to intentionally lose his next match. Leela vows to lead Bender to victory, in an effort to show up her unsupportive martial arts teacher.

episodes.title: A Bicyclops Built For Two
episodes.description: Leela meets Alkazar, who claims to be the only other remaining cyclops in the universe. But when Alkazar invites Leela back to his home planet and treats her like a slave, Fry suspects that something is amiss.

episodes.title: How Hermes Requisitioned His Groove Back
episodes.description: When Hermes takes a stress-relieving vacation, replacement bureaucrat Morgan Proctor becomes infatuated with Fry. Bender threatens to publicize their affair, but Morgan removes Bender's memory and hides it within the cavernous Central Bureaucracy.

episodes.title: A Clone of My Own
episodes.description: Professor Farnsworth unveils his clone, Cubert Farnsworth, whom he plans to leave everything to upon his retirement. But Cubert wants no part of Farnsworth's lifestyle, prompting the professor into a premature retirement on the Near-Death Star.

episodes.title: The Deep South
episodes.description: A fishing trip over the ocean takes a turn for the worse when a colossal mouth bass pulls the Planet Express ship to the bottom of the sea. There, Fry falls in love with a mermaid named Umbriel, and the crew discovers the sunken city of Atlanta, Georgia.

episodes.title: Bender Gets Made
episodes.description: Bender takes a new job in the Robot Mafia, but his loyalty is tested when he goes along on the robotic gangster's efforts to rob the Planet Express ship.

episodes.title: The Problem with Popplers
episodes.description: The crew discovers an irresistible source of food on a distant planet, and brings it back to Earth to be sold at the Fishy Joe's restaurant chain. But when it's discovered that the so-called "Popplers" are actually Omicronian babies, the Omicronians demand recompense.

episodes.title: Mother's Day
episodes.description: Mom reprograms the world's robots to rebel against humanity. The only hope of salvation is Mom's old flame - Professor Farnsworth, who must rekindle his romance with Mom in order to save mankind.

episodes.title: Anthology of Interest I
episodes.description: The Professor's "What-If" machine simulates Bender, Leela and Fry's wishes. Bender discovers what it would be like if he were 500 feet tall, Leela discovers what it would be like if she were more impulsive, and Fry discovers what would happen if he never came to the future.

episodes.title: The Honking
episodes.description: When the inheritance Bender claims in the Old Country isn't quite what he expected, the Planet Express crew has to find the source of an age-old curse.

episodes.title: War Is the H-Word
episodes.description: Fry and Bender enlist in the army to get a soldiers discount for bubblegum. When they are called to fight a war on a planet of bouncing ball aliens, Leela disguises herself as man to enlist with them. Bender is eventually sent to parley with the enemy, but this turns out to be a ploy.

episodes.title: The Cryonic Woman
episodes.description: Fry is reunited with his old girlfriend from the 20th Century, but she doesn't adapt to the 31st century as well as he has. Convincing Fry to return to the cryogenic chamber, they awaken in a barren wasteland and struggle to make a place for themselves.

episodes.title: Parasites Lost
episodes.description: When Fry becomes infested with parasitic worms that make him stronger and smarter, he finally finds the perfect way to profess his feelings to Leela. Meanwhile, the rest of the crew goes on a journey into Fry's body to eradicate the worms.

episodes.title: Amazon Women in the Mood
episodes.description: A double-date for Kif, Amy, Zapp, and Leela ends in disaster when their orbiting restaurant crashes on planet Amazonia. The hulking female inhabitants of the planet take their male captives to the omniscient Femputer, who orders Fry, Zapp, and Kif to death by "snu-snu".

episodes.title: Bendless Love
episodes.description: Bender's urge to bend prompts Professor Farnsworth to send him on a rehabilitation visit to a steel factory, where he falls in love with a shapely fem-bot named Angleyne. But Bender's old rival Flexo and the intrusion of the Robot Mafia threaten to throw a wrench into the proceedings.

episodes.title: The Day the Earth Stood Stupid
episodes.description: Earth is invaded by super-intelligent flying brains, who sap the Earth's populace of their intelligence. Leela is taken to Nibbler's home planet Eternia, where the Nibblonians explain that only one human is immune to the brains' powers - Fry.

episodes.title: That's Lobstertainment!
episodes.description: Dr. Zoidberg reunites with his uncle, silent hologram star Harold Zoid, and the two of them set out to make a movie together. They cast the temperamental Calculon in the lead role, who demands an Oscar for his performance, but the movie doesn't go over well with audiences.

episodes.title: The Birdbot of Ice-Catraz
episodes.description: A sober Bender crashes a dark matter tanker on Pluto, threatening the penguin reserve nearby. Leela helps out in the clean-up, but when the penguins begin mating out of control, drastic action must be taken to thin the herd.

episodes.title: The Luck of the Fryrish
episodes.description: After a string of bad luck, Fry ventures into the decaying ruins of Old New York to regain his lucky seven-leaf clover from his childhood, only to find that his brother Yancy Fry had stolen not only the clover, but Fry's identity as well. Fry sets out to exhume his brother's body, but discovers the startling truth about Yancy instead.

episodes.title: The Cyber House Rules
episodes.description: Leela meets up with her former orphanarium playmate Adlai Atkins, now a plastic surgeon, who offers to grant Leela surgery that will give her two eyes. Meanwhile, Bender adopts twelve orphans in order to collect $1200 in government stipends.

episodes.title: Insane in the Mainframe
episodes.description: Accused of robbing a bank, Fry and Bender plead insanity and are both sent to a robot insane asylum. While Bender and his buddy Roberto plan an escape, Fry is brainwashed into thinking that he is a robot.

episodes.title: Bendin' in the Wind
episodes.description: When Bender is paralyzed in a tragic can opener accident, he discovers his musical washboard skills and goes on tour as a member of Beck's folk-rock band, acting as a voice for broken robots everywhere. Fry, Leela, Amy, and Zoidberg tag along in Fry's antique 1960s VW Van.

episodes.title: Time Keeps On Slippin'
episodes.description: While creating a team of mutants to play the Harlem Globetrotters, the Professor accidentally causes a disruption in time that threatens the existence of the universe. Meanwhile, Fry tries to win an unreceptive Leela's heart.

episodes.title: I Dated a Robot
episodes.description: Fry discovers the ability to download any celebrity onto a blank robot, and chooses to download Lucy Liu, with whom he falls madly in love. Repulsed by this disgusting display of human/robot love, Leela, Bender, and Zoidberg set out to shut down Nappster.com and put an end to illegal celebrity downloads forever.

episodes.title: Roswell That Ends Well
episodes.description: A spacetime accident leaves the Planet Express crew stranded in Roswell, New Mexico in the year 1947, where a shattered Bender is mistaken for UFO debris and Zoidberg is captured as an alien specimen. Leela and the professor work to get everybody home, while Fry tries to keep his accident-prone grandfather alive.

episodes.title: A Tale of Two Santas
episodes.description: A Planet Express mission to Robot Santa's colony on Neptune leaves the murderous robot trapped in the frozen sea, and Bender takes over as Santa, vowing to bring peace and goodwill to Xmas again. But when Bender is mistaken for the real Robot Santa, he is arrested and sentenced to death.

episodes.title: Anthology of Interest II
episodes.description: When the Professor fine tunes his "What-If" machine, Bender discovers what it would be like if he were human, Fry discovers what it would be like if life were more like a video game, and Leela discovers what it would be like if she found her true home.

episodes.title: Love and Rocket
episodes.description: As Valentine's Day approaches, Bender's romance with the Planet Express ship puts the crew in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Leela's Homeworld
episodes.description: Leela finally learns the truth about her parents and her own identity.

episodes.title: Where the Buggalo Roam
episodes.description: When Amy's parents' ranch is hit by a dust storm that blows away their herd of buggalo, Kif sets out to prove his masculinity by rounding up the herd, only to become entangled with the native Martians.

episodes.title: A Pharaoh to Remember
episodes.description: Bender fears that nobody will remember him after he dies, and sees his chance for immortality when the crew is enslaved on the planet Osiris 4. Posing as the planet's new pharaoh, Bender orders a humongous statue built in his honor, and quickly goes mad with power.

episodes.title: Godfellas
episodes.description: Bender is accidentally shot out of the ship's torpedo tube and becomes lost in space. Floating through the ethereal darkness, Bender becomes inhabited with tiny alien life forms, but has trouble playing God to their unyielding prayers.

episodes.title: Future Stock
episodes.description: With Planet Express in financial trouble, Fry nominates a flashy businessman from the 1980s to replace Professor Farnsworth as CEO of the company.

episodes.title: A Leela of Her Own
episodes.description: Leela endeavors to become the first female blernsball player, but her lack of depth perception hinders her skills. Nevertheless, she becomes the pitcher for the New New York Mets, purely for her novelty value.

episodes.title: 30% Iron Chef
episodes.description: Bender, insulted by the reception his terrible cooking receives, runs away and joins a space hobo camp, where he apprentices with a legendary former TV chef. Meanwhile, Dr. Zoidberg accidentally destroys Professor Farnsworth's prized ship-in-a-bottle and frames Fry.

episodes.title: Where No Fan Has Gone Before
episodes.description: The crew is pitted against the original Star Trek cast to win the devotion of an energy creature.

episodes.title: Crimes of the Hot
episodes.description: When Earth is jeopardized by global warming, the crew attends a conference in Kyoto hosted by Al Gore's head.

episodes.title: Jurassic Bark
episodes.description: Bender grows jealous when Fry attempts to clone Seymour, his beloved fossilized dog.

episodes.title: The Route of All Evil
episodes.description: Farnsworth's clone Cubert teams up with Hermes' son Dwight to launch a newspaper delivery business. Farnsworth and Hermes scoff at the kids' efforts - until the delivery boys accumulate enough capital to buy out Planet Express. Meanwhile, Fry and Leela use Bender to brew their own homemade beer.

episodes.title: A Taste of Freedom
episodes.description: Zoidberg becomes the center of a Supreme Court case after he celebrates Freedom Day by publicly eating the Earth flag.

episodes.title: Kif Gets Knocked Up a Notch
episodes.description: When Kif gets pregnant, Amy questions her readiness to become a parent.

episodes.title: Less Than Hero
episodes.description: When Fry and Leela discover a cream that gives them unusual powers, they form a superhero team along with Bender.

episodes.title: Teenage Mutant Leela's Hurdles
episodes.description: The Planet Express crew is exposed to a substance that causes everyone to age backwards.

episodes.title: The Why of Fry
episodes.description: Nibbler enlists Fry in a mission to blow up evil brains bent on destroying the universe.

episodes.title: The Sting
episodes.description: The Planet Express crew attempt the mission that killed the last crew: raiding a massive alien beehive for its honey.

episodes.title: The Farnsworth Parabox
episodes.description: The Planet Express crew goes to a parallel universe made accessible by the Professor's latest experiment.

episodes.title: Three Hundred Big Boys
episodes.description: With the help of a $300 government refund, the Planet Express crew pursue their dreams and desires.

episodes.title: Spanish Fry
episodes.description: Fry's nose is stolen by alien poachers to sell as a black market aphrodesiac.

episodes.title: Bend Her
episodes.description: Bender's scam to win Olympic gold sets him on the road to becoming a celebrity wife.

episodes.title: Obsoletely Fabulous
episodes.description: A new model of robot threatens Bender, forcing him to run away after he avoids upgrading his own technology.

episodes.title: Bender Should Not Be Allowed on TV
episodes.description: Bender becomes a television star as well as a terrible role model for children.

episodes.title: The Devil's Hands Are Idle Playthings
episodes.description: Fry makes a deal with the Robot Devil so he can become a skillful musician and win Leela's heart.

title: Black Mirror
description: Twisted tales run wild in this mind-bending anthology series that reveals humanity's worst traits, greatest innovations and more.

episodes.title: The National Anthem
episodes.description: Prime Minister Michael Callow faces a shocking dilemma when Princess Susannah, a much-loved member of the Royal Family, is kidnapped.

episodes.title: Fifteen Million Merits
episodes.description: After failing to impress the judges on a singing competition show, a woman must either perform degrading acts or return to a slave-like existence.

episodes.title: The Entire History of You
episodes.description: In the near future, everyone has access to a memory implant that records everything humans do, see and hear.

episodes.title: Be Right Back
episodes.description: After learning about a new service that lets people stay in touch with the deceased, a lonely, grieving Martha reconnects with her late lover.

episodes.title: White Bear
episodes.description: Victoria wakes up and cannot remember anything about her life. Everyone she encounters refuses to communicate with her.

episodes.title: The Waldo Moment
episodes.description: A failed comedian who voices a popular cartoon bear named Waldo finds himself mixing in politics when TV executives want Waldo to run for office.

episodes.title: White Christmas
episodes.description: In a mysterious and remote snowy outpost, Matt and Potter share a Christmas meal together, swapping creepy tales of their earlier lives in the outside world.

episodes.title: Nosedive
episodes.description: A woman desperate to boost her social media score hits the jackpot when she's invited to a swanky wedding. But the trip doesn't go as planned.

episodes.title: Playtest
episodes.description: An American traveler short on cash signs up to test a revolutionary new gaming system, only to discover the thrills are a little too real.

episodes.title: Shut Up and Dance
episodes.description: After a virus infects his laptop, a teen faces a daunting choice: carry out orders delivered by text message, or risk having intimate secrets exposed.

episodes.title: San Junipero
episodes.description: In a seaside town in 1987, a shy young woman and an outgoing party girl strike up a powerful bond that seems to defy the laws of space and time.

episodes.title: Men Against Fire
episodes.description: After his first battle with an elusive enemy, a soldier begins experiencing unfamiliar sensations and strange technical glitches.

episodes.title: Hated in the Nation
episodes.description: The death of a journalist at the center of a social media firestorm leads a veteran detective and her tech-savvy apprentice to a chilling discovery.

episodes.title: USS Callister
episodes.description: Capt. Robert Daly presides over his crew with wisdom and courage. But a new recruit will soon discover nothing on this spaceship is what it seems.

episodes.title: Arkangel
episodes.description: Worried about her daughter's safety, single mom Marie signs up for a cutting-edge device that monitors the girl's whereabouts -- and much more.

episodes.title: Crocodile
episodes.description: Architect Mia scrambles to keep a dark secret under wraps, while insurance investigator Shazia harvests people's memories of a nearby accident scene.

episodes.title: Hang the DJ
episodes.description: Paired up by a dating program that puts an expiration date on all relationships, Frank and Amy soon begin to question the system's logic.

episodes.title: Metalhead
episodes.description: At an abandoned warehouse, scavengers searching for supplies encounter a ruthless foe and flee for their lives through a bleak wasteland.

episodes.title: Black Museum
episodes.description: On a dusty stretch of highway, a traveler stumbles across a museum that boasts rare criminal artifacts -- and a disturbing main attraction.

episodes.title: Striking Vipers
episodes.description: When old college friends Danny and Karl reconnect in a VR version of their favorite video game, the late-night sessions yield an unexpected discovery.

episodes.title: Smithereens
episodes.description: A London rideshare driver ignites an international crisis when he kidnaps a worker from a social media company.

episodes.title: Rachel, Jack and Ashley Too
episodes.description: A lonely teen becomes obsessed with a robot doll based on her pop star idol, Ashley O - just as the real Ashley's life begins to unravel.

title: SEAL Team
description: Military drama following the professional and personal lives of the most elite unit of Navy SEALs as they train, plan and execute the most dangerous, high stakes missions our country can ask of them.

episodes.title: Tip of the Spear
episodes.description: Team Bravo, an elite Tier One Navy SEAL unit, is sent on a clandestine mission to capture a most-wanted terrorist alive. Meanwhile, team leader Jason Hayes must deal with personal issues affecting his marriage and family.

episodes.title: Other Lives
episodes.description: While on an evidence-collecting mission in Syria, Jason and the SEAL Team find innocent civilians in desperate need of rescue just as enemy forces close in on them. Also, while on the mission, the team debates whether or not to tell Ray that his wife has gone into labor.

episodes.title: Boarding Party
episodes.description: Jason and the SEAL team must rescue a group of researchers being held hostage on a ship in the South China Sea. Also, Clay is ranked in the "bottom five" of his class, jeopardizing his future as a SEAL

episodes.title: Ghosts of Christmas Future
episodes.description: Jason and the SEAL Team refuse to abort a mission to capture a dangerous war criminal after it goes sideways. Also, Clay's controversial father, Ash Spenser, comes to town on his book tour.

episodes.title: Collapse
episodes.description: Jason and the SEAL Team must protect the American Embassy in South Sudan when the ambassador refuses to evacuate as the country becomes increasingly unstable. Also, Clay and Stella take their relationship to the next level.

episodes.title: The Spinning Wheel
episodes.description: The SEAL Team must work with Jason's longtime rival, Beau Fuller, and his team to plan and perfect a raid under the watchful eye of top military brass. Also, Clay delivers solemn news to a teammate's next of kin.

episodes.title: Borderlines
episodes.description: Jason and the SEAL Team must rescue an undercover CIA operative after she is captured by radical terrorists to be used as a bargaining chip. Also, Clay undergoes the final harrowing exercise for his candidacy into Tier One.

episodes.title: The Exchange
episodes.description: Jason and the SEAL Team have mixed feelings when they are tasked with bringing home an American soldier who was captured after deserting, in exchange for detainees in Gitmo.

episodes.title: Rolling Dark
episodes.description: Jason and the SEAL team must rescue a Russian scientist and his wife and bring them across the Afghanistan border to safety as Chinese and Russian Special Forces close in, intent on stopping them. Also, Clay endures his first day with Jason's unit.

episodes.title: Pattern of Life
episodes.description: Tensions are high when Jason and the SEAL Team enter a Yemeni house to locate a cell phone linked to a terrorist network, and interrogate the family while the daughter lays in critical condition after being accidentally shot.

episodes.title: Containment
episodes.description: Jason and the SEAL team are sent to intercept the sale of nuclear weapons, but the mission goes sideways when they must make the treacherous journey back to base with nukes that have unsecured fuel rods. Also, Ray is sidelined with a shoulder injury, and Jason and Alana are shocked by their kids' reactions when the topic of their reunion is brought up.

episodes.title: The Upside Down
episodes.description: While on a mission to retrieve a downed top-secret drone, Jason and the SEAL Team disobey orders so they can save Clay, who is trapped beneath a room full of armed terrorists. Also, Clay and Stella's relationship takes a new turn.

episodes.title: Getaway Day
episodes.description: Jason and the SEAL Team must leave their families immediately when their deployment date is moved up after the team they were going to relieve is ambushed. Also, Jason and Alana make a big decision about their future, and Clay and Stella feel the weight of his marriage proposal.

episodes.title: Call Out
episodes.description: Jason and the SEAL Team settle into deployment life and get closer to discovering who ambushed Echo Team after Mandy gets a lead from an unlikely source on the base.

episodes.title: No Man's Land
episodes.description: Jason and the SEAL Team close in on avenging the deaths of Echo Team when they find the money that funded their murder on a nearby poppy farm that was previously used to make heroin. Also, Jason meets an intriguing woman on the base.

episodes.title: Never Get Out of the Boat
episodes.description: Jason leads the SEAL Team on a dangerous daytime mission where Sonny is wounded and must now rely on Clay and his brothers to save his life.

episodes.title: In Name Only
episodes.description: As Jason and the SEAL Team come closer to avenging the loss of Echo Team, Mandy takes matters into her own hands after her boss won't green-light her mission to take out their biggest target. Also, Jason is unsure of where his relationship with Amy stands.

episodes.title: Credible Threat
episodes.description: Jason and the SEAL Team are tasked with protecting a delegation of congressmen and department of defense officials who come to Jalalabad for a publicity tour even though a credible threat has been made against them.

episodes.title: Takedown
episodes.description: The SEAL Team sends Ray undercover in a busy spice market to make a high-stakes money swap, and Jason attempts to take down a terrorist known to wear a suicide belt. Also, Ray realizes the devastating consequences of his decisions.

episodes.title: Enemy of My Enemy
episodes.description: The lives of Jason and the SEAL Team are in jeopardy when a risky mission to capture a highly valuable target may actually be a trap. Also, Clay and Davis commiserate about the frustrations of having long distance relationships, and Ray has a meeting regarding his involvement with the accidental death of the local boy that could affect his military career.

episodes.title: The Graveyard of Empires
episodes.description: Following a helicopter crash, the SEAL Team must proceed with the mission as hostiles bear down on them and an injured and impaired Jason goes after their target alone.

episodes.title: The Cost of Doing Business
episodes.description: After Jason lies about his concussion to get cleared for combat, he and the SEAL Team plan a final mission to avenge Echo Team's deaths once and for all before they return home from deployment.

episodes.title: Fracture
episodes.description: Jason and Bravo Team head to the Gulf of Guinea to rescue American hostages after an oil platform is overtaken by armed militants.

episodes.title: Never Say Die
episodes.description: Jason and Bravo Team travel to Saudi Arabia, where extremists take hold of an underground water source and threaten to release anthrax into the water supply. Also, Ray contemplates joining another team.

episodes.title: The Worst of Conditions
episodes.description: After tragedy strikes, Jason is faced with a huge decision regarding his future with Bravo Team.

episodes.title: All That Matters
episodes.description: Bravo Team is in Mumbai to rescue a U.S. Foreign Service officer being held hostage by radicals who attacked the city. Also, Jason reevaluates his parenting style and finds a way to connect with his kids.

episodes.title: Say Again Your Last
episodes.description: While tasked with rescuing a group of American students held hostage in Mumbai, Bravo Team suffers life-threatening injuries.

episodes.title: Hold What You Got
episodes.description: Bravo Team partners with the Mexican Marines to hunt the head of one of the most powerful and lethal drug cartels in Mexico.

episodes.title: Outside the Wire
episodes.description: Bravo Team continues to follow tips that will lead to Andres Doza, the head of one of the most powerful and lethal drug cartels in Mexico.

episodes.title: Parallax
episodes.description: Jason and Mandy go undercover as a couple on vacation at an upscale night club in Mexico City in order to track one of Andres Doza's cartel members.

episodes.title: Santa Muerte
episodes.description: Following an ambush, the SEAL team suspects someone on the inside is leaking information to the cartel.

episodes.title: Prisoner's Dilemma
episodes.description: The hunt for Andres Doza comes to a head when the SEAL Team makes one last ditch effort to find and capture the leader of one of the most powerful and lethal drug cartels in Mexico.

episodes.title: Backwards in High Heels
episodes.description: Bravo Team partners with the British Special Air Service to rescue passengers on a hijacked plane who are taken hostage by terrorists.

episodes.title: Things Not Seen
episodes.description: Bravo Team travels to Turkey to rescue a young American who voluntarily married an ISIS leader.

episodes.title: Time to Shine
episodes.description: Bravo Team desperately works to save Sonny from a life-threatening situation, after he becomes trapped in a submarine torpedo tube during a clandestine mission off the coast of North Korea.

episodes.title: What Appears to Be
episodes.description: Bravo Team works with the Congolese Army on a covert mission to capture the head of a rebel militia group. Jason argues with Emma about college. Sonny and Davis make a big decision about their future.

episodes.title: You Only Die Once
episodes.description: Bravo Team sets out on a special ops mission to take down the financier and mastermind behind several terrorist attacks.

episodes.title: Dirt, Dirt, Gucci
episodes.description: As Bravo Team prepares for what they expect to be a "cushy" deployment with the luxury of staying in a hotel in the Philippines, Jason tries to find a way to pay for Emma's college.

episodes.title: Paradise Lost
episodes.description: While Bravo Team is deployed to train Filipino SEALs, a surprise bomb attack in Manila leaves them in peril.

episodes.title: Payback
episodes.description: Bravo Team is out for revenge as they search for the person responsible for the surprise bomb attack that left one of their own in peril.

episodes.title: Medicate and Isolate
episodes.description: While Bravo Team is on a recovery mission in Mali, their friend, former Navy SEAL Brett Swan, continues to struggle with his mental health.

episodes.title: Rock Bottom
episodes.description: The tension between Jason and Ray comes to a head, and Lisa faces her final test in officer candidate school.

episodes.title: My Life for Yours
episodes.description: Bravo Team desperately searches for Ray after he gets separated from them while in enemy territory.

episodes.title: Never Out of the Fight
episodes.description: Bravo team's future is on the line when Commander Shaw recommends they be split up, but Jason's unit has one final mission to prove him wrong.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Refuge
episodes.description: Jason Hayes leads the team on a mission in Serbia to track down an organization linked to the bombing of multiple American military outposts.

episodes.title: Ignore and Override
episodes.description: Bravo Team continues their mission in Serbia to track down an organization linked to the bombing of multiple American military outposts, when Jason Hayes' past returns to haunt him and leaves him contemplating his future.

episodes.title: Theory and Methodology
episodes.description: Bravo Team is on a mission in Azerbaijan to help retake a power plant in order to avoid political instability in the area.

episodes.title: The Strength of the Wolf
episodes.description: Tensions boil over among Bravo members when they disagree while training for a mission, and Jason must select a new candidate to join the team.

episodes.title: All Along the Watchtower (1)
episodes.description: Jason pleads to be sent to help Ray and Clay, who are abroad on a mission to protect a U.S. ambassador when their compound is attacked.

episodes.title: All Along the Watchtower (2)
episodes.description: While on a mission abroad to protect U.S. ambassador Nicole Marsden, Bravo Team must fight off enemy attackers trying to infiltrate their compound.

episodes.title: The Ones You Can't See
episodes.description: As Jason contemplates surgery for an injury, Bravo Team is on a mission abroad to help the secret service prevent a sniper attack on U.S. dignitaries.

episodes.title: Danger Crossing
episodes.description: While Jason is sidelined with an injury, Ray takes over as Bravo 1 and leads the team on a mission to rescue a marine pilot who was shot down in enemy territory.

episodes.title: Kill or Cure
episodes.description: Bravo team is on a mission to protect aid convoys in an Ebola hot zone after a warlord steals preserved samples of the virus that can be weaponized.

episodes.title: Unbecoming an Officer
episodes.description: Jason leads Bravo Team on his first mission back following surgery, and Ensign Davis faces disciplinary action

episodes.title: Siege Protocol
episodes.description: Amid several life-altering moments on the home front, Bravo Team travels overseas to extract a CIA agent who is being held hostage. As the situation escalates, the Tactical Operations Center is compromised and Bravo's support team comes face-to-face with the enemy.

episodes.title: Fog of War
episodes.description: Following a mission failure, Bravo Team conducts a high-stakes After Action Review to identify who’s responsible for a possible career-ending mistake.

episodes.title: Objects in Mirror
episodes.description: Bravo Team travels overseas for a foreign training exercise to disguise their true mission – to rescue a high-value target that is being held hostage. Also, NASCAR driver Austin Dillon gives the team a special driving lesson.

episodes.title: Rules of Engagement
episodes.description: While Bravo Team is on a special reconnaissance mission abroad, they are diverted to protect a group of American engineers and the dam they are constructing from a terrorist attack. The rules of engagement raise the level of danger, as the team is not permitted to use their weapons unless the enemy fires first.

episodes.title: Last Known Location
episodes.description: Tensions flare on the home front, as Sonny faces disciplinary action, Clay considers a new career path and Jason faces pressure from Capt. Lindell to consider the next phase of his career, all while Bravo Team prepares for a three-month deployment in Afghanistan.

episodes.title: Drawdown
episodes.description: As Bravo Team begins their deployment in Afghanistan during peace negotiations, Sonny reports to an Air Force base in Texas to serve his disciplinary training action, where he gets reacquainted with Hannah, a childhood friend.

episodes.title: Edge of Nowhere
episodes.description: Bravo Team searches for a new terrorist group leader who is orchestrating violent resistance to peace negotiations in Afghanistan. Also, Clay learns what it means to be a leader and Sonny works to repair his relationship with his father in Texas.

episodes.title: In the Blind
episodes.description: Bravo Team gets ambushed by enemy forces during a mission to extract a potential link to a new terrorist leader. Also, Sonny considers planting roots in his hometown.

episodes.title: No Choice in Duty
episodes.description: While Jason escorts Mandy on a condolence visit to the family of a fallen informant, Ray leads Bravo on an urgent mission when they are confronted with a time-sensitive lead on a terrorist leader's location. Also, Davis reveals to the team that the terrorist leader they've been searching for is related to a target from Jason's past, and Sonny rejoins Bravo team in Afghanistan.

episodes.title: God of War / Forever War
episodes.description: Bravo Team enters enemy territory in the snowy Spin Ghar Mountain Range to capture Al-Hazred, the leader of a terrorist group and son of the terrorist leader that Jason took down early in his career and made him Bravo One. When they are attacked, Jason and Cerberus, Bravo's canine member, are separated from the team. / Bravo Team reunites with Jason and Cerberus, then go underground to search booby-trapped tunnels for terrorist leader Al-Hazred.Bravo Team reunites with Jason and Cerberus, then go underground to search booby-trapped tunnels for terrorist leader Al-Hazred.

episodes.title: The New Normal
episodes.description: Bravo Team struggles to adjust to a new team dynamic after several members make life-altering career decisions.

episodes.title: Shockwave
episodes.description: When Warrant Officer Ray Perry goes missing following an explosion in Tunisia, his former teammates wrestle with how to help their brother and his family while Bravo Team is sidelined.

episodes.title: The Carrot or The Stick
episodes.description: With no leads on Ray's whereabouts, Jason pushes Bravo team to extreme lengths and considers crossing a dangerous line to help locate their missing brother. Meanwhile, Ray tries to survive captivity.

episodes.title: Horror Has a Face
episodes.description: As Ensign Davis tracks Ray's location to a shipping container in the Mediterranean Ocean, Bravo team becomes increasingly desperate to rescue their brother before it's too late.

episodes.title: All In
episodes.description: As Bravo continues grappling with major changes, the team spins up on a mission in Ecuador. Also, Natalie presents a life-changing idea to Jason.

episodes.title: Cover for Action
episodes.description: When Jason returns to Bravo, tensions rise as Ray outranks him on a mission to recover military drones in Syria. Sonny receives surprising news from Texas.

episodes.title: Reckoning
episodes.description: As Ray continues to lead the mission in Syria, the stakes grow higher when members of Bravo team learn the truth about their target.

episodes.title: A Question of Honor
episodes.description: Jason's career and freedom hang in the balance when Command accuses him of committing a horrific crime during a mission. With Bravo under a no-contact order, Jason must fight this battle without his brothers.

episodes.title: Limits of Loyalty
episodes.description: Jason is put on trial with a potential career-ending outcome, without knowing if his closest friend, Ray, has his back. Also, Stella moves in with Clay, and Sonny visits Hannah to help her prepare for the arrival of their baby.

episodes.title: Rearview Mirror
episodes.description: Jason's visit with a former teammate causes him to reevaluate his role as team leader. Also, several Bravo members grapple with their personal relationships when Command sends them on an unexpected mission to the coast of Africa.

episodes.title: Do No Harm
episodes.description: Bravo is tasked with bringing a defecting Boko Haram lieutenant into U.S. custody, but the mission goes sideways when the target gets attacked. Sonny drops the ball as Bravo's rep on the USS Keating, and the entire team pays the price.

episodes.title: Hollow at the Core
episodes.description: Bravo is tasked with a covert mission to infiltrate a Boko Haram camp, hack its data network and rescue an American hostage.

episodes.title: Nightmare of My Choice
episodes.description: Bravo joins forces to protect a crucial Nigerian pipeline under attack by Boko Haram. But when a team member is injured, Jason and Clay fight to save his life, and Bravo discovers an even more dangerous enemy is attacking them.

episodes.title: One Life to Live
episodes.description: Bravo takes a devastating hit that will change the team forever, and forces each of the members to make some big personal decisions. Fourth season finale.

episodes.title: Trust, But Verify (1)
episodes.description: Everyone on Bravo is shocked when they learn a training exercise is really cover for a covert mission to get a weapons expert out of one of the most dangerous countries in the world.

episodes.title: Trust, But Verify (2)
episodes.description: When Bravo's operation is compromised, they must figure out how to escape undetected from one of the most dangerous countries in the world.

episodes.title: Nine Ten
episodes.description: As members of Bravo team travel to New York City, they reflect on a day that shaped each of their lives forever.

episodes.title: Need to Know (1)
episodes.description: As each member of Bravo confronts major family obstacles, the team gets spun up on a sudden mission in Africa. When the intel alters their plan, the team finds themselves in a rush to prevent a major terrorist attack.

episodes.title: Frog on the Tracks (2)
episodes.description: Team Bravo races against the clock to prevent a terrorist attack, while attempting to locate and capture their enemy. Preoccupied with questions, Jason must make a tough call to get the answers he so deeply craves.

episodes.title: Man on Fire (3)
episodes.description: Bravo manages to escape their SUV engulfed in flames, but plans go awry when Jason's personal and professional lives become intertwined and he's forced to make decisions that put Bravo's jobs and lives at risk. The team works through disagreements, reveals exciting personal news and an unlikely hero emerges.

episodes.title: What's Past Is Prologue
episodes.description: Bravo returns to Afghanistan to continue the fight against the Taliban, and the Team ruminates on America's longtime involvement in the War on Terror.

episodes.title: Conspicuous Gallantry
episodes.description: After an op gone sideways lands the whole team in the hospital, Bravo must create a little chaos to stay calm, while Clay tries to piece together what went wrong.

episodes.title: Close to Home
episodes.description: Jason seeks refuge at home while Ray leads Bravo Team on an op accompanying British forces.

episodes.title: Head On
episodes.description: Bravo Team is presented with a mission in South America unlike any other, while tensions surrounding Jason's leadership are at an all-time high.

episodes.title: Violence of Action
episodes.description: Bravo Team is still on the ground in South America working against the Iranian nuclear project. Multiple high stakes missions only make the team's interpersonal problems more obvious to all.

episodes.title: Keys to Heaven
episodes.description: Jason must confront his deepest fears on the road to healing while Clay and Sonny are forced to take certain matters into their own hands.

episodes.title: Pillar of Strength
episodes.description: Bravo will need all hands on deck for a massive mission to shut down the Venezuelan nuclear program, but the biggest threat to their success could be one of their own.

episodes.title: All Bravo Stations
episodes.description: Bravo must make a daring escape before they can put Venezuela in their rearview mirror, but they find themselves on even less stable ground when they return home to Virginia Beach.

title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
description: Agent Phil Coulson of S.H.I.E.L.D. (Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division) puts together a team of agents to investigate the new, the strange and the unknown around the globe, protecting the ordinary from the extraordinary.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: After the events of The Avengers, S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent Phil Coulson assembles a small team of agents to investigate a mysterious group called the Rising Tide. In doing so, they encounter Mike Peterson, a man who has acquired superhuman powers.

Coulson and his S.H.I.E.L.D. agents travel to Peru to investigate an object of unknown origin, codenamed 0-8-4. But when he runs into Comandante Camilla Reyes, more than just sparks fly at 30,000 feet.

episodes.title: The Asset
episodes.description: When the brilliant scientist, Dr. Franklin Hall, is kidnapped, Agent Coulson and his S.H.I.E.L.D. agents must race against the clock to locate him. Skye is their only way in–pushing the team to their limits when the entire plan turns upside-down.

episodes.title: Eye Spy
episodes.description: Agent Coulson and the S.H.I.E.L.D. team try to track down a mysterious woman who has single-handedly committed numerous high-stakes heists. But when the woman’s identity is revealed, a troubling secret stands to ruin Coulson.

episodes.title: Girl in the Flower Dress
episodes.description: An elusive girl in a flower dress may hold the key to the mystery that brings Coulson and team to Asia to rescue a young man with an unusual and dangerous power; and Skye has a secret that jeopardizes her relationship with the team right when they need her most.

episodes.title: FZZT
episodes.description: When floating bodies turn up, Coulson and the agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. must hunt down an elusive killer. No one is safe - not even the team.

episodes.title: The Hub
episodes.description: Dangerous secrets are being kept from Coulson's Team, and he works the system to save Ward and Fitz when they are sent on a Level 8 classified mission that may end in tragedy.

episodes.title: The Well
episodes.description: In the aftermath of the events chronicled in the feature film Marvel's Thor: The Dark World, Coulson and the agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. pick up the pieces–one of which threatens to destroy a member of the team.

episodes.title: Repairs
episodes.description: Coulson and his team are haunted by a ghost that threatens to destroy them all, and only a secret from May's past can save them.

episodes.title: The Bridge
episodes.description: In a shocking cliffhanger episode, Coulson takes the war back to Centipede, and this time he brings in Michael Peterson for some super-soldier support. As they get closer to the truth, startling secrets are revealed and an unexpected twist threatens the team.

episodes.title: The Magical Place
episodes.description: S.H.I.E.L.D. organizes a full scale hunt for Coulson. Meanwhile, Coulson uncovers vital information about the mystery of his death, but, with Centipede out for blood, this knowledge may come at the cost of one of the team!

episodes.title: Seeds
episodes.description: Coulson and May uncover startling information about Skye's past, while the team is swept into a storm at a S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy of Science and Technology.

episodes.title: T.R.A.C.K.S.
episodes.description: Hot on the trail of The Clairvoyant, Coulson and his team board a mystery train that seems to be headed for certain death.

episodes.title: T.A.H.I.T.I.
episodes.description: Coulson goes on the attack to save Skye by enlisting the aid of Ward's former S.O. John Garrett and uncovers shocking truths about his own life and S.H.I.E.L.D.

episodes.title: Yes Men
episodes.description: When Coulson and his team are attacked by Lorelei - a deadly seductress who escaped from Asgard - Thor’s Lady Sif, her longtime nemesis, steps in to try to save them.

episodes.title: End of the Beginning
episodes.description: Agents Garrett and Triplett are back to help Coulson's Team track down S.H.I.E.L.D.'s nefarious enemy--The Clairvoyant. But will Deathlok destroy them all to protect his master's identity?

episodes.title: Turn, Turn, Turn
episodes.description: Coulson and his team find themselves without anyone they can trust, only to discover that they are trapped with a traitor in their midst.

episodes.title: Providence
episodes.description: With Colonel Glenn Talbot now on their trail, Coulson and his team seek refuge in the last place anyone would look, where they begin to uncover S.H.I.E.L.D.'s most dangerous secrets. Secrets that could destroy them all.

episodes.title: The Only Light in the Darkness
episodes.description: With their world turned upside down, Coulson races to save the life of his one true love as the mystery of "The Cellist," which began in Marvel's The Avengers, is finally revealed.

episodes.title: Nothing Personal
episodes.description: Just when there's no one left to trust, Agent Maria Hill returns to team up with Coulson as S.H.I.E.L.D. is being destroyed around them.

episodes.title: Ragtag
episodes.description: Ward's betrayal and HYDRA's shocking secrets are revealed as Coulson's team goes undercover on a mission that leaves no one unscathed.

episodes.title: Beginning of the End
episodes.description: Dark secrets are revealed as Coulson and his team put everything on the line to stop Garrett and the forces of HYDRA.

episodes.title: Shadows
episodes.description: Coulson and his team are now wanted fugitives with limited resources, but that's not stopping them from keeping the world safe from powerful and unseen threats everywhere. However, with new members they hardly know, will S.H.I.E.L.D. ever be trusted again?

episodes.title: Heavy Is the Head
episodes.description: Hunted and running out of solutions, Phil Coulson puts his team right in the line of fire in the hopes of saving them all. But with General Glenn Talbot, HYDRA, and Carl Creel all on the attack, can they possibly survive? Meanwhile, a mysterious Doctor harbors some dangerous secrets that could destroy one of our core team members.

episodes.title: Making Friends and Influencing People
episodes.description: Coulson and his team race against HYDRA to get to Donnie Gill--a dangerous gifted with the ability to freeze objects--while Simmons is caught in the crossfire.

episodes.title: Face My Enemy
episodes.description: While on a mission to learn more about the secrets of the mysterious writing, Coulson finds himself attacked by the only person he can trust: Agent Melinda May. Meanwhile, the rest of the team is trapped in an explosive situation, and it's up to Fitz to save them--but is he up to it?

episodes.title: A Hen in the Wolf House
episodes.description: Coulson's team is up against the beautiful and deadly Bobbi Morse--Security Chief for HYDRA. Meanwhile, Skye's father forces Raina to reunite him with his daughter at any cost.

episodes.title: A Fractured House
episodes.description: The world turns against S.H.I.E.L.D. when HYDRA impersonates them to attack The United Nations, and an unexpected enemy leads the charge to bring about their downfall.

episodes.title: The Writing on the Wall
episodes.description: The team discovers murder victims with the alien glyphs on them that Coulson's been etching. All of Coulson's secrets and lies come to a head.

episodes.title: The Things We Bury
episodes.description: Coulson and team find themselves in an epic face-off against HYDRA to uncover an ancient secret, while Ward kidnaps his brother, Senator Christian Ward, for a violent trip down memory lane.

episodes.title: ...Ye Who Enter Here
episodes.description: S.H.I.E.L.D. discovers the ancient city before HYDRA, but uncovering the secrets may require one of Coulson's team to make the ultimate sacrifice. Meanwhile, Melinda May and Skye race to get to Raina before Daniel Whitehall takes her.

episodes.title: What They Become
episodes.description: Coulson and Whitehall's forces meet in an explosive confrontation that dramatically alters everyone's fates. Meanwhile, Skye discovers shocking secrets about her past.

episodes.title: Aftershocks
episodes.description: Coulson's team must deal with the consequences of their war with HYDRA as shocking revelations threaten to tear them apart, and HYDRA makes a dangerous move that may involve a traitor in S.H.I.E.L.D.'s midst.

episodes.title: Who You Really Are
episodes.description: Coulson and his team come to the aid of a confused Lady Sif, who has lost her memory after fighting with a mysterious warrior whose mission will send shockwaves through S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile, Bobbi and Mack continue to hide their true mission from everyone close to them.

episodes.title: One of Us
episodes.description: Cal seeks revenge on Coulson by assembling a team of Super Villains to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile, May calls on renowned Dr. Andrew Garner, her charismatic ex-husband, with a crisis that threatens to tear the team apart.

episodes.title: Love in the Time of Hydra
episodes.description: Coulson and his team are still reeling from a shocking revelation that leaves the team fractured as they must decide what to do with one of their own. Meanwhile, Bobbi and Mack reveal their true allegiance to Hunter, while elsewhere, Ward and Agent 33 embark on a personal mission.

episodes.title: One Door Closes
episodes.description: War comes to Coulson's doorstep in a way he never anticipated as shocking revelations are brought to light, and Skye struggles to control her new abilities but will soon make a decision that irrevocably changes her life.

episodes.title: Afterlife
episodes.description: As Robert Gonzales makes his move, Coulson must do whatever it takes to protect the future of S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile Skye’s journey to control her powers takes a surprising turn when she meets the enigmatic Inhuman named Lincoln.

episodes.title: Melinda
episodes.description: The story of Melinda May’s transformation into “The Cavalry” is revealed as she finds herself at a crossroads in the war between Coulson and Gonzales. As Skye learns more about her true heritage from Lincoln, the truth about the Inhumans will send her in a new direction.

episodes.title: The Frenemy of My Enemy
episodes.description: A dangerous new alliance is formed as Coulson and Hunter turn to the last person anyone would expect – Grant Ward! As the war between S.H.I.E.L.D. factions continues, Skye and Lincoln will find themselves drawn into this conflict.

episodes.title: The Dirty Half Dozen
episodes.description: Gonzales and Coulson must find a way to put their differences aside and work together against HYDRA, even if it means teaming up with someone they don't trust.

episodes.title: Scars
episodes.description: Skye is torn between her loyalty to S.H.I.E.L.D. and her connection to the Inhumans as tensions rise between the groups -- and Coulson reveals a secret he's been hiding from even those closest to him.

episodes.title: S.O.S. (1)
episodes.description: S.H.I.E.L.D. puts everything on the line to survive a war that blurs the line between friend and foe. Coulson and his team will be forced to make shocking sacrifices that will leave their relationships and their world changed forever.

episodes.title: S.O.S. (2)
episodes.description: S.H.I.E.L.D. puts everything on the line to survive a war that blurs the line between friend and foe. Coulson and his team will be forced to make shocking sacrifices that will leave their relationships and their world changed forever.

episodes.title: Laws of Nature
episodes.description: When a new Inhuman is discovered, Coulson and the team have an encounter with another organization seeking powered people; Fitz goes to extreme measures to determine how to get Simmons back.

episodes.title: Purpose in the Machine
episodes.description: Fitz and the team enlist the aid of an Asgardian to unlock the secrets of the ancient Monolith that swallowed Simmons, and Agent May is at a crossroads in her personal and professional life.

episodes.title: A Wanted (Inhu)man
episodes.description: Daisy, Mack and Coulson race to protect Lincoln as Rosalind’s team hunts down the Inhuman in their quest for powered people. Meanwhile, Hunter proves that there is no line that he will not cross to exact his revenge against Ward and HYDRA.

episodes.title: Devils You Know
episodes.description: Coulson and the team search for the Inhuman who is killing other Inhumans. Meanwhile, May feels that Hunter's mission to take down Ward is getting too personal.

episodes.title: 4,722 Hours
episodes.description: After her dramatic rescue from another planet, Simmons is still reeling from her ordeal and reveals how she had to fight for her life in a harsh new world.

episodes.title: Among Us Hide...
episodes.description: The stakes get even higher as Hunter and May continue to go after Ward and HYDRA, and Daisy and Coulson begin to suspect that the ATCU may be keeping a big secret from S.H.I.E.L.D.

episodes.title: Chaos Theory
episodes.description: As Daisy and the team fight to protect Inhumans, S.H.I.E.L.D. discovers the shocking truth about one of their foes; Fitz helps Simmons recover information that could lead them back through the portal.

episodes.title: Many Heads, One Tale
episodes.description: The S.H.I.E.L.D. team discovers dangerous truths about the ATCU, and Ward's plans to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D. take a surprising twist.

episodes.title: Closure
episodes.description: Ward's campaign for revenge brings the S.H.I.E.L.D. team to their knees, and Coulson proves he will do anything to settle the score.

episodes.title: Maveth
episodes.description: S.H.I.E.L.D battles HYDRA head-to-head, which sees Coulson and Fitz take the ultimate risk while Daisy and the Inhumans try to keep HYDRA at bay.

episodes.title: Bouncing Back
episodes.description: In the aftermath of his trip to Maveth, Coulson is more determined than ever to get to Gideon Malick and put an end to HYDRA once and for all. Daisy and the team encounter more Inhumans who have powers like they've never seen before, but will they be friends or enemies of S.H.I.E.L.D.?

episodes.title: The Inside Man
episodes.description: Coulson and General Talbot are forced to team up and attend a worldwide symposium on Inhumans, where they suspect Malick has an inside man. As the S.H.I.E.L.D. team gets closer to the truth, an unexpected traitor is revealed.

episodes.title: Parting Shot
episodes.description: Bobbi and Hunter become ensnared in an assassination plot after tracking Malick to Russia. As S.H.I.E.L.D. races to save the lives on the line, the team is changed forever.

episodes.title: Watchdogs
episodes.description: When a radical group called The Watchdogs emerges with plans to eliminate the Inhumans, Agent Mack and his brother become caught in the crossfire. Meanwhile, Simmons discovers a powerful chemical compound that could alter the future for Inhumans.

episodes.title: Spacetime
episodes.description: When Daisy gets a horrifying glimpse of the future, S.H.I.E.L.D. races to prove that fate is not fixed.

episodes.title: Paradise Lost
episodes.description: S.H.I.E.L.D. hunts for information on their dangerous new enemy, and a shameful secret from Malick's past is exposed, threatening to destroy his HYDRA legacy.

episodes.title: The Team
episodes.description: Agent Daisy Johnson must call upon the Secret Warriors for an inaugural mission that will leave no member unscathed, and S.H.I.E.L.D. learns more about Hive's powers, forcing them to question everyone they trust.

episodes.title: The Singularity
episodes.description: The S.H.I.E.L.D. team is left reeling and decimated as Hive continues to sway Inhumans to his side. But there is a sliver of hope as Agents Fitz and Simmons follow a lead that may be able to stop the maniacal Inhuman once and for all.

episodes.title: Failed Experiments
episodes.description: Coulson and his team race to combat Hive's control over the Inhumans, as their enemy's deadly plan for the human race is revealed.

episodes.title: Emancipation
episodes.description: In the aftermath of the events of Captain America: Civil War, S.H.I.E.L.D. feels pressure to reveal their involvement with Inhumans. But with the stakes higher than ever and Hive growing stronger, the team is tested in ways they could never anticipate.

episodes.title: Absolution (1)
episodes.description: S.H.I.E.L.D. takes on Hive, and when his master plan is finally revealed, the team must spring into action.

episodes.title: Ascension (2)
episodes.description: As Hive prepares to convert the world into his personal army, S.H.I.E.L.D. scrambles to mount a counteroffensive. Who's going to pay the ultimate price to ensure that the mission is a success?

episodes.title: The Ghost
episodes.description: Daisy has left S.H.I.E.L.D. and is trying to solve the mystery of a bunch of serial killings in the Los Angeles area. At the same time her old friends suspect her for the killings and are following her trail in an attempt to find her.

episodes.title: Meet the New Boss
episodes.description: Daisy goes to battle Ghost Rider at a terrible cost, and Coulson faces the new Director, and his bold agenda surprises them all.

episodes.title: Uprising
episodes.description: As Coulson, Mack and Fitz attempt to track down and neutralize a rogue group looking to end Inhuman Registration worldwide, Simmons and Dr. Radcliffe only have hours to save May before she succumbs forever to her mysterious illness.

episodes.title: Let Me Stand Next to Your Fire
episodes.description: As Ghost Rider's quest for vengeance brings him into an explosive confrontation with S.H.I.E.L.D., Coulson and Mack must rely on an unlikely ally in their time of desperate need; and Daisy reunites with a familiar face to stop the Watchdogs.

episodes.title: Lockup
episodes.description: As Robbie Reyes struggles to control the Ghost Rider, S.H.I.E.L.D. infiltrates a high-security prison to unravel the secrets that haunt them all.

episodes.title: The Good Samaritan
episodes.description: Robbie's shocking story on how he became Ghost Rider is finally discovered as Coulson and his team's lives hang in the balance.

episodes.title: Deals with Our Devils
episodes.description: With the loss of half the team, the remaining members search for answers as the clock counts down for Ghost Rider.

episodes.title: The Laws of Inferno Dynamics
episodes.description: S.H.I.E.L.D. and Ghost Rider find themselves unlikely allies when the lives of all of Los Angeles hang in the balance.

episodes.title: Broken Promises
episodes.description: Coulson is unaware of a dark secret May is hiding, even as the two grow closer; Aida is determined to find the Darkhold.

episodes.title: The Patriot
episodes.description: Separated from their team, Coulson and Mack discover a shocking secret about Mace, leaving all of S.H.I.E.L.D. in a precarious position.

episodes.title: Wake Up
episodes.description: May works to uncover the truth about what happened to her; Aida's next move puts everyone's life at risk.

episodes.title: Hot Potato Soup
episodes.description: Agents Sam and Billy Koenig are hunted down to get at the Darkhold book, and only Phil Coulson and the team can save them before the clock ticks out.

episodes.title: BOOM
episodes.description: Daisy, Director Mace and the S.H.I.E.L.D. team must find a way to contain an explosive Inhuman. Meanwhile, Coulson and Mack come face-to-face with Radcliffe’s inspiration for Aida.

episodes.title: The Man Behind the Shield
episodes.description: Mace fights for his life while Coulson and team find themselves in a deadly cat-and-mouse game as they attempt his rescue.

episodes.title: Self Control
episodes.description: Suspicion turns to paranoia when the team doesn't know who can be trusted as more LMDs infiltrate S.H.I.E.L.D.

episodes.title: What If...
episodes.description: Daisy and Simmons uncover secrets and lies in a world gone mad. With HYDRA in control, they are our only hope to save everyone.

episodes.title: Identity and Change
episodes.description: As Daisy and Simmons struggle to discover an escape route to the real world, the identity of the Inhuman leader of the Resistance is revealed.

episodes.title: No Regrets
episodes.description: The truth behind Fitz's turn could bring down all of S.H.I.E.L.D..

episodes.title: All the Madame's Men
episodes.description: Daisy finds herself teamed up with an unlikely partner. Meanwhile, Aida prepares to put her ultimate end game into effect.

episodes.title: Farewell, Cruel World!
episodes.description: The clock is ticking for Daisy and Simmons to get the team out of the Framework, but not everyone is ready and willing to leave.

episodes.title: The Return
episodes.description: Coulson and the team's victory in the Framework is short-lived, as an even deadlier enemy looms against them all.

episodes.title: World's End
episodes.description: With the surprising emergence of Ghost Rider, Coulson and the team attempt to stop Aida from ending the world.

episodes.title: Orientation (1)
episodes.description: Coulson and the team find themselves stranded on a mysterious ship in outer space, and that's just the beginning of the nightmare to come.

episodes.title: Orientation (2)
episodes.description: Coulson and the team find themselves stranded on a mysterious ship in outer space, and that's just the beginning of the nightmare to come.

episodes.title: A Life Spent
episodes.description: Daisy decides she will rescue Simmons, even if it means risking everything to do it.

episodes.title: A Life Earned
episodes.description: Coulson and the team discover what their captors' true intentions are, and in space, escape is not an option.

episodes.title: Rewind
episodes.description: With the surprising help of Lance Hunter, nothing will stop Fitz from finding the lost team as his incredible journey is revealed.

episodes.title: Fun & Games
episodes.description: With Daisy's life on the line, an unexpected friend attempts to rescue her.

episodes.title: Together or Not at All
episodes.description: Just as the team reunites, they become prey to an undefeated Kree warrior bent on killing them all.

episodes.title: The Last Day
episodes.description: Coulson and the team discover that the most unexpected person from S.H.I.E.L.D.’s past may hold the key to stopping Earth’s destruction.

episodes.title: Best Laid Plans
episodes.description: Mack, Yo-Yo, and Flint fight to keep everyone alive by starting a revolution against the Kree.

episodes.title: Past Life
episodes.description: The team has one final chance to return to the timeline, but their actions may have deadly consequences.

episodes.title: All the Comforts of Home
episodes.description: Coulson and the team set out to rewrite the course of humanity's fate; they're unaware that their efforts will dramatically change one S.H.I.E.L.D. agent's life.

episodes.title: The Real Deal
episodes.description: In the milestone 100th episode, Coulson finally reveals the mysterious deal he made with Ghost Rider, which will impact everyone on the team.

episodes.title: Principia
episodes.description: The team goes in search of Gravitonium in order to save the world.

episodes.title: The Devil Complex
episodes.description: As Fitz and Simmons race to find a way to seal the Rift, they are faced with one of their greatest fears manifested.

episodes.title: Rise and Shine
episodes.description: Coulson uncovers General Hale's true agenda, and it could be the end of the world if S.H.I.E.L.D. doesn't help her.

episodes.title: Inside Voices
episodes.description: Coulson is forced to team up with surprising allies to save the world, while the S.H.I.E.L.D. team attempts to track down and rescue him.

episodes.title: The Honeymoon
episodes.description: While an agent's life hangs in the balance, Fitz, Simmons, and Yo-Yo attempt to neutralize a weapon that could play a role in Earth’s destruction.

episodes.title: All Roads Lead…
episodes.description: The team must find a way to stop Ruby before the prophesied chain reaction that can destroy the Earth is put into motion.

episodes.title: Option Two
episodes.description: Coulson and the team find themselves under siege at the Lighthouse.

episodes.title: The One Who Will Save Us All
episodes.description: A newly determined Talbot takes Coulson to meet the enemy and attempts to avert Earth's destruction.

episodes.title: The Force of Gravity
episodes.description: Daisy's future as the Destroyer of Worlds could take a critical change.

episodes.title: The End
episodes.description: Coulson's life or death is the challenge the team finds themselves in, as the wrong decision will cause the Destruction of Earth.

title: The Handmaid's Tale
description: Set in a dystopian future, a woman is forced to live as a concubine under a fundamentalist theocratic dictatorship.

episodes.title: Offred
episodes.description: Offred, one the few fertile women known as Handmaids in the oppressive Republic of Gilead, struggles to survive as a reproductive surrogate for a powerful Commander and his resentful wife.

episodes.title: Birth Day
episodes.description: Offred and her fellow Handmaids assist with the delivery of Janine’s baby, prompting Offred to recall her own daughter’s birth. Offred draws closer to Ofglen while dreading a secret meeting with the Commander.

episodes.title: Late
episodes.description: Offred visits Janine’s baby with Serena Joy and remembers the early days of the revolution before Gilead. Ofglen faces a difficult challenge.

episodes.title: Nolite Te Bastardes Carborundorum
episodes.description: Punished by Serena Joy, Offred begins to unravel and reflects on her time with Moira at the Red Center. A complication during the Ceremony threatens Offred’s survival with the Commander and Serena Joy.

episodes.title: Faithful
episodes.description: Serena Joy makes Offred a surprising proposition. Offred remembers the unconventional beginnings of her relationship with her husband.

episodes.title: A Woman's Place
episodes.description: A Mexican Ambassador visiting Gilead questions Offred about her life as a Handmaid. Serena Joy reflects on her marriage and the role she once played in Gilead’s inception.

episodes.title: The Other Side
episodes.description: Remembering her family’s treacherous escape attempt, a shocking revelation from life before Gilead provides a new perspective on Offred’s life.

episodes.title: Jezebels
episodes.description: The Commander surprises Offred with a secret adventure in Gilead. Nick’s troubled past leads to his recruitment by the Sons of Jacob.

episodes.title: The Bridge
episodes.description: Offred embarks on a dangerous mission for the resistance. Janine moves to a new posting. Serena Joy suspects the Commander’s infidelity.

episodes.title: Night
episodes.description: Serena Joy confronts Offred and the Commander. Offred struggles with a complicated, life-changing revelation. The Handmaids face a brutal decision.

episodes.title: June
episodes.description: Offred reckons with the consequences of a dangerous decision while haunted by memories from her past and the violent beginnings of Gilead.

episodes.title: Unwomen
episodes.description: Offred adjusts to a new way of life. The arrival of an unexpected person disrupts the Colonies. A family is torn apart by the rise of Gilead.

episodes.title: Baggage
episodes.description: Offred reflects on her relationship with her mother as she navigates her way through Gilead. In Little America, Moira tries to cope with the trauma she endured.

episodes.title: Other Women
episodes.description: A baby shower provokes a troubling shift in Offred’s relationship with Serena Joy. Offred reckons with the choice she made that led her to become a Handmaid.
