episodes.description: The fifth season ends with Howard and Bernadette deciding to get married before his NASA mission, causing the gang to scurry into overdrive in an effort to stage the wedding. NASA astronaut Mike Massimino has a cameo as himself.

title: Teen Wolf
description: Scott McCall, a high school student living in the town of Beacon Hills has his life drastically changed when he's bitten by a werewolf, becoming one himself. He must henceforth learn to balance his problematic new identity with his day-to-day teenage life. The following characters are instrumental to his struggle: Stiles, his best friend; Allison, his love interest who comes from a family of werewolf hunters; and Derek, a mysterious werewolf with a dark past. Throughout the series, he strives to keep his loved ones safe while maintaining normal relationships with them.

episodes.title: Wolf Moon
episodes.description: When Scott suffers a werewolf bite, his strange new abilities begin to complicate his life - and his relationship with the new girl in town.

episodes.title: Second Chance at First Line
episodes.description: Scott struggles to balance his new life as a werewolf and the pressures of being a teen, all while avoiding werewolf hunters and trying to score a second date with Allison.

episodes.title: Pack Mentality
episodes.description: Scott and Allison end up in a group date; an animal attack has Stiles' sheriff father on the lookout.

episodes.title: Magic Bullet
episodes.description: A new hunter comes to town and shoots Derek, who is certain to die unless Scott can find the right kind of bullet that caused his injury.

episodes.title: The Tell
episodes.description: There's another animal attack involving Lydia and Jackson, raising more questions about wild animals. Meanwhile, Scott and Allison skip school and Derek must deal with the werewolf hunters on his own.

episodes.title: Heart Monitor
episodes.description: Scott tries to control his transformation so he can spend more time with Allison. Elsewhere, Derek continues trying to make an ally of Scott.

episodes.title: Night School
episodes.description: Scott and the others are trapped inside the high school as the Alpha draws near.

episodes.title: Lunatic
episodes.description: The hunt is on for Derek's whereabouts, meanwhile Stiles tries to help Scott with controlling his transformation when a second full moon is approaching.

episodes.title: Wolf's Bane
episodes.description: Jackson seeks out a specialist regarding the wound on his neck.

episodes.title: Co-Captain
episodes.description: Scott moves to protect his friends from the Alpha, meanwhile Stiles makes a discovery about Derek's family.

episodes.title: Formality
episodes.description: While Derek is still stuck in captivity, Scott's true identity might become public information.

episodes.title: Code Breaker
episodes.description: Caught in a war between hunters and werewolves, Scott seeks help from friends and enemies.

episodes.title: Omega
episodes.description: When Lydia goes missing from the hospital, werewolves and hunters begin a search.

episodes.title: Shape Shifted
episodes.description: Isaac's father is murdered; Scott, Stiles and Derek plan a break-out. At the same time, the Argent family remove the principal and Allison's grandfather replaces him. Scott senses that another werewolf is in the lacrosse locker room and plans to sniff them out, literally.

episodes.title: Ice Pick
episodes.description: Scott tries to keep Derek from creating new werewolves; Argent officially begins Allison's training; the new creature in town takes another victim.

episodes.title: Abomination
episodes.description: When the new shapeshifter strikes again, Scott has to recruit a reluctant Allison to acquire a rare book in Gerard's collection, while also once again surviving dinner with her family.

episodes.title: Venomous
episodes.description: Derek becomes convinced that Lydia is the shapeshifter they're after, forcing Scott to gather his friends -- and even some enemies -- to protect her.

episodes.title: Frenemy
episodes.description: With startling new information about the shapeshifter, Scott and Stiles hurry to protect their friends while Allison is given an investigative task by her family.

episodes.title: Restraint
episodes.description: As Lydia begins to make connections about the bite from Peter, Jackson causes new problems for Scott and Stiles while Derek has a crisis of faith in his leadership as a new Alpha.

episodes.title: Raving
episodes.description: During a secret concert, Scott and Stiles come up with a method to trap the new shapeshifter. At the same time, Allison's mother comes up with a plan of her own to take care of Scott once and for all.

episodes.title: Party Guessed
episodes.description: Even as his relationship with Allison becomes further strained, Scott and Stiles must attend Lydia's birthday party while Derek locks his new wolves up to watch after them on their first full moon together.

episodes.title: Fury
episodes.description: Scott, Stiles, Melissa and Stillinski are taken hostage; Allison tracks Derek to the station.

episodes.title: Battlefield
episodes.description: Scott plays in the championship lacrosse game and must figure out a way to stop Gerard. Meanwhile, Allison continues her hunt for Derek and his pack.

episodes.title: Master Plan
episodes.description: Scott races to uncover Gerard's master plan following a shocking death on the lacrosse field. Derek plots to take Gerard down using his own methods. Erica and Boyd are captured as Allison continues her merciless bloodthirsty revenge on the werewolves for her mother's suicide. Meanwhile, Scott, Stiles, Lydia, Melissa and Isaac are all under pressure amidst the chaotic events.

episodes.title: Tattoo
episodes.description: The secret behind Derek's tattoo is revealed and the Alpha pack make their presence known. Derek and Isaac struggle to locate Erica and Boyd.

episodes.title: Chaos Rising
episodes.description: Allison and Lydia locate a possible clue to finding Boyd and Erica while one of Stiles' childhood friends goes missing.

episodes.title: Fireflies
episodes.description: With Boyd and Cora on the loose and under the influence of the full moon, Scott and Derek must turn to an unlikely ally for help.

episodes.title: Unleashed
episodes.description: While Scott tries to keep Isaac from engaging in a deadly confrontation with the Twins in school, Stiles attempts to prove his theory that the killings have nothing to do with werewolves.

episodes.title: Frayed
episodes.description: During a bus ride to a cross country meet, Scott and his friends flash back to the events of a preemptive strike against the Alphas that has left several injured and possibly one or more dead.

episodes.title: Motel California
episodes.description: Stranded at a motel for the night because of the postponed cross country meet, Scott and the others suffer strange experiences that cause them to believe members of their own group may the mysterious killer’s newest targets.

episodes.title: Currents
episodes.description: As the danger begins to reach closer to Scott, threatening his trusted mentor and boss, Deaton, Kali and the Twins go after Derek.

episodes.title: Visionary
episodes.description: Seeking answers, Scott, Allison and Stiles hear stories told by two unlikely narrators and discover a secret about the color of a werewolf’s eyes.

episodes.title: The Girl Who Knew Too Much
episodes.description: As Allison begins to suspect someone dangerously close to her may be involved in the murders, Scott and Stiles conclude that Lydia’s rising talents may be their best bet to solving the murders.

episodes.title: The Overlooked
episodes.description: Trapped inside an evacuated Beacon Hills hospital by a powerful storm, Scott and Derek must defend themselves against the Alphas while trying to figure out how to save Cora’s life.

episodes.title: Alpha Pact
episodes.description: With the threat growing far more personal and time running out on innocent lives, Scott is forced to make a difficult choice in order to save both friends and family while, at the same time, Derek and Peter try to figure out how to save Cora’s life.

episodes.title: Lunar Ellipse
episodes.description: Under Deaton’s advice, Scott and his friends use an ancient but extremely dangerous ritual to help them both save the lives of the people they love and stop Deucalion from achieving his sinister goal.

episodes.title: Anchors
episodes.description: Scott, Stiles and Allison suffer side effects from the ritual sacrifice; Sheriff Stilinski searches through old cases.

episodes.title: More Bad Than Good
episodes.description: Scott and his friends ponder catching the werecoyote before it is hunted down; an unlikely ally helps Derek and Peter break out.

episodes.title: Galvanize
episodes.description: On the night before Halloween, Mischief Night, a convicted murderer brought to Beacon Hills Hospital for surgery escapes, forcing Scott and his friends to step in to help when his unexpected target becomes clear.

episodes.title: Illuminated
episodes.description: Beacon Hills is under curfew from the power outage; the teens throw a blacklight Halloween party; Scott tries to earn Kira's trust.

episodes.title: Silverfinger
episodes.description: Scott's friends pledge to protect him against an increasingly hostile enemy while Argent, Isaac and Allison search for answers through an old adversary from the Japanese Yakuza. At the same time, Stiles enlists Melissa's help in figuring out exactly what's going on with him.

episodes.title: Riddled
episodes.description: Stiles goes missing; Scott and the others set off on a search; Lydia tries to master her new abilities.

episodes.title: Letharia Vulpina
episodes.description: Scott and the others try to prevent a disaster; Lydia and Allison seek out an unlikely teacher.

episodes.title: Echo House
episodes.description: Scott and the others seek an important artifact; Stiles must make a decision about Eichen House.

episodes.title: The Fox and the Wolf
episodes.description: An important clue is revealed in the story of a World War II internment camp; Kira's role is more crucial, and she discovers unusual abilities.

episodes.title: De-Void
episodes.description: Scott and Lydia join forces. Meanwhile, Stilinski faces a review board.

episodes.title: Insatiable
episodes.description: Kira faces an unexpected enemy.

episodes.title: The Divine Move
episodes.description: Scott and Derek call upon their friends and allies to make a last stand.

episodes.title: The Dark Moon
episodes.description: When one of their friends goes missing, Scott and the pack travel into Mexico on a search and rescue mission.
Scott teams up with an unlikely source in the hopes of putting an end to Kate's evil plan.

episodes.title: Muted
episodes.description: Whilst Stilinski investigates a murder, Scott has his place on the Lacrosse team threatened by a freshman.

episodes.title: The Benefactor
episodes.description: When the full moon is out, Lydia's lake house brings uninvited guests, and Derek hunts for a killer.

episodes.title: I.E.D.
episodes.description: Scott, Stiles and Kira participate in their first Lacrosse game; Lydia looks to get help controlling her powers.

episodes.title: Orphaned
episodes.description: A dangerous enemy forces Scott to help him. Derek and Malia track down an old ally.

episodes.title: Weaponized
episodes.description: A mysterious outbreak takes over the high school.

episodes.title: Time of Death
episodes.description: Scott attempts a dangerous plan to draw out The Benefactor. Malia confronts her past.

episodes.title: Perishable
episodes.description: An assassin targets Scott and Liam at the lacrosse team's annual bonfire.

episodes.title: Monstrous
episodes.description: Scott and Kira fight to protect Satomi's pack from assassins.

episodes.title: A Promise to the Dead
episodes.description: Scott and his Pack begin a dangerous battle against an old enemy.

episodes.title: Smoke and Mirrors
episodes.description: Scott and Stiles return to La Iglesia to save the Pack from Kate.

episodes.title: Creatures of the Night
episodes.description: On the eve of senior year, Scott and his pack deal with the arrival of a new enemy and the return of an old friend.

episodes.title: Parasomnia
episodes.description: Stiles is suspicious of a new classmate; and Lydia helps a student with night terrors.

episodes.title: Dreamcatchers
episodes.description: Scott tracks a new shapeshifter that's threatening Stilinski; and Malia receives information about her mother.

episodes.title: Condition Terminal
episodes.description: Stiles works on tracking down a fugitive; Liam tries to be Mason's wingman at a nightclub.

episodes.title: A Novel Approach
episodes.description: In hopes of learning more about the Dread Doctors, the pack goes into Eichen House.

episodes.title: Required Reading
episodes.description: After following Dr. Valack's advice, Scott and the others begin to experience strange things.

episodes.title: Strange Frequencies
episodes.description: Stiles is suspicious about a new girl showing up and what her intentions are. Scott's plans to protect the newest victim are derailed when The Dread Doctors attack.

episodes.title: Ouroboros
episodes.description: Scott and Malia get help to try to find Hayden and Liam. Deaton discovers something horrific about the dread doctors. Hayden and Liam will be faced with a life and death situation.

episodes.title: Lies of Omission
episodes.description: Scott finds himself turning to an unlikely ally for help. Stiles and Lydia attempt to find out the truth about Parrish.

episodes.title: Status Asthmaticus
episodes.description: With both lives and friendships on the verge of being destroyed, Scott and his pack face their greatest enemy yet.

episodes.title: The Last Chimera
episodes.description: Scott and Stiles try to learn what is behind the mysterious infection that is killing the town sheriff.

episodes.title: Damnatio Memoriae
episodes.description: Even without the support of his pack, Scott considers what the Dread Doctors' success means for Beacon Hills.

episodes.title: Codominance
episodes.description: Kira and her mother make a journey to help Kira deal with her dark side; Lydia is surprised at Eichen House.

episodes.title: The Sword and the Spirit
episodes.description: As Scott tries to put his pack back together, Malia and her new ally set out to rescue Deaton from The Desert Wolf.

episodes.title: Amplification
episodes.description: Upon learning that Lydia is in danger, Stiles makes a plan to break her out of Eichen House; Theo has his own plans.

episodes.title: Lie Ability
episodes.description: While trapped in Eichen House with Theo and the Chimera pack, Scott tries to rescue Lydia before time runs out.

episodes.title: A Credible Threat
episodes.description: Scott and his pack use a charity lacrosse game in a deadly gambit to figure out the identity of the Beast.

episodes.title: Maid of Gévaudan
episodes.description: Scott, Stiles, Lydia, Malia, and Liam are trying to figure out how to defeat the Beast of Gévaudan that the Maid of Gévaudan, Marie-Jeanne Valet, faced in 1765. As Gerard Argent, recounts Valet’s story to Scott’s pack in hopes they can deduce the creature’s weaknesses.

episodes.title: The Beast of Beacon Hills
episodes.description: With the identity of the Beast finally revealed, Scott and his friends are in a race against time to stop The Dread doctors from implementing their final plan.

episodes.title: Apotheosis
episodes.description: Loyalties are tested and new alliances forged as Scott and his friends work to stop the Beast before Beacon Hills is razed to the ground.

title: The Last of Us
description: Twenty years after modern civilization has been destroyed, Joel, a hardened survivor, is hired to smuggle Ellie, a 14-year-old girl, out of an oppressive quarantine zone. What starts as a small job soon becomes a brutal, heartbreaking journey, as they both must traverse the United States and depend on each other for survival.

episodes.title: When You're Lost in the Darkness
episodes.description: 2003. As a parasitic fungal outbreak begins to ravage the country and the world, Joel Miller attempts to escape the escalating chaos with his daughter and brother. Twenty years later, a now hardened Joel and his partner Tess fight to survive under a totalitarian regime, while the insurgent Fireflies harbor a teenage girl with a unique gift.

episodes.title: Infected
episodes.description: In 2003, an Indonesian scientist makes a devastating discovery. In 2023, now outside of the quarantine zone, Joel and Tess clash over Ellie's fate as they navigate a long-abandoned Boston overrun with Infected.

episodes.title: Long, Long Time
episodes.description: Doomsday prepper Bill prepares to ride out the apocalypse alone...until a mysterious stranger upends his plans. Years later, Joel and Ellie seek Bill's guidance – and find themselves at a crossroads.

episodes.title: Please Hold to My Hand
episodes.description: After a harrowing trek across a desolate United States, Joel and Ellie find themselves navigating a dangerous Kansas City on foot. Later, rebel leader Kathleen instigates a manhunt – one that pits her violent civilian militia against the world's best hope.

episodes.title: Endure and Survive
episodes.description: On the streets of a newly free Kansas City, Henry fights to protect his brother Sam from rebel soldiers who will stop at nothing to appease their ruthless leader. As her manhunt continues, Kathleen doubles down on her quest for revenge, while Ellie forms a meaningful friendship.

episodes.title: Kin
episodes.description: After months of traveling, Joel and Ellie receive a grave warning about what lies ahead. Later, Ellie learns more about Joel's past – while Joel tries his best to forget.

episodes.title: Left Behind
episodes.description: As Joel fights to survive, Ellie’s struggle to save him stirs memories of her life in a FEDRA orphanage. Weeks before meeting Joel, Ellie recalls joining her best friend Riley for a night to remember… one that will change the course of both of their lives – and the fate of the world – forever.

episodes.title: When We Are in Need
episodes.description: After crossing paths with a vengeful group of survivors, Ellie's fighting spirit draws unwanted attention from its leader. Still battling for his life, a weakened Joel faces off with a hunting party out for blood.

episodes.title: Look for the Light
episodes.description: After being pursued by Infected, a pregnant Anna places her trust in a lifelong friend. Years later, Ellie is forced to grapple with the emotional toll of her journey, while Joel faces a devastating decision of his own.

episodes.title: Future Days
episodes.description: Five years after the events in Salt Lake City, a now 19-year-old Ellie makes a discovery while on patrol with her best friend Dina. Back in Jackson Hole, Joel seeks help to mend his relationship with Ellie.

episodes.title: Through the Valley
episodes.description: As a storm brews in the mountains, the people of Jackson Hole prepare for the worst amid increased sightings of Infected. Meanwhile, Abby weighs her options.

episodes.title: The Path
episodes.description: After Dina shares crucial information, Ellie prepares to petition the town council, even while she struggles with her deep emotional scars. On the outskirts of Seattle, a religious sect attempts to flee a war – raising questions on what lies ahead.

episodes.title: Day One
episodes.description: In 2018, Seattle FEDRA confronts an unexpected foe. Ten years later, Ellie and Dina find themselves in the middle of a bloody battle between the zealous Seraphites and a ruthless militia.

episodes.title: Feel Her Love
episodes.description: The WLF makes a dangerous discovery... at a great cost. Later, Ellie must decide whether to continue with her plan – and risk putting Dina in danger – or give up on her quest for justice.

episodes.title: The Price
episodes.description: Joel surprises Ellie for her birthday. Years later, Ellie prepares to confront Joel about her past.

episodes.title: Convergence
episodes.description: As the Wolves and the Scars prepare for a battle that could potentially end their longstanding feud, Ellie's search draws her away from her friends and toward a devastating confrontation.

title: BoJack Horseman
description: Meet the most beloved sitcom horse of the '90s , 20 years later. He's a curmudgeon with a heart of...not quite gold...but something like gold. Copper?

episodes.title: BoJack Horseman: The BoJack Horseman Story, Chapter One
episodes.description: To help with the memoir he hopes will put him back in the spotlight, BoJack hires a ghostwriter.

episodes.title: BoJack Hates the Troops
episodes.description: BoJack finds himself the subject of national media attention after he calls the troops "jerks."

episodes.title: Prickly-Muffin
episodes.description: BoJack reconnects with a friend from his past who moves into his house and creates pandemonium.

episodes.title: Zoës and Zeldas
episodes.description: BoJack decides to mentor Todd; Diane's ex-boyfriend writes an article about Mr. Peanutbutter.

episodes.title: Live Fast, Diane Nguyen
episodes.description: A business trip for BoJack and Diane takes a detour; Todd runs a scam that gets him in trouble.

episodes.title: Our A-Story Is A 'D' Story
episodes.description: BoJack is jealous of Diane's relationship with Mr. Peanutbutter; Todd's in a new environment.

episodes.title: Say Anything
episodes.description: BoJack sabotages himself with an epic bender; Princess Carolyn's agency merges with another.

episodes.title: The Telescope
episodes.description: When he learns that his old friend from "Horsin' Around" is dying, BoJack tries to mend fences.

episodes.title: Horse Majeure
episodes.description: A lovestruck BoJack tries to sabotage a wedding; Todd accepts a surprising new professional role.

episodes.title: One Trick Pony
episodes.description: BoJack shoots a movie at Mr. Peanutbutter’s house; Diane finishes her book.

episodes.title: Downer Ending
episodes.description: BoJack embarks on a project in his typically gonzo style, leading to a drug-fueled revelation.

episodes.title: Later
episodes.description: Months after his memoir is released, BoJack's being considered for a role that's a lifelong dream.

episodes.title: Brand New Couch
episodes.description: BoJack believes an upbeat attitude will change his life, but that attitude doesn't mesh well with his new acting job.

episodes.title: Yesterdayland
episodes.description: BoJack is drawn to the one female in town who has no idea who he is (because she was in a coma). Todd opens a theme park.

episodes.title: Still Broken
episodes.description: A funeral turns into a treasure hunt for the "Horsin' Around" cast -- and a potential schmooze-fest for Princess Caroline and Mr. Peanutbutter.

episodes.title: After the Party
episodes.description: Princess Caroline, BoJack, Diane, and Mr. Peanutbutter learn some important lessons about love in the wake of a surprise birthday party.

episodes.title: Chickens
episodes.description: BoJack really wants his director, Kelsey, to like him. Todd, Diane and Kelsey's daughter help a chicken who's on the lam from the police.

episodes.title: Higher Love
episodes.description: Princess Caroline sees an opportunity when Mr. Peanutbutter's agent dies. BoJack flips when he says the "L" word out loud to Wanda.

episodes.title: Hank After Dark
episodes.description: Diane goes off script during BoJack's book tour, jeopardizing Mr. Peanutbutter's new show. Todd gets involved in international affairs.

episodes.title: Let's Find Out
episodes.description: BoJack is one of the celebrity guest stars on the first episode of Mr. Peanutbutter's game show, but the game doesn't go as expected.

episodes.title: The Shot
episodes.description: BoJack cooks up a scheme with Kelsey, Todd, Princess Caroline and Mr. Peanutbutter to steal a crucial shot for the Secretariat film.

episodes.title: Yes And
episodes.description: Todd gets sucked into the cult of improv comedy. Wanda thinks Diane is a bad influence on BoJack when he has to deal with a career crisis.

episodes.title: Escape from L.A.
episodes.description: BoJack goes on a road trip to visit an old friend, and gets a taste of existence outside the Holywood bubble.

episodes.title: Out to Sea
episodes.description: The important things in life becomes clear to BoJack when Todd moves out to join the improv comedy group on their special cruise ship.

episodes.title: Start Spreading the News
episodes.description: Ana Spanakopita sends BoJack to New York to do interviews, and Todd tags along. Princess Carolyn tells Mr. Peanutbutter to get back to work.

episodes.title: The BoJack Horseman Show
episodes.description: In 2007, Princess Carolyn finds a new project for BoJack, Diane meets Mr. Peanutbutter at the coffee shop where she works, and Todd kisses a girl.

episodes.title: BoJack Kills
episodes.description: BoJack is framed for the murder of a Whale World dancer. Mr. Peanutbutter and Todd get into a stinky situation with the skunk next door.

episodes.title: Fish Out of Water
episodes.description: BoJack takes an underwater trip to the Pacific Ocean Film Festival for the “Secretariat” premiere, where he tries to reach out to Kelsey.

episodes.title: Love And/Or Marriage
episodes.description: While Todd and BoJack crash a rehearsal dinner, Diane gets high with a client. Princess Carolyn goes on a series of blind dates.

episodes.title: Brrap Brrap Pew Pew
episodes.description: Diane's tweet lands Sextina Aquafina in hot water. Prankster and A-list actor Jurj Clooners gets under BoJack's skin.

episodes.title: Stop the Presses
episodes.description: Todd builds a giant papier-mâché Todd head. A customer service rep gives BoJack some sound advice when he tries to cancel his newspaper subscription.

episodes.title: Old Acquaintance
episodes.description: BoJack is up for a part in David Pincher's latest film. Diane meets Mr. Peanutbutter's brother,  and Todd takes the business in a new direction.

episodes.title: Best Thing That Ever Happened
episodes.description: BoJack meets Princess Carolyn at Elefante, leading to a night of soul-searching as they help the staff impress a food critic.

episodes.title: It's You
episodes.description: Mr. Peanutbutter announces the Oscar nominees. BoJack surrounds himself with admirers, but his real friendships are falling apart.

episodes.title: That's Too Much, Man!
episodes.description: On a drug-fueled bender, BoJack and Sarah Lynn crash an AA meeting, and BoJack decides to make amends to the people he hurt.

episodes.title: That Went Well
episodes.description: Mr. Peanutbutter saves the day. Todd gets exciting news. BoJack, Diane and Princess Carolyn pursue new opportunities.

episodes.title: See Mr. Peanutbutter Run
episodes.description: Mr. Peanutbutter's campaign to recall the governor of California culminates in a high-stakes ski race. Meanwhile, BoJack is nowhere to be found.

episodes.title: The Old Sugarman Place
episodes.description: BoJack goes off the grid and winds up at his grandparents' dilapidated home in Michigan where he reflects on his family legacy and befriends another soul haunted by the past.

episodes.title: Hooray! Todd Episode!
episodes.description: Helpful to a fault, Todd is spread thin doing favors for Princess Carolyn, Mr. Peanutbutter and a visitor with a potential connection to BoJack.

episodes.title: Commence Fracking
episodes.description: The campaign takes a toll on Diane's love life. BoJack helps Hollyhock search for her mom. Princess Carolyn tries to get pregnant.

episodes.title: Thoughts and Prayers
episodes.description: A mass shooting at a mall creates a PR nightmare for Princess Carolyn. BoJack takes Hollyhock to visit his estranged mother.

episodes.title: Stupid Piece of Sh*t
episodes.description: Surrounded by family, BoJack spirals into self-loathing. Princess Carolyn and Rutabaga Rabitowitz plan Courtney and Todd's sham wedding.

episodes.title: Underground
episodes.description: Mr. Peanutbutter's posh campaign fundraiser takes a terrifying turn. As chaos swirls around them, BoJack and Diane get drunk.

episodes.title: The Judge
episodes.description: Hollyhock starts dating an intern on BoJack's new show. Princess Carolyn meets Ralph's parents. Mr. Peanutbutter throws his support behind Woodchuck.

episodes.title: Ruthie
episodes.description: On one awful day, Princess Carolyn deals with rejection, deception and loss. BoJack and Diane try to track down Hollyhock's birth certificate.

episodes.title: lovin that cali lifestyle!!
episodes.description: Diane leaks damaging information on Jessica Biel, Todd's clown dentist business hits a snag, and Princess Carolyn finds hope in an unlikely place.

episodes.title: Time's Arrow
episodes.description: In 1963, young socialite Beatrice Sugarman meets the rebellious Butterscotch Horseman at her debutante party.

episodes.title: What Time Is It Right Now
episodes.description: Princess Carolyn pitches "Philbert" to company execs. Todd gets a better business idea. BoJack comes to a realization about Hollyhock.

episodes.title: The Light Bulb Scene
episodes.description: BoJack has misgivings about his new show. Princess Carolyn visits an adoption agency. Todd interviews for a job at WhatTimeIsItRightNow.com.

episodes.title: The Dog Days Are Over
episodes.description: Diane divorces Mr. Peanutbutter and moves into a shabby studio. Feeling melancholy, she travels to Vietnam to get away from it all.

episodes.title: Planned Obsolescence
episodes.description: Todd meets Yolanda's parents, who don't know she's asexual. Mr. Peanutbutter romances a young waitress. Gina confesses a childhood dream to BoJack.

episodes.title: BoJack the Feminist
episodes.description: When Princess Carolyn casts a disgraced celeb in "Philbert," BoJack inadvertently takes a stand. Mr. Peanutbutter tries to toughen up his image.

episodes.title: The Amelia Earhart Story
episodes.description: Painful memories come rushing back when Princess Carolyn visits her hometown and meets a pregnant teen. A stunt goes awry on the "Philbert" set.

episodes.title: Free Churro
episodes.description: BoJack delivers a eulogy at a funeral.

episodes.title: INT. SUB
episodes.description: Diane's therapist encourages her to set boundaries with BoJack. A missing string cheese ignites a dispute between Todd and Princess Carolyn.

episodes.title: Mr. Peanutbutter's Boos
episodes.description: At BoJack's 25th annual Halloween party, Pickles gets a crash course in Mr. Peanutbutter's romantic history -- and some advice from Diane.

episodes.title: Ancient History
episodes.description: A visiting Hollyhock dumps BoJack's painkillers, sending him on a desperate search for more. Todd tries to solve Emily's dating dilemma.

episodes.title: Head in the Clouds
episodes.description: At the "Philbert" premiere party, Princess Carolyn deftly negotiates a deal, Gina steps into the limelight, and Diane confronts BoJack.

episodes.title: The Showstopper
episodes.description: "Philbert" is a hit, and filming begins on Season 2. But as BoJack spirals deeper into addiction, he loses his grip on reality.

episodes.title: The Stopped Show
episodes.description: In the midst of the latest PR crisis, Princess Carolyn gets a life-changing opportunity. With Diane's help, BoJack finally faces the music.

title: Euphoria
description: A group of high school students navigate love and friendships in a world of drugs, sex, trauma, and social media.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: Seventeen-year-old Rue returns home from rehab with no plans to stay clean.

episodes.title: Stuntin' Like My Daddy
episodes.description: On the first day of school, Rue has a new friend, Jules, but struggles to put the past behind her.

episodes.title: Made You Look
episodes.description: Kat starts camming. Jules falls for a boy online. Rue is confronted at NA, and Cassie visits McKay at college.

episodes.title: Shook Ones Pt. II
episodes.description: Rue, trying to get clean for Jules, chaperones Gia at the carnival. Jules encounters Cal with his family.

episodes.title: '03 Bonnie and Clyde
episodes.description: Maddy and Nate must deal with a police investigation. Rue and Jules each reflect on their relationship.

episodes.title: The Next Episode
episodes.description: On Halloween, Rue worries about her reliance on Jules when she starts acting strange.

episodes.title: The Trials and Tribulations of Trying to Pee While Depressed
episodes.description: Rue gets depressed and watches 22 straight episodes of a British reality show.​ Jules visits an old friend.

episodes.title: And Salt the Earth Behind You
episodes.description: It's the winter formal at East Highland.

episodes.title: Trying to Get to Heaven Before They Close the Door
episodes.description: Rue and Jules cross paths for the first time since Christmas as East Highland rings in the new year.

episodes.title: Out of Touch
episodes.description: As the new semester kicks off, Jules questions Rue and Elliot’s new friendship, while Cal hunts for answers.

episodes.title: Ruminations: Big and Little Bullys
episodes.description: Rue pursues a new business venture, Cassie settles into a routine, and Cal finds a target.

episodes.title: You Who Cannot See, Think of Those Who Can
episodes.description: Jules and Elliot grow closer, Maddy celebrates her birthday and Cal takes a trip down memory lane.

episodes.title: Stand Still Like the Hummingbird
episodes.description: Fate has a way of catching up with those who try to outrun it.

episodes.title: A Thousand Little Trees of Blood
episodes.description: Rue tries to recover, Lexi questions putting on her play and Nate celebrates his newfound freedom.

episodes.title: The Theater and Its Double
episodes.description: Art imitates life as the East Highland crew watches their complicated dynamics play out onstage.

episodes.title: All My Life, My Heart Has Yearned for a Thing I Cannot Name
episodes.description: As the show goes on, fragments of memories collide with the present and future.

episodes.title: Andale
episodes.description: A few years after high school, Rue's debts finally catch up with her. Hoping to finance her dream wedding, Cassie tries to become internet famous – to the disapproval of Nate, who's juggling the demands of running Cal's business.

episodes.title: America My Dream
episodes.description: Maddy arrived in the city with no money, a suitcase full of clothes, and a plan.

episodes.title: The Ballad of Paladin
episodes.description: While in art school, Jules learns she can fund her dreams by going on dates with rich men. Having worked her way up in Alamo's organization, Rue is sent on a special mission with Bishop. Meanwhile, Cassie's storybook wedding doesn't go as planned.

episodes.title: Kitty Likes to Dance
episodes.description: Rue is offered a risky deal that draws her deeper into Alamo's world. While Nate battles the city council, Maddy gives Cassie a mission that could skyrocket her new career, and Lexi enlists Jules to create an original painting for LA Nights.

episodes.title: This Little Piggy
episodes.description: She would never say it out loud, but Nate going broke finally granted Cassie permission to follow her dreams.

episodes.title: Stand Still and See
episodes.description: Rue makes a deal with the devil in the form of a promise to Alamo...and gives a word of warning to Maddy. Later, Cassie gets her first real taste of stardom on the set of LA Nights, and Rue paints Jules a picture of her ideal future.

episodes.title: Rain or Shine
episodes.description: Under intense financial pressure, Maddy schemes to get Cassie back in the spotlight. Meanwhile, Rue obsesses over the sign God gave her.

episodes.title: In God We Trust
episodes.description: Danger closes in on all sides as Rue's double-dealing finally reaches its breaking point. While the medical van speeds towards the border, Maddy and Cassie must band together – and Alamo is struck by a life-changing epiphany.

title: House of Cards
description: Betrayed by the White House, Congressman Frank Underwood embarks on a ruthless rise to power. Blackmail, seduction and ambition are his weapons.

episodes.title: Chapter 1
episodes.description: When the newly elected President reneges on a promise, Frank and Claire decide to sever all allegiances and toss the rules out the window.

episodes.title: Chapter 2
episodes.description: Frank uses a young reporter, Zoe Barnes, to spin a story that puts the White House on its heels. Claire makes a cold-blooded move at work.

episodes.title: Chapter 3
episodes.description: Frank must leave union negotiations to deal with a crisis in his home district. Zoe negotiates the politics of being a journalist on the rise.

episodes.title: Chapter 4
episodes.description: Frank shakes down the Congressional leadership. Peter Russo must choose between politics and family.

episodes.title: Chapter 5
episodes.description: Frank's fight over the Education Bill threatens Claire's own ambitions. Zoe mixes work and play.

episodes.title: Chapter 6
episodes.description: Frank strikes back at the striking teachers. Claire is caught off guard by a deathbed confession.

episodes.title: Chapter 7
episodes.description: Frank wins a major battle, but doesn't pause to rest on his laurels. Peter must face his past. Stamper hushes a secret.

episodes.title: Chapter 8
episodes.description: Frank is honored at his alma mater, while Peter returns to Philly. Both men tackle unfinished business.

episodes.title: Chapter 9
episodes.description: Russo hits the road with V.P. Matthews. Frank and Stamper try to whip up support in Congress. Claire looks out for herself.

episodes.title: Chapter 10
episodes.description: Rebellion on all fronts. Claire defies Frank, Zoe finds comfort in someone new, and Peter makes an ultimatum.

episodes.title: Chapter 11
episodes.description: Claire fuels an old flame. Peter wrestles with his demons. Frank crosses the point of no return.

episodes.title: Chapter 12
episodes.description: Frank must make an unforeseen detour. Zoe, Lucas and Janine get closer to the truth.

episodes.title: Chapter 13
episodes.description: Frank scrambles to keep his plan on track. Claire is haunted by choices old and new. Zoe poses a serious threat.

episodes.title: Chapter 14
episodes.description: The Underwoods tackle two threats that could bring their plans to ruin. Frank grooms his replacement as Whip. Claire goes on the offensive.

episodes.title: Chapter 15
episodes.description: Frank puts China in the cross-hairs. Claire confronts a painful trauma from her past. Lucas Goodwin presses for the truth.

episodes.title: Chapter 16
episodes.description: Tension rises between Frank and Raymond Tusk as the situation with China deteriorates. A battle in the Senate pits Frank against the Republicans.

episodes.title: Chapter 17
episodes.description: A terror scare at the Capitol traps Frank with a resentful Donald Blythe. Claire gives a live interview that rocks the media.

episodes.title: Chapter 18
episodes.description: Frank back-channels with a Chinese billionaire. Lucas uses extreme measures to expose the Vice President. A shadowy figure joins Team Underwood.

episodes.title: Chapter 19
episodes.description: Amidst an energy crisis, Frank and Tusk end their shaky alliance. Lucas must make a difficult choice. Stamper grows closer to Rachel.

episodes.title: Chapter 20
episodes.description: Despite some friction, the Walkers deepen their friendship with the Underwoods. But it's all-out war between Frank and Tusk.

episodes.title: Chapter 21
episodes.description: The war with Tusk intensifies. Claire influences Tricia Walker politically and domestically. Frank has a show-down with Linda Vasquez.

episodes.title: Chapter 22
episodes.description: Things get personal when Tusk blindsides the Underwoods with a scandal. Freddy and his BBQ joint get caught up in the mix.

episodes.title: Chapter 23
episodes.description: With a military stand-off overseas and potential violence at home, Frank wants to finish off Tusk for good. Claire and Jackie Sharp collide.

episodes.title: Chapter 24
episodes.description: A Special Prosecutor interrogates Frank. Remy Danton tries to keep his options open. Stamper wrestles with his demons.

episodes.title: Chapter 25
episodes.description: Frank finds himself shut out, and Claire makes a difficult sacrifice. Stamper tries to regain control.

episodes.title: Chapter 26
episodes.description: Frank faces annihilation while the nation is in an uproar. Stamper must tie up loose ends. Claire feels the cost of ruthlessness.

episodes.title: Chapter 27
episodes.description: A rocky start for the Underwood Presidency. Frank wants to introduce an ambitious jobs program, while Claire sets her sights on the United Nations.

episodes.title: Chapter 28
episodes.description: Claire's U.N. bid runs into trouble. Frank fights off mutiny with a bold address to the country.

episodes.title: Chapter 29
episodes.description: The Russian president's state visit becomes a cold war of wills, and some punks heat things up.

episodes.title: Chapter 30
episodes.description: Claire bypasses Russia at the U.N. Frank tries to outmaneuver a potential challenger and ends up face to face with a higher power.

episodes.title: Chapter 31
episodes.description: Frank declares war on Congress to jump-start his jobs program. Claire spars with the Russian Ambassador.

episodes.title: Chapter 32
episodes.description: Frank and Claire travel to Moscow to negotiate the return of an imprisoned U.S. citizen. Claire takes a stand that jeopardizes their plans.

episodes.title: Chapter 33
episodes.description: The damage is done and the Underwoods must repair it. But deep wounds don't heal fast, and sometimes not at all.

episodes.title: Chapter 34
episodes.description: A hurricane endangers more than just the entire East Coast and Frank must make a difficult choice.

episodes.title: Chapter 35
episodes.description: The Jordan Valley erupts in chaos as Frank's campaign is picking up steam. Claire gets distrubing intel and counsels him.

episodes.title: Chapter 36
episodes.description: Frank needs to deal with Petrov one on one while Claire tries to preserve the peace-keeping mission. Sacrifices must be made.

episodes.title: Chapter 37
episodes.description: Things turn ugly when Frank, Jackie, and Heather square off during their first debate. Tom joins Claire on the campaign trail.

episodes.title: Chapter 38
episodes.description: Heather Dunbar goes for the jugular, forcing Claire to confront her worst fears. The rift between Frank and Claire widens.

episodes.title: Chapter 39
episodes.description: In the midst of the Iowa caucuses, Frank and Claire must confront hard truths about each other.

episodes.title: Chapter 40
episodes.description: Claire's absence causes problems for Frank on the campaign trail amid rumors of a marital rift. Claire tries to strike out on her own.

episodes.title: Chapter 41
episodes.description: As Claire begins exploring a campaign of her own, she and Frank engage in backdoor political maneuvering. But this time they're not on the same side.

episodes.title: Chapter 42
episodes.description: Claire joins Frank as he stumps in South Carolina, but he doesn't trust her. A disastrous scandal blindsides Frank's campaign on primary day.

episodes.title: Chapter 43
episodes.description: Claire threatens Frank. Frank makes a politically bold move that may provoke Russia. An event at a campaign stop changes everything.

episodes.title: Chapter 44
episodes.description: Claire advises Donald Blythe on dealing with Petrov. Further investigation of Lucas Goodwin dredges up his accusations against Frank.

episodes.title: Chapter 45
episodes.description: Claire clashes with the Secretary of State over her involvement in negotiations with Russia. Dunbar must choose between her campaign and her ethics.

episodes.title: Chapter 46
episodes.description: Frank and Claire adjust to their new reality. The search for Frank's running mate begins. Frank starts a campaign to weaken Conway's strong support.

episodes.title: Chapter 47
episodes.description: Formidable as ever, both Underwoods have their eyes on the big picture as they manipulate a potential running mate and push the gun bill.

episodes.title: Chapter 48
episodes.description: At the convention, Frank and his team publicly push for Catherine Durant to be chosen as his running mate, but privately pursue a different agenda.

episodes.title: Chapter 49
episodes.description: As Frank deals with a new threat to his candidacy, Claire has doubts about their plan. Claire faces a difficult decision concerning her mother.

episodes.title: Chapter 50
episodes.description: Frank ups the ante on the war on terror to counter Conway's public show of strength. Tom joins Claire on the campaign trail.

episodes.title: Chapter 51
episodes.description: Frank asks Will to help deal with extremists threatening to murder hostages. Hammerschmidt digs deeper into the allegations against Frank.

episodes.title: Chapter 52
episodes.description: As the hostage situation continues, Claire secretly negotiates with Yusuf al Ahmadi. Frank confronts Hammerschmidt.

episodes.title: Chapter 53
episodes.description: As Congress debates investigating Frank, he and Claire attempt to stoke fear of terrorism. Tom Yates continues his stay in the White House.

episodes.title: Chapter 54
episodes.description: Frank and his team work to leverage support in key states by any means necessary. Claire learns some upsetting news about one of Frank's friends.

episodes.title: Chapter 55
episodes.description: The day before the election, Conway holds a 24-hour Skype session with voters, while Frank and Claire stump in key states and try to discredit him.

episodes.title: Chapter 56
episodes.description: With a tight race and low voter turnout on Election Day, things look grim for Frank. But he's still got one more trick up his sleeve.

episodes.title: Chapter 57
episodes.description: Nine weeks after Election Day, the Underwoods work to consolidate their power. Leann tries to track down a missing Aidan Macallan.

episodes.title: Chapter 58
episodes.description: In the midst of uncertainty, suspected Russian forces take over an American station in Antarctica. Meanwhile, a damaging news leak could hurt Frank.

episodes.title: Chapter 59
episodes.description: When a crisis forces White House personnel to take shelter in a bunker, Commerce Department official Jane Davis negotiates through back channels.

episodes.title: Chapter 60
episodes.description: While Frank attends an elite men's weekend gathering to firm up support, Claire deals with a stranded Russian ship and threats from Petrov.

episodes.title: Chapter 61
episodes.description: Petrov tries to influence affairs in the U.S. Jane discusses her agenda with Claire. With her job at stake, Leann reaches out to a reporter for help.

episodes.title: Chapter 62
episodes.description: The Underwoods and their team angle to undermine the revived committee investigating Frank. Hammerschmidt's investigation heats up.

episodes.title: Chapter 63
episodes.description: As the team tries to control fallout from damaging testimony and leaks, everyone is under suspicion and tensions flare between Frank and Claire.

episodes.title: Chapter 64
episodes.description: Frank attempts to stop Cathy from testifying. With Hammerschmidt sniffing out the truth, the Underwoods throw someone close to them under the bus.

episodes.title: Chapter 65
episodes.description: In the wake of a surprising announcement, everything at the White House is shaken up. A decision must be made about whether to go to war.

title: Supergirl
description: Twenty-four-year-old Kara Zor-El, who was taken in by the Danvers family when she was 13 after being sent away from Krypton, must learn to embrace her powers after previously hiding them. The Danvers teach her to be careful with her powers, until she has to reveal them during an unexpected disaster, setting her on her journey of heroism.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: After 12 years of keeping her powers a secret on Earth, Kara Zor-El, Superman's cousin, decides to finally embrace her superhuman abilities and be the hero she was always meant to be.

episodes.title: Stronger Together
episodes.description: When Kara’s attempts to help National City don't go according to plan, she must put aside the doubts that she -- and the city's media -- has about her abilities in order to capture an escapee from the Kryptonian prison, Fort Rozz. Also, Cat pressures James to use his connection to Superman to get her an interview with Supergirl.

episodes.title: Fight or Flight
episodes.description: Supergirl’s powers are tested when Reactron, one of Superman’s formidable enemies, arrives in National City and targets the young hero. Also, Cat plans to run an exposé on Supergirl.

episodes.title: Livewire
episodes.description: Kara's Thanksgiving may be ruined when she suspects her foster mother, Dr. Danvers, who is coming to town, disapproves of her new role as a superhero. Also, when an accident transforms a volatile CatCo employee into the villainous Livewire, she targets Cat and Supergirl.

episodes.title: How Does She Do It?
episodes.description: Kara’s two identities are stretched thin when Supergirl must protect National City from a series of bombings and Kara is tasked with babysitting Cat’s son, Carter. Also, James is conflicted when his ex-girlfriend Lucy Lane seeks to rekindle their relationship.

episodes.title: Red Faced
episodes.description: Personal and professional stress get the better of Kara when she goes too far during a training exercise against Red Tornado, a military cyborg commissioned by Lucy Lane’s father, General Sam Lane. Also, Cat’s tough exterior is shaken by a visit from her judgmental mother, Katherine, and Alex enlists Winn to look into her father’s mysterious death.

episodes.title: Human for a Day
episodes.description: Kara and her friends must rely on their inner strength and courage when an earthquake strikes National City. Also, Alex’s mistrust of Hank reaches a breaking point when the earthquake traps them in the DEO with Jemm, a powerful alien escapee.

episodes.title: Hostile Takeover
episodes.description: Kara goes toe-to-toe with Astra when her aunt challenges Kara’s beliefs about her mother. Also, Cat is threatened with being removed as the CEO of CatCo after a hacker exposes her private and damaging emails.

episodes.title: Blood Bonds
episodes.description: With Astra in captivity at the DEO, her husband, Non, captures Hank, leading to a tense standoff between the two sides. Also, Kara continues to refute Cat's allegations that she is Supergirl.

episodes.title: Childish Things
episodes.description: Kara does her best to support Winn when his father, the supervillain Toyman, breaks out of prison and seeks out his son for unknown reasons. Also, Cat offers Lucy a job at CatCo and Alex asks Hank to use his powers to help uncover Maxwell Lord's plan.

episodes.title: Strange Visitor from Another Planet
episodes.description: Kara must help Hank face his painful past when a White Martian, a member of the alien race that wiped out his people, kidnaps Senator Miranda Crane, an anti-alien politician. Also, Cat's estranged son, Adam, arrives in National City.

episodes.title: Bizarro
episodes.description: Kara faces off against her mirror image when Bizarro, a twisted version of Supergirl, sets out to destroy her. Also, Kara grows closer with Cat’s son, Adam.

episodes.title: For The Girl Who Has Everything
episodes.description: Kara’s friends must find a way to save her life when a parasitic alien attaches itself to her and traps her in a dream world where her family is alive and her home planet was never destroyed. Also, Alex, Hank and the DEO must fend off a Kryptonian attack while Kara is out of commission.

episodes.title: Truth, Justice and the American Way
episodes.description: Supergirl does battle with the deadly Master Jailer, who is hunting and executing escaped Fort Rozz prisoners. Also, Cat hires a second assistant, Siobhan Smythe, who immediately tries to one-up Kara, and Kara and James disagree over the DEO's methods.

episodes.title: Solitude
episodes.description: Kara travels to Superman’s Fortress of Solitude in hopes of learning how to defeat Indigo, a dangerous being who can transport via the Internet and who has a connection to Kara’s past. Also, James’s relationship with Lucy reaches a crossroads.

episodes.title: Falling
episodes.description: Kara turns on her friends and the citizens of National City after being exposed to Red Kryptonite makes her malicious and dangerous. Also, Cat appears on THE TALK to discuss Supergirl.

episodes.title: Manhunter
episodes.description: J'onn J'onzz reveals the details of meeting Kara and Alex's father, Dr.  Jeremiah Danvers, and assuming Hank Henshaw's identity.  Also, Kara debates trusting someone new with her secret identity and  Siobhan plots against Kara.

episodes.title: Worlds Finest
episodes.description: Kara gains a new ally when the lightning-fast superhero The Flash suddenly appears from an alternate universe and helps Kara battle Siobhan, aka Silver Banshee, and Livewire in exchange for her help in finding a way to return him home.

episodes.title: Myriad
episodes.description: Kara must find a way to free her friends when Non and Indigo use mind control to turn National City’s citizens into their own army.

episodes.title: Better Angels
episodes.description: Supergirl is forced to do battle with an unexpected foe and must risk everything – including her life – to prevent Non and Indigo from destroying every person on the planet.

episodes.title: The Adventures of Supergirl
episodes.description: When a new threat emerges in National City, Kara/Supergirl teams up with her cousin, Clark Kent/Superman, to stop it. Kara is thrilled to have family in town but it leaves Alex feeling a bit left out. Meanwhile, Hank and Supergirl are stunned by the pod that came crashing to Earth.

episodes.title: The Last Children of Krypton
episodes.description: CADMUS attacks National City with a Kryptonite-powered villain who ends up seriously hurting Supergirl. Superman blames Hank because the Kryptonite was stolen from the DEO. Meanwhile, Kara’s first day at her new job doesn’t go as planned after she meets her new boss, Snapper Carr.

episodes.title: Welcome to Earth
episodes.description: An attack is made on the President as hot-button, alien vs. human rights issues heat up in National City. Supergirl and the DEO are assigned to protect the President and bring in the responsible party. Alex teams up with Detective Maggie Sawyer to investigate the case while Kara searches for a recently escaped Mon-El, who she fears may be the alien behind the assault.

episodes.title: Survivors
episodes.description: When Kara and Alex investigate the murder of an unregistered alien, the trail leads to an alien fight club run by Roulette, the ringmaster who commands aliens to fight in mortal combat for the entertainment of rich humans. While trying to stop the fighting, Supergirl and Martian Manhunter find themselves up against a surprising opponent. Meanwhile, Hank is thrilled to have found another Martian and tries to get to know M'Gann better. Supergirl takes Mon-El under her wing and begins to train him.

episodes.title: Crossfire
episodes.description: Supergirl must beat a ruthless new gang who has been armed with dangerous new alien technology. When Cadmus sends a video to the DEO, the team realizes Cadmus is the one staffing the criminals for a secret mission. Meanwhile, Kara gets Mon-El a job as an intern at CatCo, James makes an important decision and Lena invites Kara to attend one of her fundraisers.

episodes.title: Changing
episodes.description: The Guardian debuts to lend a hand after a parasite alien drains Supergirl of her power. Mon-El considers a less than desirable new career which then leads him to contemplate his motives. Alex struggles with a new reality.

episodes.title: The Darkest Places
episodes.description: While Guardian tries to clear his name after being accused of a murder committed by another vigilante, Supergirl heads out on a solo mission to rescue Mon-El who has been captured by Cadmus. While fighting to free Mon-El, Supergirl comes face to face with Cyborg Superman.

episodes.title: Medusa (I)
episodes.description:
Eliza comes to town to celebrate Thanksgiving with her daughters. Alex decides it’s time to come out to her mother; Kara is shocked when Eliza suggests Mon-El has feelings for her, and Winn and James consider telling Kara the truth about the Guardian. Meanwhile, Cadmus unleashes a virus that instantly kills any alien in the vicinity so Kara enlists an unexpected ally – Lena Luthor. The epic superhero crossover kicks off tonight when Barry Allen and Cisco Ramon seek Kara's help with an alien invasion on their Earth.

The crossover continues on The Flash S03E08 Invasion! (II), Arrow S05E08 Invasion! (III) and DC's Legends of Tomorrow S02E07 Invasion! (IV).

episodes.title: Supergirl Lives
episodes.description: Kara is moved by the story of a missing woman named Izzy and decides to investigate despite Snapper Carr's order to leave it alone. Kara takes Mon-El with her to the last place Izzy was seen and the duo find themselves thrust through a portal to another planet, Slaver's Moon, where the downtrodden are sold as slaves. The leader of the trafficking ring is none other than Roulette. To make matters worse, Slaver's Moon has a red sun, which means Kara and Mon-El are stripped of their powers and stuck on the planet with no way home. Meanwhile, back on Earth, Alex blames herself for Kara's disappearance, fearing she's become too focused on her new relationship with Maggie and too complacent in watching out for her sister.

episodes.title: We Can Be Heroes
episodes.description: After Livewire seemingly breaks out of prison, Supergirl is intent on recapturing her. After training Mon-El, Supergirl takes him with her when she sees Livewire attack the NCPD but things go awry when Mon-El puts Supergirl before the citizens of National City. Meanwhile, James decides to come clean with Kara and M’Gann, has a psychic attack and collapses into a coma.

episodes.title: The Martian Chronicles
episodes.description: Armek, a White Martian, descends on National City intent on taking M’gann back to Mars to face her punishment as a traitor. Hank and Supergirl determine the best way to keep M’gann safe is to bring her to the DEO. However, when it is revealed that Armek shape-shifted into M’gann and is now loose in the building, the team realize he could be disguised as any one of them.

episodes.title: Luthors
episodes.description: After Metallo breaks out of prison and frees Lillian Luthor, the police blame Lena for his escape and arrest her. Despite overwhelming evidence, Kara refuses to believe her friend is guilty and fights to clear Lena’s name. Flashbacks reveal how Lena came to be a Luthor.

episodes.title: Mr. & Mrs. Mxyzptlk
episodes.description: When Mr. Mxyzptlk, a magical imp, shows up on Earth and declares his love for Kara, she tries to let him down easy, thinking him harmless. However, he decides it’s a challenge and starts to wreak havoc on National City. Mon-El has seen beings like Mr. Mxyzptlk on Daxam and knows how dangerous they can be. He and Kara argue over how to get rid of Mr. Mxyzptlk, further straining their relationship. Meanwhile, Alex and Maggie celebrate their first Valentine’s Day together.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.description: When Jeremiah Danvers is rescued from Cadmus, Alex and Kara are thrilled to have their father back. The Danvers arrange a family dinner to celebrate but things go awry when a suspicious Mon-El starts to question Jeremiah about his sudden return.

episodes.title: Exodus
episodes.description: As Alex searches for Jeremiah and Kara investigates a series of alien kidnappings, the sisters realize they must break the rules to foil a new Cadmus plot. In an effort to get Snapper Carr to run a story that would help her stop Cadmus, Kara agrees to set up an interview between Snapper and Supergirl.

episodes.title: Star-Crossed (I)
episodes.description:
A new villain comes to National City, putting Supergirl on high alert. Meanwhile, Winn’s girlfriend, Lyra, gets Winn in trouble with the law. Maggie attempts to help Winn but old loyalties get in the way. The Music Meister attacks Supergirl.

The crossover continues on The Flash S03E17 Duet (II).

episodes.title: Distant Sun
episodes.description: A large bounty is put out on Supergirl and aliens from far and near attack National City intent on taking out the woman of steel.  Alex and Maggie run into Maggie’s ex-girlfriend, Emily, who is in town for a week.  Hank gets an interesting order from President Marsdin.

episodes.title: Ace Reporter
episodes.description: Lena’s ex-boyfriend, Jack Spheer, comes to National City to unveil his big breakthrough in nano-technology, which has the potential to eradicate all diseases. Lena asks Kara to attend Jack’s conference with her for support. When Kara sees Snapper in attendance she’s inspired to tap back into her reporter skills and questions Jack on his discovery, which ultimately leads to a bigger investigation that puts everyone in danger.

episodes.title: Alex
episodes.description: Alex is kidnapped and the kidnapper threatens to kill her unless Supergirl releases a notorious criminal from prison. Supergirl and Maggie have always had different approaches to apprehending criminals but this time they must work together to save Alex. Meanwhile, Rhea has an interesting proposal for Lena.

episodes.title: City of Lost Children
episodes.description: When an alien attacks National City, Supergirl and the DEO learn the alien is a Phorian, an otherwise peaceful race with telekinetic powers. Guardian gets a lead on the Phorian's address but instead of finding the culprit, he finds a very scared boy named Marcus. Marcus will only trust James so it is up to Guardian to stop the attacks on the city. Rhea's plan escalates.

episodes.title: Resist
episodes.description: Supergirl grapples with whether or not to obey the President's orders regarding Rhea's latest actions. Meanwhile, Cat Grant returns to National City.

episodes.title: Nevertheless, She Persisted
episodes.description: Supergirl challenges Rhea to battle to save National City. Meanwhile, Superman returns and Cat Grant offers Supergirl some sage advice.

episodes.title: Girl of Steel
episodes.description: Kara deals with the loss of Mon-El by focusing all her energy on being Supergirl and the mysterious new threat against National City. Alex confesses a secret to Maggie about their impending nuptials. A citizen of National City has a mysterious connection to Kara, and Lena makes a bold move.

episodes.title: Triggers
episodes.description: Psi, a thief with psychic powers, attacks National City. Able to immobilize people by tapping into their worst fears, Psi proves a formidable opponent for Supergirl. Meanwhile, James and Lena are at an impasse, and Samantha starts her new job at L-Corp.

episodes.title: Far From the Tree
episodes.description: Eliza throws Alex and Maggie a wedding shower, which causes Maggie to reach out to her estranged father. Supergirl joins J’onn on a personal mission.

episodes.title: The Faithful
episodes.description: Kara investigates a secretive new group whose leader, Thomas Coville, has a mysterious connection to Supergirl. Meanwhile, Samantha feels like she's letting Ruby down, and J'onn confesses an old secret.

episodes.title: Damage
episodes.description: When multiple children get sick from lead poisoning, Morgan Edge points the finger at Lena and blames her creation of the lead bomb she made to save National City from the Daxamites. While Lena knows she never intended any harm, she fears there may have been a flaw in her design, leaving her responsible. Kara teams up with Samantha to clear Lena’s name, but it turns out to be harder than they thought. Meanwhile, Alex and Maggie make a crucial decision about the future of their relationship.

episodes.title: Midvale
episodes.description: Kara and Alex head home to Midvale for a little R&R. While there, Kara recalls a painful memory of a childhood friend's death and how that traumatic experience brought the Danver sisters closer together.

episodes.title: Wake Up
episodes.description: When Winn and the team discover an alien ship has crash landed deep underwater beneath National City, Kara/Supergirl is called in to investigate. Meanwhile, Hank attempts to bond with his father, Myr'nn. Samantha, eager for some understanding of the changes she has been experiencing, looks to her estranged mother, Patricia Arias, for answers.

episodes.title: Crisis on Earth-X (I)
episodes.description:
Barry and Iris’s wedding brings the gang together, but things go awry when villains from Earth-X attack the ceremony. All of the superheroes band together with help from their super friends like Citizen Cold, The Ray, Felicity Smoak, Iris West and Alex Danvers to take on their most formidable villains yet. Earth’s mightiest heroes – Green Arrow, Supergirl, The Flash and White Canary – lead their teams into battle to save the world.

The crossover continues on Arrow S06E08 Crisis on Earth-X (II), The Flash S04E08 Crisis on Earth-X (III) and DC's Legends of Tomorrow S03E08 Crisis on Earth-X (IV).

episodes.title: Reign
episodes.description: Supergirl investigates a mysterious symbol popping up all over National City, tracing its origins back to an ancient prophecy and the mark of the World Killer, Reign. Meanwhile, the tension between Lena and Morgan Edge continues to build, causing James to step in and offer up some protection, and possibly igniting a spark in the process.

episodes.title: Legion of Superheroes
episodes.description: Struggling to heal from her injuries inflicted by Reign, Supergirl remains in a dreamlike state, unable to be reached. Mon-El recruits one of the Legion members, Brainiac-5, to try to bring her back. Meanwhile, Reign continues her rampage on the city so the DEO teams up with the Legion of Superheroes to try to stop her.

episodes.title: Fort Rozz
episodes.description: As Reign continues to terrorize the city, Supergirl teams up with Saturn Girl, and the two recruit Supergirl’s former enemies, Livewire and Psi, to form a team for a mission to Fort Rozz to recover a prisoner who has information on how to defeat Reign once and for all. Meanwhile, Alex babysits Ruby.

episodes.title: For Good
episodes.description: Someone tries to kill Morgan Edge and he barely survives. He accuses Lena of being behind the attempt and vows to destroy her. When Lena fears her hatred for Morgan will take her to the Luthor dark side, Kara steps in to help her friend. Meanwhile, after Sam realizes she’s losing time, she confides in Alex who decides to run some medical tests to see if she can find out what’s going on with her new friend.

episodes.title: Both Sides Now
episodes.description: The DEO captures a second Worldkiller, Purity. Supergirl and Alex use very different methods of interrogation with Purity in the hopes of finding out how to defeat Reign. However, Purity escapes and attacks the city’s subway tunnels. Meanwhile, J’onn, Winn and Mon-El band together to fix the Legion ship.

episodes.title: Schott Through the Heart
episodes.description: When Winn’s father dies, his estranged mother, Mary, reappears trying to reconnect and to explain why she abandoned him all those years ago. Winn is too embittered from his rough childhood to forgive her but when a copycat Toyman attacks, the two must work together to stop him. Mon-El tells Kara something important about the Worldkillers, and Alex becomes suspicious of Myr'nn’s recent behavior.

episodes.title: In Search of Lost Time
episodes.description: Myr'nn inadvertently causes psychic disturbances at the DEO; Supergirl must work with J'onn to contain the chaos; Mon-El begins training Kara in fighting techniques he's learned in the future.

episodes.title: Of Two Minds
episodes.description: Supergirl and Imra have different ideas on how to stop the third Worldkiller, Pestilence. However, when both Alex and Winn are seriously injured by Pestilence, Supergirl and Imra team up to stop the destruction.

episodes.title: Trinity
episodes.description: Still reeling after learning about Lena’s secret, Supergirl asks Guardian for a favor that could alter his relationship with Lena forever. Meanwhile, with all three Worldkillers united, Supergirl and the team brace for an epic battle.

episodes.title: Shelter from the Storm
episodes.description: When Reign starts hunting Ruby, Supergirl and Alex work together to keep her safe. Supergirl and J'onn look to Sam’s mother for advice on how to stop Reign and come away with some shocking news.

episodes.title: The Fanatical
episodes.description: When Tanya, a disciple of Coville's, escapes from what's left of his cult, she gives Kara and James a journal that could hold the key to saving Sam. Someone learns Guardian's identity and threatens to expose James if he doesn't do what they ask. James contemplates what it means to be a black vigilante without a mask in America.

episodes.title: Dark Side of the Moon
episodes.description: Supergirl is stunned to discover that a part of Krypton survived. Meanwhile, Alex is attacked while out with Ruby, and Lena considers how far she will go to keep Reign contained.

episodes.title: Not Kansas
episodes.description: Kara makes a major life decision. Meanwhile, J'onn finds out that special DEO-caliber guns have hit the streets of National City.

episodes.title: Make It Reign
episodes.description: Supergirl learns the true depth of Selena's nefarious plans for Earth. Supergirl, Mon-El and Alura must devise a plan to stop her before Selena gets to Earth. J'onn prepares to say goodbye to his father.

episodes.title: Battles Lost and Won
episodes.description: Supergirl and team take on Selena in an epic battle for Earth.

episodes.title: American Alien
episodes.description: Diving back into reporting, Kara welcomes a new cub reporter to CatCo. Meanwhile, James and Lena argue about James’ impending indictment for acting as the vigilante Guardian, while Alex and Brainy struggle to get in sync at the DEO. Supergirl  is called into action when remnants of the anti-alien terrorist organization Cadmus try to assassinate pro-alien leaders, but their endgame turns out to be much more sinister than she expected. J’onn relishes his peaceful new life, but an outing with an old friend causes him concern.

episodes.title: Fallout
episodes.description: A shocking revelation causes chaos in National City. Supergirl sets out to capture Mercy Graves, while Alex takes control at the DEO. Back at CatCo, Kara decides to write an investigative story on Mercy and asks Lena if she can interview her as Mercy has ties to the Luthors. Meanwhile, Brainy meets Nia and the two end up in a precarious situation.

episodes.title: Man of Steel
episodes.description: Ben Lockwood didn't always hate aliens. Through a series of incidents, and input from his anti-alien father, Ben slowly transforms from a mild-mannered professor into the villainous Agent Liberty of today.

episodes.title: Ahimsa
episodes.description: When Supergirl needs help, Alex asks Lena and Brainiac to team up. Meanwhile, J’onn questions his decision to quit the DEO. However, after running into Manchester Black, he realizes there are a lot of ways to help his fellow aliens during this tumultuous time.

episodes.title: Parasite Lost
episodes.description: Colonel Haley makes a surprising decision regarding Supergirl. Kara writes a series of articles highlighting aliens in National City in the hopes that humans will stop being so fearful of them. Unfortunately, the article puts some of the aliens in harm’s way.

episodes.title: Call to Action
episodes.description: Everyone gathers for Thanksgiving but Kara is feeling down after her televised debate with Ben Lockwood about the anti-alien sentiment coursing through National City. Meanwhile, James and Lena argue about the best way to handle the Children of Liberty.

episodes.title: Rather the Fallen Angel
episodes.description: James falls in deeper with the Children of Liberty in his efforts to meet Agent Liberty. Meanwhile, Supergirl and Manchester Black follow a lead on Agent Liberty’s location, but things take a dark turn. Lena kicks off her first set of trials.

episodes.title: Bunker Hill
episodes.description: Nia has a powerful dream about Agent Liberty but refuses to look at it as a prophetic dream and pushes it aside. After noticing something is bothering Nia, Kara  enlists Brainy's help, and the two try to persuade Nia to embrace her destiny. Meanwhile, Manchester Black pays Ben Lockwood a menacing visit.

episodes.title: Elseworlds (III)
episodes.description:
Supergirl, The Flash, Green Arrow and Superman engage in the battle of their lives.

The crossover starts on The Flash S05E09 Elseworlds (I) and Arrow S07E09 Elseworlds (II).

episodes.title: Suspicious Minds
episodes.description: Colonel Haley is upset after Supergirl responds to a distress call from a Navy ship that turned out to be a deadly alien attack. Colonel Haley reclaims the site as DEO territory and demands that Supergirl step aside. After Supergirl refuses to be told what to do, Haley refocuses her energy on finding out Supergirl's true identity and begins to interrogate all DEO agents, including Alex. Meanwhile, Brainiac-5 tries to persuade Nia to embrace her superpowers but she misinterprets his motives.

episodes.title: Blood Memory
episodes.description: Kara joins Nia on a trip to Nia's hometown to visit her family during the town's annual Harvest Festival. While home, Nia's mother encourages her daughter to embrace her destiny. Meanwhile, Alex deals with a street drug that is turning people violent and giving them temporary superpowers.

episodes.title: Menagerie
episodes.description: With his P.I. shingle newly hung outside his office, J'onn welcomes new clients. Trying to take her mind off what happened at the DEO, Kara decides to team up with J'onn on his latest assignment, which unfortunately ends up tying directly into Alex's current investigation that involves the villain Menagerie. Meanwhile, Lena shares some news with James, but his reaction isn't what she expected. Nia invites Brainy to her Valentine's Day party.

episodes.title: What's So Funny About Truth, Justice, and the American Way?
episodes.description: Manchester Black breaks out of prison with the help of his new team, The Elite, who are set on punishing the anti-alien forces. Supergirl pulls double duty as she tries to apprehend Manchester Black and his team as well as deal with a shocking new development with Ben Lockwood.

episodes.title: Stand and Deliver
episodes.description: Between Ben Lockwood’s new push to stir up the anti-alien movement and the Elite’s desire to target Lockwood and his minions, Supergirl is concerned about the safety of the American people – both human and alien. When Lockwood organizes a rally, the aliens decide to peacefully protest. Brainiac and J’onn join the alien march while Supergirl and Dreamer patrol to keep everyone safe. Meanwhile, James picks up his camera again to cover the march for CatCo, and Hayley assigns Alex a job that clashes with her beliefs. When The Elite and Ben Lockwood stir up trouble at the rally, Supergirl is forced to take a stand.

episodes.title: O Brother, Where Art Thou?
episodes.description: Secretly furloughed from prison due to failing health, Lex Luthor visits his sister, Lena, to seek her help finding a cure. Savvy as ever, Lena is suspicious of Lex's motives but when she's faced with a life and death situation, she must decide how she truly feels about her brother. Meanwhile, Supergirl and J'onn face off against Manchester Black. James' sister Kelly comes to town.

episodes.title: The House of L
episodes.description: In the wake of Lex Luthor's return, the show flashes back to what he's been doing for the last two years and how his secret machinations and plans have affected Supergirl and Lena.

episodes.title: All About Eve
episodes.description: Supergirl must deal with the destructive aftermath of Lex's nefarious plans. Shocked at what Lex has created, Supergirl faces her biggest challenge yet.

episodes.title: Crime and Punishment
episodes.description: Kara and Lena head to Stryker's Island to search for clues on how to defeat Lex. At the prison, Kara tries to befriend a nosy prisoner, Steve, who may have insight into what Lex was doing, while Lena studies an array of puzzles Lex left behind in the hopes of discovering his whereabouts. While there, a prison riot breaks out and Kara must find a way to stop the prisoners without revealing her secret identity as Supergirl. Meanwhile, Kelly encourages James to talk to someone for his PTSD, and Alex faces off against Ben Lockwood after he storms the DEO and acquires some powerful weapons to hunt Supergirl.

episodes.title: American Dreamer
episodes.description: As Kara doggedly works as a reporter to clear Supergirl's name, Dreamer picks up the slack as National City's protector, which leads to a showdown with Ben Lockwood. James takes drastic measures to relieve his PTSD.

episodes.title: Will The Real Miss Tessmacher Please Stand Up?
episodes.description: Kara and Lena head to Kaznia to hunt down Lex. However, Eve Tessmacher sets a trap for the duo that could ultimately reveal that Kara is Supergirl. Meanwhile, Alex gets a long-awaited phone call, James practices using his powers, and Ben Lockwood takes a dangerous stand inside the DEO.

episodes.title: Red Dawn
episodes.description: Kara comes face to face with Red Daughter and the two engage in an epic battle. Determined to find a way to extract the Harun-El, Lena turns to an unlikely source for help - Lillian Luthor. Meanwhile, Alex realizes she's missing parts of her memory, and Brainy, Nia and J'onn set out to track down aliens who have been abducted by Lex.

episodes.title: The Quest for Peace
episodes.description: Lex Luthor descends upon Washington, DC and summons Lena and Lillian Luthor to the White House. Supergirl realizes she has one last chance to stop Lex and turns to the power of the press to help her.

episodes.title: Event Horizon
episodes.description: Kara is surprised to find that CatCo has a new owner who has brought in a star reporter. New couples emerge and explore their budding relationships while J’onn J’onzz receives an unexpected visitor.

episodes.title: Stranger Beside Me
episodes.description: Supergirl, Alex, and Brainiac thwart an alien attack while William investigates Kara. J'onn J'onzz and Kelly use Obsidian tech to solve a problem.

episodes.title: Blurred Lines
episodes.description: Kara attempts to mend her relationship with Lena. J’onn J’onzz takes a deep dive into his memories while Kelly  tries to help an old friend.

episodes.title: In Plain Sight
episodes.description: Kara's investigation into William Dey's "criminal" activities results in the shocking revelation he is not who she thinks. Meanwhile, the conflict between Malefic and J'onn J'onzz reaches a boiling point.

episodes.title: Dangerous Liaisons
