episodes.description: The Moon examines dreams and nightmares of Elmore residents.

episodes.title: The Misunderstandings
episodes.description: On his way to a date with Penny, Gumball finds himself dealing with people at their most oblivious.

episodes.title: The Roots
episodes.description: The family tries to make Darwin connect with his fish roots.

episodes.title: The Blame
episodes.description: After Felicity bans video games in Elmore, Gumball and his friends try to have books banned instead.

episodes.title: The Slap
episodes.description: Tobias offends Gumball when he doesn't slap him on the butt.

episodes.title: The Detective
episodes.description: When Daisy goes missing, Anais suspects Gumball and Darwin.

episodes.title: The Fury
episodes.description: A strange figure arrives and insults Nicole, but the kids are surprised when Nicole doesn't fight back.

episodes.title: The Compilation
episodes.description: Odd internet clips are recalled by the people of Elmore.

episodes.title: The Scam
episodes.description: Gumball scares the school into thinking a monster named Gargaroth is haunting the place, then recruits Carrie and Darwin (who has a crush on Carrie) as ghost exterminators in order to scam everyone in Elmore of their candy.

episodes.title: The Disaster
episodes.description: Rob gets new powers through a remote control and tries to destroy Gumball's world.

episodes.title: The Stories
episodes.description: Fed up with having to listen to Molly's long, tedious anecdotes, Gumball and Darwin try to teach her how to make them sound more exciting. When this doesn't work, they decide their only option is to give Molly a story worth telling.

episodes.title: The Re-Run
episodes.description: In this sequel to last season's "The Disaster", Gumball travels back to the events of the previous episode to prevent Rob from ruining his life, but everything he does makes things worse.

episodes.title: The Guy
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin are wary of Anais' new friend, Josh, making her question his motives as well.

episodes.title: The Boredom
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin search for adventure during a walk around Elmore.

episodes.title: The Vision
episodes.description: After finding a secret manifesto on Alan's memory stick, Gumball and Darwin decide to foil his plan for world domination.

episodes.title: The Choices
episodes.description: Nicole reminisces about how she met Richard during a disastrous family dinner, and how things could have turned out for her if she had not.

episodes.title: The Code
episodes.description: The family goes without wi-fi after Mr. Robinson changes the passcode, so Gumball tries to recover it.

episodes.title: The Test
episodes.description: When he is labeled a "loser" in an online test, Gumball believes he must do the opposite of everything he would normally do. Meanwhile, Darwin and Sarah notice Tobias is stealing Gumball's life and role in the series in the form of a cheesy sitcom.

episodes.title: The Slide
episodes.description: Rocky decides to stop living life online, and find love on a dating app, and Gumball and Darwin try to help him.

episodes.title: The Loophole
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin give Bobert instructions so he will behave in a safe and responsible manner, but he applies his logic to their rules.

episodes.title: The Potato
episodes.description: When Darwin has lunch with Idaho, he decides to stop eating potatoes in solidarity with his brotato, but he finds his obsession with his favorite food harder to kick than he ever imagined, so Gumball decides to help his friend curb his carb cravings.

episodes.title: The Fuss
episodes.description: Nicole tries, and fails, to hide her disappointment when Richard and the kids fail to remember her special day. Richard has to figure out what special day he has actually forgotten and then make it a day to remember or else.

episodes.title: The Copycats
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin are confused when they meet Chi Chi and Ribbit, a pair of siblings that copy everything they do and say. Then they find out this copycat family is making money online from imitating the Watterson family.

episodes.title: The Outside
episodes.description: The family goes to visit Richard's dad. Based on his basic living standards and extended absence from Richard's life, they assume Frankie must have done a stretch in the slammer.

episodes.title: The Vase
episodes.description: Sick of Granny Jojo's ugly gifts, Nicole encourages the kids to take matters into their own hands and "accidentally" break her latest hideous vase. But when Gumball, Darwin, and Anais try to destroy it, they discover it is more robust than it seems.

episodes.title: The Matchmaker
episodes.description: Gumball enlists Carrie to help bring Darwin and Teri together, but when they can't make Darwin and Teri's love blossom naturally, they decide to make it happen supernaturally.

episodes.title: The Box
episodes.description: The Wattersons receive an unmarked package in the mail. To distract themselves from the urge to open it they all take turns to imagine what it might contain.

episodes.title: The Console
episodes.description: When Gumball is given a cursed video game console, Elmore becomes trapped inside a fantasy RPG world. Gumball, Darwin and Anais have to battle their way through town, unraveling the secrets of their new virtual reality.

episodes.title: The Ollie
episodes.description: Gumball teaches Darwin everything he knows about the world of skateboarding.

episodes.title: The Catfish
episodes.description: When Gumball and Darwin realize Grandpa Louie has no friends, they create one called Muriel, when Granny Jojo finds out Louie has been spending time online with another woman, Muriel not existing is not going to stop her from being destroyed.

episodes.title: The Cycle
episodes.description: Gumball, Darwin and Anais discover that Mr. Wilson has been picking on Richard for most of his life; ever since he humiliated Richard with a high school prank. The kids try to work their dad through it, but when their efforts fail they realize that getting back at Mr. Wilson is the only way to break the cycle.

episodes.title: The Stars
episodes.description: When Richard gives Larry’s hairdresser a bad review for saying he’s bald, he gets offered a free haircut. This inspires Gumball and Darwin to go on a reviewing spree across town, forcing Larry to give them stuff with the threat of a bad review. But, just because the customer is always right doesn’t mean that what they’re doing isn’t wrong.

episodes.title: The Grades
episodes.description: When a failed test grade brings down Gumball’s grade point average, he is forced to return to kindergarten.

episodes.title: The Diet
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin find out why Richard's diet wasn't working, and after they help him lose weight, he becomes more obnoxious.

episodes.title: The Ex
episodes.description: When Gumball learns that his nemesis, Rob, has found a new nemesis, he tries to sabotage Rob's new "enemy-ship", much to the frustration of Penny.

episodes.title: The Sorcerer
episodes.description: Gumball refuses to accept he is the only kid at school that does not have special powers. He convinces Mrs. Jötunheim, Hector's mom, to take him on as her apprentice but she soon learns leaving Gumball unsupervised around magic is a big mistake.

episodes.title: The Menu
episodes.description: The prize jewel on the Secret Joyful Burger menu is a mysterious burger, but to order it you need to know its name. When Larry refuses to tell Richard, Gumball, and Darwin what it is called, they go to super-sized lengths to discover it.

episodes.title: The Uncle
episodes.description: When Gumball finds out that Ocho has an uncle named Mario, he becomes desperate to meet him.

episodes.title: The Weirdo
episodes.description: When they see the school bullies making fun of Sussie, Gumball and Darwin decide to try and help her act less weird. They carefully observe her behavior and decide that the only thing they have to change is absolutely everything.

episodes.title: The Heist
episodes.description: Richard discovers that going into a bank whilst wearing a motorcycle helmet can lead to trouble.

episodes.title: The Singing
episodes.description: Join the citizens of Elmore for a song and dance spectacular that will have people covering their ears with joy.

episodes.title: The Best
episodes.description: No matter what Gumball does, Carmen thinks she knows better; when Gumball attempts to gain the moral high ground, but fails, his only option left is to bring Carmen down to his level.

episodes.title: The Worst
episodes.description: The Wattersons compete over who has the worst life.

episodes.title: The Deal
episodes.description: Richard goes on strike to prove that his work around the house is under appreciated by Nicole.

episodes.title: The Petals
episodes.description: When Leslie's petals begin falling off, he feels like his good looks are fading, so Gumball and Darwin use everything they know about style and beauty to try and help him.

episodes.title: The Puppets
episodes.description: Darwin is delighted when they discover their old childhood toys, but soon realizes that some things are best left in the past.

episodes.title: The Nuisance
episodes.description: The Wattersons fear the worst when they are summoned to a Town Hall meeting, but are surprised when they're offered a new house - until they discover it's in a different state.

episodes.title: The Line
episodes.description: The Wattersons will do whatever it takes to get into the first screening of the latest Stellar Odyssey sequel.

episodes.title: The List
episodes.description: When the kids find out that Mom's life hasn't panned out as she'd hoped, they start taking on her chores, but they accidentally grab her bucket list instead of her to-do list.

episodes.title: The News
episodes.description: From police chases to the inside scoop on Daisy the Donkey, Channel 6 Elmore News has all the top local stories. Experienced newscaster Kip Schlezinger brings the latest news, sports and weather, even when there is absolutely nothing to report.

title: You
description: A dangerously charming, obsessive man goes to extreme measures to insert himself into the lives of women who fascinate him.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: A charming first encounter quickly turns into something more nefarious when bookstore manager Joe takes a very strong liking to grad student Beck.

episodes.title: The Last Nice Guy in New York
episodes.description: As Beck deals with unwanted advances from her advisor, she brings Joe to Peach's high society soiree. Joe tries to navigate matters with Benji.

episodes.title: Maybe
episodes.description: Beck's continued casual encounters catch Joe off guard, as does a run-in with the police. Both make him realize a key situation must be dealt with.

episodes.title: The Captain
episodes.description: After an awkward evening with Beck, Joe discovers he's not the only one keeping secrets. Peach's antagonistic approach to Joe intensifies.

episodes.title: Living with the Enemy
episodes.description: A video from Annika's past comes back to haunt her. Joe and Peach's simmering tension boils over when Peach introduces Beck to a major literary agent.

episodes.title: Amour Fou
episodes.description: Beck heads to Connecticut with Peach, whose motives are not what they seem. Joe's pursuit of her stirs up old memories – and brings new injuries.

episodes.title: Everythingship
episodes.description: A grieving Beck turns to therapy, which leads Joe to do the same – for different reasons. Joe's plans for Beck's birthday don't go as expected.

episodes.title: You Got Me, Babe
episodes.description: Three months later, life is good for Joe and Beck, respectively. But a series of reconnections may spell trouble for Joe's current relationship.

episodes.title: Candace
episodes.description: So, what exactly happened to Candace? Beck is determined to find out – but to do so, she'll have to take a page straight from Joe's book.

episodes.title: Bluebeard's Castle
episodes.description: Joe juggles problems with Paco and Beck – and now must contend with a private investigator as well. But resolution is coming, one way or another.

episodes.title: A Fresh Start
episodes.description: Joe – now "Will" – arrives in his own personal hell on Earth: LA. He's trying to go straight, but the past doesn't always leave well enough alone.

episodes.title: Just the Tip
episodes.description: Joe realizes Will Bettelheim isn't all he's cracked up to be. The fallout threatens to get in the way of his burgeoning connection with Love.

episodes.title: What Are Friends For?
episodes.description: Joe attempts to keep things platonic with Love and keep his nose out of Ellie's business. But his instincts soon get the better of him.

episodes.title: The Good, the Bad, & the Hendy
episodes.description: As he tries to adapt to sharing Love with Forty, Joe is caught off guard by a group date – while his protectiveness of Ellie quickly escalates.

episodes.title: Have a Good Wellkend, Joe!
episodes.description: Love brings Joe to a wellness weekend, where he gets a good look at her family's dynamic. But Forty's surprise guest has him feeling anything but zen.

episodes.title: Farewell, My Bunny
episodes.description: Joe performs surveillance on a potential problem, but suspects someone might be tailing him, too. Painful memories put Love on edge about the present.

episodes.title: Ex-istential Crisis
episodes.description: To soothe heartache, Joe turns to ancient remedies, modern technology and drinking with Delilah. But one small slip-up could have major consequences.

episodes.title: Fear and Loathing in Beverly Hills
episodes.description: Joe wants to get away, but Forty insists they finish their script. As pressure mounts, Forty's excessive coping devices make for a harrowing night.

episodes.title: P.I. Joe
episodes.description: As Love looks after an increasingly skittish Ellie, Joe tries to reconstruct the events of a trippy evening – but finds the truth to be elusive.

episodes.title: Love, Actually
episodes.description: Joe has always been full of surprises, but Love has a few of her own. Is this the beginning of the end, or the end of the deceiving?

episodes.title: And They Lived Happily Ever After
episodes.description: After a delivery room surprise, new dad Joe struggles to connect with his infant child, but he has no trouble at all fostering a new infatuation.

episodes.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
episodes.description: Joe and Love try couples therapy, but their issues may need more than counseling – and their friction isn't the only thing they need to make disappear.

episodes.title: Missing White Woman Syndrome
episodes.description: Love grows apprehensive as media scrutiny intensifies next door. An acute sickness in the family drudges up old memories – and worse – for Joe.

episodes.title: Hands Across Madre Linda
episodes.description: An impulsive retaliation by Love lands her and Joe in a bind. Though Joe seeks a different way out than usual, it proves to be a tall order.

episodes.title: Into the Woods
episodes.description: Joe begrudgingly goes on a hunting trip with some other local husbands as Love tries to manage her burgeoning relationship with Theo.

episodes.title: W.O.M.B.
episodes.description: As her mother launches a new venture, Love grows increasingly concerned about a potential big change herself. Joe has a breakthrough in self-awareness.

episodes.title: We're All Mad Here
episodes.description: While Dottie spirals into emotional turmoil, Love tries to get intel on Matthew's investigation. Joe sets his sights on derailing Marienne's ex.

episodes.title: Swing and a Miss
episodes.description: Joe selfishly tries to coerce Love into a lifestyle change, but things go south quickly. Theo discovers just how deep Matthew's obsession goes.

episodes.title: Red Flag
episodes.description: While Love tends to some unexpected long-term guests, Joe decides to take a drastic step to get what he wants the most.

episodes.title: What Is Love?
episodes.description: As news permeates the community about a recent murder, Joe looks toward a future with Marienne – but hell hath no fury like Love scorned.

episodes.title: Joe Takes a Holiday
episodes.description: Now living in London, Joe tries to lay low and resist old habits... until he's forced to tie up loose ends and bond with a circle of wealthy socialites.

episodes.title: Portrait of the Artist
episodes.description: Joe leans on his skills — and a student's insights — to catch his stalker. An art show offers a gallery of suspects, revealing more than the eye can see.

episodes.title: Eat the Rich
episodes.description: As news of a killer targeting the rich swirls, Joe's stalker inches dangerously close to the truth. Joe's efforts to protect Kate take a dark turn.

episodes.title: Hampsie
episodes.description: A ritzy weekend getaway doubles as a chance for Joe to hunt down his elusive stalker. Without cell service or Wi-Fi, Joe makes a key connection.

episodes.title: The Fox and the Hound
episodes.description: While falling back into familiar patterns, Joe gets caught up in an unfortunate game as everyone's plans go up in flames.

episodes.title: Best of Friends
episodes.description: In the aftermath of the murders, Joe searches for a scapegoat and Rhys pursues his grand ambitions while Kate and Phoebe assert their independence.

episodes.title: Good Man, Cruel World
episodes.description: The tables turn for Joe when an influential figure comes to town with a tempting offer as Nadia follows a hunch.

episodes.title: Where Are You Going, Where Have You Been?
episodes.description: As memories of the past trickle in, Joe struggles to recall an important detail. Phoebe shares her hasty plans with Kate. Nadia scrambles for a solution.

episodes.title: She's Not There
episodes.description: Torn between his dark side and good intentions, Joe works to right his wrongs. After attempting to help Phoebe, Kate faces her father – and hard truths.

episodes.title: The Death of Jonathan Moore
episodes.description: With love and loss weighing heavily on his mind, Joe commits a final act in hopes of never walking down the same path again.

episodes.title: The Luckiest Guy in NY
episodes.description: Joe and Kate settle in New York with a pledge to start over, but their headline-making marriage hits a snag when betrayal strikes close to home.

episodes.title: Blood Will Have Blood
episodes.description: A family dinner descends into chaos when Kate's sister Reagan makes a shocking allegation. Bronte's curiosity lands her in a tight spot.

episodes.title: Imposter Syndrome
episodes.description: Joe hits an impasse in Mooney's basement, as tension builds at home. Kate plays hardball to protect Henry. Bronte faces exposure at a literary salon.

episodes.title: My Fair Maddie
episodes.description: A game-changing announcement at Lockwood Corporation sets off alarm bells for Kate. An unwelcome guest crashes Mooney's grand reopening.

episodes.title: Last Dance
episodes.description: Fueled by fear, Kate finds answers from a troubled source. A puzzling note at work sends Joe on a search for the whereabouts of a missing person.

episodes.title: The Dark Face of Love
episodes.description: A viral video complicates Joe's dreams of a fresh start — and forces Bronte to question her loyalties. Kate makes changes at home.

episodes.title: #JoeGoldberg
episodes.description: As faces from his past resurface, the "most visible man in New York" must sway the court of public opinion.

episodes.title: Folie a Deux
episodes.description: With their relationship at a crossroads, Joe gives Bronte a gift to test her commitment. Kate finds a shoulder to lean on.

episodes.title: Trial of the Furies
episodes.description: Joe must use all his talents to liberate himself from the Lockwoods' financial grip. Kate tries a dose of deception to achieve her goal.

episodes.title: Finale
episodes.description: Hoping to decisively close the book on the past, Joe embarks on a risky new chapter. But as with every great story, one last twist awaits.

title: Scorpion
description: Eccentric genius Walter O’Brien and his team of brilliant misfits comprise the last line of defense against complex, high-tech threats of the modern age. As Homeland Security’s new think tank, O’Brien’s “Scorpion” team includes Toby Curtis, an expert behaviorist who can read anyone; Happy Quinn, a mechanical prodigy; and Sylvester Dodd, a statistics guru.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: When a crisis at LAX prevents dozens of airplanes from landing, the government brings in a group of misfit geniuses to sort things out.

episodes.title: Single Point of Failure
episodes.description: The governor calls on Team Scorpion when his daughter is mysteriously "bio-hacked" with a deadly virus and only has 24 hours to live. The case takes on a deeper significance for Walter after he receives a letter regarding his sister.

episodes.title: A Cyclone
episodes.description: After failing a military training mission, the team members are determined to prove themselves when an Internet infrastructure is threatened by a bomber.

episodes.title: Shorthanded
episodes.description: Against Cabe's advice, Team Scorpion heads to Las Vegas for a simple casino job, but a robbery leads to Walter's arrest and the rest of the team is left to clear his name.

episodes.title: Plutonium Is Forever
episodes.description: To fix a Los Angeles nuclear reactor that's on the verge of a cataclysmic meltdown, Walter and the team must reluctantly enlist the help of a troubled former member.

episodes.title: True Colors
episodes.description: The members of Team Scorpion must pass a mandated psych evaluation or face being disbanded after they're accused of destroying a priceless work of art in an attempt to protect an art exhibit. Paige enlists the help of the team when Ralph is reluctant to go to his school's Halloween party.

episodes.title: Father's Day
episodes.description: A case gets personal for Team Scorpion when three convicts break out of prison and one of them is a brilliant hacker who was forced to help the others steal billions online. Meanwhile, Paige must manage Ralph's expectations when his father returns.

episodes.title: Risky Business
episodes.description: Team Scorpion enlists the help of a musician who created a controversial algorithm that generates hit songs to help find the murderer of a music blogger.  Meanwhile, Drew asks Walter to help him connect with his son.

episodes.title: Rogue Element
episodes.description: Team Scorpion try to protect Cabe's ex-wife, after she uncovers evidence that suggests foul play in the death of a prominent congressman.

episodes.title: Talismans
episodes.description: When a military plane is shot down in Bosnia, Team Scorpion must help recover its stealth technology before it falls into enemy hands. Meanwhile, Walter's sister takes a break from her MS treatment and spends time at the garage with Sylvester

episodes.title: Revenge
episodes.description: When Sylvester accidentally triggers an explosive device during an investigation, Team Scorpion must focus on finding who's responsible even while their friend's life hangs in the balance.

episodes.title: Dominoes
episodes.description: On Christmas Eve, Team Scorpion races to find a way to save a young boy's life after he is trapped in a beachside cave and the rising tide threatens to drown him.

episodes.title: Kill Screen
episodes.description: Team Scorpion must help Ralph when the FBI questions him after his dark web game play inadvertently reveals the location of a CIA safe house and results in the murder of CIA operatives.

episodes.title: Charades
episodes.description: Team Scorpion is tasked with uncovering a mole inside the CIA who is being coerced into stealing deadly chemicals. Paige gives Walter a flirting lesson in preparation for the case.

episodes.title: Forget Me Nots
episodes.description: Team Scorpion must jog the memory of an injured former Secret Service agent to prevent nuclear weapons from being launched. Meanwhile, Paige is torn when Drew suggests that moving to Maine might be the best for Ralph.

episodes.title: Love Boat
episodes.description: Team Scorpion goes undercover on a cruise ship to locate and disable deadly stolen rockets. Meanwhile, as Valentine's Day approaches, Toby and Happy help Ralph, who is in the throes of his first crush.

episodes.title: Going South
episodes.description: A tech billionaire hires Team Scorpion to rescue his kidnapped daughter. Meanwhile, some feelings get hurt when Walter gives an interview and fails to acknowledge the other members of the team.

episodes.title: Once Bitten, Twice Die
episodes.description: When a conflict in Eastern Europe threatens to escalate, Team Scorpion is called on to help facilitate secret peace talks to prevent World War III.

episodes.title: Young Hearts Spark Fire
episodes.description: While on a mission to save lost hikers, Team Scorpion’s helicopter crashes, igniting a massive wildfire that quickly closes in on them. Also, Sylvester must help their injured pilot who is unable to make it to safer ground.

episodes.title: Crossroads
episodes.description: To protect a key witness who is en route to testifying against a deadly drug cartel, Team Scorpion takes her on the run, with the cartel hot on their heels.

episodes.title: Cliffhanger
episodes.description: Walter finally learns Cabe’s long-kept secret regarding the Baghdad mission, and it threatens to tear Team Scorpion apart forever.  Also, Paige’s world is rocked when Ralph puts his life in danger to help the team.

episodes.title: Postcards from the Edge
episodes.description: Scorpion, torn apart and uncertain about their future as a team, must come together for their most important mission yet – to save Walter’s life as his car teeters on the side of a cliff.

episodes.title: Satellite of Love
episodes.description: The new Director of Homeland Security, Adriana Molina, reunites the team when a nuclear powered Russian satellite is knocked out of orbit and must be diverted before it detonates over Southern California. Paige and Walter face their feelings for each other when hospital footage reveals that Paige kissed him.

episodes.title: Cuba Libre
episodes.description: Team Scorpion heads to Cuba when a woman from Cabe’s past pleads for him to help catch a Serbian war criminal.

episodes.title: Fish Filet
episodes.description: Sylvester goes undercover in a federal prison in order to save the lives of three judges, but the team must help him escape when his life is threatened.

episodes.title: Robots
episodes.description: Walter, Cabe and Happy are trapped with the crew in a top secret submarine when an explosion sends it to the bottom of the ocean with limited oxygen and a self-destruct function that will soon activate.

episodes.title: Super Fun Guys
episodes.description: Team Scorpion goes undercover on the “Super Fun Guy” movie set in Kazakhstan in order to disable a soviet era nuclear missile being sold by terrorists.

episodes.title: Tech, Drugs, and Rock 'n Roll
episodes.description: Walter’s attempt to “normalize” goes horribly wrong when a nefarious virus is uploaded to his computer, turning Team Scorpion’s new “smart” building project into a burning death trap with people locked inside.

episodes.title: Crazy Train
episodes.description: Team Scorpion must stop a sabotaged runaway subway train with Paige and Ralph on board. Also, in his attempt to impress Happy, Toby has his first boxing match.

episodes.title: Area 51
episodes.description: Team Scorpion helps the CIA locate a top-secret aircraft in Area 51 in order to raise money for Walter's research to save his sister's life.

episodes.title: US vs. UN vs. UK
episodes.description: Team Scorpion is blackmailed to break into the United Nations to assist in the assassination of a menacing arms dealer. Also, Sylvester makes a bold move to protect Megan's wishes.

episodes.title: Arrivals and Departures
episodes.description: When Team Scorpion and Walter's parents visit Megan in the hospital as her health deteriorates, they are quarantined after a deadly fungus outbreak threatens to infect everyone.

episodes.title: The Old College Try
episodes.description: Team Scorpion goes undercover at a university to find a hacker who infiltrates the Federal Reserve and threatens to collapse the world economy.

episodes.title: Dam Breakthrough
episodes.description: Team Scorpion must stop a catastrophe on Christmas Eve when heavy rain creates a large crack in a dam, putting an entire town in danger.

episodes.title: White Out
episodes.description: The members of Team Scorpion brave subzero temperatures in Antarctica to save a United States Special Forces unit. Toby risks his life to save Happy.

episodes.title: Sun of a Gun
episodes.description: Sylvester comes face to face with his estranged father, a retired general, who asks Team Scorpion for help when he believes that a dictator in Africa has uncovered a deadly World War II-era weapon of mass destruction and intends to use it.

episodes.title: Da Bomb
episodes.description: Team Scorpion is tasked with helping NASA’s top secret rocket launch, but they must sabotage their own mission when Walter’s date from the previous night has a bomb strapped to her chest.

episodes.title: Fractured
episodes.description: After a powerful earthquake rocks Los Angeles, Team Scorpion must fix a pinched gas line to prevent a massive explosion.

episodes.title: Adaptation
episodes.description: While Team Scorpion works to stop an influx of drugs being smuggled into the country via drones, Walter gives Happy and Toby an ultimatum on their new relationship.

episodes.title: The Fast & the Nerdiest
episodes.description: After Sylvester scores big on The Price Is Right, Team Scorpion must infiltrate a high-end car smuggling operation about to ship bioweapons to South America.

episodes.title: Ticker
episodes.description: When Los Angeles’ blood supply is hacked and deemed unusable because of fear it’s been tainted, Team Scorpion must find the culprit in order to save a young girl in desperate need of a heart transplant.

episodes.title: Djibouti Call
episodes.description: While on a secret mission in Djibouti, Africa, with his new Homeland protégé, Tim Armstrong, Cabe is captured and Team Scorpion must save him.

episodes.title: Twist and Shout
episodes.description: Team Scorpion’s mission to recover the remains of fallen Marines in Vietnam is threatened along with their lives when a deadly tornado heads directly towards them.

episodes.title: Hard Knox
episodes.description: Team Scorpion is hired by the Department of Defense to break into Fort Knox and “steal” a precious artifact in order to test their security, but they must break in a second time when they find something dangerous hidden inside the object.

episodes.title: Chernobyl Intentions
episodes.description: Team Scorpion goes to Chernobyl to repair the decaying nuclear reactor before a catastrophic meltdown, but must also save Sylvester and Paige when they become trapped inside.

episodes.title: Toby or Not Toby
episodes.description: Team Scorpion must outthink their unstable ex-Scorpion member, Mark Collins, after he kidnaps Toby and threatens to kill him unless his cunning demands are met.

episodes.title: Civil War
episodes.description: The team members set aside their personal and romantic issues when hackers take over targeted U.S. military aircraft and war ships, pointing the weaponry at American cities.

episodes.title: More Civil War
episodes.description: The team members set aside their personal and romantic issues when hackers take over targeted U.S. military aircraft and war ships, pointing the weaponry at American cities.

episodes.title: It Isn’t the Fall That Kills You
episodes.description: When Walter is accidentally launched into space in a rocket, he hallucinates about Paige as his oxygen runs low, and Team Scorpion works feverishly to find a way to bring him home before he suffocates.

episodes.title: Little Boy Lost
episodes.description: Team Scorpion must find a boy from Ralph’s class who goes missing on a field trip after he accidentally has a run-in with a deadly criminal. Also, Toby gets closer to finding out the identity of Happy’s husband.

episodes.title: Plight at the Museum
episodes.description: Team Scorpion’s simple job at the Los Angeles Natural History Museum turns deadly when they discover thieves robbing a rare gem exhibit in order to get materials needed to enrich a nuclear bomb.

episodes.title: Bat Poop Crazy
episodes.description: Before Halloween, Team Scorpion must infiltrate a deep, vast cave system in order to prevent a bat population from destroying the North America ecosystem. Also, the team dons costumes to stage photos from Halloween’s past for Walter’s upcoming immigration inspection.

episodes.title: We’re Gonna Need a Bigger Vote
episodes.description: On Election Day, as democracy hangs in the balance, Team Scorpion is called on when someone tries to throw the U.S. presidential election into chaos.

episodes.title: Sly and the Family Stone
episodes.description: When Team Scorpion travels to Ireland for Megan’s one-year memorial, Walter discovers that a nearby lake’s natural disaster has created a poisonous cloud that could kill everyone in the village. Also, Cabe and Toby try to alleviate the tension between Tim and Walter.

episodes.title: Mother Load
episodes.description: Paige’s estranged mother calls on Team Scorpion when she accidentally uncovers a forgotten nuclear reactor on the verge of exploding.

episodes.title: This is the Pits
episodes.description: Walter must swim through the deadly La Brea Tar Pits when Team Scorpion helps a woman trapped in the tar before she runs out of oxygen.

episodes.title: Wreck the Halls
episodes.description: It’s Christmas Eve and Team Scorpion’s electronics-free mountain getaway turns deadly when they come across gun-runners, and Ralph is kidnapped when they try to escape.

episodes.title: Ice Ca-Cabes
episodes.description: When a mission in the desert results in exploding shrapnel that seriously wounds Cabe, Team Scorpion must freeze his body in order to save his life.

episodes.title: Faux Money Maux Problems
episodes.description: When Team Scorpion is duped into producing counterfeit money for a foreign entity intent on ruining the U.S. economy, Paige must rely on her mother Veronica’s skills as a grifter to save them.

episodes.title: The Hole Truth
episodes.description: Team Scorpion must save a man teetering on the edge of a massive sink hole that threatens to destroy the Los Angeles water supply forever.

episodes.title: Sharknerdo
episodes.description: Team Scorpion’s job to find sunken treasure goes awry when Walter and Paige’s boat explodes, leaving them lost in the middle of the Pacific Ocean surrounded by sharks.

episodes.title: Keep it in Check, Mate
episodes.description: Walter and Sylvester enter an international chess competition under cover on foreign soil for Team Scorpion in order to extricate a U.S. spy before her identity is exposed.

episodes.title: Dirty Seeds, Done Dirt Cheap
episodes.description: When a simple mission to protect a vital seed bank goes awry, Team Scorpion must save Happy, Sylvester and Cabe, who begin suffering from life-threatening, fear-based hallucinations.

episodes.title: Don't Burst My Bubble
episodes.description: Following a severe storm, Happy’s friend Ada, who lives in a sterile bubble to protect her compromised immune system, is left with dangerous debris on the verge of puncturing the structure. Now, Team Scorpion works to safely move Ada to a more secure location without risking her life.

episodes.title: Monkey See, Monkey Poo
episodes.description: To stop a dangerous virus from spreading, Team Scorpion must locate a rare endangered monkey in the Amazon that has the antibody for the cure. Also, Toby and Happy see a counselor to prepare for matrimony.

episodes.title: Broken Wind
episodes.description: While on a mission to repair a turbine at a wind farm, Team Scorpion must race to save Paige and Happy before the cable holding the gondola they are in snaps and sends them plummeting to the ground.

episodes.title: Rock Block
episodes.description: Team Scorpion must defy the orders of a foreign government after they retrieve an asteroid from space containing DNA strands that could have deadly consequences once exposed.

episodes.title: Strife on Mars
episodes.description: Team Scorpion gets trapped inside a failing and dangerous biodome designed for Mars while trying to extract a pair of scientists inside.

episodes.title: Something Burrowed, Something Blew
episodes.description: Team Scorpion help Toby and Happy race to the altar to say “I Do” after a simple job extinguishing a tunnel fire becomes catastrophic.

episodes.title: Maroon 8
episodes.description: While en route to Toby and Happy’s honeymoon, Team Scorpion’s plane crash lands on a remote deserted island, leaving them all with little hope for rescue.

episodes.title: Scorp Family Robinson
episodes.description: Three weeks after they crash land on a deserted island, tensions run high for Team Scorpion when they must battle to overcome their relationship obstacles with each other in order to be rescued.

episodes.title: Extinction
episodes.description: Team Scorpion must work with their old nemesis Mark Collins in order to prevent the extinction of mankind. Also, Walter and Paige awkwardly navigate their new relationship.

episodes.title: More Extinction
episodes.description: Team Scorpion continues to work with their nemesis, Mark Collins, in order to prevent an extinction event that could end humanity. Also, Cabe’s last-minute decision while on the case leads to the possible end of his career.

episodes.title: Grow a Deer, A Female Deer
episodes.description: When poachers almost kill a pregnant endangered deer, Team Scorpion recreates the animal’s womb to try to save it and its baby’s life. Also, Happy and Toby discuss the future of their family.

episodes.title: Nuke Kids on the Block
episodes.description: While decommissioning an old nuclear missile, a simple accident causes Team Scorpion to endure exposure to toxic vapor while trying to prevent the nuke from detonating. Also, Paige confronts Happy about constantly tagging along with her and Walter.

episodes.title: Sci Hard
episodes.description: While attending a tech convention, Team Scorpion is taken hostage by a group attempting a virtual heist.

episodes.title: Queen Scary
episodes.description: At Halloween, Team Scorpion takes on a case to prove the existence of ghosts on the Queen Mary but find an all-too-real disaster when they locate a “ghost ship” on a deadly collision course. Also, Walter considers taking note of Paige’s interests to benefit their relationship.

episodes.title: Go with the Flo(rence)
episodes.description: While tracking a device that can prevent a nuclear meltdown through the Los Angeles sewers, Walter learns the nuances of listening and not offering advice to Paige. Also, Team Scorpion meets Florence, their new neighbor at the garage, after she sends a mix of smelly chemicals through their shared ventilation as a warning to keep the noise down.

episodes.title: Faire Is Foul
episodes.description: For Sylvester’s birthday, Team Scorpion visits a renaissance festival, but the revelry is cut short when a group tries to rob a nearby police evidence locker. Also, Paige grows weary of Walter’s play-by-play of all the historical inaccuracies at the festival

episodes.title: It's Raining Men (Of War)
episodes.description: On Thanksgiving, Team Scorpion's new neighbor, Florence, joins them at sea on a mission to destroy a floating island of trash, but her flawed contribution leaves her, Walter and Happy stranded on the quickly dissolving island. Also, Toby works with Cabe to uncover the details of his father's death that he has suppressed since he was a boy.

episodes.title: Crime Every Mountain
episodes.description: As Cabe’s trial looms over Team Scorpion, a simple case goes sideways when they help a father and his daughter whose plane crashes nearby. Also, Paige helps Walter navigate his feelings about Cabe’s possible future in prison.

episodes.title: Who Let the Dog Out ('Cause Now It's Stuck in a Cistern)
episodes.description: As Team Scorpion anxiously awaits the verdict of Cabe’s trial which could send him to prison, they focus their nervous energy on trying to save a dog stuck in a cistern.

episodes.title: A Christmas Car-Roll
episodes.description: On Christmas Eve, when Walter chooses work over spending quality time with his friends, he falls down the stairs and hits his head, and as he lays unconscious, he enters a dream world where Team Scorpion never existed.

episodes.title: The Bunker Games
episodes.description: Team Scorpion must work with Toby’s nemesis, Quincy Berkstead, and his wife, Amy, Toby’s ex-fiancée, when they are locked inside an artificially intelligent doomsday bunker that aims to kill them. Also, Walter is distracted by his recent dream where he is married to Florence, not Paige.

episodes.title: Lighthouse of the Rising Sun
episodes.description: A solar storm knocks out power in Los Angeles, and Team Scorpion must help a teen pilot and his girlfriend who are lost over the Pacific without navigation or radio contact. Also, during the crisis, Walter must look after a group of Ralph’s classmates, and Cabe tries to tell Allie finally that he loves her.

episodes.title: Wave Goodbye
episodes.description: Team Scorpion must prevent an incoming tsunami from hitting a vulnerable nuclear power facility, and Toby secretly helps his ex-fiancée retrieve her stolen identity.

episodes.title: Nerd, Wind and Fire
episodes.description: On Valentine's Day, Team Scorpion must set aside their romantic plans to help a doctor and pilot trapped inside a helicopter that crashed atop a skyscraper. Also, Toby and Happy wait for news on their fertility results, and Sylvester realizes that he may have feelings for Florence.

episodes.title: Dumbster Fire
episodes.description: The geniuses of Team Scorpion turn into knuckleheads and Paige must simplify the science for them, when their mental faculties are impaired during a job to prevent the creation of a black hole. Also, Florence and Sylvester grow closer when she helps him with a special project.

episodes.title: Dork Day Afternoon
episodes.description: Team Scorpion inadvertently crashes a bank robbery in progress and is taken hostage. Also, Sylvester’s feelings for Florence grow.

episodes.title: Gator Done
episodes.description: Team Scorpion heads to the bayou to track down a cagey alligator in order to stop a deadly mosquito-borne virus, and Paige teaches Walter the concept of the “white lie.” Also, Walter hits Cabe with a tranquilizer gun and Toby must save his life, and Sylvester and Ralph help Patty when the mean girls at her school force her to get a dreaded tardy slip.

episodes.title: Foul Balls
episodes.description: Team Scorpion must use their high IQs to win a softball game when the homeland director challenges, with all of their future government contracts on the line. Also, Walter’s secret night out with Florence puts Toby and Happy on edge.

episodes.title: Kenny and the Jet
episodes.description: Paige’s maternal side goes into high gear when Team Scorpion must save an unconscious, hypothermic boy stuck in the wheel well of their airborne airplane. Also, Walter’s white lie to Paige starts to take a toll on him, and Paige realizes something’s up.

episodes.title: A Lie in the Sand
episodes.description: Team Scorpion heads to Northeast Africa where they must carefully navigate a minefield in order to save the lives of local villagers. Also, Paige and Walter’s relationship takes a shocking turn, and Toby and Happy make an important decision.

title: Cobra Kai
description: This Karate Kid sequel series picks up 30 years after the events of the 1984 All Valley Karate Tournament and finds Johnny Lawrence on the hunt for redemption by reopening the infamous Cobra Kai karate dojo. This reignites his old rivalry with the successful Daniel LaRusso, who has been working to maintain the balance in his life without mentor Mr. Miyagi.

episodes.title: Ace Degenerate
episodes.description: Thirty years after the events of the 1984 All Valley Karate Tournament, Johnny Lawrence’s life has taken a rocky turn as he tries to forget a past that constantly haunts him. He seeks redemption by reopening the infamous Cobra Kai karate dojo. But the LaRusso-Lawrence rivalry of yesteryear is reignited when their lives become intertwined with the next generation of “karate kids.”

episodes.title: Strike First
episodes.description: Present day Daniel LaRusso lives a charmed life. That is, until he sees that the Cobra Kai dojo, the source of his teenage angst and rivalry, has been reestablished by Johnny Lawrence. Struggling to launch the business, Johnny starts teaching karate to his teenage neighbor Miguel. Daniel faces his former opponent and old offenses are quickly reignited.

episodes.title: Esqueleto
episodes.description: Johnny tries to recruit more students to join the dojo. Troubled by his daughter’s friends, Daniel chaperones her high school costume dance. Johnny takes Miguel’s training seriously and starts creating a badass.

episodes.title: Cobra Kai Never Dies
episodes.description: When Daniel’s car dealership billboard is sprayed with lewd graffiti, it consumes Daniel and escalates tensions against a rival. Robby, Johnny’s delinquent son, is embarrassed about his father and his new dojo. The bullying escalates against Miguel and motivates Johnny in a surprising way.

episodes.title: Counterbalance
episodes.description: Daniel tries to strike a shady deal to undermine Johnny’s dojo. Meanwhile, Johnny expands his enrollment ranks in the dojo. Miguel puts his karate practice into reality as Samantha faces rejection in school.

episodes.title: Quiver
episodes.description: Johnny’s dojo class attracts a group of misfits while his son Robby, who harbors ulterior motives, lands a new job. Samantha makes a new friend in science class. Daniel inspires interest in karate from an unlikely person.

episodes.title: All Valley
episodes.description: Daniel takes on teaching his new pupil using the unconventional techniques from Mr. Miyagi. Robby is tempted to return to his delinquent ways. Johnny helps Miguel with his first date.

episodes.title: Molting
episodes.description: Johnny prepares his Cobra Kai students for the next All Valley Karate Tournament and in turn, he is inspired to clean up his life. Daniel is still unaware of his new pupil’s background. But as events unfold, it seems nothing has changed between Daniel and Johnny in 30 years.

episodes.title: Different But Same
episodes.description: Despite Johnny’s efforts to move forward, he confronts Daniel about the assault on his property. An attempt to appease Johnny makes them revisit the past together. Miguel senses Samantha is lying to him. The dojo students try to intimidate the popular kids at a party.

episodes.title: Mercy
episodes.description: The highly-anticipated All Valley Karate Tournament brings Johnny and Daniel on opposite sides again, except this time, the new generation of karate students are the combatants. Who will pay the price for ultimate victory?

episodes.title: Mercy (2)
episodes.description: In the aftermath of Cobra Kai’s win at the Under 18 All Valley Karate Championships, Johnny questions his dojo’s philosophy and deals with a figure from his past. Daniel searches for the right way to respond to Cobra Kai’s dominance.

episodes.title: Back in Black
episodes.description: When Daniel starts teaching his first karate students, he questions whether he can fill Mr. Miyagi’s shoes. Johnny invents some unorthodox training methods with help from an unlikely source.

episodes.title: Fire and Ice
episodes.description: Daniel pulls out all the stops in an effort to recruit new students to Miyagi Do. Johnny reflects on some of the major relationships in his life - and responds to Daniel’s promotional efforts with his own.

episodes.title: The Moment of Truth
episodes.description: Daniel makes another attempt to promote Miyagi Do, and receives guidance in a familiar form. Johnny grows suspicious about Kreese’s backstory. A new Cobra Kai student challenges Miguel and befriends Aisha, while Robby revisits a past he’d rather forget.

episodes.title: All In
episodes.description: Daniel struggles to help a new student learn. Miguel makes a new connection, while Johnny tries to repair a relationship. Tensions between the two dojos build to a breaking point.

episodes.title: Take a Right
episodes.description: Daniel’s students are given a lesson in overcoming their grudges. Johnny spends some time away from the dojo, while Kreese exerts his influence.

episodes.title: Lull
episodes.description: To prepare his students, Daniel gives some new training methods a shot. Miguel puts a new lesson into practice. Johnny makes a tough but pivotal decision that affects Cobra Kai.

episodes.title: Glory of Love
episodes.description: Daniel works to make amends with Amanda, while Johnny is introduced to the world of dating apps. Complications arise when Miguel, Samantha, Robby and Tory cross paths.

episodes.title: Pulpo
episodes.description: Johnny cautiously takes a stab at love, while Daniel and Amanda enjoy a romantic date night. An attempt to bring the students of the two dojos together backfires as hostilities between the teens escalate.

episodes.title: No Mercy
episodes.description: It’s the first day of school at West Valley High but tensions between the two dojos have not cooled with the end of summer. And the rivalry between Daniel and Johnny comes to a head.

episodes.title: Aftermath
episodes.description: Miguel's fighting for his life, Robby's missing, and Daniel and Johnny's reputations are in tatters as the community reacts to the West Valley brawl.

episodes.title: Nature Vs. Nurture
episodes.description: Daniel and Johnny team up to find Robby. Miguel faces an uncertain future. Kreese tries to bring Tory back to Cobra Kai.

episodes.title: Now You're Gonna Pay
episodes.description: Daniel's tarnished public image takes a toll on his sales, leading to a takeover offer. Johnny tries to raise money for Miguel's surgery.

episodes.title: The Right Path
episodes.description: Following an important meeting in Japan, Daniel revisits Mr. Miyagi's hometown on Okinawa. Johnny attempts to reconnect with Robby.

episodes.title: Miyagi-Do
episodes.description: In Okinawa, Daniel spends time with an old friend — and an old enemy, who has much to teach him. The dueling dojos' rivalry comes to a nasty head.

episodes.title: King Cobra
episodes.description: Miguel helps Johnny craft the perfect social media message. Kreese scouts new recruits while Daniel and Amanda try to shut down Cobra Kai.

episodes.title: Obstáculos
episodes.description: Daniel spends some father-daughter time with a traumatized Sam. Johnny plans to form a new karate dojo but struggles to come up with a cool name.

episodes.title: The Good, the Bad, and the Badass
episodes.description: Informed that this year's All Valley Karate Tournament is being canceled, the three competing sensei attend a city council meeting to save it.

episodes.title: Feel the Night
episodes.description: It's Christmastime in the Valley, and romance is in the air. Daniel and Miguel find unexpected common ground, and the Cobra Kai recruits go on a mission.

episodes.title: December 19
episodes.description: Old wounds begin to heal at a country club holiday party, but a brutal assault by Kreese's students leads to new betrayals and alliances.

episodes.title: Let's Begin
episodes.description: Johnny and Daniel combine dojos but their opposing styles immediately clash.  Kreese tries to persuade a former partner to rejoin him at Cobra Kai.

episodes.title: First Learn Stand
episodes.description: Johnny picks up defensive strategies while Daniel learns how to go on the offensive. Amanda confronts Tory. New kid Kenny is bullied at school.

episodes.title: Then Learn Fly
episodes.description: Kenny tries to become a student of Cobra Kai with some encouragement from Robby, while Johnny urges Sam to take a leap of faith – in herself.

episodes.title: Bicephaly
episodes.description: Kreese brings Terry back to Cobra Kai, but his former partner isn't interested in repeating history. Johnny grows envious of Daniel mentoring Miguel.

episodes.title: Match Point
episodes.description: Johnny and Daniel's dojo — and their fragile alliance — teeter on the brink of collapse when they agree to a winner-takes-all sensei showdown.

episodes.title: Kicks Get Chicks
episodes.description: A major change to the upcoming tournament sends Johnny scrambling to find a new recruit for Eagle Fang. Tory must ask a favor of the LaRussos.

episodes.title: Minefields
episodes.description: Daniel invites Anthony to join Miyagi-Do and discovers he doesn't know his son as well as he thought. Miguel learns the truth about Johnny and Carmen.

episodes.title: Party Time
episodes.description: Miguel and Sam are excited about attending the junior prom until another couple unexpectedly shows up. Terry lures Johnny to a familiar location.

episodes.title: The Fall
episodes.description: The annual All Valley Karate Tournament kicks off as several competing dojos vie for the grand championship – and settle some personal scores.

episodes.title: The Rise
episodes.description: The tournament comes to a shocking end, with the aftermath leaving its participants reeling – and two champions facing uncertain futures.

episodes.title: Long, Long Way from Home
episodes.description: Daniel’s new ally-turned-housemate tests Amanda’s patience. Miguel searches for his father in Mexico. Terry starts to transform Cobra Kai.

episodes.title: Molé
episodes.description: Chozen and Daniel hatch a risky plot against Terry. In Mexico, Robby and Johnny look for Miguel, who discovers the truth about his dad.

episodes.title: Playing with Fire
episodes.description: Another enemy from Daniel’s past resurfaces. After a spa day and some soul-searching, Sam comes to a decision about her future with Miguel.

episodes.title: Downward Spiral
episodes.description: Johnny and Carmen's romance flies high while Daniel and Amanda are rattled by Terry's schemes. The teens' feuds spill over at the waterpark.

episodes.title: Extreme Measures
episodes.description: Daniel leans on a friend – and frenemy. Tensions come to a head for Miguel and Robby. A familiar face returns.

episodes.title: Ouroboros
episodes.description: Terry recruits an expert in the way of the fist. Daniel walks away from a fight, and Johnny and Chozen pick one. In prison, Kreese confronts old demons.

episodes.title: Bad Eggs
episodes.description: Terry and Kim issue a brutal challenge while Chozen teaches his students a different kind of lesson. Johnny and Daniel demand answers from Kreese.

episodes.title: Taikai
episodes.description: A coveted spot in an elite international tournament ignites a fight between dojos. Tory’s loyalties are tested. Sam struggles to let Miguel go.

episodes.title: Survivors
episodes.description: Tory pays a price for defiance. Stingray does battle with his conscience. A celebratory night on the town takes a turn for Johnny, Daniel and Chozen.

episodes.title: Head of the Snake
episodes.description: A fight night erupts in the Valley as Johnny, Daniel, Chozen and their students summon all their skills and strength to expose Terry and take him down.

title: Fear the Walking Dead
description: What did the world look like as it was transforming into the horrifying apocalypse depicted in "The Walking Dead"? This spin-off set in Los Angeles, following new characters as they face the beginning of the end of the world, will answer that question.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: A highly dysfunctional blended family is forced together when they realize a reported virus is actually the onset of the undead apocalypse.

episodes.title: So Close, Yet So Far
episodes.description: While Madison struggles to keep Nick from crippling withdrawal, Travis ventures out to find his son before the city of Los Angeles falls.

episodes.title: The Dog
episodes.description: After they escape a riot, Travis, Liza and Chris seek refuge with the Salazars; Madison defends her home.

episodes.title: Not Fade Away
episodes.description: Madison and Travis see different sides of the National Guard's occupation in their neighborhood; the family tries to adapt to the new world.

episodes.title: Cobalt
episodes.description: The National Guard's plan for the neighborhood is revealed; Travis and Madison make a difficult decision.

episodes.title: The Good Man
episodes.description: As civil unrest grows, and the dead take over, Travis and Madison try to devise ways to protect their families.

episodes.title: Monster
episodes.description: After fleeing a burning Los Angeles on Strand's yacht, tensions arise among the group. Strand remains mysterious. Our group encounters danger at sea.

episodes.title: We All Fall Down
episodes.description: The group seeks shelter with a survivalist family; and Madison tries to uncover the family's true motives. Meanwhile, Salazar works to discover Strand's intentions.

episodes.title: Ouroboros
episodes.description: Madison confronts Strand about his mysterious destination. Nick, Alicia, and others inspect wreckage from a plane crash.

episodes.title: Blood in the Streets
episodes.description: A family in distress boards the Abigail. Strand branches off and his past begins to emerge. Nick searches for an associate of Strand's.

episodes.title: Captive
episodes.description: Alicia works to reunite with her family. Travis meets a familiar face. Madison and Nick lead a charge to save their family against all odds.

episodes.title: Sicut Cervus
episodes.description: Conflict erupts in a final push towards Strand's destination. Chris makes a decision that shakes the family. Nick meets a new maternal figure.

episodes.title: Shiva
episodes.description: The family faces their greatest test yet. Nick, Travis, Madison and others go to great lengths to keep each other close.

episodes.title: Grotesque
episodes.description: Nick's steadfast search for answers leads him into a deadly dog-eat-dog landscape. A dark piece of his past is uncovered.

episodes.title: Los Muertos
episodes.description: After the fall of the compound, Madison, Strand and others forge a tenuous path forward.  Meanwhile, Nick is recruited for a perilous assignment.

episodes.title: Do Not Disturb
episodes.description: Travis struggles to connect with Chris while searching for shelter. Meanwhile, Alicia meets a lonely woman with a bloody past.

episodes.title: Pablo & Jessica
episodes.description: Alicia and Madison work to unite two competing factions. Nick draws upon skills from his past to take on a new role at the Colonia.

episodes.title: Pillar of Salt
episodes.description: At the Colonia, Alejandro reveals his darker side; a hotel resident becomes violent and Madison springs into action.

episodes.title: Date of Death
episodes.description: Refugees flood into the hotel, including an unexpected refugee from our group. Madison struggles to cope with the situation.

episodes.title: Wrath
episodes.description: Travis is thrown off by new refugees; Nick must decide if he's going to stay at the Colonia with Luciana or leave.

episodes.title: North
episodes.description: When Travis' rage causes unrest at the hotel, Madison has to choose whether or not she will stand by him; Nick becomes leader of the Colonia as Narcos close in.

episodes.title: Eye of the Beholder
episodes.description: The Clark family find themselves in a dire predicament. They must work together to discover a path to safety.

episodes.title: The New Frontier
episodes.description: Following a harrowing journey, the Clark family arrive at their new home. Strand faces resistance as he attempts to hold power over his domain.

episodes.title: TEOTWAWKI
episodes.description: Still finding their place, Alicia and Nick fall in with new crowds while Madison discovers Otto's past mimics that of her own.
A mysterious character searches for purpose and soon becomes tied to the struggle over a key resource in the apocalypse.

episodes.title: Burning in Water, Drowning in Flame
episodes.description: A new threat reveals itself to Madison and Troy as they search for answers. Alicia must reconcile with her past decisions.

episodes.title: Red Dirt
episodes.description: News of incoming danger spreads throughout the community as Madison struggles to keep everyone together. Nick grapples with a hard truth.

episodes.title: The Unveiling
episodes.description: A new arrival sows a divide within the ranch. Meanwhile, Alicia forms a new relationship in the hopes of maintaining peace.

episodes.title: Children of Wrath
episodes.description: Madison must negotiate the terms of an agreement in the midst of ranch-wide turmoil. Nick and Alicia challenge their mother's motives.

episodes.title: Minotaur
episodes.description: In the aftermath of the Clark family's actions, new leadership assumes control of the Ranch. Daniel assists Lola in the distribution of water.

episodes.title: The Diviner
episodes.description: With the Ranch dangerously low on resources, Madison and Walker leave in search of a solution. Nick and Alicia struggle to keep the peace.

episodes.title: La Serpiente
episodes.description: Following the rekindling of an old friendship, a mission is launched to replenish the Ranch's water supply by seeking the help of another community.

episodes.title: Brother's Keeper
episodes.description: Nick and Jake set out to handle a delicate situation; the Ranch prepares for a threat greater than any they've faced before.

episodes.title: This Land is Your Land
episodes.description: With the Ranchers trapped and without hope, Alicia is thrust into a position of leadership where she's forced to make life-changing decisions.

episodes.title: El Matadero
episodes.description: Alicia encounters a potential ally; Ofelia fights for survival; Nick uses his skill set for profit.

episodes.title: Things Bad Begun
episodes.description: Strand's motives are made clear when Nick discovers a new threat descending on the dam.

episodes.title: Sleigh Ride
episodes.description: Madison faces a horrifying revelation.

episodes.title: What's Your Story?
episodes.description: A lone traveler’s wearying journey is interrupted by new acquaintances, some who become friend, others who become foe.

episodes.title: Another Day in the Diamond
episodes.description: A troubled survivor finds allies in an unexpected place. Meanwhile, the life Madison has fought to build comes under threat.

episodes.title: Good Out Here
episodes.description: Madison and Morgan try to help Nick find inner peace. A quest for revenge exacts its toll on the group.

episodes.title: Buried
episodes.description: Al's questioning uncovers some surprising truths about the group's past. John Dorie receives unexpected news.

episodes.title: Laura
episodes.description: The arrival of a wounded visitor in John Dorie's life forces him to change his ways.

episodes.title: Just in Case
episodes.description: Strand wrestles with Madison's decisions. Things take an unexpected turn at the Stadium.

episodes.title: The Wrong Side of Where You Are Now
episodes.description: Madison's decision to help an adversary has unintended consequences. Meanwhile, John Dorie's life hangs in the balance.

episodes.title: No One's Gone
episodes.description: Madison fights to preserve the life she worked so hard to build. Morgan tries to do the right thing.

episodes.title: People Like Us
episodes.description: Morgan tries to help Alicia and the fractured group of survivors as a storm brews.

episodes.title: Close Your Eyes
episodes.description: Alicia's forced to reckon with an agonizing past while seeking refuge from a storm.

episodes.title: The Code
episodes.description: Morgan's journey is derailed by some new acquaintances.

episodes.title: Weak
episodes.description: June helps when Al's health deteriorates; Morgan searches for friends lost in the storm.

episodes.title: Blackjack
episodes.description: Strand and Dorie are marooned. Luciana aids a man in need. The group's efforts to help a stranger put everyone in danger.

episodes.title: MM 54
episodes.description: Difficult decisions lead the group into uncertainty. Alicia delivers on a promise to Charlie.

episodes.title: I Lose People...
episodes.description: The group's hope falters as they seek a way out. Alicia and Charlie reunite with friends.

episodes.title: ... I Lose Myself
episodes.description: Morgan struggles to find the strength to help friends in dire need before it's too late.

episodes.title: Here to Help
episodes.description: Lead by Morgan and Alicia, the group lands in uncharted territory in search of survivors to help. But everything is not as it seems in this foreboding new land.

episodes.title: The Hurt That Will Happen
episodes.description: Morgan and Alicia meet a survivor and learn of a grave new walker threat. Meanwhile, the mission is put to the test when one of their own goes missing. Elsewhere, Strand makes contact.

episodes.title: Humbug's Gulch
episodes.description: June and John take shelter to hide from a threat, but a misunderstanding with a desperate survivor leads to trouble. Meanwhile, Alicia and Morgan face a dangerous obstacle.

episodes.title: Skidmark
episodes.description: Charlie makes a friend, while Strand, Wendell, and Sarah's rescue mission hits a snag. Elsewhere, Alicia, Luciana, and Morgan struggle to fulfill their mission.

episodes.title: The End of Everything
episodes.description: Althea chases a story with dogged determination, putting the mission, and her life, in danger.

episodes.title: The Little Prince
episodes.description: Facing impossible odds, Luciana and the group work together to tackle an impossible task while Morgan helps prevent disaster. Elsewhere, an old friend presents Sarah, Charlie, and Strand with a solution

episodes.title: Still Standing
episodes.description: Strand and Charlie seek safety. Dorie helps Dwight on his quest. Morgan stays focused on the greater mission. Elsewhere, Alicia refuses to give up.

episodes.title: Is Anybody Out There?
episodes.description: Up against the clock, Morgan, Grace, and Alicia work to buy time as Dorie and Dwight race against the elements. Meanwhile, Sarah and Wendell get help from an unexpected source.(TD)

episodes.title: Channel 4
episodes.description: The group, traveling in a convoy, doubles-down on their mission to find and help survivors.

episodes.title: 210 Words Per Minute
episodes.description: Morgan and Grace search a shopping mall to fulfill a dying man's wish; Dwight is tested.

episodes.title: You're Still Here
episodes.description: Alicia and Strand answer a call for help; Morgan and Al hit a roadblock.

episodes.title: Ner Tamid
episodes.description: In search of a permanent home, Charlie encounters a rabbi struggling to survive on his own.

episodes.title: Leave What You Don't
episodes.description: Logan's motives are revealed; Sarah and Dwight negotiate; a dangerous threat emerges.

episodes.title: Today and Tomorrow
episodes.description: A survivor sends Al and Morgan into a dangerous settlement where Al chases a lead.

episodes.title: Channel 5
episodes.description: The group searches for a new home; concerned for Grace, Morgan makes a tough call.

episodes.title: End of the Line
episodes.description: Facing an unknown future, Morgan leads the group on a mission; John and June make a promise.

title: The Originals
description: The Vampire Diaries spin-off that follows the Mikaelsons, a family of millennia-old, power-hungry vampires who want to reclaim the city they built, New Orleans, and dominate all those who have wronged them.

episodes.title: Always and Forever
episodes.description: Klaus returns to the French Quarter of New Orleans, a place where he helped build centuries ago. Now he sees that it has been taken over by his former protege Marcel. Camille, a psychology student, doesn't believe in supernatural beings. However, she finds herself drawn to Klaus. Meanwhile, Hayley and Elijah wait to see what Klaus will do next.

episodes.title: House of the Rising Son
episodes.description: Rebekah arrives in New Orleans at her brother Elijah's insistence, but, concerned that Klaus is up to no good, she seeks help from a reluctant Sophie. Marcel enlists Davina's help.

episodes.title: Tangled Up in Blue
episodes.description: Betrayal at the masquerade ball? Klaus and Rebekah come together to attempt to unravel Marcel's empire from within, in spite of Elijah's concerns. They enlist help from Sophie.

episodes.title: Girl in New Orleans
episodes.description: Determined Rebekah is on a mission to get to the bottom of a recent strange encounter involving Elijah. Davina convinces Marcel to let her attend an annual street music festival.

episodes.title: Sinners and Saints
episodes.description: Klaus becomes angry over recent events involving the safety of his unborn baby and demands answers from Sophie. Meanwhile, gruesome remains are discovered in the bayou; and Davina reveals some shocking information about the witches.

episodes.title: Fruit of the Poisoned Tree
episodes.description: Klaus goes to extreme measures to protect Hayley and their unborn baby when he learns Hayley's life is being threatened. Meanwhile, Cami turns to Father Kieran for guidance. Marcel seeks advice from an old friend. Davina tries to control her magic.

episodes.title: Bloodletting
episodes.description: Hayley goes missing after someone from her past makes a startling revelation. Klaus has a dangerous encounter with an unexpected visitor. Davina makes a surprising connection. Marcel makes Rebekah an enticing offer that leaves her torn.

episodes.title: The River in Reverse
episodes.description: In the war between Klaus and Marcel, Rebecca stands against her own brother Klaus. The chemistry between Elijah and Hayley gets stronger. Klaus accuses his siblings of distrust and betrayal.

episodes.title: Reigning Pain in New Orleans
episodes.description: Klaus tries to get adapted to his new duties as he became the king of the city. He offers Marcel a compromise and he fixes his relationship with his siblings. Davina feels betrayed by Marcel. She finally finds an ally, Cami.

episodes.title: The Casket Girls
episodes.description: Locals prepare to celebrate the annual Casket Girls Festival in the French Quarter. Davina tries to free Cami from Klaus's mind compulsion. Hayley is forced to make a difficult decision after she receives an unexpected phone call.

episodes.title: Après Moi, Le Déluge
episodes.description: Davina becomes violently ill and the repercussions affect the entire French Quarter. Sophie delivers some startling information about the harvest festival and presents a drastic plan to save Davina. Hayley, racked with guilt, confesses to Elijah about her role in Sophie's plan.

episodes.title: Dance Back from the Grave
episodes.description: Tension between Marcel and Klaus results in Marcel refusing to help Klaus with a gruesome discovery in the Cauldron. Rebekah revisits her past when she finds the remnants of a sacrifice by the docks - the work of a dangerous warlock she has come across before. Klaus battles, but his opponent has an unfair advantage.

episodes.title: Crescent City
episodes.description: Marcel and Rebekah fret over whether secrets hidden for nearly a century are about to be exposed. Father Kieran deals with a witch from his past. Hayley and her werewolf clan enjoy a party. Sophie discovers something shocking at the cemetery. Klaus takes some dangerous measures that will affect everybody.

episodes.title: Long Way Back from Hell
episodes.description: In 1919, Rebekah worked in a sanatorium. She finds herself back there and locked up as a witch who is seeking revenge plans to reveal her darkest secrets. Elijah makes a decision that puts the others in further danger.

episodes.title: Le Grand Guignol
episodes.description: Rebekah and Marcel have been trying to keep a secret from Klaus which may come to the light as we flashback to 1919. Elijah and Monique bond. Hayley takes Sabine hostage to try and get information on reversing the curse on her clan.

episodes.title: Farewell to Storyville
episodes.description: Since the original vampires were stuck in the cemetery, Klaus takes any chances to punish his sister with the Original-killer stake.

episodes.title: Moon Over Bourbon Street
episodes.description: Elijah is taking control of the quarter and receives a surprising offer, and they know how to throw a party.

episodes.title: The Big Uneasy
episodes.description: Genevieve asks Elijah to allow her coven to publicly celebrate a traditional feast day, where members of the community offer the witches gifts in return for blessings. Meanwhile, Elijah makes plans to restore his home to its former glory; and Klaus sends Cary, a werewolf from his own line, to find a missing piece of family history.

episodes.title: An Unblinking Death
episodes.description: Kieran lashes out unexpectedly after Cami's good intentions don't get her what she expected. Elijah and Klaus can't agree on how to handle the Crescent Wolves. Elijah visits the bayou were he is witness to a explosion that see's hatred between the communities intensify. Hayley learns about her family from Marcel.

episodes.title: A Closer Walk with Thee
episodes.description: A surprising enemy is confronted by Hayley. Klaus has some nightmares about his father and is forced to examine his own relationship with his adoptive son.

episodes.title: The Battle of New Orleans
episodes.description: Cami feels threatened, as Marcel rallies an army to take back control of the city.

episodes.title: From a Cradle to a Grave
episodes.description: Hayley atempts to save her unborn baby from the witches. Francesca meets with Oliver and Jackson to decide the future of the werewolves in New Orleans.

episodes.title: Rebirth
episodes.description: Hayley struggles with her powers. Marcel sides with Klaus and gets revenge over the wolves. Esther is busy plotting her own plans. Everyone wants control over the city.

episodes.title: Alive and Kicking
episodes.description: Klaus wants Hayley to re-establish herself in her pack. Mikael is impatient under Davina. Cassie arouses suspicions.

episodes.title: Every Mother's Son
episodes.description: After Klaus and Elijah receive a cryptic invitation to dinner from their mother, they get ready to expect the worst.

episodes.title: Live and Let Die
episodes.description: Davina takes Mikael to a cabin to heal from his wolf bites. Klaus searches for them. Elijah, Marcel and Hayley try to rescue some young wolves.

episodes.title: Red Door
episodes.description: In order to show Elijah that her plan is what's best for him, Esther forces him to relive a time long ago when he loved a young woman named Tatia.

episodes.title: Wheel Inside the Wheel
episodes.description: Cami teams up with Marcel and Gia after she becomes suspicious of her faculty advisor Vincent. Lastly, in a surprising turn of events, Klaus comes face-to-face with a visitor from his past.

episodes.title: Chasing The Devil's Tail
episodes.description: Going after everything Esther loves. Klaus and Hayley seek an antidote for Elijah in the bayou assisted by Marcel and Josh. Kaleb takes Davina to an old hangout.

episodes.title: The Brothers That Care Forgot
episodes.description: Rebekah is on the run with baby Hope.

episodes.title: The Map of Moments
episodes.description: Rebekah persuades Klaus and Elijah to take part in a family tradition from their childhood.

episodes.title: Gonna Set Your Flag on Fire
episodes.description: Finn puts a spell on the compound, trapping wolves and vampires. Klaus takes Cami to the safe house, then confronts Kol about Rebekah's whereabouts.

episodes.title: Brotherhood of the Damned
episodes.description: Finn captures his brother's spirits, while the vampires remain trapped and their hunger grows.

episodes.title: Sanctuary
episodes.description: Rebekah becomes interested in a girl. Hayley struggles with coming clean and is surprised by something Jackson admits. Klaus learns something and heads to confront Hayley. Vincent sets his eyes on Marcel for answers to what Klaus is hiding.

episodes.title: The Devil Is Damned
episodes.description: Vincent joins forces with a figure from his past. Kaleb is forced to make a difficult life or death decision, and Elijah finds himself in the fight of his life. Hayley and Jackson become pawns in Vincent's dangerous plan.

episodes.title: I Love You, Goodbye
episodes.description: Following a tense run in, Elijah believes that Klaus is up to something. Kaleb needs Rebekah's help.

episodes.title: They All Asked For You
episodes.description: A discovery is made about the body Rebekah is living in. Klaus clashes with Hayley and Jackson.

episodes.title: Save My Soul
episodes.description: Suspicious of where her true loyalties lie, Klaus invites Freya to the compound in order to gain more insight into her past with Dahlia.Source: CW

episodes.title: Exquisite Corpse
episodes.description: Klaus must put aside his mistrust for Freya in order to save Rebekah's life.

episodes.title: Night Has A Thousand Eyes
episodes.description: While searching for a way to vanquish Dahlia, Klaus is faced with another threat.

episodes.title: When the Levee Breaks
episodes.description: Hayley and Klaus need to hit a deadline to turn over Hope, which causes Klaus to proceed with a dangerous plan.

episodes.title: City Beneath The Sea
episodes.description: Elijah and Freya think differently about how to deal with Dahlia's deadline.

episodes.title: Fire with Fire
episodes.description: With the knowledge that he has been betrayed by his siblings, Klaus and an unlikely friend plan to get even with them.

episodes.title: Ashes To Ashes
episodes.description: With time running out, Klaus' ultimate plan to protect baby Hope at all costs continues to take shape.Source: CW

episodes.title: For the Next Millennium
episodes.description: Months following their violent and deadly showdown with the powerful witch Dahlia, a rift continues to divide brothers Klaus and Elijah, while Freya searches for a way to heal their fractured bond and return their family to the way they once were. Meanwhile, Klaus' suspicion piques when he learns that an old vampire friend named Lucien has arrived to New Orleans with a mysterious agenda involving the Mikaelson's remaining sire lines. Elsewhere, Elijah questions whether he can truly forgive his brother for his mounting offenses, while Hayley struggles with being cursed to her wolf form in the bayou. In the French Quarter, Vincent and Cami assist Detective Kinney after a series of gruesome discoveries are made, leading them to believe they may have a serial killer on the loose. Finally, Marcel, who has regained control of the French Quarter once again, tries a new strategy to recruit vampires, while Davina, who is now Regent to the New Orleans witches, makes a decision that will find her and Marcel on opposite sides of an escalating conflict.

episodes.title: You Hung the Moon
