episodes.description: Catching their breath before attempting a river crossing, Geralt and his party regale each other with stories and song, revealing a shocking truth.

episodes.title: Twilight of the Wolf
episodes.description: Out of options, Yennefer rallies her novices in a deadly battle against the army of Vilgefortz. A dangerous foe catches Ciri's scent.

episodes.title: What I love I do not carry
episodes.description: A trek through treacherous swamplands confronts Geralt with troubling visions. Emhyr discovers what he must do in order to claim absolute power.

episodes.title: Baptism of Fire
episodes.description: As the Continent sinks deeper into war, Geralt, Yennefer and Ciri each meet their fate on the roads they took to avoid it.

title: Severance
description: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.

episodes.title: Good News About Hell
episodes.description: Mark is promoted to lead a team who've had their memories surgically divided between their work and personal lives.

episodes.title: Half Loop
episodes.description: The team train new hire Helly on macrodata refinement. Mark takes a day off to meet with a mysterious former colleague.

episodes.title: In Perpetuity
episodes.description: Mark takes the team on a field trip, but Helly continues to rebel. A deteriorating Petey struggles to tell Mark about Lumon’s misdeeds.

episodes.title: The You You Are
episodes.description: Irving finds an intriguing book at work. Helly aggressively pursues a meeting with her Outie. Mark attends a funeral with Ms. Selvig.

episodes.title: The Grim Barbarity of Optics and Design
episodes.description: Irving and Dylan confront Burt about his lies. Mark and Helly discover a strange new department.

episodes.title: Hide and Seek
episodes.description: The team angers Cobel by forming an alliance.

episodes.title: Defiant Jazz
episodes.description: Mark and the team encounter new security measures from Cobel.

episodes.title: What's for Dinner?
episodes.description: The team prepares a plan. Mark attends Devon and Ricken’s party.

episodes.title: The We We Are
episodes.description: The team discovers troubling revelations.

episodes.title: Hello, Ms. Cobel
episodes.description: Mark returns to work under different circumstances. Secrets from the Outie world come to light.

episodes.title: Goodbye, Mrs. Selvig
episodes.description: Mark contemplates the meaning of a message.

episodes.title: Who Is Alive?
episodes.description: Mark, Helly, Irving, and Dylan search for answers.

episodes.title: Woe's Hollow
episodes.description: The team participates in a group activity.

episodes.title: Trojan's Horse
episodes.description: Tensions emerge after the team suffers a loss.

episodes.title: Attila
episodes.description: Bonds are tested. Mark continues on his path of discovery.

episodes.title: Chikhai Bardo
episodes.description: An old romance intersects with a deadly present threat.

episodes.title: Sweet Vitriol
episodes.description: Discoveries are made.

episodes.title: The After Hours
episodes.description: Mark and Devon team with an ally. Helly investigates further.

episodes.title: Cold Harbor
episodes.description: Mark forms a shaky alliance in an all-or-nothing play, while the team makes a dangerous last stand.

title: Tokyo Ghoul
originalTitle: 東京喰種トーキョーグール
description: Ken Kaneki, a bookworm college student, meets Rize, a girl his own age with whom he shares many interests.

episodes.title: Tragedy
episodes.description: Amid news reports of "Ghoul" attacks nearby, Ken Kaneki points out Rize, a girl he is interested in, to his friend Hide at a local coffee shop. When Kaneki discovers the two share a favorite author, he asks her out. However, their date ends in tragedy!

episodes.title: Incubation
episodes.description: Kaneki desperately fights the urge to eat human flesh, the only thing that can satisfy his hunger as a ghoul. He meets up with Hide again, joining him on an errand, and is glad for the companionship. But will his declining condition place Hide at risk?

episodes.title: Dove
episodes.description: Yoshimura teaches Kaneki more about how to blend in with mankind, and takes in a mother and daughter needing protection. Two ghoul investigators, Mado and Amon, are assigned to the 20th Ward. In response, Toka takes Kaneki out to have a mask made for him.

episodes.title: Supper
episodes.description: Kaneki starts receiving self-defense lessons from Yomo. He meets Itori, who runs her own bar, and is friends with Uta and Yomo. Kaneki is befriended by Tsukiyama, a ghoul who knew Rize, who also enjoys reading, and possesses other, more epicurean tastes.

episodes.title: Scars
episodes.description: When Touka falls ill, Kaneki pays her a visit that has unexpected consequences. Meanwhile, as Nishiki is still recovering from his run-in with Kaneki, he is nearly preyed upon by other ghouls. Tsukiyama remains consumed with the idea of having Kaneki.

episodes.title: Cloudburst
episodes.description: The fight against Tsukiyama is resolved, but Touka wants to kill Kimi, now that it's clear she knows that Nishiki and Kaneki are ghouls. Meanwhile, Hinami is eager to see her father again after being apart for so long, and acts out when she is unable.

episodes.title: Captivity
episodes.description: After Kaneki and Hinami witness Ryoko's fate, the personnel at Anteiku are grieved, and Touka decides to take matters with the investigators into her own hands. Kaneki is fed up with not being able to do anything, and makes up his mind to become involved.

episodes.title: Circular
episodes.description: Touka sets out to lure the ghoul investigators, but before she can strike, she finds that Hinami has run away. When Touka and Kaneki go out looking for her, they find themselves face to face with Amon and Mado, who has a few surprises of his own for them.

episodes.title: Birdcage
episodes.description: After several weeks go by, everyone tries to return to their normal lives. Hinami moves in with Touka, and despite her aversion to birds, they nurse an injured cockatiel they name Hetare back to health. Kaneki visits Itori to try to learn more about Rize.

episodes.title: Aogiri
episodes.description: The 11th Ward offices of CCG are attacked by ghouls, wiping everyone out. Banjo and company stop in at Anteiku, looking for Rize to warn her to flee from Aogiri Tree, a new group of ghouls bent on taking over-- until Kaneki accidentally knocks him out!

episodes.title: High Spirits
episodes.description: Kaneki is held captive by Yamori, who practices his torturous craft on him. The police and CCG move in to deal with Aogiri Tree, who have made an 11th Ward shopping mall their headquarters. In all the commotion, the Anteiku team tries to rescue Kaneki.

episodes.title: Ghoul
episodes.description: As Yamori continues to brutally torture Kaneki, Rize once again appears to him, and the two of them explore Kaneki's childhood and relationship with his mother. Kaneki is forced to make a choice that has a profound impact on him.

episodes.title: New Surge
episodes.description: Having defeated Jason and accepted his ghoul half, Kaneki joins Aogiri Tree to protect those close to him in Anteiku.

episodes.title: Dancing Flowers
episodes.description: Now with Kaneki at their ranks, the Aogiri Tree takes the offensive against the CCG, and Amon is introduced to Mado's daughter Akira, who is assigned to become his new partner.

episodes.title: Hangman
episodes.description: Kaneki and Ayato rescue Naki, one of Jason's old cohorts from CCG custody, and prepare to storm the maximum security prison for Ghouls known as "Cochlea". Meanwhile, Tōka pays a visit to the university were Kaneki used to attend, where she has an encounter with Hideyoshi.

episodes.title: Deeper Layers
episodes.description: Aogiri commences their invasion of Cochlea and free a majority of the imprisoned ghouls while Amon and Akira visit the prison to learn more about Aogiri's plan from Donato Porpora. Amid the battles between the CCG, Cochlea security and ghouls, Kaneki meets a ghoul named Orca with orders to break him free, but is attacked by him instead.

episodes.title: Rift
episodes.description: The battle at Cochlea intensifies on several fronts and when Ayato is to be almost killed, he is rescued in the nick of time by Kaneki, who undergoes a bizarre transformation after consuming the bodies of several dead Ghouls to empower himself.

episodes.title: Thousand Paths
episodes.description: The appearance of the "One-Eyed-Ghoul", considered the most dangerous of them all, leaves the CCG in a state of alert while Kaneki writhes in pain due to his new condition.

episodes.title: Permeation
episodes.description: Worried about Kaneki's disappearance, Hinami wants to do something for him, but is uncertain about it, until Kaneki appears at Anteiku and she calls for Touka to see him again.

episodes.title: Old Nines
episodes.description: During Kaneki's visit with Yoshimura, he asks for information about the Owl, and is told the tragic tale of a young ghoul named Kuzen. Touka makes plans to move out of Anteiku. A snowy day brings with it brisk business at the coffee shop.

episodes.title: City in Waiting
episodes.description: Yoshitoki is granted permission to execute the operation to eradicate the Owl. The many CCG officers involved in the mission take time beforehand to write any last words they might have, as the 20th Ward is cordoned off and its civilians evacuated.

episodes.title: Last Rain
episodes.description: The battle between CCG and Anteiku continues, and Koma, Irimi, and Yoshimura each engage the special investigators. When a civilian gets caught in the middle, Hachikawa continues to press his attack unabated. Shinohara receives some unexpected advice.

episodes.title: Deluge of Flowers
episodes.description: Suzuya is left to face the newly-arrived one-eyed Owl on his own. Aogiri Tree joins the battle against CCG, who find themselves overwhelmed by the sheer number of opponents. Meanwhile, Kaneki confronts Amon, who stands in his way to Anteiku.

episodes.title: Ken
episodes.description: After waking up in Anteiku, he hears someone mention that "making coffee is difficult." When the person comes out, it is revealed to be Hide. By the time that Kaneki realises that he has his ghoul eye activated, Hide tells him "I Knew."

episodes.title: START: Those Who Hunt
episodes.description: The members of Quinx Squad, an experimental division of Akira Mado's CCG squad, and composed of investigators who have been surgically made part ghoul, work to track down the A-rated ghoul Torso.

episodes.title: member: Fragments
episodes.description: Haise loses control while fighting Orochi, and has to be subdued. Later at the Chateau, Haise berates Urie for not getting the squad to safety, and removes him from his squad captaincy. Urie seeks to increase his power.

episodes.title: fresh: Eve
episodes.description: Urie speaks to Chief Washu about having his Frame level increased. With a mission coming up, the Quinxes try to get Saiko to come to work. Donato asks Haise about his missing memories. The squad goes undercover.

episodes.title: MAIN: Auction
episodes.description: The Clowns act as auctioneers for a human auction, in which Mutsuki finds himself embroiled. CCG forces surround the complex in which the auction is being held, with orders to exterminate the ghouls inside--especially Big Madam.

episodes.title: PresS: Night of Scattering
episodes.description: The Quinx Squad rushes to save Mutsuki from Kanae. The Owl goes on a seemingly unstoppable rampage. Urie is frustrated when he is assigned escort duty. Ato Squad meets resistance trying to secure the monitor room.

episodes.title: Turn: In the End
episodes.description: Takizawa continues his offensive against Haise on the main stage. Shirazu tries to get Saiko to help him subdue Nutcracker in the monitor room. Urie pursues Big Madam, and feels the effects of his increased Frame level.

episodes.title: Mind: Days of Recollections
episodes.description: Haise asks Arima to allow him to take custody of Hinami, and the remaining ghouls retreat. Following an awards ceremony where many of the investigators are promoted, Haise hosts a celebratory dinner at the Chateau.

episodes.title: TAKe: One Who Writhes
episodes.description: Tsukiyama's condition worsens. Tatara and Ayato argue about rescuing Hinami. Shirazu finds it difficult to take possession of the Nutcracker quinque. Quinx Squad begins a new joint investigation with S1 Squad.

episodes.title: Play: Departed Spirit
episodes.description: Having seen a photo of Haise, Tsukiyama bounces back and races to see him. Haise takes the rest of the squad to Uta's shop to be fitted for masks. Kijima releases a shocking video on the CCG website to draw Rose out.

episodes.title: Think: Sway
episodes.description: Eto drops in on a defeated Kanae, offering to help. Shirazu decides he needs to make a fresh start. Ui finally consents to Haise's idea of an undercover fact-finding mission. Haise grows frustrated probing into his past.

episodes.title: WritE: The Absent One
episodes.description: Matsumae and Mairo try to hold off the investigators long enough for Shu to escape. Haise and Shu face each other on the building's helipad. Quinx Squad has their hands full when a powerful ghoul stands in their way.

episodes.title: Beautiful Dream: Daybreak
episodes.description: Eto arrives on the rooftop, spurring Kanae to attack Haise, who must also reason with Kaneki. With the other squad members on the ropes, Shirazu goes all-out to stop Noro. Kanae and Tsukiyama reach an understanding.

episodes.title: Place: And So, Once Again
episodes.description: CCG locates Aogiri Tree's headquarters. Hinami's execution is scheduled. Takatsuki's editor is questioned over whether or not she is a ghoul. Before Takatsuki can be questioned, however, she makes a stunning public announcement.

episodes.title: VOLT: White Darkness
episodes.description: Ayato leads a raiding party on Cochlea to rescue Hinami, He is joined by Touka and Yomo. Haise tries to get Hinami to safety, but is confronted by Furuta. As the others flee through the basement, Haise confronts Arima.

episodes.title: Union: Cross Game
episodes.description: CCG's assault on Aogiri Tree on Rushima Island continues, and Urie and Saiko are anxious to rescue Mutsuki. Tatara and Kurona both make their stands against the investigators. Akira receives help from a surprise source.

episodes.title: Vive: Those Left Behind
episodes.description: As the fighting on Rushima reaches its climax, Akira makes a fateful decision. Urie, together with the new members of the Quinx Squad, continue their search for Mutsuki. Arima makes a startling revelation to Kaneki.

episodes.title: MovE: Confluence, Confusion
episodes.description: Kaneki assembles the remaining Aogiri Tree and Anteiku members to announce the creation of a new ghoul organization. Akira's course of treatment takes a surprise turn. Yomo and Touka both try to make peace with their past.

episodes.title: FACE: Effulgence
episodes.description: The CCG investigators that were close to Haise react to his leaving. Furuta takes over as the head of the CCG, and sets forth a new strategy to deal with the ghouls. The Clowns begin to riot, threatening CCG Headquarters.

episodes.title: Proof: Bonds
episodes.description: Under Furuta, CCG cracks down hard on the ghoul community, forcing Goat to go underground. Takeomi and Yoriko set a wedding date. Mutsuki locates Kaneki and invites him back. Touka takes the next step with Kaneki.

episodes.title: Incarnation: Awakened Child
episodes.description: Mutsuki leads the Oggais in a raid on Goat's underground lair. Urie and Kuroiwa confront Furuta in his office over his fitness to lead. Kaneki and Suzuya face each other in combat. Kaneki goes to drastic lengths to protect Touka.

episodes.title: Morse: Remembrances
episodes.description: As Dr. Kanou visits his family's gravesite, Kurona confronts him. CCG gains a new ally and expert on ghouls. Hide enlists the help of Akira and Amon to plead his case to CCG. A despondent Mutsuki lashes out at Saiko and Urie.

episodes.title: Call: The Far Side of Tragedy
episodes.description: While Kaneki's body lies dormant in its giant kagune, he has an inner dialogue with Rize. Urie talks to Mutsuki about the hardships of going it alone. A crisis places the city on alert, forcing CCG and the ghouls to work together.

episodes.title: ACT: Encounters
episodes.description: Following increasing dragon activity and the discovery of a second core, Kaneki and Ayato volunteer to go and deal with it. When Kaiko and the members of V launch an attack, CCG and the ghouls must fight together to stop them.

episodes.title: The Final Episode
episodes.description: Kaneki and Furuta continue their duel below the streets of Tokyo, as CCG and Goat jointly continue fighting the members of V aboveground. Kaneki comes to terms with the events of the last several years.

title: Fallout
description: The story of haves and have-nots in a world in which there's almost nothing left to have. 200 years after the apocalypse, the gentle denizens of luxury fallout shelters are forced to return to the irradiated hellscape their ancestors left behind — and are shocked to discover an incredibly complex, gleefully weird, and highly violent universe waiting for them.

episodes.title: The End
episodes.description: Okey dokey...

episodes.title: The Target
episodes.description: I know life can't have been easy up here...

episodes.title: The Head
episodes.description: The Wasteland's got its own Golden Rule...

episodes.title: The Ghouls
episodes.description: Death to Management.

episodes.title: The Past
episodes.description: Everyone wants to save the world...

episodes.title: The Trap
episodes.description: What happens when the ranchers have more power than the Sheriff?

episodes.title: The Radio
episodes.description: Every generation has their own dumbass ideas...

episodes.title: The Beginning
episodes.description: War...

episodes.title: The Innovator
episodes.description: Every dollar spent is a vote cast.

episodes.title: The Golden Rule
episodes.description: You can't put a price on family…

episodes.title: The Profligate
episodes.description: Most kids are dead by this age.

episodes.title: The Demon in the Snow
episodes.description: Rock to spear and so on...

episodes.title: The Wrangler
episodes.description: Big Whoop.

episodes.title: The Other Player
episodes.description: I remember good people.

episodes.title: The Handoff
episodes.description: You always end up back where you started.

episodes.title: The Strip
episodes.description: Winning might be overrated...

title: Death Note
description: Light Yagami is an ace student with great prospects—and he’s bored out of his mind. But all that changes when he finds the Death Note, a notebook dropped by a rogue Shinigami death god. Any human whose name is written in the notebook dies, and Light has vowed to use the power of the Death Note to rid the world of evil. But will Light succeed in his noble goal, or will the Death Note turn him into the very thing he fights against?

episodes.title: Rebirth
episodes.description: Brilliant but bored high school student Light Yagami suddenly finds himself holding the power of life and death in his hands—the power of the Death Note. He decides to rid the world of evil—by killing off criminals one by one. When the murders start to pile up, genius detective L is on the case, and an epic battle of wits unfolds.

episodes.title: Confrontation
episodes.description: While the world’s criminals continue to drop dead, L meets by computer with representatives from various nations. He requests that a task force be set up in Japan, under the direction of none other than Soichiro Yagami, Light’s father.

episodes.title: Dealings
episodes.description: Ryuk, the Shinigami, or god of death, who dropped the Death Note into the human world, warns Light that someone is on his trail. Light is troubled that he can’t find out the identity of his tracker, and Ryuk suggests an amazing deal...

episodes.title: Pursuit
episodes.description: Light—now known to the world as Kira—tests the Death Note to understand the scope of its powers by killing off six convicts in various ways—and confirms he can control his victims’ actions before they die.

episodes.title: Tactics
episodes.description: Soichiro Yagami demands to meet with L in person when he finds out that L has secretly brought FBI agents into Japan. Light, meanwhile, has found a way to get those very FBI agents off the case—permanently...

episodes.title: Unraveling
episodes.description: Light meets a woman at the Police Department with an urgent message for the Kira task force. As son of the chief investigator, Light listens to her story, and is startled to discover she may have information that could lead to his arrest.

episodes.title: Overcast
episodes.description: Light uses the Death Note to try to get rid of the woman who could get him captured, and is shocked when it doesn’t work. Realizing she must have given him an alias, he’s only got minutes to find out her real name before she tells her story to the task force.

episodes.title: Glare
episodes.description: L insists on setting up bugs and cameras in the homes of Chief Yagami and Deputy Director Kitamura—whom Raye Penber was tracking. But Light is a step ahead as usual—he knows he’s being watched.

episodes.title: Encounter
episodes.description: The murders continue, and L grows suspicious of Light’s too-perfect behavior and decides to investigate him on his own. In order to get closer to Light, L enrolls at the same university and reveals himself to be L.

episodes.title: Doubt
episodes.description: L's suspicion of Light deepens, compelling him to invite Light into the investigation. But then a phone call alerts them that Soichiro Yagami has suffered a heart attack!

episodes.title: Assault
episodes.description: As predicted on the tapes sent to Sakura TV, news anchors and commentators who expressed doubt about Kira die one by one. On further investigation, L concludes that this Kira is not the original—there's a second Kira!

episodes.title: Love
episodes.description: With a second Kira now on the loose, L asks Light to join the task force and pose as the real Kira in order to catch the copycat. Light agrees, hoping to divert suspicion from himself. To his surprise, this new Kira has a special ability even Light lacks…

episodes.title: Confession
episodes.description: Light goes to Aoyama to discover the identity of the second Kira before L becomes more suspicious. But Misa Amane, the new Kira, uses her unusual gift to find Light before he finds her.

episodes.title: Friend
episodes.description: Light and Misa show each other their Death Notes, and Light asks Misa to have her shinigami Rem get rid of L. But Misa asks something of Light in return—to fall in love with her!

episodes.title: Wager
episodes.description: Evidence turns up that points to Misa Amane as the second Kira. In an effort to spare her, Rem forces Misa to forfeit her ownership of the Death Note.

episodes.title: Decision
episodes.description: Misa is in confinement, though her memories of the Death Note have been completely wiped away. When Light is confined as well, the murders stop and suspicion of Light grows stronger. Then suddenly, the killings resume.

episodes.title: Execution
episodes.description: After fifty days of confinement the killings continue, and Misa and Light are released. But L has devised a plan to ensure no more murders occur, and has Light's father, Soichiro, take the two for a ride that may be their last.

episodes.title: Ally
episodes.description: Though L is still suspicious, Light and Misa, their memories of being Kira wiped clean, return to headquarters, where Light notices a strange connection between the recent Kira killings and the Yotsuba Group.

episodes.title: Matsuda
episodes.description: Matsuda, the task force member assigned to watch Misa, is eager to distinguish himself, and while on a job with Misa, he decides to do a little snooping on his own at the Yotsuba Group’s Tokyo headquarters.

episodes.title: Makeshift
episodes.description: L's team discovers that the Yotsuba Group meet in secret to discuss the elimination of individuals who are troublesome to their company, and concludes that Kira must be one of the eight executives. Can Light posing as L ferret out the right one?

episodes.title: Performance
episodes.description: The Task Force uses Misa as a way to get closer to the Yotsuba corporation. But things get complicated when Rem tries to communicate with her.

episodes.title: Guidance
episodes.description: Thanks to Misa, the Task Force now knows the identity of the new Kira and L plans an elaborate scheme to smoke him out of hiding.

episodes.title: Frenzy
episodes.description: L, Light and Misa watch from the investigation team building and wonder who he is talking to. L wonders if Higuchi is talking to a shinigami. Rem convinces Higuchi to go to the station, but she has her own selfish motives for doing so.

episodes.title: Revival
episodes.description: While Higuchi is finally captured, Light inadvertently regains his memories as Kira.

episodes.title: Silence
episodes.description: Light, his memory recovered, orders Misa to begin killing after Higuchi dies. The Shinigami Rem realizes that everything is going according to Light's plan, and that L will arrest Misa as Kira-unless Rem acts quickly.

episodes.title: Renewal
episodes.description: Light has removed everyone in his way and is closer to achieving his perfect world.

episodes.title: Abduction
episodes.description: A new investigator steps forward-Near, a central figure in the SPK, an organization that is trying to catch Kira without relying on L. Near is aware of the existence of the Death Notes and wants to get his hands on one.

episodes.title: Impatience
episodes.description: Light, acting as L, reveals to Near that his sister Sayu has been kidnapped by someone wanting to trade her for the Death Note. Near finds out that the trade will happen in Los Angeles and promises to help, while secretly planning to steal the Death Note and capture Kira.

episodes.title: Father
episodes.description: Mortified over allowing the Death Note to fall into Mello's hands in order to save his daughter, Soichiro puts himself into harm's way in order to get it back.

episodes.title: Justice
episodes.description: Mello busts into SPK headquarters to retrieve a photograph of himself to make sure he won't be killed by Kira. In exchange for Near giving him the picture, Mello drops an important hint about the Death Notes: some of the rules are fake.

episodes.title: Transfer
episodes.description: Near contacts the Japanese task force and determines that Kira is among their members. He asks for insider information, and Aizawa, beginning to doubt Light, responds. Near suspects that the new L is really Light Yagami and that Light is Kira.

episodes.title: Selection
episodes.description: Star newscaster Kiyomi Takada becomes Kira's spokesperson to the world, after Demegawa is deleted by Mikami, and she just so happens to have been Light's girlfriend in college. Aizawa's suspicions about Light grow.

episodes.title: Scorn
episodes.description: Near goes to Japan, allegedly as bait for Kira. Following Light's instructions, Takada asks Mikami to send her five pages of the Death Note. She tells him that he will continue his work in a fake book made to look like the real one.

episodes.title: Vigilance
episodes.description: Aizawa figures out what's going on and tells Near, who already knows about the notes. Near instructs Aizawa to continue watching Light, and then puts in motion a plan to separate Misa from Light.

episodes.title: Malice
episodes.description: Light and Near agree upon a meeting place for the final confrontation. A key player is kidnapped and the end results are shocking.
The Japanese Task Force and the SPK finally meet at YellowBox Warehouse on January 28th. However, a third party has come to the warehouse as well, on Kira's orders to kill everyone else there.

episodes.title: New World
episodes.description: Though Mikami has written all the investigators' names in the Death Note, a minute passes and everyone is still alive. Near seizes Mikami's Death Note, and all is at last revealed.

title: Sherlock
description: A modern update finds the famous sleuth and his doctor partner solving crime in 21st century London.

episodes.title: A Study in Pink
episodes.description: A war hero, invalided home from Afghanistan, meets a strange but charismatic genius who is looking for a flatmate; it is London, 2010, and Dr Watson and Sherlock Holmes are meeting for the first time. A string of impossible suicides has Scotland Yard baffled - and only one man can help.

episodes.title: The Blind Banker
episodes.description: A mysterious cipher is being scrawled on the walls around London. The first person to see the cipher is dead within hours of reading it. Sherlock plunges into a world of codes and symbols, consulting with London's best graffiti artists. He soon learns that the city is in the grip a gang of international smugglers, a secret society called the Black Lotus.

episodes.title: The Great Game
episodes.description: A strange clue in an empty room, a blood-soaked car, a priceless Old Master, a deranged bomber. With the clock ticking, the curtain rises on a battle of wits between Sherlock, John and the shadowy stranger who seems to know all the answers...

episodes.title: A Scandal in Belgravia
episodes.description: Blackmail threatens the monarchy and Sherlock is about to meet the woman who beats him.

episodes.title: The Hounds of Baskerville
episodes.description: A hound from hell. Sherlock's most famous case. But is a monster really stalking Dartmoor?

episodes.title: The Reichenbach Fall
episodes.description: The return of Moriarty. The crime of the century. Can Sherlock possibly survive?

episodes.title: The Empty Hearse
episodes.description: Two years on from reports of his Reichenbach Fall demise, Sherlock resurfaces as London comes under threat of a huge terrorist attack. John, though, has mixed feelings about his friend's shocking return.

episodes.title: The Sign of Three
episodes.description: Sherlock faces his biggest challenge of all – delivering a Best Man’s speech on John’s wedding day! But all isn’t quite as it seems. Mortal danger stalks the reception – and someone might not make it to the happy couple’s first dance. Sherlock must thank the bridesmaids, solve the case and stop a killer.

episodes.title: His Last Vow
episodes.description: A case of stolen letters leads Sherlock Holmes into a long conflict with Charles Augustus Magnussen, the Napoleon of blackmail, and the one man he truly hates. But how do you tackle a foe who knows the personal weakness of every person of importance in the Western world?

episodes.title: The Six Thatchers
episodes.description: Why is someone destroying images of Margaret Thatcher? Is there a madman on the loose? Or is there a much darker purpose at work?

episodes.title: The Lying Detective
episodes.description: Sherlock faces perhaps the most chilling enemy of his long career: the powerful and seemingly unassailable Culverton Smith – a man with a very dark secret indeed.

episodes.title: The Final Problem
episodes.description: Holmes and Watson travel to Europe to escape Moriarty's vengeance.

title: Marvel's Daredevil
description: Lawyer-by-day Matt Murdock uses his heightened senses from being blinded as a young boy to fight crime at night on the streets of Hell’s Kitchen as Daredevil.

episodes.title: Into the Ring
episodes.description: Murdock's vigilante crime fighting and his new law practice find equally dangerous challenges in a murder case tied to a corporate crime syndicate.

episodes.title: Cut Man
episodes.description: Murdock makes a near fatal error while trying to save a kidnapped boy, and finds an unlikely ally when he needs saving himself.

episodes.title: Rabbit in a Snowstorm
episodes.description: Murdock and Foggy take on a mysterious wealthy client, but Murdock is convinced that there's more to the case than just the facts.

episodes.title: In the Blood
episodes.description: Two vicious Russian brothers working for Fisk strike back against Daredevil. Fisk moves to further consolidate his power in the criminal underworld.

episodes.title: World on Fire
episodes.description: Fisk moves forward with plans that threaten to rip Hell's Kitchen apart. Murdock and Foggy take on a case helping tenants victimized by a slumlord.

episodes.title: Condemned
episodes.description: Daredevil finds himself trapped in the fallout of Fisk's plan to take control of Hell's Kitchen. Ben Urich digs closer to the truth.

episodes.title: Stick
episodes.description: An important figure from Murdock's past reemerges seeking his help to battle a new enemy threatening Hell's Kitchen.

episodes.title: Shadows in the Glass
episodes.description: While Murdock, Foggy and Karen's mission becomes clearer, Fisk's world spins further out of control in his battle for Hell's Kitchen.

episodes.title: Speak of the Devil
episodes.description: When Fisk gains the upper hand, the goal to destroy him becomes even more difficult, while Daredevil faces his own demons.

episodes.title: Nelson v. Murdock
episodes.description: Murdock and Foggy's relationship is put to the ultimate test while a new enemy against Fisk emerges.

episodes.title: The Path of the Righteous
episodes.description: Fisk and Murdock wrestle with the consequences of their chosen paths, while Ben and Karen get closer to Fisk's true past.

episodes.title: The Ones We Leave Behind
episodes.description: Fisk seeks revenge while Karen is haunted by recent events. Daredevil makes a startling discovery about Fisk's financing.

episodes.title: Daredevil
episodes.description: In the season finale, a boxed-in Fisk and a desperate Murdock, Foggy and Karen are forced to play their end games.

episodes.title: Bang
episodes.description: Hell's Kitchen has calmed, but it's not out of the fire yet. When an unknown vigilante begins to take the fight to the streets in a big and bloody way, Matt Murdock must don the mask of Daredevil to stop him before innocent people end up in the crossfire.

episodes.title: Dogs to a Gunfight
episodes.description: As Murdock recovers from an attack, Foggy and Karen fight to protect their new client from both the law and the Kitchen's newest vigilante.

episodes.title: New York's Finest
episodes.description: Trapped face-to-face with the Punisher, Daredevil wrestles with the morality of vigilante justice. Meanwhile, Foggy and Karen work to save the firm.

episodes.title: Penny and Dime
episodes.description: Karen uncovers shocking facts about the Punisher, who finds himself hunted by a powerful force in Hell's Kitchen. Daredevil ponders his next moves.

episodes.title: Kinbaku
episodes.description: A former lover arrives in Hell's Kitchen and turns Murdock's world upside down. Karen digs for the truth about the Punisher.

episodes.title: Regrets Only
episodes.description: A lethal foe returns with a vengeance, Foggy and Murdock risk the firm to ensure justice, and Karen sees a different side of the Punisher.

episodes.title: Semper Fidelis
episodes.description: Murdock and Foggy take on the DA in the trial of the century, but their client refuses to play along. Murdock struggles to balance his dual identities.

episodes.title: Guilty as Sin
episodes.description: As the firm's trial spins out of control, a figure from Murdock's past returns to deliver shocking revelations about the future of Hell's Kitchen.

episodes.title: Seven Minutes in Heaven
episodes.description: Castle gets an offer he can't refuse. Foggy and Murdock question the future of their firm, but Karen won't give up so easily.

episodes.title: The Man in the Box
episodes.description: Murdock and Foggy get caught in the crossfire of the Punisher's revenge. Karen and Murdock dig for the truth in very different ways.
The Punisher's war continues, and so does the body count in Hell's Kitchen. Murdock tries to finish what the DA started.

episodes.title: The Dark at the End of the Tunnel
episodes.description: Daredevil goes underground to save an old friend. Karen follows a dangerous lead. The law firm of Nelson and Murdock may have reached its final chapter.

episodes.title: A Cold Day in Hell's Kitchen
episodes.description: In the season finale, Daredevil is backed into the ultimate showdown for his own life - and the future of Hell's Kitchen.

episodes.title: Resurrection
episodes.description: Shattered physically and spiritually, Matt rethinks his purpose and place in Hell's Kitchen. Meanwhile, Fisk puts a plan in motion from behind bars.

episodes.title: Please
episodes.description: Grieving for the life he's abandoned, Matt suffers a crisis of faith. Fisk makes a deal with the FBI that turns him into a target.

episodes.title: No Good Deed
episodes.description: As Fisk moves into swanky new digs amid a public outcry, Matt wrestles with how far he's ready to go to right this wrong. Dex's aim comes into focus.

episodes.title: Blindsided
episodes.description: While Matt infiltrates a prison to find information on the Albanians, Fisk puts Dex in his crosshairs and a fed-up Foggy goes on the offensive.

episodes.title: The Perfect Game
episodes.description: To quell the rising backlash over his release, Fisk serves up a scapegoat to the FBI. Dex misses the mark when he runs into a woman from his past.

episodes.title: The Devil You Know
episodes.description: Driven to the edge, Dex loses his way until he's offered a lifeline by Fisk. Matt comes to Karen for help, which she agrees to give -- on one condition.

episodes.title: Aftermath
episodes.description: The press crucifies Daredevil after the attack on the Bulletin, and Agent Nadeem suspects the FBI paid too high a price for Fisk's cooperation.

episodes.title: Upstairs/Downstairs
episodes.description: A desperate Dex reaches out for help, Matt forms an uneasy alliance with Agent Nadeem, and Karen concocts a dangerous plan to provoke Fisk.

episodes.title: Revelations
episodes.description: Matt's already shaky world tilts when he learns a shocking truth. Karen runs for her life. Nadeem discovers how deep Fisk's influence runs.

episodes.title: Karen
episodes.description: Hunted by Fisk and haunted by mistakes from her past, Karen seeks refuge at the church. Matt finally gets his shot, and Dex goes in for the kill.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.description: Dex tries to run his prey to ground, Nadeem's conscience kicks in, and Fisk looks to recover a gift from Vanessa seized during his incarceration.

episodes.title: One Last Shot
episodes.description: Fisk’s long-awaited reunion doesn't go as planned. Nelson & Murdock take on a new client who holds key information on Kingpin.

episodes.title: A New Napkin
episodes.description: In the season finale, Matt prepares to cross the line, as Dex becomes more dangerous than ever and Fisk enacts his endgame.

title: Rebelde
description: A group of young adults will spend their adolescence at the Elite Way School, where they will learn about love, life and live their passion for music.

episodes.title: ¿Dónde vas a estudiar?
episodes.description: After doing a bawdy dance in front of all the students, Mía ends up being punished by her father. Miguel decides to move to Mexico City to find the family of the man who killed his father. Meanwhile, Roberta shows her famous mother how rebellious she is.

episodes.title: Exámenes de admisión
episodes.description: Mia meets Roberta and offers to give her a makeover, but she takes it the wrong way. Lupita, accompanied by her aunt Mayra, applies for a scholarship at the Elite Way School. Miguel is not allowed to take the school entrance exam.

episodes.title: Intercambio de favores
episodes.description: Lupita's aunt manages to arrange for Miguel to take his exam, and in return, she asks him to look after her niece. Vico flirts with Diego. Miguel meets Mía, and they develop an attraction for each other. Celina is also drawn to him, but she struggles with insecurities about her weight.

episodes.title: Amenazas y ataques
episodes.description: Mía pretends that she doesn't like Miguel and makes fun of him in front of Celina. Diego threatens Roberta for standing up for Vico. In Valle de Bravo, Roberta tries to get Mauro's attention by pretending to drown. Diego gets into a fight and is injured with a knife.

episodes.title: Engaños y malentendidos
episodes.description: After injuring Diego, his attackers stage everything to make it look like a robbery. Miguel rescues Diego and hides the truth. Celina gets angry with Mía and Vico due to a misunderstanding. Miguel fights with Mía at the edge of a cliff.

episodes.title: Peleas
episodes.description: At the edge of a cliff, Miguel humiliates Mía for what she did to Celina. Diego tries to find his attackers, but his dad stops him. Mía decides to conceal what happened with Miguel and apologizes to Celina. Roberta fights with Alma and insults her.

episodes.title: Besos falsos y verdaderos
episodes.description: Franco visits Mía and promises not to travel as much anymore. Miguel expresses his admiration to Franco, but plans to destroy him. Mía discovers Miguel in her room. Roberta kisses Mauro and José tries to make her appreciate her mom. Vico believes that Mía and Diego kissed.

episodes.title: Declaración de amor
episodes.description: Miguel asks Celina to be his girlfriend. Roberta begs the principal not to fire Mauro. Diego and Roberta make each other's lives miserable. Everyone thinks that Roberta is the one writing the anonymous notes. The principal takes charge of the Vacance Club.

episodes.title: Enfermedad fingida
episodes.description: Roberta pretends to be sick to be able to leave school. Mía wants a photograph of her mom. Diego tries to intimidate Roberta. Miguel hits Nico for insulting him and leaves him unconscious.

episodes.title: Lupita y Roberta ¿amigas?
episodes.description: Roberta convinces Lupita not to change dormitories. Pascual finds Diego's wallet among Roberta's belongings and accuses her of being a thief. Nico lies to save Miguel. León threatens to send Diego to military school.

episodes.title: Desmentida, inventos y humillación
episodes.description: Celina confronts Lupita and asks her to stop harassing Miguel. León bribes Pascual with a car. Lupita manages to prove Roberta's innocence, and Diego publicly apologizes to her. Mía takes photos of Miguel with Lupita and confronts him.

episodes.title: Falsa acusación
episodes.description: Franco sues Alma for defamation. Pilar discovers that the bribe to her father is true. Tomás has a secret admirer. Giovanni accuses Pilar of writing the anonymous notes. Roberta secures a new audition for the dance group.

episodes.title: Falta de sinceridad
episodes.description: Mía can't help but dream about Miguel and imagines herself kissing him. Roberta confesses to her mother that she made up the rumor about her stalker. Tomás thinks Pilar is his secret admirer. Miguel introduces himself to Celina's mother as her boyfriend.

episodes.title: Bofetadas y verdades
episodes.description: Miguel continues to be with Celina because he doesn't want to hurt her. Tomás tries to take advantage of Pilar, thinking she is his secret admirer. Alma clarifies the rumors about the alleged harassment. Vico kisses Tomás to get back at Diego.

episodes.title: Celos, mentiras y confianza
episodes.description: Peter gives a photo of his mother to Mia. Vico has romantic encounters with Tomas. After discovering that he lied to her, Franco confronts Miguel. Mia presents her choreography, but Roberta and Miguel break into the dance, demonstrating their talent.

episodes.title: Me suena
episodes.description: Diego tries to intimidate Roberta so she does not talk about him in his work on ethics and threatens to tell the director that she hides a boy.

episodes.title: Secretos no tan bien guardados
episodes.description: The ethics professor tells students to read all the papers and that he liked a lot the Roberta's work and asks her if she can read it aloud. Leon arrives at this point.

episodes.title: Cosas que se deben ocultar
episodes.description: Miguel finds his room all messy and a card with a hand printed.

episodes.title: La logia
episodes.description: Miguel tells Nico that the sect exists and says she was tortured and threatened with death.

episodes.title: Trampa, venganza y beso
episodes.description: José can't find her tutor's name in the files. Roberta and Diego convince everyone to go to a club. Wanting to get back at her, Diego kisses Roberta.

episodes.title: Fiesta
episodes.description: Esteban informs Pascual there are no fourth-year students. A brawl breaks out at the club and the police shows up. Diego finds out Tomás likes Vico.

episodes.title: Tratamiento psicológico
episodes.description: Gandia won't expel Roberta but expects her to go to counseling. The Lodge members try to run Miguel over. Mia's angry that Miguel's in her home.

episodes.title: No te metas con mi novia
episodes.description: Miguel lies and says he's worried about Celina to get into Mia's home. Diego hits Tomás for stealing his girlfriend. Nico's dad is very sick.

episodes.title: A la hora de bailar
episodes.description: Miguel finds Celina dancing and tells her to confront Mia. After, Roberta and Miguel expose Mia for not wanting Celina to be part of the dance group.

episodes.title: Expulsión
episodes.description: The Lodge beats Nico up. Roberta's dance group beats Mia's at the auditions. Celina doesn't want to be Mia's friend anymore. Diego finds Marcelino.

episodes.title: Chantaje
episodes.description: Roberta becomes Diego's slave for fear he'll tell on her. Pascual tells Vico she must leave the school. Mia and Roberta fight in the middle of class.

episodes.title: Se extraña a Vico
episodes.description: Celina tells Miguel she is going to kill herself if he leaves her. The dance teacher wants Mia back in the group. Roberta's with Mia in favor of Vico.

episodes.title: Celina obsesionada
episodes.description: Alma finds out Lupita's been taking Roberta's place during counseling. Celina confronts Mia over Miguel. Leon tells Diego to put Roberta in her place.

episodes.title: ¿Qué tiene Celina?
episodes.description: Mia's punished for leading the protest in favor of Vico. Marcelino shows Roberta how much he loves her. Mia and Miguel find Celina in very bad shape.

episodes.title: El nuevo
episodes.description: Mia tries to kiss Miguel but gets cold feet. Alma asks Roberta what she's been spending so much money on. Both Roberta and Mia like the new student.

episodes.title: Cita ¿arruinada?
episodes.description: Mia's not allowed out and so her date's ruined. Miguel gets Celina to understand they have to split. Roberta has a plan to get out of Diego's grip.

episodes.title: La mentira de Roberta
episodes.description: Franco asks Miguel to keep an eye on Mia. Roberta's going out with Joaquín but she lies about her parents. Pilar confronts her mom for cheating.

episodes.title: Discreción y chantaje
episodes.description: Joaquín asks Roberta to be discreet about them. Diego has Roberta do his history assignment. Miguel gets the Lodge to think the old Lodge is back.

episodes.title: Doble cara
episodes.description: Joaquín rejects Mia in front of Miguel and convinces her to keep their relationship secret. Miguel learns that Joaquín is playing with both Roberta and Mia.

episodes.title: El cassette
episodes.description: Roberta rips into Diego for spreading gossip and tells him she's going to send the tape with his name to all the radio stations as pay back.

episodes.title: Venganza y verdad
episodes.description: Marcelino apologizes to Roberta for thinking she gave him up. Mia won't accept Celina's apology. Roberta finds out Diego didn't tell on her.

episodes.title: Delatores
episodes.description: León finds out about the tape and slaps Diego, but Tomás takes the blame. Celina tells Mia about Joaquín and Roberta. A drunken Diego hits his Dad.

episodes.title: La mamá de Roberta
episodes.description: Mía buys Celina a dance outfit. Joaquín finds out Alma is Roberta's mom. Vico tells Mía she'll lose Joaquín if she doesn't sleep with him.

episodes.title: ¿Embarazada?
episodes.description: Roberta tells Alma she's pregnant and that she broke up with Joaquín. Madariaga advises Diego to fight for what he wants and not give up. Mia asks Giovanni for a favor.

episodes.title: Mi padre es narco
episodes.description: Mía finds out that Miguel told Joaquín that her dad is a drug dealer. Roberta rejects Joaquín's sexual advances. Madariaga punishes Mía and Miguel.

episodes.title: Qué quieren los padres
episodes.description: Nico's parents want Karen for him, but he likes Lupita. Miguel tells Joaquín the truth about Franco. Roberta gets mad at Enrique for being interested in Alma.

episodes.title: El divorcio
episodes.description: Roberta attacks Vico. León tells Diego that his mom wants a divorce but since that would look bad for his image, he has to choose to stay with him.

episodes.title: No querer ver la verdad
episodes.description: Roberta tells Teo he's not guilty of his brother's death. Diego tells Roberta that Joaquín is cheating on her with Mia so she pushes him down the stairs.

episodes.title: Accidentes
episodes.description: Teo wants to know if his brother was high when the accident happened, but his parents deny it. Roberta tells Mía that Joaquín has been seeing both of them.

episodes.title: Decepción
episodes.description: Alma gets Roberta to tell her what happened. Franco finds Mía singing at a cafe and punishes her. Celina tells Mía Vico and Miguel were together.

episodes.title: Lupita no es judía
episodes.description: Vico is mad at Celina for saying Miguel spent the night with her. Nico's mom is upset when she learns that Lupita isn't Jewish.

episodes.title: Falso rumor
episodes.description: Mía and Roberta get everyone to think that Joaquín is gay. Nico breaks up with Lupita. Miguel and Diego hear that the cafe wants to hire the band.

episodes.title: Orden en la escuela
episodes.description: Mr. Mendiola threatens to fire Pascual. Miguel tells Franco that he's afraid Mía might try to kill herself. Tomás is worried about Diego's self-kidnapping.

episodes.title: Mejor ser diferente
episodes.description: León thwarts Diego's plans and has the bodyguard who helped arrested. Enrique tells Diego he is acting like his father and advises him not to.

episodes.title: Invitación para cantar
episodes.description: Celina confronts Miguel over Vico. Roberta invites Celina to sing with the band. Robert and Lupita think that Jose Lujan is stealing food and selling it.

episodes.title: La burla
episodes.description: Celina confronts Miguel over Vico. Roberta invites Celina to sing with the band. Robert and Lupita think that Jose Lujan is stealing food and selling it.

episodes.title: Ataques de pánico
episodes.description: Diego is disappointed his mom went back to his dad. Roberta pretends to have panic attacks so Pascual won't expel her. Pascual hires Esteban back.

episodes.title: Discusiones y golpes
episodes.description: Miguel hits Giovanni when he finds out he's with Celina as a favor. Diego argues with Roberta and says one of them has to leave the band.

episodes.title: No se vayan
episodes.description: Miguel asks both Roberta and Diego to stay in the band. Mía has to go to the show with Miguel. Alma brings Marcelino and Dulce to visit Roberta and Lupita at school.

episodes.title: Lavado de dinero
episodes.description: Pascual agrees to start a foundation, but the real purpose is to launder money. Roberta pretends to be with Diego in front of León.

episodes.title: La verdad siempre se sabe
episodes.description: Miguel's mother gets upset when she learns about him attending Elite Way School. In fear of The Lodge, Vico breaks up with Miguel. Franco and Miguel's mother meet.

episodes.title: Viaje de fin de año
episodes.description: Franco invites Miguel and his family to celebrate Christmas at his house. Miguel's mother is confused at why Miguel is going back to high school.

episodes.title: Madres
episodes.description: Mía confronts her father asking why he never talks about her mother. Miguel and his mother argue; he reveals his plan to avenge his father's death.

episodes.title: La foto de Vico
episodes.description: Franco sends Alma a message saying he won't be intimidated. Esteban destroys José Lujan's homework. Only the boys are allowed to be in the dance contest.

episodes.title: Dinero
episodes.description: Nico's dad is very sick, so the guys from the band decide to give him the money from their first singing gig to help. Miguel asks Franco for a loan.

episodes.title: Navidad
episodes.description: Pascual wants Roberta to apologize to Hilda but Alma comes to put the teacher straight before it can happen. Roberta invites Teo and José Lujan to her house for Christmas.

episodes.title: Mía no confía en Miguel
episodes.description: Mía doesn't want Miguel to have the check her father has given her to give to him. Roberta gets mad at Mía for thinking Miguel lied about Nico's dad.

episodes.title: Boxeo
episodes.description: Roberta gets revenge on Mía by making Mia think he father died. Joaquín offers Tomás work running drugs. Mía and Roberta have a legitimate boxing match.

episodes.title: ¿Por qué pelearon?
episodes.description: Everyone thinks Mía and Roberta fought over Joaquín. Tomás doesn't want to run drugs but is threatened by Joaquín. Nico plans to quit school to take care of his family.

episodes.title: Droga en la escuela
episodes.description: Mía apologizes to Nico. Madariaga finds out that Joaquín is selling drugs in the school. Mía asks Alma for confirmation that Franco is dating his lawyer, Valeria.

episodes.title: Viaje a Cozumel
episodes.description: Carlos accuses Madariaga of taking bribes from León for Diego to pass his class. Nico says his goodbyes to Miguel and Teo. Celina shuns Mia.

episodes.title: Fiesta en la playa
episodes.description: After he is taken to the principal's office for the rumor of drugs being sold in the school, Joaquín denies everything and puts the blame on Tomás. Roberta and Mia both don't want to spend New Year's with their parents. Their friends throw a beach party and the band performs.

episodes.title: Año Nuevo
episodes.description: Miguel saves Mia from a possible self-induced drowning; they kiss. Nico accepts his mother's conditions. José steals some papers and Teo takes the blame.

episodes.title: La fundación del director
episodes.description: Peter asks Mia if she knows that Franco is with Valeria. Tomás's dad finds out about Pascual's foundation and wants to become a part of it.

episodes.title: Obligado a vender droga
episodes.description: Tomás reveals to his friends that Joaquín's forcing him to sell drugs. Joaquín wants Tomás to run drugs outside as well as inside of school. Mia and Celina find out Vico's been lying.

episodes.title: Tomás quiere escapar
episodes.description: Tomás decides to run away after the threat of expulsion from the school. Miguel warns Joaquín to tell the truth. Madariaga wants to call the police to handle the situation of drugs in the school.

episodes.title: Venganza
episodes.description: The girls get back at their dance professor, Lulu. Mia gets Miguel thrown out of the mall. Alma comes up with a plan to sabotage Franco and Valeria's romance.

episodes.title: Celos
episodes.description: Roberta gets mad at Alma because she's friends with Mia. Madariaga warns Galia to keep an eye on Pilar since she's in a relationship with Joaquín.

episodes.title: Mía se siente herida
episodes.description: Mia cries after she hears what Miguel thinks of her and seeing him kissing Julieta. Roberta is kicked out by Lupita's mom for playing with Lupita's sister, Dulce.

episodes.title: Drogas y deporte
episodes.description: Pilar tells her mother, Galia, that Joaquín doesn't do drugs because he's an athlete. Alma is afraid that Roberta's father will take Roberta away.

episodes.title: ¿Roberta se va a España?
episodes.description: Alma tells Franco that Roberta's father wants to take Roberta away with him to Spain. Marcelino tells Roberta that her mother is afraid of losing her to her father.

episodes.title: Diego se enfurece
episodes.description: Alma tells Roberta that she can't stop her father from taking her away to Spain and that she loves her very much. Pilar sees Vico and Joaquín kissing.

episodes.title: Decidirse por una banda
episodes.description: When Diego finds out Roberta is in two bands he tells her to pick one or the other. Valeria breaks up with Franco because of Mia. Meanwhile, Mia tells on Miguel and Julieta.

episodes.title: Cartas de amor
episodes.description: Mia asks her dad to stop Miguel from getting expelled after she told on him and Julieta. Esteban receives love letters and thinks they are from Mia.

episodes.title: Lulú pide disculpas
episodes.description: Lulu apologizes to the students for lying. Celina asks Mia to take her place at the band's rehearsal. Vico demands that Joaquín breaks up with Pilar.

episodes.title: El temor
episodes.description: Giovanni gives his support to Mia. Fearing the Lodge might hurt Julieta, Miguel breaks up with her. By Diego's request, Facundo turns down Roberta.

episodes.title: Ruptura y reconciliación
episodes.description: Joaquín breaks up with Pilar because she won't sleep with him. Vico thinks that Mia told Esteban about the love letters she's been sending him. Roberta gets manipulated by Diego.

episodes.title: En reemplazo
episodes.description: Valeria pretends to be a photographer for the school to get close to Mia. Miguel warns Mia about Esteban. Roberta makes her choice of which band to stay in.

episodes.title: Golpes y presentaciones
episodes.description: Miguel and Esteban get into a fist fight. Joaquín breaks up with Vico by lying that the Lodge might come after her. However, Pilar tells Vico that Joaquín and her are dating again.

episodes.title: Incomunicada
episodes.description: Miguel admonishes Julieta for going out with her former boyfriend, who is dangerous. Valeria tells Franco she spent the day with Mia. Paola tries to seduce Diego.

episodes.title: Obligadas a acostarse
episodes.description: Miguel asks Teo to help get him in as a member at the Lodge. Mia finds out Vanessa is really the woman dating her father, Valeria. Paola is hired by León to sleep with Diego.

episodes.title: Cosas del pasado
episodes.description: Diego reveals to Paola he's a virgin. Miguel is asked by Franco to find Mia, who has run away after she finds out her father and Valeria had a history.

episodes.title: Trampa
episodes.description: Miguel comes up with a plan to get Rodrigo to invite Teo into the Lodge. Celina tells Mia that Valeria could tell her everything she wants to know about her mother.

episodes.title: Creer o no creer
episodes.description: Antonio punishes Roberta and locks her up for throwing the gifts he gave her out the window. Pascual warns Pilar that he doesn't want to see her with Joaquín. Valeria tells Mia that her mom was promiscuous and used drugs, but Franco denies it.

episodes.title: Haciendo lo que no se debe
episodes.description: Julieta breaks up with Miguel once she figures out he is in love with Mia. Teo and Miguel pretend to fight. Franco gets upset with Valeria for telling Mia about her mom.

episodes.title: No te drogues
episodes.description: Lupita tells Mia of how Miguel got Teo into the Lodge. José makes Teo believe that Roberta is in love with him.

episodes.title: Autoestima
episodes.description: Mia accuses Miguel to Esteban of spying on her in the bathroom. Miguel and Julieta begin dating again.

episodes.title: Una relación seria
episodes.description: Esteban finds out the letters aren't Mia's, but tells her, if she wants a real relationship where she is loved, he'll be waiting. Tomás gets beat up by a strange man when he goes to visit Lulu.

episodes.title: Cambios
episodes.description: Mia confides in Alma about Franco's change since his relationship with Valeria started. Nico thinks Lupita is after Karen's cousin.

episodes.title: Decir la verdad
episodes.description: León reminds Paola that he did her a favor, and forbids her to ever see or go near Diego again. Mia accepts Giovanni's request to start dating.

episodes.title: ¿Sobredosis?
episodes.description: Everyone laughs when Giovanni reveals that him and Mia are dating. Joaquín faints in gym class after taking drugs; Esteban doesn't let the fellow classmates get help.

episodes.title: Ascenso
episodes.description: Roberta ruins her dad's fancy dinner by embarrassing him and pretending he beats her. Mia plans to get evidence of Joaquín's drug business.

episodes.title: No creas los chismes
episodes.description: Lupita finds Mia's diary in Nico's belongings, not knowing that Miguel is the one who took it. Franco tells Mia to ignore the rumours about her mother.

episodes.title: Rehabilitación
episodes.description: Diego finds out about the ring Paola received from his father, León, and breaks up with her. Mia plans to get revenge on Miguel for reading her diary. Joaquín starts rehab.

episodes.title: La verdad sobre mi vida
episodes.description: Mia asks Raquel to tell Miguel, when he's with Julieta or alone, that she is crazy for him. Paola confesses to Diego about her past.

episodes.title: Diego vuelve con Paola
episodes.description: Mia learns the truth about her mom's past. After getting back with Paola, Diego hides her in the school.

episodes.title: Roberta regresa
episodes.description: Giovanni gives his full support to Mia after she learns how her mother died. After talking to Valeria, Mia accepts the truth and the fact that her mom was a hoe.

episodes.title: Mía se va
episodes.description: Roberta finds out about Diego and Paola dating. Mia runs away from school and goes to stay with Alma. Meanwhile, Miguel searches for Mia.

episodes.title: Mía está con Alma
episodes.description: Giovanni is angry that Miguel goes to look for Mia. Roberta finds Mia at Alma's and gets upset. Miguel finds Mia at Alma's and they kiss; they leave and spend the day together.

episodes.title: Olvida lo que pasó
episodes.description: Before returning to school, Miguel tells Mia that they have to forget everything that happened between them and they can't begin dating. However, Miguel ends his relationship with Julieta.

episodes.title: Roberta está celosa
episodes.description: Due to jealousy, Roberta tells her mom to choose her or Mía. Miguel decides to tell Mía he has feelings for her; they decide to keep their relationship secret.

episodes.title: Mía no cree en su papá
episodes.description: Mia loses trust in her dad. Franco believes that Alma is turning Mia against him. Miguel wants his relationship with Mia to be public.

episodes.title: ¿Alma y Franco juntos?
episodes.description: When Alma comes to Franco's house, she finds him drunk; he kisses her. Mia tells Giovanni the truth of how she feels and breaks up with him.

episodes.title: Mía y Miguel
episodes.description: Valeria warns Alma to stay away from Franco. After Mia and Miguel kiss, she runs away. However; she returns, apologizes, and ask him to make her a woman.

episodes.title: Celina sale de la banda
episodes.description: Celina quits the band and asks Mia to take her place. Miguel takes Mia to her house to reconcile with her father.

episodes.title: Téo, aceptado en la logia
episodes.description: Teo tells Miguel he passed the test given by the Lodge members and it's all thanks to his girlfriend, Roberta. Franco tells Mia about her mom.

episodes.title: Fin de semana
episodes.description: Franco tells Miguel that Mia has been happier and more mature since she fell in love. Carlo, Mia's uncle comes to visit; him along with Franco, Valeria, Alma, Mia, and Miguel spend the weekend together.

episodes.title: Miguel pide disculpas
episodes.description: Paola tells Roberta everything that happened between León and her. Miguel apologizes to Mia for exploding on her about his father.

episodes.title: Show exitoso
episodes.description: Giovanni, Mia, Roberta, Diego, Miguel, and Mia have a successful show. Giovanni's mother embarrasses him in front of Tomas and his mother when they're invited to dinner.

episodes.title: Avergonzado
episodes.description: Miguel flips out when Mia invites his mother and sister to a family trip. Luisa finds out that Giovanni is ashamed of his parents, but she plays along with the lie he invented.

episodes.title: ¿A Roberta le gusta Carlo?
episodes.description: Alma asks Roberta if she likes Carlo. Lupita asks Nico what's up with Miguel, because Mia is worried about him.

episodes.title: Mía o Julieta
episodes.description: Oso wants to convince Marcelino to steal money to help him. Nico tells Lupita that Miguel feels like he's betraying his father because he's in love with Mia.

episodes.title: No está listo para tener novia
episodes.description: Miguel goes to Julieta's house to tell her that he is with Mia. She kisses him and Lupita sees them.

episodes.title: Venganza y apuesta
episodes.description: Lupita tells Mia that Miguel is dating her for revenge. Mia insults Miguel and tells the whole school that she was with him because of a bet.

episodes.title: A la sombra de su fama
episodes.description: Roberta is afraid her mother's reputation will cast a shadow on her career in the band. Marcelino's brother escapes and has him ask for money from Alma and Pepa and steal from other places. Esteban overworks José until she collapses.

episodes.title: Nuevo prefecto
episodes.description: Carlo tells Roberta he is interested in her mom, not her. José reveals to Teo that she was the one who sent the emails, not Roberta.

episodes.title: Cambios en la banda
episodes.description: Mia quits the band and Miguel is pleased. However, Diego tells her it would be a mistake to quit and Vico convinces her to stay in the band.

episodes.title: Invitados a Otro Rollo
episodes.description: The band needs to get exposure so they try to get on the Otro Rollo TV show. Franco gives Carlo another chance at working for the family company.

episodes.title: La recomendada
episodes.description: Giovanni and Tomás cover for Diego with Alicia. Everyone in the school finds out in another anonymous letter that José made fun of Teo.

episodes.title: Delatores y encubridores
episodes.description: Roberta asks Teo to forgive her. José blames Lupita for writing and sending out the anonymous letters.

episodes.title: La banda se llama RBD
episodes.description: Giovanni, Mia, Roberta, Diego, Miguel, and Lupita decide to name their band Rebelde aka RBD. Lenny Kravitz gives Roberta his guitar at the Otro Rollo.

episodes.title: RBD en Otro Rollo
episodes.description: Adal Ramones listens to the band sing and invites them on the show. RBD performs on the Otro Rollo show. Meanwhile, their closest friends prevent others students and their respective parents from watching the show. Gastón and Mia first meet.

episodes.title: El horario de las clases
episodes.description: The new math teacher, Renata, refuses to help the kids with the schoolwork. Roberta and José mix up Hilda's first love and the important guest speaker; they lock Hilda and the speaker in a room together. Lupita tells Nico she has to go back to be with her sister.

episodes.title: Una confusión
episodes.description: The band gets news that the recording label wants them to sing other songs and not their own. Alma goes on live TV to find Marcelino. Gastón has it out for Roberta for the mishap, however, she succeeds in getting Hilda and her first love face to face.

episodes.title: Diego y Roberta, otra vez
episodes.description: Roberta kisses Diego and Paola tells him to quit the band. Nico asks Lupita to not drop out for her future. Marcelino calls Roberta to say goodbye. Celina is put in charge of picking the dance members.

episodes.title: Diego se va de la banda
episodes.description: Mia reflects on her and Miguel's precious moments. Diego decides to leave the band and Roberta is blamed for it. Alma decides to be the dance group's choreographer. Gastón calls Mia out of class, she cries about Miguel and he comforts her.

episodes.title: Cuidemos el bosque
episodes.description: Mia start a campaign/fundraiser to help save the Chapultepec Forest. Teo tells the Lodge that José was the one responsible for the anonymous letters out of fear and spite. Lupita decides to stay in school. Gastón gives Mia a present. Miguel becomes suspicious of Gastón.

episodes.title: Diego quiere a Paola
episodes.description: Diego tells his mom of his love for Paola; she asks to meet her. Gastón overhears José and Vico talking about him; he threatens José. Miguel is allowed access to Franco's files. Roberta tells Facundo not to let Diego into his band. León gets pictures of Paola with Diego.

episodes.title: Enojos
episodes.description: León threatens Paola on the phone and demands to speak to Diego. Mia distracts Gastón so the band won't be seen; he embraces her. Roberta tricks the principal to stop her mother from teaching choreography at the school. Mia gets mad at Miguel for telling the everyone that her and Gastón are dating.

episodes.title: Acusada
episodes.description: León give Paola a few days to leave Diego. Teo is told by the Lodge to steal a teacher's wallet; José is later blamed. Miguel tells Gastón to stay away from Mia and cleverly threatens him. Gastón and Renata conspire against Enrique.

episodes.title: Huída y vida nueva
episodes.description: Roberta helps Diego ditch school. Alma brings Mia from school to be the new main fashion model. José is threatened with expulsion if she doesn't admit to theft. Diego and Paola plan to run away together. Renata confronts Enrique about his past.

episodes.title: ¿Quién robó?
episodes.description: Roberta asks Paola to tell Diego the truth of her relationship with León. Diego leaves with Paola. Franco tries to pay Alma to stay away from Mia. Alma and Roberta cry for their loves. Gastón tells Mia he has a love he can't get out of his head; he embraces her a second time.

episodes.title: Roban a los profesores
episodes.description: Alma reveals to Franco, in a big way, how she spent the his bribe money. Teo steals all the other teachers wallets and puts them in Pascual's desk in order to save José. Roberta gets Mabel to go look for Diego. Galia, Pascual and Pilar's wife and mother respectively, becomes the new English teacher.

episodes.title: La logia está furiosa
episodes.description: The Lodge is upset that they failed in getting José expelled. José meets her tutor face to face. Franco finds out that Mia like a man; not a boy at the school. Mia, in anger, tells her father she's in love with Gastón; however Gastón is not worried. Later, when Mia becomes upset at the sight of Viviana with Miguel, Gastón kisses her.

episodes.title: Modelo de lencería
episodes.description: Gastón kisses Mia for the first time. Franco believes that Alma is cheating on Carlo. Nico tells Teo he might like José more than he knows. Mia tells Gastón she's harassed by Miguel at school. Franco follows the alleged cheater and finds out he's in charge of Mia's model campaign. Raquel and Giovanni begin to date; Tomás and him fight. Teo is saved by a fellow Lodge member. Gastón tells Mia he wants to take care of her for life.

episodes.title: Ojo morado
episodes.description: Teo tells Miguel and Nico that the room guard of the Lodge has a black eye; they look for suspects. Celina becomes depressed because of her break up with Augusto; she binge eats. Roberta and Pepa go to Puebla City. León finds out Diego left school.

episodes.title: ¿Con quién se fugó Diego?
episodes.description: León reveals to Mabel that Paola is a prostitute. Giovanni lies to Raquel about his family, saying they're royalty. José tries to help Celina with the PE test. Mia forgets to do her math homework; Gastón brings it to class completed. Renata makes the students participate in a math competition. Celina gets injured during the test. Mia angers Gastón when she goes to Madariaga for help. León finds Diego with Roberta at the hotel.

episodes.title: En el hospital
episodes.description: Pilar tries to get Lupita and Tomás together for hidden reasons. Paola rejects Diego after seeing León. Miguel, Nico, and Teo plan to follow Tomás and Giovanni to see which is in the Lodge. Giovanni hires a man to pose as his rich father. León tells Diego that Paola is a whore. Nico and Miguel get ambushed by the suspect. Celina is comforted by Miguel on the subject of image.

episodes.title: Padres impostores
episodes.description: Gastón invites Mia out on a date. Giovanni's fake parents aren't what they seem. Vico follows Celina to find out her secret appointment. Carlo tells Roberta he has a surprise for her. Franco and Valeria come to see if Mia lied about staying at school so she could go out with Gastón.

episodes.title: Dominar a las mujeres
episodes.description: Carlo and Roberta go drag racing. Giovanni tries to ride a horse. Vico realizes the place Celina visited. Nico tries to ruin Lupita's date. León has Diego fight his anger out. Raquel finds out Giovanni lied. Diego give Nico his guitar; Nico sees the matching shoes in Diego, Tomás, Giovanni's room. Roberta and Carlo are arrested; revealing Mia's lie.

episodes.title: Hacerse monja
episodes.description: Franco finds out Mía isn't with Carlo and Roberta. Paola begs for Diego's forgiveness. Mía and Gastón go out on a date. Vico calls Celina's mom to stop her from making a life change. Carlo and Roberta go search for Mía. Celina's mom sets her up on a date. Roberta ruins Simón's date.

episodes.title: Ceremonia de iniciación
episodes.description: Nico breaks up with Karen. Gastón tells Mia he wants to speak to her dad. Teo receives a gift. Simon plans to get Roberta back for flattening his tires. Paola lies to Roberta that her and Diego are back together to get revenge. Miguel tells Teo he will take his place at the Lodge initiation.

episodes.title: Auto de regalo
episodes.description: León gives Diego a brand new car; Roberta crashes it. Gastón confronts Mia about her lingering feelings for Miguel. The Lodge figures out Miguel took Teo place; the later kidnap and torture Teo. Miguel and Mia kiss. Nico is told by Karen's father that the band is no longer welcome at his club. Giovanni, Diego, and Tomás put Madariaga's picture on an online dating site.

episodes.title: Téo secuestrado
episodes.description: Nico is upset about Karen's father, Jacobo's, decision about the band. Gastón orders Mia to call her father so they can talk. Teo is tied up by the Lodge and tortured. Diego finds out it was Roberta who crashed his car. Viviana misleads Franco to get Mia in trouble. The other band members try to convince Diego to come back to the band; without him they can't perform at the club. José's tutor comes to take her out but also to tell her to get close to Gastón. Gastón follows Mia and sees the band.

episodes.title: Presentimiento
episodes.description: The band finds out Gastón saw them perform; Miguel blames Mia, the others agree. Giovanni tries to rescue Teo but they are both caught and tortured. Nico tells his mother that he is in love with Lupita, not Karen. It's revealed that Pilar is in the Lodge. Viviana threatens Mia that she will tell Franco; later writes a fake fan letter even after Miguel asked her not to. Nico's mom tells Lupita to break up with Nico if she loves him.

episodes.title: Téo logra escapar
episodes.description: Giovanni climbs through the vents, onto the roof, then falls where he is later found by Tomás and Lupita. Gastón rebuffs Mia. Miguel, Diego, Tomás and Nico try to get Gandia to listen to them about the Lodge. A woman from the online dating site confronts a confused Madariaga. Gastón receives a love note from Mia. Roberta disrespectfully embarrasses Alma in front of Carlo and the others; however she is mistaken. Madariaga and the other boys help save Teo.

episodes.title: Mía furiosa
episodes.description: Gandia and Mendiola want to act like the Lodge doesn't exist. Miguel tries to draw the Lodge out. Franco tells Mia that Valeria will move in. Diego curses Giovanni and calls him a traitor. The kids are lied to about Teo's condition. The Lodge plans revenge on Miguel. Mia decides to play Valeria's game. Giovanni reflects on the good and bad. José makes a deal with Gastón so she can see Teo; she tells his father she's his girlfriend; she reveals her true feelings.

episodes.title: Los nombres de los logios
episodes.description: José kisses Teo after revealing her feelings; though he's unconscious. Giovanni reveal he knows where all the records of the Lodge are kept; him, Miguel, and Diego try to retrieve them but get caught by the Lodge. Gandia finds out Pilar is apart of the Lodge but vows to protect her. Rodrigo sets the basement on fire, trapping the guys. Franco finds out Mia is in the band. Roberta and the others convince Gandia to rescue the guys.

episodes.title: Desaparecen las pruebas
episodes.description: Roberta saves the Lodge files from burning; she gives them to Gandia. Gandia tells Mendiola the Lodge exists and is ordered to get rid of the evidence. Mia tells Miguel what Viviana did. Gandia and Mendiola plan to blame everything on Giovanni. Alma has decided to never bother Roberta again. Miguel confront Viviana about the letter; he breaks up with her. Teo and his father reconnect.

episodes.title: Exigimos justicia
episodes.description: Alma refuses to talk to Roberta. Giovanni is blamed for everything concerning with the Lodge and expelled; the other students demand justice and Roberta threatens to tell all. Gustavo and Marcia, decide it's better for Gustavo to have custody of Teo. Gandia punishes the students for protesting. Franco punishes Mia unjustly. Teo confronts José about saying she was his girlfriend. Rodrigo kidnaps Roberta for her interference; Diego ditches school to go find her.

episodes.title: Intento de violación
episodes.description: Rodrigo tries to attack Roberta but Diego saves her. León demands that all the Lodge members be taken to prison. Carlo finds Alma a performance opportunity in New York. José leaves the hospital after being found out by Teo.

episodes.title: Invitado a ir de vacaciones
episodes.description: As vacation nears, Diego and Tomás forgive Giovanni and invite him to go with them.Giovanni's father tells him not to come home. Miguel is asked by Franco to keep watch over Mia during vacation. Mia, Vico, and Celina plan a vacation. Roberta, Lupita, and José plan a vacation. Mia tells Alma she's dating Gastón. Alma convinces Franco to let Mia stay in the band.

episodes.title: Puedes seguir en la banda
episodes.description: The anonymous gossip column is all about Mia and Gastón. Teo and José are set up by Roberta and Lupita. Giovanni is given his own apartment. Gandia sees the gossip column and gives it to Franco, who flies into a rage. While Franco is threatening Gastón, Miguel jumps in and says he's dating Mia. José refuses to let her feelings for Teo show.

episodes.title: Recuperar lo perdido
