episodes.description: Miguel tells his friends that Gastón kicked José out in the middle of the night. Hilda finds José and takes her home. Madariaga returns to the school. Roberta spends her first night at her father's house.

episodes.title: La historia de Julia
episodes.description: The students complain about Julia to Gandía. Julia tells everyone her boyfriend left her to marry her best friend. Sabrina and Miguel talk about RBD. Sol confesses to Raquel that she will win Gastón over to make him forget Mía. Miguel and Mía tell Roberta that there will be no protest because they have been discovered. Professor Enrique meets Julia.

episodes.title: Sabrina mánager de RBD
episodes.description: Roberta talks to José and tells her that Gastón hates her. Alma donates all of Roberta's clothes to a home.

episodes.title: Gastón y José
episodes.description: Gastón is wanted by the police and believes that José was the one who called them. Mía sets a trap for Sol to stop using her perfume. Téo and Miguel go with the police to Gastón's house. Miguel wants to prevent Gastón from leaving.

episodes.title: A pesar de todo
episodes.description: Gastón is seriously ill in the hospital and receives a visit from Enrique, who takes the opportunity to ask him for a favor. Miguel finds Franco and Alma kissing, but they ask him not to tell Roberta and Mía anything. José is afraid that Gastón will die.

episodes.title: Profunda tristeza
episodes.description: León investigates Diego and realizes that he has been lying to him. Unintentionally, Sol discovers that Franco and Alma are dating. The principal holds a meeting to decide who will occupy Gastón's position.

episodes.title: Permiso materno
episodes.description: Diego decides to leave the group because his father does not accept that he is a singer. Javier wants to replace Diego in RBD. José talks to Lola and tells her that it is painful to be an orphan.

episodes.title: Daría todo por RBD
episodes.description: Professor Enrique talks to Diego and tells him that he will be able to travel to the tour in Los Angeles. León tells Madariaga he'll have him fired for helping Diego. Diego tells León he's willing to live on the street if necessary to stay in RBD. Mía finds out through an anonymous message that her father is dating Alma, she believes it's a lie.

episodes.title: No las dejen ir
episodes.description: Roberta is impressed by how Diego confronts his father. León tries to convince Franco and Alma not to let their daughters go to the concert. Pilar questions Tomás about Celeste. Celeste goes to the Elite to visit Giovanni. Lola's parents tell her the truth about her origin.

episodes.title: Mentiras y verdades
episodes.description: Giovanni confesses to Tomás that he told Agustina about Celeste being his lover. Diego and Giovanni try to get Pilar to forgive Tomás. The band plans their Los Angeles tour and everyone is excited. Mía fights with Miguel at rehearsal because she is jealous of Sabrina. Franco gives Mía permission to go on a trip with Miguel.

episodes.title: Contrato para grabar
episodes.description: Alma asks Franco to tell Mía the truth about Marina. Tomás hits Giovanni. Sabrina shows RBD a contract to make several records. Max tells Celina that he is in love with her. Pilar demands that Giovanni explain about his illness. Celina receives a visit from her mother, who makes her feel bad about her being overweight. León decides to punish Diego for continuing in the band.

episodes.title: Concierto en Los Ángeles
episodes.description: Tomás tells Pilar there's nothing between Celeste and him. RBD's show at Memorial Coliseum is a success. Madariaga gives José a letter from Gastón. Santos sends Lupita a rose with a dedication. RBD returns from tour with a big announcement.

episodes.title: Por amor
episodes.description: Javier tells Roberta what he did that he blamed on Diego, all because he loves her. José's angry at Roberta for reading the letter Gastón left her.

episodes.title: Un gran padre
episodes.description: Roberta hits Mía for saying she was a liar just like her mother. Upset with her dad, Roberta goes to Alma's. Diego finds out about Javier's lies.

episodes.title: Más conciertos
episodes.description: Celina tells Mía that her dad and Alma really are together. Mía asks Alma to stay away from her dad. Miguel confronts Sabrina on her lies about them.

episodes.title: Mala elección de vestido
episodes.description: Celina invites Vico to her sister's wedding, but Damiana kicks them out outraged by Celina's dress, but her boyfriend comforts her and they experience something they haven't done before. Lupita tells Roberta that Santos is with her now. Permissions to record the RBD disc are ready.

episodes.title: Madre soltera
episodes.description: Roberta is very sad because she misses Alma, but she cannot forgive her for so much loneliness that she felt when she was a child. Martín Reverte talks to Roberta to get her to understand that her mom was a single parent and needed to work. Miguel faints when he tries to talk to Mía. Mía confronts Alma and Franco in front of Roberta.

episodes.title: Desmayo
episodes.description: Roberta tells everyone Reverte's her dad. A farewell party is held for Reverte. Miguel faints again, and Dr. López tells Franco he's slipped into a coma. Téo suspects José's with Iñaki.

episodes.title: Alma contra León
episodes.description: Mía tells an unconscious Miguel that she forgives him and that she doesn't want him to die. Alma confronts León for insulting and threatening Roberta. Raquel exposes Sol's lies and tells her that she can never be a top model because of her height.

episodes.title: Papeles comprometedores
episodes.description: Diego tells León he'll leave Roberta and RBD. León influences the school directors to expel Roberta. Mía finds out Miguel was never unfaithful to her.

episodes.title: Documentos robados
episodes.description: Diego asks his dad to help Roberta. Alma threatens León with disclosing documents that can ruin him. León wants Diego to help him get those documents.

episodes.title: Miguel está grave
episodes.description: Madariaga tells the students that Miguel is in critical condition. Reverte tells the members of RBD they must go on with their record. Alma demands León to reinstate Roberta and Professor Reverte to the school in exchange for some papers that compromise him.

episodes.title: Mujeres fuertes
episodes.description: Celina suspects she's pregnant. José reads Gastón's letter and finds out he admired her strength. Miguel opens his eyes, but doesn't recognize Mía. Diego makes it clear to León that he can take care of himself and doesn't need his money.

episodes.title: Amnesia
episodes.description: Damiana causes Max to lose his job. Miguel can only remember Diego. Diego tries to help Miguel to remember. Mía is very upset because Miguel doesn't remember her. Javier tells José that Roberta feels sorry for her because she's an orphan. The students start looking for college.

episodes.title: Celina está embarazada
episodes.description: Celina's pregnancy test comes out positive. Celina tells Sol she doesn't have what it takes to be a model. Sol withholds Max's letter to Celina.

episodes.title: Guardar secretos
episodes.description: Marina tells Alma that it's best if Mía continues to think that she's dead. Roberta asks her classmates to keep Celina's pregnancy a secret.

episodes.title: Que Miguel se recupere
episodes.description: Celina doesn't know what to do with her baby, she feels very lonely because Max left and Professor Madariaga advises her. Sol finds out about the pregnancy, blackmails Celina and her friends. Alma doesn't believe Marina's intentions to stay away from Mía. Madariaga's going to report José missing. RBD will wait for Miguel to recover. Pilar's bikini pictures send Gandía to the hospital.

episodes.title: Te engañé porque te quería
episodes.description: Celina attends her first medical appointment. Marina apologizes to Franco for having abandoned him. León has Diego's work place closed down. Miguel asks Mía to help him remember about his girlfriend, but he thinks his girlfriend is Sabrina. Franco confesses to Mía that her mother's not dead.

episodes.title: Negocios sucios
episodes.description: Mía tells her dad she hates him for lying to her and that she regrets that her mom didn't take her. Téo and Roberta find José at the Casa Hogar. Javier is accused of stealing thongs and panties from Elite Way students.

episodes.title: Mía busca a su mamá
episodes.description: Mía wants to find her mother, but Franco tells her she's disappeared again. Miguel asks Diego and Roberta if Mía was his girlfriend. Gandía confesses the truth to Madariaga about León's threats to get him to agree to enter his business.

episodes.title: Golpe publicitario
episodes.description: Mía places an ad in the newspaper to locate her mom; Pascual refuses to defy León so as not to lose his job; León orders Diego to be kidnapped to use him as a publicity coup for his campaign; Mía and Marina meet.

episodes.title: Mía va a vivir con su mamá
episodes.description: Marina explains to Mía why she left. Gandía refuses to quit. Alma's afraid that Franco and Marina might reconcile. Mía plans to go live with her mom. Roberta accepts León's blackmail and breaks up with Diego.

episodes.title: Boda y bebé
episodes.description: Franco agrees to Mía going with her mother. Damiana learns that her daughter is pregnant and she demands a abortion. Celina tells her mom that she is going to marry Max. Alma's jealous of Marina.

episodes.title: Patria potestad y adopción
episodes.description: Roberta asks Mía to support Miguel in his recovery. Franco tells Marina that he knows about her addiction. Alma and Franco plan to adopt José. Giovanni pretends to be gay to deceive Javier's father. Roberta accepts Colucci as her mother's partner. Miguel seeks to talk to Mía to reconcile.

episodes.title: Declaraciones de amor
episodes.description: León's arrested. Celina has her dad's support. Mía begs Miguel not to go to Monterrey because she loves him, and Diego tells Roberta he loves her. Mía forgives her dad. Marina promises Mía to overcome her addictions.

episodes.title: Sé rebelde
episodes.description: Franco and Alma get married, José thanks them for accepting her into their family. Diego and Roberta reconcile. Miguel asks Mía to marry him. Pascual closes the course. Roberta tells everyone that RBD will continue.

title: Elite
description: When three working class kids enroll in the most exclusive school in Spain, the clash between the wealthy and the poor students leads to tragedy.

episodes.title: Welcome
episodes.description: After a public high school collapses, the builder tries to repair its image by paying for three impacted students to attend an exclusive private school.

episodes.title: Desire
episodes.description: A school project brings Marina and Samuel closer, and inspires Guzmán to try and win over Nadia. Meanwhile, Christian is shocked by a revelation.

episodes.title: Saturday Night
episodes.description: Samuel throws a party, where Nano makes a move on Marina and spiked punch affects more than one couple. Nadia is hurt by what she learns about Guzmán.

episodes.title: Love Is a Drug
episodes.description: Guzmán tries to earn Nadia's forgiveness. Polo and Christian bond at a gala. Lu bribes her teacher. To pay his debt, Nano must complete a dark mission.

episodes.title: Everyone Lies
episodes.description: Marina gives Nano a way to pay his debt. Lu intentionally leaks a secret in front of Nadia. Omar learns Ander told his friends about the two of them.

episodes.title: Everything Will Be Okay
episodes.description: Nano learns one watch holds a secret. Marina's pot stash is found. News of a pregnancy raises suspicions. Christian is offered fame if he does a favor.

episodes.title: Everything Explodes
episodes.description: Carla suspects Marina is involved in the theft. Omar's father makes plans for his son. After learning his sister’s secret, Guzmán seeks revenge.

episodes.title: Assilah
episodes.description: The last moments before the murder unfold. Christian makes a tough decision. The police arrest a suspect. Guzmán becomes reckless with grief.

episodes.title: 20 hours missing
episodes.description: New students start school at Las Encinas as Guzmán continues to mourn his sister and Christian struggles with his secret. A classmate goes missing.

episodes.title: 34 hours missing
episodes.description: Seeking the truth about Marina's death, Samuel attempts to seduce Carla. Lu's new friend, social media guru Cayetana, hosts an impromptu party.

episodes.title: 36 hours missing
episodes.description: Polo and Ander have a heart-to-heart. Nadia gets creative to stop Guzmán from drinking too much and doing drugs. Rebeka's mother offers Samuel a job.

episodes.title: 59 hours missing
episodes.description: Pressured by his friends, Polo's guilt overwhelms him. Cayetana's mother threatens to reveal her secret. Ander and Guzmán argue with their partners.

episodes.title: 63 hours missing
episodes.description: Rebeka teases Cayetana with what she's learned. The Halloween party takes a troubling turn. Samuel walks in on a shocking scene.

episodes.title: 66 hours missing
episodes.description: Lu blackmails Nadia, and Samuel confronts Carla with his suspicions. In the future, Guzmán is interrogated about the missing student.

episodes.title: 84 hours missing
episodes.description: Lu uncovers a secret while helping Cayetana with her fundraiser party. Omar worries about Samuel's fate. Ander's behavior confuses Guzmán.

episodes.title: 0 hours missing
episodes.description: Painful truths and dark secrets are exposed as the students unburden themselves and the circumstances behind Samuel's disappearance are revealed.

episodes.title: Carla
episodes.description: Carla is interrogated when a student is killed at a party. In the past, she faces Polo in court, Ander has a health worry, and Nadia meets a new suitor.

episodes.title: Samuel and Guzmán
episodes.description: Guzmán attempts to make amends. Nadia threatens payback when she and Lu go after the same scholarship. Ander comes clean to his loved ones.

episodes.title: Cayetana and Valerio
episodes.description: Polo is harassed at school. Samuel mulls the police's offer as he and Rebeca become closer. Ander struggles with his treatment.

episodes.title: Lu
episodes.description: Guzmán confronts Nadia's father. New romances transpire when Lu throws a creative Valentine's Day party. Rebeka struggles with a moneymaking decision.

episodes.title: Ander
episodes.description: Rebeka tries to identify the traitor. A blackout party at the club leads to multiple shocking revelations.

episodes.title: Rebeka
episodes.description: The Columbia scholarship winner is announced. Nadia makes a momentous decision. Samuel's concern about Carla causes issues between him and Valerio.

episodes.title: Nadia and Omar
episodes.description: As graduation day arrives, the futures of multiple students remain uncertain. Polo begs his mothers to reconsider their recent decision.

episodes.title: Polo
episodes.description: The events that transpired the night of the murder unfold. The police interview several eyewitnesses who are ready to point fingers.

episodes.title: The New Order
episodes.description: A stern principal and three new students begin at Las Encinas. Omar and Samuel must prove themselves academically while their friends try to help.

episodes.title: Five Seconds
episodes.description: Prince Phillipe's arrival at the school prompts strict security measures and controversy. Samuel and Omar's towel party leads to new romantic hookups.

episodes.title: When Lies Dance with Temptation
episodes.description: When Prince Phillippe hosts his famous Le Bal party, betrayals ensue. The jealousy between Guzmán and Samuel intensifies. Patrick sparks friction.

episodes.title: I'm a...
episodes.description: Rebe is confused and hurt by Mencía's mysterious behavior. Much to Ari's chagrin, Benjamín suggests Samuel join the debate team.

episodes.title: Reintegration
episodes.description: Ari and Samuel face off in an important and public debate. After speaking with Ander, Omar struggles with the emotional fallout.

episodes.title: I Love You All Wrong
episodes.description: Phillippe worries that his friends are using him for Ambar Lucid performance tickets. Rebe warns Mencía she feels skeptical about Armando's assistance.

episodes.title: Before I Go (1)
episodes.description: Samuel tells Ari to make her choice while Guzmán plans a romantic date. Cayetana is stunned by a realization. Mencía is backed into a corner.

episodes.title: Before I Go (2)
episodes.description: The details of Ari's attack are revealed but the Las Encinas students prove yet again there is always more than meets the eye.

episodes.title: I Killed Him
episodes.description: A new student catches Patrick's eye while another surprises Cayetana by defending Phillipe. Benjamín implements stricter measures at school.

episodes.title: Anything Goes
episodes.description: Patrick lashes out at his dad by hosting a hedonistic party for everyone at the school. Samuel struggles with keeping both Ari and Benjamín happy.

episodes.title: Tie Me Up
episodes.description: Tensions grow between Omar and Samuel as the students vote for someone to be expelled. Isadora tries to persuade Phillipe that she knows what's best.

episodes.title: The Body
episodes.description: While helping her father with an auction, Mencía makes a shocking discovery. Outside of the event, Omar is surprised by what he finds in the water.

episodes.title: Please, Tell the Truth
episodes.description: The police investigation forces Benjamín into the spotlight. Patrick finds himself in a tough spot with Iván and Cruz. Caye reconnects with a friend.

episodes.title: Can't Buy My Love
episodes.description: The students auction off dates to raise money for Samuel's bail, but the results of the bidding cause more than one broken heart.

episodes.title: Toxic
episodes.description: Samuel, Rebe and Cayetana look for evidence that could implicate Benjamín. Heartbroken over Phillipe's harsh words, Isadora embarks on a trip to Ibiza.

episodes.title: Your Side of the World and Mine
episodes.description: Samu considers his next move with the SIM card, Cruz gives Iván relationship advice, and Caye tries to support a traumatized Isadora.

title: WandaVision
description: Wanda Maximoff and Vision—two super-powered beings living idealized suburban lives—begin to suspect that everything is not as it seems.

episodes.title: Filmed Before a Live Studio Audience
episodes.description: Wanda and Vision struggle to conceal their powers during dinner with Vision’s boss and his wife.

episodes.title: Don't Touch That Dial
episodes.description: In an effort to fit in, Wanda and Vision perform a magic act in their community talent show.

episodes.title: Now in Color
episodes.description: Wanda's pregnancy fritzes her powers as she and Vision prepare for an accelerated delivery.

episodes.title: We Interrupt This Program
episodes.description: Monica Rambeau, tasked with a special assignment regarding sentient weapons, goes missing.

episodes.title: On a Very Special Episode...
episodes.description: Wanda addresses Vision's worries when he grows suspicious of the neighbors' strange behavior.

episodes.title: All-New Halloween Spooktacular!
episodes.description: Disturbances on Halloween separate Wanda from Vision, who looks into anomalous activity in Westview.

episodes.title: Breaking the Fourth Wall
episodes.description: Monica plots her return to the anomaly while Wanda navigates a slew of unsettling complications, and Vision forms a new alliance to help.

episodes.title: Previously On
episodes.description: Wanda embarks on a troubling journey revisiting her past for insight into her present and future.

episodes.title: The Series Finale
episodes.description: The events of WandaVision come to a head, and the destinies of all who took part are determined.

title: The Last Kingdom
description: A show of heroic deeds and epic battles with a thematic depth that embraces politics, religion, warfare, courage, love, loyalty and our universal search for identity. Combining real historical figures and events with fictional characters, it is the story of how a people combined their strength under one of the most iconic kings of history in order to reclaim their land for themselves and build a place they call home.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Abducted by a Viking warlord after his father is slain in battle, young Uhtred adopts the Norse way of life until tragedy befalls his new family.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Caught between his scheming uncle Ælfric and pitiless Viking warlord Ubba, Uhtred goes on the run and seeks out Alfred, the man who would be king.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Uhtred allies himself with newly crowned Alfred, but his commitment to the nascent king jeopardizes his bond with Brida.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: King Alfred keeps Uhtred close with a tactical play, but Uhtred soon realizes he's been tricked. Meanwhile, a great battle looms over Wessex.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Uhtred volunteers to attack Danish ships, but challenges Ubba in the process as the Danes threaten Wessex.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Uhtred leads a raiding party to Cornwall on a mission for wealth and independence and attracts the attention of a beautiful sorceress queen.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: As a consequence of their actions in Cornwall, Uhtred and Leofric face off in a death match. The Danes launch an invasion of Wessex.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: A united King Alfred and Uhtred leave the cover of the marshes and make a rallying call to all Saxon armies.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Sent North by Alfred to ransom enslaved King Guthred, Beocca seeks help from Uhtred, who makes a new allegiance in his quest for vengeance.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: The stratagems of Abbot Eadred play on Guthred's weakness. Uhtred rallies the men of Cumbraland to march on Eoferwic, but faces a cruel betrayal.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Hild and Ragnar hunt for Uhtred, who lays plans for escape. Alfred eyes the kingdom of Mercia, and chaos erupts when Guthred's alliance crumbles.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Dispatched to Northumbria, Uhtred walks a fine line between fealty to Alfred and assisting Ragnar's savage blood feud with Kjartan.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: After a season of peace, Uhtred receives a mystical call to follow his fate. Erik makes a cunning request, and Beocca navigates matters of the heart.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: As his distrust of Uhtred deepens, Alfred sends Æthelred to drive Erik and Sigefrid from London, but the young lord harbors ambitions of his own.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Æthelred faces humiliation after his blunder in London backs Alfred into a corner. Her loyalties shifting, Æthelflæd makes a dire appeal to Uhtred.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Odda defies Alfred to coerce the king into war. Uhtred conspires with Erik to rescue Æthelflæd, forcing a fateful confrontation with Sigefrid.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: His health failing and fearing for his legacy, Alfred sends Uhtred to confront a new threat: fierce Danish warrior Bloodhair and his sorceress, Skade.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Falling afoul of Alfred, Uhtred flees north to his brother, Ragnar. His eye on the throne, Aethelwold begins assembling an alliance to strike Wessex.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Bloodhair and Aethelwold try to coax Uhtred into their alliance against Alfred. Fearing for her life, Aethelflaed turns to Father Beocca for aid.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Uhtred turns his attention to Aethelflaed's plight. Alfred forces Edward to face his duty. Ragnar's army marches but traitors emerge from within.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: A deadly betrayal threatens to splinter Ragnar's army. Uhtred forms a cunning battle plan and finds an unexpected ally in young Edward.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Edward makes a kingly decision. Alfred lays plans for his son's future reign. Aethelwold faces a treacherous task. Uhtred and Brida search out a seer.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: A message from Uhtred and the machinations of Skade exploit divisions among the Danes. His health failing, Alfred wrestles with Aethelwold's fate.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Uhtred risks returning to Wessex to fulfill his vow to Brida. As the royal wedding approaches, Aethelwold spreads discord from the shadows.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: At the end of his days, Alfred takes Uhtred into his confidence about his plans for Edward's uncertain future, but Aelswith charts a different course.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: As a climactic battle with the Danes draws near, untested Edward faces dire decisions about the fates of Uhtred, Wessex -- and England.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Uhtred receives news that Bebbanburg's defenses have been weakened by Scottish attacks and plans to seize his birthright, but Edward refuses to help.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: As Uhtred and his men draw closer to Bebbanburg, prodigal son Wihtgar returns with some tricks up his sleeve. News of Cnut's treachery reaches Wessex.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Uhtred suffers an unbearable loss in his attack on Bebbanburg but takes some valuable captives during his retreat south. Aethelflaed prepares for war.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Hoping to be joined by Edward's troops, Aethelflaed and Uhtred ally with the Welsh to face Cnut's thousand-warrior army at the Battle of Tettenhall.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: A repentant Aethelred lingers near death while his ealdormen vie for control of Mercia and Edward uses his niece Aelfwynn as a bargaining chip.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Eardwulf and his men pursue Uhtred's party as it flees through a countryside ravaged by disease. Tensions rise between Edward and the Mercians.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Aelfwynn suffers from the sickness sweeping the land. Edward proposes an unexpected path forward for Mercia. Brida is freed by Cnut's kinsman.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Uhtred reluctantly prepares to take power in Mercia but secretly formulates an alternate plan. Brida joins the Danes in attacking the Welsh.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: The Danes under Brida and Sigtryggr sack Winchester, guided by the traitor Eardwulf. Haesten ambushes Uhtred's party and seizes valuable captives.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: Edward besieges Winchester as he awaits Aethelflaed's reinforcements, but Uhtred isn't convinced that conquest is really Sigtryggr's ultimate aim.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Ill omens and border raids make Uhtred extra-vigilant at his northern outpost. King Sigtryggr is visited by his notorious brother Rognvaldr.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: A betrayal at Eoferwic sends Sigtryggr in search of aid, while Uhtred begs Aethelflaed for military support she cannot give. Edward meets a new ally.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: In the aftermath of the tragic battle for Eoferwic, Sigtryggr is forced to make a painful choice. Edward learns of Aethelhelm's intrigues in Mercia.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Rivals secretly advance competing successors upon the death of a Mercian ruler. Brida finds solace in the faith of her prisoner, Father Pyrlig.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Aethelhelm's subterfuge successfully foments war tensions between Edward and Sigtryggr, but his thugs make a crucial mistake in attacking a pilgrimage.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: The forces of Edward and Sigtryggr march toward battle as Uhtred races to reveal the truth of Aethelhelm's scheming and avert a ruinous war.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Edward offers a role to Stiorra that would restore her to power. Aethelhelm meets with a Saxon enemy. Uhtred has a long-overdue reckoning with Brida.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Upon learning of Aethelhelm's location, Uhtred proposes an audacious attack to rescue Aelfwynn and restore his birthright — but Edward is cautious.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Edward marches his troops north while Uhtred recruits a small force to infiltrate Bebbanburg. King Constantin arrives to meet his new bride, Aelfwynn.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: Armies converge in an epic, final showdown that determines the fate of a king's dream for England — and Uhtred's hope of securing his family's future.

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
description: In a war-torn world of elemental magic, a young boy reawakens to undertake a dangerous mystic quest to fulfill his destiny as the Avatar, and bring peace to the world.

episodes.title: The Boy in the Iceberg
episodes.description: Two teenage siblings (Sokka and Katara) living in the South Pole discover a very strange boy (Aang), along with his pet flying bison Appa, in an iceberg. But can they trust him when he accidentally draws the war to their village's doorstep?

episodes.title: The Avatar Returns
episodes.description: Katara and Sokka discover that Aang is the long-lost Avatar and must rescue him when a firebending prince named Zuko kidnaps him.

episodes.title: The Southern Air Temple
episodes.description: Aang is excited about going home for the first time in one hundred years, but he is shocked to find out that the temple is deserted. Aang tells Sokka and Katara about his childhood as they explore the temple, but they soon discover something that Aang never expected. Meanwhile, Zuko must make repairs to his ship and the only way he can do it is to dock his ship at his rival's naval base.

episodes.title: The Warriors of Kyoshi
episodes.description: The gang arrives at Kyoshi Island and are captured by some Kyoshi warriors. When Aang reveals that he is the avatar, news quickly spreads out, eventually reaching Zuko, who then goes to Kyoshi Island to capture him.

episodes.title: The King of Omashu
episodes.description: Aang's abilities as an airbender are challenged by a strange king.

episodes.title: Imprisoned
episodes.description: In a nearby Earth Village, the gang meets a teenage earthbender named Haru. This village lives in fear of the Fire Nation, for soldiers there capture any earthbenders they can find. After Haru is captured for earthbending, Katara is compelled to rescue him.

episodes.title: The Spirit World: Winter Solstice (1)
episodes.description: Aang and friends visit a village being terrorized by an angry spirit. Iroh is captured by Earth Kingdom soldiers.

episodes.title: Avatar Roku: Winter Solstice (2)
episodes.description: To contact the spirit of the previous Avatar, Aang must reach a temple in the Fire Nation before the sun sets on the following day. There he will learn what he must do to restore balance to the world. Zuko must defy his banishment to follow Aang.

episodes.title: The Waterbending Scroll
episodes.description: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, but realizes that he is learning it much faster than she is, she is desperate to improve her abilities.  When Katara inadvertently stumbles across a waterbending scroll that can help improve her abilities at a pirate’s store, she decides to steal it, realizing that she couldn’t hope to afford it.

episodes.title: Jet
episodes.description: While traveling towards the North Pole, the group almost gets captured by the Fire Nation.  However, when a charismatic young man and his band of rebels attack the Fire Nation camp and rescue them, they learn that they are trying to resist the Fire Nation’s motives to expand their territory.  Katara and Aang really enjoy their time with the band of rebels, but Sokka soon discovers that they aren’t as noble as meets the eye.

episodes.title: The Great Divide
episodes.description: While on their way to the North Pole, Aang and his friends arrive at a giant canyon where two groups of refugees are bickering over who should get to go across.  Aang decides to walk across with the two groups to ensure they don’t fight one another.  However, he soon learns that the two tribes have been feuding for one hundred years and they both believe their actions are justified.  But when the predators inside the canyon start to come out, Aang is stuck trying to defend both tribes from each other and the vicious wildlife.

episodes.title: The Storm
episodes.description: Sokka accepts a job for a fisherman who is looking for someone to help him out with his fishing. After the fisherman finds out Aang is the Avatar, Aang runs away in response to the fisherman's hostile reaction. When Katara finds Aang, he begins to reveal his life before he was frozen in the iceberg. Meanwhile, after Zuko gets into a fight with his crew, Iroh tells them about Zuko's complicated past, attempting to make both sides understand each other.

episodes.title: The Blue Spirit
episodes.description: While Aang, Katara and Sokka are traveling, Sokka gets a fever. Katara and Aang try to help Sokka, when Katara also catches the fever. It's up to Aang to go up on his own to save his two friends. But before he can get the medicine he is captured by the newly promoted Admiral Zhao and put in Zhao's fortress.

episodes.title: The Fortuneteller
episodes.description: When the group tries to help a man who is being attacked by a platypus-bear, they discover that the local town has a fortuneteller named Aunt Wu in it, who has been forecasting the town's fate for years. But when Sokka and Aang discover one of the fortuneteller's most vital predictions is dead wrong, they have to develop a plan to convince the stubborn townspeople that their beloved Aunt Wu was wrong.

episodes.title: Bato of the Water Tribe
episodes.description: Aang feels neglected as Katara and Sokka reunite with Bato, an old friend of their father’s from the South Pole. They begin to reminisce on their times in the past while they wait for a message to arrive from their father. Aang believes Katara and Sokka will abandon him and go out to find their father should the message arrive. However, when the messenger gives Aang the message to give to Bato, Aang betrays his friends in a way Katara or Sokka could never imagine. However, when Zuko recruits a bounty hunter named June to track Aang down, his friendship is put to the test as he must deal with the fact that he betrayed his friends while defending himself from yet another fight.

episodes.title: The Deserter
episodes.description: Aang and his friends go to a Fire Nation town so that Aang can witness some firebending, but their plan soon goes awry when it’s discovered that he is the Avatar. Fortunately, he's rescued by an individual who serves a firebending master named Jeong Jeong who has abandoned the Fire Nation, so Aang decides to use this time to attempt to learn firebending. The firebending master, however, seems reluctant to teach Aang.

episodes.title: The Northern Air Temple
episodes.description: When Aang and his friends hear rumors about surviving airbenders, they decide to stop by the Northern Air Temple on their way to the North Pole to see for themselves. What they find is a bunch of people who are not airbenders, but have mastered the art of gliding; though this upsets Aang because they have been defacing the temple. However, there was one part of the temple where nobody has been able to enter, and what Aang and his friends discover inside spells oncoming conflict.

episodes.title: The Waterbending Master
episodes.description: When Aang tries to find the north pole, he is found by the north pole instead. As they are taken there, Aang and Katara are eager to find a waterbending master, only to discover that girls are not allowed to learn waterbending.

episodes.title: The Siege of the North (1)
episodes.description: Zhao begins to launch his attack against the Northern Water Tribe. As the walls of the prestiged city begin to fall, the Avatar taps into the spirit world and seeks the help of one of the oldest spirits, in hopes of saving one of the most prominent areas of the world.

episodes.title: The Siege of the North (2)
episodes.description: Aang returns from the spirit world to a big surprise. Meanwhile, Zhao and his forces continue to press deeper into the Northern Water Tribe. Iroh makes a powerful stand and Zuko struggles to keep his plan intact.

episodes.title: The Avatar State
episodes.description: Plagued with nightmares featuring the devastating power of his Avatar State, Aang and the gang meet an Earth Kingdom general who has big plans for defeating the Fire Nation. Meanwhile, Zuko and Iroh, having survived the failed attack on the North Water Tribe, have a surprise visit from Zuko's sister with seemingly good news.

episodes.title: The Cave of Two Lovers
episodes.description: On their way to Omashu, Aang, Katara, and Sokka meet a group of nomads who show them a shortcut through the "Cave of Two Lovers". But when the group becomes trapped in the cave, it's up to Aang and Katara to save the group by trusting in love, possibly questioning their relationship. Meanwhile, Iroh gets a lethal rash so Zuko and Iroh head to a small Earth Kingdom town for help, hoping their real identities will not be discovered.

episodes.title: Return to Omashu
episodes.description: Despite the shocking news the gang have just discovered, Aang insists on trying to find Bumi within Omashu's borders, even with the dangers that will await him and his friends if his real identity is discovered.  Meanwhile Azula goes in search of old friends to help her with her mission.

episodes.title: The Swamp
episodes.description: A mysterious tornado pulls the kids into a supernatural swamp where Katara, Sokka and Aang have mysterious visions. Meanwhile, Momo and Appa are chased by rogue swamp dwellers and only Aang and the gang can save them.

episodes.title: Avatar Day
episodes.description: Aang and the gang discover an Earth town that celebrates something called "Avatar Day." But when they get there and learn the festival is of "anti-Avatar" sentiment and Aang is put on trial for a crime a past incarnation allegedly committed. Looking to clear the Avatar's good name, Katara and Sokka venture back to a familiar  place to gather evidence and discover the truth.

episodes.title: The Blind Bandit
episodes.description: In search for an earthbending teacher for Aang, the kids go to an underground earthbending tournament called Earth Rumble 6, where they encounter Toph, a blind but powerful earthbending girl. After seeing her unique style of earthbending, Aang wants Toph to become his teacher, but there are complications with Toph's family.

episodes.title: Zuko Alone
episodes.description: Zuko travels by himself to an Earth Kingdom town where he meets a local boy. The two almost become friends, while Zuko suffers from flashbacks of his past.

episodes.title: The Chase
episodes.description: Tired from trying to escape a machine that shows up every time they try to sleep, Aang and the gang have to escape Azula and her team, but their exhaustion leads to a tight situation. Meanwhile, Zuko must deal with something personal, and Iroh bonds with an unlikely individual.

episodes.title: Bitter Work
episodes.description: Toph's instructing abilities come into question when Aang cannot seem to overcome a block that keeps him from earthbending. Sokka gets himself in a jam, while befriending what was, moments before, his next meal, and Iroh and Zuko begin training utilizing new philosophies and methods that originate from the other elements.

episodes.title: The Library
episodes.description: When Aang and his friends find a professor who knows of a library that contains information about the world, Sokka decides to go there to hopefully find some information to use against the Fire Nation. The library is guarded by the knowledge spirit, Wan Shi Tong, who unfortunately doesn't welcome humans into his library, because he believes they only seek information for evil purposes.

episodes.title: The Desert
episodes.description: Aang searches for Appa while Katara struggles to keep everyone together to survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Iroh and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.

episodes.title: The Serpent's Pass
episodes.description: When Aang and the gang meet up with a group of refugees, they tell the gang where they can get on a ferry to Ba Sing Se. But after a series of events they have to take a deadly route called the serpent's pass with the help of an old friend, Suki. Meanwhile, Zuko and Iroh meet up with a boy named Jet and his freedom fighters.

episodes.title: The Drill
episodes.description: Having made it to the outer wall of Ba Sing Se, the kids confront a Fire Nation army that is driving a massive Fire Nation drill, which poses an imminent threat to the last Earth Kingdom stronghold. Meanwhile, Zuko and Iroh make crucial mistakes which begin to attract Jet's suspicions.

episodes.title: City of Walls and Secrets
episodes.description: Having finally made it into Ba Sing Se, the kids are given a house in the upper ring. The kids are anxious to tell the Earth King their plan but there are complications. Meanwhile, still convinced that Iroh and Zuko may be Fire Nation, Jet decides to take matters into his own hands and do whatever it takes to get the refugees to reveal their true nature.

episodes.title: The Tales of Ba Sing Se
episodes.description: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city. Tales of Katara and Toph, Iroh, Sokka, Aang, Zuko, and Momo.

episodes.title: Appa's Lost Days
episodes.description: Appa's journey from being abducted in the desert to the present is explored.

episodes.title: Lake Laogai
episodes.description: Aang and his friends continue to search for Appa and, unbeknownst to them, they aren't the only ones looking for him. During their search, the kids meet up with Jet, whom they are understandably reluctant to trust. The kids soon realize that the Dai Li are doing their best to thwart the kids' efforts to find Appa. Meanwhile, Iroh is offered his own tea shop in the upper ring, and Zuko discovers the avatar is in the city.

episodes.title: The Earth King
episodes.description: The kids battle Long Feng and the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city. Zuko becomes seriously ill and has feverish dreams as he faces a spiritual crisis.

episodes.title: The Guru
episodes.description: Aang travels to the Eastern Air temple to receive guidance from Guru Pathik while Sokka is reunited with his long-lost father. Meanwhile, Azula has something diabolical in store for her enemies in the Earth Kingdom, including Zuko and Iroh.

episodes.title: The Crossroads of Destiny
episodes.description: Everyone races against time to stop Azula's sinister plan. Zuko finds companionship in an unlikely source. Aang's destiny hangs in the balance—and so does Zuko's, as Iroh tells him it's time to make a choice.

episodes.title: The Awakening
episodes.description: After sustaining serious injuries at the end of season two, Aang awakens to find himself aboard a Fire Nation ship. Meanwhile, Zuko journeys home.

episodes.title: The Headband
episodes.description: To better camouflage themselves as real Fire Nation citizens, the kids check out a Fire Nation school. Avatar dance special. Also, Zuko confronts Uncle.

episodes.title: The Painted Lady
episodes.description: When the gang arrives at a suffering fishing village, a mysterious spirit appears to help the villagers.

episodes.title: Sokka's Master
episodes.description: When Sokka feels he's not contributing enough to the group, he seeks out a mysterious master to teach him the ways of the sword.

episodes.title: The Beach
episodes.description: Zuko, Azula, Mai, and Ty Lee go on vacation at Lo and Li's beach house, where they learn a lot about themselves and each other. Meanwhile, the kids face a new enemy.

episodes.title: The Avatar and the Firelord
episodes.description:
The Avatar and The Firelord

The world's power was split between the Earth, Fire, Water and Air nations. Only Aang could save it.

episodes.title: The Runaway
episodes.description: When Toph discovers a quick way to make cash, Katara disapproves, and the rift between them has disastrous consequences.

episodes.title: The Puppetmaster
episodes.description: The kids investigate mysterious disappearances in a spooky town. Katara makes a special connection.

episodes.title: Nightmares and Daydreams
episodes.description:
Nightmares and Daydreams

On the eve of the eclipse, Aang's anxiety gets the better of him. His dreams become nightmares, and soon he can no longer tell dream from reality.

episodes.title: The Day of Black Sun: The Invasion (1)
episodes.description: The day of the eclipse has arrived, and the invasion force gathers together to make last preparations. They infiltrate the island and the battle begins. Meanwhile, Aang searches for the Fire Lord.

episodes.title: The Day of Black Sun: The Eclipse (2)
episodes.description: As the invasion force fights their way to the Fire Nation capital, the kids help Aang find the Fire Lord in time for the eclipse. Zuko confronts his father with shocking news.

episodes.title: The Western Air Temple
episodes.description: Aang and the group arrive at the Western Air Temple, with Zuko in pursuit. Zuko wishes to help the Avatar end the war by teaching him firebending.

episodes.title: The Firebending Masters
episodes.description: While teaching Aang firebending, Zuko realizes that he has lost all his firebending skills. To regain his powers, Zuko and Aang must seek the original source of firebending within the ruins of a lost civilization.

episodes.title: The Boiling Rock (1)
episodes.description: Sokka wants to break his father out of jail and asks Zuko for information on Fire Nation prisons. Sokka and Zuko head for the Boiling Rock, a prison located in the middle of a volcano, to rescue Sokka's father.

episodes.title: The Boiling Rock (2)
episodes.description: Zuko and Sokka make new plans to break out of the prison with Suki, Sokka's father and some others while a shocking twist leaves Azula none too happy with her two closest friends.

episodes.title: The Southern Raiders
episodes.description: Katara decides to confront the Fire Nation soldier responsible for her mother's death. Aang tries to talk her out of it, but she doesn't listen.

episodes.title: The Ember Island Players
episodes.description: A play recounting the gang's adventures does not sit well with Aang and his friends, except for Toph who enjoys it very much. Meanwhile, Aang confesses his love to Katara, but the response is ambiguous.

episodes.title: Sozin's Comet: The Phoenix King (1)
episodes.description: Aang struggles to decide whether or not he has to kill the Fire Lord and, during the night, is drawn toward an island which disappears before morning. Zuko leads the rest of the group to the Earth Kingdom to meet a tracker whom they hope can find Aang. The Fire Lord crowns himself Phoenix King and Aang awakens on the island not knowing where he is.

episodes.title: Sozin's Comet: The Old Masters (2)
episodes.description: While on the island, Aang seeks guidance from his past lives, but is not pleased with what he is told. The island, in fact, turns out to be a lion turtle from which Aang is given the guidance he had been seeking. Meanwhile, after the tracker is unable to track Aang, the rest of the group decide they must find Iroh. While tracking him down, the group meets up with The Order of the White Lotus, a group that transcends the division of the four nations.

episodes.title: Sozin's Comet: Into the Inferno (3)
episodes.description: Sokka, Suki, and Toph try to stop the Fire Nation's air fleet. Meanwhile, Zuko and Azula duel in an Agni Kai and Aang confronts the Fire Lord.

episodes.title: Sozin's Comet: Avatar Aang (4)
episodes.description: Aang is on the offensive after getting hit in the back of his scar and triggering the Avatar State. Meanwhile, after Zuko seems to have the upper hand against Azula, Katara is forced to join the fight when Azula resorts to desperate measures.

title: Ozark
description: A financial adviser drags his family from Chicago to the Missouri Ozarks, where he must launder $500 million in five years to appease a drug boss.

episodes.title: Sugarwood
episodes.description: After his business partner cheats a dangerous client, financial adviser Marty must devise a radical plan to save the lives of himself and his family.

episodes.title: Blue Cat
episodes.description: In the Ozarks, Marty struggles to find a local business he can use for money laundering, while his kids make new friends but neglect a crucial duty.

episodes.title: My Dripping Sleep
episodes.description: Marty finds a way to control Ruth. Wendy worms her way into a job. Looking for another business to invest in, Marty digs for info on the strip bar.

episodes.title: Tonight We Improvise
episodes.description: Marty hires Ruth to pull off a heist. Agent Petty forges a relationship with a member of the Langmore family. Jonah exhibits disturbing behavior.

episodes.title: Ruling Days
episodes.description: Marty decides to invest in the religious sector, unaware he will disrupt a discreet business operation. A surprise visitor shows up at the Byrde home.

episodes.title: Book of Ruth
episodes.description: Jacob educates Marty on his business. Ruth devises and sets in motion a deadly plan. Rachel learns Marty is cooking the books at the Blue Cat Lodge.

episodes.title: Nest Box
episodes.description: To stop Jacob from carrying out his threat, Marty makes an offer. Agent Petty gets what he needs to turn Russ. Charlotte grows desperate to escape.

episodes.title: Kaleidoscope
episodes.description: In a flashback to 10 years prior, Wendy struggles with depression, Del asks Marty to be his financial adviser, and Agent Petty faces a family crisis.

episodes.title: Coffee, Black
episodes.description: Russ learns Agent Petty's true identity and makes plans to murder, steal and flee. Wendy stumbles on an ideal business to add to the Byrde portfolio.

episodes.title: The Toll
episodes.description: During his next sermon, Mason falters. Wendy and the kids are caught trying to flee their home. Marty brokers a deal between Jacob and Del.

episodes.title: Reparations
episodes.description: Ruth's dad gets out of jail. Approval for a riverboat casino calls for Wendy's political skills. The Mexican cartel demands reparations from the Snells.

episodes.title: The Precious Blood of Jesus
episodes.description: When a mobster jeopardizes the casino bill, Marty enlists Buddy's help. Wendy resorts to dirty tactics to get votes. Cade reminds Ruth of her roots.

episodes.title: Once a Langmore...
episodes.description: Wendy does damage control when Wilkes's pressure on Sen. Blake backfires. Rachel is sent on a mission. Ruth resists accepting her Langmore destiny.

episodes.title: Stag
episodes.description: The FBI sends out a second lure. Charlotte slips up while chatting with Wyatt. The Byrdes grow wary of Rachel, who deflects suspicion onto someone else.

episodes.title: Game Day
episodes.description: Agent Petty's revelation tests the loyalties of Marty, Ruth and the cartel. Despite the FBI closing in, the Snells refuse to destroy their poppies.

episodes.title: Outer Darkness
episodes.description: An FBI search of the Snells' field yields a surprise. Playing hardball, Agent Petty questions Wilkes. The Byrdes mourn a loss.

episodes.title: One Way Out
episodes.description: Mason goes off the deep end and focuses his rage on the Byrdes. Ruth tries to make her dad proud during a boat-part heist.

episodes.title: The Big Sleep
episodes.description: Darlene makes one too many rash moves. Marty tries to free Rachel from Agent Petty's grasp. Jonah helps his mom force Wilkes to continue his support.

episodes.title: The Badger
episodes.description: Marty finds a way around the Snells. Charlotte hires a lawyer. The Byrdes get a meeting with the gaming commission, whose approval comes with a big ask.

episodes.title: The Gold Coast
episodes.description: Marty makes plans without telling Wendy. Darlene sends a message via Jonah. Wyatt learns the truth about his dad. Ruth realizes Cade must be stopped.

episodes.title: Wartime
episodes.description: Marty is pressured to move money ahead of schedule, Wendy pitches a high-stakes plan, Wyatt lives the good life, and Ruth butts heads in the casino.

episodes.title: Civil Union
episodes.description: Wendy asks Helen - not Marty - to help close a deal, the Byrdes get a new houseguest, and business goes boom aboard a rival casino.

episodes.title: Kevin Cronin Was Here
episodes.description: The FBI dives into the casino's finances, Wendy's dreams take a dark turn, and Marty worries that the writing may be on the wall.

episodes.title: Boss Fight
episodes.description: As Wendy, Helen and Ruth strive to keep the business humming, Navarro plays mind games with Marty, who worries he'll never see his family again.

episodes.title: It Came from Michoacán
episodes.description: Maya steps up her bid to turn Marty, whose eerily calm demeanor has Wendy worried. The Byrdes buy a horse farm on behalf of Navarro.

episodes.title: Su Casa Es Mi Casa
episodes.description: Marty and Wendy tell each other how they really feel, Ruth confronts Wyatt, Darlene lets her ambitions be known, and Ben's past comes into focus.

episodes.title: In Case of Emergency
episodes.description: The FBI questions Ruth, tensions between Cosgrove and Marty hit a new high, Sue takes on a new patient, and Wendy recruits for her foundation.

episodes.title: BFF
episodes.description: Ruth isn't happy about Marty and Wendy's plan to bury the hatchet with Frank Jr. The Byrdes make a difficult decision about Ben. Maya is reprimanded.

episodes.title: Fire Pink
episodes.description: Ben's confrontation with Helen and Erin sends the Byrdes into crisis mode. Meanwhile, Sam's concerns about the FBI inspire little sympathy.

episodes.title: All In
episodes.description: While Wendy battles personal demons, Marty struggles to keep their lives from falling apart. Darlene does Ruth a favor.

episodes.title: The Beginning of the End
episodes.description: Marty and Wendy wrestle with a problematic offer. Ruth goes out on her own, Jonah rebels, and Omar's nephew makes his presence known.

episodes.title: Let the Great World Spin
episodes.description: Maya pushes back on Marty's plan for Omar. Ruth pursues the hipster heroin market. Wendy tries to raise $150 million. The new sheriff causes problems.

episodes.title: City on the Make
episodes.description: Maya and Omar meet face-to-face. Wendy has a contentious business meeting. Ruth goes behind Darlene's back. Jonah finds a new place to set up shop.

episodes.title: Ace Deuce
episodes.description: Wendy's claims about Ben anger Ruth. Mel the P.I. tracks down Wendy's father. Ruth's trip to the Missouri Belle with Kerry doesn't go as planned.

episodes.title: Ellie
episodes.description: The Senator extends an olive branch — with a twist. Ruth and Marty scramble to rebuy the drugs Darlene sold. Charlotte ponders life after high school.

episodes.title: Sangre Sobre Todo
episodes.description: Marty is tasked with proving Omar wasn't involved with a bombing. Wendy pays a visit to the Lazy-O Motel. Ruth and Wyatt make a plan.

episodes.title: Sanctified
episodes.description: The FBI's long-awaited meeting with Omar takes place. Wyatt shares some news with Ruth. Feeling betrayed, Javi gets aggressive.

episodes.title: The Cousin of Death
episodes.description: Devastated by a tremendous loss, Ruth heads to Chicago to enact revenge as Marty tries to talk her out of doing something she may regret.

episodes.title: Pick a God and Pray
episodes.description: Their deal with the FBI now dead, the Byrdes desperately search for more solutions to their growing problems. Wendy’s father comes to town.

episodes.title: You're the Boss
episodes.description: Marty travels to the Navarro estate, Ruth asks Frank Jr. for a favor, a new acting sheriff makes waves, and Wendy tries to bring Jim back into the fold.

episodes.title: Pound of Flesh and Still Kickin'
episodes.description: Ruth makes a play for the casino with some help from a familiar face. Wendy cozies up to Omar's sister and arranges a meeting with Clare.

episodes.title: Trouble the Water
episodes.description: Nathan angers Wendy by making Charlotte and Jonah a surprising offer. Ruth tries to erase her own past with an assist from Charles Wilkes.

episodes.title: Mud
episodes.description: Omar pressures Marty to launder more money, but Ruth wants to keep her casino clean. Wendy goes to extremes to keep her children.

episodes.title: A Hard Way to Go
episodes.description: Every desperate deal. Every broken promise. Every bloody murder. Eager to leave their murky past behind, the Byrdes make a final bid for freedom.

title: Chucky
description: After a vintage Chucky doll turns up at a suburban yard sale, an idyllic American town is thrown into chaos as a series of horrifying murders begin to expose the town’s hypocrisies and secrets. Meanwhile, the arrival of enemies — and allies — from Chucky’s past threatens to expose the truth behind the killings, as well as the demon doll’s untold origins.

episodes.title: Death by Misadventure
episodes.description: When teen Jake Wheeler buys a vintage doll at a yard sale, his young life changes forever.

episodes.title: Give Me Something Good to Eat
episodes.description: Chucky targets one of Jake's frenemies, forcing Jake to either stop the killer doll – or help him.

episodes.title: I Like to Be Hugged
episodes.description: Chucky reminisces about his first murder, urging Jake to make a choice -- kill or be killed.

episodes.title: Just Let Go
episodes.description: Jake's bond with Devon intensifies as he teams up with an unlikely ally to outwit Chucky.

episodes.title: Little Little Lies
episodes.description: Jake and Devon are ready to take their relationship to the next level—but after another gruesome murder at Chucky's far-from-idle hands, who has time for romance? Meanwhile, enemies—and allies—from Chucky's past show up to complicate matters.

episodes.title: Cape Queer
episodes.description: As the body count in Hackensack continues to rise, Lexy and Junior's relationship becomes strained, while Jake and his friends set a risky trap for Chucky that could have dire consequences if it backfires.

episodes.title: Twice the Grieving, Double the Loss
episodes.description: As Hackensack reels from Chucky's relentless—but secret—reign of terror, the Mayor tries to allay fears by cluelessly arresting an innocent suspect. Meanwhile, the kids desperately try to figure out Chucky's mysterious endgame — before it's too late.

episodes.title: An Affair to Dismember
episodes.description: Scores old and new will be settled, and sparks will fly,as Chucky's diabolical plan comes to fruition at a particularly dangerous—and public—venue.

episodes.title: Halloween II
episodes.description: A year after seemingly defeating their nemesis Chucky, “3 Amigos" Jake, Devon, and Lexy begin receiving mysterious, threatening calls from an all-too-familiar-sounding enemy.

episodes.title: The Sinners Are Much More Fun
episodes.description: Our 3 Amigos struggle with the strict rules and institutionalized homophobia of their new Catholic reform school, especially when Chucky arrives with a murderous agenda. Meanwhile, in Beverly Hills, a suspicious detective threatens Tiffany’s imposture as “Jennifer Tilly” and the discovery of her secret hostage, Nica Pierce.

episodes.title: Hail, Mary!
episodes.description: With Jake and Devon’s relationship already under strain, the reveal that multiple killer dolls exist causes Jake to propose the unthinkable: brainwash the captured Chucky and turn him into an ally.

episodes.title: Death on Denial
episodes.description: In this “very special episode of Chucky,” Tiffany’s secrets are threatened by the return from college of her 18-year-old kids Glen and Glenda, and by a surprise intervention conducted by several of Jennifer Tilly’s loved ones, who are concerned about their old friend’s odd behavior.

episodes.title: Doll on Doll
episodes.description: Devon worries that Good Chucky can't be trusted; Tiffany spirals from the surprise party.

episodes.title: He Is Risen Indeed
episodes.description: Incarnate Lord goes on lockdown with the Chucky dolls inside; Nica moves forward with her plan.

episodes.title: Goin' to the Chapel
episodes.description: Ade due Damballa! The survivors band together with Father Bryce to perform an exorcism.

episodes.title: Chucky Actually
episodes.description: Back in Hackensack for the holidays, the 3 Amigos receive a special gift. Tiffany plots her escape.

episodes.title: Murder at 1600
episodes.description: No child is left behind when Chucky manages to insinuate himself into the White House and find a new "friend 'til the end" in the President's lonely young son, Henry. Meanwhile, Jake and Devon help Lexy for her missing sister Caroline.

episodes.title: Let the Right One In
episodes.description: Jake, Devon and Lexy hatch a plan to take down Chucky by befriending the President's teenage son.

episodes.title: Jennifer's Body
episodes.description: Chucky's complex motivations are revealed. Tiffany is tried for Jennifer Tilly's murder spree.

episodes.title: Dressed to Kill
episodes.description: Jake, Devon, and Lexy infiltrate a Halloween ball to stop Chucky... but the demon doll has other plans.

episodes.title: Death Becomes Her
episodes.description: Chucky wrestles with his mortality, while Jake and Devon take their romance to the next level.

episodes.title: Panic Room
episodes.description: Armed with new weapons, Chucky aims to become the most prolific serial killer in history.

episodes.title: There Will Be Blood
episodes.description: Parapsychologists investigate the disturbances in the White House, while Tiffany plans her escape.

episodes.title: Final Destination
episodes.description: Jake faces his demons and a new type of evil in the quest to find Caroline.

title: Love, Death & Robots
description: Terrifying creatures, wicked surprises and dark comedy converge in this NSFW anthology of animated stories presented by Tim Miller and David Fincher.

episodes.title: SONNIE'S EDGE
episodes.description: In the underground world of "beastie" fights, Sonnie is unbeatable -- as long as she keeps her edge.

episodes.title: THREE ROBOTS
episodes.description: Long after the fall of humanity, three robots embark on a sightseeing tour of a post-apocalyptic city.

episodes.title: THE WITNESS
episodes.description: After seeing a brutal murder, a woman flees from the killer through the streets of a surreal city.

episodes.title: SUITS
episodes.description: A community of farmers use their homemade mechs to defend their families from an alien invasion.

episodes.title: SUCKER OF SOULS
episodes.description: Unleashed by an archaeological dig, a bloodthirsty demon battles a team of mercenaries armed with... cats?

episodes.title: WHEN THE YOGURT TOOK OVER
episodes.description: After scientists accidentally breed super-intelligent yogurt, it soon hungers for world domination.

episodes.title: BEYOND THE AQUILA RIFT
episodes.description: Awakening after traveling light years off course, a ship's crew struggles to discover just how far they've come.

episodes.title: GOOD HUNTING
episodes.description: The son of a spirit hunter forges a bond with a shape-shifting huli jing.

episodes.title: THE DUMP
episodes.description: Ugly Dave calls the garbage dump home, and he's not about to let some city slicker take it away from him.

episodes.title: SHAPE-SHIFTERS
episodes.description: Deep in Afghanistan, two Marines with supernatural powers face a threat from one of their own kind.

episodes.title: HELPING HAND
episodes.description: Stranded in orbit, an astronaut must choose between life and limb before her oxygen runs out.

episodes.title: FISH NIGHT
episodes.description: After their car breaks down in the desert, two salesmen take a dreamlike voyage to the dawn of time.

episodes.title: LUCKY 13
episodes.description: After the drop-ship Lucky 13 lost two crews, no pilot would fly her... but rookies don't get a choice.

episodes.title: ZIMA BLUE
episodes.description: The renowned artist Zima recounts his mysterious past and rise to fame before unveiling his final work.

episodes.title: BLINDSPOT
episodes.description: A gang of cyborg thieves stage a high-speed heist of a heavily armored convoy.

episodes.title: ICE AGE
episodes.description: A young couple moves into an apartment and finds a lost civilization inside their antique freezer.

episodes.title: ALTERNATE HISTORIES
episodes.description: Want to see Hitler die in a variety of comically fantastic ways? Now you can. Welcome to Multiversity!

episodes.title: THE SECRET WAR
episodes.description: Elite units of the Red Army fight an unholy evil deep in the ancient forests of Siberia.

episodes.title: Automated Customer Service
episodes.description: If your home-cleaning unit is attempting to murder you, please press 3.

episodes.title: Ice
episodes.description: Two brothers far from home join genetically "modded" locals in a deadly race.

episodes.title: Pop Squad
episodes.description: A cop charged with fighting the scourge of overpopulation is haunted by the human toll of his work.

episodes.title: Snow in the Desert
episodes.description: Every bounty hunter in the galaxy wants a piece of Snow.

episodes.title: The Tall Grass
episodes.description: During a journey across the prairie, a man becomes transfixed by distant, ghostly lights.

episodes.title: All Through the House
episodes.description: On Christmas Eve, two kids tiptoe downstairs to catch a glimpse of Santa. A twisted tale for adults only.

episodes.title: Life Hutch
episodes.description: After crash-landing on a craggy planet, a pilot makes his way to shelter, only to face a threat within.

episodes.title: The Drowned Giant
episodes.description: The body of a colossal young man washes ashore and becomes an object of fascination for the locals.

episodes.title: Three Robots: Exit Strategies
episodes.description: Three robots walk into the post-apocalypse… and take a whirlwind tour of humankind's last attempts to save itself.

episodes.title: Bad Travelling
episodes.description: Release the Thanapod! A ship’s crew member sailing an alien ocean strikes a deal with a ravenous monster of the deep.

episodes.title: The Very Pulse of the Machine
episodes.description: When an exploratory mission to a Jovian moon ends in disaster, the lone survivor must begin a perilous but mind-expanding journey.

episodes.title: Night of the Mini Dead
episodes.description: A bit of unholy cemetery sex ends badly, kicking off a worldwide zombie plague. It’s the cutest apocalypse you’ll ever see.

episodes.title: Kill Team Kill
episodes.description: US Special Forces are trained to neutralize any threat — even a cybernetic killing machine created by the CIA. Their secret weapon? A sense of humor.

episodes.title: Swarm
episodes.description: Two human scientists study the secrets of an ancient alien entity — but soon learn the horrible price of survival in a hostile universe.

episodes.title: Mason's Rats
episodes.description: Welcome to the Ratpocalypse! Farmer Mason knows he has a real pest problem when they start shooting back. Bloody hell!

episodes.title: In Vaulted Halls Entombed
episodes.description: Modern warfare meets elder gods. A special forces squad on a hostage rescue mission finds themselves trapped in a prison containing an age-old evil.

episodes.title: Jibaro
episodes.description: A deaf knight and a siren of myth become entwined in a deadly dance. A fatal attraction infused with blood, death and treasure.

episodes.title: Can't Stop
episodes.description: Turn up your stereo and tune into a Red Hot Chili Peppers concert that's unlike any other — with a few strings attached.

episodes.title: Close Encounters of the Mini Kind
episodes.description: They came in peace. But when their first encounter with Earthlings goes awry, these extra-tiny extraterrestrials are ready for vengeance.

episodes.title: Spider Rose
episodes.description: At the edge of the galaxy, a grieving woman dreams of revenge. Can an adorable newcomer help her destroy her enemies — without destroying her humanity?

episodes.title: 400 Boys
episodes.description: Are they gods? Are they giants? All this band of survivors knows is that they're deadly — and they'll have to set aside their own turf war to stop them.

episodes.title: The Other Large Thing
episodes.description: This furry revolutionary has plans for world domination. All he needs is a henchman with opposable thumbs.

episodes.title: Golgotha
episodes.description: A mysterious race of aquatic aliens has arrived on Earth. They don't want to be taken to our leaders.

episodes.title: The Screaming of the Tyrannosaur
episodes.description: In an orbital arena, gladiators and dinosaurs compete in a deadly race — and face a terrifying new opponent.

episodes.title: How Zeke Got Religion
episodes.description: On a perilous mission into hostile territory, the crew of a World War II bomber encounters an unholy enemy.

episodes.title: Smart Appliances, Stupid Owners
episodes.description: From thermostats to toothbrushes to toilets, these ultra-modern appliances have something to say about their hapless owners.

episodes.title: For He Can Creep
episodes.description: London, 1757. Satan battles a cat for the soul of a poet whose verse could give him dominion over the earth.

title: Shōgun
description: In Japan in the year 1600, at the dawn of a century-defining civil war, Lord Yoshii Toranaga is fighting for his life as his enemies on the Council of Regents unite against him, when a mysterious European ship is found marooned in a nearby fishing village.

episodes.title: Anjin
episodes.description: Destinies converge in Japan after a barbarian ship washes ashore in a poor fishing village. Meanwhile, in Osaka, Lord Toranaga finds himself outplayed by his enemies.

episodes.title: Servants of Two Masters
episodes.description: Blackthorne's arrival in Osaka stirs up a hornet's nest of rivalries. Mariko is trapped between her cause and her faith when she must translate for the barbarian in Lord Toranaga's custody.

episodes.title: Tomorrow Is Tomorrow
episodes.description: After Blackthorne survives a brazen assassination attempt, Toranaga realizes he must ferry his allies out of Osaka or risk certain defeat.

episodes.title: The Eightfold Fence
episodes.description: Blackthorne and Mariko test their new alliance as they train Toranaga's gun regiment for war. Yabushige must navigate his past promises to Ishido when an old friend comes to the village.

episodes.title: Broken to the Fist
episodes.description: Blackthorne and Mariko struggle to contain the secret that could get them both killed. Yabushige searches for the spy who has betrayed his intentions to Lord Toranaga.

episodes.title: Ladies of the Willow World
episodes.description: Lady Ochiba returns to Osaka in order to accelerate the Regents' campaign against Toranaga. In Ajiro, Toranaga tests Mariko's loyalty to his cause.

episodes.title: A Stick of Time
episodes.description: Outplayed by new alliances in Osaka, Toranaga is forced to carve out a new deal with a long lost family member.

episodes.title: The Abyss of Life
episodes.description: Toranaga's defeated clan moves to Edo and awaits their fate. Blackthorne must decide who he fights for - the lord who has turned his back on him, or the ambition that brought him to Japan in the first place.

episodes.title: Crimson Sky
episodes.description: Mariko arrives in Osaka for the fight of her life. Blackthorne and Yabushige scramble to save their own heads as their options dwindle.

episodes.title: A Dream of a Dream
episodes.description: In the wake of a tragic death, Blackthorne finally considers the true nature of Toranaga's plan.

title: Peacemaker
description: The continuing story of Peacemaker, a vainglorious superhero/supervillain who believes in peace at any cost — no matter how many people he has to kill. After a miraculous recovery from his duel with Bloodsport, Peacemaker soon discovers that his freedom comes at a price.

episodes.title: A Whole New Whirled
episodes.description: After making a miraculous recovery, Peacemaker returns home–only to discover that his freedom comes at a price.

episodes.title: Best Friends, For Never
episodes.description: After Peacemaker’s hazardous escape, tension and mistrust build within the team. Later, as Peacemaker grapples with his new assignment, he receives a surprise visitor.

episodes.title: Better Goff Dead
episodes.description: On their first official mission to assassinate suspected “butterflies,” Economos and Murn bond, and Peacemaker and Harcourt reach an understanding. But the whole job goes sideways with the arrival of Judomaster.

episodes.title: The Choad Less Traveled
episodes.description: Following a somewhat successful mission, Murn recruits Vigilante. Meanwhile, after learning that the team helped land his father in prison, Peacemaker confronts his complicated past.

episodes.title: Monkey Dory
episodes.description: The team scouts the apparent hub for the aliens’ food supply, only to come face-to-face with a full-fledged invasion. Meanwhile, Auggie’s attempt to sell out his son to the police is complicated by Murn’s mysterious contact.

episodes.title: Murn After Reading
episodes.description: Murn reveals his deepest secret. Auggie is set free. The botched arrest of Peacemaker sends alien Goff into an unexpected new host.

episodes.title: Stop Dragon My Heart Around
episodes.description: Harcourt, Murn, and Adebayo find themselves surrounded by an alien force, while Peacemaker squares off against his father with help from Vigilante and Economos.

episodes.title: It's Cow or Never
episodes.description: With Peacemaker and Adebayo at odds, can the team kill the cow once and for all – or will their fracture give the aliens the opening they need to complete its teleportation?

episodes.title: The Ties That Grind
episodes.description: While Peacemaker attempts to join the Justice Gang, Harcourt struggles to find work, and Economos takes on a challenging new assignment.

episodes.title: A Man Is Only As Good As His Bird
episodes.description: As Economos clashes with his new handler, Peacemaker must deal with the consequences of his actions in the alternate dimension.

episodes.title: Another Rick Up My Sleeve
episodes.description: Economos pays for the team's bungled mission, while Peacemaker explores the depths of his relationship with Harcourt in the other dimension.

episodes.title: Need I Say Door
episodes.description: As A.R.G.U.S. ramps up efforts to find the QUC, Harcourt receives a tempting offer from Flag – which comes at a steep cost to Peacemaker.

episodes.title: Back to the Suture
episodes.description: After a catastrophic showdown with Flag, Peacemaker makes a shocking decision, while his friends scramble to keep the 11th Street Kids together.

episodes.title: Ignorance Is Chris
episodes.description: As the 11th Street Kids fight to bring their missing member home, Flag doubles down on his efforts to hold Peacemaker accountable.

episodes.title: Like a Keith in the Night
episodes.description: As Flag and A.R.G.U.S. close in, the 11th Street Kids attempt to keep the ever-increasing dangers of the alternate world around them at bay.

episodes.title: Full Nelson
episodes.description: As Flag puts everyone around him in increasing danger, the 11th Street Kids must convince Peacemaker that he's one of them.

title: One-Punch Man
description: Saitama is a hero who only became a hero for fun. After three years of “special” training, though, he’s become so strong that he’s practically invincible. In fact, he’s too strong—even his mightiest opponents are taken out with a single punch, and it turns out that being devastatingly powerful is actually kind of a bore. With his passion for being a hero lost along with his hair, yet still faced with new enemies every day, how much longer can he keep it going?

episodes.title: The Strongest Man
episodes.description: Saitama is a guy who’s a hero for fun. After saving a child from certain death, he decided to become a hero and trained hard for three years. Though he’s now so strong he can defeat any opponent with a single punch, lately he feels as if, in exchange for overwhelming power, he’s lost something even more important.

episodes.title: The Lone Cyborg
episodes.description: A monster is moving toward City Z, one that has been  created by the mysterious organization known as The House of Evolution.  Genos, a young cyborg, attempts to stop it, but gets in over his head  before Saitama happens along.

episodes.title: The Obsessive Scientist
episodes.description: Saitama and Genos glean information about The House of  Evolution and its founder Dr. Genus, a scientist with dangerous ideas on  artificial human evolution. Meanwhile, Dr. Genus learns of Saitama’s  amazing strength and has plans of his own for One-Punch Man.

episodes.title: The Modern Ninja
episodes.description: A group of battlesuit-clad terrorists called “The Paradisers” appears in City F, led by an enormous man known as Hammerhead. Calling for the redistribution of wealth, the group targets the fat-cat Zeniru, who in turn dispatches his bodyguard to defeat them. Unfortunately, Saitama is on the same errand.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Master
episodes.description: Though he’s been doing the hero gig for three years,  Saitama realizes that the public knows nothing about him. Determined to  get a little recognition, he decides to become a pro hero, but first he  must pass the Hero Association tests and become a full-fledged member.

episodes.title: The Terrifying City
episodes.description: It’s been five days since Saitama became a professional  hero and he has yet to do anything heroic. When Genos informs him that  C-class heroes who don’t fight bad guys are dropped from the hero  registry after a week of inaction, Saitama heads out on patrol, yet  can’t find any criminals or monsters to stop.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Disciple
episodes.description: An enormous meteor hurtles toward City Z, forcing the Hero Association to ask its S Class heroes to respond. When all their efforts prove in vain, Genos decides it’s up to him to protect the home of his master and stop the meteor, no matter what the cost.

episodes.title: The Deep Sea King
