episodes.description: A pack of monsters calling themselves the “Clan of the  Seafolk” arrive on the shores of City J intent on invading the land.  When the hero sent to fight them is defeated easily by the Deep Sea King  himself, Saitama and Genos head for the city to help.

episodes.title: Unyielding Justice
episodes.description: As the battle with the Deep Sea King reaches its climax,  more heroes fall to the aquatic despot’s brutal attacks. Which of them  has what it takes to be a true hero?

episodes.title: Unparalleled Peril
episodes.description: Saitama tags along to an emergency meeting of Class S  heroes and discovers that a seer has foretold a serious danger  threatening the Earth. Though the crisis could occur anytime in the next  six months, the heroes are surprised to hear the roar of explosions  that very hour!

episodes.title: The Dominator of the Universe
episodes.description: As a colossal spaceship floats in the skies above City A, a member of its monstrous crew battles on the ground against a group of S Class heroes. Despite their powers, they can’t seem to finish it off. Meanwhile, Saitama has boarded the enemy ship on his own.

episodes.title: The Strongest Hero
episodes.description: The inconceivably powerful Lord Boros has traveled untold distances in search of someone who can cure his boredom: Saitama! With the fate of humanity in the balance, will the two champions at last find in each other the worthy opponent they’ve been searching for?

episodes.title: Return of the Hero
episodes.description: Saitama is out shopping with Genos in tow when the pair come across G4, a demonic robot on a mission to eliminate King. Elsewhere, Sitch attempts to recruit various cutthroats, villains and assassins of the underworld to help the Hero Association.

episodes.title: Human Monster
episodes.description: Garou issues a declaration of war on the Hero Association through terrifying means, Hellish Blizzard gives Saitama an ultimatum, and Genos decides to eliminate his master's stalker, Speed-o'-Sound Sonic.

episodes.title: The Hunt Begins
episodes.description: Garou, out hunting heroes, can barely contain his excitement when he gets the chance to battle the S Class hero Tank-top Master. Meanwhile, Silverfang shutters his dojo to begin his own hunt of his former disciple.

episodes.title: Metal Bat
episodes.description: Assigned to guard a VIP and his son, Metal Bat couldn't be less thrilled. But when the group is suddenly attacked all hell breaks loose. Meanwhile, Saitama has disguised himself as Charanko in order to enter the “Super Fight” martial arts tournament.

episodes.title: Martial Arts Tournament
episodes.description: Monsters from the Monster Association launch simultaneous attacks on all the human cities, attempting to overwhelm the forces of the Hero Association. Meanwhile, the “Super Fight” martial arts tournament kicks off.

episodes.title: The Uprising of the Monsters
episodes.description: The Super Fight tournament kicks off while Genos takes on multiple monsters who have appeared in City C. Elsewhere, countless monsters are wreaking havoc in multiple areas, but the Hero Association is being overwhelmed by the sheer number of threats.

episodes.title: Class S Heroes
episodes.description: As the Super Fight tournament heads for its grand finale, the Class S heroes battle to hold back the tide of monster incursions. Meanwhile, Atomic Samurai is setting in motion a plan of his own.

episodes.title: The Strong Ones Fight Back
episodes.description: Goketsu, the first Super Fight Tournament champion, arrives in the stadium. Having now become a monster, he’s aiming to force the Super Fight competitors to turn into monsters themselves. When several do, it’s up to Suiryu to take them on alone.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Dilemma
episodes.description: Just as Suiryu finds himself in the depths of despair, Saitama suddenly appears to help him out. But despite all Saitama’s strength, there’s still something bugging the hero that he just can’t seem to shake.

episodes.title: The Encircling Net of Justice
episodes.description: The Monster Association issues a challenge to the Hero Association, telling them they have only three days to rescue the hostage Waganma. Elsewhere, Garou tries to recover from his constant fighting, but things don’t quite go as planned.

episodes.title: Everyone's Dignity
episodes.description: Garou is at last surrounded by multiple heroes and forced to fight, even though he’s covered in wounds and nearly at his limit. The hero hunter still has his incredible ability to read opponents’ fighting styles, but there are surprises in store for all.

episodes.title: Cleaning Up the Disciple's Mess
episodes.description: Silverfang and Bomb catch up with Garou while the hero hunter is battling Genos, starting a whirlwind battle that draws in more and more combatants as it marches towards its hair-raising climax!

episodes.title: Strategy Meeting
episodes.description: The heroes plan a rescue of a child kidnapped by monsters, while Garou awakens deep underground.

episodes.title: Monster Traits
episodes.description: On his way to hunt heroes, Garou dines and dashes at a restaurant, but is chased by Saitama.

episodes.title: Organism Limits
episodes.description: Garou fights Insect God and King the Ripper, while Tareo gets kidnapped. Dr. Kuseno visits Saitama.

episodes.title: Counterattack Signal
episodes.description: The heroes prepare for battle without Silverfang and Genos. Garou attacks the Monster Association.

episodes.title: Monster King
episodes.description: Garou rescues Tareo but is struck by Overgrown Pochi, falling to Orochi and Gyoro-Gyoro.

episodes.title: Motley Heroes
episodes.description: Class-S heroes plan the Monster Association assault, but Amai Mask arrives and clashes with them.

episodes.title: Counterstrike
episodes.description: Heroes arrive in Z City but face a monster ambush. A-class aids while Gyoro-Gyoro watches the fight.

episodes.title: Ninja Tale
episodes.description: Tempest Wind and Hellfire Flame, who were ninjas but are now monsters, battle with Flashy Flash.

episodes.title: Brave Child
episodes.description: Child Emperor finds Waganma and faces Phoenix Man, using his ultimate weapon to protect him.

episodes.title: Immortal Bloodbath
episodes.description: Zombieman faces Vampire, a descendant of a supernatural bloodline, in a brutal, deadly showdown.

episodes.title: Top Dragons
episodes.description: Child Emperor rescues Waganma. The heroes take on threat-level Dragon monsters in a deadly fight.

episodes.title: Ultimate Lifeform
episodes.description: The heroes battle monsters while Terrible Tornado faces Gyoro-Gyoro. Orochi appears before Saitama.

title: Dark
description: A missing child sets four families on a frantic hunt for answers as they unearth a mind-bending mystery that spans three generations.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.description: In 2019, a local boy's disappearance stokes fear in the residents of Winden, a small German town with a strange and tragic history.

episodes.title: Lies
episodes.description: When a grim discovery leaves the police baffled, Ulrich seeks a search warrant for the power plant. A mysterious stranger checks into the hotel.

episodes.title: Past and Present
episodes.description: It's 1986, and Ulrich's brother, Mads, has been missing for a month. Confusion reigns as past and present intertwine.

episodes.title: Double Lives
episodes.description: Bizarre occurrences give Charlotte a sense of déjà vu, and she suspects Peter is hiding something. Franziska snaps when Magnus confronts her.

episodes.title: Truths
episodes.description: Hannah takes her obsession with Ulrich too far. The stranger asks Regina to deliver an important package. Martha is torn between Jonas and Bartosz.

episodes.title: Sic Mundus Creatus Est
episodes.description: Ulrich looks to the past for answers and dredges up disturbing family secrets. Armed with new tools, Jonas probes the cave's murky depths.

episodes.title: Crossroads
episodes.description: Ulrich questions a frail and frightened Helge in the nursing home. Jonas searches for Mikkel, but the stranger warns him about meddling with the past.

episodes.title: As You Sow, So You Shall Reap
episodes.description: In 1953, the disfigured bodies of two boys are exhumed at a construction site, the future location of Winden's nuclear power plant.

episodes.title: Everything Is Now
episodes.description: Ulrich runs afoul of the law, Helge tries to dodge Egon Tiedemann, Claudia harnesses the cave's powers, and Katharina lashes out at Hannah.

episodes.title: Alpha and Omega
episodes.description: Peter gets a shock. Jonas learns the truth about his family, but there are more surprises still to come. Helge makes a sacrifice.

episodes.title: Beginnings and Endings
episodes.description: Six months after the disappearances, the police form a task force. In 2052, Jonas learns that most of Winden perished in an apocalyptic event.

episodes.title: Dark Matter
episodes.description: Clausen and Charlotte interview Regina. The Stranger takes Hannah to 1987, where Claudia has an unnerving encounter and Egon visits an old nemesis.

episodes.title: Ghosts
episodes.description: In 1954, a missing Helge returns, but he'll only speak to Noah. In 1987, Claudia brings the time machine to Tannhaus, and Egon questions Ulrich again.

episodes.title: The Travelers
episodes.description: Jonas meets an ominous figure. While the kids comb the cave for answers, the adults gather in the bunker to share what they know about the travelers.

episodes.title: Lost and Found
episodes.description: In 1987, Ulrich seizes an opportunity. The kids return to the cave with the time machine, and Jonas learns of a loophole that could change the future.

episodes.title: An Endless Cycle
episodes.description: Armed with a plan to prevent the apocalypse, Jonas travels to 2019. During the Nielsens' anniversary party, Ulrich sneaks off with Hannah.

episodes.title: The White Devil
episodes.description: Martha meets the Stranger and learns his true identity. Claudia tries to prevent Egon's death in 1987. Hannah travels to 1954 to see Ulrich.

episodes.title: Endings and Beginnings
episodes.description: On the day of the apocalypse, Clausen executes a search warrant at the power plant as Jonas and Claudia use the time machine to connect past and future.

episodes.title: Deja-vu
episodes.description: In 2019, Jonas emerges from the cave into a strange but familiar world: the town of Winden, reeling from the recent disappearance of a young boy.

episodes.title: The Survivors
episodes.description: Martha travels to 1888 to warn her friends about the 2020 disaster. Winden residents past and present search for their missing loved ones.

episodes.title: Adam and Eva
episodes.description: Charlotte and Ulrich try to piece together what happened in the bunker. In different times and worlds, Jonas and Martha work to gain each other's trust.

episodes.title: The Origin
episodes.description: Martha and Jonas travel to 2052 and get a glimpse of a grim future. In 1954, two residents of Winden go missing, and Hannah receives surprising news.

episodes.title: Life and Death
episodes.description: In 2020, a visitor delivers a warning to Claudia. The day before the apocalypse, Jonas begins to question Eva's motives.

episodes.title: Light and Shadow
episodes.description: Adam holds Martha captive. On the day of the apocalypse, an increasingly frantic Martha begs Bartosz for his help.

episodes.title: Between the Time
episodes.description: Across three centuries, Winden's residents continue their desperate quest to alter their fate and save their loved ones.

episodes.title: The Paradise
episodes.description: Claudia reveals to Adam how everything is connected — and how he can destroy the knot.

title: Over the Garden Wall
description: Two brothers, Wirt and Greg, find themselves lost in the Unknown; a strange forest adrift in time. With the help of a wise old Woodsman and a foul-tempered bluebird named Beatrice, Wirt and Greg must travel across this strange land, in hope of finding their way home. Join them as they encounter surprises and obstacles on their journey through the wood.

episodes.title: The Old Grist Mill
episodes.description: Lost in the mysterious woods of the Unknown, two brothers named Wirt and Gregory run into a jaded old woodsman who warns them to beware the terrifying Beast that roams the dark forest.

episodes.title: Hard Times at the Huskin' Bee
episodes.description: A bluebird named Beatrice offers to guide Wirt and Greg to Adelaide of the Pasture (the good woman of the woods) and help them get home.

episodes.title: Schooltown Follies
episodes.description: Wirt, Greg, and Beatrice get all mixed up in the musical antics of a schoolhouse of animals, a lovelorn teacher, a grouchy old benefactor, and an escaped gorilla.

episodes.title: Songs of the Dark Lantern
episodes.description: Beatrice is left out in the rain with a brainless horse while Wirt and Greg must ask for directions in a lively colonial tavern called "The Dark Lantern" where some surprising secrets are revealed about the Unknown.

episodes.title: Mad Love
episodes.description: Is millionaire Quincy Endicott's sprawling mansion haunted by a beautiful ghost, or is the tea baron going mad? Greg and Fred the Horse are on the case! Meanwhile, Wirt and Beatrice get trapped in an armoire while searching for loose change.

episodes.title: Lullaby in Frogland
episodes.description: We join Wirt and Greg on a lighthearted romp aboard the Frogland Ferry as they approach Adelaide of the Pasture. But why is Beatrice acting so glum? Things turn emotional for Greg as well when he realizes that his own frog may be better off living with his amphibian compatriots.

episodes.title: The Ringing of the Bell
episodes.description: After unexpected darkness tears the gang apart, Wirt takes charge and meets Loma, a young woman forced to do housework by an odious witch with a magic bell. Can Wirt and Greg save Lorna, and themselves, from the wicked witch?

episodes.title: Babes in the Wood
episodes.description: While Wirt and Greg lay down to rest, they're drawn into a dreamworld of cherubs, flowers, and clouds where Greg must battle the North Wind.

episodes.title: Into the Unknown
episodes.description: The origin of Wirt and Greg’s descent into the Unknown reveals itself.

episodes.title: The Unknown
episodes.description: The Beast has come. The final chapter begins.

title: Hannibal
description: Both a gift and a curse, Graham has the extraordinary ability to think like his prey—he sees what they see, feels what they feel. But while Graham is pursuing an especially troubling, cannibalistic murderer, Special Agent Jack Crawford teams him with a highly respected psychiatrist – a man with a taste for the criminal minded – Dr. Hannibal Lecter.

episodes.title: Apéritif
episodes.description: When the FBI takes on a case of disappearing college girls, Jack Crawford recruits Will Graham, a gifted criminal profiler with a unique view into the psyche of serial killers, to consult. Jack also seeks the help of Dr. Hannibal Lecter, a brilliant psychiatrist. After a copycat strikes, Will and Hannibal join forces to track down the culprit.

episodes.title: Amuse-Bouche
episodes.description: Will and Jack race to apprehend a serial killer using humans as fertilizer.

episodes.title: Potage
episodes.description: Abigail Hobbs comes out of her coma with new information about her father.

episodes.title: Œuf
episodes.description: A series of family murders takes place.

episodes.title: Coquilles
episodes.description: Jack and Will search for a killer who turns his victims into angels.

episodes.title: Entrée
episodes.description: The Chesapeake Ripper taunts Jack Crawford with guilt from the past.

episodes.title: Sorbet
episodes.description: Will races to stop a rogue surgeon extracting organs from his victims.

episodes.title: Fromage
episodes.description: A deadly symphony hall killing forces Will to hunt a defiant killer.

episodes.title: Trou Normand
episodes.description: Will, Jack and the BAU team hunt for a serial killer who creates a totem pole out of his victims' bodies.

episodes.title: Buffet Froid
episodes.description: Will tracks a killer with mental instability similar to his own.

episodes.title: Rôti
episodes.description: When Dr. Gideon escapes to terrorize Alana and Dr. Chilton, Hannibal and Will go on the hunt. Eddie Izzard guest stars.

episodes.title: Relevés
episodes.description: Hannibal convinces Jack and Alana that Will could be the copycat killer.

episodes.title: Savoureux
episodes.description: Hannibal frames Will, convincing Jack and Alana that Will's the copycat killer.

episodes.title: Kaiseki
episodes.description: With Will Graham in prison, the FBI investigates his claims against Hannibal. A new serial killer emerges.

episodes.title: Sakizuke
episodes.description: As the FBI seeks Will's help in tracking a killer who turns his victims' bodies into art, Will plots to reveal the truth about Hannibal.

episodes.title: Hassun
episodes.description: As Will's murder trial begins, a copycat killer sends a gruesome message. Jack is under pressure to wrap up Will's case while Hannibal hopes for his friend's exoneration.

episodes.title: Takiawase
episodes.description: Emboldened after drug therapy from Dr. Chilton, Will sets a deadly plan in place to expose Hannibal. A new killer is turning victims into beehives.

episodes.title: Mukōzuke
episodes.description: The BSU investigates Beverly's death after her body is found displayed in a gruesome tableau. Abel Gideon returns to the Baltimore Hospital for the Criminally Insane. Will seeks a horrific revenge for Beverly's death.

episodes.title: Futamono
episodes.description: Jack suspects Hannibal might be the Chesapeake Ripper as two more victims turn up. Hannibal and Alana distance themselves from Will.

episodes.title: Yakimono
episodes.description: As Miriam Lass begins her recovery, Will is released from prison and resumes his pursuit of Hannibal.

episodes.title: Su-zakana
episodes.description: Will resumes his therapy with Dr. Lecter. The FBI investigates the murder of a woman whose body was found sewn inside a dead horse.

episodes.title: Shiizakana
episodes.description: Margot Verger seeks out Will as she tries to understand Hannibal. The FBI searches for an animalistic killer who tears his victims' bodies apart.

episodes.title: Naka-Choko
episodes.description: Will's readiness to go to dark places strengthens his bond with Hannibal.

episodes.title: Kō No Mono
episodes.description: Will and Margot hide her pregnancy from Mason. After Freddie's gruesome murder, Alana's doubts about Will and Hannibal grow stronger.

episodes.title: Tome-wan
episodes.description: Bedelia returns and accepts immunity to testify against Hannibal. Mason Verger plots revenge after learning of Hannibal's manipulations.

episodes.title: Mizumono
episodes.description: Springing their trap, Jack, Will, and Alana face off with Hannibal in a bloody final showdown, but the doctor has a few surprises of his own. Will makes his decision, and it results in devastating consequences.

episodes.title: Antipasto
episodes.description: After the devastating bloodbath at the Lecter home, Hannibal establishes a new life for himself in Italy along with the company of his own psychiatrist, Bedelia.

episodes.title: Primavera
episodes.description: With his wounds now healed, Will Graham heads to Europe eight months after the horrific event that almost took his life, in search of closure with Hannibal Lecter. Meanwhile, an Italian inspector suspects that Lecter and a killer he pursued 20 years earlier are the same person.

episodes.title: Secondo
episodes.description: Will continues his search, making his way to Hannibal's childhood home in Lithuania. Meanwhile, Jack Crawford arrives in Italy, hoping to find Will and intervene before tragedy strikes again, and Bedelia warns Hannibal against unraveling his new life.

episodes.title: Aperitivo
episodes.description: After surviving a disfiguring gunshot, Dr. Fredrick Chilton rallies support to capture Hannibal using Will as bait. Jack is distracted by Bella's failing health, but implores Will to abandon the risky idea of finding Hannibal. Meanwhile, Alana Bloom entertains a different approach, partnering with Mason Verger to utilize his vast resources.

episodes.title: Contorno
episodes.description: Will travels via train with Chiyoh to Florence, as Alana and Mason use Hannibal's fine tastes to track his whereabouts. Pazzi tries to get in close to find out if Hannibal is the man he's looking for, but his greed may get the better of him.

episodes.title: Dolce
episodes.description: With Bedelia securing her alibi, Hannibal prepares to leave Florence just as Jack and Will begin to track him down. However, Chiyoh has arrived in Florence with her own agenda.

episodes.title: Digestivo
episodes.description: Captured in Italy by police on Mason Verger's payroll, Will Graham and Hannibal Lecter are delivered to Muskrat Farm to await Mason's revenge.

episodes.title: The Great Red Dragon
episodes.description: Hannibal has been under lock and key for three years at the Baltimore State Hospital for the Criminally Insane when a new villain arises - Francis Dolarhyde, also known as "The Tooth Fairy." Crawford approaches Will to help catch the vicious serial killer targeting families.

episodes.title: And the Woman Clothed with the Sun…
episodes.description: Wading deeper into dangerous territory, Will enlists the help of Hannibal Lecter to assist with the search for an elusive serial killer. Elsewhere, a new woman comes into Dolarhyde's life.

episodes.title: And the Woman Clothed in Sun
episodes.description: Carvings symbolizing the Great Red Dragon shed light on Francis Dolarhyde's disturbing psychology. Will feels his bond with Hannibal growing uncomfortably stronger, and seeks out Bedelia Du Maurier, the only other person who fully understands the complexities of such a relationship.

episodes.title: And the Beast from the Sea
episodes.description: Convinced that the Red Dragon will strike at the next full moon, Jack and Will grow desperate, and Alana turns to Hannibal for help.

episodes.title: The Number of the Beast is 666…
episodes.description: Will enlists Dr. Frederick Chilton to lure Francis Dolarhyde into an ambush, using Freddie Lounds as their mouthpiece. Meanwhile, Dolarhyde senses that the FBI is closing in and launches a horrifying endgame.

episodes.title: The Wrath of the Lamb
episodes.description: In a desperate bid to slay Francis Dolarhyde, Will engineers a cunning ploy involving Hannibal.

title: Narcos
description: A gritty chronicle of the war against Colombia's infamously violent and powerful drug cartels.

episodes.title: Descenso
episodes.description: Chilean drug chemist Cockroach brings his product to Colombian smuggler Pablo Escobar. DEA agent Steve Murphy joins the war on drugs in Bogota.

episodes.title: The Sword of Simón Bolívar
episodes.description: Communist radical group M-19 makes a move against the narcos, while Murphy gets an education in Colombian law enforcement from his new partner Peña.

episodes.title: The Men of Always
episodes.description: Murphy encounters the depths of government corruption when he and Peña try to derail Escobar's political ambitions by proving he's a narco.

episodes.title: The Palace in Flames
episodes.description: Despite a new extradition treaty, the U.S. puts more money into fighting communism, creating new challenges for Murphy and Peña in the hunt for Pablo.

episodes.title: There Will Be a Future
episodes.description: Pablo's extreme methods put the narcos on the brink of war with Carillo and  the government. Peña tries to protect his witness, Elisa.

episodes.title: Explosivos
episodes.description: Peña and Carillo close in on Gacha, while Murphy tries to protect pro-extradition candidate Gaviria from a notorious assassin connected to Pablo.

episodes.title: You Will Cry Tears of Blood
episodes.description: Pablo goes into hiding as the political tide turns against him, but he finds a way to strike back. Murphy and Peña finally get the CIA to help them.

episodes.title: La Gran Mentira
episodes.description: A tragic mistake forces the government to change tactics in the fight against Pablo. But Pablo faces bigger threats from inside his empire.

episodes.title: La Catedral
episodes.description: The hunt for Pablo seems to be over after he makes a deal with the government, but Murphy and Peña -- and the Cali Cartel -- have other plans.

episodes.title: Despegue
episodes.description: Pablo's activities in prison provoke the government into taking extreme action. Murphy and Peña face a situation of their own.

episodes.title: Free at Last
episodes.description: In the aftermath of a massive military effort to take Pablo into custody, the family reunites while enemies worry. Steve and Connie fight about safety.

episodes.title: Cambalache
episodes.description: Tata gets impatient with life on the run. Pablo responds to President Gaviria's reward offer. Steve and Javier meet their new boss.

episodes.title: Our Man in Madrid
episodes.description: President Gaviria has a new job for an old colleague. The Search Bloc's new tactics shake up Pablo, but also unsettle Steve and Javier.

episodes.title: The Good, The Bad, and The Dead
episodes.description: The Cali cartel discusses moving in on Pablo's territory. Limón proposes a plan to Maritza. Tata gets a gun for protection.

episodes.title: The Enemies of My Enemy
episodes.description: The Search Bloc gets a new leader. Javier loses faith in the system. Pablo brings Tata's brother Carlos down from Miami to cheer her up.

episodes.title: Los Pepes
episodes.description: The newly-formed Los Pepes want to destroy Pablo and his empire. Tata's brother urges her to leave and seek safety with her children.

episodes.title: Deutschland 93
episodes.description: As the danger intensifies for the Escobars, Pablo sends his family to another country. Gaviria weighs the opportunity to use them as leverage.

episodes.title: Exit El Patrón
episodes.description: Colombia begins to turn on Escobar after his latest terrorist attack. Tata receives help from an unlikely ally. Quica gets increasingly anxious.

episodes.title: Nuestra Finca
episodes.description: Pablo is reunited with an estranged family member. Judy Moncada's life is put in danger. The DEA and CIA clash over how to handle Los Pepes.

episodes.title: Al Fin Cayó!
episodes.description: Javier deals with the repercussions from Judy's interview. Tata tries to convince Pablo to surrender for the sake of his children.

episodes.title: The Kingpin Strategy
episodes.description: The Gentlemen of Cali gather their associates together for a big surprise announcement about the future of their business.

episodes.title: The Cali KGB
episodes.description: A gas incident threatens to disrupt the Cali-government deal and Jorge is asked to help out. Peña grapples with his former Los Pepes connection.

episodes.title: Follow the Money
episodes.description: The Rodriguez brothers go into hiding during negotiations. Pacho meets with the Lord of the Skies in Mexico. Peña's new DEA team visits Cali.

episodes.title: Checkmate
episodes.description: Peña hatches a plan to try to capture Cali leader Gilberto Rodriguez. Amado proposes a business idea to Pacho.

episodes.title: MRO
episodes.description: Paranoid about leaks, Miguel cracks down on his security. Pacho makes a decision about his new offer. Peña works on cultivating a witness.

episodes.title: Best Laid Plans
episodes.description: Jorge takes a dangerous risk. An accident in New York threatens to expose Chepe. Peña travels to Curaçao to arrest a potential witness.

episodes.title: Sin Salida
episodes.description: Peña plans another covert operation to take down a key Cali cartel member, but he risks running out of time during his search.

episodes.title: Convivir
episodes.description: David seeks revenge on behalf of his father, putting Enrique in danger. Peña asks Don Berna for help on a rescue mission.

episodes.title: Todos Los Hombres del Presidente
episodes.description: David follows his suspicions. Peña is shocked to discover the depth of corruption in the Colombian government. Miguel is sought after once again.

episodes.title: Going Back to Cali
episodes.description: David and Peña are in a race against each other to find Pallomari. Peña makes a serious decision about the future of his career.

title: Dragon Ball Super
originalTitle: ドラゴンボール超（スーパー）
description: With Majin Buu defeated, Goku has taken a completely new role as...a radish farmer?! With Earth at peace, our heroes have settled into normal lives. But they can’t get too comfortable. Far away, the powerful God of Destruction, Beerus, awakens to a prophecy revealing his demise at the hands of an even more formidable being. When his search for the Saiyan God brings him to Earth, can Goku and his friends take on their strongest foe yet?

cast.characterName: Son Goku / Goku Black / Son Gohan / Son Goten (voice)

episodes.title: A Peacetime Reward; Who Gets the 100,000,000 Zeni?!
episodes.description: Goku is farming with Goten when Mr. Satan tries to give him 100 Million Zeni! Goten and Trunks try to find a gift to Videl.

episodes.title: To the Promised Resort! Vegeta Takes a Family Trip?!
episodes.description: Vegeta and his family go on a family trip while Goku trains. Beerus remembers the Super Saiyan God in his dream.

episodes.title: Where Does the Dream Pick Up? Find the Super Saiyan God!
episodes.description: Beerus and Whis track down the Super Saiyan God. Meanwhile, Bulma and her friends set up her birthday party.

episodes.title: Bid for the Dragon Balls! Pilaf and Crew's Impossible Mission!
episodes.description: The Pilaf Gang end up at Bulma's birthday party to steal the Dragon Balls, but they are sidetracked. Meanwhile, Goku trains on Kaio's planet.

episodes.title: Showdown on King Kai's World! Goku vs. Beerus the Destroyer!
episodes.description: While Goku is training, Beerus shows up at Kaio's planet. Goku suggests that they fight against Kaio's wishes, but Goku is later beaten by Beerus as a Super Saiyan 3.

episodes.title: Don't Anger the Destroyer! A Heart-Pounding Birthday Party
episodes.description: Beerus arrives at Bulma's birthday party, and Vegeta tries his best to keep the God of Destruction under wraps for the time being.

episodes.title: How Dare You Do That to My Bulma! Vegeta's Metamorphosis of Fury?
episodes.description: The Z-Fighters attempt to subdue Beerus after he gets angry, to no avail. Vegeta transforms out of rage after witnessing Bulma get slapped.

episodes.title: Goku Makes an Entrance! A Last Chance from Lord Beerus?
episodes.description: An enraged Vegeta fights Beerus, but is overwhelmed. Later, Beers wins a rock-paper-scissors contest against Oolong, and decides to destroy Earth. Before he can, Goku returns.

episodes.title: Thanks for Waiting, Lord Beerus! A Super Saiyan God Is Born at Last!
episodes.description: After Goku asks Beerus for more time, they summon Shen Long to find out how to achieve the Super Saiyan God form. They perform the ritual and Goku becomes a Super Saiyan God.

episodes.title: Show Us, Goku! The Power of a Super Saiyan God!
episodes.description: After successfully becoming a Super Saiyan God, Goku challenges Beerus to another fight.

episodes.title: Let's Keep Going, Lord Beerus! The Battle of Gods!
episodes.description: The battle between gods continues.

episodes.title: The Universe Will Shatter? Clash! Destroyer vs. Super Saiyan God!
episodes.description: The destructive power of Goku and Beerus' fight puts the entire universe in danger.

episodes.title: Goku, Surpass Super Saiyan God!
episodes.description: Although Goku loses the Super Saiyan God form, he absorbs and retains its power, and continues to fight Beerus.

episodes.title: This Is All the Power I've Got! A Settlement Between Gods
episodes.description: The fight between Goku and Beerus reaches its climactic end.

episodes.title: Valiant Mr. Satan, Work a Miracle! A Challenge from Outer Space!
episodes.description: After the battle with Beerus wraps up, a terrible visitor comes to Satan!?

episodes.title: Vegeta Becomes a Student?! Win Over Whis!
episodes.description: With the battle over, one day Kuririn visits Goku. His unexpected request is…!? Meanwhile, Vegeta tries to convince Whis to make him one of his students by…?

episodes.title: Pan Is Born! And Goku Goes on a Training Journey?!
episodes.description: Some time has passed on Earth. Gohan and Videl’s daughter is finally born!!

episodes.title: I'm Here, Too! Training Commences on Beerus' World
episodes.description: Goku departs Earth and begins training under Whis. The surprising training method is…!?

episodes.title: Despair Redux! The Return of the Evil Emperor, Frieza!
episodes.description: Sorbet is eager to revive Frieza and receives the help of Pilaf and his gang.

episodes.title: A Warning from Jaco! Frieza and 1,000 Soldiers Close In
episodes.description: Jaco travels to Earth to give out a warning of Frieza's arrival.

episodes.title: The Start of Vengeance! The Frieza Force's Malice Strikes Gohan!
episodes.description: Frieza's forces begin their raid on Planet Earth. Goku and Vegeta, oblivious to what is happening on Earth, continue their training under Whis.

episodes.title: Change! An Unexpected Return! His Name Is Ginyu!!
episodes.description: Ginyu switches bodies with Tagoma and wreaks havoc on the Z-Fighters

episodes.title: Earth! Gohan! Both on the Ropes! Hurry and Get Here, Goku!!
episodes.description: Goku and Vegeta hear of Frieza's return and quickly teleport to Earth.

episodes.title: Clash! Frieza vs. Goku; This Is the Result of My Training!
episodes.description: Goku and Frieza go one-on-one. Goku wants to reveal his true power, and so he transforms...

episodes.title: A Full-Throttle Battle! The Vengeful Golden Frieza
episodes.description: Frieza reveals his new evolution and the battle truly begins.

episodes.title: A Chance Appears in a Tight Spot! Launch a Counteroffensive, Goku!
episodes.description: The battle continues as Frieza's weakness begins to make itself obvious.

episodes.title: The Earth Explodes?! A Decisive Kamehameha!
episodes.description: With Goku badly injured, Vegeta steps in to face Frieza. Stronger than ever, Vegeta proves to be a challenge and an enraged Frieza destroys the planet! Protected by Whis, the Z-Fighters are given a chance to save Earth, if they act fast enough.

episodes.title: The 6th Universe's Destroyer! His Name Is Champa!
episodes.description: While training on Beerus' Planet, Goku and Vegeta meet Beerus' twin brother Champa.

episodes.title: Combat Matches Are a Go! The Captain Is Someone Stronger Than Goku
episodes.description: Beerus and Champa decided to hold a tournament between their universes to settle who gets to use the Super Dragon Balls.

episodes.title: A Run-Through For the Competition! Who Are the Last Two Members?
episodes.description: Goku and Vegeta go find the two remaining members for Team Universe 7.

episodes.title: Off to See Master Zuno! Find Out Where the Super Dragon Balls Are!
episodes.description: Jaco and Bulma visit Zuno to learn more about the Super Dragon Balls.

episodes.title: The Matches Begin! We're All Off to the "Planet with No Name!"
episodes.description: The tournament between Universe 6 and Universe 7 begins! The first match is going underway.

episodes.title: Surprise, 6th Universe! This is Super Saiyan Goku!
episodes.description: It's Goku versus Botamo! After Goku's victory, he faces Frost, Universe 6's version of Frieza. Who wins the match...?

episodes.title: Piccolo vs. Frost! Stake It All on the Special Beam Cannon!
episodes.description: The next contestant for Team Universe 7 is Piccolo. Frost is doing what?!

episodes.title: Turn Your Anger into Strength! Vegeta's Full-Bore Battle
episodes.description: Vegeta battles Frost. After a short-lived fight, Vegeta is challenged by Magetta.

episodes.title: An Unexpectedly Uphill Battle! Vegeta's Great Blast of Fury!
episodes.description: Vegeta is struggling during his match with Magetta. What is Magetta doing to Vegeta?!

episodes.title: Don't Forget Your Saiyan Pride! Vegeta vs. the 6th Universe's Saiyan
episodes.description: The next match is between Vegeta and the Saiyan from Universe 6, Cabba. What secret power does Cabba possess?

episodes.title: The 6th Universe's Mightiest Warrior! Engage the Assassin Hit!
episodes.description: The final contestant for Universe 6 is the confident, legendary assassin, Hit. Does Vegeta stand a chance?

episodes.title: A Developed "Time Skip" Counterstrike? Here Comes Goku's New Move!
episodes.description: The battle between Goku and Hit continues, however, Hit proves to be more formidable than anticipated.

episodes.title: A Decision at Last! Is the Winner Beerus? Or Is it Champa?
episodes.description: The winner of the tournament between Universe 6 and 7 is decided!

episodes.title: Come Forth, Divine Dragon! And Grant My Wish, Peas and Carrots!
episodes.description: As the winners of the Tournament Universe 7 are given the Super Dragon Balls and make summon the Dragon for their wish.

episodes.title: A Chaotic Victory Party! Showdown at Last?! Monaka vs. Goku!
episodes.description: The Tournament may be over, but Goku still wants to battle Monaku to see how really strong he is. While Beers and the rest of Dragon Ball Cast try and keep his secret hidden from Goku.

episodes.title: Goku's Energy Is Out of Control?! The Struggle to Look After Pan
episodes.description: Pan is kidnapped thought to be defenseless by her captors, but as it turned out, the plan backfired.

episodes.title: The Seal of Planet Pot-au-feu; Secrets of the Unleashed Superhuman Water!
episodes.description: While Monaka delivers super sweets of the Galaxy to Bulma, Trunks and Goten end up locking themselves in his truck. Finding trouble on a planet Pot-au-feu, Where Vegeta and Jaco have to go and rescue them.

episodes.title: Vegeta Disappears?! Menace of the Duplicate Vegeta!
episodes.description: With Vegeta losing all of his power to the copy of himself that was made from Superhuman Water, it is up to Goten and Trunks to defeat him. Mean while Goku is back at full health and training at Kaio's planet.

episodes.title: Goku vs. the Duplicate Vegeta! Which One Is Going to Win?
episodes.description: The battle between Goku and Duplicate Vegeta Continues. Will Goku defeat the copy in time to save Vegeta?

episodes.title: SOS from the Future: A Dark New Enemy Appears!
episodes.description: In the timeline of Future Trunks, a new enemy appears that requires him to return to the past and get help from the Z-Fighters.

episodes.title: Hope!! Redux: Awaken in the Present, Trunks
episodes.description: Much to everyone's surprise, a war-torn and unconscious Future Trunks arrives in the past after evading Black.

episodes.title: A Message from the Future - The Incursion of Goku Black!
episodes.description: After awakening in the present, Future Trunks mistakes Goku for his evil look-alike Black.

episodes.title: Goku vs. Black! A Closed-Off Road to the Future
episodes.description: Goku Black invades from Trunks' future! Excited to fight a strong opponent, Goku immediately challenges him to one-on-one combat, but Goku Black isn't taking the fight seriously?!

episodes.title: Feelings That Transcend Time: Trunks and Mai
episodes.description: Bulma finds the Time Machine that Cell used to travel to the past and promptly gathers the team to repair it. Future Trunks and Mai discuss their counterparts from alternate timelines.

episodes.title: Master and Pupil Reunited! Gohan and "Future" Trunks!
episodes.description: Piccolo mentions that Gohan decided to abandon his training to become a scholar, which suprised Future Trunks. Piccolo and Kuririn suggest that Future Trunks should meet their timeline's Gohan.

episodes.title: Uncover Black's Identity! Off to the 10th Universe's World of the Kai's!
episodes.description: Goku, Beerus, and Whis arrive in Universe Ten. They meet the Supreme Kai Gowasu and his apprentice Zamasu.

episodes.title: He Who Is of Saiyan Blood: Trunks's Resolve
episodes.description: Vegeta wants to test Future Trunks' power to see how strong his son had become.

episodes.title: I'd Like to See Goku, You See; A Summons From Grand Zeno!
episodes.description: Whis and Beerus are worried over Zen-Oh's request to meet Goku and what it could mean for their universe.

episodes.title: Rematch with Goku Black! Enter Super Saiyan Rosé
episodes.description: Goku and Vegeta appear in the future to fight Goku Black, but they find that he has developed a new power.

episodes.title: A God with an Invincible Body - The Advent of Zamasu
episodes.description: Zamasu appears unexpectedly from the sky. He states that he and Goku Black are "kindred spirits" who want a world without mortals.

episodes.title: Zamasu and Black - The Duo's Mystery Deepens
episodes.description: Defeated, Son Goku, Vegeta and Trunks travel to the present, in order to find a way to defeat Zamasu. We also witness a developing relating to the mystery between Black and Zamasu.

episodes.title: Protect the Supreme Kai Gowasu - Destroy Zamasu!
episodes.description: Goku, Beerus and Whis must save Gowasu from his treacherous apprentice.

episodes.title: Into the Future Again - Goku Black's True Identity Revealed!
episodes.description: Trunks returns to the future, with Goku and his parents accompanying him. There they discover Goku Black still lives, and he explains how he defied space and time to exist.

episodes.title: Zamasu's Ambition – The Storied "Project 0 Mortals" of Terror
episodes.description: Goku, Vegeta and Future Trunks fight Black and Zamasu in the future. Black explains his true identity.

episodes.title: I Will Defend the World! Trunks' Furious Burst of Super Power!
episodes.description: With his new found power, Trunks attempts to hold off Black and Zamasu. Meanwhile, Goku and Vegeta head back to the past to try come up with a new strategy.

episodes.title: Don't You Disgrace Saiyan Cells! Vegeta's Fierce Battle Commences!
episodes.description: Trunks wakes up in a rebel base only to find out that Mai set off on her own in an attempt to take out Black. Will he make it in time to save her?

episodes.title: Worship Me! Give Praise Unto Me! The Explosive Birth of a Merged Zamasu!
episodes.description: As the battle rages on in the future, Bulma and Trunks devise a plan to take down Zamasu, meanwhile, Vegeta shows his new-found strength while taking on Goku Black.

episodes.title: Final Judgement? The Ultimate Power of an Absolute God
episodes.description: The two zamasu fuse and become the ultimate god. Meanwhile Vegeta, Goku and others are stunned and try to somehow defeat the eternal god.

episodes.title: Showdown! The Miraculous Power of Unyielding Warriors
episodes.description: After Goku's attack shakes Zamazu's balance and reveal a weakness in him, he and Vegeta fuse together as they see hope to prevail. Nevertheless, It's Trunks's world and to him it all ultimately comes down.

episodes.title: With New Hope in His Heart - Farewell, Trunks
episodes.description: Zamasu makes one final almighty move to destroy the universe, but Goku brings out a forgotten but all-powerful ally to stop him.

episodes.title: Come Forth, Shenron! Whose Wish Will Be Granted?
episodes.description: Goku decides to summon Shenron to honor a promise, but his friends have things they want to wish for too.

episodes.title: Goku vs. Arale! An Off-the-Wall Battle Spells the End of the Earth?
episodes.description: Goku and the android girl Arale Norimaki meet after many years, in a fun-filled episode where the cast of Dr Slump and DBZ meet.

episodes.title: A Challenge from Champa! This Time, a Baseball Game!
episodes.description: Chanpa returns, and offers a baseball game between him and Beerus.

episodes.title: Goku Dies! An Assassination That Must Be Executed!
episodes.description: Hit gets a contract to kill Goku, and prepares his assassination.

episodes.title: Will He Strike Back? The Unseen Killing Technique!
episodes.description: Goku manages to come back to life, but he seeks a fight with Hit. And who is the client who put Hit to fight Goku?

episodes.title: Gohan's Plight! The Preposterous Great Saiyaman Film Adaptation?!
episodes.description: A film of the Great Saiyaman is to be made, and Gohan is to be in it - to his chagrin, as a stuntman.

episodes.title: For My Beloved Ones! The Indomitable Great Saiyaman!
episodes.description: Barry Kahn's attempts to sabotage Gohan get lethal when the alien parasite Watagash takes control of him.

episodes.title: Goku and Krillin! Back to the Old Familiar Training Ground!
episodes.description: Krillin decides to train with Goku after a police battle goes bad, but can he match up to the Saiyan's level?

episodes.title: Conquer the Terrifying Foes! Krillin's Fighting Spirit Rebounds!
episodes.description: Goku and Krillin fight against their old enemies such as Frieza and Cell in a form of nightmares in a mystical forest Master Roshi sent them to in order to fetch him a special herb.

episodes.title: Let's Do It, Grand Zeno! The Universes' Best Tournament!!
episodes.description: Goku goes and sees Zen-O to get the Tournament of Power going.

episodes.title: Even the Universes' Gods are Appalled?! The Lose-and-Perish Tournament of Power
episodes.description: Goku gets an invitation to the Tournament of Power, an epic tournament between universes.

episodes.title: The 9th Universe's Kicking Basil vs. the 7th Universe's Majin Buu!!
episodes.description: Majin Buu and Basil the Kicker continue to give Zen-Chan a show while they unravel the fight.

episodes.title: Awaken Your Dormant Fighting Spirit! Gohan's Fight!
episodes.description: With Majin Buu and Basil's battle concluded, Gohan is the next warrior of Universe 7 to fight. The rusty warrior's opponent is Universe 9's Lavendar. Lavender, however, has a trick up his sleeve.

episodes.title: Bergamo the Crusher vs. Goku! Whose Strength Reaches the Wild Blue Yonder?
episodes.description: The greatest fighters of Universes 7 and 9, Goku and Bergamo, face off.

episodes.title: Goku Must Pay; The Warrior of Justice Top Barges In!
episodes.description: After Goku won his battle against Bergamo, Toppo from Universe 11 challenges Goku for a fight.

episodes.title: Field the All-7th-Universe Team! Who are the Mighty Ten?
episodes.description: With the Zen-O Exhibition Match concluded and 48 hours until the Tournament of Power, Goku and Gohan search for the 10 warriors needed to complete Universe 7's team.

episodes.title: Goku the Talent Scout; Recruit Krillin and Android 18
episodes.description: Goku and Gohan recruit Krillin to join the Tournament of Power.

episodes.title: The Universes Go into Action -- Each with Their Own Motives
episodes.description: Goku searches for Majin Buu, as the Supreme Kais of each universe hold a secret meeting without Universe 7.

episodes.title: First Time Exchanging Blows! Android 17 vs. Goku!!
episodes.description: Goku travels to an isolated wildlife preserve run by Android 17, and attempts to recruit him for the Tournament of Power.

episodes.title: Hunt the Poaching Ring! Goku and Android 17's Joint Struggle!
episodes.description: Goku helps Android 17 pursue poachers from outer space.

episodes.title: Gohan and Piccolo Master and Pupil Clash in Max Training!
episodes.description: In preparation for the tournament, Piccolo trains Gohan so that he may awaken the power he had long ago.

episodes.title: A Mysterious Beauty Appears! The Enigma of the Tien Shin-Style Dojo?
episodes.description: Goku arrives at the dojo run by Tienshinhan to recruit him for the Tournament of Power.

episodes.title: Staring Down the Wall to be Overcome; Goku vs. Gohan
episodes.description: Gohan tests his powers he rediscovered in an exhibition match against Goku. Gohan forces Goku to transform into Super Sayan God Blue.

episodes.title: Which Universe Will Win Their Place? The Mighty Warriors Gradually Assemble!
episodes.description: The Warriors that are participating in the tournament are gathering while the tournament draws near other universes are gathering their warriors too.

episodes.title: A State of Emergency! Failure to Reach Ten Members!
episodes.description: While each of the Universes prepare for the Tournament of Power in their own ways, Universe 7 gets in a pinch when they learn Majin Buu will be unable to enter the competition.

episodes.title: You're Our Tenth Warrior! Goku Approaches Frieza!!
episodes.description: In a desperate move to keep the roster for the Tournament, Goku decides to revive his archenemy Frieza so he can compete.

episodes.title: The Evil Emperor Returns! A Reception from Mysterious Assassins?
episodes.description: Frieza is resurrected. However, a group of assassins come for him and Goku.

episodes.title: Most Heinous! Most Evil! Frieza's Rampage!
episodes.description: Frieza goes on a rampage against the assassins sent to take him out. But if he takes too long, Universe 7 is disqualified and erased from the Tournament.

episodes.title: The Time Has Come! To the Null Realm with the Universes on the Line!
episodes.description: The Tournament of Power is finally about to begin. Goku and the rest of the team head to the World of Void, site of the battle stage.

episodes.title: Survive! The Tournament of Power Begins at Last!
episodes.description: The 80 warriors assemble in the fighting arena in the World of Void and the curtain rises on the battle for survival.

episodes.title: Ah, the Uncertainty! A Universe Despairs!
episodes.description: The Universe 7 team is hit by a concentrated attack from the other universes.

episodes.title: Show Them! Krillin's Underlying Strength!
episodes.description: The Universes get a taste of what it's like to be erased, after universe 9 is wiped out of existence, Krillin begins showcasing his newly-found powers. Universe 7 loses it's first participant.

episodes.title: Rampage! A Crazed Warrior's Savagery Awakens!
episodes.description: Kale unleashes her berserk Saiyan ability, but endangers her fellow teammates.

episodes.title: Warriors of Justice Close In! The Pride Troopers!
episodes.description: The Pride Troopers of Universe 11 launch an assault on Goku's team.

episodes.title: The Power of Love Explodes? The 2nd Universe's Witchy Warriors!
episodes.description: The Universe 2 lady fighters make their move.

episodes.title: Gohan, Get Ruthless! Showdown with the 10th Universe!
episodes.description: Gohan goes up against Universe 10 warriors.

episodes.title: A Transcendent Light-Speed Battle Erupts! Goku and Hit's United Front!
episodes.description: Hit and Dispo begin to fight at the speed of light. Hit is disadvantaged when Goku comes to help.

episodes.title: A Valiant Fight! Master Roshi's Blaze of Glory!
episodes.description: Master Roshi takes on the fighters of Universe 4.

episodes.title: Find them Out! Deathmatch with a Furtive Attacker!
episodes.description: An unknown sniper with incredible aim launches a stealth attack in the Tournament.

episodes.title: Revenge "F"! A Cunning Trap Is Set?
episodes.description: Frost recalls how Champa promised to pardon his crimes if he humiliated and defeated Universe 7.

episodes.title: Frieza and Frost! A Mutual Malevolence?
episodes.description: As Gohan Struggles, Freeza and Frost appear... together they approach Gohan! What!?

episodes.title: The Mightiest Enemy Zeroes In on Goku! Launch the Knockout Spirit Bomb Now!
episodes.description: The Tournament of Power is now half over, and Jiren finally attacks.  Goku is forced to Super Saiyan Blue to keep pace with the overwhelming power of the 11th Universes most powerful warrior.

episodes.title: Goku Enkindled! The Awakened One's New Ultra Instinct!
episodes.description: After a surprise counter by Jiren, Goku disappears inside the blast of his spirit bomb. Will this be the end for Universe 7?!

episodes.title: An Extra-Dimensional Ultimate Battle! Hit vs. Jiren!
episodes.description: Hit uses his time-skip powers against Jiren and pools all his energy in a final attack to defeat him. Is this the end of Jiren?!

episodes.title: A Saiyan Oath! Vegeta's Resolve!
episodes.description: Vegeta and Cabba stand to face Monna from Universe 4 to show the power of the proud warrior race.

episodes.title: With Great Joy! The Fighting Freak Saiyans' Battle Rejoined!
episodes.description: Exhausted from his battle with jiren, Goku and Caulifla fight.  Goku doesn’t have the strength to transform into a Super Saiyan yet, but he slowly gains his strength back during their fight.

episodes.title: Bloodcurdling! The Explosive Birth of a New Super Warrior!
episodes.description: Kale controls that fierce power and becomes a true legendary Super Saiyan!

episodes.title: Goku vs. Kefla! Super Saiyan Blue Beaten?
episodes.description: Kefla was born from the Potara fusion.  Her power and speed are unbelievable!  Goku has to fight Kefla using his Blue Kiao Ken in the Ultimate Saiyan showdown!

episodes.title: Signs of a Turnabout! The Autonomous Ultra Instinct Erupts!
episodes.description: Goku unleashes stupendous ki.  In his battle with Kafla, he has once more reached Ultra Instinct.  His body unconsciously dodges Kafla's attacks, which triggers her to launch an even fiercer assault.  Then after avoiding her attack, Goku fires a Kamehameha at point-blank range!

episodes.title: Showdown of Love! The Androids vs. the 2ⁿᵈ Universe!
episodes.description: Ribrianne targets Goku right as he's worn out from an intense battle!  But then 17 and 18 appear!  18 takes Goku's place and challenges Ribrianne to one-on-one combat, while 17 takes on Rozie.  Can the two of them prevail against Universe 2's strongest?!

episodes.title: Accelerating Tragedy - Vanishing Universes
episodes.description: Gohan and Piccolo's tough fight!  Gohan and Piccolo struggle against the desperate attacks of Universe 6's final warriors, Saonel and Pirina!  Piccolo therefore thinks up a method of attack their opponents won't expect.

episodes.title: Unavoidable? The Ferocity of a Stealth Attack!
episodes.description: The Tournament of Power Continues and Universe 7 takes on Universe 4.

episodes.title: A Perfect Survival Strategy! The 3ʳᵈ Universe's Menacing Assassin!
episodes.description: Universe 3's Menacing Assassins attack Universe 7.

episodes.title: All-Out War! The Ultimate Four-Fold Union vs. the 7ᵗʰ Universe's Total Offensive!
episodes.description: Universe 7's all-out war begins with the quadruple Merge from Universe 3 named Aniraza. Goku and all his team members take on the new opponent.

episodes.title: With His Pride on the Line! Vegeta's Challenge to Be the Strongest!
episodes.description: With 7 minutes remaining the fight to determine who will survive, Vegeta challenges the strongest warrior Jiren.  What!?

episodes.title: Body, Soul and Power Unleashed! Goku and Vegeta!
episodes.description: Vegeta puts his full power in display against the mighty warrior Jiren of Universe 11, but can he hold his ground against him?

episodes.title: A Storm-and-Stress Assault! Gohan's Last Stand!
episodes.description: Frieza is about to eliminate Dyspo, but Dyspo suddenly shows his true power. Can Universe 7 be able to defeat this warrior with Lightning Speed?

episodes.title: A Commanding Presence! The Advent of Top the Destroyer!
episodes.description: The Battle continues between Toppo and Android 17 but Toppo displays the power of a God of Destruction. Can this obstacle be destroyed?

episodes.title: Surpass Even a God! Vegeta's Sacrifice Strike!
episodes.description: Vegeta displays his full power against Toppo in this high heated Match. Can Vegeta be able to defeat him with his Final Trick?

episodes.title: The Approaching Wall! A Hopeful Final Barrier!
episodes.description: Android 17, Vegeta, Goku and Frieza maximize their struggle to defeat Jiren. Jiren releases his hidden power that surprises everyone. Android 17 shows Jiren his bravery and tries to mentally steer him into defeat. 17, protects Vegeta and Goku from a lethal attack from Jiren.

episodes.title: To the Noble, Proud End! Vegeta Falls!
episodes.description: While Goku tries to master the Ultra Instinct, Vegeta still fights Jiren with everything he's got.

episodes.title: A Transcendent Limit Break! Autonomous Ultra Instinct Mastered!
episodes.description: A super heated battle for survival continues. With Jiren puttin Goku on the ropes even after he awakens ultra instict Goku surrpasses his limits once again by mastering the ultra instict.

episodes.title: The Greatest Showdown of All Time! The Ultimate Survival Battle!
episodes.description: The climactic battle to decide the fate of Universe 7 continues as Goku, now mastering Ultra Instinct, fights Jiren at his full power.

episodes.title: A Miraculous Conclusion! Farewell Goku! Until We Meet Again!
episodes.description: The Tournament of Power reaches its final climactic moment, as Goku, Frieza and 17 have to eliminate Jiren for the survival of Universe 7.

title: 13 Reasons Why
description: High school student Clay Jensen lands in the center of a series of heartbreaking mysteries set in motion by a friend's tragic suicide.

episodes.title: Tape 1, Side A
episodes.description: As the school mourns the death of Hannah Baker, her friend Clay receives a box of tapes with messages she recorded before she died by suicide.

episodes.title: Tape 1, Side B
episodes.description: Hannah makes friends with Jessica and Alex, two other new students. Justin doesn't show up at school, and Hannah's mother finds something troubling.

episodes.title: Tape 2, Side A
episodes.description: Jealousy and gossip take a toll on Hannah's relationships. As Alex struggles with feelings of regret, the guys pressure Clay into getting drunk.

episodes.title: Tape 2, Side B
episodes.description: Hannah thinks someone is stalking her and sets a trap. Hannah's mother confronts the principal, and Clay strikes back at someone who wronged Hannah.

episodes.title: Tape 3, Side A
episodes.description: Hannah and Clay connect at the school dance, but a crass rumor ruins the mood. Clay takes Courtney to visit Hannah's grave.

episodes.title: Tape 3, Side B
episodes.description: Hannah's date on Valentine's Day doesn't go as planned. Alex gets in a big fight at school and has to face the honor board.

episodes.title: Tape 4, Side A
episodes.description: Another student sabotages Hannah during a class project. Clay's nightmares about Hannah spill over into the daytime.

episodes.title: Tape 4, Side B
episodes.description: Inspired by a friend's poetry reading, Hannah pours her heart out. Tony confides in Clay about the night of Hannah's death.

episodes.title: Tape 5, Side A
episodes.description: Hannah witnesses a traumatic event at a summertime party. Clay tries to reason with Justin, and Marcus warns him that the worst is yet to come.

episodes.title: Tape 5, Side B
episodes.description: A distraught Hannah gets a ride home from the party. Jessica's behavior grows increasingly erratic, and Clay learns the truth behind a tragedy.

episodes.title: Tape 6, Side A
episodes.description: Clay and Hannah grow closer. While Clay spends a heartbreaking night listening to his tape with Tony, tensions boil over at Bryce's house.

episodes.title: Tape 6, Side B
episodes.description: Hannah winds up at a party after an argument with her parents. The students are served with subpoenas, and Justin wrestles with conflicting loyalties.

episodes.title: Tape 7, Side A
episodes.description: Hannah seeks help from Mr. Porter, the school counselor. Clay plays the new tape for Tony and weighs what to do next.

episodes.title: The First Polaroid
episodes.description: Five months after Hannah's death, the case against Liberty goes to trial, with Tyler as the first witness. Clay finds a troubling photo in his locker.

episodes.title: Two Girls Kissing
episodes.description: Courtney makes a brave decision. Clay's memories of Hannah drive a wedge between him and Skye. Someone trashes the yearbook office.

episodes.title: The Drunk Slut
episodes.description: Worried about threats against them, Alex and Clay urge Jessica to testify about Bryce. Clay enlists Tony's help to find a potential witness.

episodes.title: The Second Polaroid
episodes.description: Clay hides a secret from his parents. Concerned about his reputation, Marcus lies in court. Jessica and Alex skip school together.

episodes.title: The Chalk Machine
episodes.description: Tyler and Cyrus embrace their outsider status. Alex fights to recover his lost memories. Ryan and Mrs. Baker look to Hannah's poems for clues.

episodes.title: The Smile at the End of the Dock
episodes.description: Clay tries to figure out where the Polaroids were taken. Justin shows up at school. Zach's revelation about Hannah takes everyone by surprise.

episodes.title: The Third Polaroid
episodes.description: Alex blows up at Bryce. Someone blackmails Marcus. Clay testifies about a night he and Hannah spent together. Jessica experiences a flashback.

episodes.title: The Little Girl
episodes.description: When Hannah's parents come under scrutiny, Jessica reaches out to Mrs. Baker. Justin struggles to stay clean. Clay reconnects with Skye.

episodes.title: The Missing Page
episodes.description: Tyler goes out with Cyrus's sister. Chloe confronts Bryce about the tapes. Jess wonders if she's ready to date again. Mr. Porter wrestles with regret.

episodes.title: Smile, Bitches
episodes.description: Tony opens up about his past. Sheri devises a plan to get into the clubhouse. Mr. Porter tries to help Justin. Zach and Bryce butt heads.

episodes.title: Bryce and Chloe
episodes.description: Chaos erupts at school in the aftermath of Bryce's testimony. Jessica tells Chloe about the clubhouse. Alex's memories come rushing back.

episodes.title: The Box of Polaroids
episodes.description: Threats against Clay and the others escalate. Tyler faces disciplinary action. Justin testifies about Bryce, putting his own future at risk.

episodes.title: Bye
episodes.description: One month later, Hannah's loved ones celebrate her life and find comfort in each other. Meanwhile, a brutal assault pushes one student over the edge.

episodes.title: Yeah. I'm the New Girl
episodes.description: The cops question Clay about Bryce's disappearance. Clay remembers the aftermath of Spring Fling, when he raced to cover Tyler's tracks and met Ani.

episodes.title: If You're Breathing, You're a Liar
episodes.description: After learning about Chloe's pregnancy, Clay and Ani pay her a visit. Chloe recalls how she leaned on Zach for support -- and that Bryce never knew.

episodes.title: The Good Person Is Indistinguishable from the Bad
episodes.description: As the police investigation sets the school on edge, Ani remembers that Jessica confronted Bryce. Growing suspicious of Jess, Ani and Clay follow her.

episodes.title: Angry, Young and Man
episodes.description: After Tyler admits he still has a gun, the group keeps tabs on him at school. But their worry deepens when they learn he had a motive to kill Bryce.

episodes.title: Nobody's Clean
episodes.description: The police search the school after finding steroids in Bryce's car. Alex remembers how Bryce supported Alex after Jessica dumped him.

episodes.title: You Can Tell the Heart of a Man by How He Grieves
episodes.description: The police bring in Tony for questioning. At Bryce's funeral, Ani uncovers two damning secrets.

episodes.title: There Are a Number of Problems with Clay Jensen
episodes.description: The police interrogate Justin and Clay about the night Clay pulled a gun on Bryce. Clay discovers that Ani and Bryce's bond ran deeper than he realized.

episodes.title: In High School, Even on a Good Day, It's Hard to Tell Who's on Your Side
episodes.description: Mr. Porter interviews students about Clay, who pleads his innocence to Mrs. Walker. Learning Porter counseled Bryce, Clay and Ani question his motives.

episodes.title: Always Waiting for the Next Bad News
episodes.description: The cops name Clay as a person of interest in the murder. Ani catches Justin in a lie after learning Bryce bailed him out of a dangerous situation.

episodes.title: The World Closing In
episodes.description: Hannah's mother returns to town. Urging Clay to protect himself, she reveals that there was more to Tony and Bryce's relationship than Clay knew.

episodes.title: There Are a Few Things I Haven't Told You
episodes.description: As the cops close in on Clay -- their main suspect -- violent confrontations at the homecoming game expose that everyone had a reason to kill Bryce.

episodes.title: And Then the Hurricane Hit
episodes.description: The pressure of Clay's arrest leads his friends to make risky decisions, and the full story of the brawl that erupted at homecoming emerges.

episodes.title: Let the Dead Bury the Dead
episodes.description: Clay is released on bail, Ani puts a plan to exonerate him into action, and the truth about Bryce's murder finally comes to light.

episodes.title: Winter Break
episodes.description: The police question Tyler about the guns, leaving the friends rattled. Winston transfers to Liberty High after getting expelled from Hillcrest.

episodes.title: College Tour
episodes.description: After an incident at school, Clay thinks someone's trying to set him up. Zach and Clay land in hot water during a college tour.

episodes.title: Valentine's Day
episodes.description: As the school gears up for the Love Is Love dance on Valentine's Day, disturbing phone calls keep Clay from getting in the spirit.

episodes.title: Senior Camping Trip
episodes.description: Clay is forced to confront his anxiety on the senior camping trip as a suspicious email threatens to turn the friends against each other.

episodes.title: House Party
episodes.description: The Jensens make the boys take a drug test. When the Liberty parents learn about an upcoming party, Clay suspects that they're tracking the students.

episodes.title: Thursday
episodes.description: The school goes into lockdown, and Clay, Tony and Justin worry about Tyler's whereabouts.

episodes.title: College Interview
episodes.description: Clay's mental health continues to decline as the friends wrestle with difficult emotions during their college admissions interviews.

episodes.title: Acceptance/Rejection
episodes.description: In the wake of the lockdown, the school is on edge — and a troubling abuse of power pushes the students to take action.

episodes.title: Prom
episodes.description: When the dean begins a new investigation and threatens to cancel prom, the friends decide to confide in their parents ... but not about everything.

episodes.title: Graduation
episodes.description: Strengthened by the struggles they've endured, the friends say goodbye to high school and look toward the future.

title: Hawkeye
description: Former Avenger Clint Barton has a seemingly simple mission: get back to his family for Christmas. Possible? Maybe with the help of Kate Bishop, a 22-year-old archer with dreams of becoming a superhero. The two are forced to work together when a presence from Barton’s past threatens to derail far more than the festive spirit.

episodes.title: Never Meet Your Heroes
episodes.description: Archer Kate Bishop lands in the middle of a criminal conspiracy, forcing Hawkeye out of retirement.

episodes.title: Hide and Seek
episodes.description: Clint has to help Kate disentangle herself from the Tracksuit mafia and a real-life murder mystery.

episodes.title: Echoes
episodes.description: After narrowly escaping the Tracksuits and their daunting leader Maya Lopez, Clint and Kate work together to find answers. With each step they take, however, they find themselves sliding deeper into a rapidly growing criminal conspiracy.

episodes.title: Partners, Am I Right?
episodes.description: Secrets are revealed and hard truths emerge, culminating in a battle against two opposing forces.

episodes.title: Ronin
episodes.description: After a fallout between Clint and Kate, the younger archer is ready to abandon her dream of becoming a hero. Meanwhile, a guilt-ridden Clint prepares to go face-to-face with the Tracksuit mafia, owning up to past actions. Everything changes, however, when Kate makes a surprising discovery.

episodes.title: So This Is Christmas?
episodes.description: Clint and Kate’s partnership is tested as they face the consequences of exposing the conspiracy.

title: The Owl House
description: Luz, a self-assured teenage human girl, accidentally stumbles upon a portal to a magical new world where she befriends a rebellious witch, Eda, and an adorably tiny warrior, King.

episodes.title: A Lying Witch and a Warden
episodes.description: Luz, a self-assured teenage girl, accidentally stumbles upon a portal to a magical world where she befriends a rebellious witch, Eda, and an adorably tiny warrior, King. In order to get home, Luz must help them with a mission.

episodes.title: Witches Before Wizards
episodes.description: When an ancient wizard gives Luz a map for a mystical quest, she wonders if she is actually a Chosen One.

episodes.title: I Was a Teenage Abomination
episodes.description: Luz sneaks into the local magic school to help a friend and makes a new enemy in the process.

episodes.title: The Intruder
episodes.description: Luz and King have to defend the Owl House from a mysterious intruder.

episodes.title: Covention
episodes.description: Luz's lesson about witch covens goes awry when she finds herself thrust into a witch's duel.

episodes.title: Hooty's Moving Hassle
episodes.description: When Luz, Willow and Gus accidentally animate the Owl House, the house runs amok around Bonesborough.

episodes.title: Lost in Language
episodes.description: While checking out the library, Luz's pranks lead to unintended consequences.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Swap
episodes.description: A simple disagreement leads to a complex situation when Eda, King, and Luz triple-down on a wager.

episodes.title: Something Ventured, Someone Framed
episodes.description: When Gus sneaks Luz into Hexside School to present at the Human Appreciation Society, Luz sees a side of the school she didn't expect.

episodes.title: Escape of the Palisman
episodes.description: When an adventure with Eda's staff goes awry, Luz and her friends have to earn the staff back from a mysterious forest creature, or lose the staff forever.

episodes.title: Sense and Insensitivity
episodes.description: When King becomes a bestselling author, he learns a valuable lesson in reading the fine print.

episodes.title: Adventures in the Elements
episodes.description: Luz needs to learn a new spell, so Eda takes her to the most magical place on the island to train.

episodes.title: The First Day
episodes.description: During Luz’s first day of Magic School, curiosity gets the best of her, and she finds herself thrown into the Delinquent Track, where she’s not allowed to learn magic.

episodes.title: Really Small Problems
episodes.description: King confides in a carnival fortuneteller who makes his dream come true, but it comes at a cost.

episodes.title: Understanding Willow
episodes.description: Luz, Willow and Amity take a trip down memory lane.

episodes.title: Enchanting Grom Fright
episodes.description: Luz experiences Grom, Hexside’s version of Prom, and it’s not what she expects.

episodes.title: Wing It Like Witches
episodes.description: Not your average underdog story.

episodes.title: Agony of a Witch
episodes.description: On a school field trip to the mysterious Emperor’s Castle, Luz strays from the group and into danger.

episodes.title: Young Blood, Old Souls
episodes.description: Luz’s skills as a witch are put to the test when she attempts the impossible.

episodes.title: Separate Tides
episodes.description: Luz feels guilty about Eda losing her powers, so she sets sail in search of a lucrative bounty to help the Owl House.

episodes.title: Escaping Expulsion
episodes.description: When Amity's parents get Luz, Willow and Gus expelled from Hexside, Luz strikes a dangerous deal with them to get back into school.

episodes.title: Echoes of the Past
episodes.description: King's delusions of grandeur lead Luz, Lilith, and Hooty to a dangerous new island.

episodes.title: Keeping Up A-fear-ances
episodes.description: Eda gets an unwelcome visit from a family member who puts a strain on everyone in the Owl House.

episodes.title: Through the Looking Glass Ruins
episodes.description: Gus tries to impress a group of cool kids from Glandus High, while Luz and Amity journey into the most dangerous section of the library.

episodes.title: Hunting Palismen
episodes.description: It’s Palisman Pairing Day at Hexside, but Luz doesn’t match with a Palisman of her own and soon finds herself on an unexpected journey with a foe.

episodes.title: Eda's Requiem
episodes.description: A special witch from Eda’s past enlists her in a rebellion against the Emperor.

episodes.title: Knock, Knock, Knockin' on Hooty's Door
episodes.description: Hooty tries to help King, Eda and Luz with their problems, but it doesn’t go as planned.

episodes.title: Eclipse Lake
episodes.description: When Luz gets sick with the Common Mold, it's up to Amity to find an important ingredient for the portal door - but Amity's not the only one on its trail.

episodes.title: Yesterday's Lie
episodes.description: Luz thinks she's found a way back home. But is she ready for what she'll find on the other side?

episodes.title: Follies at the Coven Day Parade
episodes.description: In the aftermath of her trip home, Luz takes on daring rescue missions during the Coven Day parade.

episodes.title: Elsewhere and Elsewhen
episodes.description: Luz is desperate for more information about Philip Wittebane, the creator of the portal door. With Lilith's help, she sets off on a journey for the ages.

episodes.title: Any Sport in a Storm
episodes.description: Hunter goes uncover at Hexside for his most important mission yet. Willow becomes determined to succeed at an exciting new sport.

episodes.title: Reaching Out
episodes.description: Amity wants to prove herself to her father, and Luz thinks she's found the perfect way to do it: Underground Witch Duels.

episodes.title: Them's the Breaks, Kid
episodes.description: Eda tells a story from her teen years: the day she met Raine Whispers.

episodes.title: Hollow Mind
episodes.description: A magical mishap transports Luz and Hunter into a new mindscape - and this one is a twisted nightmare.

episodes.title: Edge of the World
episodes.description: King's quest to uncover his past leads to shocking revelations and horrifying truths.

episodes.title: Labyrinth Runners
episodes.description: When the Emperor's coven comes to Hexside, Gus teams up with an unlikely ally.

episodes.title: O Titan, Where Art Thou
episodes.description: Eda and Luz scramble to face the day of unity. King faces his true identity.

episodes.title: Clouds on the Horizon
episodes.description: Everyone on the Isles prepares to celebrate the Day of Unity.

episodes.title: King's Tide
episodes.description: The Day of Unity begins.

episodes.title: Thanks to Them
episodes.description: After months of trying, Luz and her friends make a daring attempt to return to the Demon Realm.

episodes.title: For the Future
episodes.description: Luz and her friends race against Belos to confront the Collector and save the Boiling Isles.

episodes.title: Watching and Dreaming
episodes.description: The fate of the Boiling Isles rests on the shoulders of a human, a cursed witch and a little King.

title: Money Heist
description: To carry out the biggest heist in history, a mysterious man called The Professor recruits a band of eight robbers who have a single characteristic: none of them has anything to lose. Five months of seclusion - memorizing every step, every detail, every probability - culminate in eleven days locked up in the National Coinage and Stamp Factory of Spain, surrounded by police forces and with dozens of hostages in their power, to find out whether their suicide wager will lead to everything or nothing.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: The Professor recruits a young female robber and seven other criminals for a grand heist, targeting the Royal Mint of Spain.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Hostage negotiator Raquel makes initial contact with the Professor. Police grab an image of the face of one of the robbers.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Raquel suffers a personal crisis with her ex. The hostages are frightened by the gunshots they overheard. The thieves argue among themselves.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: The thieves let a medical team enter the Mint, and an undercover policemansneaks in with them. Can the Professor stay one step ahead of Raquel?

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Rio is disturbed by news he sees on the television. A break in the investigation puts the Professor at risk of being discovered.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Berlin seeks revenge once his identity is revealed in the press. Tokyo catches Alison chatting with Rio and confronts her.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Raquel enters the Mint to secure proof of life that all of the hostages are still alive and well. Nairobi gives Alison advice.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Arturo formulates an escape plan for a group of hostages. Ángel and Raquel question each other's loyalties. Mónica makes a move on Denver.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: The Professor reveals who gave him the idea for the plan. At the Mint, the thieves offer the hostages a decision: money or freedom?

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: As forensic experts comb the Toledocountry house for DNA, the Professor loses control. Inside the Mint, the robbers' nerves reach a breaking point.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.description: The police interrogate the first robber to be captured. Furious over Berlin's recent actions, Rio takes a stand against him.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.description: Recognizing their plan isn't working out, the robbers instead aim to win over the public via the press. Raquel sets a trap to capture the Professor.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.description: Arturo faces harsh consequences for trying to set another escape plan in motion. After making a confession, Moscow loses Denver's trust.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.description: When Raquel's relationship with the Professor is discovered and she's removed from the case, she decides to conduct her own search for the mastermind.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.description: As the police enter the Mint, Berlín leads the robbers in a final showdown. Will they escape with the 984 million euros—and with their lives intact?

episodes.title: We're Back
episodes.description: When Rio is captured, a distraught Tokyo turns to the Professor for help. Armed with a bold new plan, they reunite the team in order to rescue him.

episodes.title: Aikido
episodes.description: The Professor recruits Martin to put his brother's plan into action and target the Bank of Spain. First step? Create total chaos.

episodes.title: 48 Meters Underground
