episodes.description: Catalina, Nachito and Valentina threaten Daniela with death but Marcial and Capitán Pérez step in to avoid a tragedy.

episodes.title: Episode 73
episodes.description: Catalina and Valentina consider paying someone to kill Daniela, although this would mean spending all the money Catalina's sister left her family.

episodes.title: Episode 74
episodes.description: Nachito and Catalina dream about a future together. Aníbal accuses Nachito of a robbery. An ironic cackle turns into a clue.

episodes.title: Episode 75
episodes.description: Diabla reappears before Aníbal’s eyes and threatens him. Nachito gives the Maríns valuable documents.

episodes.title: Episode 76
episodes.description: Martina fools herself about Titi, who boasts he is the best narco, but his heart belongs to another woman. Nachito goes to the ranch with Catalina.

episodes.title: Episode 77
episodes.description: Adriana’s burial is the perfect time to attack. Diabla orders her men to eliminate Catalina and Hilda. Aníbal negotiates murder terms.

episodes.title: Episode 78
episodes.description: One of Aníbal’s bodyguards becomes a murderer. A massacre is about to erupt. Adriana’s final goodbye has a huge turnout. Marcial is depressed.

episodes.title: Episode 79
episodes.description: The Maríns and their allies meet to make a decision. Catalina, Nachito and Valentina show their weapons and desire to fight but not everyone agrees.

episodes.title: Episode 80
episodes.description: Diabla threatens to kill her doctor. Marcial might never walk again after his suicide attempt. Gato Gardo wants to take Martina’s life.

episodes.title: Episode 81
episodes.description: Gato Gordo takes control and puts the plan into action. Diabla puts a hefty sum on the heads of the Maríns and Pipe’s mother.

episodes.title: Episode 82
episodes.description: Catalina and Nachito swear their eternal love. Capitan Pérez suffers the consequences of selling his soul to Diabla. Catalina’s father loses his mind.

episodes.title: Episode 83
episodes.description: Nachito convinces Albeiro that Catalina is the love of his life. Titi goes to the hospital to visit Marcial, who is in the depths of depression.

episodes.title: Episode 84
episodes.description: The Maríns, Jota, Vanessa and Valentina unite forces to open up Diabla’s grave. Daniela is taken over by jealousy and decides it’s time for revenge.

episodes.title: Episode 85
episodes.description: The Maríns and their allies take a DNA sample from one of Diabla’s victims and then make a key decision. Titi and Gato Gordo shake on a business deal.

episodes.title: Episode 86
episodes.description: The plan is clear: it will have two phases. Aníbal is Diabla’s next victim. Martina is in love with a trafficker and her mother gives her some advice.

episodes.title: Episode 87
episodes.description: Marcial gives the TEA agents the information they need to find and capture Diabla. This is the only way the first phase of the plan will work.

episodes.title: Episode 88
episodes.description: Hilda and Albeiro give the TEA agents information about Diabla. Meanwhile, she sends her men to the ranch to finish off Catalina and her family.

episodes.title: Episode 89
episodes.description: Hilda and Albeiro return to the ranch and Albeiro faces Diabla’s men. Catalina swears she won’t harm Diabla and Daniela in exchange for Nachito.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Everyone thinks Catalina la Grande is dead but she is alive and well. She made a deal with the TEA and now has a new life in the United States.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Catalina, now Virginia Fernández, starts her life in the U.S. Albeiro professes his eternal love to her before her “grave.”

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Martín offers Virginia employment as an undercover TEA agent. Soraya tries to seduce Santiago with deceit.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Virginia returns to Colombia to bury her past and give Jota instructions. Yésica goes to Mexico to make a deal. Virginia is given a promotion.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: 20 years go by. Yésica is a powerful drug trafficker. When she finds out that la Diabla isn’t dead, Virginia goes to Colombia to confront her enemy.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Virginia exposes la Diabla with a DNA test and escorts her to a prison in the U.S. The Maríns spend their first night in la Diabla’s mansion.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Virginia is rewarded for capturing la Diabla but first, she, Marcial, Hilda, and Albeiro will all have to testify.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: El Titi suggests that he, Daniela, and Gato Gordo all work together as partners. Daniela agrees to run la Diabla’s routes if el Titi kills Catalina.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Martín wants Catalina to go to Colombia undercover and trap el Titi. Daniela and Aníbal offer to team up with el Titi and Gato Gordo.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: Hilda and Albeiro have to testify against la Diabla. Yésica plans her escape from prison. Virginia informs her children that they will go to Colombia.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.description: Virginia offers Yésica a reduced penalty if she pleads guilty but she has two key witnesses who could bring her down.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.description: Yésica records the conversation she has with the prison director. Daniela accuses Hernán Darío of stealing money from the safe.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.description: Catalina la Pequeña submits to Daniela. Martín tells Virginia to seduce el Titi and trap him. La Diabla teams up with Mayra.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.description: Santiago asks Virginia to quit the TEA so that they both can spend more time with their children. Yésica blackmails the director and plans to escape.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.description: Catalina la Pequeña and Hernán Darío make love. Yésica meets her new lawyer. The prison director is forced to consent to la Diabla’s conditions.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.description: Yésica hasn't made a decision about Virginia's proposal. La Diabla threatens her. Marcial gets a feeling that Titi is going to kill him.

episodes.title: Episode 17
episodes.description: Hilda and Albeiro find Catalina la Grande's grave empty. Yésica finds out the details for her escape and Titi tries to kill Marcial.

episodes.title: Episode 18
episodes.description: Hilda and Albeiro are excited to get to Miami. Virginia is tormented after seeing her mother and her first love but Albeiro finds her.

episodes.title: Episode 19
episodes.description: La Diabla's escape plan takes shape in jail. Virginia is flustered after seeing her mother and Albeiro. Hilda demands to know what Albeiro is hiding.

episodes.title: Episode 20
episodes.description: Martín sets up a meeting between Virginia and Albeiro in an office at the courthouse. They intercept the van transporting la Diabla and three inmates.

episodes.title: Episode 21
episodes.description: Albeiro tells Hilda that he was with Catalina la Grande and that she never died but Hilda doesn't believe him.

episodes.title: Episode 22
episodes.description: Albeiro and Santiago meet. Chuky takes photos of Daniela and her step-father kissing and taking each other's clothes off. La Diabla worries everyone.

episodes.title: Episodio  23
episodes.description: Albeiro tells Catalina la Pequeña her mother is in a coma after making sure that she is alive. La Diabla makes it to Mexico for a meeting with Chalo.

episodes.title: Episode 24
episodes.description: Santiago tells Catalina la Grande and Albeiro that Hilda will recover but when she wakes up, she'll have amnesia and have to start all over again.

episodes.title: Episode 25
episodes.description: Hilda doesn't recognize Albeiro and attacks him with scissors. Yésica visits her sister in Venezuela. Titi orders his men to scare Catalina.

episodes.title: Episode 26
episodes.description: Hilda is released and everyone travels to Colombia. Titi's men go to the hospital to kill Catalina la Pequeña. Yésica steals her sister's passport.

episodes.title: Episode 27
episodes.description: Mariana hides some marijuana in Albeiro's belongings. Titi's hitmen kill a patient by accident and Catalina la Pequeña is still alive.

episodes.title: Episode 28
episodes.description: Marcial finds out that Titi was behind the hospital attack. Catalina and her family make it to Colombia. La Diabla becomes Amparo to cross the border.

episodes.title: Episode 29
episodes.description: While Albeiro and Hernán Darío take Hilda to the hospital, Titi's hitmen take advantage of the opportunity to attack the house.

episodes.title: Episode 30
episodes.description: Marcial and Catalina la Grande are reunited after 20 years and he apologizes to her. Catalina la Pequeña feels guilty for murdering two men.

episodes.title: Episode 31
episodes.description: Marcial tells Titi that he's ready to die. Catalina la Grande and Santiago invite Albeiro and Hernán Darío to spend the night at their house.

episodes.title: Episode 32
episodes.description: La Diabla makes it to Pereira. Everyone realizes that Marcial has died and that Titi is behind it. Catalina la Grande remembers her time with Marcial.

episodes.title: Episode 33
episodes.description: Las Diablas reach the new ranch and plan to build an emergency tunnel. Hilda recovers part of her memory but she is referred to a psychiatrist.

episodes.title: Episode 34
episodes.description: Chuky burns the money that Daniela hid. The Captain is going to frame Chuky for Marcial's death. La Diabla stays on the street.

episodes.title: Episode 35
episodes.description: The police arrest Albeiro and Jota for burning down Las Diablas' house. Yésica is furious when Daniela admits that she slept with Titi.

episodes.title: Episode 36
episodes.description: Mariana gets naked in front of Hernán Darío. Catalina la Grande sees them together and Mariana cuts her veins. Hilda is taken to the psychiatric ward.

episodes.title: Episode 37
episodes.description: Martín tells Virginia how to get to Titi and Gato Gordo: by moving to their old neighborhood. The agent traps Martina and wants her to be a TEA spy.

episodes.title: Episode 38
episodes.description: Hilda digs up the past and throws it in Virginia's face in front of Santiago. Mayra and Flavia join Las Diablas to set up a new cartel in Mexico City.

episodes.title: Episode 39
episodes.description: Gato Gordo and Titi film their meeting with their partners. Daniela suggests that Titi kill Gato Gordo. Nacho is disappointed by Catalina la Pequeña.

episodes.title: Episode 40
episodes.description: Calvo and his men attack Gato Gordo's ranch but he manages to escape with Titi. Las Diablas and Flavia prepare Mayra to become the cocaine queen.

episodes.title: Episode 41
episodes.description: Albeiro and Jota get out of jail. Gato Gordo wants to make a claim about the attack on his ranch. Chuky organizes a vigil for Marcial.

episodes.title: Episode 42
episodes.description: Titi suspects that Daniela gave the order to kill him so he confronts her but she denies it. Yésica changes her plan: she'll have to do it herself.

episodes.title: Episode 43
episodes.description: Virginia starts acting as an undercover agent in front of Paola and Martina. Gato Gordo gets shot in a fight.

episodes.title: Episode 44
episodes.description: Titi is excited to hear Catalina la Grande's voice and wants to see her. She shows up in the neighborhood and sees her old friends.

episodes.title: Episode 45
episodes.description: Catalina la Pequeña hears her sister yelling at her daughter and finds out what happened with Hernán Darío. Titi dreams of being number one.

episodes.title: Episode 46
episodes.description: A heartbroken Catalina la Pequeña confronts Hernán Darío about his betrayal. La Diabla and Chalo plan to eliminate Gato Gordo and Titi in Mexico.

episodes.title: Episode 47
episodes.description: Virginia plays the role of Catalina Santana on her date with Titi. He is thrilled and invites her to Mexico. Martin organizes an operation.

episodes.title: Episode 48
episodes.description: Virginia and Titi get to Chalo's ranch in Mexico but the TEA is on their tail. Las Diablas' hitmen kidnap Hilda at Marcial's burial.

episodes.title: Episode 49
episodes.description: Titi shoots Chalo and gunfire commences. Catalina la Grande joins in and Titi is surprised that she can use a gun. The TEA shows up at the ranch

episodes.title: Episode 50
episodes.description: Virginia pretends to be sick and Titi goes out to get her medicine. She uses the opportunity to give Martín their location.

episodes.title: Episode 51
episodes.description: Titi manages to flee the TEA. Virginia asks Martín to arrest her so that Titi isn't suspicious and he agrees so that she won't go back to Colombia.

episodes.title: Episode 52
episodes.description: Martín secretly takes Virginia to a rented house. Aníbal get to Daniela's "aunt's" house. She seduces him and Yésica shows up to torture him.

episodes.title: Episode 53
episodes.description: Virginia thinks that Martín is helping her but he has different intentions. Mariana manipulates Catalina la Pequeña.

episodes.title: Episode 54
episodes.description: Martín holds Virginia against her will and declares his love for her. La Diabla gets revenge and Titi looks for Chalo's competition.

episodes.title: Episode 55
episodes.description: La Diabla demands that Calvo seduce Hilda. Gato Gordo is at death's door but he has two last requests: one has to do with a crime.

episodes.title: Episode 56
episodes.description: Catalina tries to trick Martín so that she can escape. The policeman is clever and she swears her revenge. Santiago finds Martín.

episodes.title: Episode 57
episodes.description: Albeiro goes to Yésica's ranch to negotiate Hilda's freedom. Mayra pretends to be a narco by following La Diabla's instructions.

episodes.title: Episode 58
episodes.description: Albeiro insists on negotiating Hilda's freedom. Mariana goes to a drunk Nacho's house. She pretends to be Catalina la Pequeña to confuse him.

episodes.title: Episode 59
episodes.description: Mariana plays with Catalina la Pequeña's excitement. Catalina la Grande finds out that Hilda has been kidnapped. The past surprises Santiago.

episodes.title: Episode 60
episodes.description: Albeiro sends a drone to find Hilda. Daniela and La Diabla go to Aníbal's funeral. Yésica speaks to the governor. Titi calls Martina about business.

episodes.title: Episode 61
episodes.description: Hilda hides from Calvo and La Diabla realizes that they're not there. Daniela glimpses a drone and warns her mother that she might be recognized.

episodes.title: Episode 62
episodes.description: Catalina la Grande tries to find Santiago and his kids but he makes an irreversible decision and leaves a letter. Nachito wants to rescue his love.

episodes.title: Episode 63
episodes.description: Martina tries to kill Titi for all the humiliation he caused her. Catalina la Pequeña is suspicious of Mariana and talks to Hernán Darío.

episodes.title: Episode 64
episodes.description: Catalina la Grande and co. get ready to confront Las Diablas. Mariana and Sebastián leave because of their parents. Nacho tries to clear his name.

episodes.title: Episode 65
episodes.description: Catalina la Grande shows up heavily armed at Las Diablas' ranch and sparks a massacre. Hilda refuses to go with her family and everyone is shocked.

episodes.title: Episode 66
episodes.description: La Diabla takes Hilda to her new hiding place. A furious Catalina la Pequeña strangles Daniela. Catalina la Grande can't find her children.

episodes.title: Episode 67
episodes.description: Daniela escapes. Catalina la Grande is alone and suffering after her children and husband abandon her. Hilda considers teaming up with Yésica.

episodes.title: Episode 68
episodes.description: Albeiro and Yésica set up a meeting to exchange hostages. Catalina la Grande meets the new TEA boss. The new neighborhood pimp, Dayana, meets Titi.

episodes.title: Episode 69
episodes.description: Yésica coordinates the meeting with Albeiro for the exchange. The neighborhood pimp goes after Mariana and is surprised to see Catalina.

episodes.title: Episode 70
episodes.description: Catalina la Grande and her boss set up a secure area for the exchange. Dayana is ready to start recruiting her next victim: Mariana.

episodes.title: Episode 71
episodes.description: Gunfire starts at the exchange and Albeiro and Jota are trapped. Dayana gives Mariana a hallucinogenic and she takes it, unaware of the consequences.

episodes.title: Episode 72
episodes.description: Mariana is out of her mind due to the drugs and alcohol. She hallucinates that Titi is Hernán Darío and asks him to impregnate her.

episodes.title: Episode 73
episodes.description: Mariana is repulsed after unabashedly sleeping with Titi. Yésica coerces Albeiro into her bed and takes photos to show Hilda.

episodes.title: Episode 74
episodes.description: Catalina la Grande tells Mariana that she can get marijuana under three conditions. Hilda sends Albeiro a video message.

episodes.title: Episode 75
episodes.description: Yésica fantasizes about having a family with Albeiro. Catalina la Grande is planning to track Daniela so she can find La Diabla.

episodes.title: Episode 76
episodes.description: Catalina la Pequeña puts a tracker on Daniela and lets her go free. The TEA and the police take action. Gatillo betrays Las Diablas.

episodes.title: Episode 77
episodes.description: Mariana is willing to go to extremes to get Hernán. At Titi's request, Dayana convinces Mariana to visit him again.

episodes.title: Episode 78
episodes.description: Titi organizes Mariana's big birthday party. Catalina la Grande gives her daughter marijuana. Santiago tries to forget Catalina.

episodes.title: Episode 79
episodes.description: Las Diablas go to see the witch Abigail and Daniela asks her for some help. Catalina la Pequeña walks in on Hernán Darío and Dayana together.

episodes.title: Episode 80
episodes.description: La Diabla freezes Albeiro's semen so she can have his child. Hilda calls Albeiro out for his infidelity. Las Diablas show up in the neighborhood.

episodes.title: Episode 81
episodes.description: Yésica goes to an artificial insemination clinic. Hilda admits her feelings for Calvo to Albeiro. La Diabla hears from a secret admirer.

episodes.title: Episode 82
episodes.description: Las Diablas make it to Chalo's ranch and he decides to give Daniela the house. Catalina la Pequeña and Vanessa plan a trap. Dayana gets a beating.

episodes.title: Episode 83
episodes.description: Catalina la Grande finds out that Chalo is still alive and that he and La Diabla want to kill her. Hilda says that she'll never get back with Albeiro.

episodes.title: Episode 84
episodes.description: Albeiro is hurt by Hilda and turns to alcohol. Chalo has a proposition for Daniela. Everyone goes to Paola's daughter's funeral.

episodes.title: Episode 85
episodes.description: Yésica gives Albeiro a concoction that the witch Abigail prepared. Mariana goes to the birthday party Titi is throwing and he gives her a fancy gift.

episodes.title: Episode 86
episodes.description: Everything has a price for Las Diablas. The TEA deploys an operative to trap Yésica Beltrán. Daniel unleashes Daniela's fury.

episodes.title: Episode 87
episodes.description: Hours before the pageant, La Diabla tries to sway the judges' votes, unaware Catalina la Grande and her TEA partners are planning to capture her.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: The beauty pageant winner is crowned. An order to kill is issued. The TEA finds out that Yésica is using her sister's identity.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: A mother refuses to believe her daughter is dead and wants a different doctor to revive her. Mariana's daughter is born. Yésica receives a diagnosis.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: The TEA appoints Tony Campana as Catalina la Grande's bodyguard when they find out that Martín, the serial killer, has escaped from jail.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: When she wakes up, Catalina la Grande sees a yellow rose with a note that Martín left her. La Diabla parades Daniela through the neighborhood.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Catalina la Grande is willing to protect her daughter. Catalina la Mediana plans to kidnap Mariana's daughter to give her a DNA test.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: La Diabla tells a bewitched Albeiro that she froze his semen and hired a surrogate. The tension between Catalina la Grande and Albeiro explodes.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: The witch Abigaíl is targeted for failing to bring a dead person's spirit back to life. The spell on Albeiro is lifted.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Albeiro, conscious but tied up, convinces Yésica to let him go. Hilda shares secrets with Catalina la Grande. Yamilé escapes with La Diabla's son.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Yamilé tells Catalina about the hell she endured while on La Diabla's ranch. Hilda finds out that Albeiro has a child with Yésica.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: La Diabla stops El Cerdo from killing Albeiro and finds out that her child was kidnapped, so Calvo blackmails her. The authorities find a body.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.description: Catalina plans to capture El Titi and La Diabla. Yésica orders Calvo to kill Yamilé and bring her the child that night.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.description: Calvo sets out to prove his loyalty to La Diabla by following her orders. Catalina la Grande tells Hilda that Albeiro fell prey to black magic.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.description: El Titi surrenders at Catalina's feet. La Diabla orders Calvo to kill Hilda. El Chalo finds out that Albeiro is at the ranch with Daniela.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.description: La Diabla returns to the ranch with an army to save Albeiro and her son from the hands of El Chalo and get back her daughter, who has been embalmed.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.description: La Diabla orders photographic proof be taken of her latest feat, and makes a deal with Albeiro. Catalina la Grande tries to escape.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.description: Catalina goes to live with El Titi to trap him. Catalina la Mediana gives her boyfriend's daughter a DNA test. La Diabla negotiates with the TEA.

episodes.title: Episode 17
episodes.description: While Catalina la Grande distracts Cabras with an exotic dance, the TEA carries out the raid to find El Titi. Yésica is crazy about Albeiro.

episodes.title: Episode 18
episodes.description: In order to jumpstart her business again, La Diabla decides to stop the war with her enemy. Albeiro takes advantage of Yésica's absence to escape.

episodes.title: Episode 19
episodes.description: El Titi professes his love for Catalina. Mariana is alone with the baby and Martín comes into the mansion. La Diabla organizes a meeting with Aurelio.

episodes.title: Episode 20
episodes.description: Catalina takes control in order to rescue Mariana and her granddaughter from Martín's grip. La Diabla is anxious when she doesn't hear from Albeiro.

episodes.title: Episode 21
episodes.description: Catalina avoids a shoot-out with the TEA and escapes. She feels unsafe and flees with her family. La Diabla orders Calvo to kidnap Albeiro.

episodes.title: Episode 22
episodes.description: La Diabla suffers a betrayal that gives Catalina la Grande a juicy opportunity. Hilda asks Albeiro if Yésica's child is his. El Titi flees.

episodes.title: Episode 23
episodes.description: Catalina helps the TEA to score a huge win, but a later accusation made against her changes her feelings toward the agency.

episodes.title: Episode 24
episodes.description: Desperate for information about El Chalo, the TEA enters into a negotiation with their prisoner, behind the Colombian government's back.

episodes.title: Episode 25
episodes.description: To finalize the deal with the TEA, the prisoner will need to be extradited to the U.S. Dayana wants Catalina la Mediana's head and seduces Villa.

episodes.title: Episode 26
episodes.description: Lucía has hell in store for her after she is kidnapped. Albeiro reveals who the love of his life is. Yésica moves to a bunker.

episodes.title: Episode 27
episodes.description: Santiago receives joyous news. La Diabla meets Lucrecia. Lucía attempts to escape from her captor.

episodes.title: Episode 28
episodes.description: Albeiro is confused about his feelings and can't manage to get Catalina out of his mind. He calls her but she is with Santiago.

episodes.title: Episode 29
episodes.description: Albeiro admits that he has always been in love with Catalina but Hilda is his here and now. Zoraya escapes from the hospital and plots revenge.

episodes.title: Episode 30
episodes.description: Catalina and Santiago tell Hernán Darío that they're going back to Miami and that they fear for their daughter's and granddaughter's lives.

episodes.title: Episode 31
episodes.description: Catalina la Mediana gives Nachito the DNA results. La Diabla refuses a proposal. The doctor tells Hilda her presence helps bring back Carlos's memory.

episodes.title: Episode 32
episodes.description: Mariana refuses to give her daughter another DNA test but Hernán Darío demands it. Hilda talks to Albeiro about Carlos and he agrees to help him.

episodes.title: Episode 33
episodes.description: Everyone believes the curse of the five women in the neighborhood has been lifted. Lucrecia gives La Diabla some advice. Nachito makes a promise.

episodes.title: Episode 34
episodes.description: Mexico's second biggest drug trafficker gives the order to kill Catalina's sister. El Titi warns her and she decides to go back to the TEA.

episodes.title: Episode 35
episodes.description: Catalina la Grande finds out who the father of her granddaughter is. La Diabla makes an outrageous demand.

episodes.title: Episode 36
episodes.description: Catalina la Grande is more determined than ever to capture El Titi. Mariana forms an alliance with Dayana.

episodes.title: Episode 37
episodes.description: When she realizes that she won't be a good mother, Mariana decides to flee and live the life she's dreamed of. Strange things happen in the town.

episodes.title: Episode 38
episodes.description: Mariana tells the father of her baby about his child. The TEA changes tactics regarding the extradition of its prisoner.

episodes.title: Episode 39
episodes.description: As revenge, Mariana plans to bomb Hernán Darío's house and blow up him and Catalina la Mediana together. La Diabla has a hidden enemy.

episodes.title: Episode 40
episodes.description: El Titi and Villa find out about the extradition to the United States and make a plan. Daniel wakes up in the hospital.

episodes.title: Episode 41
episodes.description: While the TEA relocates its prisoner, El Titi's thugs lie in wait to execute his plan. Jota repents. Miguel gives something to Yésica.

episodes.title: Episode 42
episodes.description: The attack results in a bloody scene, with more than one casualty. Mariana finds out that her daughter is in Nachito's house.

episodes.title: Episode 43
episodes.description: Mariana and her baby's father race against the clock to rescue their daughter in time. Zoraya learns she saved the life of La Mano Negra.

episodes.title: Episode 44
episodes.description: The doctors fight to save Hernán Darío's life. Unconscious, Nachito remembers what happened. Catalina la Grande is reunited with her father.

episodes.title: Episode 45
episodes.description: Upon hearing that only a miracle can save Hernán Darío, Catalina la Mediana accuses Mariana of being responsible.

episodes.title: Episode 46
episodes.description: Catalina la Grande and the others don't know that Paola is under Laura's spell. La Mano Negra gives Zoraya and Mateo a new identity.

episodes.title: Episode 47
episodes.description: Hilda begins to doubt when she sees Albeiro and Catalina la Grande. Zoraya and Mateo leave their past behind. Mariana hatches a plan.

episodes.title: Episode 48
episodes.description: Albeiro confesses to Hilda that he will never forget Catalina la Grande. Catalina and Santiago lament upon learning their granddaughter was stolen.

episodes.title: Episode 49
episodes.description: El Titi is thrilled with his new role. Catalina la Grande hides information from the police. Hilda dresses Carlos in Albeiro's clothes.

episodes.title: Episode 50
episodes.description: Catalina la Grande receives a big career opportunity. La Diabla already has her child in her hands. Zoraya learns part of La Mano Negra's plan.

episodes.title: Episode 51
episodes.description: Mariana risks revealing to Titi that her mother is a TEA agent, but he doesn't believe it. La Diabla has a blood sample from Albeiro.

episodes.title: Episode 52
episodes.description: Regretfully, Catalina la Grande confesses that she will pursue her own daughter like any other drug trafficker. La Diabla needs a face transplant.

episodes.title: Episode 53
episodes.description: Yésica Beltrán faces a harsh reality. A loved one is buried. El Titi is attracted to Mariana, who finds files that may help him.

episodes.title: Episode 54
episodes.description: Nachito believes that he does not have much time left and his last wish is to marry his love. La Diabla risks changing her face. Titi gets a DNA test.

episodes.title: Episode 55
episodes.description: The doctor agrees to operate on La Diabla, who asks for a new identity and donor. Catalina la Grande is appointed to her new position.

episodes.title: Episode 56
episodes.description: Titi asks Mariana what she would like to study. She responds: the drug trafficking business. Catalina is sent to watch La Diabla's mother's house.

episodes.title: Episode 57
episodes.description: El Titi is surprised to hear that Mariana hates her mother and will stop at nothing to avenge her. Martín shows up at the clinic.

episodes.title: Episode 58
episodes.description: Calvo helps La Diabla choose a new face for her transplant. Catalina and Nachito prepare their wedding. El Titi decides to put Mariana on the job.

episodes.title: Episode 59
episodes.description: After so many obstacles, Catalina la Mediana and Nachito get married in the hospital. Mariana tries to create her own cartel. Daniel meets Martín.

episodes.title: Episode 60
episodes.description: While Nachito is suffering, Catalina la Mediana makes a discovery. La Diabla undergoes her transplant. Mendieta plots against Tony and Santiago.

episodes.title: Episode 61
episodes.description: Following instructions, Santiago goes to the motel where he thinks Catalina la Grande and her escort are staying. Nachito gets a message from Marcial.

episodes.title: Episode 62
episodes.description: Catalina la Grande loses trust in Santiago after seeing the mounting evidence. Daniel attempts to save Lucía. Jota falls into Laura's hands.

episodes.title: Episode 63
episodes.description: Catalina has no idea that her biggest enemy is so close. La Diabla infiltrates the TEA with her new face and a different name.

title: DAHMER - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story
originalTitle: DAHMER - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story
description: This series examines the gruesome and horrific true crimes of Jeffrey Dahmer and the systemic failures that enabled one of America’s most notorious serial killers to continue his murderous spree in plain sight for over a decade.

episodes.title: Episode One
episodes.description: After throwing his neighbor off the stench coming from his apartment, Jeff heads to a local bar, where a stranger takes him up on a tempting offer.

episodes.title: Please Don't Go
episodes.description: A young Jeff contends with troubles at home and school. Years later, his strange behavior evolves into murderous deeds that slip past the police.

episodes.title: Doin' a Dahmer
episodes.description: Left to live alone after his parents' turbulent divorce, high school senior Jeff breaks routine when he invites a hitchhiker into his home.

episodes.title: The Good Boy Box
episodes.description: From high school to the Army, Jeff struggles to find stability. While living in his grandmother's house, Jeff begins targeting young men at gay bars.

episodes.title: Blood on Their Hands
episodes.description: Jeff's list of victims grows longer without a full police investigation. An encounter with a teen lands him in jail. Later, he gets his own apartment.

episodes.title: Silenced
episodes.description: Aspiring model Tony moves to Madison and meets Jeff at a bar, beginning a relationship through handwritten notes that takes a dark turn.

episodes.title: Cassandra
episodes.description: A prominent activist meets with Glenda, who recounts her harrowing experiences living next door to Jeff and how her concerns went largely ignored.

episodes.title: Lionel
episodes.description: As Jeff awaits trial, his father deals with his own demons, the Milwaukee police try to save face and the victims' families share their stories.

episodes.title: The Bogeyman
episodes.description: Glenda, the victims and their families do their best to move forward despite haunting memories, while Jeff attracts fanfare from behind bars.

episodes.title: God of Forgiveness, God of Vengeance
episodes.description: In prison, Jeff's newfound fame makes him a target. His parents seek closure and Glenda pushes for a memorial on familiar grounds to honor the victims.

title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
description: Will, a street-smart teenager, moves from the tough streets of West Philly to posh Bel-Air to live with his Uncle Philip, Aunt Vivian, his cousins — spoiled Hilary, preppy Carlton and young Ashley — and their sophisticated British butler, Geoffrey. Though Will’s antics and upbringing contrast greatly with the upper-class lifestyle of his extended relatives, he soon finds himself right at home as a loved part of the family.

episodes.title: The Fresh Prince Project
episodes.description: Aunt Vivian tries to mediate between her husband Philip and the newly arrived Will.

episodes.title: Bang the Drum, Ashley
episodes.description: Will persuades Ashley to pawn her violin for a drum set.

episodes.title: Clubba Hubba
episodes.description: Will wants to go out with a beautiful girl he meets at the country club, but first he must figure out how to impress her extremely snobbish and very protective father so he seeks tips from cousin Carlton on becoming preppie.

episodes.title: Not with My Pig, You Don't
episodes.description: Will tries to smooth things between Philip and his very rural parents when they visit to see him receive an award.

episodes.title: Homeboy, Sweet Homeboy
episodes.description: Will gets a visit from an old pal named Ice Tray, who, to Vivian and Philip's dismay, warms up to Hilary.

episodes.title: Mistaken Identity
episodes.description: Jailed, Will and Carlton stage a media stunt.

episodes.title: Def Poet's Society
episodes.description: Will joins his prep school's poetry club.

episodes.title: Someday Your Prince Will Be in Effect (1)
episodes.description: Carlton and Will, babe magnets. Who will be first to get a date for Hilary's Halloween party?

episodes.title: Someday Your Prince Will Be in Effect (2)
episodes.description: Carlton and Will, babe magnets. Who will be first to get a date for Hilary's Halloween party?

episodes.title: Kiss My Butler
episodes.description: Happy birthday Geoffrey! For a gift, Will tries matchmaking, then falls for Geoffrey's date himself.

episodes.title: Courting Disaster
episodes.description: Carlton feels overshadowed by Will, who's become a basketball star at school.

episodes.title: Talking Turkey
episodes.description: A holiday visit from Will's taskmaster mother puts the kibosh on conspicuous consumption and puts the kids to work preparing Thanksgiving dinner.

episodes.title: Knowledge is Power
episodes.description: Hilary becomes Will's personal maid when he threatens to disclose she's dropped out of UCLA.

episodes.title: Day Damn One
episodes.description: Will tells Ashley's slumber party guests a scary tale about his first day at Bel-Air Academy.

episodes.title: Deck the Halls
episodes.description: Will inimitably dresses the mansion for the holidays, to the dismay of the neighbors, including heavyweight boxing champion Evander Holyfield.

episodes.title: The Lucky Charm
episodes.description: Philip may lose a superstitious client whom he advises not to make decisions based on Will's spontaneous remarks.

episodes.title: The Ethnic Tip
episodes.description: Will proposes a black history class be instituted at Bel-Air Academy, and gets a surprise when Aunt Viv arrives to teach it.

episodes.title: The Young and the Restless
episodes.description: Will sneaks Philip's elderly mother out of the house for a night on the town.

episodes.title: It Had to Be You
episodes.description: Will has girl problems after a date with Jazz's domineering sister, who's ready to pick out a china pattern before the night is over.

episodes.title: Nice Lady
episodes.description: Fresh Prince Will is on his best behavior for visiting royalty - the seemingly demure Lady Penelope, who Will hopes to persuade to let herself have a good time at a party.

episodes.title: Love at First Fight
episodes.description: Jasmine Guy plays a scholarship student whose introduction to Will opens up a different world of fun and games - and romance - to divert her from her studies.

episodes.title: Banks Shot
episodes.description: Will crawls to Philip for help after sneaking out on the town and getting hustled by sleazy pool sharks.

episodes.title: 72 Hours
episodes.description: Will challenges Carlton to spend time in a tough neighborhood, trying to survive by masquerading as a financial consultant.

episodes.title: Just Infatuation
episodes.description: R&B singer Tevin Campbell plays teen idol Little T, who surprises Ashley on her birthday with a special song and an invitation for a date.

episodes.title: Working It Out
episodes.description: Rap's Queen Latifah plays Hilary's new actress boss, who wants Will as her boy toy - or Hilary's glamorous job is over.

episodes.title: Did the Earth Move for You?
episodes.description: Will's all-consuming romance with a new girlfriend shakes up the Banks' household, as does Mother Nature, trapping them together during an earthquake.

episodes.title: The Mother of All Battles
episodes.description: Will and Carlton arrive as reinforcements when a bully challenges Ashley to a rumble, but there's real trouble when Philip and Vivian intervene.

episodes.title: Will Gets a Job
episodes.description: Will tries to juggle school and a new job in order to earn money for the homecoming party, at the same time Ashley's classmate Tina becomes interested in Carlton. Will starts becoming paranoid when he constantly is getting confused with Carlton.

episodes.title: PSAT Pstory
episodes.description: Will is a picture of confidence, while Carlton is a frazzled bundle of nerves preparing for college aptitude tests.

episodes.title: Granny Gets Busy
episodes.description: Mortified over spying his mother kiss the handyman, Philip can't bear to think of her having a new man in her life.

episodes.title: Guess Who's Coming to Marry?
episodes.description: Tensions spill over just before the wedding of Will's Aunt Janice when Will's mom meets Janice's intended - and forbids Will to attend the interracial wedding.

episodes.title: The Big Four-Oh
episodes.description: Vivian's 40th birthday marks a crisis and a career change in which she plans to perfect her dance skills.

episodes.title: She Ain't Heavy
episodes.description: Will hits it off with the full-figured Dee Dee, but her size keeps him from asking her to the dance.

episodes.title: Cased Up
episodes.description: A pompous lawyer who's dating Hilary is no fan of Will's after he's sideswiped by Will's roadster.

episodes.title: Hi-Ho Silver
episodes.description: Will and Carlton think a party guest stole the silverware.

episodes.title: The Butler Did It
episodes.description: Bell Biv DeVoe shoots a video at the Bankses, courtesy of Carlton, who rents the house while his parents are away.

episodes.title: Something for Nothing
episodes.description: After winning at the country club's Monte Carlo night fund-raiser, Will learns that he's expected to donate the money to charity.

episodes.title: Christmas Show
episodes.description: On a family ski trip, the Banks find that they must come up with Christmas gifts from the heart after their belongings are stolen.

episodes.title: Hilary Gets a Life
episodes.description: Hilary must work for a caterer after her credit cards are cancelled.

episodes.title: My Brother's Keeper
episodes.description: On the basketball court, winning is everything to Will, as it is to an opponent from Malibu Prep, who can't afford to lose.

episodes.title: Geoffrey Cleans Up
episodes.description: Geoffrey falls hard for a neighbor he believes is a housekeeper - but who turns out to be very wealthy.

episodes.title: Community Action
episodes.description: When Hillary is ordered to do community service at a free clinic, the doctor in charge becomes the antidote for her marriage-mindedness.

episodes.title: Ill Will
episodes.description: The family fears a steamy exposé when Geoffrey begins his memoirs, while Will fears the scalpel when he enters the hospital, kicking and screaming, for a tonsillectomy.

episodes.title: Eyes on the Prize
episodes.description: Needing a game show partner, Will must choose between bickering friends.

episodes.title: Those Were the Days
episodes.description: Philip and Vivian welcome a '60s radical, who arouses the FBI's interest and influences Will and Carlton to take action over the firing of a nonconformist teacher.

episodes.title: Vying for Attention
episodes.description: Will dislikes his mother's new boyfriend.

episodes.title: The Aunt Who Came to Dinner
episodes.description: Aunt Helen arrives unexpectedly, and upsets Will and Carlton's plans for a rendezvous with two French women.

episodes.title: Be My Baby Tonight
episodes.description: Ashley cringes when the family oohs and aahs over her relationship with Kevin , but Will chokes when she asks him about sex - and her curiosity about reproduction sends Will to a pregnancy counseling center.

episodes.title: Strip-Tease for Two
episodes.description: Will and Carlton lose their shirts investing on a tip - then take jobs as strippers to recoup their losses and get Vivian's bracelet out of hock.

episodes.title: How I Spent My Summer Vacation
episodes.description: Will returns home from spending the summer in Philadelphia with a new look that doesn't sit well with Uncle Phil.

episodes.title: Will Gets Committed
episodes.description: When the Banks family returns to its former neighborhood to help old friends after a destructive city-wide riot, Vivian reveals a surprise to Philip.

episodes.title: That's No Lady, That's My Cousin
episodes.description: Enrolled at the newly coed Bel-Air Prep, Ashley begins dressing to entice guys, using Will's preferences in women as her examples.

episodes.title: Hilary Gets a Job
episodes.description: Hilary gets a job reporting weather on television.

episodes.title: Mama's Baby, Carlton's Maybe
episodes.description: Carlton prepares for a dinner date with his former girlfriend, Cindy (Lark Voorhees), forgiving her for rejecting him several months earlier, but when she arrives with a newborn baby named Carlton Jr., the entire Banks family is stunned.

episodes.title: P.S. I Love You
episodes.description: While Philip entertains rude, senile Judge Robertson, Will accepts expensive gifts from Lindsey Simon, a rich classmate who wants to buy his affection.

episodes.title: Here Comes the Judge
episodes.description: Will gets arrested for numerous parking tickets as Phil runs for judge against incumbent Judge Robertson.

episodes.title: Boyz in the Woods
episodes.description: Philip takes Will and Carlton on a camping trip that turns out to be a disaster when snow traps the unhappy campers.

episodes.title: A Night at the Oprah
episodes.description: The Bankses appear on Oprah's show and fail to invite Will on-stage, which may cause Philip to lose the election.

episodes.title: Asses to Ashes
episodes.description: Election results are in and Philip fights to remain cool amid lies by Judge Robertson, which prompt Will to confront the outspoken incumbent. Will Will go to far? Will he say what everyone is feeling? Will Judge Robertson be able to take it?

episodes.title: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
episodes.description: At Vivian's Lamaze class, Will cozies up to a pregnant sportswriter, who takes him to a game - and delivers more than just fun.

episodes.title: The Cold War
episodes.description: When Vivian quarantines Will and Carlton in the backyard pool house after both are stricken with contagious colds, they spend the night arguing over a girl that Will stole from Carlton.

episodes.title: Mommy Nearest
episodes.description: Will tries to tell his mother that he doesn't want to return to Philadelphia with her after his high school graduation.

episodes.title: Winner Takes Off
episodes.description: Geoffrey humiliates himself by insulting the Banks family and quitting his job when Will and Carlton trick him into thinking he has won millions of dollars in the lottery.

episodes.title: Robbing the Banks
episodes.description: Philip is quick to judge an ex-con Will urged him to hire as a handyman and temporary assistant after the house is robbed.

episodes.title: Bundle of Joy
episodes.description: As Vivian's delivery date approaches, the family fantasizes about what the baby will mean to each of them: Ashley feels all but invisible, Geoffrey feels overwhelmed by the family's demands, and Vivian feels like she's having triplets.

episodes.title: The Best Laid Plans
episodes.description: When Monique refuses to have sex until she's married, Will stages a mock wedding ceremony with D.J. Jazzy Jeff as the preacher.

episodes.title: The Alma Matter
episodes.description: Depressed and suicidal over having ruined his chances of attending Princeton University, Carlton is visited by his Guardian Angel, who shows him how awful the Banks family would be if he weren't alive.

episodes.title: Just Say Yo
episodes.description: Will learns a sobering lesson after Carlton pops the wrong pills from Will's locker, mistaking amphetamines for vitamins, and winds up in hospital.

episodes.title: The Baby Comes Out
episodes.description: Vivian's baby is a week late, but family members and her visiting sisters are nowhere to be found when it's time to rush to the hospital.

episodes.title: You Bet Your Life
episodes.description: Heavyweight boxing champ Riddick Brown wreaks havoc with Carlton's mind and Will's face at a funky cafe-casino in Nevada, where the cousins have stopped on their way to check out a college for Will.

episodes.title: Ain't No Business Like Show Business
episodes.description: Will lands a spot in a comedy showcase after accompanying a comic friend to an audition.

episodes.title: The Way We Were
episodes.description: Series clips illustrate family recollections as the kids put together a scrapbook for Vivian and Philip, who want to renew their vows on their anniversary.

episodes.title: Six Degrees of Graduation
episodes.description: Vy anticipates Will's graduation with enthusiasm, but there may be discord when she learns Will is failing music. To pass his music class, Will must sing at the graduation ceremony - with a class of eight-year-olds.

episodes.title: Where There's a Will, There's a Way (1)
episodes.description: Will and Carlton begin their first year of college by moving into their own apartment, while Philip and Vivian enjoy their newborn son. Hilary learns that Trevor plans to propose marriage to her during an elaborate stunt on his TV news show.

episodes.title: Where There's a Will, There's a Way (2)
episodes.description: Will and Carlton begin their first year of college by moving into their own apartment, while Philip and Vivian enjoy their newborn son. Hilary learns that Trevor plans to propose marriage to her during an elaborate stunt on his TV news show.

episodes.title: All Guts, No Glory
episodes.description: Registration day finds Will signing up for no-brainer classes, plus one that might truly challenge him - a philosophy course he takes to meet a girl.

episodes.title: Father of the Year
episodes.description: Stuck with caring for Nicky for the day, Will soon discovers the benefits of baby-sitting: he's suddenly a big man on campus with the women so long as he poses as a single dad.

episodes.title: It's Better to Have Loved and Lost It...
episodes.description: After Will's friends guys rib Carlton about being a virgin, Miss Right appears and sweeps Carlton off his feet. Elsewhere, Geoffrey confesses a secret of his own.

episodes.title: Will Goes a-Courtin'
episodes.description: When Phillip sues Will and Carlton for unpaid rent, two different versions of the dispute are aired - neither entirely truthful.

episodes.title: Hex and the Single Guy
episodes.description: Will disses a seance - until the spiritualist zaps him with a hex that (uh-oh) seems to work.

episodes.title: Blood is Thicker Than Mud
episodes.description: A bro with dough? Carlton's upper-class upbringing may make him unwelcome at a black fraternity.

episodes.title: Fresh Prince After Dark
episodes.description: Will breaks a date with Jackie to accompany Hilary to a Playboy Mansion reception for weather reporters being photographed for the magazine.

episodes.title: Home is Where the Heart Attack Is
episodes.description: Will sneaks greasy, high-fat foods to Philip after he promises to diet and exercise, then blames himself when Philip has a heart attack.

episodes.title: Take My Cousin... Please
episodes.description: On academic probation, Will schemes to improve his grades by fixing up a newly divorced English professor with Hilary, who soon finds fault with the man, further jeopardizing Will's academic future.

episodes.title: You've Got to Be a Football Hero
episodes.description: Will uses booze to prove his manliness while competing with a hulking football hero who wants to score points with Jackie, and his fraternity brothers leave drunken Will in a cemetery, where he is haunted. Meanwhile, Ashley learns that beauty is in the eye of the beholder.

episodes.title: 'Twas the Night Before Christening
episodes.description: Vivian promises god-motherhood of her child to both of her sisters, while Will hatches a harebrained scheme to get Boyz II Men to perform at baby Nicky's christening.

episodes.title: Sleepless in Bel-Air
episodes.description: Will pays for putting off studying for a midterm until the last minute, and Ashley pays for staying out late on her first date.

episodes.title: Who's the Boss
episodes.description: Carlton in charge. Will gets his feathers ruffled when his cousin becomes his boss at the Peacock Stop.

episodes.title: I Know Why the Caged Bird Screams
episodes.description: Bird is the word when Carlton, ULA's peacock mascot, is kidnapped by a rival school before the big game.

episodes.title: When You Hit Upon a Star
episodes.description: Will becomes a jet-setter while dating a pop star.

episodes.title: Stop Will! In the Name of Love
episodes.description: A Valentine's double date finds Will treating Ashley like a kid and Ashley demanding r-e-s-p-e-c-t.

episodes.title: You'd Better Shop Around
episodes.description: A car dealer hires Will, then persuades him to drop out of college.

episodes.title: The Ol' Ball and Chain
episodes.description: Jazz's bride has a couple of teensy character flaws: She's a convict. And she puts the moves on Will.

episodes.title: The Harder They Fall
episodes.description: Will finds himself stranded in a mountain forest with his new girlfriend's disagreeable father after they parachute out of his disabled plane.

episodes.title: M is for the Many Things She Gave Me
episodes.description: It's double trouble for Will when Philip's old flame visits with her daughter, who's attracted to Will.

episodes.title: Mother's Day
episodes.description: Say, homie, could you do me a favor? Just-married Jazz makes a surprising request of Will.

episodes.title: Papa's Got a Brand-New Excuse
episodes.description: Ben Vereen plays Will's long-lost father, who breezes into town and promises Will the moon, which angers an unforgiving Philip.

episodes.title: For Sale by Owner
episodes.description: A stranger makes a generous offer for the Banks estate, which prompts the family to reminisce about their good times there.

episodes.title: The Philadelphia Story
episodes.description: Will returns to the City of Brotherly Love and discovers he's the butt of old friends' jokes, prompting him to go into training to settle an old score and clear his reputation as a chicken.

episodes.title: The Client
episodes.description: Will revels in Ashley's music industry success, but both Will and Ashley are about to have a rude surprise.

episodes.title: What's Will Got to Do With It?
episodes.description: Will helps Ashley make a big impression on a recording executive, but Philip is adamantly against her pursuing a singing career.

episodes.title: Reality Bites
episodes.description: Will loses points as a role model for Nicky while visiting an ever-positive kiddie hero who brings joy to youngsters - but not to Will.

episodes.title: Grumpy Young Men
episodes.description: War breaks out when the girl Will likes plants a big one on Carlton.

episodes.title: Fresh Prince: The Movie
episodes.description: Will tells a tall tale about seeing a mob killing, then being placed in a witness-protection program in the backwoods of Alabama.

episodes.title: Will's Misery
episodes.description: The Banks hate the ugly golf shirts Hilary gives them - until they see Kareem Abdul-Jabbar wearing the same design.

episodes.title: Father Knows Best
episodes.description: To help Ashley out of a jam at school, Will poses as her father. Oh yeah, this is gonna work.

episodes.title: Soooooooul Train
episodes.description: At a Soul Train reunion, middle-aged Philip feels like his train has left the station.

episodes.title: Love Hurts
episodes.description: Lisa humiliates Will by knocking out a guy with her self-defense moves.

episodes.title: Will's Up a Dirt Road
episodes.description: Will tries his hand at journalism to prove something to Lisa, but his efforts get him sued for libel - by Jay Leno.

episodes.title: Will Steps Out
episodes.description: To understand Philip's battle with the scale, Will dons a fat suit and gets a big fat lesson in empathy.

episodes.title: Same Game, Next Season
episodes.description: Will works so hard to impress Lisa's dad that he spends all his free time with his new best buddy.

episodes.title: Three's a Crowd
episodes.description: Will gets roped into a weekend ski trip with Carlton that quickly turns to disaster when their party arrives; meanwhile, back home, Hilary prepares to leave the nest.

episodes.title: It's a Wonderful Lie
episodes.description: The party's over. Will and Lisa tell each other lies so they can sneak off to the (uh-oh) same party.

episodes.title: Bullets Over Bel-Air
episodes.description: A planned camping trip is cut short for Carlton and Will when a robber approaches them at an automated bank-teller machine - and fires a gun.

episodes.title: A Decent Proposal
episodes.description: Mr. and Mrs. Smith? Will pops the question from his hospital room. And Lisa's answer is...

episodes.title: Will is from Mars...
episodes.description: Thanks to relationship counseling, Will and Lisa hop to move on up to a new understanding in preparation for marriage. Meanwhile Hillary wants Geoffrey to work at her new home.

episodes.title: The Wedding Show (Psyche!)
episodes.description: Shafted! The engaged couple opts for flashy Vegas vows, complete with costumes. The tasteful theme: Shaft.

episodes.title: Slum Like It... Not!
episodes.description: Will vows Philip with his sound investment advice to buy Jazz's apartment building - but the tenants scream slumlord after Philip acts on Will's moneymaking tip.

episodes.title: As the Will Turns
episodes.description: Will inadvertently finds himself in the right place at the right time and lands a part in a daytime soap opera.

episodes.title: Save the Last Trance for Me
episodes.description: Put into a trance by a stage hypnotist, Will behaves like a 4-year-old just as the family gears up for an interview with the admissions head of a private school.

episodes.title: To Thine Own Self Be Blue... and Gold
episodes.description: A dream job for Will with a businessman friend of Philip's turns into a nightmare when the man offers him a bonus to help bribe a councilman.

episodes.title: Cold Feet, Hot Body
episodes.description: Dinner date. The Banks host a gorgeous girl from Philly who tries to lure Will away from Lisa.

episodes.title: Love in an Elevator
episodes.description: Stuck and out of luck, Will spends his bachelor party trapped in an elevator with a feuding Carlton and Jazz.

episodes.title: For Whom the Wedding Bells Toll
episodes.description: Husband-to-be Will has the bride, the ring, the date...and second thoughts about the whole idea.

title: Ben 10
description: When 10-year-old Ben Tennyson discovers a mysterious device, he gains the power to change into ten different alien heroes, each with uniquely awesome powers. With such abilities at his disposal, Ben realizes a greater responsibility to help others and stop evildoers, but that doesn't mean he's above a little superpowered mischief now and then.

episodes.title: And Then There Were 10
episodes.description: Average kid, ten year old Ben Tennyson, his Grandpa Max and his cousin Gwen's summer of adventure takes an odd turn when Ben discovers a watch like object  that has been jettisoned from alien spacecraft high above the Earth.

episodes.title: Washington B.C.
episodes.description: Ben must fight Dr. Animo, a crazed scientist who has a DNA-altering device.

episodes.title: The Krakken
episodes.description: Ben has his hands full with a giant sea monster and an evil poacher.

episodes.title: Permanent Retirement
episodes.description: Ben must rescue his aunt and grandfather when they are held hostage by shape-shifting aliens.

episodes.title: Hunted
episodes.description: Ben is pursued by three bounty hunters sent by Vilgax to steal the Omnitrix.

episodes.title: Tourist Trap
episodes.description: Ben accidentally releases creatures made of electric energy and must use his own powers to recapture them.

episodes.title: Kevin 11
episodes.description: Ben meets a mutant who can absorb any form of energy and may be after the Omnitrix.

episodes.title: The Alliance
episodes.description: Ben clashes with a female gang member who's become part cyborg.

episodes.title: Last Laugh
episodes.description: Ben discovers an evil circus that's headed by a psychic vampire clown named Zombozo.

episodes.title: Lucky Girl
episodes.description: Ben battles a sorcerer who possesses a number of charms, and Gwen suddenly becomes a superhero when one of the charms falls into her hands.

episodes.title: A Small Problem
episodes.description: Ben gets revenge on an amusement-park attendant who said he was too small to go on a ride.

episodes.title: Side Effects
episodes.description: Ben's summer cold causes strange physical changes in his alien personas.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.description: Vilgax tries to get the Omnitrix for himself while Grandpa Max's strange past becomes known, causing a showdown between Vilgax and the Tennyson family.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.description: After the battle with Vilgax, Grandpa Max retells his story to Ben about his past. He was with an organization that was not known to exist, referred to as "The Plumbers," a group of people who track down extraterrestrial life. Meanwhile, they meet Phil, an old partner of Grandpa Max. But they soon find out that he steals a device, called the Null Void Projector, to selfishly use it to make money by appearing to capture aliens that he alone released himself.

episodes.title: The Big Tick
episodes.description: At Yellowstone Park, Ben and Gwen inadvertently discover a new form on the Omnitrix: Cannon Bolt, an armadillo-like alien that Ben isn't too fond of. Soon after, a meteor comes crashing down to the park, containing a planet-devouring, tick-like alien. On top of that, three other aliens arrive with it, and worship it as their savior, the "Great One." Powerless to stop the planet-eater with his regular forms, Ben must rely on a new form he knows nothing about.

episodes.title: Framed
episodes.description: At a city, Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max are waiting outside a video game store to purchase the newly-released Sumo Slammer video game. Gwen and Grandpa Max go the book store, but when they return to check on him, Four Arms comes out of the store by force. They return to the RV, and find that Ben is already there. Gwen yells at Ben for what he's done, but he has no clue of what she's talking about. But as she gives direct evidence that Four Arms was attacking the city, Ben heads out to find the perpetrator, using the identity of his aliens to ruin his current reputation as a hero.

episodes.title: Gwen 10
episodes.description: In this "how 'bout?" episode, Gwen gets the Omnitrix and the power that comes with it.

episodes.title: Grudge Match
episodes.description: In the middle of nowhere, Ben, as Diamond Head, fights Kevin 11, who is still in his mutated form. As they fight, they are taken to a ship, where a battle between different aliens are held. But when a mechanical droid named Slix decides to create a bond with Ben and Kevin as a team, they immediately turn his idea down. But with no choice, they must find a way out. Will Ben and Kevin learn the importance of teamwork?

episodes.title: The Galactic Enforcers
episodes.description: At a museum, Ben sits and reads a comic, daydreaming about himself as a super hero. As Gwen interrupts him, she is not happy how Ben treats the artwork. His day has been a bore, but when an alien vessel arrives, an alien named Volcanus and the bounty hunter Sixsix come to pursue the Biocenthium alloy to complete a mixture with Element X to create a bomb, strong enough to destroy a whole solar system. Suddenly, Ben meets The Galactic Enforcers, a group of three who serve in protecting the galaxy under the conduct code. Ben is intrigued by their heroic appearance, but are they really something to be looking up to?

episodes.title: Camp Fear
episodes.description: When Ben and Gwen argue over a birthday party to occur in the next few months, Grandpa Max is distracted by their quarreling and almost hits a young boy camper. To ensure the boy's life, they head to Camp Opinicon, only to find no people around. As they investigate the premises, they find twins, whom were also hiding from something that may have a connection to the lifeless camp. Grandpa Max readies to leave the area with the children, only to find that the RV's engine is clogged with a mysterious fungus. While the kids take in shelter in a nearby cabin, Grandpa Max is captured. Now Ben must come to the rescue to discover a new alien form, as well as a way to destroy the evil alien Myceloid Monsters and their Fungal Master, and learn the benefits of what sharing can do.

episodes.title: Ultimate Weapon
episodes.description: In Texas, a group of men discover a mysterious mask belonging to Ah Puch, the Mayan god of death and destruction. The mask is the key to the ultimate weapon in the world, known as the Sword of Ekchuah. However, when Grandpa Max and his grandkids learn that the mask is discovered, he impatiently sets out to obtain the mask, so that it does not fall in the wrong hands. Unfortunately, they find out that Enoch of The Organization is after it as well. The kids worry of how Grandpa Max has become, but with Enoch in the way, will Grandpa Max find the sword before him?

episodes.title: Tough Luck
episodes.description: Hex's niece, Charmcaster, enters the underground prison he's held at to release him out of his cell. With her help, Hex was able to regain most of his powers after being given his magical staff. Meanwhile, Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max head to a magic convention held in Las Vegas, and in there, Gwen finds the legendary Keystone of Bazell. With it, she gains the powers of Lucky Girl once again, but will it last after finding out that Hex and his niece are after it?

episodes.title: They Lurk Below
episodes.description: Our heroes ride a jet belonging to Grandpa Max's old Friend, Donovan Grand Smith, who owns an underwater resort. At the entrance, they receive a warm welcome from Donovan himself, though they also meet with his grandson, Edwin, who didn't seem to be excited about their guests. Later, when Edwin, Ben, and Gwen enter the Undersea Manta Ray, a giant submarine, they encounter strange aliens that threatened to destroy the whole resort. While the kids find a way to cooperate with each other to find the source that lures them in, Donovan himself learns a few lessons in how to bond better with his grandson.

episodes.title: Ghostfreaked Out
episodes.description: A terrorizing nightmare of Ghostfreak is half the trouble for an unnerved Ben, as a tour of an important academy that Gwen wishes to attend is disturbed by the uncanny alien's manifestations and the antics of Acid Breath, Frightwig, and Thumbskull.

episodes.title: Dr. Animo and the Mutant Ray
episodes.description: The Tennysons arrive at a swamp, where a festivities of Gatorfest start first thing the next day. Gwen finds Ben playing around with the Omnitrix, and she warns him that it may create unusual problems. Without heeding Max and Gwen's warning, he pops the face out, and the Omnitrix acts up. Right away, something was wrong, though it was gone unnoticed, at least, until the next day. Gator-fest was going along well, but the giant frog of Dr. Animo comes in to disrupt it. Dr. Animo has returned, and he wants to take revenge on Ben. But when Ben goes alien, he transforms into a hybrid alien with unbalanced attributes. Will Ben ever learn his lesson in listening for a change?

episodes.title: Back With a Vengeance
episodes.description: The Megacruiser flies solo in space, and inside Kevin examines the giant ice block found in space. Inside the mass, held Vilgax, and Kevin underestimated his current situation. He was very much alive and well, and they soon create a partnership after learning that they were both after the same person. On Earth, Ben plays around with the Omnitrix, hoping to find a better way of controlling it. Eventually, he finds the master control of the Omnitrix, giving him the ability to alternate between aliens, as well as prolong his duration with a form. Although his discovery has given him a stronger advantage, will it be enough to stop the danger that lies ahead?

episodes.title: Ben 10,000
episodes.description: When Gwen is abducted, Ben as XLR8 follows her abductor to the future where they discovered that her abductor is the future Gwen and they discover his future version of Ben and Grandpa Max. In the future, Dr. Animo revives Vilgax and plots to open the Null Void chamber. Both Bens must work together to stop them.

episodes.title: Midnight Madness
episodes.description: When Ben is hypnotized, he begins breaking the law while sleepwalking. Once the evil hypnotist called Sublimino discovers the aliens at his disposal, he plots to put hundreds of people under his control forever.

episodes.title: A Change of Face
episodes.description: Dressed as Pilgrims, to honor their history, while in the streets of Salem, MA, Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max witness an explosion of a nearby building. But when Ben rushes to the rescue, Charmcaster is there waiting with a spell to take over Ben's body and the Omnitrix. Only things go awry and Gwen and Charmcaster switch bodies. Gwen goes to prison and the sorceress is brewing a plan to gain the Omnitrix. Now Gwen must find the way to get out of prison, alert her family against Charmcaster, and get her own body back using every trick up her sleeve... or Charmcaster's.

episodes.title: Merry Christmas
episodes.description: Ben, Grandpa Max, and Gwen come upon a bizarre Christmas theme park run by an evil entity who thinks Grandpa Max is Santa Claus and proceeds to trap him.

episodes.title: Benwolf
episodes.description: Ben, as Wildvine, is fighting against an evil werewolf and is bitten. The Omnitrix times out and Ben turns back to his human form. Then, when the werewolf hits the Omnitrix, it starts to mess up and act weird. After all of this, Ben starts to get a crush on a girl that he meets. But things change, as Ben slowly starts to turn into a werewolf himself.

episodes.title: Game Over
episodes.description: The Tennysons stay in as it rains outside, and Ben plays a video game to pass the time by. When Gwen decides to join in, Ben is jealous of how she's a far superior player. Instead, Ben decides to transform to Upgrade, and merges with the game console. Gwen makes an attempt at shaking him off, but suddenly, a lightning strike causes them to transfer into the video game itself. The only way Ben can use the Omnitrix is to find coins with the different aliens on it. To get out, they must find the Upgrade coin before an evil being uses it to escape into the real world.

episodes.title: Super Alien Hero Buddy Adventures
episodes.description: Ben's alien heroes are starring in a silly network cartoon called Super Alien Hero Buddy Adventures and his favorite action hero Kangaroo Commando has been pulled off the air by the same network, so Ben tries to get him back on television and get credit for the alien heroes.

episodes.title: Under Wraps
episodes.description: In order for Ben and Gwen to learn the value of hard work, Grandpa Max takes them to a farm. Meanwhile, an alien mummy arrives to uncover a rare and dangerous element.

episodes.title: The Unnaturals
episodes.description: While attending the Little League World Series to see his home team play, Ben discovers that the opponents are actually robots posing as kids. They also have plans to replace the President with one, as well.

episodes.title: Monster Weather
episodes.description: Grandpa Max takes the kids to Chicago to see one of his favorite band, Shag Carpeting. The kids meet a weather reporter who forecasts the weather with a robot named S.A.M. He uses the robot to create rain, but a giant creature forms! Ben quickly takes care of it. The reporter tries to destroy S.A.M., but he convinces him not to. S.A.M. then goes into the sky and begins to cause chaos. The reporter tries to stop it again, but he is no longer in control. Can Ben destroy the robot and save a city from disaster?

episodes.title: The Return
episodes.description: While driving on a Florida highway, a bus of escaped felons rams into the RV. Ben transforms into Stinkfly (though not intentionally) and tries to stop them. With a little help from Grandpa's handy driving, and a magic spell from Gwen, the felons are put back in jail. On the news, the Tennyson's hear about purple lightning delaying a space shuttle launch. Remembering the lightning from the encounter with the werewolf and mummy aliens, they head to Cape Canaveral. At the Space Center, Ben comes under attack by the werewolf and mummy aliens, and new Frankenstein alien. However, why is the purple lightning occurring, and what ties does it have to an old "friend"?

episodes.title: Be Afraid of the Dark
episodes.description: Ghostfreak's return spells disaster for our heroes. Grandpa Max and Gwen must deal with the mummy alien in space while Ben deals with Ghostfreak and Dr. Vicktor on Earth. Ghostfreak then reveals his master plan: he plans to blanket the Earth with Coronium so that sunlight will not reach the planet so that he may rule. With the power of a new alien in the watch, can Ben stop Ghostfreak, and save Grandpa and Gwen?

episodes.title: The Visitor
episodes.description: While snowmobiling, two guys accidentally release an alien named Xylene from a strange container. At a park, Ben (as Wildmutt) steals Gwen's kite, so she casts a spell to make dogs attracted to him. Grandpa Max seems sad to be in St. Louis since it is where he met his wife. Xylene attacks, and Grandpa Max comes to defend, only to recognize her. Xylene reveals that she came to find the Omnitrix since she lost it when Vilgax attacked her ship. While Grandpa Max and Xylene talk about the past, a robot emerges from the area where Xylene was and attacks Ben and Gwen. The mechadroid attacks twice, taking Grandpa Max with him. Now Ben must work with Xylene (to his dismay) to save Grandpa Max.

episodes.title: Perfect Day
episodes.description: Enoch and the Forever Knights return, putting Ben in a dream world where he's tricked into having the perfect day. However, his dream quickly turns into a nightmare.

episodes.title: Divided We Stand
episodes.description: Ben gains another Omnitrix hero to use, which he calls Ditto. Gwen can't stand being around the multiplying Dittos, and they end up giving her headaches. The Dittos, though, prove to be real helpful against Dr. Animo and his multiplying Stinkflies after he extracted some of Ditto's DNA.

episodes.title: Don't Drink the Water
episodes.description: After being in contact with water from the Fountain of Youth, Grandpa Max and Ben are reverted to being kids again. Now, Gwen is left to take care of them while stopping Hex from finding the fountain's source.

episodes.title: Big Fat Alien Wedding
episodes.description: Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max attend a family wedding. During the ceremony, a strange alien attacks. Will the two ever finish this strange wedding?

episodes.title: Secret of the Omnitrix (1)
episodes.description: During a battle with Dr. Animo, the Omnitrix is accidentally set to self-destruct. In order to stop it, Ben, Gwen, and Tetrax travel across spaceto track down the Omnitrix's creator, Azmuth.

episodes.title: Secret of the Omnitrix (2)
episodes.description: During a battle with Dr. Animo, the Omnitrix is accidentally set to self-destruct. In order to stop it, Ben, Gwen, and Tetrax travel across spaceto track down the Omnitrix's creator, Azmuth.

episodes.title: Secret of the Omnitrix (3)
episodes.description: During a battle with Dr. Animo, the Omnitrix is accidentally set to self-destruct. In order to stop it, Ben, Gwen, and Tetrax travel across spaceto track down the Omnitrix's creator, Azmuth.

episodes.title: Ben 4 Good Buddy
episodes.description: While on a desert highway, the RV gets stolen by a group of modern-day pirates, who use it to go on a robbery.

episodes.title: Ready to Rumble
episodes.description: When Ben accidentally breaks Gwen's laptop, he participates in the "Ultimate Wrestling Competition" as Four Arms to get the prize money for a new laptop to replace Gwen's broken one.

episodes.title: Ken 10
episodes.description: In the future, Ben gives his son, Ken, an Omnitrix for his 10th birthday. However, Ben will have to learn to trust him with that power.

episodes.title: Ben 10 vs. Negative 10 (1)
episodes.description: Ben, Gwen, Cooper and Grandpa Max face their last battle ever against the villains they have encountered and they will battle to get the world's most powerful energy source.

episodes.title: Ben 10 vs. Negative 10 (2)
episodes.description: The Forever King sets his plan in motion and recruits the most powerful enemies Ben has ever faced in order to steal the world's most powerful energy source.

episodes.title: Goodbye and Good Riddance
episodes.description: The summer finally ends. Ben and Gwen have to go back to their normal lives. Grandpa Max tells Ben to keep the Omnitrix a secret from everyone, even his parents. Ben agrees, but Vilgax arrives and he'll stop at nothing to get the Omnitrix.

title: Super Dragon Ball Heroes
originalTitle: スーパードラゴンボールヒーローズ
description: Trunks returns from the future to train with Goku and Vegeta. However, it disappears without warning. Then the mysterious Fu bursts in, telling them that Trunks has been imprisoned in the Prison Planet, a mysterious complex in an unknown place in the universes. The group seeks the dragon balls to free Trunks, but an endless battle awaits them! Will Goku and the others rescue Trunks and escape the Prison Planet?

episodes.title: Goku vs. Goku! A Super Battle Begins on Prison Planet!
episodes.description: Goku and Vegeta's training with Whis and Beerus is interrupted by the arrival of Future Mai, who tells them that Future Trunks has been captured. A mysterious figure emerges, introducing himself as Fu; he tells Goku, Vegeta and Mai that Future Trunks is trapped on a world called the "Prison Planet", a planet where warriors from alternate timelines and dimensions fight as part of an experiment conducted by Fu. The trio arrive on the planet and meet an alternate version of Goku called "Xeno Goku", who transforms into Super Saiyan 4 and attacks Goku, who reacts by transforming into Super Saiyan Blue. During the fight, Goku discovers that there is an invisible barrier around the Prison Planet that prevents them from escaping. Then Fu disappears, and the two Goku agree to work with each other to escape the planet. In the end, Fu observes the Prison Planet and tells a seemingly evil Saiyan that his time will come.

episodes.title: Goku Goes Berserk! The Evil Saiyan's Rampage!
episodes.description: Goku and company are helpless against the evil Saiyan who is shrouded in an overwhelming large, sinister ki! Goku is enveloped by the evil Saiyan’s ki and runs wild, but an unexpected savior comes to the rescue!

episodes.title: The Mightiest Radiance! Vegito Blue Kaio-ken Explodes!
episodes.description: The evil Saiyan Cumber has now revealed his true form, and in order to face off against him, Goku and Vegeta fuse via the Potara! They become the mightiest warrior, Vegito Blue, and even let loose with the Kaio-Ken!! Cumber counters by unleashing an amazing form.

episodes.title: Rage! Super Fu Appears!
episodes.description: Cumber unleashes his fearsome form and runs wild. His power is too much for the Prison Planet to handle, and the chains start to snap one by one. Seeing this throws Fu into a rage, and he unleashes his hidden power.

episodes.title: The Mightiest Warrior! Super Saiyan 4 Vegetto!!
episodes.description: As Goku and company are in a jam, Xeno Goku and Xeno Vegeta come to their aid, having noticed the change in the Prison Planet. To counter Cumber's bottomless power, the two use the Potara to fuse! It's the explosive birth of the mightiest warrior!

episodes.title: I'll Settle This!! Into Operation! Ultra Instinct!
episodes.description: After an endless fierce battle, Ultra Instinct finally goes into operation. Amidst the crumbling Prison Planet, a final battle begins with everything on the line!

episodes.title: Zamasu Revived?! The Curtain Rises On The Universal Conflict Arc!
