episodes.description: A mummy seeks revenge on the two people who wrongfully entombed him.

episodes.title: Invisible Muriel
episodes.description: Muriel whips up her secret recipe dog food for the County Dog Food Contest.

episodes.title: Human Habitrail
episodes.description: A vacuum salesman shrinks Muriel and Eustace and sucks them up into his vacuum.

episodes.title: Mission to the Sun
episodes.description: The family goes on a dangerous space mission to save the Sun.

episodes.title: Courage the Fly
episodes.description: After being turned into a fly, Courage overhears military personnel discussing a satellite plunging to Earth.

episodes.title: Katz Kandy
episodes.description: Katz returns to eliminate Muriel.

episodes.title: Nowhere TV
episodes.description: The lottery is about to be announced, and Le Quack arrives.

episodes.title: Mega Muriel the Magnificent
episodes.description: The Computer decides to take over Muriel's body to show the world what it can do.

episodes.title: Bad Hair Day
episodes.description: Muriel is kidnapped and taken to a hair farm to be used for growing hair.

episodes.title: The Forbidden Hat of Gold
episodes.description: Eustace takes the family on an adventure to find a hat worth millions.

episodes.title: Serpent of Evil River
episodes.description: The family signs up for a free vacation but ends up having to serve as the ship's crew.

episodes.title: The Transplant
episodes.description: Courage unearths a bone from a giant kangaroo.

episodes.title: Car Broke, Phone Yes
episodes.description: A visitor on an alien mission extracts Muriel's kindness.

episodes.title: Cowboy Courage
episodes.description: Courage dreams of being a brave lawman.

episodes.title: Evil Weevil
episodes.description: Muriel invites a weevil to the farmhouse to recover from his injuries.

episodes.title: McPhearson Phantom
episodes.description: A ghost harasses Muriel by sabotaging everything she does for Eustace.

episodes.title: The House of Discontent
episodes.description: Eustace doesn't exchange crops for luck, and the house terrorizes the family.

episodes.title: The Sand Whale Strikes
episodes.description: A sand whale arrives at the farm demanding his accordion.

episodes.title: The Tower of Dr. Zalost
episodes.description: The miserable Dr. Zalost rains pink cannonballs down on the people of Nowhere, turning them gray and depressed.

episodes.title: Muriel Meets Her Match
episodes.description: New neighbor Maria disguises herself as Muriel in order to steal a diamond.

episodes.title: Courage vs. Mecha-Courage
episodes.description: Eustace replaces Courage with a technologically superior dog.

episodes.title: Campsite of Terror
episodes.description: Muriel is kidnapped by two raccoons.

episodes.title: Record Deal
episodes.description: Muriel becomes trapped in a record album.

episodes.title: Stormy Weather
episodes.description: Muriel tries to stop a storm goddess from adopting Courage as her own dog.

episodes.title: The Sandman Sleeps
episodes.description: The Sandman tries to use Muriel's sleep to cure his own insomnia.

episodes.title: Hard Drive Courage
episodes.description: A computer virus captures Muriel while on the Internet.

episodes.title: The Ride of the Valkyries
episodes.description: Muriel is mistaken for the leader of the Valkyries.

episodes.title: Scuba-Scuba Doo
episodes.description: Muriel discovers tiny people while scuba diving.

episodes.title: Conway the Contaminationist
episodes.description: A man with a filthy lifestyle contaminates the farmhouse.

episodes.title: Katz Under the Sea
episodes.description: Muriel becomes the cook on a nuclear submarine.

episodes.title: Curtain of Cruelty
episodes.description: A luminous curtain instills cruel behavior in Nowhere citizens.

episodes.title: Feast of the Bullfrogs
episodes.description: Bullfrogs take over the farm.

episodes.title: Tulip's Worm
episodes.description: A giant worm swallows Muriel and Eustace.

episodes.title: So In Louvre Are We Two
episodes.description: Courage, Muriel and Eustace get locked into a French art museum at closing time.

episodes.title: Night of the Scarecrow
episodes.description: A scarecrow appoints himself as Muriel's bodyguard.

episodes.title: Mondo Magic
episodes.description: A monster-in-disguise wants to transform Muriel into his beastly bride.

episodes.title: Watch the Birdies
episodes.description: A giant bird insists that Muriel baby-sit while she goes on vacation.

episodes.title: Fishy Business
episodes.description: When the family is deemed uncivilized, they are forced to live underwater as fish.

episodes.title: Angry Nasty People
episodes.description: Tarantella offers the family roles on his new show.

episodes.title: Dome of Doom
episodes.description: Eustace signs up for a science experiment that covers the farm with a dome.

episodes.title: Snowman's Revenge
episodes.description: The Snowman decides to make a West Pole, forcing the family to live in blistering cold.

episodes.title: The Quilt Club
episodes.description: Muriel joins a mysterious quilt club.

episodes.title: Swindlin' Wind
episodes.description: Angry at Eustace for cheating her, Shirley curses Eustace and Muriel.

episodes.title: King of Flan
episodes.description: A flan infomercial hypnotizes the people of Nowhere.

episodes.title: Courage Under the Volcano
episodes.description: Muriel is abducted by a tribe to become their human sacrifice.

episodes.title: A Beaver's Tale
episodes.description: A beaver's huge dam forces water into the farmhouse.

episodes.title: The Nutcracker
episodes.description: Rats capture Muriel and Eustace, preparing to cook them for a feast.

episodes.title: Rumpledkiltskin
episodes.description: Muriel is summoned to Scotland to weave the family tartan.

episodes.title: House Calls
episodes.description: A lonely scientist moves the farmhouse next to his mansion.

episodes.title: Le Quack Balloon
episodes.description: Le Quack wants to use Muriel to rob the Piggy Bank of Sweden.

episodes.title: Windmill Vandals
episodes.description: Courage tries to repair the farm's jammed windmill.

episodes.title: The Uncommon Cold
episodes.description: Courage notices a strange creature in Muriel's sneezes.

episodes.title: Farmer-Hunter, Farmer-Hunted
episodes.description: Eustace takes Courage on a deer-hunting trip.

episodes.title: Bride of the Swamp Monster
episodes.description: A swamp monster believes Muriel is his long-lost-love.

episodes.title: Goat Pain
episodes.description: In order to treat Muriel's back pain, the family must travel to a mountain spring.

episodes.title: Muriel Blows Up
episodes.description: When Muriel eats a carrot covered in a mysterious residue, she begins to grow.

episodes.title: Profiles in Courage
episodes.description: Cameo silhouettes steal Muriel and Eustace's souls.

episodes.title: The Mask
episodes.description: A masked stranger who hates dogs arrives at the farm, beating Courage whenever possible.

episodes.title: Squatting Tiger, Hidden Dog
episodes.description: Muriel is abducted during a tour of the Great Wall of China.

episodes.title: Muted Muriel
episodes.description: Courage seeks Shirley's help when Muriel decides to stop talking.

episodes.title: Aqua-Farmer
episodes.description: Eustace boasts that he can swim better than a dolphin.

episodes.title: Food of the Dragon
episodes.description: A human-eating dragon arrives at the farmhouse and eats Eustace.

episodes.title: The Last of the Starmakers
episodes.description: Muriel bonds with a star-making alien.

episodes.title: Son of the Chicken from Outer Space
episodes.description: The three-headed son of the Chicken from Outer Space wants to avenge his father.

episodes.title: Courageous Cure
episodes.description: Desperate to cure a disease, alien naturalists abduct Courage.

episodes.title: Ball of Revenge
episodes.description: Courage is challenged to a game of dodgeball.

episodes.title: Cabaret Courage
episodes.description: The family is offered great prizes to perform in an underground cabaret.

episodes.title: Wrath of the Librarian
episodes.description: Courage returns a library book that is two years overdue.

episodes.title: Remembrance of Courage Past
episodes.description: Courage becomes depressed after thinking of his parents.

episodes.title: Perfect
episodes.description: Fed up with Courage's incompetence, Eustace seeks a professional dog trainer.

title: My Hero Academia
originalTitle: 僕のヒーローアカデミア
description: Izuku has dreamt of being a hero all his life—a lofty goal for anyone, but especially challenging for a kid with no superpowers. That’s right, in a world where eighty percent of the population has some kind of super-powered "quirk," Izuku was unlucky enough to be born completely normal. But that’s not enough to stop him from enrolling in one of the world’s most prestigious hero academies.

episodes.title: Izuku Midoriya: Origin
episodes.description: Izuku Midoriya desperately wants to be a hero, but he is one of the few in his generation born without a Quirk. Will meeting the number one hero, All Might, change his fate?

episodes.title: What It Takes to Be a Hero
episodes.description: Izuku accidentally learns of All Might’s secret, but there’s trouble in town again before Izuku has time to process it. Will All Might be able to save the day again?

episodes.title: Roaring Muscles
episodes.description: All Might tells Izuku that he can become a hero, but does he really have what it takes to become one?

episodes.title: Start Line
episodes.description: At the entrance exam, Izuku falls behind as the other students defeat faux villains left and right. Will he be able to get enough points to pass?

episodes.title: What I Can Do for Now
episodes.description: It’s Izuku’s first day of high school, and he still can’t control his new Quirk. Will he make it to the second day of school with his eccentric new teacher?

episodes.title: Rage, You Damn Nerd
episodes.description: Izuku somehow gets through his first day of school and falls into a regular schedule of classes and training at U.A. In their first class with All Might…

episodes.title: Deku vs. Kacchan
episodes.description: Izuku is up against Katsuki in their first class with All Might! Can he and Uraraka beat the villain team of Katsuki and Tenya before time runs out?

episodes.title: Bakugo’s Start Line
episodes.description: After the combat training lesson, the students and All Might reflect on their matches as they think about their next steps.

episodes.title: Yeah, Just Do Your Best, Iida!
episodes.description: Class 1-A has to elect a class representative, and everyone wants the job! How will they choose? And what lies in wait for them at the next class?

episodes.title: Encounter with the Unknown
episodes.description: Villains have attacked USJ, and it’s up to Class 1-A to stop them. What are the villains after? Will All Might be able to save the day again?

episodes.title: Game Over
episodes.description: The students of Class 1-A are up against the League of Villains. Will they survive long enough for help to arrive?

episodes.title: All Might
episodes.description: All Might has finally shown up, but will he be able to defeat Nomu and save the day?!

episodes.title: In Each of Our Hearts
episodes.description: As the battle at USJ winds down, Izuku and All Might think about its repercussions. Meanwhile, the villains slink home to plan their next move.

episodes.title: That’s the Idea, Ochaco
episodes.description: As U.A. students and teachers recover from the League of Villains attack on USJ, Izuku learns about why Ochaco wants to become a hero.

episodes.title: Roaring Sports Festival
episodes.description: The U.A. sports festival begins and all eyes are on the first-years as they start their qualifying round—the obstacle course race.

episodes.title: In Their Own Quirky Ways
episodes.description: The first years try to stand out as they struggle to finish the obstacle course and qualify for a spot in the next round.

episodes.title: Strategy, Strategy, Strategy
episodes.description: Izuku’s having trouble finding a team for the cavalry battle in the next round of the U.A. sports festival. Luckily, he has a plan.

episodes.title: Cavalry Battle Finale
episodes.description: Fighting it out in the second half of the cavalry battle, does Team Midoriya have what it takes to stay in the top four?

episodes.title: The Boy Born with Everything
episodes.description: Izuku learns more about Todoroki’s past as the first-years head into the final round of the sports festival.

episodes.title: Victory or Defeat
episodes.description: Izuku is up against Shinso in the first match of the finals, but can he overcome Shinso’s Quirk to advance to the next round?

episodes.title: Battle on, Challengers!
episodes.description: It’s one match after another in the first round of the finals tournament. Who will advance to second round?

episodes.title: Bakugo vs. Uraraka
episodes.description: Bakugo seems almost villainous when he’s up against Uraraka, but she has a plan to keep it from being a one-sided match.

episodes.title: Shoto Todoroki: Origin
episodes.description: Izuku forces Todoroki to face his past in a chilling battle as the two class rivals finally go head to head!

episodes.title: Fight On, Iida
episodes.description: It’s class rep versus child prodigy as Iida and Todoroki square off. Will Iida’s Reciproburst be enough to beat the boy of fire and ice?

episodes.title: Todoroki vs. Bakugo
episodes.description: The explosive showdown between Todoroki and Bakugo begins. Only one can take the title of first-year champion!

episodes.title: Time to Pick Some Names
episodes.description: Following their epic debut at the sports festival, it’s time for the first-years to pick the most important part of their identities—their hero name!

episodes.title: Bizarre! Gran Torino Appears
episodes.description: The internships begin! While everyone adjusts to their new tasks, Izuku starts training with Gran Torino, the same man who once taught All Might.

episodes.title: Midoriya and Shigaraki
episodes.description: The U.A. students are finally starting to get the hang of their internships, but Izuku has much more to learn about One For All.

episodes.title: Hero Killer: Stain vs U.A. Students
episodes.description: Stain strikes again, and this time some U.A. students are around when it happens. Will they be able to hold him off until the pros come?

episodes.title: Climax
episodes.description: It all comes to a head as Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki face off against Stain while the pro heroes in Hosu City fight against the Nomus.

episodes.title: The Aftermath of Hero Killer: Stain
episodes.description: Stain is finally captured, but while the hero community deals with the consequences, an even greater challenge is set in motion.

episodes.title: Everyone's Internships
episodes.description: As Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki recover from their fight with Stain, the other members of Class 1-A work hard at their own internships.

episodes.title: Listen Up!! A Tale from the Past
episodes.description: The students return to their daily lives while All Might has a special history lesson for Izuku. It’s time to learn about One For All!

episodes.title: Gear up for Final Exams
episodes.description: Finals are coming up and Class 1-A is going to need more than a cram session. This year, the teachers are changing the practical exams.

episodes.title: Yaoyorozu: Rising
episodes.description: The exams are turning out to be much more challenging than the students expected. Can any of the teams hold their own against a teacher?

episodes.title: Stripping the Varnish
episodes.description: As the students of Class 1-A fight in their practical exams, their resolve to become heroes is put to the test.

episodes.title: Katsuki Bakugo: Origin
episodes.description: It’s finally time for Izuku and Bakugo’s practical exam. How can they challenge All Might without a plan?

episodes.title: Encounter
episodes.description: Class 1-A goes shopping for training camp supplies, but things get out of hand when a villain pulls Izuku aside.

episodes.title: Game Start
episodes.description: Before the U.A. students head to their training camp, Class 1-A goes to the pool for extra training, and the League of Villains plots their next move.

episodes.title: Wild, Wild Pussycats
episodes.description: Class 1-A faces the first challenge of their summer training camp when they have to fight their way through “The Beast’s Forest” before lunch.

episodes.title: Kota
episodes.description: Izuku tries to talk with Kota as the first-years start their training in earnest. Little do they know what awaits them in the forest.

episodes.title: My Hero
episodes.description: The villains launch their attack, and only Izuku knows where Kota is. Can he get to him in time?

episodes.title: Drive It Home, Iron Fist!!!
episodes.description: Izuku finally makes it back to the training camp only to leave again with a message for Mandalay to broadcast.

episodes.title: Roaring Upheaval
episodes.description: The students and teachers of U.A. are still fighting in the woods, but has the Vanguard Action Squad accomplished its mission already…?!

episodes.title: What a Twist!
episodes.description: The battle at the training camp concludes, and now the students and teachers of U.A. have to deal with the aftermath.

episodes.title: From Iida to Midoriya
episodes.description: Todoroki, Kirishima, and Midoriya want to go after Bakugo, but the class rep is standing in their way. Meanwhile, Shigaraki makes Bakugo an offer…

episodes.title: All For One
episodes.description: The heroes and U.A. students close in on the League of Villains’ hideouts, but the League still has an ace up its sleeve.

episodes.title: Symbol of Peace
episodes.description: As the fight against the League of Villains escalates, can the U.A. students get Bakugo out in time for All Might to make a big comeback?

episodes.title: One For All
episodes.description: All Might’s time is running out as he faces his ultimate nemesis head on. Will he finally be able to defeat All For One once and for all?

episodes.title: End of the Beginning, Beginning of the End
episodes.description: After All Might and All For One’s fight, the students go back home while the U.A. teachers decide how to deal with the aftermath.

episodes.title: Moving into Dorms
episodes.description: The students of Class 1-A move into their dorms and hold a competition to determine who has the best room.

episodes.title: Create Those Ultimate Moves
episodes.description: Class 1-A works on developing their Quirks and creating ultimate moves to prepare for the provisional hero licensing exam.

episodes.title: The Test
episodes.description: Izuku and his classmates make some final adjustments to their ultimate moves and then head off to the provisional licensing exam.

episodes.title: Shiketsu High Lurking
episodes.description: The exam has begun, and everyone’s after Class 1-A! Can the first-years last long enough to pass this first test?

episodes.title: Class 1-A
episodes.description: Todoroki’s on his own against Seijin High, and Yaoyorozu’s group is pitted against Seiai Academy as they and the rest of Class 1-A fight to pass the first test.

episodes.title: RUSH!
episodes.description: It’s down to the final minutes of the first test and almost half of Class 1-A has yet to earn a passing score!

episodes.title: Rescue Exercises
episodes.description: The second test of the provisional licensing has begun, and the hero candidates are suddenly thrust into a rescue operation.

episodes.title: Special Episode: Save the World with Love!
episodes.description: We take a break from the provisional licensing exam to visit a class held before the summer training camp!

episodes.title: What’s the Big Idea?
episodes.description: The exam nears its end, but Izuku and the other hero candidates must fend off Gang Orca to finish the rescue mission.

episodes.title: A Talk about Your Quirk
episodes.description: While the U.A. students finish up the provisional licensing exam and get their results, All Might has a talk with All For One.

episodes.title: Deku vs. Kacchan, Part 2
episodes.description: Following the provisional licensing exam, Izuku tries out his Shoot Style on Bakugo as they have a heart-to-heart through their fight.

episodes.title: A Season for Encounters
episodes.description: The world has changed for villains and heroes alike in the weeks after All Might’s fight with All For One, and the U.A. students start their second semester.

episodes.title: Unrivaled
episodes.description: The students of Class 1-A learn about work studies from the Big Three. Meanwhile, the villains also prepare their next steps.

episodes.title: The Scoop on U.A. Class 1-A
episodes.description: After All Might announces his retirement, freelance reporter Taneo Tokuda goes to the dorms to investigate U.A. Class 1-A.

episodes.title: Overhaul
episodes.description: Overhaul pays a visit to the League of Villains, and Midoriya tries to find a place to do his work study.

episodes.title: Boy Meets…
episodes.description: Izuku battles Sir Nighteye so he can do his work study at Nighteye’s agency, but Nighteye has someone else in mind to be All Might’s successor…

episodes.title: Fighting Fate
episodes.description: Izuku’s mind is swirling with feelings from his work study, so he goes and talks to All Might about it and learns about All Might’s fate.

episodes.title: Let’s Go, Gutsy Red Riot
episodes.description: The U.A. work study students go out with their respective heroes and become involved in some big fights.

episodes.title: An Unpleasant Talk
episodes.description: The work study students from U.A. attend a meeting of heroes gathered by Sir Nighteye and leave with new resolve.

episodes.title: GO!!
episodes.description: The work study students wait until the pro heroes find Eri and it’s time to start the operation to save her.

episodes.title: Suneater of the Big Three
episodes.description: The Shie Hassaikai is going all out to stop the heroes, and Suneater volunteers to take out the first batch of Eight Bullets members in their way.

episodes.title: Red Riot
episodes.description: As the fight with the Shie Hassaikai continues, Kirishima has to face his past when he and Fat Gum get separated from the others.

episodes.title: Temp Squad
episodes.description: The Hassaikai gets some help from the League of Villains as the heroes continue to make their way to Chisaki to rescue Eri.

episodes.title: Lemillion
episodes.description: The League of Villains stay true to their name in their fight. Meanwhile, Togata catches up to Chisaki and Eri first…

episodes.title: Unforeseen Hope
episodes.description: Izuku, Eraser Head, and Sir Nighteye finally reach the area where Chisaki and the others are and find Togata past his limit…

episodes.title: Infinite 100%
episodes.description: As the fight with the Shie Hassaikai reaches its climax, Chisaki looks back on how it all started, and Izuku uses All For One at 100%.

episodes.title: Bright Future
episodes.description: As the heroes deal with the aftermath of the fight with the Shie Hassaikai, the vehicle transporting Chisaki has an encounter with the League of Villains…

episodes.title: Smoldering Flames
episodes.description: After the fight with the Shie Hassaikai, a new villain emerges, and the students who participated reflect on their own roles as future heroes.

episodes.title: Win Those Kids’ Hearts
episodes.description: Camie joins the provisional license training course and is added to the team working with the kids from Masegaki. Meanwhile, Endeavor has a serious talk with All Might.

episodes.title: Relief for License Trainees
episodes.description: The trainees bond with the precocious Masegaki kids and life at U.A. goes back to normal as autumn approaches, but Aoyama has been acting strangely…

episodes.title: School Festival
episodes.description: As the students of U.A. prepare for their school festival, Deku and Togata visit Eri in the hospital. Meanwhile, a new villain named Gentle Criminal begins his reign of crime.

episodes.title: Prepping for the School Festival Is the Most Fun Part
episodes.description: Class 1-A assigns roles for their performance at the school festival, and Gentle starts preparing his next plan.

episodes.title: Gold Tips Imperial
episodes.description: Eri visits U.A. while the students are preparing for the school festival, and Gentle finalizes his plans.

episodes.title: Deku vs. Gentle Criminal
episodes.description: As Deku buys some last-minute supplies for the school festival, he encounters a mysterious man wrapped in a trench coat…

episodes.title: School Festival Start!!
episodes.description: Izuku must stop Gentle Criminal and his partner, La Brava, or else the school festival will be cancelled.

episodes.title: Let It Flow! School Festival!
episodes.description: Izuku rushes back to the school festival after his encounter with Gentleman and La Brava, but will he make it in time for his performance?

episodes.title: Japanese Hero Billboard Chart
episodes.description: It’s time for the next Japanese Hero Billboard Chart rankings to be announced, and this time, all the top ten heroes make an appearance.

episodes.title: His Start
episodes.description: Endeavor and Hawks are up against High-End, and it’s Endeavor’s chance to show the world what the new number one hero is like.

episodes.title: All Hands on Deck! Class 1-A
episodes.description: There's an emergency drill at U.A. High School, and Class 1-A is requested to report for duty!

episodes.title: Vestiges
episodes.description: After their fight with the Nomu, Hawks and Endeavor return to daily life, and Izuku dreams of One For All…

episodes.title: Clash! Class A vs. Class B!
episodes.description: Class A and Class B are joined by a special guest as they battle it out during their joint combat training.

episodes.title: Make It Happen, Shinso!
episodes.description: The Class A team tries to put Shinso and his new equipment to good use in the first match against Class B.

episodes.title: Operation New Improv Moves
episodes.description: It's darkness versus darkness as Tokoyami and Kuroiro face off in the second match of the class battles!

episodes.title: Foresight
episodes.description: Separated from her team, Yaoyorozu's leadership skills are put to the test in the second match of the class battles.

episodes.title: Match 3
episodes.description: In the third match of the class battles, Honenuki leads the Class B team against a well-balanced Class A team.

episodes.title: Match 3 Conclusion
episodes.description: It's still anybody's game as the the third match continues with an endurance battle between Todoroki and Tetsutetsu.

episodes.title: Early Bird!
episodes.description: Bakugo shows a different side of himself in the fourth team match as the class battles continue.

episodes.title: That Which Is Inherited
episodes.description: Midoriya and Shinso face off for the first time since the sports festival in the last fight of the class battles.

episodes.title: Our Brawl
episodes.description: It's an all-out brawl as the last two teams from Class A and Class B fight it out to the finish!

episodes.title: The New Power and All For One
episodes.description: As the class battles conclude, Midoriya works with All Might and Bakugo on learning more about his new power.

episodes.title: Have a Merry Christmas!
episodes.description: It's Christmas at U.A. and the Class 1-A students celebrate with a Christmas party.

episodes.title: Off to Endeavor's Agency!
episodes.description: Hawks acts strange when he meets Endeavor and his work study students on their way to Endeavor Agency.

episodes.title: One Thing at a Time
episodes.description: As the villains continue to move behind the scenes, Endeavor helps his work study students with the next steps in their training.

episodes.title: Long Time No See, Selkie
episodes.description: Ryukyu brings her work study students with her when Selkie asks her to team up with him.

episodes.title: The Hellish Todoroki Family
episodes.description: Endeavor brings his work study students over for dinner at Fuyumi's request but faces awkward conversations at home.

episodes.title: The Unforgiven
episodes.description: One of Endeavor's biggest fans shows up to settle some unfinished business, and he expects far more than an autograph.

episodes.title: More of a Hero Than Anyone
episodes.description: When an unsettling discovery is made regarding Kurogiri, Aizawa and Present Mic are summoned to interrogate him.

episodes.title: My Villain Academia
episodes.description: A series of surprise encounters helps give Shigaraki a new sense of direction for the League of Villains.

episodes.title: Revival Party
episodes.description: The League of Villains waits for Gigantomachia to wake up as they clash with the Meta Liberation Army.

episodes.title: Sad Man's Parade
episodes.description: As Twice tries to save Toga, he thinks back on his past and makes a realization that helps him overcome it.

episodes.title: Tenko Shimura: Origin
episodes.description: Memories from Shigaraki's past as Tenko Shimura resurface as he confronts Re-Destro.

episodes.title: Tomura Shigaraki: Origin
episodes.description: Shigaraki remembers his first encounter with All For One during the climax of his battle with Re-Destro.

episodes.title: The High, Deep Blue Sky
episodes.description: Both sides prepare for the confrontation between the heroes and the Paranormal Liberation Front as Class 1-A finishes their first year of high school.

title: MINDHUNTER
description: An agent in the FBI's Elite Serial Crime Unit develops profiling techniques as he pursues notorious serial killers and rapists.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: In 1977, frustrated FBI hostage negotiator Holden Ford finds an unlikely ally in veteran agent Bill Tench and begins studying a new class of murderer.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Holden interviews the eerily articulate murderer Ed Kemper, but his research provokes negative feedback at the Bureau.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Dr. Wendy Carr joins Holden and Tench in their first success, when their insights lead to an arrest.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Bill and Holden consult with Dr. Wendy Carr to begin classifying their subjects. They receive surprising news.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Holden and Bill return to a perplexing case in Pennsylvania where a set of clues leading in multiple directions leaves no shortage of suspects.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Wendy considers an offer. Holden and Bill struggle to communicate the meaning of their findings to the judicial system in the baffling Altoona case.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Wendy takes a career risk to relocate and join the team full time. Holden and Bill find it harder to keep the emotional intensity of work at bay.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Bill and Wendy interview candidates for a fourth member of the team. Holden is intrigued by complaints about a school principal's odd habit.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Holden's methods during a disturbing interview with mass murderer Richard Speck create dissension among the team and kick off an internal FBI probe.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: The team cracks under pressure from an in-house review. Holden's bold style elicits a confession but puts his career, relationships and health at risk.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Amid sweeping changes at the BSU, Holden deals with severe repercussions from his close encounter with Ed Kemper.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: To glean insight into the elusive BTK killer, Bill and Holden interview the Son of Sam, who makes a startling admission.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Bill gets drawn into a horrifying crime that hits close to home. Holden receives an intriguing offer while in Atlanta to interview a pair of killers.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Holden develops a controversial profile in the Atlanta slayings. Wendy conducts her first interview and finds being on the front lines suits her well.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Bill's devastating family situation spills over during his interview with Holden's holy-grail subject: Charles Manson. Wendy's new romance heats up.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: The FBI officially sends the BSU to Atlanta to investigate the missing and murdered children. Wendy second-guesses her interview methods.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Hitting a dead end, Holden suggests a bold plan to draw the killer out. Bill's family faces more scrutiny. Wendy chafes as her job begins to shift.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Red tape hinders Holden's plan to narrow his suspect pool. A weary and heartsick Bill tries to connect with his son. Wendy rethinks her relationship.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: The investigation zeroes in on a prime suspect who proves surprisingly adept at manipulating a volatile situation to his advantage.

title: Moon Knight
description: When Steven Grant, a mild-mannered gift-shop employee, becomes plagued with blackouts and memories of another life, he discovers he has dissociative identity disorder and shares a body with mercenary Marc Spector. As Steven/Marc’s enemies converge upon them, they must navigate their complex identities while thrust into a deadly mystery among the powerful gods of Egypt.

cast.characterName: Marc Spector / Steven Grant / Moon Knight / Mr. Knight

episodes.title: The Goldfish Problem
episodes.description: Steven Grant, a mild-mannered man who works a mundane job, begins to suspect that his life may not be his own when an alter living inside him begins to emerge.

episodes.title: Summon the Suit
episodes.description: As Steven reels from the fact that his life may not be his own, a mysterious partner emerges from the past as a war of the gods looms on the horizon.

episodes.title: The Friendly Type
episodes.description: With Marc in the forefront and Harrow near Ammit’s tomb, Marc needs to navigate Cairo while putting his differences aside with Layla and Steven without jeopardizing their mission.

episodes.title: The Tomb
episodes.description: Marc & Steven trek the Siwa Desert with Layla to find Ammit’s tomb, but the threats ahead look to protect the goddess’ resting place.

episodes.title: Asylum
episodes.description: Marc & Steven search through their memories to find their truth or become left behind.

episodes.title: Gods and Monsters
episodes.description: With Layla tracking down Harrow, Marc, Steven, and Khonshu must return to Cairo to stop Ammit as she looks to threaten humanity once more.

title: Wynonna Earp
description: Wyatt Earp's great granddaughter Wynonna battles demons and other creatures with her unique abilities and a posse of dysfunctional allies - the only thing that can bring the paranormal to justice.

episodes.title: Purgatory
episodes.description: Wyatt Earp's great granddaughter celebrates her 27th birthday by reluctantly returning to her hometown to take on her family's legendary curse.

episodes.title: Keep the Home Fires Burning
episodes.description: Wynonna attracts some unwanted attention after returning to Purgatory. At the same time, she struggles to keep her impetuous nature in check while trying to conform to the rules imposed by the Black Badge Division. In other happenings, drifter Henry makes a deal he may not be able to honor.

episodes.title: Leavin' on Your Mind
episodes.description: Wynonna investigates when a posse of Revenants go on a killing spree, which she concludes has a darker and more sinister point behind it. Meanwhile, Waverly challenges Henry's motives and sets out to unearth more of his past.

episodes.title: The Blade
episodes.description: Wynonna and Dolls try to stop an invisible assailant killing Purgatory residents.

episodes.title: Diggin' Up Bones
episodes.description: Wynonna and Dolls make a daring raid on the trailer park run by the lead Revenant. Henry comes face to face with an old nemesis.

episodes.title: Constant Cravings
episodes.description: Wynonna hunts down one of the Revenants responsible for the attack on the Homestead fifteen years earlier. Waverly unravels a mystery left behind by her Uncle Curtis.

episodes.title: Walking After Midnight
episodes.description: Waverly's engagement party guests are put in danger by Henry's quest for revenge. Wynonna investigates a killer targeting young women.

episodes.title: Two-Faced Jack
episodes.description: Henry and Deputy Marshall Dolls infiltrate a Revenant hive. Wynonna tries to avoid being a serial killer's next victim.

episodes.title: Bury Me with My Guns On
episodes.description: Wynonna undergoes a psychiatric fitness test that she initially fails but Dolls ends up having her back after she sleeps with Doc.

episodes.title: She Wouldn't Be Gone
episodes.description: Wynonna and Dolls investigate the snowy Barrens and the rumors of a bloodthirsty beast. Henry confronts his future with Waverly's help.

episodes.title: Landslide
episodes.description: Wynonna puts the discovery in the Barrens behind her after a gambler is torn apart. Henry meets a mysterious stranger.

episodes.title: House of Memories
episodes.description: An admirer with a gruesome vendetta threatens the town. Wynonna tries to outwit Bobo Del Rey and protect Dolls.

episodes.title: I Walk the Line
episodes.description: A treachery is revealed. Wynonna prepares for her final showdown with Bobo.

episodes.title: Steel Bars and Stone Walls
episodes.description: Wynonna tries to rescue a seemingly mutated Dolls. There may be more to Waverly than meets the eye.

episodes.title: Shed Your Skin
episodes.description: While Waverly's change accelerates and Doc makes a dangerous deal, Wynonna must fight spider creatures. Yep.

episodes.title: Gonna Getcha Good
episodes.description: Doc tries to help a friend, while Wynonna must deal with an angry Marzanoik - that's like a genie but way more evil - with payback on his mind. It's Wynonna to the rescue when this demonic force threatens some high school friends. But there's a much bigger threat looming.

episodes.title: She Ain't Right
episodes.description: The team must recover a very powerful briefcase before it falls into the wrong hands. Don't expect everything to go smoothly - it's Earp vs. Earp as Wynonna fights for her sister Waverly's soul.

episodes.title: Let's Pretend We're Strangers
episodes.description: A furious thunder-snowstorm makes landfall while Wynonna and Waverly are forced to confront their demons - and each other.

episodes.title: Whiskey Lullaby
episodes.description: Wynonna races against the clock to save Purgatory before the whole town takes a permanent dirt nap.

episodes.title: Everybody Knows
episodes.description: Doc and Wynonna's indiscretions haunt the team and the ties that bind them. Wynonna's past mistakes hold present consequences, while Purgatory has a new most wanted: Doc Holliday. Wynonna and Nicole hit the road for answers.

episodes.title: No Future in the Past
episodes.description: Wynonna has an opportunity to discover the origins of the Earp curse while her team works to save the future.

episodes.title: Forever Mine Nevermind
episodes.description: Wynonna asks Doc to make an impossible choice. Waverly makes a new friend - and is terrorized by an old one.

episodes.title: I See a Darkness
episodes.description: The team may not be able to save one of their own after a deadly run-in with the widows.

episodes.title: Gone as a Girl Can Get
episodes.description: Allies become enemies when a vengeful wish goes awry.

episodes.title: I Hope You Dance
episodes.description: Wynonna is running out of time, and is desperate to defeat the widows before her fate is sealed.

episodes.title: Blood Red and Going Down
episodes.description: When a mysterious bus full of sexy strangers rolls into town, Wynonna must figure out why they are in Purgatory before the entire town falls under their spell.

episodes.title: When You Call My Name
episodes.description: The demon who cursed the Earp heir reveals himself in a shocking turn of events that will leave the team forever changed.

episodes.title: Colder Weather
episodes.description: The team must come to terms with the consequences of their actions. Meanwhile, someone claiming to be from Black Badge Division arrives in Purgatory.

episodes.title: No Cure for Crazy
episodes.description: The forest reveals its secrets - and a clue to Nicole's past. Meanwhile, Wynonna pays an unexpected visit to her mother.

episodes.title: Jolene
episodes.description: A demon causes havoc in town as Wynonna, Waverly and Jolene must decide who they can trust.

episodes.title: If We Make It Through December
episodes.description: Eggnog for everyone! It's holiday season in Purgatory! Wynonna teams up with a new ally to search for a missing kid on Christmas Day. Meanwhile, Waverly learns more about her father.

episodes.title: I Fall to Pieces
episodes.description: Lady Luck seems to have abandoned Wynonna and Nicole when an errand for Nedley goes terribly wrong. Mama discovers Doc's secret.

episodes.title: Waiting Forever for You
episodes.description: It's date night in Purgatory, which means dressing up, drinking, and fighting demons as a formidable, former foe stalks the gang.

episodes.title: Undo It
episodes.description: History keeps repeating itself when Wynonna has to make an impossible choice. Waverly and Nicole visit a jeweller and a familiar face returns to Purgatory.

episodes.title: The Other Woman
episodes.description: A mysterious woman who knows a little too much about the Earps arrives on the Homestead with a special mission for Wynonna and Waverly. The rest of the team must wrangle a deadly fire witch.

episodes.title: Daddy Lessons
episodes.description: Wynonna has a run in with Revenants that leads her to an unexpected revelation about the curse. Waverly meets an important figure from her past, and Nicole tries to evacuate Purgatory - before it's too late.

episodes.title: War Paint
episodes.description: The Pledge Moon looms over Purgatory as Wynonna and Waverly must find a way to end the family curse before their demonic foe puts an end to the Earp line - and humanity - once and for all.

episodes.title: On the Road Again
episodes.description: Wynonna Earp races to find a way into the Garden before her sister is trapped forever.

episodes.title: Friends in Low Places
episodes.description: Wynonna works with a new ally to rescue her family, but reunions come at a price.

episodes.title: Look at Them Beans
episodes.description: Wynonna finds herself on the wrong side of the law and Doc partners with a new demon.

episodes.title: Afraid
episodes.description: Wynonna faces down an ancient enemy as Waverly and Nicole search for help.

episodes.title: Holy War (1)
episodes.description: Trouble at the Homestead leads to payback time for a deadly deal.

episodes.title: Holy War (2)
episodes.description: The gang races to save one of their own, but are hindered by unseen forces.

episodes.title: Love's All Over
episodes.description: Love is in the air as Waverly and Nicole celebrate their engagement with an enchanted evening.

episodes.title: Hell Raisin' Good Time
episodes.description: Wynonna and Waverly have a Halloween they'll never forget as Rotten Jack terrorizes Purgatory.

episodes.title: Crazy
episodes.description: It's Trivia Night in Purgatory and that can only mean murder, mayhem and brain sandwiches.

episodes.title: Life Turned Her That Way
episodes.description: A deadly foe re-emerges in the Ghost River Triangle, intent on finishing what they started.

episodes.title: Better Dig Two
episodes.description: Wynonna and Waverly take two very different and dangerous paths in an effort to save Purgatory.

episodes.title: Old Souls
episodes.description: Big feelings and bigger decisions are revealed when a new witch makes herself known in Purgatory.

title: Big Time Rush
description: Four teenage friends move from Minneapolis to Los Angeles to form a potential chart-topping boy band after Kendall is inadvertently discovered by an eccentric record executive, Gustavo Rocque. As they seize this opportunity of a lifetime, these friends embark on an exciting comedy and music-filled journey to prove to themselves and their record label that they are serious about their new career choice.

episodes.title: Big Time Audition
episodes.description: James, Carlos, Logan and Kendall get the opportunity of a lifetime when they are asked to head to Los Angeles and form a singing group. Once they are in Los Angeles, they must figure out a way to make Gustavo Rocque and Rocque Records happy in order to become a singing sensation.

episodes.title: Big Time School of Rocque
episodes.description: The boys get a dose of reality when Kelly tells them they have to go to school at least four hours every day while they live in Los Angeles. While the boys want to go to the fun Palm Woods school, they learn that Gustavo has arranged to have their school located at the recording studio, so they are never far from his grip. The boys do whatever is necessary to take down the "School of Rocque" and go to the Palm Woods school. Meanwhile, an attempt from Mrs. Knight to home school Katie (Ciara Bravo) fails, so she tries to get Katie to act in a commercial to gain entrance in the Palm Woods, with the help of Mr. Bitters.

episodes.title: Big Time Crib
episodes.description: The boys are not thrilled with their boring apartment at the Palm Woods and hatch a plan to improve it when Gustavo creates a fun "fake" living area for them on a soundstage for an upcoming EPK shoot. The guys enlist the help of all their friends at Palm Woods to move all the cool games and gadgets from the set to their apartment.

episodes.title: Big Time Bad Boy
episodes.description: The record company CEO thinks adding a fifth band member will broaden Big Time Rush's appeal and sticks the guys with a self-proclaimed "bad boy" named Wayne Wayne, who tries to inject dissension and tension within the group. Ultimately, Gustavo and the guys secretly band together to get him booted out of the band, in a "bad boy-off". Meanwhile, Mrs. Knight gets persuaded that there's an axe maniac on the loose, and forces Katie to play with a girl named Molly, who is later found to be a con actress that's 20 years old and tries to pass herself off as an 11-year-old girl driving in a high speed chase with cops, using Mrs. Knight's rental car, trying to get a job in Hollywood.

episodes.title: Big Time Love Song
episodes.description: The guys chase the same girl named Jo, causing the band to fight. Meanwhile, James gets an allergic reaction to a body spray and Kelly (Tanya Chisholm) attempts to make him get an allergy shot, Gustavo gets a new personal helper named Freight Train, Katie has to write a report on her biggest hero and writes about Gustavo so she does not have to read anything, and Griffin wants a slow love song for the next song, but Gustavo cannot seem to figure out how to make the song work.

episodes.title: Big Time Mansion
episodes.description: When Gustavo goes away for a few days to check out a new boyband called "The Windmills", the guys "mansion sit" for him much to Gustavo's dismay. After much discussion with Kelly, Gustavo allows the boys to "mansion sit" but they must follow his rules or else they are fired. Once at the mansion the guys think it will be an easy task, but what seems like a task they can handle soon turns into a "big time disaster" as things don't go according to plan. Meanwhile with Kendall and the guys away, Mrs Knight starts to fell less needed by her children, so Katie decides to help her mother out by pretending to be sick.

episodes.title: Big Time Photo Shoot
episodes.description: The boys are at the Palm Woods, severely injured. Camille asked them why they look so beat up if they just got their picture in Pop Tiger. The boys show their entire flashback from beginning to end: The boys were having their very first photo shoot as Big Time Rush. However, with Gustavo and Kelly doing community service for vandalizing Matthew McConaughey's mailbox, Griffin took over and makes them "space matadors with stuffy puppies". A simple photo shoot becomes a race for time and the perfect shot. Meanwhile, Katie and her mom are determined to get an autograph from teen hunk Dak Zevon, and Mrs. Knight starts to go a little nuts when the security guards are mean to Katie, so she (Mrs. Knight) gets all the fans of Dak and tries to barricade the door to Dak's recording room.

episodes.title: Big Time Break
episodes.description: The boys are relieved to finally be able to spend some time apart after finding out that Gustavo is taking the day off. Logan is determined to get into a math lecture taught by Phoebe Nachee, but is disappointed when he finds out that the lecture is at an all girls school. Carlos panics when he realizes his helmet is missing, but gets a surprise visit from his father, a policeman, who accompanies him on the mission to retrieve his helmet. James decides to spend his day off trying to set off his acting career with the help of Camille. Kendall is desperate to spend time with his crush, Jo, but is discouraged when she continuously reminds him she has a boyfriend. However, when Katie finds out that Jo does not have a boyfriend, she tells Kendall, and he is determined to get the truth out of her.

episodes.title: Big Time Demos
episodes.description: The guys, who desperately want to remain in L.A., have to pass the greenlight of their demos for that to happen, after Kelly tells them they will be forced to head back to Minnesota if they do not get their CD's greenlighted. Mercedes Griffin, Griffins daughter, comes and pretends to be the "secret someone who picks the demos". They soon find out that the demos are picked by a chimpanzee, so they try to bribe it to pick Big Time Rush. Meanwhile, Mrs. Knight tries to be assistant manager to stay at Palm Woods for Katie's sake.

episodes.title: Big Time Party
episodes.description: When the boys find out they are not invited to their own party at Rocque Records, they decide to throw their own in the Palm Woods, since Mrs. Knight and Katie are off to San Diego, even though Mr. Bitters does not allow it. They call the party a 'social gathering', since there is no rule forbidding them, and the boys agree on only inviting 3 friends each. Kendall invites Jo, as his 'guest-friend-person-thing', while James invites the 3 hottest girls on his phone. It is unknown who Logan invited. Carlos cannot decide and ends up inviting the first 3 contacts on his phone and one of them is 'All Contacts' (Carlos thought it was "Al Contacts", thus inviting his whole phone). During the "social gathering," everybody in Carlos phone is now in the party which causes a big problem. Soon, Bitters is hunting for their party, so Kendall and Jo try to stop him before the boys get "3 strikes" and are thrown out of the Palm Woods. Both Camille and Mercedes arrive at the party trying to spend some time with Logan which causes a problem for him.

episodes.title: Big Time Jobs
episodes.description: The boys have been breaking things while having too much fun at the Palm Woods and Gustavo has had enough. Rather than covering for them, Gustavo decides to teach the guys a lesson by making them get jobs to pay off $2,000.30 for the damages. Gustavo puts the boys on Freight Train's "No-Swim list" so they cannot swim in the Palmwoods pool until they pay all of the money back. Carlos becomes Gustavo's production assistant, while James attempts to become a model with Katie as his manager. At first, Logan and Kendall were going to be sign spinners. However, they get fired and start a babysitting service, which was not as easy as they expected. Eventually, Kendall and Logan make the kids wash cars. When Carlos is getting a coffee for Gustavo using an automated coffee maker C.A.L. (very likely a parody of H.A.L.), it makes a coffee with foam, and when it asks Carlos if he wants more foam, C.A.L. keeps on squirting more and more foam until the kitchen is full of it and more and proclaims it wants to cover the Earth in foam. The boys eventually pay Gustavo back his money, but then, people come storming in asking who will pay for setting up an illegal daycare service in the Palm Woods, using Palm Woods rags and towels, James' wardrobe, the coffee machine, and foam removal. Gustavo gets angry and wrecks his studio. Griffin sees this and asks him to pay him back the exact same amount of money the boys get fined. The episode ends with Gustavo, Kelly, and the boys washing cars.

episodes.title: Big Time Blogger
episodes.description: The boys must impress a well-known blogger, Deke whose words can control their career. They are going to be spending a "Day with Deke" very soon, so Gustavo hires people to train the boys to have a good "Day with Deke". When the interview starts, 5 minutes later, Deke writes a bad review, and the boys must figure out how to change his mind about them for a good review before he posts it through a series of traps. Meanwhile, Gustavo gets a "Scuttlebutter" account and sends out a Scutbut that he hate Brussels, the capital of Belgium. (He meant to type that he hates Brussel Sprouts)

episodes.title: Big Time Terror
episodes.description: Gustavo's mansion becomes flooded, so he decides to live with the boys at the Palm Woods until it's unflooded. However, the boys want him to leave as soon as possible and will do whatever it takes to make him leave. Meanwhile, Carlos and Mr. Bitters are trying to prove that there is a ghost in the Palm Woods, while Logan is there to prove him wrong.

episodes.title: Big Time Dance
episodes.description: The kids at the Palm Woods are organizing their first school dance, and the boys of Big Time Rush have secured the perfect location, Gustavo's recording studio. However there is a catch, the guys have to perform one of their songs during the evening. Now on top of having to get the perfect date, the guys have the added pressure of giving their first performance in front of a live audience. Kendall and Katie attempt to find their mom a perfect date, during which Kendall forgets to ask Jo to the dance, instead asking her to do preparations for the dance. The Jennifers all take Carlos under different personas after rejecting all the guys who asked them including Carlos (Carlos being the coolest, but still out of their league) and a nerdy kid. Logan tries to find the courage to ask Camille, but keeps failing miserably. James in his attempts to help out Logan accidentally asks out numerous girls including Rachael.

episodes.title: Big Time Sparks
episodes.description: The boys are told to stay away from Jordin Sparks while she stays at the Palm Woods and records a new song at Rocque Records. As they try to protect her, they only give her bad luck, eventually pushing her down a well and when Kendall tries to help her, Jo catches him and thinks he is cheating on her.

episodes.title: Big Time Fever
episodes.description: A heatwave strikes Hollywood and James starts to use tanning spray that's supposedly "mangerine" to the point of his skin looking orange. The boys find out that James has "Hollywood Fever" from Camille and when Gustavo sees this, he tells Kendall, Logan, and Carlos to fix James, or he will fire and replace him. Kendall, Logan, and Carlos go on a mission to get rid of the his tanning spray by chasing him around with water-guns. While on the mission, Carlos finds out that the one of the Jennifers went away so he joins their group and also catches Hollywood fever. Meanwhile, while Logan looks for James in Palm Woods Park, he runs into Guitar Dude who gives him a set of bongos and tells him to chill out, catching the fever and losing his uptight edge in the process.

episodes.title: Big Time Video
episodes.description: The boys learn that Camille is leaving the Palm Woods unless she gets a part in an acting job, and must help her, eventually promising everyone a part in their upcoming music video. But Gustavo said Camille cannot be in the video, and Big Time Rush tell everyone that they can be in the video. They gotta figure out how to get everyone in the video, and Marcos tries to direct the music video but Gustavo will not let him. They stole Mr. Bitter's car for the video themselves, including all the people they promise and Marcos is directing, and the video's amazing. Gustavo asks Mr. Bitters to sell his car, and makes it Big Time Rush Mobile.

episodes.title: Big Time Concert
episodes.description: In the eye of their first album release, Griffin, the head of the record label, cancels the album, tour, and concert, forcing them to return to Minnesota, which threatens to break up their life-long friendships. James gets mad and he's got 3 record deal, and joins Hawk, Gustavo's Arch-Rival. Gustavo has to pay back to Griffin $2,000,000 to get back Big Time Rush, and to get them to come back and to finally perform concert. They come back to the LA, and they cannot stay in the Palmwoods again, so they all start living in the Rocque Records "RocqueWoods". James does not want to come back to Big Time Rush so they open an audition for the new James, but they can find anyone and James comes back and they prepare for the concert

episodes.title: Welcome Back, Big Time
episodes.description: The boys have come back from their concert tour only to find certain things at the Palm Woods altered. Meanwhile, Jo is seen macking with a new guy.

episodes.title: Big Time Fans
episodes.description: The boys get a chance to see one of their hometown friends when she comes over to visit, who happens to be very clumsy. Meanwhile, James gets a visit of his own by a crazed fan.

episodes.title: Big Time Girlfriends
episodes.description: Each member of Big Time Rush is trying to deal with a female friend throughout the day. For an upcoming audition, James is trying to help Camille prepare for it. Meanwhile, in order learn about heartbreak, Gustavo tries to help Carlos get his first girlfriend. Also, Kendall and Jo are having a hard time trying to keep up with each other's busy schedule.

episodes.title: Big Time Live
episodes.description: The boys are scheduled to make their first TV appearance, but when it looks like they'll be bumped, they do whatever it takes to keep their spot.

episodes.title: Big Time Halloween
episodes.description: The monstrous personas of Big Time Rush come to light: James is a sexy vampire, Logan is a zombie, Carlos is Franken-Carlos and Kendall is a werewolf.

episodes.title: Big Time Sneakers
episodes.description: James and Logan try to buy and resell sneakers. Meanwhile, Jo's publicist wants the press to think that she is dating her co-star Jett, Kendall and Jo must hide their relationship, and doing so requires many different disguises when Kendall just wants to go to the zoo with Jo. Also, Carlos and Katie name themselves Robin and Hoodie, and try to find other ways to get their favorite fruit snacks, fruit smackers after Bitters makes the price insanely high so everyone cannot afford to buy them.

episodes.title: Big Time Pranks
episodes.description: The boys hold their annual prank-day contest and the girls at Palm Woods want to participate, so it soon becomes a battle of boys vs. girls. Meanwhile, an awry prank-themed day with Gustavo and Kelly escalates into minor destruction and some violence. Logan becomes Dr. Hollywood's assistant for the day after his eyes got hurt because his own prank backfired on him. At the end, the prank war ended with Kendall and Katie as the champions.

episodes.title: Big Time Christmas
episodes.description: The boys are excited to head back to Minnesota for the holidays, but hours before their flight, Griffin, the head of the record label, insists on them recording a Christmas EP, and will not let them leave until it's done. So it looks like they will be spending their first Christmas away from home. After making the first song, Griffin told them the other two songs must be celebrity duets. Then Big Time Rush trying to do the duet with Miranda Cosgrove in Have a Miranda's little Christmas and another duet with Snoop Dogg. Meanwhile, Mrs. Knight attempts to pack up presents and clothes so she does not have to pay a luggage fee and Katie attempts to give a Scrooge-esque Mr. Bitters some holiday cheer.

episodes.title: Big Time Guru
episodes.description: Gustavo is really angry at Big Time Rush and he chases them into the Palmwoods. Big Time Rush ask for help from Buddha Bob, and he does the Himalayan monkey pinch on Gustavo and he becomes so mellow that he writes a horrible song for the New Town High soundtrack. Kelly and Kendall team up to help Gustavo return to his regular, angry self. Meanwhile, Logan downloads a Swagger app on his phone, which increases Logan's swagger and decreases James', causing James to almost "die" from dangerously low swagger counts. Carlos takes advice from a parrot, and when he is about to go on a date with a girl, the parrot tells him he has 24 hours to live, horrifying him and leaving him to live in the bathroom (Panic Room) of the apartment. The boys must now do whatever it takes to get back control of Big Time Rush, and make Gustavo get back to normal before the New Town High producers come and find that he has not written a good song.

episodes.title: Big Time Crush
episodes.description: Kendall and Jo help Carlos find a date, and Logan flirts with a new girl, Peggy, while he is still confused about his feelings for Camille. James wants to help Katie get closer to her new crush, Kyle, but becomes like an overprotective brother instead. Logan wants to get back together with Camille, but she goes on a date with Steve, and at the end all the boys are alone when they go see a movie they planned to see with their dates.

episodes.title: Big Time Beach Party
episodes.description: Big Time Rush and the Palm Woods kids get to hang out at Griffin's beach house for the day. Carlos and Logan hunt for buried treasure, James falls for a pretty girl who he suspects is a mermaid and Kendall and Jo's relationship hits the skids.

episodes.title: Big Time Songwriters
episodes.description: When Griffin is releasing the BTR deluxe edition album. Gustavo has to hire songwriters but they end up fighting and cannot write the song. So Gustavo writes the song himself. Kendall, James, Carlos, and Logan want to write their own song, Gustavo doesnt agree with them so the boys want Katie to open a health spa in the Palmwoods so they can write the song while Camille and Buddha Bob keep Gustavo busy. In the song writing process, Kendall and Carlos write a song named "Oh" while James and Logan prefer their song called "Yeah", this creates a fight between the members of the group. After the fight, they realize the song can collaborate together and form "Oh" and "Yeah", the song then becomes Oh Yeah and is approved by Griffin.

episodes.title: Big Time Reality
episodes.description: Griffin orders a reality show about the guys' lives, complete with the audience voting to eliminate one member of BTR. To stay interesting, Carlos and James resort to non-stop fighting, Logan and Camille fake a melodramatic relationship, and Kendall attempts to unplug all the cameras once and for all after one catches him off-guard at the Palm Woods pool. In order to get the show cancelled and keep the group together, the boys must try to prove to Griffin that a reality show is a bad idea.

episodes.title: Big Time Girl Group
episodes.description: When Gustavo begins working with a female pop group called the Kat's Crew, the boys of Big Time Rush get some jealousy when their new single "I Know You Know" is taken by the Kat's Crew. They start a war between each side (Big Time Rush & Kat's Crew), believing that Gustavo will forget about them and cancel Big Time Rush. The guys turn to "Boys in the Attic", Gustavo's first boy band, for some advice: they were also destroyed by a female group named "Angel Angels". In the end Gustavo decides to keep the guys and stop working with the Kat's Crew, but before the girls leave Rocque Records forever, Big Time Rush makes a song and a video with them. Meanwhile, Katie and Mrs. Knight and are trying to find good friends

episodes.title: Green Time Rush
episodes.description: The gang is taking part in a classroom competition to make the Palm Woods more environmentally friendly. Things go wrong when Kendall and Logan end up with undesirable partners and Carlos and James' efforts to start an organic farm in the crib lead to a cow on the loose in the hallways.

episodes.title: Big Time Moms
episodes.description: James' mom, nicknamed the "Estee Lauder of the Midwest" for her successful cosmetics line, arrives at the Palm Woods to bring James home and groom him to take over the family company. The guys have to act fast to save the band, and figure out how to stand up to a woman not used to being told "no".

episodes.title: Big Time Prom King
episodes.description: The Palm Woods school is having its annual prom and Kendall, James, Carlos and Logan are all determined to win the title of Prom King and each will do whatever it takes to win. Carlos takes one of the Jennifers, but thinking he took the wrong date, Carlos dumps her, therefore the Jennifers team up again to destroy him. Kendall has to sneak Jo out of her apartment on being grounded, but they both get caught later on by her dad. Logan is jealous when Camille is going to prom with another guy so he tries to make sure James will be Prom King and queen with his date. But James ends up being hunted by three body guards, when trying to get Aubrey Stewart from "The Vampire Stories Chronicles Saga Trilogy". James and Logan both end up winning Prom King and Queen. Logan wins King, while James wins Queen.

episodes.title: Big Time Break-Up
episodes.description: Jo was offered a role in a major motion picture that shoots in New Zealand for 3 years. However, she lies to Kendall, saying that she is incapable of doing the movie due to her "New Town High " contract. But when Kendall and Katie check Jo's New Town High contract, it states that ", if offered a role in a major motion picture, she can get out of her contract. Much to Kendall's guilt, he tries to get Jo to break up with him by acting disgusting on their date. Jo then decides to take the role after Kendall convinces her. After her limo leaves, the boys realize that Kendall and Jo forgot their signature "Goodbye Kiss." The boys rush to the airport just before Jo's plane leaves for a proper goodbye.

episodes.title: Big Time Single
episodes.description: The guys help Kendall cheer up after his big break up with Jo in order for him to get prepared for the band's new super huge summer single. While guys try to help Kendall cheer up he states that they'll never know what he's going through because they've never had their hearts broken. So James, Carlos, and Logan each date a girl from the Palmwoods for a few minutes and then try to break up with them to know what its like to get their hearts broken after a short relationship. James date the Jennifers and Logan dates Camille. When Kendall finally cheers up, James is upset because Jennifer broke up with him instead of vice versa ruining his perfect "never been dumped" record. Carlos is upset because he only spent 12 minutes dating 'red shirt girl' and it was "the best 12 minutes of his life." Meanwhile, Gustavo has writers block while trying to write the band’s summer single that has to “rule the world.”

episodes.title: Big Time Wedding
episodes.description: James accidentally proposes to a girl and Logan, Kendall, and Carlos have to stop the wedding before it's too late.

episodes.title: Big Time Rocker
episodes.description: A new rocker-chick neighbor blows the guys away. Carlos and James are desperate to date her, while Kendall tries to prove that BTR can rock too.

episodes.title: Big Time Strike
episodes.description: BTR refuses to record their second album after Gustavo is too hard on them, and the strike pits the band against their producer in a battle of wills.

episodes.title: Big Time Contest
episodes.description: A "Win a Date with BTR" contest held by a Teen Magazine goes all wrong with Logan's date an old lady, Kendall's date is a young boy only interested in his little sister. Carlos and James keeps swapping dates.

episodes.title: Big Time Superheroes
episodes.description: An early release of Hawk from prison proves to be a big mistake. A costumed Hawk, complete with large costumed henchmen, steals the hard drive that contains the only copy of the new album's masters. And only "The Supertastic Super-6" can save the day.

episodes.title: Big Time Secret
episodes.description: James works with Carlos to win over an old friend from camp who is now a super model. Logan and Lucy try to find out what the secret is between Kendall and Camille and why are they spending so much time together. Gustavo, Kelly and Katie try to learn Mrs Knight's secret cookie recipe.

episodes.title: Big Time Interview
episodes.description: Big Time Rush has dropped their second album, and a TV program has the guys making revealing comments about their lives inside and outside the band.

episodes.title: Big Time Move
episodes.description: The boys have the fight of all fights and decide to move out. James ends up squatting in a cool retiree's apartment, Logan moves into a place right by the water, Carlos builds a cardboard house, and Kendall must fix things.

episodes.title: Backstage Rush
episodes.description: On their last day of their "All Over the World Tour", the boys want to learn how to change costumes faster, so they can break a backstage record held by NSYNC. Logan wanted to finish a book before the tour ends and French Inspector Henri Duchamp was looking for Carlos after posting online that he took a cricket out of France. Meanwhile, Kelly must save the boys from a faulty stage trampoline, but she is trapped outside.

episodes.title: Big Time Returns
episodes.description: Big Time Rush returns to the Palm Woods after their world tour and learn they are now famous.

episodes.title: Bel Air Rush
episodes.description: Because of the paparazzi and crazy fans, Gustavo moves the boys to Bel-Air, but the guys dislike the confinements of their new ritzy lifestyle and make a plan to return to the Palm Woods.

episodes.title: Big Time Double Date
episodes.description: Kendall has dinner with Lucy and her parents who believe she is a classical musician. Meanwhile, Logan goes on a date with a girl he has the same interests, after a fight with Camille and Carlos is on a date with a Jennifer and James wants to help him.

episodes.title: Big Time Merchandise
episodes.description: The boys dislike Griffin's new line of Big Time Rush merchandise and attempt to sabotage his sales plan, but they wind up making matters worse. Meanwhile, Katie accidentally destroys her mother's Palm Woods robe and buys a replacement robe from Bitters, only that the robe she was sold doesn't include a belt, and Bitters refuses any refunds or returns so she attempts to get her money's worth by getting the belt the robe was supposed to have.

episodes.title: Big Time Surprise
episodes.description: Kendall attempts to ask Lucy out on a date, until her ex-boyfriend Beau arrives at the Palm Woods to reunite with her. Moments later, he is caught also making out with other girls at the Palm Woods. With James, Jett and Camille to assist, Kendall is determined to document evidence of Beau's activity. Meanwhile, Griffin orders Gustavo to kidnap him, so Gustavo hires Carlos and Logan to do the job. Also, Mrs. Knight and Katie (with help from Buddha Bob) try to steal Jett's computer to find out the ending of the cliffhanger episode of New Town High which Jett is on.

episodes.title: Big Time Decision
episodes.description: Kendall is unsure whether he has moved on with Lucy during Jo's absence, or whether he still has feelings for Jo. Meanwhile, Carlos has to make a choice to stand by either his best friend James, or his new benefactor Mr. Bitters, during a supposed zombie apocalypse.

episodes.title: Big Time Babysitting
episodes.description: Kendall and Logan have to take care of a rock legend before his Hall of Fame induction; James and Carlos are forced to watch Katie.

episodes.title: Big Time Gold
episodes.description: Camille finds a gold necklace and believes it's Logan anniversary gift to her, when it's really Kendall's birthday gift for Jo. Meanwhile, James and Carlos want to find out if they can listen to BTR in pure gold without getting caught by Gustavo.

episodes.title: Big Time Camping
episodes.description: Gustavo doesn't allow the boys to go camping because he fears for their safety, so they resort to camping on a soundstage with Jo, Camille and The Jennifers, but end up with a face off (Boys vs Girls). Meanwhile, Gustavo is trying to stop the boys camping section with the help of Kelly because he's afraid of them getting hurt. Elsewhere, Katie and Mrs. Knight are camping outside to get a new iSlab 3. Mr. Bitters had saved Jett a space on line.

episodes.title: Big Time Rescue
episodes.description: Kendall, Jo , Camille, and Logan volunteer at a dog shelter and end up adopting 12 dogs. Meanwhile, James finds Carlos and Jennifer's puppy love sickening.

episodes.title: Big Time Bloopers
episodes.description: The boys mistakenly ruin the tape with their last episode, so they quickly set a blooper+outtakes episode hosted by Stephen Kramer Glickman as Gustavo Roque and Ciara Bravo as Katie Knight.

episodes.title: Big Time Invasion
episodes.description: The new British band "invade" the music business and Big Time Rush is afraid that they are going to end their career. To save their career they decide to hire new managers but disagree on who they are going to take.

episodes.title: Big Time Scandal
episodes.description: Big Time Rush are accused for scandals: Lucy Stone releases an album about a bad break-up with a guy who is rumored to be Kendall, Carlos tries to swat a bee and is accused by E! News for hitting grannies and Logan is accused for trying to rob a granny, which was really helping. Meanwhile, James spreads up a rumor about him doing a duet with Cher Lloyd.

episodes.title: Big Time Lies
episodes.description: Lucy tries to get Kendall back, but Kendall lies to Jo and tells nothing is happening. Meanwhile, James and Carlos lie to Gustavo about destroying his office and make up a story about a robbery and Logan lies to Camille about being sick, because he doesn't want to come to a boring play.

episodes.title: Big Time Bonus
episodes.description: Griffin gives the boys a $20,000 bonus and wants them to prove him they will spend them with responsibility.

episodes.title: Big Time Cameos
episodes.description: Gustavo books the boys to a lot of painful TV show cameos, but they decide to do no more cameos, until they get booked for "Coco.0", a show Carlos loves and has a pretty main character, Dara Larameigh.

episodes.title: Big Time Tour Bus
episodes.description: Big Time Rush is on the way to their concert to San Diego, in tour buses, but they get stuck in traffic. Kendall is with Carlos, who is filming videos with his camera all the time and Logan is with James and they have roommate problems. Meanwhile, Victoria Justice keeps the crowd busy until Big Time Rush shows up and Mrs. Knight and Katie are also stuck in traffic.

episodes.title: Big Time Pranks II
episodes.description: Palm Woods' prank wars kick off again, and this time the kids battle the adults. Logan pranks himself out (again) and becomes "The Prankster Gangster", supplying prank tools to the kids.

episodes.title: Big Time Rides
episodes.description: James buys a motorcycle to try to impress Lucy; Kendall teaches Jo how to drive a stick-shift; Carlos and Logan hold on to a childhood treasure (wood wagon).

episodes.title: Big Time Tests
episodes.description: Logan brings Carlos along to the MCAT test as his good luck charm; James is upset because Lucy is off for a European tour and he becomes obsessed with relationship quizzes; Griffin puts on a product testing lab at Rocque Records and asks for Katie, Gustavo and Kelly to test the products for him.

episodes.title: Big Time Cartoon
episodes.description: The boys have been approached by two huge companies that are interested in expanding the BTR brand a little farther. They have two options of choosing between getting their own cartoon or their own video game.

episodes.title: Big Time Break Out
episodes.description: At a party at Rocque Records, celebrating the release of their third studio album, Griffin asks the boys about which one of them is going to leave Big Time Rush and break out.

episodes.title: Big Time Dreams (1)
episodes.description: It's the Tween Choice Awards, and BTR's night is in jeopardy when the guys uncover an evil plan to brainwash the audience. Now BTR must find a way to defeat the bad guy, save the show, and still make sure their dreams come true.

title: The Queen's Gambit
description: In a 1950s orphanage, a young girl reveals an astonishing talent for chess and begins an unlikely journey to stardom while grappling with addiction.

episodes.title: Openings
episodes.description: Sent to an orphanage at age 9, Beth develops an uncanny knack for chess — and a growing dependence on the green tranquilizers given to the children.

episodes.title: Exchanges
episodes.description: Suddenly plunged into a confusing new life in suburbia, teenage Beth studies her high school classmates and hatches a plan to enter a chess tournament.

episodes.title: Doubled Pawns
episodes.description: The trip to Cincinnati launches Beth and her mother into a whirlwind of travel and press coverage. Beth sets her sights on the U.S. Open in Las Vegas.

episodes.title: Middle Game
episodes.description: Russian class opens the door to a new social scene. In Mexico City, Beth meets the intimidating Borgov, while her mother cozies up to a pen pal.

episodes.title: Fork
episodes.description: Back home in Kentucky, a shaken Beth reconnects with a former opponent who offers to help sharpen her game ahead of the U.S. Championship.

episodes.title: Adjournment
episodes.description: After training with Benny in New York, Beth heads to Paris for her rematch with Borgov. But a wild night sends her into a self-destructive spiral.

episodes.title: End Game
episodes.description: A visit from an old friend forces Beth to reckon with her past and rethink her priorities — just in time for the biggest match of her life.

title: Anne with an E
description: A coming-of-age story about an outsider who, against all odds and numerous challenges, fights for love and acceptance and for her place in the world. The series centers on a young orphaned girl in the late 1890s, who, after an abusive childhood spent in orphanages and the homes of strangers, is mistakenly sent to live with an elderly woman and her aging brother. Over time, 13-year-old Anne will transform their lives and eventually the small town in which they live with her unique spirit, fierce intellect and brilliant imagination.

episodes.title: Your Will Shall Decide Your Destiny
