episodes.description: When a miscommunication brings a girl to Green Gables instead of a boy, Marilla and Matthew are faced with a life-changing decision.

episodes.title: I Am No Bird, and No Net Ensnares Me
episodes.description: Hoping all is not lost, Matthew races to catch up with Anne while Marilla anxiously hopes and waits for their return to Green Gables.

episodes.title: But What Is So Headstrong as Youth?
episodes.description: Anne is excited to begin school and make friends, but is unprepared for the bullying that occurs when she doesn’t fit in. Marilla accepts an invitation for a group.

episodes.title: An Inward Treasure Born
episodes.description: Anne is faced with the decision of whether or not to return to school. A fire at the Gillis house and Anne’s generous actions help her in her choice.

episodes.title: Tightly Knotted to a Similar String
episodes.description: Anne must deal with the inevitability of womanhood when she gets her first period. At the same time, Marilla and Matthew acclimatize to parenthood and revisit moments of their youth through Anne.

episodes.title: Remorse Is the Poison of Life
episodes.description: When her little sister becomes ill, Diana runs to Anne for help. Meanwhile, the Blythe farm sees change, as Marilla is reminded of what she gave up and Matthew receives some unsettling news.

episodes.title: Wherever You Are Is My Home
episodes.description: On the verge of losing the farm, the Cuthberts must do whatever it takes to save it. Anne is reminded of the strength of friendship and love. Season finale.

episodes.title: Youth is the Season of Hope
episodes.description: The Cuthberts' boarders stir excitement with a question: Could there be gold in Avonlea? Elsewhere, Gilbert makes a new friend at sea.

episodes.title: Signs are Small Measurable Things, but Interpretations are Illimitable
episodes.description: The steamer lands in Trinidad, bringing Bash face to face with his past. The Barrys get behind the gold rush, but Matthew and Marilla aren't so sure.

episodes.title: The True Seeing is Within
episodes.description: An adventure away with the Barrys teaches Anne to trust her instincts. Marilla begins to suspect that her boarders aren’t as innocent as they seem.

episodes.title: The Painful Eagerness of Unfed Hope
episodes.description: Anne writes letters as an "agent of romance" while Diana trains at home to be a lady. A life-changing encounter steers Gilbert toward his destiny.

episodes.title: The Determining Acts of Her Life
episodes.description: A game of spin the bottle prompts burning questions about love and beauty. Anne and Cole bond over their differences as Gilbert makes his way home.

episodes.title: I Protest Against Any Absolute Conclusion
episodes.description: Anne faces the world with a shocking new look while the town preps for its annual Christmas pantomime. Gilbert and Bash join the Cuthberts for dinner.

episodes.title: Memory Has as Many Moods as the Temper
episodes.description: Cole accompanies the girls to Aunt Josephine's for a lavish party filled with surprises. Back at home, Marilla's health takes a worrisome turn.

episodes.title: Struggling Against the Perception of Facts
episodes.description: With a wedding on the horizon, Anne wonders what kind of bride she'd like to be. Marilla sees an oculist, and Bash meets a friendly face in "The Bog."

episodes.title: What We Have Been Makes Us What We Are
episodes.description: A brand-new teacher brings unconventional methods -- and a motorbike -- to Avonlea. Gilbert's plan to speed up his studies leaves Bash feeling lost.

episodes.title: The Growing Good of the World
episodes.description: Anne rallies her friends to save Miss Stacy in the wake of a disastrous incident. Bash gets an unexpected gift, and Cole makes a surprising choice.

episodes.title: A Secret Which I Desired to Divine
episodes.description: Anne's 16th birthday inspires her to learn more about her genealogy. Meanwhile, the school kids prepare for the Queen's entrance exams, leaving Diana isolated.

episodes.title: There is Something at Work in My Soul Which I Do Not Understand
episodes.description: Anne's search takes her back to the orphanage, where she's forced to confront new realities while Elijah pays a visit to Avonlea.

episodes.title: What Can Stop the Determined Heart
episodes.description: As Easter approaches, Mary's illness brings change to Avonlea. An Indian Affairs agent brings news that changes Ka'kwet's life.

episodes.title: A Hope of Meeting You in Another World
episodes.description: Ka'kwet travels to school, while Anne embarks on the next phase of her quest. Diana pushes back against her parent's wishes resulting in an unforeseen adventure.

episodes.title: I Am Fearless and Therefore Powerful
episodes.description: A dance rehearsal generates sparks -- and tension. A field trip to the woods opens new horizons for Gilbert. Bash seeks help from an unexpected source.

episodes.title: The Summit of My Desires
episodes.description: Avonlea hosts the Island County Fair, which brings romance, heartbreak, competition, and disaster. Matthew goes head to head with an old friend, while Jerry seizes a unique opportunity and Anne seeks the advice of a fortune teller. The barn dance brings a devastating incident to light and compels Anne to take bold action.

episodes.title: A Strong Effort of the Spirit of Good
episodes.description: Anne rallies the town to speak out against injustice. Josie makes a brave decision. A secret comes to light, causing a rift between Anne and Diana. Miss Stacy and the kids raise the ire of the School’s Board of Directors, to disastrous results.

episodes.title: Great and Sudden Change
episodes.description: The students sit for the Queen's entrance exams. Ka’kwet hatches a plan. Aunt Josephine visits and brings a devious scheme. Gilbert is given an opportunity he never could have dreamed of. A new arrival in Avonlea tests Bash’s patience.

episodes.title: A Dense and Frightful Darkness
episodes.description: After a shocking act of violence, Oqwatnuk and Aluk call upon the Cuthberts for help. Anne is forced to confront harsh truths. Gilbert makes a decision about his future.

episodes.title: The Better Feeling of My Heart
episodes.description: As the students prepare to depart for Queen’s College, Gilbert takes a final chance. Marilla intervenes on Diana’s behalf. Anne embraces her future but finds that change also brings loss. Elijah returns to Avonlea. Anne has a fateful encounter in Charlottetown. Series finale.

title: Marvel Studios Legends
description: Revisit the epic heroes, villains and moments from across the MCU in preparation for the stories still to come. Each dynamic segment feeds directly into the upcoming series — setting the stage for future events. This series weaves together the many threads that constitute the unparalleled Marvel Cinematic Universe.

episodes.title: Wanda Maximoff
episodes.description: Explore Wanda Maximoff’s growth and the unique bond shaping her destiny.

episodes.title: Vision
episodes.description: Explore Vision’s quest for humanity and love, capped by selfless sacrifice.

episodes.title: Falcon
episodes.description: Revisit Sam's journey to becoming The Falcon, and his eventual partnering with The Winter Soldier.

episodes.title: The Winter Soldier
episodes.description: Relive how Bucky Barnes was twisted into the ultimate assassin, and finally redeemed.

episodes.title: Zemo
episodes.description: Retrace Zemo’s diabolical scheme to incite a war amongst the Avengers themselves.

episodes.title: Sharon Carter
episodes.description: Learn how Agent Sharon Carter risked all for Steve Rogers, doing what she knew was right.

episodes.title: Loki
episodes.description: Retrace Loki's evolution from power-mad villain, to a being with more noble tendencies.

episodes.title: The Tesseract
episodes.description: Trace the journey of the Tesseract, a powerful object sought by villains and heroes alike.

episodes.title: Black Widow
episodes.description: Catch up on the history of Agent Romanoff as you prepare for her new film, "Black Widow."

episodes.title: Peggy Carter
episodes.description: Learn how Peggy Carter aided Captain America and became a founding member of S.H.I.E.L.D.

episodes.title: The Avengers Initiative
episodes.description: Learn how the "Earth's mightiest heroes" assembled to fight the battles no one else could.

episodes.title: The Ravagers
episodes.description: Learn the exploits of the Ravagers and trace the unique journey of their leader, Yondu.

episodes.title: The Ten Rings
episodes.description: Recounts the history of the Ten Rings organization and its mysterious leader, The Mandarin.

episodes.title: Hawkeye
episodes.description: Recounts how Hawkeye employed his unique skillset to help defeat the evil plans of not just one, but three megalomaniacal beings: Loki, Ultron, and Thanos.

episodes.title: Doctor Strange
episodes.description: Retrace Doctor Strange's journey from an arrogant neurosurgeon, to the heroic master of sorcery.

episodes.title: Wong
episodes.description: Retrace Wong's mystical journey from protector of ancient tomes, to protector of worlds.

episodes.title: Scarlet Witch
episodes.description: Revisit Wanda Maximoff's strange journey from happy homemaker to the dreaded Scarlet Witch.

episodes.title: Thor
episodes.description: Retrace Thor's journey, from banished Asgardian prince, to one of Earth’s mightiest heroes.

episodes.title: Jane Foster
episodes.description: Recount Jane Foster’s singular journey, from maverick astrophysicist, to defender of Earth.

episodes.title: Valkyrie
episodes.description: Recount Valkyrie’s surprising journey: from fallen warrior, to king of New Asgard.

episodes.title: Bruce Banner
episodes.description: Recounts Bruce Banner’s epic evolution: from man, to monster, to mythic hero.

episodes.title: King T'Challa
episodes.description: Recall T’Challa's momentous tenure as Wakanda’s most beloved protector, the Black Panther.

episodes.title: Princess Shuri
episodes.description: Recall Shuri's inspirational journey, from brilliant inventor, to Wakandan warrior.

episodes.title: The Dora Milaje
episodes.description: Revisit the extraordinary exploits of Wakanda’s fiercest female warriors, the Dora Milaje.

episodes.title: Mantis
episodes.description: Recall how a lonely empath named Mantis became a Guardian of the Galaxy.

episodes.title: Drax
episodes.description: Remember the epic journey of Drax, from vengeful Destroyer, to Guardian of the Galaxy.

episodes.title: Ant-Man
episodes.description: LEGENDS traces those moments big and small that transformed Scott Lang into the tiniest of Earth’s mightiest heroes. Scott faces off against powerful adversaries, meets the love of his life, and becomes the dad he was destined to be. Oh, and it’s the Ant-Man who winds up providing the key to defeating Thanos and saving the universe. He’s kind of a huge deal.

episodes.title: Wasp
episodes.description: All her life, Hope was shielded from the action by her overprotective father, inventor Hank Pym. But when the Pym Particles fell into the wrong hands, Hope reluctantly trained a thief named Scott Lang to become the Ant-Man.

episodes.title: Hank & Janet
episodes.description: Hank Pym and Janet Van Dyne were the original Ant-Man and Wasp, but after an epic show of bravery, Janet was lost forever… or so Hank thought.

episodes.title: Peter Quill
episodes.description: Armed with a cocky attitude and trusty cassette player, Peter Quill, or also known as, Star-Lord, only ever looked out for himself. He stole, punched and kissed his way across the stars. That is, until he found his true family: the Guardians of the Galaxy.

episodes.title: Gamora
episodes.description: Raised in captivity to be the ultimate warrior by Thanos the Mad Titan, Gamora seemed destined for villainy. But a rebellious turn against her adoptive captor led Gamora to team up with the Guardians of the Galaxy, a band of misfits that would become her chosen family.

episodes.title: Nebula
episodes.description: For most of her life, Nebula yearned for validation from Thanos, carrying out his evil orders as he conspired to annihilate half the universe. But it was Gamora's love as a sister that finally turned Nebula against their genocidal father, and compelled her to join the Guardians of the Galaxy.

episodes.title: Rocket
episodes.description: Rocket was the product of illegal genetic experimentation on a raccoon, but after surviving his torturous past, he came out the other side a crack pilot with a snarky mouth and a penchant for making things go boom.

episodes.title: Kraglin
episodes.description: The second mate in Yondu Udonta's band of swashbuckling Ravagers, Kraglin was almost always a loyal supporter of his blue captain. Over the course of their run-ins with Peter Quill and his oddball crew, Kraglin grew from a faithful follower, to a formidable leader in his own right.

episodes.title: Groot
episodes.description: Groot is a talking tree that can utter just three words: I am Groot. And only in that particular order. But Groot's also a loyal friend, ferocious warrior and invaluable member of the Guardians of the Galaxy.

episodes.title: Nick Fury
episodes.description: Track the adventures of Earth’s greatest spy, and the behind the Avengers, Nick Fury.

episodes.title: Maria Hill
episodes.description: Remember the indispensable agent who defended Earth from annihilation time and time again.

episodes.title: Talos & the Skrulls
episodes.description: Revisit the story of the Skrulls: a race of oppressed shape-shifters fighting for freedom.

episodes.title: Everett Ross
episodes.description: Revisit Agent Everett Ross’ unlikely journey, from CIA suit, to valued Wakandan ally.

episodes.title: James Rhodes
episodes.description: Remember how Col. James Rhodes traded his military uniform for a suit of mechanized armor.

episodes.title: TVA
episodes.description: Explore the mysterious origins of the Time Variance Authority.

episodes.title: Variants
episodes.description: What exactly is a Variant?

episodes.title: Carol Danvers
episodes.description: Retrace Captain Marvel's epic journey as one of the most powerful heroes in the MCU.

episodes.title: Kamala Khan
episodes.description: Unpack Khan's journey: from a teen who dreams of the Avengers, to a hero names Ms. Marvel.

episodes.title: Monica Rambeau
episodes.description: Recall Monica Rambeau's unlikely journey: from wide-eyed kid, to full-grown superhero.

episodes.title: Guardians of the Multiverse
episodes.description: LEGENDS recalls a handful of hair-raising highlights from season one of Marvel Studios' "What If...?"

title: Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous
description: Six teens attending an adventure camp on the opposite side of Isla Nublar must band together to survive when dinosaurs wreak havoc on the island.

episodes.title: Camp Cretaceous
episodes.description: After waiting his whole life to see dinosaurs, lucky Darius wins the chance to join five other campers on Isla Nublar for a once-in-a-lifetime adventure.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.description: With the rest of the crew off visiting a genetics lab, Kenji sneaks Darius into the park's top-secret underbelly — and straight into danger.

episodes.title: The Cattle Drive
episodes.description: The campers hop into their Gyrospheres to help move a dinosaur herd toward fresh grazing lands. But an incoming storm stirs up unexpected trouble.

episodes.title: Things Fall Apart
episodes.description: Darius remembers the promise he made to his dad. Elsewhere on the island, the campers find themselves face-to-face with a newly freed threat.

episodes.title: Happy Birthday, Eddie!
episodes.description: After a close encounter with the Indominus, the gang seeks shelter in the genetics lab, where a strange scientist reveals the truth about Dr. Wu.

episodes.title: Welcome to Jurassic World
episodes.description: Sammy's secret shocks everyone — but there's no time for anger when an accident unleashes a flock of Pteranodons and forces the crew below ground.

episodes.title: Last Day of Camp
episodes.description: The campers leave the Mosasaurus lagoon and fight their way onto the monorail … where Ben gets a chance to face his fears.

episodes.title: End of the Line
episodes.description: It's a race against time as the campers make their way to the main dock to catch the last ferry leaving the island. But what if they're too late?

episodes.title: A Beacon of Hope
episodes.description: Still stranded on the island — and still reeling from the apparent loss of Ben — the campers make a last-ditch attempt at rescue by sending out an SOS.

episodes.title: The Art of Chill
episodes.description: Darius and Sammy face a moral dilemma while searching the park for supplies. The campers start building a new treehouse. Brooklynn sees something odd.

episodes.title: The Watering Hole
episodes.description: Brooklynn, Sammy and Yasmina team up to investigate strange noises in the park. Elsewhere, Darius and Kenji go exploring and witness a majestic sight.

episodes.title: Salvation
episodes.description: A bonfire in the distance signals that the campers have company: a pair of posh eco-tourists and their disgruntled security guy. But can they be trusted?

episodes.title: Brave
episodes.description: The campers reunite with a long-lost friend, who shares an inspiring story — then reveals that Mitch, Tiff and Hap aren't who they seem.

episodes.title: Misguided
episodes.description: Darius must make a difficult choice to save Sammy and Yasmina. Meanwhile, the remaining campers are trying to decide if Hap is a friend... or a foe.

episodes.title: Step One
episodes.description: Brooklynn, Ben, Kenji and Yasmina work to uncover a secret and restore power to the park as Darius leads Mitch and Tiff straight into a T. rex trap.

episodes.title: Chaos Theory
episodes.description: A guilty Darius is determined to protect the island's innocent dinos — even if he has to do it all alone. But with luck, maybe he won't have to...

episodes.title: View from the Top
episodes.description: The campers catch a lift to Lookout Point in search of materials to make a sail, then must quickly find a way back down. Ben worries about leaving Bumpy.

episodes.title: Safe Harbor
episodes.description: After finding Mitch and Tiff's abandoned yacht, the happy campers celebrate. But the party's over when something big goes bump in the night.

episodes.title: Casa De Kenji
episodes.description: Kenji takes the campers to his father's penthouse to gather supplies — but they've soon got company. Sammy reflects on what life must be like back home.

episodes.title: Clever Girl
episodes.description: A thrilling chase brings Darius, Kenji and Yaz to the old Jurassic Park Visitors Center. Elsewhere on the island, Brooklynn and Sammy find a secret lab.

episodes.title: Eye of the Storm
episodes.description: Sammy and Brooklynn rush to warn the others about a sinister new threat while Darius, unaware of the danger, searches for his dad's favorite dinosaur.

episodes.title: The Long Run
episodes.description: As a poisoned camper fights to survive, it's up to Yaz — the fastest among them — to fetch the antidote before it's too late.

episodes.title: A Shock to the System
episodes.description: It's crunch time for the campers to get to the boat and make their escape... until Ben disappears, deciding he'd rather stay. Can Darius change his mind?

episodes.title: Escape from Isla Nublar
episodes.description: With multiple threats running rampant on the island, dinosaur lover Darius must put his feelings aside and make a difficult decision.

episodes.title: Whatever It Takes
episodes.description: The group is forced to switch gears when a familiar face returns to Isla Nublar. Now, getting off the island is no longer the most important thing.

episodes.title: Stay on Mission
episodes.description: With Brooklynn being held prisoner, the remaining campers hatch a plan to rescue her — and it won't be easy.

episodes.title: Beneath the Surface
episodes.description: Out at sea, the campers see sunny skies... then discover a stowaway on board. A surprise attack from the deep leaves them stranded on unfamiliar shores.

episodes.title: At Least...
episodes.description: The weary crew dodges danger in the desert while trying to figure out where they are. But they unearth more questions than answers.

episodes.title: Turning Dr. Turner
episodes.description: A strange tunnel takes the teens to a lush forest, where they meet a mysterious scientist studying dino behavior. The question is: Can they trust her?

episodes.title: Rude Awakening
episodes.description: With Dr. Turner's help, the campers hatch a plan to get off the island that finds them crossing a snowy arctic biome — and making a selfless rescue.

episodes.title: The Long Game
episodes.description: After learning the truth about Mae's boss, Sammy's ready to go rogue to take him down... just as Mae gets ready to confront him. Cue the killer robots!

episodes.title: Mission Critical
episodes.description: With Mae in serious condition and Kash's end game clear, the campers vow to save the dinosaurs and stop Mantah Corp. But evil BRADs are everywhere.

episodes.title: Staying Alive
episodes.description: Darius has to think fast to distract Kash and protect the others, so he pretends to hate dinos as much as Kash does — while learning everything he can.

episodes.title: Technical Difficulties
episodes.description: Brooklynn must devise a hack to help Darius, who's being tailed by an upgraded BRAD-X. Meanwhile, Kash prepares to woo a group of dangerous investors.

episodes.title: Dino-Sitting
episodes.description: Darius keeps Kash busy with competitive video gaming while the others break into the nursery. Yaz asks Brooklynn how she feels about Kenji.

episodes.title: Taking Control
episodes.description: Ben's refusal to bond with a new friend leads to regret — and a realization that it's time to take Kash down. Kenji and Brooklynn face their feelings.

episodes.title: Who's the Boss?
episodes.description: Just when it feels like things are getting back to normal, Kash's boss arrives on Mantah Corp. island and begins moving forward with a devastating plan.

episodes.title: Reunited
episodes.description: Kenji's thrilled to see his father - and eager to prove himself. Elsewhere, Sammy and Brooklynn team up to find out what happened to Sammy's family.

episodes.title: The Final Test
episodes.description: A cryptic clue prompts Brooklynn, Darius and Ben to dig into Mr. Kon's motives. Kenji plans a date with Brooklynn while helping his dad prep for a party.

episodes.title: Battle Lines
episodes.description: Kenji asks his friends to back off and stay out of his father's business. But to save the island's dinos, they're willing to risk breaking his trust.

episodes.title: Evasive Action
episodes.description: A stunning betrayal lands the friends in lockdown, where they unpack their feelings and plot their escape. Kenji follows his father to Isla Nublar.

episodes.title: Shaky Ground
episodes.description: Something unsettling is sending the dinos into a frenzy. Darius and Brooklynn pour their energies into problem-solving. Kenji chooses sides.

episodes.title: Out of the Pack
episodes.description: Kenji accepts an important assignment - and drives straight into danger. Back on Mantah Corp. Island, the others race to ruin Mr, Kon's plans.

episodes.title: The Leap
episodes.description: The Kids come up with a plan to protect the dinosaurs. Left on her own, Sammy will have to rely on her own strength. Yaz opens up to Ben.

episodes.title: Clean Break
episodes.description: An Increasingly suspicious Kenji starts looking into his father's activities. Mae works to break free from Kon's control and follow her heart.

episodes.title: The Core
episodes.description: Yaz is ready to tell Sammy the truth - but the island has other plans. A conflicted Darius worries that he's lost his way.

episodes.title: Arrival
episodes.description: The friends must think fast to outwit Mr. Kon and his cronies. Ben sets out to rescue an old friend - and gets help from a surprising source.

episodes.title: The Last Stand
episodes.description: A high-stakes battle begins for control of Mantah Corp. Island. Kenji's ready to rejoin his friends, but Darius isn't sure he can forgive him.

episodes.title: The Nublar Six
episodes.description: With the future of the Island at steak, the friends band together - and fight harder than ever before - to protect what's really important.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants
description: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

episodes.title: Help Wanted
episodes.description: SpongeBob goes to the Krusty Krab to apply for the new fry cook job. Against the advice of Squidward, Mr. Krabs, the owner of the restaurant decides to give SpongeBob a chance. Can SpongeBob find the spatula needed for the job and serve all the hungry customers?

episodes.title: Reef Blower
episodes.description: Squidward and SpongeBob are cleaning up their yards with their reef blowers. When one person ends up cleaning their yard, the others gets ruined. Who will get the clean yard in the end?

episodes.title: Tea at the Treedome
episodes.description: SpongeBob meets a land squirrel named Sandy. He is invited to come over to her house, but he finds out that it is full of air. SpongeBob holds out for as long as he can, which isn't a very long time.

episodes.title: Bubblestand
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick are blowing bubbles. Squidward thinks it is a simple task, but he can't blow one single bubble. SpongeBob and Patrick need to teach him the proper bubble blowing technique.

episodes.title: Ripped Pants
episodes.description: While at Goo Lagoon, SpongeBob accidentally rips his pants while trying to impress Sandy, causing everyone to laugh.

episodes.title: Jellyfishing
episodes.description: To make Squidward feel better after a biking accident, SpongeBob and Patrick take him to go Jellyfishing.

episodes.title: Plankton!
episodes.description: Plankton is always trying to steal the secret Krabby Patty formula, but his tiny size gets in his way. In Plankton's latest scheme, he controls SpongeBob's brain to try and steal the Krabby Patty recipe.

episodes.title: Naughty Nautical Neighbors
episodes.description: Squidward is having a peaceful day, until he hears giggling from next door. He gets SpongeBob and Patrick to believe that they hate each other, but now they want to be his best friend.

episodes.title: Boating School
episodes.description: SpongeBob is going to take a driving test, a synonym for disaster. This time is a little different, as SpongeBob gets some help from Patrick.

episodes.title: Pizza Delivery
episodes.description: A customer calls and asks the Krusty Krab to deliver him some pizza. Mr. Krabs orders SpongeBob and Squidward to deliver it. SpongeBob will stop at nothing to get the pizza to the customer, even if that means getting lost.

episodes.title: Home Sweet Pineapple
episodes.description: One night, some nematodes feast on SpongeBob's pineapple house. All that is left is a tiny pebble. Now, SpongeBob must live with his parents! How will he get a new house?

episodes.title: Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick find that their television heroes, Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy, are retired old people. SpongeBob and Patrick try to get them back into Superhero business again.

episodes.title: Pickles
episodes.description: SpongeBob gives an incomplete Krabby Patty to Bubble Bass for the first time. SpongeBob goes crazy, and forgets how to do everything, including his job.

episodes.title: Hall Monitor
episodes.description: SpongeBob is finally given the chance to be a hall monitor at his boating school, but he wastes the school day giving a speech and doesn't get to do anything. That doesn't mean he can't be a Hall Monitor outside of school, right?

episodes.title: Jellyfish Jam
episodes.description: A wild jellyfish follows SpongeBob home, so he decides to keep it. The jellyfish loves to party and dance. Unluckily, SpongeBob's house turns into a party overnight with more jellyfish coming by the second.

episodes.title: Sandy's Rocket
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick accidentally launch Sandy's rocket, and land back in Bikini Bottom. They think they've landed on the moon and that everyone in Bikini Bottom are aliens.

episodes.title: Squeaky Boots
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs gives SpongeBob a pair of "special" boots because he bought them for Pearl, but she didn't want them. SpongeBob loves them, but the squeaking drives Mr. Krabs crazy.

episodes.title: Nature Pants
episodes.description: SpongeBob wants to give up his current life to live with the jellyfish against the wishes of all his friends. But, SpongeBob learns that a jellyfish life is not an easy one.

episodes.title: Opposite Day
episodes.description: Squidward gets so mad at SpongeBob and Patrick, he decides to sell his house. Squidward needs to get rid of his annoying neighbors so he can sell his house. He tells SpongeBob and Patrick that it is "Opposite Day." Squid hopes that they will act the opposite of what they usually are, annoying. Of course, it doesn't work out as planned.

episodes.title: Culture Shock
episodes.description: A talent show is taking place at the Krusty Krab to get more customers and more money, and Squidward is in charge. He will do anything to prevent SpongeBob from doing participating in it.

episodes.title: F.U.N.
episodes.description: SpongeBob thinks that Plankton is evil only because he is lonely and has no friends. SpongeBob becomes Plankton's friend and plays with him. But, Mr. Krabs is convinced that Plankton is evil and that SpongeBob should not be hanging around with him.

episodes.title: MuscleBob BuffPants
episodes.description: SpongeBob thinks he can get more attention if he becomes physically fit. But he soon finds that exercise is hard work, and orders "anchor arms," which he inflates with air, and looks buff. Everyone finds out how fake he is when Sandy signs him up for the annual anchor toss competition at Muscle Beach.

episodes.title: Squidward the Unfriendly Ghost
episodes.description: SpongeBob thinks he accidentally killed Squidward, so Squidward decides to use it for his advantage. Threatening to haunt them for the rest of their lives, Squidward makes SpongeBob and Patrick his servants.

episodes.title: The Chaperone
episodes.description: SpongeBob takes Pearl to the prom because her previous prom date dumped her, and she is very emotional about it. SpongeBob and Pearl cause all kinds of mischief, and they eventually get thrown out of the prom.

episodes.title: Employee of the Month
episodes.description: SpongeBob must try to uphold his position as "Employee of the Month," which he has won for 27 months in a row. But, when Squidward tells him the award is a scam, SpongeBob starts to tease Squidward by saying he could never be "Employee of the Month." Squidward challenges SpongeBob, and then make a mess of everything.

episodes.title: Scaredy Pants
episodes.description: It's Halloween and SpongeBob tries to scare some kids as "The Flying Dutchman," but the kids just laugh at his silly costume. SpongeBob gets Patrick to shave his head round, so he will look more like a ghost. He goes to the Krusty Krab to show off his costume, but everyone is more afraid of what is inside the costume.

episodes.title: I Was a Teenage Gary
episodes.description: Gary becomes sick when Squidward forgets to feed him, so a doctor has to come and give Gary some medicine. The doctor has Squidward give Gary the shot. Squidward accidentally gives the medicine to SpongeBob instead of Gary, which turns SpongeBob into a snail.

episodes.title: SB-129
episodes.description: Squidward becomes frozen while hiding from SpongeBob and Patrick. He stays frozen for so long, he wakes up in the future. Once he's in the future, he thinks he will be able to get away from SpongeBob and Patrick, but it seems where ever he goes, they are always there somehow.

episodes.title: Karate Choppers
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Sandy just can't stop practicing karate, even after Mr. Krabs warns SpongeBob that he will be fired. Soon Mr. Krabs finds them in the park using karate to make sandwiches, so he hires them both to make Krabby Patties at a super fast rate using Karate.

episodes.title: Sleepy Time
episodes.description: SpongeBob leaves his dream in order to see what everyone else is dreaming about. But the other citizens of Bikini Bottom don't appreciate this because in the process of his "Dream Exploring" he wakes everyone up and disturbs their sleep.

episodes.title: Suds
episodes.description: SpongeBob becomes sick after he leaves the door to the fridge open, and his house becomes icy. But when he gets ready to go to the doctor, Patrick scares him, and tries to cure SpongeBob himself.

episodes.title: Valentine's Day
episodes.description: SpongeBob wants to give Patrick the best Valentine's Day gift ever, a chocolate heart shaped hot air balloon. Sandy starts to drive it over to SpongeBob and Patrick at the Valentine Day fair but, scallops attack the balloon, and SpongeBob must stall for time. Patrick goes crazy waiting for his gift, and starts to attack people at the fair.

episodes.title: The Paper
episodes.description: SpongeBob gets a small piece of paper from Squidward to play with. Squidward thinks that the paper is useless and just gives it away. SpongeBob soon does many fun things with it, and makes Squidward very jealous.

episodes.title: Arrgh!
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick play a pirate board game based on a real treasure map. Mr. Krabs joins in and wins a bunch of times in a row. The next day, Mr. Krabs takes the two boys on a treasure hunt, but they find out later that Mr. Krabs is using the game as a map, and is going crazy trying to find the Flying Dutchman's treasure.

episodes.title: Rock Bottom
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick accidentally get on the wrong bus coming out of an amusement park called Glove World, and head for a city named Rock Bottom. When they get there, Patrick gets on a bus back to Bikini Bottom, and leaves SpongeBob by mistake. How will SpongeBob ever get home?

episodes.title: Texas
episodes.description: Sandy gets homesick, so SpongeBob and Patrick do as much as they can to cheer her up. When they want to throw her a surprise party and she won't come, SpongeBob and Patrick make Sandy chase them to the Krusty Krab, where the party is being held.

episodes.title: Walking Small
episodes.description: Plankton's newest scheme involves getting someone to scare everyone away from "Goo Lagoon" so he can create his new restaurant, "The Mega Bucket." He tricks SpongeBob into scaring everyone away from the beach, until SpongeBob realizes what he is doing is wrong.

episodes.title: Fools in April
episodes.description: Squidward wakes up and finds out it is April Fools Day. April Fools Day is SpongeBob's favorite holiday so Squidward becomes paranoid, thinking SpongeBob will play a joke on him. Squidward plays a mean trick on SpongeBob, but after SpongeBob runs home crying, Squidward must apologize.

episodes.title: Neptune's Spatula
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick go to the Fry Cook Museum and are looking at the exhibits, when they come across the a spatula stuck in hardened grease. This spatula could only be pulled out by a fry cook worthy enough to cook for Neptune himself. SpongeBob pulls the spatula out with ease, and is excepted to move to Atlantis as Neptune's fry cook! But, when Neptune tells SpongeBob he cannot bring his friends, SpongeBob starts to reconsider. Will SpongeBob leave his friends behind?

episodes.title: Hooky
episodes.description: Patrick introduces SpongeBob to a carnival but this "carnival" is really colored fishing hooks dropped by fishermen on land. Mr. Krabs warns SpongeBob to stay away and how dangerous they are, but Patrick keeps on talking about how fun they are. Who will SpongeBob listen to, Patrick or Mr. Krabs?

episodes.title: Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy II
episodes.description: SpongeBob is awarded a prize for his life size Krabby Patty sculptures of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy. The prize is the "Magic Conch" as seen in many episodes of the television show "The Adventures of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy." The conch shell, when blown, will make a noise and Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy will come running! It is meant only for danger. SpongeBob blows the conch for simple chores. Will the heroes be so annoyed they must take back the conch?

episodes.title: Something Smells
episodes.description: SpongeBob eats a peanut onion sundae and acquires a hideous case of bad breath. And he can't quite understand why everyone runs away from him whenever he talks to them.

episodes.title: Bossy Boots
episodes.description: When Pearl remodels the Krusty Krab into a hip local hangout, SpongeBob worries about the fate of the original restaurant (not to mention, his position as Fry Cook!).

episodes.title: Your Shoe's Untied
episodes.description: SpongeBob forgets how to tie his shoes, so he must re-learn how. But no one else knows how, either.

episodes.title: Squid's Day Off
episodes.description: Squidward is put in charge of the Krusty Krab when Mr. Krabs goes to the hospital and decides to take the day off, but can't help thinking SpongeBob will do something wrong.

episodes.title: Big Pink Loser
episodes.description: Patrick realizes that he has never won any awards in his life, so he decides to copy everything that SpongeBob does. SpongeBob has won countless awards, so Patrick is sure that he will win one.

episodes.title: Bubble Buddy
episodes.description: When no one will play with SpongeBob, he creates his own bubble buddy, but it causes many problems around town.

episodes.title: Mermaid Man & Barnacle Boy III
episodes.description: Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy decide to go on vacation, but unfortunately they don't have anyone to look after the Merma-lair, so they ask SpongeBob and Patrick to look after it. However, they accidentally release Man Ray from a prison made of frozen tartar sauce.

episodes.title: Squirrel Jokes
episodes.description: SpongeBob tells jokes in a talent show at the Krusty Krab, but ends up saying jokes about squirrels, which makes Sandy mad.

episodes.title: Christmas Who?
episodes.description: SpongeBob brings Christmas to Bikini Bottom.

episodes.title: Dying for Pie
episodes.description: It's employee brotherhood day and Squidward has nothing to give to SpongeBob, so he accidentally gives SpongeBob a pie bomb. Squidward spends the whole day with SpongeBob because SpongeBob only has one day to live.

episodes.title: Imitation Krabs
episodes.description: In another attempt to steal the Krabby Patty formula, Plankton makes a robot that looks just like Mr. Krabs. But in order to get the formula, he will have to do some odd things as part of the "secret handshake."

episodes.title: Wormy
episodes.description: Sandy is going away and calls SpongeBob and Patrick to take care of her pets. One of them is a worm, and SpongeBob and Patrick have fun with it all day long, until the next day when it transforms into a butterfly and everybody in town gets scared of it.

episodes.title: Patty Hype
episodes.description: The Krusty Krab hasn't had costumers in weeks, so SpongeBob comes up with an idea, but Mr. Krabs and Squidward laugh at the idea. So SpongeBob opens his own restaurant and becomes a huge success in Bikini Bottom.

episodes.title: Survival of the Idiots
episodes.description: Despite Sandy's warning, SpongeBob and Patrick sneak into her treedome, during a terrible snowstorm and since the doorknob is frozen, SpongeBob and Patrick realize they have to wait until spring. Will SpongeBob and Patrick be able to survive the entire winter? Or will Sandy, and the cold weather, stop them first?

episodes.title: Dumped
episodes.description: Suddenly, Gary seems to be hanging out with Patrick more than SpongeBob. SpongeBob thinks it's because he loves Patrick more. But, what's the real reason that Gary is attached to Patrick all of a sudden?

episodes.title: Grandma's Kisses
episodes.description: SpongeBob asks his grandma not to kiss him because her public displays of affection are embarrassing.

episodes.title: Squidville
episodes.description: Squidward is fed up with living next to Spongebob and Patrick, so he finds new neighbors who are more like himself.

episodes.title: No Free Rides
episodes.description: To avoid another year with SpongeBob in her class, Mrs. Puff passes him with bogus extra credit and lets him have his license, but soon realizes that the consequences are beyond bad. When SpongeBob receives a new boat-mobile from his parents, Mrs. Puff attempts to steal it, and SpongeBob will stop at nothing to stop her.

episodes.title: I'm Your Biggest Fanatic
episodes.description: While at a jellyfishing fan convention, SpongeBob meets Kevin C. Cucumber, who gives him a chance to see if he can join his club, The Jellyspotters. However, SpongeBob is unaware that Kevin is only trying to make a fool out of him, but soon discovers the truth after the club attacks him with a robotic queen jellyfish.

episodes.title: Pressure
episodes.description: Sandy and SpongeBob get into a fierce competition doing extreme underwater sports.

episodes.title: The Smoking Peanut
episodes.description: SpongeBob accidentally throws a peanut at Clamu the Oyster and then the police think that the one who threw the peanut was Patrick.

episodes.title: Shanghaied
episodes.description: When a giant anchor falls onto SpongeBob's house, Squidward, SpongeBob and Patrick decide to climb the anchor, and they find the boat of the Flying Dutchman, who imprisons them.

episodes.title: Prehibernation Week
episodes.description: Sandy is going wild over the fact that she will have to hibernate in a week.

episodes.title: Life of Crime
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick find out that you can borrow anything without permission as long as you return it, or that's what wise Mr. Krabs says. SpongeBob and Patrick want a balloon, but neither one has any money, so they "borrow" it and it pops. They decide to run away and live like criminals, because they think they're now "thieves."

episodes.title: The Secret Box
episodes.description: Patrick keeps a small box everywhere he goes and refuses to tell SpongeBob what's in it. Curiosity eventually gets the better of our spongy hero, as he decides to try and sneak a peek while Patrick is sleeping.

episodes.title: Band Geeks
episodes.description: Squidward enlists the aid of SpongeBob and the rest of Bikini Bottom to form a marching band to impress Squidward's old high school rival, Squilliam Fancyson.

episodes.title: Sailor Mouth
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick pick up a "bad word," and start repeating it to the shocked patrons of the Krusty Krab, but Mr. Krabs doesn't like this!

episodes.title: Artist Unknown
episodes.description: Squidward starts to teach an art class at the Recreation Center, but SpongeBob is the only person who shows up.

episodes.title: Jellyfish Hunter
episodes.description: Mr. Krab's turns SpongeBob's idea for 'Jelly Krabby Patties' into a colossal customer favorite, and it leads to trouble when the local population of jellyfish become hunted to near-extinction.

episodes.title: The Fry Cook Games
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick compete in the Fry Cook Games after they get in a fight. Who will come out victorious?

episodes.title: Just One Bite
episodes.description: When SpongeBob learns that Squidward has never actually tried a Krabby Patty, he becomes obsessed with the idea that Squidward must try it.

episodes.title: The Bully
episodes.description: At boating school, a new student shows up, but he says he's gonna kick SpongeBob's butt!

episodes.title: Squid on Strike
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Squidward go on strike after they don't get their paycheck from Mr. Krabs. How long will the strike last?

episodes.title: Sandy, SpongeBob, and the Worm
episodes.description: An Alaskan Bull Worm is on the loose in Bikini Bottom, and Sandy must stop it from destroying the town.

episodes.title: Procrastination
episodes.description: SpongeBob must write an 800-word essay for boating school but gets distracted easily.

episodes.title: I'm with Stupid
episodes.description: Patrick's parents are coming over and Patrick doesn't want to look stupid, so he tells SpongeBob to be stupider than him.

episodes.title: Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy IV
episodes.description: After Mermaid Man accidentally drops his utility belt, SpongeBob finds it and can't resist trying it on.

episodes.title: Doing Time
episodes.description: After SpongeBob accidentally drives into a shipment of juice to the senior home, Mrs. Puff is mistakenly arrested.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Chum Bucket
episodes.description: SpongeBob is forced to work at the Chum Bucket.

episodes.title: Frankendoodle
episodes.description: SpongeBob creates DoodleBob.

episodes.title: Snowball Effect
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick try to show Squidward how much fun it can be to play in the snow.

episodes.title: One Krab's Trash
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs has a garage sale and sells SpongeBob the most valuable of items.

episodes.title: Nasty Patty
episodes.description: A health inspector shows up at the Krusty Krab, and while he is there, SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs see the news about a guy passing himself off as a health inspector to get free food.  Mr. Krabs is so mad he and SpongeBob make a Krabby Patty made with a bunch of nasty things. After it is served to the inspector he chokes on a fly and the two think he died from the patty. They later find out that he was a real health inspector, and that the other one was caught. Now, what will SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs do with the dead health inspector?

episodes.title: Idiot Box
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick buy a big screen TV, just so they can use the box using imagination, while Squidward refuses to believe that they are using their imagination inside the box on account of all the noise they are making.

episodes.title: As Seen on TV
episodes.description: After SpongeBob has a small role in a commercial for the Krusty Krab, he thinks he is now famous.

episodes.title: Can You Spare a Dime?
episodes.description: Squidward quits his job after Mr. Krabs accuses him of stealing the first dime he ever made, but Squidward has a hard time finding a new job.

episodes.title: No Weenies Allowed
episodes.description: Spongebob must find a way to prove that he's tough so he can get into the Salty Spitoon.

episodes.title: Squilliam Returns
episodes.description: When Squidward's old school rival, Squilliam, returns to Bikini Bottom to brag to Squidward, Squidward tells him that he owns a five star restaurant to get him to stop. Squidward must get Spongebob to turn the Krusty Krab into a fancy restaurant before Squilliam arrives.

episodes.title: The Algae's Always Greener
episodes.description: Plankton invents a machine enabling him to switch lives with Mr. Krabs, but he finds out that Mr. Krab's life isn't as good as it seems.

episodes.title: SpongeGuard on Duty
episodes.description: SpongeBob volunteers for a lifeguard job, despite the fact that he can't swim.

episodes.title: Krab Borg
episodes.description: After watching a horror movie, SpongeBob thinks that Mr. Krabs is a robot.

episodes.title: Rock-a-Bye Bivalve
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick find an abandoned clam and decide to take care of it.

episodes.title: Wet Painters
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs has SpongeBob and Patrick paint the inside of his house, with a strict rule to not get paint on anything besides the walls.

episodes.title: Krusty Krab Training Video
episodes.description: A training video for new employees of the Krusty Krab, which goes over the basics of being a good employee.

episodes.title: Party Pooper Pants
episodes.description: SpongeBob buys a "Throw The Best Party Ever" kit and invites all 177 of his closest friends to a house party. But when he accidentally locks himself out of his house during the party, he must try to get back in.

episodes.title: Chocolate with Nuts
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick decide to become rich entrepreneurs by selling chocolate bars door to door.

episodes.title: Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy V
episodes.description: After being treated too much like a child by everyone, Barnacle Boy quits being a superhero and decides to be a supervillain.

episodes.title: Club SpongeBob
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick's club is too small for Squidward... literally. But Squidward forces his way in, "propelling" the clubhouse into the middle of nowhere.

episodes.title: My Pretty Seahorse
episodes.description: It's spring in Bikini Bottom, and SpongeBob finds a wild seahorse and decides to keep her.

episodes.title: Graveyard Shift
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Squidward work the night shift.

episodes.title: Krusty Love
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs falls in love with Mrs. Puff.

episodes.title: New Student Starfish
episodes.description: Patrick gets bored everyday when SpongeBob goes to boating school, so SpongeBob insists that Patrick could join him. But what happens when Patrick makes SpongeBob lose a Noodle Student Star?

episodes.title: Clams
episodes.description: In celebration of Mr. Krabs' one millionth dollar, he takes Squidward and SpongeBob on a fishing trip. After a giant clam snatches his precious dollar, Mr. Krabs tries to get it back.

episodes.title: The Great Snail Race
episodes.description: When Squidward gets a purebred snail named Snelle, SpongeBob challenges him in the great snail race.

episodes.title: Mid-Life Crustacean
episodes.description: When Mr. Krabs feels like an aging old man, he tries to feel young again, so he goes out with SpongeBob and Patrick for a night on the town.

episodes.title: The Sponge Who Could Fly
episodes.description: SpongeBob tries his best to make an invention that allows him to fly. When all of them fail, people start to think that SpongeBob is crazy until he puts a hair dryer his pants. The hot air in his pants allows him to fly! But then, people start asking SpongeBob to do things for them, stopping him from flying with the jellyfish.

episodes.title: Gary Takes a Bath
episodes.description: The day that Gary has to take a bath arrives, but he doesn't want to take one.

episodes.title: Born Again Krabs
episodes.description: After Mr. Krabs eats a rotten Krabby Patty to save money, he ends up hospitalized for food poisoning and bargains with the Flying Dutchman for his soul, leading him to second-guess his cheap and miserly ways.

episodes.title: I Had an Accident
episodes.description: After SpongeBob shatters his buttocks in a sandboarding injury, he becomes paranoid of everything and confines himself to his own home with inanimate objects for friends.

episodes.title: Missing Identity
episodes.description: While at a diner, SpongeBob tells the story of when he lost his name tag.

episodes.title: Plankton's Army
episodes.description: It's the 25th anniversary of Plankton's first attempt to steal the Krabby Patty Secret Formula, and Plankton enlists his relatives to help him try again.

episodes.title: Ugh
episodes.description: SpongeBob, Patrick, and Squidward's long ago ancestors, SpongeGar, Pattar, and Squagg, discover fire.

episodes.title: Krabby Land
episodes.description: The first day of summer lures Mr. Krabs into making a children's theme park, which doesn't turn out the way he thinks it should.

episodes.title: The Camping Episode
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick decide to go camping for the weekend, they camp out in the backyard. Squidward lures a sea bear to the campsite by doing stuff that would allure a sea bear.

episodes.title: SpongeBob Meets the Strangler
episodes.description: SpongeBob goes on his early litter patrol when he catches The Strangler. After he calls the police, The Strangler (disguised with a fake mustache) decides to be SpongeBob's bodyguard. After three parties at SpongeBob's house, The Strangler tries to strangle SpongeBob, but never gets the chance to be alone.

episodes.title: Pranks a Lot
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick buy a prank called Invisible Spray. After taunting each other with the spray, they run out and decide to haunt Bikini Bottom while being invisible, preferably being ghosts. But with their last victim Mr. Krab, he washes them out with water and exposes them nude (they took their clothes off because the spray stains clothes) to the whole Krusty Krab, embarrassing them.

episodes.title: Fear of a Krabby Patty
episodes.description: Plankton unleashes a new plan; to get the Krusty Krab to work 24 hours. SpongeBob thinks this is a dream, until he thinks he is being chased by killer Krabby Patties.

episodes.title: Shell of a Man
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs is going to a naval reunion, but molts (leaves his shell) before he goes. He asks SpongeBob to go in his shell and imitate him for the reunion.

episodes.title: The Lost Mattress
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs complains that his back hurts, so SpongeBob and Patrick buy a new mattress and Squidward tries to take credit for it. They give the new mattress to Mr. Krabs, but Mr. Krabs put his money in his old mattress, which SpongeBob, Patrick, and Squidward must find while Mr. Krabs is at the hospital.

episodes.title: Krabs vs. Plankton
episodes.description: Plankton tries to steal the formula, but slips and sues Mr. Krabs. Mr. Krabs hires a lawyer, but his lawyer slips and is hurt, so SpongeBob must try to help Mr. Krabs win the case by trying to open a briefcase that has something very important in it.

episodes.title: Skill Crane
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs gets a new toy vender by the name of "Skill Crane." At first, Squidward doesn't like it, but when Mr. Krabs lets him and SpongeBob give it a try, Squidward becomes obsessed with it. Can he win anything from the Skill Crane before it ruins his life?

episodes.title: Good Neighbors
episodes.description: It's Sunday and Squidward just wants to relax. But when SpongeBob and Patrick elect him as Good Neighbor President, they won't leave him alone.

episodes.title: Selling Out
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs sells the Krusty Krab to a conglomerate that plans to turn it into a big corporate chain.

episodes.title: Funny Pants
episodes.description: Squidward fools SpongeBob into thinking that he has a laughter-related illness and convinces SpongeBob that if he laughs one more time in the next 24 hours, his laugh box could explode.

episodes.title: Mermaid Man & Barnacle Boy VI - The Motion Picture
episodes.description: The adventures of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy are being told in a thrilling new motion picture. But after SpongeBob learns the heroes will be played by young actors, he sets out to make his own version of the movie using the real guys, fresh from their retirement home.

episodes.title: Enemy In-Law
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs' mom is dating again, and it seems like things could be serious. Krabs tries to be happy for his mother, but he is absolutely horrified when he learns that the secret paramour is his arch-rival Plankton! Convinced that this just another trick aimed at getting the family formula for Krabby Patties, Krabs tries to reveal Plankton's schemes and break up the ill-favored fling.

episodes.title: Patrick SmartPants
episodes.description: After Patrick accidentally falls off a cliff while jellyfishing, he wakes up with superior intellect.

episodes.title: SquidBob TentaclePants
episodes.description: Sandy's experimental teleportation device malfunctions, melding SpongeBob and Squidward into one body.

episodes.title: Have You Seen This Snail?
episodes.description: While trying to beat a paddle-ball world record, SpongeBob forgets to feed Gary -- for 10 days. Gary runs away to downtown Bikini Bottom where he is taken in by a kindly old woman who confuses him with one of her many deceased pets. Once SpongeBob realizes that he has neglected Gary, he sets out in a town-wide search for him. Meanwhile, as Gary is wrapped in comfy blankets and indulged in an endless assortment of snacks, he discovers a very dark secret about this sweet old woman...

episodes.title: Dunces and Dragons
episodes.description: After a freak jousting accident at a Medieval Times-style restaurant, SpongeBob and Patrick are transported to a medieval version of Bikini Bottom. There they are mistaken for great knights and sent on a quest by King Krabs to rescue his daughter, the Princess Pearl, from the clutches of the evil wizard Planktonamor.

episodes.title: Krusty Towers
episodes.description: After Mr. Krab's gets a huge hotel bill he decides that he can make a profit from opening his own. When Patrick decides to visit the hotel Mr. Krabs demands Squidward to never deny a guest even the most ridiculous request, but after Patrick frustrates Squidward so badly he quits his job. Then he decides to check into the Krusty Towers.

episodes.title: Mrs. Puff, You're Fired
episodes.description: Mrs. Puff gets fired from her boating school job due to her lack of passing Spongebob. Instead, a more-intense new instructor takes her place.

episodes.title: Chimps Ahoy
episodes.description: The Chimpanzee beneficiaries of Sandy's undersea treedome are paying a visit to see what progress she has made with her inventions. But Sandy doesn't think any of her work will satisfy the chimps, and if they don't like what she's invented Sandy could lose her funding forcing her to leave Bikini Bottom. SpongeBob and Patrick decide to help their distraught friend by taking over her work and finishing her inventions.

episodes.title: Ghost Host
episodes.description: The Flying Dutchman takes up residence at SpongeBob's house where he proceeds to scare, startle and surprise SpongeBob around the clock. Eventually all the spooky shenanigans grow old, and SpongeBob is no longer afraid of the Dutchman. This creates a panic for the old ghost who now fears that he has lost his scary touch. So SpongeBob decides to lend a hand and help the Flying Dutchman learn to scare people again.

episodes.title: Whale of a Birthday
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs wants to give his daughter Pearl the best birthday ever. While he works on the party, SpongeBob is assigned the task of figuring out what Pearl would like for a present. So he trails her through the Bikini Bottom mall and takes note of everything she thinks is "Coral." Once Pearl arrives at her party she is horrified to find that her dad's miserly ways have won out again. What was supposed to be the most fun and fabulous event ended up cheap and lame. It looks like Pearl's birthday will go down in history as the worst one ever - until SpongeBob shows up with a truck-load of presents. Everything Pearl looked at in the mall was so Coral that SpongeBob bought it all - maxing out Mr. Krab's credit card in the process.

episodes.title: Karate Island
episodes.description: SpongeBob receives an invitation to take part in a competition on mysterious Karate Island for the chance to be crowned "King of Karate." SpongeBob and Sandy arrive at Karate Island and it turns out that it was just all a set-up to make SpongeBob buy real estate.

episodes.title: All That Glitters
episodes.description: When a customer orders the one thing that no one has ordered for years, the monster krabby patty, SpongeBob tries to lift it, but old Spat cracks in two. So he sells every single thing he owns (plus his clothes) for a new spatula, but the spatula refuses to flip a single patty, so SpongeBob tries to get his old spatula back. Will Spat forgive him? Will SpongeBob ever be dressed again?

episodes.title: Wishing You Well
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs makes SpongeBob go down the new wishing well after experiencing one for himself, and Patrick and Squidward accidentally join in. So, will they be able to get out and watch everybody's wishes come true? Or will Mr. Krabs just make them stay down there when he enjoys the money?

episodes.title: New Leaf
episodes.description: In the battle for fast food supremacy, Plankton has decided to throw in the towel and start a new business selling trinkets and souvenir gifts. He even renames his store from The Chum Bucket to The Chumporium. But Mr. Krabs doesn't buy the change for a second. He's determined to prove that this is nothing more than one of Plankton's elaborate schemes aimed at stealing the Krabby Patty formula.

episodes.title: Once Bitten
episodes.description: Gary starts biting everyone in town, starting with Squidward. When Squid asks if Gary has been up-to-date on all of his snail shots, SpongeBob reveals that he's never done any of that before. This only sends Squidward into a panic. Does he now have some rare snail-related disease? Is this the end for Squidward?

episodes.title: Squidtastic Voyage
episodes.description: While Squidward is playing the clarinet, he accidentally swallows the reed. SpongeBob and Patrick take a microscopic submarine to try to retrieve it from inside Squidward.

episodes.title: Bummer Vacation
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs forces SpongeBob to take a vacation, but he doesn't know how. Meanwhile, Patrick takes SpongeBob's place as fry cook.

episodes.title: Best Day Ever
episodes.description: SpongeBob is going to have the best day ever. But when work, karate, jellyfishing and Squidward's clarinet recital don't go as planned will his day be ruined?

episodes.title: Wigstruck
episodes.description: SpongeBob finds an old-time wig and starts wearing it everywhere he goes.

episodes.title: That's No Lady
episodes.description: A misunderstanding over a vacation getaway advertisement causes Patrick to think he must "get out of town" or face dire consequences. SpongeBob can't bear the thought of his best buddy moving away, so he decides to do what he can to hide Patrick's identity from his "pursuers." After many failed attempts at disguises, they finally settle on the perfect one: Patrick is transformed into a girl, Patricia, to be exact. Patricia catches the eye of Mr. Krabs and soon she becomes the most charming waitress/waiter at the Krusty Krab.

episodes.title: The Thing
episodes.description: After being covered in cement, the Bikini Bottomites are convinced that Squidward is an unknown species and SpongeBob tries to keep him as a pet.

episodes.title: Hocus Pocus
episodes.description: SpongeBob tries out his new magic kit on Squidward and is convinced he's turned his neighbor into an ice cream cone!

episodes.title: Driven to Tears
episodes.description: For the 58th time in a row, SpongeBob has failed his driving test, so Patrick takes a test and passes. But SpongeBob is angry that he did.

episodes.title: Rule of Dumb
episodes.description: Patrick's ancestors were adlings, so Patrick is the legal king of Bikini Bottom and now he reigns/misrules Bikini Bottom.

episodes.title: The Pink Purloiner
episodes.description: Patrick is jealous of SpongeBob's jellyfish net. When SpongeBob finds out that it's been stolen, he suspects Patrick is the culprit.

episodes.title: The Gift of Gum
episodes.description: It's Best Friends Day, so Patrick and SpongeBob trade presents.

episodes.title: Rise and Shine
episodes.description: Take a look inside Patrick Star's rock, where we see that his morning routine is anything but ordinary.

episodes.title: Waiting
episodes.description: After SpongeBob discovers that his breakfast cereal has an offer for a free toy, he mails his requests. But now the hardest part is upon him: waiting for the toy to arrive.

episodes.title: Sing a Song of Patrick
episodes.description: After Patrick writes a song, SpongeBob helps him try to get it played on the radio.

episodes.title: Born to Be Wild
episodes.description: When SpongeBob hears that a ferocious biker gang is coming to town, SpongeBob dons his leather jacket, warms up his bike, and prepares to protect the town all by himself.

episodes.title: Best Frenemies
episodes.description: A new Kelp Smoothie chain is opening up all over Bikini Bottom. The chain's smoothies are so delicious that soon everyone in town can be seen drinking one. But now that customers already have their smoothie, they don't need to buy a beverage with their Krusty Krab order. This could hurt Mr. Krabs' profits.

episodes.title: Friend or Foe
episodes.description: After yet another attack on the Krusty Krab by Plankton, SpongeBob asks Mr. Krabs why they hate each other so much. Mr. Krabs tells his side of the story in a series of flashbacks.

episodes.title: Spy Buddies
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs enlists SpongeBob and Patrick to spy on Plankton.

episodes.title: Boat Smarts
episodes.description: Mrs. Puff presents a film on good and bad boat drivers.

episodes.title: Good Ol' Whatshisname
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs organizes a work contest for SpongeBob and Squidward that involves naming all the customers at the Krusty Krab.

episodes.title: The Krusty Sponge
episodes.description: After a food critic raves about SpongeBob's cooking, Mr. Krabs makes him the focal point of the Krusty Krab restaurant.

episodes.title: Squid Wood
episodes.description: Rejected yet again by Squidward, SpongeBob decides that if he can't hang with the real Squidward, he'll make his own.

episodes.title: New Digs
episodes.description: After being late to work, SpongeBob decides to move into the Krusty Krab.

episodes.title: Krabs à la Mode
episodes.description: Plankton turns down the Krusty Krab's thermostat as part of another Krabby Patty stealing scheme, but it backfires on him when Mr. Krabs turns the Krusty Krab into a skating rink.

episodes.title: To Love a Patty
episodes.description: SpongeBob falls in love with a Krabby Patty.

episodes.title: Breath of Fresh Squidward
episodes.description: Squidward gets electrocuted by his own electric fence, causing a complete change in his personality.

episodes.title: Roller Cowards
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick are determined to ride a new roller coaster at Glove World called "The Fiery Fist o' Pain," but the more they think about it, the more they get scared.

episodes.title: Bucket Sweet Bucket
episodes.description: While Mr. Krabs is on vacation, Plankton tricks SpongeBob, Patrick, and Squidward into helping him redecorate the Chum Bucket.

episodes.title: The Original Fry Cook
episodes.description: When Mr Krabs' old fry cook pays a special visit to the Krusty Krab, SpongeBob is in awe of his predecessor, who has since become a world renowned chef.

episodes.title: Night Light
episodes.description: After SpongeBob reads a scary book before bedtime, he sees scary creatures in the dark.

episodes.title: Money Talks
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs makes a wish that he could talk to money.

episodes.title: SpongeBob vs. The Patty Gadget
episodes.description: Squidward invents a Krabby Patty-making machine to try to make SpongeBob lose his job. SpongeBob will not go down without a fight, so he competes against it.

episodes.title: Slimy Dancing
episodes.description: SpongeBob, Patrick, and Squidward enter a dance contest, but when Squidward fails to proceed to the finals, he decides to coach SpongeBob to win the trophy.

episodes.title: A Flea in Her Dome
episodes.description: SpongeBob and Patrick organize a party in the Treedome to welcome Sandy, who is returning from Texas. However, unknown to her, Sandy has carried back fleas.

episodes.title: The Donut of Shame
episodes.description: After Patrick accidentally takes SpongeBob's donut, he is wracked with guilt over his action.

episodes.title: The Krusty Plate
episodes.description: During an evening of washing dishes at the Krusty Krab, SpongeBob cannot remove a spot from a dinner plate.

episodes.title: Picture Day
episodes.description: It's picture day for the Boating School year book, and SpongeBob has spent all morning getting ready for it. Now he has to make it to school without getting dirty, but this proves to be more difficult than he imagined.

episodes.title: Pat No Pay
episodes.description: When Patrick eats Krabby Patties without paying, Mr. Krabs puts him to work in the restaurant to pay it back.

episodes.title: BlackJack
episodes.description: When SpongeBob's parents go missing, he suspects that his cousin BlackJack, the family bully who used to torment him when they were little, has kidnapped them.

episodes.title: Blackened Sponge
episodes.description: While brushing his teeth, SpongeBob accidentally gets a black eye. Too embarrassed to tell anyone the truth behind his injury, SpongeBob makes up a tale about a fight with a thug.

episodes.title: Mermaid Man vs SpongeBob
episodes.description: After Plankton turns Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy into his minions with his mind controlling device, he controls the heroes and orders them to encourage the customers of the Krusty Krab to eat at the Chum Bucket.

episodes.title: Le Big Switch
episodes.description: After being enrolled in a chef exchange program, SpongeBob switches places with a snooty French chef from a high-end restaurant.

episodes.title: Fungus Among Us
episodes.description: After SpongeBob becomes infected by an itch-causing fungus, he accidentally spreads it to the customers at the Krusty Krab.

episodes.title: Atlantis SquarePantis
episodes.description: SpongeBob and his friends journey to Atlantis, where each member of the group is charmed by an attraction.

episodes.title: The Inmates of Summer
episodes.description: Instead of getting on a ship headed for summer camp, SpongeBob and Patrick accidentally board a ship full of prisoners on their way to jail on Inferno Island.

episodes.title: The Two Faces of Squidward
episodes.description: After SpongeBob accidentally breaks Squidward's face by slamming a door into it, the resulting plastic surgery repair makes Squidward look handsome.

episodes.title: The Battle of Bikini Bottom
episodes.description: When Patrick and SpongeBob discover they have conflicting views on cleanliness, their disagreement blows up into an epic battle.

episodes.title: Banned in Bikini Bottom
episodes.description: SpongeBob loves Krabby Patties so much, he can't help singing and dancing when he's around them. Appalled by his behavior, Miss Gristlepuss bans Krabby Patties in Bikini Bottom.

episodes.title: SpongeHenge
episodes.description: A windy day in Bikini Bottom causes SpongeBob's holes to create a jellyfish-enticing sound.

episodes.title: 20,000 Patties Under the Sea
episodes.description: Mr. Krabs opens a mobile underwater restaurant to compete with Plankton.

episodes.title: Stanley S. SquarePants
episodes.description: When SpongeBob's klutzy cousin Stanley comes to visit, he attempts to get a job at the Krusty Krab but quickly causes trouble.

episodes.title: To Save a Squirrel
episodes.description: After SpongeBob and Patrick stow away on one of Sandy's wilderness adventures, they become stranded in a cave.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
description: After a demon attack leaves his family slain and his sister cursed, Tanjiro embarks upon a perilous journey to find a cure and avenge those he's lost.

episodes.title: Cruelty
episodes.description: It is the Taisho Period (i.e. 1912-1926). Tanjiro Kamado is living a modest but blissful life in the mountains with his family. One day, when he returns from selling charcoal in town, he finds the remains of his slaughtered family in pools of blood after a demon attack. Tanjiro rushes down the snowy mountain with the sole survivor, his sister Nezuko, on his back. But on the way, Nezuko suddenly snarls, turning on Tanjiro.

episodes.title: Trainer Sakonji Urokodaki
episodes.description: At Giyu Tomioka's urging, Tanjiro heads for Mt. Sagiri with his sister Nezuko who's been turned into a demon. During the night, Tanjiro catches the smell of blood from inside a temple. He enters, thinking that someone might be hurt, only to come upon a man-eating demon. When the demon attacks, Tanjiro manages to fight back with his hatchet, but the demon's strength is overwhelming. Just as the demon is about to finish him off, Tanjiro is saved by none other than.

episodes.title: Sabito and Makomo
episodes.description: The Demon Slayer Corps... An organization that's been hunting down demons since ancient times. Sakonji Urokodaki starts training Tanjiro for Final Selection, the test for joining the unit. Navigating a mountain riddled with booby traps, dry sword swings, waterfall immersion and breathing techniques... A year later, Urokodaki informs Tanjiro that he has nothing more to teach him, and gives him one last hurdle to overcome in front of a giant boulder.

episodes.title: Final Selection
episodes.description: To pass Final Selection, one must survive for seven days on Mt. Fujikasane where demons captured by the Demon Slayers have been imprisoned. So begins the battle for survival between the young swordsmen and the demons. Armed with the breathing techniques and stances he'd learned from Sakonji Urokodaki, Tanjiro slashes demon after demon. His two years of training have not gone to waste. But just then, a morphed demon appears out of nowhere.

episodes.title: My Own Steel
episodes.description: When day breaks, there are only four swordsmen left standing after the seven-day battle. The guides who greet Tanjiro and the other survivors explain the Demon Slayer Corps system. All four are issued uniforms and Kasugai Crows as messengers, after which they must select the ore for their own Nichirin swords. After gazing hard at each lump of ore, and using his keen sense of smell, the one Tanjiro chooses is...

episodes.title: Swordsman Accompanying a Demon
episodes.description: Tanjiro is now clad in the uniform of the Demon Slayer Corps. His Nichirin Sword on his hip, and Nezuko, now awake, in a special box made by Urokodaki on his back, he heads out for his first assignment. A town to the northwest where girls have been vanishing nightly. There, Tanjiro meets Kazumi, haggard with worry after his girlfriend's been abducted. Though he does catch the scent of a demon nearby, there's just no demon in sight. Tanjiro is sure that a demon is behind this sinister incident...

episodes.title: Muzan Kibutsuji
episodes.description: Now split into three, the demons have driven Tanjiro into a corner. It is then that Nezuko attacks. Now that she’s become a demon herself, she’s no longer so weak that she needs protection. His mind made up, Tanjiro follows one of the demons into the swamp now spreading across the ground. Waiting for him there is...

episodes.title: The Smell of Enchanting Blood
episodes.description: The next mission is in Asakusa, Tokyo. Tanjiro is taken aback by the opulent Taisho Era cityscape, but soon picks up the demon’s scent there. His pursuit of the scent leads him to Muzan Kibutsuji. Tanjiro attempts to strike him down. But Kibutsuji transforms a passerby into demon, triggering a commotion. As Tanjiro desperately tries to get things under control, someone appears before him...

episodes.title: Temari Demon and Arrow Demon
episodes.description: It was two demons named Tamayo and Yushiro who came to Tanjiro’s rescue. Using the “Eyeblind” spell, Tamayo guides Tanjiro and Nezuko to her house. There, through his conversation with Tamayo, Tanjiro learns that there is a way to return demons to human form. Just then, two demons in pursuit of Tanjiro locate the house and unleash a furious assault...

episodes.title: Together Forever
episodes.description: Tanjiro’s crisis continues. He uses multiple forms of the Water Breathing technique to hold out against Yahaba’s final Blood Demon Art, the "Kouketsu Arrow." Meanwhile, Nezuko and Susamaru are still battling it out. Worried about the outcome, Tamayo unleashes her own Blood Demon Art.

episodes.title: Tsuzumi Mansion
episodes.description: Tanjiro's next destination, according to his Kasugai Crow, is to the south-southeast. On the way, Tanjiro runs into his fellow Final Selection survivor, the swordsman Zenitsu Agatsuma. Tanjiro has a hard time dealing with Zenitsu's passive attitude as they head deep into the mountains. They encounter two children whose older brother was taken away right in front of their house. There, Zenitsu hears the sound of a tsuzumi ringing out from somewhere.

episodes.title: The Boar Bares Its Fangs, Zenitsu Sleeps
episodes.description: Inside the house, where the rooms spin each time the tsuzumi is played, Tanjiro gets separated from Zenitsu Agatsuma. Without Tanjiro by his side, Zenitsu is overcome by fear and despair as he takes Shoichi through the house. Meanwhile, Tanjiro meets the master of the house, the tsuzumi-playing demon, and an odd-looking man wearing a boar’s head mask.

episodes.title: Something More Important Than Life
episodes.description: Every time Kyogai, the master of house, plays his tsuzumi, the room spins and Tanjiro struggles. Debilitated by the fractured bones he sustained in his previous battle, Tanjiro tries to fire himself up as he desperately fights on, but he is overwhelmed by Kyogai's Blood Demon Art. Will he find a way to slice off Kyogai's head?

episodes.title: The House With the Wisteria Family Crest
episodes.description: After a desperate fight to the death, Tanjiro prevails over Kyogai. He exits the house to find Zenitsu who had escaped earlier. But it is then that he sees the strange circumstances before him... The battered Zenitsu holding the box containing Nezuko in his arms while the man in the boar's head mask stands in the way with two Nichirin Swords drawn.

episodes.title: Mount Natagumo
episodes.description: Their next destination is to the north-northwest. Tanjiro and Nezuko head towards Mount Natagumo with Zenitsu and Inosuke. This mountain is covered with spider webs and is swarming with innumerable spiders. Leaving the cowering Zenitsu behind, Tanjiro and Inosuke head up the mountain where they run into fellow Demon Slayers entangled in spider webs.

episodes.title: Letting Someone Else Go First
episodes.description: Tanjiro and Inosuke battle the Demon Slayers trapped by spider webs. After slashing the threads and destroying the webs, they head deeper into the mountain. The farther they advance through the forest, the thicker the threads become, and those under their control start moving in ways impossible for a human being. Stopping the Demon Slayers without hurting them isn't going to be easy, but then Tanjiro makes a certain move...

episodes.title: You Must Master a Single Thing
episodes.description: One of the Twelve Kizuki, a direct subordinate of Muzan Kibutsuji, is here somewhere. When Tanjiro slays the Mother Spider Demon of Mt. Natagumo, he learns that a demon who might hold the key to turning Nezuko back into a human is somewhere in this very forest. With the battered Inosuke in tow, he heads deeper into the forest.
